statement.en: Erlik is the god of death and the underworld in Turkic mythology, the underworld sometimes called Tamag (hell).

basis_claims.quote: In Turkic mythology, Erlik was involved in the creation of humanity. He slew the messenger-god, Maidere/Maydere, and is a teacher of sin. He is sometimes represented by a totemic bear.

statement.id: Erlik terlibat dalam penciptaan manusia, membunuh dewa utusan Maidere, dan mengajarkan dosa; kadang ia dilambangkan dengan beruang totem.
statement.en: Erlik took part in the creation of humanity, slew the messenger god Maidere and teaches sin; he is sometimes represented by a totemic bear.

basis_claims.quote: Erlik gilt als Ursache von Krankheit und Tod, und als Richter über die Verstorbenen in der Unterwelt. Über jene Unterwelt regierte Erlik in deren tiefstem Punkt in einem Schloss.

statement.id: Erlik dianggap penyebab penyakit dan kematian serta hakim bagi orang mati, yang memerintah dari sebuah istana di titik terdalam dunia bawah.
statement.en: Erlik is held to cause sickness and death and to judge the dead, ruling from a castle at the deepest point of the underworld.

erlik.aura_policy: Character presence through positioning, framing, expression, scene atmosphere and natural lighting. No generic magical envelope, emitted halo, neon outline, energy ribbons or luminous colored mist. Magical effects only where source-described physical traits, manifestations or documented abilities warrant them, and only to an appropriate degree.

aura_revision.rationale: Bear emits crimson-violet smoke/ribbons and red eye bulbs; source only supports symbolic totemic bear representation.

artistic_changes: Character presence conveyed by pose, composition, scene atmosphere and natural lighting; effects only where the source supports them.

the-dragon-of-the-north.depicted_variant: Kreutzwald's malevolent giant Northern Frog: armoured scales and two candle-bright eyes, not the modern protector interpretation.
visual_requirements: Giant low broad frog-like body and frog limbs
Dense armour-like scales covering the body
Exactly two large bright eyes; restrained source-supported light
No conventional dragon wings, horns or fire breath
Trees provide reference for the documented gigantic scale
the-dragon-of-the-north.aura: Threatening presence through looming crouch, predatory gaze, low viewpoint and cold natural woodland light; only the eyes emit restrained documented candle-like light.

basis_claims.quote: is a legendary frog-like creature in Estonian lore. The story was popularized by Friedrich Reinhold Kreutzwald in the collection Eesti rahva ennemuistsed jutud or Old Tales of the Estonian People (1866).

statement.id: Naga dari Utara atau Katak Utara adalah makhluk legenda mirip katak dalam cerita rakyat Estonia; kisahnya dipopulerkan Friedrich Reinhold Kreutzwald dalam kumpulan Eesti rahva ennemuistsed jutud (Old Tales of the Estonian People, 1866).
statement.en: The Dragon of the North or Northern Frog is a legendary frog-like creature of Estonian lore; the story was popularised by Friedrich Reinhold Kreutzwald in the collection Eesti rahva ennemuistsed jutud (Old Tales of the Estonian People, 1866).

basis_claims.quote: The frog is described as a massive, dragon-like monster that wreaks havoc on the land until it is defeated.

statement.id: Katak itu digambarkan sebagai monster raksasa mirip naga yang memorakporandakan negeri sampai akhirnya dikalahkan.
statement.en: The frog is described as a massive, dragon-like monster that wreaks havoc on the land until it is defeated.

basis_claims.quote: there lived a terrible monster, who came out of the North, and laid waste whole tracts of country, devouring both men and beasts

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu, sesosok monster mengerikan datang dari Utara, menghancurkan wilayah-wilayah luas dan memangsa manusia serta hewan.
statement.en: In the tale, a terrible monster came out of the North, laying waste whole tracts of country and devouring both men and beasts.

basis_claims.quote: "The frog's body was completely covered with scales, which were stronger than stone and iron, so that nothing could harm it. Its two large eyes shone night and day like the brightest candles..."

statement.id: Tubuh katak itu tertutup sisik yang lebih kuat dari batu dan besi sehingga tak ada yang bisa melukainya, dan kedua mata besarnya bersinar siang dan malam seperti lilin paling terang.
statement.en: The frog's body was covered with scales stronger than stone and iron, so nothing could harm it, and its two large eyes shone night and day like the brightest candles.

eryr-gwern-abwy.depicted_variant: Ancient Welsh eagle answering Arthur's envoys about Mabon
visual_requirements: Ancient Welsh eagle answering Arthur's envoys about Mabon
Coherent anatomy and documented mythic scene
eryr-gwern-abwy.aura: Presence through source-backed form and physical scene; no generic glow, ribbons or magical mist.

basis_claims.quote: Un o'r Anifeiliaid Hynaf yn chwedloniaeth Cymru yw Eryr Gwern Abwy. Cyfeirir at yr eryr mytholegol hwn yn chwedl Culhwch ac Olwen.

statement.id: Eryr Gwern Abwy (elang Gwern Abwy) adalah salah satu Hewan Tertua (Anifeiliaid Hynaf) dalam mitologi Wales (Cymru) dan disebut dalam kisah Culhwch ac Olwen.
statement.en: Eryr Gwern Abwy (the Eagle of Gwern Abwy) is one of the Oldest Animals (Anifeiliaid Hynaf) in the mythology of Wales (Cymru) and is mentioned in the tale Culhwch ac Olwen.

basis_claims.quote: when I first came hither there was a rock here, from the top of which I pecked at the stars every evening; and now it is not so much as a span high.

statement.id: Elang berkata saat pertama datang ada batu yang puncaknya ia patuk bintang-bintang setiap malam, dan kini batu itu tingginya tak sampai sejengkal.
statement.en: The Eagle says that when he first came there was a rock from whose top he pecked at the stars every evening, and now it is not so much as a span high.

basis_claims.quote: Unless he know something of him whom you seek, I cannot tell who may. However, I will guide you to the place where he is.

statement.id: Elang berkata hanya sang salmon yang mungkin tahu, dan ia sanggup menuntun para utusan ke tempat salmon itu berada.
statement.en: The Eagle says only the salmon may know, and offers to guide the envoys to where he is.

basis_claims.quote: we have come to thee an embassy from Arthur, to ask thee if thou knowest aught of Mabon the son of Modron

statement.id: Para utusan Arthur bertanya kepada Elang Gwern Abwy apakah ia tahu sesuatu tentang Mabon putra Modron.
statement.en: Arthur's envoys ask the Eagle of Gwern Abwy whether he knows anything of Mabon the son of Modron.

artistic_changes: Painterly square composition
Clothing, weather and exact setting details are editorial unless identified in claims

presentation_revision.rationale: Replaces ordinary animal presentation with Ancient Welsh eagle answering Arthur's envoys about Mabon

loong.depicted_variant: Chinese four-legged serpentine dragon with deer antlers and crocodilian head, rain and flaming pearl.

visual_requirements.description: Serpentine dragon with exactly four legs, deer antlers and crocodilian head.
Rain domain and pursuit of flaming pearl.

loong.aura: Documented distribution of rain, powerful storm-rain scene and flaming pearl.

basis_claims.quote: The Chinese dragon, known as long or loong (/lʊŋ/ LUUNG) is a legendary creature in Chinese mythology, Chinese folklore, and Chinese culture generally. Chinese dragons have many animal-like forms, such as turtles and fish, but are most commonly depicted as snake-like with four legs.

statement.id: Loong adalah naga dalam mitologi Tiongkok, lazim digambarkan menyerupai ular dengan empat kaki.
statement.en: Loong belongs to Chinese mythology and commonly has a serpentine shape with four legs.

basis_claims.quote: "The antlers of a deer. The head of a crocodile. A demon's eyes. The neck of a snake. A tortoise's viscera. A hawk's claws. The palms of a tiger. A cow's ears. And it hears through its horns, its ears being deprived of all power of hearing".

statement.id: Doré mencatat varian anatomi dengan tanduk rusa dan kepala buaya.
statement.en: Doré records an anatomical variant with deer antlers and a crocodile head.

basis_claims.quote: Many pictures of Chinese dragons show a flaming pearl under their chin or in their claws. The pearl is associated with spiritual energy, wisdom, prosperity, power, immortality, thunder, or the moon. Chinese art often depicts a pair of dragons chasing or fighting over a flaming pearl.

statement.id: Naga dalam seni sering mengejar atau memperebutkan mutiara menyala.
statement.en: Art often shows dragons pursuing or contesting a flaming pearl.

basis_claims.quote: Chinese dragons are strongly associated with water and weather in popular religion. They are believed to be the rulers of moving bodies of water, such as waterfalls, rivers, or seas. The Dragon god is the dispenser of rain as well as the zoomorphic representation of yang, the masculine power of generation.

statement.id: Kepercayaan populer menghubungkan naga dengan sungai, laut, dan pengaturan hujan.
statement.en: Popular belief connects dragons with rivers, seas, and the distribution of rain.

artistic_changes: Scale color and S-curve flight composition editorial; antlers and head form from explicit Doré variant.
No wings, thunderbolt weapon, or extra paws. Weather visualization follows rain domain.

presentation_revision.rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.

markut.depicted_variant: Great Markut eagle carrying weary shaman from sky
visual_requirements: Great Markut eagle carrying weary shaman from sky
Coherent anatomy and documented mythic scene
markut.aura: Presence through source-backed form and physical scene; no generic glow, ribbons or magical mist.

basis_claims.quote: Teleüt şamanlarının davullarında yer alan resimlerden biri de "Ülgen kuşu Bay Mörküt" adında büyük kartal görünüşlü bir kuştur.

statement.id: Salah satu gambar pada genderang dukun Teleüt (Teleüt şamanlarının davullarında) adalah burung bernama Ülgen kuşu Bay Mörküt yang berwujud elang besar.
statement.en: One of the images on the drums of Teleüt shamans (Teleüt şamanlarının davullarında) is a bird called Ülgen kuşu Bay Mörküt, shaped like a great eagle.

basis_claims.quote: Altay ve Moğol mitolojisindeki efsânevî kartaldır. Şamanları korur ve göğe yaptıkları yolculukta yardımcı olarak ruhlarına kılavuzluk eder.

statement.id: Markut adalah elang legendaris (efsânevî kartal) dalam mitologi Altai (Altay) dan Mongol (Moğol); ia melindungi para dukun (şamanları korur) dan membimbing jiwa mereka dalam perjalanan ke langit (göğe yaptıkları yolculukta).
statement.en: Markut is the legendary eagle (efsânevî kartal) of Altay and Mongol (Moğol) mythology; it protects shamans (şamanları korur) and guides their souls on their journey to the sky (göğe yaptıkları yolculukta).

basis_claims.quote: Güçleri tükenince sırtında yeryüzüne indirir. Anadolu'da yörük boyları arasında da rastlanan bir motiftir.

statement.id: Ketika tenaga mereka habis (güçleri tükenince), ia membawa mereka turun ke bumi di punggungnya; motif ini juga dijumpai di antara suku Yörük di Anatolia (Anadolu'da yörük boyları).
statement.en: When their strength runs out (güçleri tükenince), it carries them down to earth on its back; the motif is also found among the Yörük tribes of Anatolia (Anadolu'da yörük boyları).

artistic_changes: Painterly square composition
Clothing, weather and exact setting details are editorial unless identified in claims

presentation_revision.rationale: Replaces ordinary animal presentation with Great Markut eagle carrying weary shaman from sky

unnamed-eagle-on-the-top-of-yggdrasil.depicted_variant: Snorri's Yggdrasil eagle with Veðrfölnir perched centrally above its eye line
visual_requirements: Ordinary eagle on the upper branches of Yggdrasil
Separate smaller hawk centrally on eagle forehead between its eyes
Natural folded wings and two taloned feet; no fusion or magical envelope
unnamed-eagle-on-the-top-of-yggdrasil.aura: Calm commanding wisdom through watchful gaze, extreme height, distant clouds and cold natural dawn

basis_claims.quote: In Norse mythology, Veðrfölnir (Old Norse "storm pale", "wind bleached", or "wind-witherer") is a hawk sitting between the eyes of an unnamed eagle that is perched on top of the world tree Yggdrasil.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik (Norse), Veðrfölnir adalah elang kecil yang duduk di antara kedua mata seekor elang tanpa nama yang bertengger di puncak pohon dunia Yggdrasil.
statement.en: In Norse mythology Veðrfölnir is a hawk sitting between the eyes of an unnamed eagle perched on top of the world tree Yggdrasil.

basis_claims.quote: There is much to be told. An eagle sits at the top of the ash, and it has knowledge of many things. Between its eyes sits the hawk called Vedrfolnir [...]. The squirrel called Ratatosk runs up and down the ash. He tells slanderous gossip, provoking the eagle and Nidhogg.

statement.id: Gylfaginning: seekor elang duduk di puncak pohon ash dan mengetahui banyak hal; di antara matanya duduk elang kecil Vedrfolnir; tupai Ratatosk berlari naik-turun membawa gunjingan fitnah yang memancing elang dan Nidhogg.
statement.en: Gylfaginning: an eagle sits at the top of the ash with knowledge of many things; between its eyes sits the hawk Vedrfolnir; the squirrel Ratatosk runs up and down telling slanderous gossip that provokes the eagle and Nidhogg.

akbuzat.depicted_variant: Bashkir white winged heroic horse on land; the documented colour and winged anatomy are retained.
visual_requirements: One white horse with two wings and four equine legs
Ordinary horse scale without rider or armor
Natural landscape and light; no luminous envelope
akbuzat.aura: Noble alert stance, sweeping wings, wind and natural dusk light convey the heroic presence.

basis_claims.quote: L'origine d'Akbuzat est liée à la large diffusion du totémisme parmi les peuples turciques, ainsi qu'au culte du cheval, qui jouait un rôle important dans la vie des Turcs. La couleur blanche symbolise une naissance réussie et heureuse, une vie, une mort paisible et un enterrement digne.

statement.id: Asal-usul Akbuzat terkait luasnya totemisme di kalangan bangsa Turkik dan pemujaan kuda, sedangkan warna putih melambangkan kelahiran yang selamat, hidup bahagia, kematian damai, dan pemakaman yang layak.
statement.en: Akbuzat's origin is tied to widespread totemism among Turkic peoples and the cult of the horse, while white symbolises a safe birth, a happy life, a peaceful death and a worthy burial.

basis_claims.quote: Dans la mythologie bachkire, c'est un cheval héroïque ailé magique, ancêtre des Tulpars. Cheval d'Oural-Batyr, personnage principal de l'épopée bachkire (kubair) « Akbuzat ».

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Bashkir ia kuda pahlawan bersayap yang ajaib, leluhur para tulpar, kuda Ural-Batyr, dan tokoh utama epos Bashkir (kubair) Akbuzat.
statement.en: In Bashkir mythology it is a magic winged heroic horse, ancestor of the tulpars, Ural-Batyr's horse and the title character of the Bashkir epic (kubair) Akbuzat.

basis_claims.quote: Күктә тыуған, ерҙә һәм һыу аҫтында йәшәй ала, утта янмай, һыуҙа батмай, тояҡтары менән тауҙарҙы емерә һәм диңгеҙҙе айыра.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Bashkir, ia lahir di langit, dapat hidup di darat dan di bawah air, tidak terbakar api, tidak tenggelam, menghancurkan gunung dengan kukunya, dan membelah laut.
statement.en: According to the Bashkir article, it was born in the sky, can live on land and under water, does not burn in fire or sink in water, smashes mountains with its hooves and parts the sea.

badrac.depicted_variant: Seven-headed scaled dragon with a whip tail and restrained documented fire breath.
visual_requirements: Exactly seven separately visible heads on a single dragon body
Armour-like scales and one long whip tail
Restrained fire from one mouth only; no generic aura
badrac.aura: Threatening presence through an alert fan of seven heads, armoured material and storm-dark natural light.

basis_claims.quote: Badraç, Türk mitolojisinde Yedibaşlı Ejderha; Padraç da denir. Yedi tane başı vardır. Ölmesi için yedisinin de kesilmesi gerekir.

statement.id: Badraç adalah Naga Berkepala Tujuh (Yedibaşlı Ejderha) dalam mitologi Turk, juga disebut Padraç; ia punya tujuh kepala, dan untuk mati ketujuhnya harus dipenggal.
statement.en: Badraç is the Seven-Headed Dragon (Yedibaşlı Ejderha) of Turkic (Türk) mythology, also called Padraç; it has seven heads, and all seven must be cut off for it to die.

basis_claims.quote: Ağzından ateşler saçar. Kuyruğu bir kamçı gibi şaklar. Derisi zırh gibi pullarla kaplıdır.

statement.id: Ia menyemburkan api (ateş) dari mulutnya, ekornya melecut seperti cambuk (kamçı), dan kulitnya tertutup sisik seperti baju zirah (zırh).
statement.en: It spews fire (ateş) from its mouth, its tail cracks like a whip (kamçı), and its skin is covered in scales like armour (zırh).

feathered-serpent.depicted_variant: Olmec crested rattlesnake Feathered Serpent, selecting legless feathered variant
visual_requirements: One coiling legless serpent with rattlesnake head and visible tail rattle
Layered feather crest and feathered portions of body
No bird wings, human form or generic magical effects
feathered-serpent.aura: Calm sacred authority through upright head, close framing and natural forest dawn light

basis_claims.quote: The Feathered Serpent is a prominent supernatural entity or deity found in many Mesoamerican religions.

statement.id: Ular Berbulu adalah sosok supernatural atau dewa penting dalam banyak agama Mesoamerika.
statement.en: The Feathered Serpent is a prominent supernatural entity or deity in many Mesoamerican religions.

basis_claims.quote: being feathered represents its divine nature or ability to fly to reach the skies, while being a serpent represents its human nature or ability to creep on the ground

statement.id: Bulu melambangkan sifat ilahinya atau kemampuan terbang ke langit, sedangkan wujud ular melambangkan sifat manusiawi atau kemampuan melata di tanah.
statement.en: Its feathers represent its divine nature or ability to fly to the skies, while its serpent form represents its human nature or ability to creep on the ground.

basis_claims.quote: Representations of feathered serpents appear in the Olmec culture (c. 1400–400 BC).

statement.id: Penggambaran ular berbulu sudah muncul dalam kebudayaan Olmek (sekitar 1400–400 SM).
statement.en: Representations of feathered serpents appear in Olmec culture (c. 1400–400 BC).

basis_claims.quote: show the Feathered Serpent as a crested rattlesnake, sometimes with feathers covering the body and legs, and often close to humans.

statement.id: Seni Olmek menggambarkannya sebagai ular derik berjambul, kadang dengan bulu menutupi tubuh dan kaki, dan sering berada dekat manusia.
statement.en: Olmec art shows it as a crested rattlesnake, sometimes with feathers covering the body and legs, often close to humans.

rodos-jdahas.depicted_variant: Bosio's medium-horse-size Rhodes dragon, portrait of documented serpent head and scaled mule ears
visual_requirements: Scaled reptilian serpent head and two long mule-shaped ears
Hard scales and visibly sharp teeth
Close head/neck portrait leaves undescribed limbs and tail outside frame
No inflated gigantic scale
rodos-jdahas.aura: Threatening alert expression, dark scales and naturally lit rocky Mediterranean dusk

basis_claims.quote: Le dragon de l'île de Rhodes est un animal mythique qui, d'après la légende, semait la terreur dans la « vallée de Soudourli », au pied du mont Saint-Étienne (« Agios Stephanos », actuellement « Monte Smith »).

statement.id: Naga pulau Rhodes adalah hewan mitos yang menurut legenda meneror "lembah Soudourli" di kaki gunung Santo Stefanus (Agios Stephanos, kini Monte Smith).
statement.en: The dragon of Rhodes is a mythical animal that, according to legend, terrorised the 'Soudourli valley' at the foot of Mount Saint Stephen (Agios Stephanos, now Monte Smith).

basis_claims.quote: le Dragon estoit de la grosseur d'un cheval moyen, la teste de serpent, les oreilles de mulet couvertes de peau fort dure et escailles, les dents fort aigus

statement.id: Menurut legenda Bosio, naga itu sebesar kuda sedang, berkepala ular, bertelinga bagal yang berkulit sangat keras dan bersisik, dan bergigi sangat tajam.
statement.en: In Bosio's legend the dragon was the size of a medium horse, with a serpent's head, mule's ears covered in very hard, scaly skin, and very sharp teeth.

basis_claims.quote: Rodos əjdahası — əfsanəyə görə 1340-cı illərdə, səlibçilərin hökmranlığı dövründə, Rodos adasının əhalisinə divan tutan və Müqəddəs Stefan dağının (Monte Smit) ətəyində yaşayan kiçik ölçülərə malik əjdaha.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Azerbaijan menyebutnya naga kecil yang pada 1340-an, masa kekuasaan tentara salib, meneror penduduk Rhodes dari kaki gunung Santo Stefanus.
statement.en: The Azerbaijani article calls it a small dragon that in the 1340s, under crusader rule, terrorised the people of Rhodes from the foot of Mount Saint Stephen.

zaldi.depicted_variant: Zamari zuria, the headless white horse haunting Basque mountains, shown intact and bloodless as a supernatural form.
visual_requirements: One white equine body with four legs
Truly headless: no equine head or face, clean smooth natural end to neck
Mountain setting without wings or glowing effects
zaldi.aura: The unsettling headless form, solitary mountain silhouette and natural dusk create ominous presence.

basis_claims.quote: Zamari zuria, est un cheval blanc, un cheval sans tête qui hante les montagnes basques ... Le voir est un présage de mort ou, tout au moins, de malheur imminent.

statement.id: Zamari zuria adalah kuda putih tanpa kepala yang menghantui pegunungan Basque; melihatnya pertanda kematian atau setidaknya kemalangan yang segera datang.
statement.en: Zamari zuria is a white, headless horse haunting the Basque mountains; seeing it portends death or at least imminent misfortune.

basis_claims.quote: En los monts de Sola y Ultrapuertos cuan amaneix lo caballo sin capeza gosa estar un anuncio de la muerte.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Aragon, di pegunungan Sola dan Ultrapuertos kemunculan kuda tanpa kepala biasanya menandakan kematian.
statement.en: According to the Aragonese article, in the mountains of Sola and Ultrapuertos the appearance of the headless horse usually heralds death.

chudo-yudo.depicted_variant: Six-headed serpent of Ivan the Peasant's Son and Chudo-Yudo; no twelve-headed fiery-finger or Fish-Whale mixture.
visual_requirements: Exactly six separate heads and necks on one snake body
No limbs, wings, horns or twelve-headed variant attributes
Stony riverbank crossing setting
chudo-yudo.aura: Ominous presence from six poised serpent heads, predatory gaze and bleak natural riverside light.

basis_claims.quote: В русской народной сказке «Иван — крестьянский сын и Чудо-юдо» Чудо-юдо — это группа многоголовых (6-, 9-, 12-головых) змеев, отрицательных персонажей. Живут они за рекой Смородиной, через которую перебираются по Калинову мосту. В сказке Чудо-юдо изображается верхом на коне. Вред от него заключается в том, что оно сжигает города-сёла огнём.

statement.id: Dalam dongeng "Ivan, Anak Petani, dan Chudo-Yudo", Chudo-Yudo adalah sekelompok ular berkepala 6, 9, dan 12 (enam, sembilan, dua belas) yang jahat, tinggal di seberang Sungai Smorodina dan menyeberang lewat Jembatan Kalinov, digambarkan menunggang kuda, dan membakar kota serta desa.
statement.en: In the tale "Ivan the Peasant's Son and Chudo-Yudo", Chudo-Yudo is a group of evil 6-, 9- and 12-headed serpents living beyond the River Smorodina, crossing by the Kalinov Bridge, shown on horseback, burning towns and villages.

faronika.depicted_variant: Single fish-shaped Faronika carrying the earth on its back
visual_requirements: One immense coherent fish, normal fins and tail
Earth with mountains and forests above its broad back
No two-fish tradition or merged Veronika woman-serpent variant
faronika.aura: Cosmic scale and sacred quiet tension conveyed by dark sea depths, low dawn and tiny forest reference features

basis_claims.quote: Faronika je ryba či vodní had ze slovinského folklóru, která na svých zádech nese zemi. Její pohyb způsobuje zemětřesení a když se potopí nastane konec světa.

statement.id: Faronika adalah ikan atau ular air dalam cerita rakyat Slovenia yang memikul bumi di punggungnya; geraknya menyebabkan gempa, dan bila ia menyelam dunia berakhir.
statement.en: Faronika is a fish or water serpent of Slovene folklore that carries the earth on its back; its movement causes earthquakes, and when it dives the world ends.

basis_claims.quote: Faronika je lik iz slovenske mitologije. Je bitje v obliki ribe, ki na hrbtu nosi svet.

statement.id: Faronika adalah tokoh mitologi Slovenia, makhluk berbentuk ikan yang memikul dunia di punggungnya.
statement.en: Faronika is a figure of Slovene mythology, a fish-shaped being that carries the world on its back.

basis_claims.quote: Riba Faronika, naj bi, kot mitološko bitje, nastopala v s krščanstvom povezani staroslovanski zgodbi o nastanku sveta, v katerem so sprva obstajali le Bog, Sonce in morje.

statement.id: Ikan Faronika, sebagai makhluk mitologis, konon muncul dalam kisah Slavia lama terkait Kekristenan tentang penciptaan dunia, ketika yang ada hanyalah Tuhan, Matahari, dan laut.
statement.en: The fish Faronika, as a mythological being, is said to appear in an Old Slavic, Christian-linked story of the creation of the world, in which at first only God, the Sun and the sea existed.

kuperan.depicted_variant: Siegfried-cycle human-looking giant Kuperan with mountain key
visual_requirements: One human-looking giant with normal human anatomy
Visible iron key at mountain entrance
Giant scale indicated by small trees and low framing
No invented horns, animal limbs or magic effects
kuperan.aura: Threatening treacherous gaze, looming stance and rock shadows under cold twilight

basis_claims.quote: Kuperan ist in dem Sagenkreis um Siegfried den Drachentöter ein Riese, der den Zugangsschlüssel zu einem Berg hat, wo ein Drache haust.

statement.id: Kuperan adalah raksasa (Riese) dalam kisah Siegfried pembunuh naga (Drachentöter), pemegang kunci (Zugangsschlüssel) gunung (Berg) tempat naga (Drache) tinggal.
statement.en: Kuperan is a giant (Riese) in the Siegfried dragon-slayer (Drachentöter) cycle, holding the key (Zugangsschlüssel) to a mountain (Berg) where a dragon (Drache) lives.

basis_claims.quote: Er verrät Siegfried, der die Jungfrau Kriemhilde von dem Felsen retten will, zweimal und wird am Ende von Siegfried vom Felsen gestoßen, wo er in tausend Stücke zerspringt.

statement.id: Ia mengkhianati (verrät) Siegfried dua kali (zweimal) ketika Siegfried hendak menyelamatkan Kriemhilde, dan akhirnya didorong dari batu karang (Felsen) hingga pecah seribu keping (tausend Stücke).
statement.en: He betrays (verrät) Siegfried twice (zweimal) as Siegfried seeks to rescue Kriemhilde, and is finally pushed off the rock (Felsen), shattering into a thousand pieces (tausend Stücke).

basis_claims.quote: Eugel tells him that the giant Kuperan lives nearby, who has the key to the mountain. Kuperan and Seyfrid fight, but Seyfrid wounds the giant, whom he spares in exchange for help freeing Kriemhild. Yet while they are riding through the forest, Kuperan attacks Seyfrid, knocking him unconscious.

statement.id: Eugel berkata raksasa Kuperan tinggal di dekat situ dan memegang kunci gunung; Seyfrid melukai dan mengampuninya demi bantuan membebaskan Kriemhild, tetapi di hutan Kuperan menyerang Seyfrid hingga pingsan.
statement.en: Eugel says the giant Kuperan lives nearby and has the key to the mountain; Seyfrid wounds and spares him for help freeing Kriemhild, but in the forest Kuperan knocks Seyfrid unconscious.

basis_claims.quote: But by a stroke of luck, the treacherous giant Kuperan tells him that nearby there is stored a mighty sword, the only one which is capable of defeating the dragon. Kuperan then attacks Seyfrid disloyally for the third time after crying mercy

statement.id: Kuperan memberi tahu letak pedang yang mampu mengalahkan naga, lalu menyerang Seyfrid untuk ketiga kalinya.
statement.en: Kuperan tells of a sword able to defeat the dragon, then attacks Seyfrid disloyally for the third time.

heqet.depicted_variant: One majestic Egyptian fertility goddess in FROG-HEADED WOMAN variant: a single anatomically accurate frog head with rounded bulging frog eyes and ordinary human body, two arms and two legs, fully modest ceremonial dress. Standing benevolently above a vast rising Nile flood with small green cultivated riverbanks; soft visible breath-like mist near her mouth hints at breathing LIFE, not an attack or fabricated ray. Low-angle monumental composition, dramatic golden dawn over floodwater. No crocodile head, no extra arms, no invented horns or eggs.

visual_requirements.description: One majestic Egyptian fertility goddess in FROG-HEADED WOMAN variant: a single anatomically accurate frog head with rounded bulging frog eyes and ordinary human body, two arms and two legs, fully modest ceremonial dress. Standing benevolently above a vast rising Nile flood with small green cultivated riverbanks; soft visible breath-like mist near her mouth hints at breathing LIFE, not an attack or fabricated ray. Low-angle monumental composition, dramatic golden dawn over floodwater. No crocodile head, no extra arms, no invented horns or eggs.
Nile flood and soft breath-of-life mist; basis: documented flood fertility association and life-giving breath

heqet.aura: Nile flood and soft breath-of-life mist

basis_claims.quote: Heqet (Egyptian ḥqt, also ḥqtyt "Heqtit"), sometimes spelled Heket, is an Egyptian goddess of fertility, identified with Hathor, represented in the form of a frog.

statement.id: Heqet adalah dewi kesuburan Mesir yang digambarkan sebagai katak.
statement.en: Heqet is an Egyptian fertility goddess depicted as a frog.

basis_claims.quote:
To the Egyptians, the frog was an ancient symbol of fertility, related to the annual flooding of the Nile. 
Heqet was originally the female counterpart of Khnum, or the wife of Khnum, and eventually she also became the mother of Heru-ur.
It has been proposed that her name is the origin of the name of Hecate, the Greek goddess of witchcraft.

statement.id: Katak berkaitan dengan banjir tahunan Nil dan kesuburan.
statement.en: The frog is linked with the annual Nile flood and fertility.

basis_claims.quote: In the Osiris myth, it was Heqet who breathed life into the new body of Horus at birth, as she was a goddess of the last moments of birth. As the birth of Horus became more intimately associated with the resurrection of Osiris, so Heqet's role became one more closely associated with resurrection.

statement.id: Dalam mitos Osiris ia memberikan napas hidup kepada Horus saat lahir.
statement.en: In the Osiris myth she breathes life into Horus at birth.

basis_claims.quote: Heqet (Heket) - Goddess of fertility and childbirth, depicted as a frog or a woman with the head of a frog.

statement.id: Sumber pendamping menggambarkannya sebagai katak atau perempuan berkepala katak.
statement.en: The accompanying source depicts her as a frog or frog-headed woman.

taweret.depicted_variant: One benevolent Egyptian protection goddess, BIPEDAL female HIPPOPOTAMUS with lion-like paws and crocodilian back/tail features; upright coherent hippopotamus head, two front limbs and two standing rear legs. Modest draped ceremonial cloth fully covers torso; maternal strong protective expression. Low-angle commanding stance beside tiny household protection amulets in ancient Egyptian sanctuary, warm dramatic morning light. Remain majestic rather than evil monster. No glowing forcefield, energy or fabricated supernatural anatomy.

basis_claims.quote: is the protective goddess of childbirth and fertility.

statement.id: Taweret adalah dewi Mesir pelindung kelahiran dan kesuburan.
statement.en: Taweret is an Egyptian goddess protecting childbirth and fertility.

basis_claims.quote: The name "Taweret" means "she who is great" or simply "great one"

statement.id: Namanya berarti Yang Agung.
statement.en: Her name means the Great One.

basis_claims.quote: The deity is typically depicted as a bipedal female hippopotamus with feline attributes, pendulous female human breasts, the limbs and paws of a lion, and the back and tail of a Nile crocodile.

statement.id: Ia berupa kuda nil betina berkaki dua dengan unsur singa dan buaya.
statement.en: She takes the form of a bipedal female hippopotamus with lion and crocodile features.

basis_claims.quote: It was not until the Middle Kingdom of Egypt (c. 2055–1650 BCE) that Taweret became featured more prominently as a figure of religious devotion. Her image adorns magical objects, the most notable of which being a common type of "wand" or "knife" carved from hippopotamus ivory that was likely used in rituals associated with birth and the protection of infants.

statement.id: Gambarnya menghiasi pisau atau tongkat magis untuk ritual perlindungan bayi.
statement.en: Her image adorns magical knives or wands used in infant-protection rites.

leucrota.depicted_variant: Pliny's ass-sized leucrocotta: stag haunches, lion breast/neck/tail, badger head, cloven hooves and continuous bone ridges replacing teeth.
visual_requirements: Stag haunches with cloven hooves and lion neck/breast/tail
Badger head and continuous bone ridges instead of teeth
No horns, giant scale or mixing boar-haunch variant
leucrota.aura: Uncanny presence from wide-eyed badger head, open bonelike cutting jaw, stiff neck and dusk lighting.

basis_claims.quote: Pliny (VIII.72–73) also writes of another hyena-like creature, the leucrocotta, which he calls "the swiftest of all beasts, about the size of an ass, with a stag's haunches, a lion's neck, tail and breast, badger's head, cloven hoof, mouth opening right back to the ears, and ridges of bone in place of rows of teeth—this animal is reported to imitate the voices of human beings."

statement.id: Pliny menulis tentang leucrocotta mirip hiena, hewan tercepat sebesar keledai, berpaha rusa, berkepala luak, bertulang ganti gigi, yang meniru suara manusia.
statement.en: Pliny writes of the hyena-like leucrocotta, the swiftest beast, ass-sized, with stag's haunches, badger's head, bone ridges for teeth, said to imitate human voices.

basis_claims.quote: Later bestiaries of the Middle Ages confounded these various accounts, so that one finds the largely mythical creature given differing names and various characteristics, real and imaginary.

statement.id: Bestiari Abad Pertengahan (Middle Ages) kemudian mencampuradukkan berbagai kisah ini, sehingga makhluk itu diberi nama dan ciri yang berbeda-beda.
statement.en: Later bestiaries of the Middle Ages confounded these accounts, giving the creature differing names and characteristics.

gizotso.depicted_variant: The night woodland half-man, half-wolf monster laden with chains; not the alternative human Monsieur La Forêt.
visual_requirements: Half-human half-wolf physical hybrid
Visible iron chains
Forest-edge night scene without victims or gore
gizotso.aura: Threatening gaze, hunched poised figure and natural moonlit forest shadows convey horror presence.

basis_claims.quote: C'est un être considéré comme un monstre, moitié-homme et moitié-loup. Il habite les alentours des bois et il apparaît parfois la nuit, chargés de chaînes.

statement.id: Ia dianggap monster setengah manusia setengah serigala yang tinggal di sekitar hutan dan kadang muncul pada malam hari dengan membawa rantai.
statement.en: It is considered a monster, half man and half wolf, living around the woods and sometimes appearing at night laden with chains.

basis_claims.quote: On raconte qu'un Gizotso habite dans l'obscurité du village pyrénéen de Luzaide, on imagine qu'il possède une force surhumaine.

statement.id: Konon seorang Gizotso tinggal dalam kegelapan desa Pyrenees Luzaide dan memiliki kekuatan luar biasa.
statement.en: A Gizotso is said to dwell in the darkness of the Pyrenean village of Luzaide, with superhuman strength.

hobangoas.depicted_variant: Three-legged billy-goat Habergeiß with horse hooves, long beard and restrained glowing eyes; excludes feathered/bird and procession variants.
visual_requirements: Exactly three goat legs ending in solid horse hooves
Long billy-goat beard and two glowing eyes
Goat variant without bird-body mixture or generic aura
hobangoas.aura: Sinister presence through fixed gaze, long beard, shadowed shaggy coat and cold Alpine dusk; only the source-supported eyes glow.

basis_claims.quote: Die Habergeiß (bair. Habergoaß) ist eine Dämonengestalt in Form einer Ziege mit Pferdehufen oder eines Vogels, der entweder die Stimme einer Ziege hat oder in einer anderen Weise verunstaltet ist.

statement.id: Habergeiß (Bayern: Habergoaß) adalah sosok setan berwujud kambing berkuku kuda atau burung yang bersuara kambing atau cacat dengan cara lain.
statement.en: The Habergeiß (Bavarian dialect of Bavaria: Habergoaß) is a demon figure shaped like a goat with horse's hooves or a bird that has a goat's voice or is otherwise deformed.

basis_claims.quote: In der Volkssage wird die Habergeiß meist als dreibeiniger Geißbock mit glühenden Augen und langem Bart beschrieben. In einigen Sagen besitzt dieser Geißbock kein Fell, sondern ein Gefieder. Die Habergeiß zu sehen gilt als böses Omen. Laut einer alten Sage ist die Habergeiß das Haustier der Perchten und übertrifft sie in der Stärke überragend.

statement.id: Dalam legenda rakyat Habergeiß biasanya kambing jantan berkaki tiga bermata menyala dan berjanggut panjang, kadang berbulu burung; melihatnya pertanda buruk; menurut legenda lama ia hewan peliharaan para Perchten dan jauh lebih kuat dari mereka.
statement.en: In folk legend the Habergeiß is mostly a three-legged billy goat with glowing eyes and a long beard, sometimes feathered; seeing it is an evil omen; an old legend makes it the Perchten's pet, far surpassing them in strength.

tikbalang.depicted_variant: Common later horse-headed and horse-hoofed tall bony humanoid, with disproportionately long limbs; earlier winged variant is not combined.
visual_requirements: Horse head and hooves on tall thin humanoid body
Two arms/two legs, conspicuously elongated limbs
Philippine rainforest without wings, armor or invented magic
tikbalang.aura: Uncanny lanky silhouette, sideways alert gaze and natural forest lighting express mischievous supernatural presence.

basis_claims.quote: is a creature of Philippine folklore said to lurk in the mountains and rainforests of the Philippines. It is a tall, bony humanoid creature with the head and hooves of a horse and disproportionately long limbs, to the point that its knees reach above its head when it squats down. In some versions, it is a transformation of an aborted fetus sent to earth from limbo.

statement.id: Tikbalang (juga Tigbalang, Tigbalan, Tikbalan, Tigbolan) adalah makhluk cerita rakyat Filipina yang mengintai di pegunungan dan hutan hujan; tinggi, kurus, berkepala dan berkuku kuda, bertungkai sangat panjang hingga lututnya melewati kepala saat berjongkok; dalam beberapa versi ia jelmaan janin yang digugurkan dan dikirim dari limbo.
statement.en: The tikbalang (also Tigbalang, Tigbalan, Tikbalan, Tigbolan) is a Philippine folklore creature lurking in mountains and rainforests; tall, bony, with a horse's head and hooves and limbs so long its knees pass its head when squatting; in some versions it is an aborted fetus sent from limbo.

basis_claims.quote: Tikbalang is generally associated with dark, sparsely populated, foliage-overgrown areas, with legends variously identifying their habitat as being beneath bridges, in bamboo clumps or banana groves, and atop Kalumpang (Sterculia foetida) or Balite (Ficus indica) trees.

statement.id: Tikbalang dikaitkan dengan tempat gelap, sepi, dan rimbun, seperti di bawah jembatan, rumpun bambu, kebun pisang, atau di atas pohon kalumpang dan balete.
statement.en: The tikbalang is linked with dark, lonely, overgrown places such as under bridges, bamboo clumps, banana groves, or atop kalumpang and balete trees.

basis_claims.quote: Tikbalangs or Tigbolan scare travelers, lead them astray and play tricks on them such as making them return to an arbitrary path no matter how far they go or turn. Wearing one’s shirt inside out is believed to counteract this. Another countermeasure is to ask permission aloud to pass by

statement.id: Tikbalang menakuti dan menyesatkan pejalan, membuat mereka kembali ke jalan yang sama; memakai baju terbalik atau meminta izin lewat dengan keras dipercaya menangkalnya.
statement.en: Tikbalangs scare and mislead travellers, making them return to the same path; wearing a shirt inside out or asking permission aloud is believed to counter this.

b-khesten.depicted_variant: White brook horse with sharp fangs and a lengthening back carrying multiple children
visual_requirements: White brook horse with sharp fangs and a lengthening back carrying multiple children
Coherent anatomy and documented mythic scene
b-khesten.aura: Presence through source-backed form and physical scene; no generic glow, ribbons or magical mist.

basis_claims.quote: Bäckahästen (schwedisch, von bäck „Bach“ und hästen „das Pferd“) ist im schonischen Volksglauben der Geist eines Baches oder der Näck in Pferdegestalt. Es kann mit den Wasserpferden aus der keltischen Mythologie wie dem schottischen Each Uisge, dem schottisch-irischen Kelpie oder dem walisischen Ceffyl dŵr verglichen werden.

statement.id: Bäckahästen (Swedia: bäck, "sungai kecil", dan hästen, "kuda") dalam kepercayaan rakyat Skåne adalah roh sungai atau Näck dalam wujud kuda, yang dapat dibandingkan dengan kuda air mitologi Kelt seperti each uisge Skotlandia, kelpie, dan ceffyl dŵr Wales.
statement.en: Bäckahästen (Swedish bäck 'brook' and hästen 'the horse') is in Scanian folk belief a brook spirit or the Näck in horse form, comparable with Celtic water horses such as the Scottish each uisge, the kelpie and the Welsh ceffyl dŵr.

basis_claims.quote: Das Bäckahäst ist ein hinterhältiges Raubtier, das an Bächen, Flüssen und Seen lauert, wo es Reiter und andere Pferde ins Wasser zieht, um sie zu ertränken. Es zeigt sich als stattlicher Hengst, meist weiß schimmernd, aber sein Fell kann auch apfelgrau, schwarz oder blau changieren. Sein Maul ist voller scharfer Fangzähne.

statement.id: Bäckahäst adalah pemangsa licik yang mengintai di sungai dan danau untuk menyeret penunggang dan kuda lain ke air dan menenggelamkannya; ia tampak sebagai kuda jantan gagah yang biasanya putih berkilau, kadang kelabu belang, hitam, atau kebiruan, dengan mulut penuh taring tajam.
statement.en: The bäckahäst is a treacherous predator lurking by brooks, rivers and lakes, dragging riders and other horses into the water to drown them; it appears as a fine stallion, usually shimmering white, sometimes dapple-grey, black or blue, its mouth full of sharp fangs.

basis_claims.quote: Die Anzahl der Kinder spielt dabei keine Rolle, da der Pferderücken immer länger wird, je mehr Kinder sich auf das Untier setzen. Wenn man ein Bäckahäst daran hindern will, Kinder zu ertränken, soll man ein Stück Stahl zwischen das Pferd und das Wasser werfen. ... Eine andere Möglichkeit, dem Untier zu entkommen, besteht darin, dass ein Kind das christliche Wort „Kreuz“ ausruft

statement.id: Jumlah anak tak jadi soal karena punggung kuda makin panjang semakin banyak anak yang naik; untuk mencegahnya menenggelamkan anak, orang melempar sepotong baja di antara kuda dan air, atau seorang anak menyerukan kata Kristen "salib".
statement.en: The number of children does not matter, as the horse's back grows longer the more climb on; to stop it drowning children, throw a piece of steel between horse and water, or a child may cry out the Christian word 'cross'.

basis_claims.quote: Le bäckahäst, bäckahästen ou bækhesten (littéralement « cheval des ruisseaux ») est un cheval fantastique issu du folklore scandinave, très proche du kelpie. Il s'agit d'un majestueux cheval blanc qui apparait près des rivières, en particulier par temps de brouillard. Celui qui monte sur son dos se trouve incapable d'en descendre.

statement.id: Bäckahäst, bäckahästen, atau bækhesten (harfiah "kuda sungai kecil") adalah kuda khayalan cerita rakyat Skandinavia yang sangat mirip kelpie: kuda putih megah yang muncul dekat sungai, terutama saat berkabut, dan siapa yang naik ke punggungnya tak bisa turun.
statement.en: The bäckahäst, bäckahästen or bækhesten ('brook horse') is a fantastic horse of Scandinavian folklore very close to the kelpie: a majestic white horse appearing near rivers, especially in fog, and whoever mounts it cannot get off.

Domestic protective context with kittens at her feet.

basis_claims.quote: She protected the home from evil spirits and disease, especially diseases associated with women and children.
