vellamo.depicted_variant: Documented mermaid depiction in a blue sea-moss dress, sitting on a shoreline rock combing her hair.
visual_requirements: Beautiful human upper body and exactly one fish tail
Blue sea-moss dress covers torso
Rock-seated hair-combing pose; no invented magical glow
vellamo.aura: Beneficent mysterious presence through calm expression, elegant posture, natural soft morning sea light.

basis_claims.quote: The Mistress of Water also had cows. She often helped poor people by sending them cattle. ... When the Mistress's cows were on the beach eating, she herself is sitting a bit further away on a rock, combing her hair.

statement.id: Nyonya Air memiliki sapi dan sering menolong orang miskin dengan mengirimi mereka ternak; saat sapinya makan di pantai, ia duduk agak jauh di atas batu sambil menyisir rambut.
statement.en: The Mistress of Water had cows and often helped poor people by sending them cattle; while her cows ate on the beach she sat a little way off on a rock combing her hair.

basis_claims.quote: Vellamo est décrite grande et belle, et porte une robe bleue faite de mousse de mer. Elle est parfois représentée avec une queue de poisson, comme une sirène

statement.id: Vellamo digambarkan tinggi dan cantik, mengenakan gaun biru dari lumut laut, dan kadang ditampilkan berekor ikan seperti putri duyung.
statement.en: Vellamo is described as tall and beautiful, wearing a blue dress of sea moss, and is sometimes shown with a fish tail like a mermaid.

basandere.depicted_variant: Humanlike hairy wild woman with very long hair combing with a golden comb by a cave mouth.
visual_requirements: Adult humanlike woman, very long hair, visible body hair on arms
Golden comb clearly held in her hand
Cave entrance, modest opaque robe, no horns or invented animal anatomy
basandere.aura: Watchful reserved expression, quiet combing pose and chiaroscuro at a cave entrance convey wild guardian presence.

basis_claims.quote: Basandere, Basaandere, Basa Andere, Basandere (prononcer « bachandéré ») désigne dans la mythologie basque une créature imaginaire, un jentil, femme de Basajaun. C'est une sorte de femme poilue et sauvage, vivant dans les Pyrénées basques, en particulier dans la forêt d'Iraty.

statement.id: Basandere atau Basa Andere dalam mitologi Basque adalah makhluk khayalan, seorang jentil, istri Basajaun, perempuan liar berbulu yang tinggal di Pyrenees Basque, terutama hutan Iraty.
statement.en: Basandere or Basa Andere in Basque mythology is an imaginary being, a jentil, the wife of Basajaun, a hairy wild woman living in the Basque Pyrenees, especially the forest of Iraty.

basis_claims.quote: Les Basandere, compagnes des Basajaunak, ont pour habitude de rester à proximité de l'entrée des cavernes, ou près des fontaines. Elles y passent des heures à peigner leur chevelure, tout en gardant un œil sur leurs vastes trésors. Le vol d'un peigne d'or, par un berger, est un thème de conte fréquent.

statement.id: Basandere, pasangan para Basajaun, biasa berada dekat mulut gua atau mata air, berjam-jam menyisir rambut sambil mengawasi harta mereka; pencurian sisir emas oleh gembala adalah tema dongeng yang sering muncul.
statement.en: The Basandere, companions of the Basajaunak, stay near cave mouths or springs, combing their hair for hours while watching over their great treasures; a shepherd stealing a golden comb is a common tale theme.

basis_claims.quote: Según la leyenda, a la entrada de la cueva situada en la cima del monte Mondarrain una basandere suele peinar su melena con un peine de oro.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Spanyol, di mulut gua di puncak Gunung Mondarrain seorang basandere biasa menyisir rambutnya dengan sisir emas.
statement.en: According to the Spanish article, at the mouth of the cave on the summit of Mount Mondarrain a basandere combs her hair with a golden comb.

basis_claims.quote: La Basandere ('senyora del bosc, senyora salvatge', del basc basa 'bosc, salvatge' i andere 'senyora') és un personatge de la mitologia basca amb forma humana, el cos cobert de pèl i una cabellera molt llarga.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Katalan, Basandere (dari basa, "hutan, liar", dan andere, "nyonya") berwujud manusia, bertubuh berbulu, dan berambut sangat panjang.
statement.en: According to the Catalan article, the Basandere (from basa, 'forest, wild', and andere, 'lady') is humanlike, with a hairy body and very long hair.

bukrek-and-sangal.depicted_variant: Paired giant wingless long-necked lizards Bükrek and Sangal facing each other in opposed curved fighting poses.
visual_requirements: Exactly two distinct dragon bodies, each with one head
Long-necked giant lizard forms, strong claws, no wings
Opposed curved fighting poses without drawn yin-yang icon
bukrek-and-sangal.aura: Opposing resolute and threatening presence through curved bodies, confronting jaws, muscular clawed limbs and stormy natural ocean light.

basis_claims.quote: Bükrek və Sanqal - türk və altay mifologiyasında bibirleriyle döyüşən iki əjdaha. Döyüşərkən, görünüşləri İn və Yan simvolunu xatırladır.

statement.id: Bükrek dan Sanqal adalah dua naga (əjdaha) yang saling bertarung dalam mitologi Turki (türk) dan Altai (altay); ketika bertarung, rupa mereka mengingatkan pada lambang Yin dan Yang (İn və Yan).
statement.en: Bükrek and Sanqal are two dragons (əjdaha) that fight each other in Turkic (türk) and Altai (altay) mythology; while fighting, their appearance recalls the Yin and Yang (İn və Yan) symbol.

basis_claims.quote: Kərtənkələ görünüşlüdür. Qanadları yoxdur, bu səbəblə uça bilməz. Bütün dənizləri bir-birinə bağlayan böyük dənizdə (okeanda) yaşayır.

statement.id: Bükrek berwujud seperti kadal, tidak bersayap sehingga tidak bisa terbang, dan tinggal di laut besar (samudra) yang menghubungkan semua laut.
statement.en: Bükrek looks like a lizard, has no wings and so cannot fly, and lives in the great sea (ocean) that connects all seas.

basis_claims.quote: Türk ve Altay mitolojisinde birbirleriyle çok vahşî ve acımasızca savaşan iki ejderha.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Turki (Türk) dan Altai (Altay), keduanya adalah dua naga (ejderha) yang saling bertarung dengan sangat buas dan kejam.
statement.en: In Turkic (Türk) and Altai (Altay) mythology they are two dragons (ejderha) that fight each other very savagely and mercilessly.

basis_claims.quote: Devasa iki kertenkeleye benzerler. Kanatları yoktur, bu nedenle uçamazlar, uzun boyunları ve çok güçlü pençeleri vardır.

statement.id: Keduanya menyerupai dua kadal raksasa, tidak bersayap sehingga tidak bisa terbang, berleher panjang, dan bercakar sangat kuat.
statement.en: They resemble two giant lizards, have no wings and so cannot fly, and have long necks and very strong claws.

basis_claims.quote: Bükrek, Dünyâ'nın sonundaki tüm denizlerin birbirine bağlandığı büyük okyanusta yaşar.

statement.id: Bükrek tinggal di samudra besar di ujung dunia, tempat semua laut saling bertemu.
statement.en: Bükrek lives in the great ocean at the end of the world where all the seas are joined together.

basis_claims.quote: BÜKREK ve SANGAL: İyi ve Kötü Ejderhalar. [ İKA: Bükrâk vâ Sangal ] Eşdeğer: BUKRAK ve SANKAL

statement.id: Bükrek dan Sangal adalah naga baik dan naga jahat; bentuk lain nama mereka adalah Bukrak dan Sankal.
statement.en: Bükrek and Sangal are the Good and Evil Dragons; equivalent forms of their names are Bukrak and Sankal.

death.depicted_variant: One colossal Grim Reaper: skeletal human figure inside fully covering weathered dark robes, one scythe raised diagonally, standing at a silent threshold in bleak moonlit landscape. Show clearly a skull face and coherent skeletal hands, two arms and two legs under robes. Gentle distant translucent silhouettes of departed souls walk toward the threshold, interpreted as the psychopomp role rather than invented attack or energy beams. No victims or violence. Frame skeletal figure imposing and terrifying through scale and moonlit fog.

visual_requirements.description: One colossal Grim Reaper: skeletal human figure inside fully covering weathered dark robes, one scythe raised diagonally, standing at a silent threshold in bleak moonlit landscape. Show clearly a skull face and coherent skeletal hands, two arms and two legs under robes. Gentle distant translucent silhouettes of departed souls walk toward the threshold, interpreted as the psychopomp role rather than invented attack or energy beams. No victims or violence. Frame skeletal figure imposing and terrifying through scale and moonlit fog.
Departed soul silhouettes approaching afterlife threshold; basis: psychopomp role, with soul appearance an artistic visualization

death.aura: Departed soul silhouettes approaching afterlife threshold

basis_claims.quote: In more modern stories, a character known as the Grim Reaper (usually depicted as a berobed skeleton wielding a scythe) causes the victim's death by coming to collect that person's soul.

statement.id: Dalam kisah modern, sosok yang dikenal sebagai Grim Reaper digambarkan sebagai kerangka berjubah pembawa sabit pencabut jiwa.
statement.en: In more modern stories, the Grim Reaper is depicted as a berobed skeleton wielding a scythe to collect souls.

basis_claims.quote: Other beliefs hold that the spectre of death is only a psychopomp, a benevolent figure who serves to gently sever the last ties between the soul and the body, and to guide the deceased to the afterlife, without having any control over when or how the victim dies.

statement.id: Kepercayaan lain memandang kematian sebagai psychopomp yang memandu orang meninggal ke alam baka tanpa mengendalikan kapan atau bagaimana orang itu meninggal.
statement.en: Other beliefs hold that death is a psychopomp, guiding the deceased to the afterlife without controlling when or how they die.

basis_claims.quote: It is the name given to a creature, spirit or deity who escorts people to the afterlife.

statement.id: Psychopomp adalah sebutan bagi makhluk, roh, atau dewa yang mengawal manusia ke alam baka.
statement.en: It is the name given to a creature, spirit or deity who escorts people to the afterlife.

basis_claims.quote: Some stories believe that the Reaper has no control over when or how a person dies, and its only role is to sever the final ties between the soul and the body, guiding the deceased to the afterlife.

statement.id: Beberapa cerita memandang Reaper tidak berkuasa atas waktu kematian dan hanya bertugas memutus ikatan jiwa lalu membimbingnya ke alam baka.
statement.en: Some stories believe the Reaper has no control over when a person dies, only severing ties and guiding the deceased to the afterlife.

artistic_changes: Low-angle framing, painterly materials and environmental color are artistic rendering.
Effects are limited to the cited domains, deeds, attributes or iconography; natural light and scale supply presence where no elemental ability is documented.

presentation_revision.rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.

drudwyn.depicted_variant: Drudwyn the white young hound with red ears in the hunt of Twrch Trwyth, controlled by Mabon ap Modron. White red-eared hound dashes forward in the foreground on a taut leash held by a human young Welsh huntsman Mabon; ahead across a wooded track stands an enormous wild boar, intact and not injured. Hound and huntsman visibly cooperate in the mythic hunt. Four hound legs, one head and tail, naturally red ears; no aura or glowing eyes. Generic period clothing and wooded staging are editorial.
drudwyn.visual_requirements: Drudwyn the white young hound with red ears in the hunt of Twrch Trwyth, controlled by Mabon ap Modron. White red-eared hound dashes forward in the foreground on a taut leash held by a human young Welsh huntsman Mabon; ahead across a wooded track stands an enormous wild boar, intact and not injured. Hound and huntsman visibly cooperate in the mythic hunt. Four hound legs, one head and tail, naturally red ears; no aura or glowing eyes. Generic period clothing and wooded staging are editorial.

basis_claims.quote: Drudwyn hat rote Ohren und einen weißen Körper.

statement.id: Drudwyn bertelinga merah (rote Ohren) dan bertubuh putih (weißen Körper).
statement.en: Drudwyn has red ears (rote Ohren) and a white body (weißen Körper).

basis_claims.quote: Er war nur durch Mabon ap Modron zu kontrollieren und fing für ihn den wilden Eber Twrch Trwyth ... so dass Mabon ihm Kamm und Schere entreißen konnte.

statement.id: Ia hanya dapat dikendalikan oleh Mabon ap Modron dan menangkap babi hutan liar (wilden Eber) Twrch Trwyth untuknya, sehingga Mabon bisa merebut sisir dan gunting (Kamm und Schere) darinya.
statement.en: He could be controlled only by Mabon ap Modron and caught the wild boar (wilden Eber) Twrch Trwyth for him, so that Mabon could snatch the comb and scissors (Kamm und Schere) from it.

basis_claims.quote: Throughout the world there is not a huntsman who can hunt with this dog, except Mabon the son of Modron.

statement.id: Di seluruh dunia tidak ada pemburu yang bisa berburu dengan anjing ini kecuali Mabon putra Modron.
statement.en: Throughout the world there is not a huntsman who can hunt with this dog, except Mabon the son of Modron.

drudwyn.artistic_changes: Clothes, staging and color are editorial choices.

presentation_revision.rationale: Replace animal portrait with recorded alternative form or defining mythic episode.

eog-llyn-llyw.depicted_variant: Eog Llyn Llyw, enormous oldest salmon, carries two fully clothed Welsh heroes on its shoulders through a river toward the looming prison walls where Mabon must be rescued. One gigantic coherent salmon with the two adult men sitting astride behind its head, body cuts water, prison distant on bank. Explicit extraordinary carrying role and heroic voyage, no legs or wings on fish, no glow. Medieval clothes and tower architecture editorial.
visual_requirements: Documented form or event
Coherent anatomy
No arbitrary aura
eog-llyn-llyw.aura: Presence through source-supported iconography, narrative action, posture, scale and natural scene light; no generic magical glow.

basis_claims.quote: Mae'n cynnig cludo Gwrhyr ac Eidoel ar ei ysgwyddau i weld drostynt eu hunain. Llwyddant i siarad â'r carcharor sydd neb llai na Mabon fab Modron.

statement.id: Ia menawarkan untuk membawa (cludo) Gwrhyr dan Eidoel di atas bahunya (ysgwyddau) agar mereka melihat sendiri; mereka berhasil berbicara dengan tahanan (carcharor), yang tak lain adalah Mabon fab Modron.
statement.en: It offers to carry (cludo) Gwrhyr and Eidoel on its shoulders (ysgwyddau) to see for themselves; they manage to speak with the prisoner (carcharor), who is none other than Mabon fab Modron.

basis_claims.quote: aiff Cei a Bedwyr ar hyd yr afon ar ysgwyddau Eog Llyn Llyw. Cyrhaeddent y tŵr ar lan yr afon ac mae Cei yn rhwygo'r muriau ac yn rhyddhau Mabon.

statement.id: Cei dan Bedwyr menyusuri sungai (afon) di atas bahu (ysgwyddau) Eog Llyn Llyw; mereka sampai ke menara di tepi sungai, dan Cei menjebol tembok (muriau) lalu membebaskan (rhyddhau) Mabon.
statement.en: Cei and Bedwyr go along the river (afon) on the shoulders (ysgwyddau) of Eog Llyn Llyw; they reach the tower on the river bank, and Cei tears down the walls (muriau) and frees (rhyddhau) Mabon.

basis_claims.quote: Kai and Bedwyr went upon the shoulders of the fish, whilst the warriors of Arthur attacked the castle.

statement.id: Kai dan Bedwyr naik ke atas bahu ikan (fish) itu, sementara para prajurit Arthur menyerang kastel.
statement.en: Kai and Bedwyr went upon the shoulders of the fish while Arthur's warriors attacked the castle.

artistic_changes: Painterly composition
Clothes, exact colors and scenery details editorial

presentation_revision.rationale: Replace weak animal depiction with source-backed mythic form/event.

wd-q109781296.depicted_variant: Fierce adult flying Hainu with one pair of back wings, rather than Hideyoshi puppy or modern mascot
visual_requirements: One coherent natural adult dog with four paws and canine tail
Exactly two separate wings on back
No inflated giant scale, mascot likeness or added powers
wd-q109781296.aura: Threatening resilient readiness through tense crouch, dog expression, wind and natural storm-cleared light

basis_claims.quote: 羽犬（はいぬ）は、福岡県筑後市で語り伝えられている伝説上の犬である。この犬は背中に一対の翼を持ち、自在に飛び回って暴虐の限りを尽くしていた。羽犬は島津氏征討のために九州に遠征していた羽柴秀吉の軍勢をも手こずらせたが、秀吉軍は何とか退治に成功した。秀吉は羽犬の強さに感じ入り、「羽犬塚」という塚を築いてその亡骸を手厚く葬ったという。

statement.id: Hainu adalah anjing legenda bersayap dalam cerita Chikugo, Fukuoka.
statement.en: Hainu is a winged legendary dog in stories of Chikugo, Fukuoka.

basis_claims.quote: 羽犬（はいぬ）は、福岡県筑後市で語り伝えられている伝説上の犬である。この犬は背中に一対の翼を持ち、自在に飛び回って暴虐の限りを尽くしていた。羽犬は島津氏征討のために九州に遠征していた羽柴秀吉の軍勢をも手こずらせたが、秀吉軍は何とか退治に成功した。秀吉は羽犬の強さに感じ入り、「羽犬塚」という塚を築いてその亡骸を手厚く葬ったという。

statement.id: Satu versi menggambarkannya terbang dan melawan pasukan Hideyoshi sebelum dikalahkan.
statement.en: One version depicts it flying and resisting Hideyoshi's army before being defeated.

finngalkn.depicted_variant: Vargeisa horse-centaur variant from Hjálmþés saga ok Ölvis; not the cat/fox or Grímhildr variants.
visual_requirements: Female human upper body on horse-centaur lower body
Horse hooves and tail, long mane, large hands and wide mouth
Opaque modest torso garment; natural bright eyes without emitted light
finngalkn.aura: Wary expression and poised centaur silhouette in natural windswept daylight convey uncanny saga presence.

basis_claims.quote: Finngálkn er furðusagnakvikindi, maður að ofan en dýr að neðan (einnig kallað Kentári). Finngálkn er einnig haft um afkvæmi tófu og kattar.

statement.id: Finngálkn adalah makhluk dongeng, manusia di atas dan hewan di bawah (juga disebut Kentári, kentaur); kata finngálkn juga dipakai untuk keturunan rubah dan kucing.
statement.en: The Finngálkn is a fabulous beast, human above and animal below (also called Kentári, centaur); the word also denotes the offspring of a fox and a cat.

basis_claims.quote: En hona, lystrande till namnet Vargeisa, som tycks ha tillhört ”hästkentaurerna”, omtalas i Hjálmþés saga ok Ölvis. ”Hon hade hästsvans, hovar och lång man; ögonen var ljusa, munnen bred och händerna stora.”

statement.id: Dalam Hjálmþés saga ok Ölvis disebut finngálkn betina bernama Vargeisa, tampaknya "kentaur kuda": berekor dan berkuku kuda, bersurai panjang, bermata terang, bermulut lebar, bertangan besar.
statement.en: Hjálmþés saga ok Ölvis mentions a female named Vargeisa, seemingly a 'horse-centaur': horse's tail and hooves, long mane, bright eyes, wide mouth and large hands.

basis_claims.quote: Í Hjálmþés sögu og Ölvis neyðist konungssonurinn Hjálmþés til að kyssa finngálknið Vargeisu. Hún reynist þó vera prinsessa í álögum.

statement.id: Dalam Hjálmþés saga ok Ölvis, pangeran Hjálmþér terpaksa mencium finngálkn Vargeisa, yang ternyata putri yang terkena sihir.
statement.en: In Hjálmþés saga ok Ölvis Prince Hjálmþér is forced to kiss the finngálkn Vargeisa, who proves to be a bewitched princess.

fur-bearing-trout.depicted_variant: American cold-water folklore trout with a thick fur coat, rendered as a living legendary fish.
visual_requirements: Trout body, fins and one forked tail
Thick mammal-like fur coat over fish body
No mammal head or legs and no magical glow
fur-bearing-trout.aura: Strange quiet presence through improbable thick fur on natural trout anatomy and cold filtered river daylight.

basis_claims.quote: The fur-bearing trout (or furry trout) is a legendary creature found in American folklore and Icelandic folklore. According to folklore, the trout has created a thick coat of fur to maintain its body heat. Tales of furry fish date to the 17th century. The earliest known American publication dates from a 1929 Montana Wildlife magazine article by J.H. Hicken.

statement.id: Trout berbulu adalah makhluk legenda dalam cerita rakyat Amerika dan Islandia yang menumbuhkan bulu tebal untuk menjaga panas tubuh; kisah ikan berbulu berasal dari abad ke-17, dan terbitan Amerika tertua adalah artikel majalah Montana Wildlife tahun 1929 oleh J.H. Hicken.
statement.en: The fur-bearing trout is a legendary creature of American and Icelandic folklore that grew thick fur to keep warm; tales of furry fish date to the 17th century, and the earliest American publication is a 1929 Montana Wildlife article by J.H. Hicken.

basis_claims.quote: Fur-bearing trout are fictional creatures that are purportedly found in the Arkansas River, northern North America, and Iceland. ... the waters of lakes and rivers in the area are so cold that they evolved a thick coat of fur to maintain their body heat. Another theory says that it is due to four jugs – or two bottles – of hair tonic being spilled into the Arkansas River.

statement.id: Trout berbulu konon ditemukan di Sungai Arkansas, Amerika Utara bagian utara, dan Islandia; menurut kisahnya air di sana begitu dingin sehingga ikan itu menumbuhkan bulu, sementara teori lain menyebut empat kendi atau dua botol tonik rambut tumpah ke Sungai Arkansas.
statement.en: Fur-bearing trout are purportedly found in the Arkansas River, northern North America and Iceland; the tale says the waters are so cold the fish evolved fur, while another theory blames four jugs or two bottles of hair tonic spilled into the Arkansas River.

haymon.depicted_variant: Remorseful human-looking giant Haymon as lay brother beside Wilten-inspired abbey
visual_requirements: One normal human-looking giant
Peaceful lay-brother robe and clasped hands
Abbey doorway and trees provide documented giant scale
No composite dragon or second-giant scene
haymon.aura: Compassionate reflective presence through lowered gaze, monumental stillness and warm Alpine morning

basis_claims.quote: Haymon is a mythical figure from Tyrol in form of a giant. It is said that Haymon was the founder of Stift Wilten [de], a premonstratensian abbey, located in the south of Innsbruck. He is said to have lived between 600 and 900 years ago and to have died in the year 878 A.D. in Wilten.

statement.id: Haymon adalah tokoh mitis berwujud raksasa dari Tirol (Tyrol); ia konon pendiri Stift Wilten, biara Premonstratensian di selatan Innsbruck, hidup antara 600 dan 900 tahun, dan wafat tahun 878 M di Wilten.
statement.en: Haymon is a mythical giant figure from Tyrol (Austria); he is said to have founded Stift Wilten, a Premonstratensian abbey south of Innsbruck, to have lived between 600 and 900 years ago, and died in 878 AD in Wilten.

basis_claims.quote: Der Riese Haymon ist eine Sagenfigur aus Tirol. Der Sage nach ist er der Gründer des Klosters Wilten im Süden Innsbrucks und war Landesherr in Tirol.

statement.id: Raksasa (Riese) Haymon adalah tokoh legenda dari Tirol; menurut legenda ia pendiri Biara Wilten di selatan Innsbruck dan penguasa Tirol.
statement.en: The giant (Riese) Haymon is a legendary figure from Tyrol; legend makes him founder of Wilten monastery south of Innsbruck and ruler of Tyrol.

basis_claims.quote: In remorse, Haymon takes the Christian faith being baptized by the Bishop of Chur. Thereafter, he founded the monastery Wilten which he hands over to Benedictine monks from the Tegernsee Abbey. Then he joined the order as a lay brother and stayed there until his death.

statement.id: Karena menyesal, Haymon memeluk agama Kristen (Christian), dibaptis oleh Uskup Chur, mendirikan Biara Wilten dan menyerahkannya kepada biarawan Benediktin dari Biara Tegernsee, lalu menjadi bruder hingga wafat.
statement.en: In remorse Haymon became a Christian, baptised by the Bishop of Chur, founded Wilten monastery and gave it to Benedictine monks from Tegernsee Abbey, then joined the order as a lay brother until death.

himinhrjod.depicted_variant: Living greatest bull selected by Thor from Hymir herd before fishing.
himinhrjod.visual_requirements: Correct this Himinhrjod illustration: REMOVE the distant oversized Hymir figure entirely from upper right, replacing his entire body with the continuous ordinary solid mountains and shore background. Keep living enormous brown bull, smaller cattle, red-bearded human Thor pointing beside the bull, fishing boat and natural shore. No floating or translucent figures anywhere. Source himinhrjod-c01 greatest bull and c03 Thor selects it before fishing. No injuries, aura, mist effects or text. Preserve correct physical anatomy and square composition.

basis_claims.quote: Himinhrjod er i nordisk mytologi navnet på jætten Hymers største og flotteste avlstyr.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik (nordisk), Himinhrjod adalah nama sapi pejantan terbesar dan terindah milik raksasa Hymir (Hymers).
statement.en: In Norse (nordisk) mythology Himinhrjod is the name of the giant Hymir's (Hymers) biggest and finest breeding bull.

basis_claims.quote: Han [Tor] frågade Hymer vad de skulle ha till bete, men Hymer sade åt honom att skaffa sig bete själv. Då gav sig Tor åstad tills han såg en flock oxar som Hymer ägde. Han tog den största oxen, som hette Himinhrjótr, slet av den huvudet och gick med det till stranden.

statement.id: Thor (Tor) bertanya kepada Hymir (Hymer) apa umpannya, dan Hymir menyuruhnya mencari sendiri; Thor menemukan kawanan lembu Hymir, mengambil yang terbesar bernama Himinhrjótr, mencabut kepalanya, dan membawanya ke pantai (Gylfaginning).
statement.en: Thor (Tor) asked Hymir (Hymer) what bait to use, and Hymir told him to get his own; Thor found Hymir's herd of oxen, took the largest, named Himinhrjótr, tore off its head and went to the shore (Gylfaginning).

himinhrjod.artistic_changes: Costume, staging and illustrative frost/dew are artistic choices.

presentation_revision.rationale: Recorded episode or cosmic role establishes mythic identity beyond ordinary animal.

isa-musa-qusu.depicted_variant: Isa-Musa Qusu, two brothers turned into birds after losing cattle: two owls fly anxiously low over an empty grazing field, while their two abandoned pairs of rustic sandals and cloaks sit together at the sleeping place under a tree; lost cattle distant beyond hill. Bird brothers face one another as if asking for lost herd, transformation aftermath and endless search. Birds natural, no human-bird hybrid or aura. Props editorial narrative staging.
visual_requirements: Documented role/action
Natural anatomy and scale
isa-musa-qusu.aura: Presence through source-supported iconography, narrative action, posture, scale and natural scene light; no generic magical glow.

basis_claims.quote: İsa və Musa adında iki qardaş çöldə öküzlərini ... otararkən yuxuya gedirlər və oyananda heyvanlarını tapa bilmirlər.

statement.id: Dua saudara bernama İsa dan Musa tertidur ketika menggembalakan sapi jantan (atau sapi betina) di padang, dan saat terbangun mereka tidak dapat menemukan hewan-hewan itu.
statement.en: Two brothers named İsa and Musa fall asleep while herding their oxen (or cows) in the field, and on waking they cannot find their animals.

basis_claims.quote: Əzazil ağalarının ... qorxusundan Allaha yalvarıb quşa çevrilmələrini istəyirlər.

statement.id: Karena takut kepada majikan mereka yang kejam (atau ibu tiri mereka), keduanya memohon kepada Allah agar diubah menjadi burung.
statement.en: Out of fear of their cruel masters (or stepmothers), they pray to Allah to turn them into birds.

basis_claims.quote: O zamandan bəri qardaşlar çöllərdə öküzləri axtarır və bir-birlərinə deyirlər

statement.id: Sejak saat itu kedua saudara mencari sapi jantan di padang dan saling berkata (deyirlər) satu sama lain.
statement.en: Since then the brothers have searched the fields for the oxen and said (deyirlər) to each other.

artistic_changes: Painterly storytelling
Clothes,props,palette,architecture editorial

presentation_revision.rationale: Replace ordinary animal image with documented role or episode, avoid unsupported hybrid anatomy.

lehen.depicted_variant: Xaho's Azti-begia (1834) literary Lehen-Suge, a gigantic seven-headed serpent tied to earth's depths.
visual_requirements: Exactly seven snake heads on one coiled serpent
Subterranean giant serpent without wings/legs/horns
No simple sea-serpent or Herensuge variant mixture
lehen.aura: Terrifying presence through seven vigilant heads, massive coils, low viewpoint and natural shaft of cave daylight.

basis_claims.quote: Figure associée au serpent primordial dans la tradition littéraire basque, il apparaît notamment sous la forme Lehen-Suge dans l'œuvre d'Agosti Xaho. Son principal témoignage littéraire connu se trouve dans Azti-begia, publié en 1834, où Xaho décrit Lehen-Suge comme un serpent gigantesque et monstrueux associé aux profondeurs de la terre et à une cosmologie des origines.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi sastra Basque ia dikaitkan dengan ular purba, terutama sebagai Lehen-Suge dalam karya Agosti Xaho; kesaksian utamanya ada dalam Azti-begia (1834), yang menggambarkan Lehen-Suge sebagai ular raksasa mengerikan yang terkait kedalaman bumi dan kosmologi asal-usul.
statement.en: In Basque literary tradition it is linked with the primordial serpent, notably as Lehen-Suge in the work of Agosti Xaho; its main literary witness is Azti-begia (1834), where Xaho describes Lehen-Suge as a gigantic monstrous serpent tied to the depths of the earth and a cosmology of origins.

basis_claims.quote: Le personnage y est notamment représenté avec sept têtes.

statement.id: Di sana ia digambarkan berkepala tujuh.
statement.en: There it is depicted with seven heads.

basis_claims.quote: Cette représentation ne correspond donc pas à celle d'un simple « serpent de mer ».

statement.id: Gambaran ini karena itu tidak sesuai dengan ular laut biasa.
statement.en: This depiction therefore does not match that of a simple sea serpent.

lurikeen.depicted_variant: Kildare tale shoemaking Lurikeen with gold-laced tricorne, knee-breeches, pipe and beer jug
visual_requirements: One small human-looking sprite making old brogue
Three-cornered gold-laced hat and knee-breeches
Pipe in mouth and jug of beer beside work
No invented monster anatomy or glow
lurikeen.aura: Mischievous fairy presence through concentrated expression, small scale and natural hedgerow light

basis_claims.quote: Dans le folklore irlandais ... le Lurikeen est un lutin et esprit familier des « tinkers » (ferblantiers itinérants), lié à la misère et aux défaites.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia (folklore irlandais), Lurikeen adalah lutin (peri kecil) sekaligus roh pendamping para "tinker" (tukang kaleng keliling), dikaitkan dengan kesengsaraan dan kekalahan.
statement.en: In Irish folklore (folklore irlandais), the Lurikeen is a lutin (sprite) and familiar spirit of tinkers (itinerant tinsmiths), linked to misery and defeats.

basis_claims.quote: the Lurikeen, working like vengeance at a little old brogue only fit for the foot of a fairy like himself.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Kildare, Lurikeen digambarkan duduk di bawah pohon hawthorn tua, bekerja keras memperbaiki sepatu kecil tua yang hanya pantas untuk kaki peri.
statement.en: In the Kildare tale the Lurikeen is shown working like vengeance at a little old brogue only fit for the foot of a fairy.

basis_claims.quote: There he was, boring his holes, and jerking his waxed ends, with his little three-cornered hat with gold lace, his knee-breeches, his jug of beer by his side, and his pipe in his mouth.

statement.id: Ia melubangi sepatu dan menarik benang berlilin, memakai topi kecil bersudut tiga berhias renda emas, celana selutut, dengan kendi bir di sampingnya dan pipa di mulut.
statement.en: He bores his holes and jerks his waxed ends, wearing a little three-cornered hat with gold lace and knee-breeches, with a jug of beer at his side and a pipe in his mouth.

basis_claims.quote: He was so busy at his work, and so taken up with an old ballad he was singing in Irish, that he did not mind Breedheen till she had him by the scruff o' the neck

statement.id: Ia begitu sibuk bekerja dan asyik menyanyikan balada lama dalam bahasa Irlandia sampai tidak menyadari Breedheen sudah menangkap tengkuknya.
statement.en: He was so busy at his work and so taken up singing an old ballad in Irish that he did not notice Breedheen until she had him by the scruff of the neck.

manananggal.depicted_variant: Common female flying separated upper torso with large batlike wings and fangs, rendered non-graphically without prey.
visual_requirements: Adult female upper torso only, no legs or lower body attached
Two large batlike wings, two arms, subtle fangs
Opaque blouse and lower torso in deep shadow, no graphic organs or injury detail
manananggal.aura: Frightening focused gaze, spread wings and moonlit silhouette convey nocturnal menace.

basis_claims.quote: is a mythical creature from the folklore of the Philippines. The creature is said to have the ability to detach and separate its upper torso from the lower part of its body. Its fangs and wings give it a vampire-like appearance.

statement.id: Manananggal adalah makhluk mitos dari cerita rakyat Filipina yang konon dapat memisahkan tubuh atasnya dari bagian bawah; taring dan sayapnya membuatnya tampak seperti vampir.
statement.en: The manananggal is a mythical creature of Philippine folklore said to detach its upper torso from its lower body; its fangs and wings give it a vampire-like look.

basis_claims.quote: In Philippine folklore, the manananggal is typically portrayed as a fearsome and grotesque creature, most often depicted as female. It is known to separate its upper body from its lower half, revealing its entrails and developing large, bat-like wings that allow it to fly at night in search of victims.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Filipina, manananggal biasanya digambarkan sebagai makhluk menyeramkan, paling sering perempuan, yang memisahkan tubuh atasnya, memperlihatkan isi perut, dan menumbuhkan sayap besar mirip kelelawar untuk terbang mencari korban di malam hari.
statement.en: In Philippine folklore the manananggal is usually a fearsome creature, most often female, that separates its upper body, revealing its entrails, and grows large bat-like wings to fly at night in search of victims.

basis_claims.quote: The myth of the manananggal is widely recognized in the Visayan regions of the Philippines, particularly in the western provinces of Capiz, Iloilo, Bohol, and Antique.

statement.id: Mitos manananggal dikenal luas di wilayah Visayas, terutama di Capiz, Iloilo, Bohol, dan Antique.
statement.en: The manananggal myth is widely known in the Visayas, especially Capiz, Iloilo, Bohol and Antique.

okesa-neko.depicted_variant: Revealed giant cat Okesa wearing kimono on the sleeping mat
visual_requirements: One giant natural cat with feline paws and one tail
Kimono colours echo fur colours
Seated on bedding in modest Japanese room
No human-cat mixed face or two-tailed species
okesa-neko.aura: Alert guarded kind-hearted magical identity through calm gaze and naturally lit quiet room

basis_claims.quote: Okesa neko (おけさ猫; „Okesa, die Katze“) ist eine Sagengestalt der japanischen Folklore um eine Bakeneko, die als hübsche, junge Geisha singend und musizierend durch Japan gezogen sei, um die Schulden ihrer ehemaligen Besitzerin abbezahlen zu können.

statement.id: Okesa neko adalah tokoh legenda (Sagengestalt) cerita rakyat Jepang (japanischen Folklore): Bakeneko yang sebagai geisha muda (junge Geisha) bernyanyi keliling Jepang untuk melunasi utang (Schulden) bekas pemiliknya.
statement.en: Okesa neko is a legendary figure (Sagengestalt) of Japanese folklore (japanischen Folklore): a Bakeneko who as a young geisha (junge Geisha) sang through Japan to pay off the debts (Schulden) of her former owner.

basis_claims.quote: Der alten Frau fiel sogleich auf, dass der edle Kimono, den das Mädchen trug, exakt dasselbe Muster und dieselbe Farbe hatte, wie das Fell ihrer einstigen Lieblingskatze. Das Mädchen stellte sich als „Okesa“ vor

statement.id: Kimono gadis (Mädchen) itu berpola (Muster) dan berwarna (Farbe) sama dengan bulu (Fell) kucing kesayangan (Lieblingskatze); gadis itu memperkenalkan diri sebagai Okesa.
statement.en: The girl's (Mädchen) kimono had the same pattern (Muster) and colour (Farbe) as the fur (Fell) of the favourite cat (Lieblingskatze); she introduced herself as Okesa.

basis_claims.quote: auf dem Bett, gekleidet in Okesas Kimono, saß eine riesige Katze und verzehrte die Fischköpfe des vergangenen Abends. Die Katze starrte ihn eiskalt an und sprach: „Verrate mich und ich komme über Dich!“

statement.id: Di ranjang (Bett) duduk kucing raksasa (riesige Katze) berkimono Okesa yang memakan kepala ikan (Fischköpfe) dan mengancam sang kapten agar tak membocorkannya (Verrate mich).
statement.en: On the bed (Bett) sat a giant cat (riesige Katze) in Okesa's kimono eating fish heads (Fischköpfe), and it threatened the captain not to betray it (Verrate mich).

basis_claims.quote: Plötzlich erschien Okesa in Gestalt einer riesigen Katze, packte ihn und tunkte ihn mehrfach im Wasser auf und ab.

statement.id: Okesa muncul dalam wujud kucing raksasa (riesigen Katze), menangkap kapten, dan mencelupkannya berulang kali ke air (Wasser).
statement.en: Okesa appeared as a giant cat (riesigen Katze), seized the captain and dunked him repeatedly in the water (Wasser).

basis_claims.quote: Dass mit Okesa eine gutherzige Bakeneko auftritt, ist eher ungewöhnlich, da Bakeneko für gewöhnlich als heimtückisch und rachsüchtig beschrieben werden. Deshalb mutmaßen manche Folkloristen, dass Okesa eher von der gutartigen und glückbringenden Maneki-neko inspiriert worden sein könnte.

statement.id: Okesa sebagai Bakeneko baik hati (gutherzige) tidak biasa, karena Bakeneko biasanya licik (heimtückisch) dan pendendam; folkloris (Folkloristen) menduga ia terilhami Maneki-neko.
statement.en: A kind-hearted (gutherzige) Bakeneko like Okesa is unusual, as Bakeneko are usually treacherous (heimtückisch) and vengeful; some folklorists (Folkloristen) suspect inspiration from Maneki-neko.

sobek.depicted_variant: Crocodile-headed Sobek with documented Nile water and fertility domain.

visual_requirements.description: One crocodile-headed man Sobek.
Nile flood and fertile wetlands domain.

sobek.aura: Surging Nile flood waters, c09,c12, visibly powerful water domain.

basis_claims.quote: Sobek - An important protective deity in the form of a crocodile or a man with a crocodile's head

statement.id: Sobek terkait dengan Sobek - An important protective deity in the form of a crocodile or a man with a crocodile's head
statement.en: Sobek - An important protective deity in the form of a crocodile or a man with a crocodile's head

basis_claims.quote: He was also associated with the Nile which was said to issue forth as the sweat of Sobek.

statement.id: Sobek terkait dengan He was also associated with the Nile which was said to issue forth as the sweat of Sobek.
statement.en: He was also associated with the Nile which was said to issue forth as the sweat of Sobek.

basis_claims.quote: Associated with the Nile floods and fertility, Sobek's centrality in the Fayum led to his being associated with royal power during the Middle Kingdom

statement.id: Sobek terkait dengan Associated with the Nile floods and fertility, Sobek's centrality in the Fayum led to his being associated with royal power during the Middle Kingdom
statement.en: Associated with the Nile floods and fertility, Sobek's centrality in the Fayum led to his being associated with royal power during the Middle Kingdom

artistic_changes: Full linen garments and gold decorative accessories editorial; no source-absent weapons or horned crown.
Flood is domain visualization, not unsupported fire/lightning.

presentation_revision.rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.

hathor.depicted_variant: Sacred cow advancing through papyrus, face and solar disk dominating the low-angle frame.

visual_requirements.description: One living cow with two horns surrounding a broad metal sun disk.
Cow advances out of papyrus, stars overhead.

hathor.aura: Overwhelming perspective and documented solar disk and stars (hathor-c10,c11); physical splash from motion only.

basis_claims.quote: Hathor was, in early times, worshipped in the form of a cow or as a cow with stars above her.

statement.id: Pada masa awal Hathor dipuja dalam bentuk sapi atau sapi dengan bintang di atasnya.
statement.en: Early Hathor worship used a cow form, sometimes with stars above her.

basis_claims.quote: This metal plaque depicts a cow with a sundisk between its horns, which is a common representation of the goddess Hathor.

statement.id: Sebuah plak logam menampilkan Hathor sebagai sapi bertanduk dengan cakram matahari.
statement.en: A metal plaque depicts Hathor as a cow with a sun disk between its horns.

basis_claims.quote: this goddess is shown in the form of a cow emerging from the papyrus thicket

statement.id: Hathor juga digambarkan sebagai sapi yang keluar dari rumpun papirus.
statement.en: Hathor is also shown as a cow emerging from a papyrus thicket.

artistic_changes: Tight low-angle foreshortening creates monumentality without claiming giant body size.
Night, dark russet hide and single gold backlight are editorial choices; no emitted solar attack.
Physical movement of papyrus and water comes from bodily contact, not invented magic.

presentation_revision.rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.

nozuchi.depicted_variant: Bristly mallet-like thick serpentine Nozuchi, one mouth with no eyes or nose.
visual_requirements: One thick short legless serpentine mallet-like body
Bristly hair and one mouth, entirely eyeless and noseless
No horns, limbs, wings or emitted aura; wooded slope staging
nozuchi.aura: Blind featureless mouth, low framing, damp bristly texture and dim natural forest light.

basis_claims.quote: 外見は蛇のようだが、胴は太く、頭部に口がある以外は目も鼻もなく、ちょうど柄のない槌（つち）のような形をしている。

statement.id: Tubuhnya yang tebal dan mirip ular disamakan dengan palu tanpa gagang.
statement.en: Its thick, serpentine body is compared with a mallet without a handle.

basis_claims.quote: 外見は蛇のようだが、胴は太く、頭部に口がある以外は目も鼻もなく、ちょうど柄のない槌（つち）のような形をしている。

statement.id: Kisah-kisah memberinya mulut, tetapi tanpa mata atau hidung.
statement.en: Accounts give it a mouth but no eyes or nose.

basis_claims.quote: They are slow movers, and get about by rolling and tumbling down slopes, then slowly inching their way back up.

statement.id: Ia konon berguling menuruni lereng lalu merayap naik kembali.
statement.en: It is said to roll down slopes and slowly climb back.

basis_claims.quote: Their bodies are covered in a bristly fur, much like a hairy caterpillar.

statement.id: Satu gambaran memberinya rambut kasar seperti penutup tubuh ulat.
statement.en: A description gives it bristly hair resembling a caterpillar’s covering.

orang-bati.depicted_variant: Mythical Seram ape-like being with two bat-like membrane wings; separate from real Bati community.
visual_requirements: One nonhuman ape-like creature with two arms/two legs
Exactly two bat-like membrane wings
No real-community representation, ethnic costume or village imagery
No invented huge size or emitted magical aura
orang-bati.aura: Watchful ape gaze, hunched silhouette, cave framing and natural tropical dusk.

basis_claims.quote: Orang Bati merupakan makhluk mitologis bersayap yang dikabarkan tinggal di Pulau Seram.

statement.id: Orang Bati ialah sosok mitologis bersayap yang dikabarkan tinggal di Pulau Seram.
statement.en: Orang Bati is a winged mythical figure reportedly living on Seram Island.

basis_claims.quote: Rupa makhluk ini digambarkan seperti monyet, tetapi bersayap seperti kelelawar.

statement.id: Makhluk itu digambarkan mirip monyet dengan sayap kelelawar.
statement.en: The creature is described as ape-like with bat-like wings.

basis_claims.quote: oral traditions describing winged humans and large ape-like beings with bat-shaped wings

statement.id: Tradisi lisan Bati menggambarkan manusia bersayap dan sosok besar mirip kera dengan sayap kelelawar.
statement.en: Bati oral traditions depict winged humans and large ape-like beings with bat-shaped wings.

basis_claims.quote: In reality, the Orang Bati are an indigenous ethnic community possessing their own identity, territory, and cultural system.

statement.id: Orang Bati juga merupakan komunitas adat dengan identitas, wilayah, dan budaya sendiri.
statement.en: Orang Bati also denotes an Indigenous community with its own identity, territory, and culture.

horned-serpent-q1086222.depicted_variant: Muscogee underwater serpent with stag-like antlers, iridescent crystalline scales and a single forehead crystal.
visual_requirements: One limbless snake with stag-like antlers
Crystalline iridescent scales and exactly one forehead crystal
Calm benevolent underwater appearance; no mixed-tradition lightning
horned-serpent-q1086222.aura: Quiet benevolent mystery through watchful gaze, reflective crystals and natural underwater light.

basis_claims.quote: To the Muscogee people, the Horned Serpent is a type of underwater serpent covered with iridescent, crystalline scales and a single, large crystal in its forehead. Both the scales and crystals are prized for their powers of divination.

statement.id: Bagi orang Muscogee, Ular Bertanduk adalah ular bawah air bersisik kristal berkilau dengan sebuah kristal besar di dahinya; sisik dan kristalnya dihargai karena kekuatan meramal.
statement.en: For the Muscogee the Horned Serpent is an underwater serpent with iridescent crystal scales and one large crystal on its forehead, both prized for divination.

basis_claims.quote: Jackson Lewis, a Muscogee Creek informant to John R. Swanton, said, "This snake lives in the water has horns like the stag. It is not a bad snake. ... It does not harm human beings but seems to have a magnetic power over game."

statement.id: Jackson Lewis, narasumber Muscogee Creek bagi John R. Swanton, mengatakan ular ini hidup di air, bertanduk seperti rusa, tidak jahat, tidak mencelakai manusia, tetapi seolah punya daya tarik atas hewan buruan.
statement.en: Jackson Lewis, a Muscogee Creek informant to John R. Swanton, said the snake lives in water, has horns like a stag, is not bad and does not harm people, but seems to draw game to it.

svetovit.depicted_variant: Cape Arkona wooden four-headed cult-statue form, horn and sword
visual_requirements: Exactly four distinct human heads facing different directions, rear head back visible
One wooden human torso with two arms/hands and two legs
Drinking horn and sword in hands
Timber sanctuary, no invented glowing powers
svetovit.aura: Solemn sacred authority through woodgrain, still stance and natural coastal daylight

basis_claims.quote: His organized cult was located on the island of Rügen, at Cape Arkona, where his main temple was also located.

statement.id: Pemujaan terorganisasinya berada di pulau Rügen, di Tanjung Arkona, tempat kuil utamanya juga berada.
statement.en: His organised cult was on the island of Rügen at Cape Arkona, where his main temple was also located.

basis_claims.quote: According to the descriptions of medieval chroniclers, the statue representing this god had four heads and held a horn and a sword. Dedicated to the deity were a white horse, a saddle, a bit, a flag, and eagles.

statement.id: Menurut penulis kronik abad pertengahan, patung dewa ini berkepala empat serta memegang tanduk dan pedang; kuda putih, pelana, tali kekang, panji, dan elang dipersembahkan kepadanya.
statement.en: According to medieval chroniclers, the god's statue had four heads and held a horn and a sword; a white horse, a saddle, a bit, a flag and eagles were dedicated to him.

basis_claims.quote: Auf Kap Arkona auf der Insel Rügen stand eine hölzerne Statue, die ihn mit vier Gesichtern und einem mit Wein gefüllten Horn darstellte. Die Statue befand sich in einem quadratischen, säulengetragenen Tempel innerhalb der Jaromarsburg.

statement.id: Di Tanjung Arkona (Kap Arkona), pulau Rügen, berdiri patung kayu yang menggambarkannya bermuka empat dengan tanduk berisi anggur, di dalam kuil persegi bertiang di Jaromarsburg.
statement.en: At Cape Arkona (Kap Arkona) on Rügen stood a wooden statue showing him with four faces and a wine-filled horn, inside a square pillared temple within the Jaromarsburg.

uchchaihshravas.depicted_variant: Snow-white seven-headed divine horse, represented without wings since accepted flying-horse claim does not specify wings.
visual_requirements: Exactly seven distinct horse heads with seven necks
One snowy-white horse body, four legs and white tail
No added wings or giant size
uchchaihshravas.aura: Youthful vigour, dignified seven-head formation, ocean framing and natural dawn lighting convey divine presence.

basis_claims.quote: is a seven-headed flying horse, created during the churning of the ocean.

statement.id: Uchchaihshravas adalah kuda terbang berkepala tujuh yang muncul dari pengadukan samudra dalam Hindu.
statement.en: Uchchaihshravas is a seven headed flying horse emerging from Hindu ocean churning.

basis_claims.quote: It is considered the best of horses, as prototype and king of the horses. ... Uchchaihshravas is said to be snowy white in colour.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan putih seperti salju dan sebagai raja kuda.
statement.en: He is depicted as snowy white and king of horses.

basis_claims.quote:
Divine, graceful, perpetually young, creation’s
      master-piece, and of irresistible vigour, it was blest with every
      auspicious mark.

statement.id: Terjemahan Mahabharata Ganguli menyebut Uchchaihsravas kuda ilahi yang selalu muda.
statement.en: Ganguli's Mahabharata translation calls Uchchaihsravas a divine steed that is perpetually young.

grimalkin.depicted_variant: Cat-shaped faery and intelligent witch familiar in Highland witchcraft encounter
visual_requirements: Grey feline natural anatomy
Clear purposeful interaction with human witch
No invented magical effects or animal anatomy
grimalkin.aura: Presence through source-supported iconography, narrative action, posture, scale and natural scene light; no generic magical glow.

basis_claims.quote: Scottish legend makes reference to the grimalkin as a faery cat that dwells in the highlands.

statement.id: Legenda Skotlandia (Scottish, Skotlandia): kucing peri yang tinggal di dataran tinggi (Highlands).
statement.en: Scottish legend: a fairy cat dwelling in the Highlands.

basis_claims.quote: During the early modern period, the name grimalkin – and cats in general – became associated with the devil and witchcraft. Women tried as witches in the 16th, 17th and 18th centuries were often accused of having a familiar, frequently a grimalkin.

statement.id: Dikaitkan dengan iblis dan sihir; perempuan terdakwa penyihir abad ke-16, 17, 18 dituduh memiliki familiar grimalkin.
statement.en: Associated with the devil and witchcraft; women tried as witches in the 16th, 17th, 18th centuries accused of a grimalkin familiar.

basis_claims.quote: In Macbeth, Act 1, Scene 1, the First Witch says, "I come, Graymalkin" to her familiar (Shakespeare 1.1.8).

statement.id: Dalam Macbeth (Shakespeare), Babak (Act) 1 Adegan (Scene) 1, Penyihir Pertama (First Witch): I come, Graymalkin.
statement.en: In Shakespeare's Macbeth, Act 1, Scene 1, the First Witch: I come, Graymalkin.

basis_claims.quote: Yn 'e folkloare fan Skotlân wurdt de term grimalkin spesifyk brûkt foar in type mytysk wêzen yn 'e foarm fan in kat. Sokke grimalkins soene yn 'e Skotske Heechlannen libje. Folksferhalen oer sokke katten geane teminsten tebek oant yn 'e Midsiuwen.

statement.id: Dalam folklor Skotlandia (Skotlân), makhluk mitos berwujud kucing di Highlands (Heechlannen); kisahnya setidaknya dari Abad Pertengahan (Midsiuwen, Middle Ages).
statement.en: In Scottish folklore (Skotlân), a mythical cat-shaped being of the Highlands (Heechlannen); tales date at least to the Middle Ages (Midsiuwen).

basis_claims.quote: The term stems from "grey" (the colour) plus "malkin", an archaic term with several meanings (a low class woman, a weakling, a mop, or a name) derived from a hypocoristic form of the female name Maud.

statement.id: Dari grey (kelabu) + malkin, dari bentuk panggilan nama perempuan Maud.
statement.en: From grey + malkin, from a pet form of the female name Maud.

artistic_changes: Raised paw conversation pose, rough cloak, lantern and Highland hollow are editorial staging

presentation_revision.rationale: Isolated ordinary cat portrait replaced by directly source-supported witch familiar relationship and deliberate intelligent interaction.

michael.depicted_variant: Source-listed Christian helmeted humanlike warrior above the old serpent, wingless faithful rendering.

visual_requirements.description: One humanlike fully armed warrior with helmet, sword and shield standing over a dragon.
Dragon rendered as the one-headed coiled old serpent defeated in heaven.

michael.aura: Monumental victorious guardian bearing, golden natural sunlight and enormous serpent scale; no undocumented emitted power.

basis_claims.quote: In art St. Michael is represented as an angelic warrior, fully armed with helmet, sword, and shield (often the shield bears the Latin inscription: Quis ut Deus), standing over the dragon, whom he sometimes pierces with a lance.

statement.id: Dalam seni, Michael digambarkan sebagai malaikat pejuang bersenjata lengkap dengan helm, pedang, dan perisai, berdiri di atas naga yang kadang ditusuknya dengan tombak.
statement.en: In art, Michael is represented as an angelic warrior fully armed with helmet, sword, and shield, standing over the dragon, which he sometimes pierces with a lance.

basis_claims.quote: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,

statement.id: Menurut Kitab Wahyu (Revelation), terjadi perang di surga: Michael dan para malaikatnya berperang melawan naga, dan naga beserta malaikat-malaikatnya berperang.
statement.en: According to Revelation, there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought.

basis_claims.quote: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth

statement.id: Naga besar itu, ular tua yang disebut Iblis (Devil) dan Satan, yang menyesatkan seluruh dunia, dicampakkan ke bumi.
statement.en: The great dragon, that old serpent called the Devil and Satan, who deceives the whole world, was cast out into the earth.

artistic_changes: Wingless source-limited depiction; armor design, cape, mountains and sunlight are editorial composition.
Research documents battle and protective authority but no emitted light/fire power; grandeur uses pose and natural light.

presentation_revision.rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.

zuzidun-txakurra.depicted_variant: Dog-with-burning-torch-in-muzzle representation, selected apart from huge black fire-eyes Barakaldo variant.
visual_requirements: One natural dog carrying burning torch in muzzle
Flame limited to torch
No generic glowing body or extra anatomy
zuzidun-txakurra.aura: Watchful solitary presence, night shadows and documented small torch flame.

basis_claims.quote: Zuzidun Txakurra ('el gos de la teia', del basc zuzidun 'proveït, dotat de torxes' i txakurra 'el gos'), conegut en castellà com El perro de la tea, és un esperit propi de la mitologia basca que s'apareix en forma de gos amb una teia encesa al musell.

statement.id: Zuzidun Txakurra ("anjing obor"), dalam bahasa Spanyol El perro de la tea, adalah roh mitologi Basque yang muncul berwujud anjing dengan obor menyala di moncongnya.
statement.en: Zuzidun Txakurra ('the dog of the torch'), in Spanish El perro de la tea, is a spirit of Basque mythology that appears as a dog with a burning torch in its muzzle.

roggenwolf.depicted_variant: Roggenwolf, German grain wind-spirit and children's field bogey: ominous wolf partly concealed amid violently rippling rye, its dark silhouette aligned with a sweeping moving wave in the grain that advances toward a small child at the field boundary. Child recoils, stalks lean dramatically from strong natural wind. Keep natural wolf anatomy, source wind role expressed through field movement and threatening bogey scene, no invented plant body or magic ribbons.
visual_requirements: Specific documented role/form
Coherent anatomy and source-supported scale
roggenwolf.aura: Presence through source-supported iconography, narrative action, posture, scale and natural scene light; no generic magical glow.

basis_claims.quote: Der Roggenwolf ist ein Windgeist. Er trägt davon auch den Namen Windwolf. Besonders, wenn der Wind die Getreideähren in wellenförmige Bewegung bringt, hieß es, der Wolf gehe durch oder über das Korn, sei im Korn oder jage die Schafe im Korn.

statement.id: Roggenwolf adalah roh angin, sehingga disebut Windwolf; terutama ketika angin membuat bulir gandum bergelombang, orang berkata serigala berjalan melintasi gandum.
statement.en: The Roggenwolf is a wind spirit, hence called Windwolf; especially when the wind sets the ears waving, it was said the wolf was going through the corn.

basis_claims.quote: Er soll im Feld auf die Kornblumen suchenden oder Ähren pflückenden Kinder warten, um sie zu zerreißen, zu beißen, zu packen, zu fressen oder fortzutragen. Die Seelen der vom Roggenwolf gefressenen Kinder müssen auf den Bäumen umherfliegen, bis das Korn eingefahren wird. Die Roggenwölfe gelten als Kinder der ebenfalls im Kornfeld hausenden Roggenmuhme, eines anderen Kinderschrecks.

statement.id: Roggenwolf menunggu di ladang anak-anak yang mencari bunga jagung (Kornblumen) atau memetik bulir untuk mencabik, menggigit, memakan, atau membawa mereka pergi; jiwa anak yang dimakannya harus melayang di pepohonan sampai panen dibawa masuk; para Roggenwölfe dianggap anak Roggenmuhme, momok lain di ladang.
statement.en: The Roggenwolf waits in the field for children seeking cornflowers (Kornblumen) or picking ears, to tear, bite, seize, devour or carry them off; the souls of children it ate must fly about the trees until the grain is in; the Roggenwölfe are held to be children of the Roggenmuhme, another field bogey.

basis_claims.quote: Das Heulen des Windes soll durch den Roggenwolf hervorgerufen werden. Der Roggenwolf tritt auch als Verkörperung der rauen Luft, des Nebels und des Regens auf.

statement.id: Lolongan angin konon ditimbulkan Roggenwolf; ia juga tampil sebagai penjelmaan udara kasar, kabut, dan hujan.
statement.en: The howling of the wind is said to be caused by the Roggenwolf; it also appears as the embodiment of rough air, fog and rain.

basis_claims.quote: Nyi Roro Kidul (or Nyai Rara Kidul) is a supernatural being in Indonesian folklore. She is the Queen of the Southern Sea in Sundanese and Javanese mythology.

statement.id: Nyi Roro Kidul (atau Nyai Rara Kidul) adalah makhluk gaib dalam cerita rakyat Indonesia, Ratu Laut Selatan dalam mitologi Sunda dan Jawa.
statement.en: Nyi Roro Kidul (or Nyai Rara Kidul) is a supernatural being in Indonesian folklore, the Queen of the Southern Sea in Sundanese and Javanese mythology.

basis_claims.quote: Some equate Nyi Roro Kidul with Kanjeng Ratu Kidul, although in Kejawen belief, Nyi Roro Kidul is a loyal subordinate of Kanjeng Ratu Kidul.

statement.id: Sebagian orang menyamakan Nyi Roro Kidul dengan Kanjeng Ratu Kidul, tetapi dalam Kejawen Nyi Roro Kidul adalah bawahan setia Kanjeng Ratu Kidul.
statement.en: Some equate Nyi Roro Kidul with Kanjeng Ratu Kidul, but in Kejawen she is Kanjeng Ratu Kidul's loyal subordinate.

basis_claims.quote: Nyi Roro Kidul is sometimes depicted in the form of a mermaid with her lower body in the form of a snake or fish, sometimes as a very beautiful woman. She is believed to take the soul of anyone she wants.

statement.id: Nyi Roro Kidul kadang digambarkan sebagai putri duyung bertubuh bawah ular atau ikan, kadang sebagai perempuan sangat cantik, dan diyakini dapat mengambil jiwa siapa saja.
statement.en: Nyi Roro Kidul is sometimes depicted as a mermaid with a snake or fish lower body, sometimes as a very beautiful woman, and is believed to take the soul of anyone she wants.

basis_claims.quote: Sea green (gadhung m'lathi in Javanese) is Nyi Roro Kidul's favorite color and no one should wear the color along the southern coast of Java. People visiting the southern coast are warned not to wear green garments.

statement.id: Hijau laut (gadhung m'lathi) adalah warna kesukaan Nyi Roro Kidul, dan pengunjung pantai selatan Jawa diperingatkan agar tidak berpakaian hijau.
statement.en: Sea green (gadhung m'lathi) is Nyi Roro Kidul's favourite colour, and visitors to Java's south coast are warned not to wear green.

basis_claims.quote: Nyi Roro Kidul is also associated with Parangtritis, Parangkusumo, Pangandaran, Karang Bolong, Ngliyep, Puger, Banyuwangi, and other places along the south coast of Java.

statement.id: Nyi Roro Kidul juga dikaitkan dengan Parangtritis, Parangkusumo, Pangandaran, Karang Bolong, Ngliyep, Puger, Banyuwangi, dan tempat lain di pantai selatan Jawa.
statement.en: Nyi Roro Kidul is also associated with Parangtritis, Parangkusumo, Pangandaran, Karang Bolong, Ngliyep, Puger, Banyuwangi and other places on Java's south coast.

statement.en: He is golden and shines like a thunderstorm; as an almost immortal guardian he watches over the world tree's integrity and is a terror to the giant Surt of Muspellsheim and the giantess Sinmara of Niflheim.

Deep water and small trees establish size

basis_claims.quote: Korean folk mythology states that most dragons were originally imugis (이무기; Imugi), or lesser dragons, which were said to resemble gigantic serpents. There are a few different versions of Korean folklore that describe both what imugis are and how they aspire to become full-fledged dragons.

statement.id: Imugi adalah makhluk legenda Korea menyerupai ular raksasa sebelum menjadi naga sempurna.
statement.en: Imugi is a Korean legendary giant-serpent-like being preceding a fully developed dragon.

basis_claims.quote: ‘이무기’는 일반적으로 용이 되려다 못 된 특별한 능력을 가진 뱀으로서, 그것은 깊은 물 속에 사는 큰 구렁이로 상상되어왔다.

statement.id: Ensiklopedia AKS menggambarkan Imugi sebagai ular berkekuatan khusus yang belum menjadi naga dan tinggal di air dalam.
statement.en: The AKS encyclopedia describes Imugi as a specially powered serpent that has not become a dragon and dwells in deep water.

basis_claims.quote: 그런데 이무기가 1,000년을 묵으면 용이 되어 하늘에 오른다고도 한다.

beithir.depicted_variant: Large deadly wingless fireless Scottish serpent of mountain caves and corries.
visual_requirements: One large snake-like body with single head
No wings or fiery breath
Mountain cave/corrie staging

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Skotlandia (Scottish folklore) beithir makhluk besar mirip ular atau naga; di Britania Raya.
statement.en: In Scottish folklore the beithir is a large snakelike creature or dragon.

basis_claims.quote: The beithir is described as "the largest and most deadly kind of serpent", or as a dragon (but without certain typical European folklore draconic features such as wings or fiery breath). It dwells in mountainous caves and corries (valleys) and is equipped with a venomous sting.

statement.id: Ular terbesar dan paling mematikan, naga tanpa sayap atau napas api; di gua gunung dan corrie; sengat beracun.
statement.en: The largest and deadliest serpent, a dragon without wings or fire; lives in mountain caves and corries; venomous sting.

Two human arms and legs; no added horns/wings
Underground staging and documented giant scale
diyu.aura: Threatening three-head gaze, imposing low viewpoint and natural cave daylight.

basis_claims.quote: (дейеү), дейеу, в баш. мифологии злой демон, многоголовый великан. Восходит к иранским дэвам.

statement.id: Diyu (дейеү) dalam mitologi Bashkir adalah iblis jahat, raksasa berkepala banyak, yang berakar pada dew Iran.
statement.en: The diyu (дейеү) in Bashkir mythology is an evil demon (злой демон), a many-headed giant (многоголовый великан), going back to the Iranian devs (иранским дэвам).

basis_claims.quote: Бывает муж., реже жен. пола. Царство Д. находится за Каф-тау, на небесах, под землёй или под водой

statement.id: Diyu biasanya laki-laki, lebih jarang perempuan; kerajaannya terletak di balik Kaf-tau, di langit, di bawah tanah, atau di bawah air.
statement.en: The diyu is male, more rarely female; its realm lies beyond Kaf-tau (за Каф-тау), in the heavens (на небесах), underground (под землёй) or under water (под водой).

basis_claims.quote: Сила Д. зависит от кол-ва голов, к-рых может быть 3, 6, 9 или 12. Демона способен уничтожить только батыр, отрубив ему головы.

statement.id: Kekuatan diyu bergantung pada jumlah kepalanya (3, 6, 9, atau 12), dan hanya seorang batyr yang dapat membinasakannya dengan memenggal kepala-kepalanya.
statement.en: The diyu's strength depends on the number of heads (голов), which may be 3, 6, 9 or 12; only a batyr (батыр) can destroy the demon by cutting off its heads.

valkyrie.depicted_variant: Armored divine warrior maiden with spear riding one horse through air.

Riding through air in Odin's service.

valkyrie.aura: Documented airborne ride, imposing divine martial authority.

basis_claims.quote: figures of Norse mythology, generally represented as divine (less frequently human) maidens who ride through the air on Odin’s service.

statement.en: figures of Norse mythology, generally represented as divine (less frequently human) maidens who ride through the air on Odin’s service.

gargouille.aura: Menacing raised neck, wing silhouette and natural marsh dusk; mouth flame restrained.

basis_claims.quote: La Gargouille is said to have been a standard dragon of Western-European origin, with bat-like wings, a long neck, and the ability to breathe fire.

statement.id: La Gargouille digambarkan sebagai naga bersayap kelelawar, berleher panjang, dan mampu menyemburkan api.
statement.en: La Gargouille is said to have been a dragon with bat-like wings, a long neck, and fire breath.

basis_claims.quote: Le dragon, appelé aussi la gargouille : sur la rive gauche de la Seine, s'étalaient des marécages, où sévissait un énorme serpent qui « dévouroit et détruisoit les genz et bestes du païs ».
basis_claims.locator: Le dragon, appelé aussi la gargouille

statement.en: The dragon or gargouille was a giant serpent haunting the marshes on the left bank of the Seine.

hippogriff.depicted_variant: Traditional eagle-front/horse-hind Hippogriff, source feathered wings and taloned forefeet.
visual_requirements: Eagle head, feathered front, taloned forefeet and feathered wings
Horse hindquarters, two hooved hindlegs and horse tail
Single coherent hybrid without lion anatomy

basis_claims.quote: The hippogriff (Italian: ippogrifo) or hippogryph is a legendary creature with the front half of an eagle and the hind half of a horse.

statement.id: Hippogriff (bahasa Italia: ippogrifo) atau hippogryph adalah makhluk legendaris bertubuh depan elang dan bertubuh belakang kuda.
statement.en: The hippogriff (Italian ippogrifo) or hippogryph is a legendary creature with the front half of an eagle and the hind half of a horse.

basis_claims.quote: Like a griffin, it has the head of an eagle, claws armed with talons, and wings covered with feathers, the rest of its body being that of a horse.

statement.id: Menurut Legends of Charlemagne karya Thomas Bulfinch, seperti griffin ia berkepala elang, bercakar tajam, bersayap berbulu, dan selebihnya bertubuh kuda.
statement.en: According to Thomas Bulfinch's Legends of Charlemagne, like a griffin it has an eagle's head, taloned claws and feathered wings, the rest of its body being a horse's.

kelenken.depicted_variant: Mythological Kelenken as the explicitly documented giant bird of prey; not the extinct namesake fossil bird.
visual_requirements: Giant raptorial bird, feathered wings, hooked beak and talons
Clear giant scale in Patagonian landscape
No fossil terror-bird reconstruction or added demon anatomy
kelenken.aura: Stern predatory gaze, enormous wing span and natural storm-cloud framing.

basis_claims.quote: Kelenken is een demon uit de mythologie van de Tehuelche, de inheemse bevolking van Patagonië. Hij wordt gezien als de brenger van pijn en ziekte en wordt voorgesteld als een gigantische roofvogel

statement.id: Kelenken adalah iblis (demon) mitologi Tehuelche dari Patagonia (Patagonië), pembawa rasa sakit (pijn) dan penyakit (ziekte), digambarkan sebagai burung pemangsa (roofvogel) raksasa.
statement.en: Kelenken is a demon of Tehuelche mythology in Patagonia (Patagonië), bringer of pain (pijn) and disease (ziekte), depicted as a giant bird of prey (roofvogel).

basis_claims.quote: In 2007, Bertelli, Chiappe, and Claudia Tambussi made the specimen the holotype of Kelenken guillermoi; the genus name refers to a spirit in the mythology of the Tehuelche people of Patagonia which is represented as a giant bird of prey

statement.id: Pada 2007 Bertelli, Chiappe, dan Tambussi menamai Kelenken guillermoi; nama genusnya merujuk pada roh mitologi Tehuelche di Patagonia yang digambarkan sebagai burung pemangsa raksasa.
statement.en: In 2007 Bertelli, Chiappe and Tambussi named Kelenken guillermoi; the genus name refers to a spirit of Tehuelche mythology in Patagonia represented as a giant bird of prey.

kludde.depicted_variant: Upright black dog with left-hind-ankle chain
visual_requirements: Black dog upright on two hind legs with two forepaws

kludde.aura: Tormenting spirit through upright predatory posture by moonlit bridge

basis_claims.quote: Kludde est une créature métamorphe des croyances germaniques et flamandes, mentionnée aux Pays-Bas et en Flandre, tant belge que française. C'est un métamorphe, qui prend de nombreuses formes dont celle d'un chien noir, d'un cheval et d'un chat. Sous forme de cheval, il trompe les garçons d'écurie et les jette dans un fossé

statement.id: Kludde adalah makhluk pengubah wujud dalam kepercayaan Jermanik dan Flandria (flamandes), disebut di Belanda (Pays-Bas) dan Flandria (Flandre) Belgia maupun Prancis; ia mengambil banyak wujud seperti anjing hitam, kuda, dan kucing, dan dalam wujud kuda memperdaya pengurus kandang lalu melempar mereka ke parit.
statement.en: Kludde is a shapeshifting creature of Germanic and Flemish belief, known in the Netherlands and in Belgian and French Flanders; it takes many forms, a black dog, a horse, a cat, and as a horse tricks stable boys and throws them into a ditch.

basis_claims.quote: In sommige vertellingen wordt hij omschreven als een monsterlijke zwarte hond die zich op zijn achterste poten voorbeweegt. Hij kan ook de gedaante van een grote zwarte kat of gigantische zwarte vogel aannemen. Hoe sneller de passanten weglopen, hoe sneller het wezen hen op de voet volgt. Bovendien kan hij zich vergroten en verkleinen.

statement.id: Dalam beberapa cerita ia anjing hitam mengerikan yang berjalan dengan kaki belakang; ia juga bisa menjadi kucing hitam besar atau burung hitam raksasa; makin cepat pejalan lari, makin cepat ia mengejar, dan ia dapat membesar serta mengecil.
statement.en: In some tales it is a monstrous black dog walking on its hind legs; it can also become a big black cat or giant black bird; the faster passers-by flee, the faster it follows, and it can grow and shrink.

basis_claims.quote: Kludde is een kwelgeest die zich vaak onder bruggen of in holle bomen schuilhoudt en enkel 's nachts tevoorschijn komt. Wandelaars weten uitsluitend aan de hand van het geluid dat hij maakt, dat hij eraan komt. Kludde rammelt namelijk met een ketting die hij verplicht is aan zijn linkerenkel te dragen.

statement.id: Kludde adalah roh pengganggu yang bersembunyi di bawah jembatan atau di pohon berongga dan hanya keluar malam hari; pejalan hanya tahu kedatangannya dari bunyi rantai yang wajib dipakainya di pergelangan kaki kiri.
statement.en: Kludde is a tormenting spirit hiding under bridges or in hollow trees, emerging only at night; walkers know it comes only from the rattle of the chain it must wear on its left ankle.

kornmann.depicted_variant: Documented dwarf-like Kornmann variant: little grey man with small red cap in a grain field.

kornmann.aura: Secretive human gaze and poised stance among tall grain in natural dusk light.

basis_claims.quote: Der Kornmann ist ein männlicher Korndämon und Kinderschreck der deutschen Sage, der sich im Feld und Acker aufhält.

statement.id: Kornmann adalah roh ladang gandum (Korndämon) dan penakut anak (Kinderschreck) lelaki dalam legenda Jerman (deutschen Sage) yang berdiam di ladang (Feld, Acker).
statement.en: The Kornmann is a male corn spirit (Korndämon) and child-scarer (Kinderschreck) of German legend (deutschen Sage) who stays in the field (Feld, Acker).

basis_claims.quote: Als Zwerg ist er ein schwarzes oder graues Männchen, das einem Zwerg ähnlich ist. Der zwergenhafte Kornmann trägt ein rotes Käppchen. Sein Gesang ist das Zirpen der Grillen.

statement.id: Sebagai kurcaci (Zwerg) ia lelaki kecil hitam atau kelabu bertopi merah (rotes Käppchen); nyanyiannya (Gesang) derik jangkrik (Grillen).
statement.en: As a dwarf (Zwerg) he is a little black or grey man with a red cap (rotes Käppchen); his song (Gesang) is the chirping of crickets (Grillen).

basis_claims.quote: Der Kornmann wohnt in einer unterirdischen Höhle. Er umwandelt die Kornhaufen auf dem Feld.

statement.id: Kornmann tinggal di gua bawah tanah (unterirdischen Höhle) dan mengitari tumpukan gandum (Kornhaufen).
statement.en: The Kornmann lives in an underground cave (unterirdischen Höhle) and circles the corn stacks (Kornhaufen).

sarac.depicted_variant: Piebald winged Šarac in Serbian epic account
visual_requirements: Cowlike black-white piebald horse coat

basis_claims.quote: Šarac (en serbio: Шарац; Šarec, en macedonio: Шарец) era el caballo del Príncipe Marko, un héroe de la poesía épica serbia y del folclore de los eslavos meridionales.

statement.id: Šarac (bahasa Serbia: Шарац; bahasa Makedonia: Šarec) adalah kuda Pangeran Marko, pahlawan puisi epik Serbia dan cerita rakyat Slavia Selatan.
statement.en: Šarac (Serbian Шарац; Macedonian Šarec) was the horse of Prince Marko, a hero of Serbian epic poetry and South Slavic folklore.

basis_claims.quote: Es descrito como un caballo moteado, cuyo color se asemeja a una vaca, que tenía características milagrosas. Era un caballo alado, rápido como un hada.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai kuda belang yang warnanya mirip sapi, punya sifat ajaib, bersayap, dan secepat peri.
statement.en: It is described as a piebald horse coloured like a cow, with miraculous qualities, winged and as fast as a fairy.

basis_claims.quote: Šarac entendía serbio, turco y griego (incluso hablaba estos idiomas; bebía vino con su amo, le aconsejaba y venía en su ayuda en el campo de batalla.

statement.id: Šarac memahami bahkan berbicara bahasa Serbia, Turki, dan Yunani, minum anggur bersama tuannya, memberinya nasihat, dan menolongnya di medan perang.
statement.en: Šarac understood and even spoke Serbian, Turkish and Greek, drank wine with his master, advised him and helped him in battle.

visual_requirements: One adult stocky human male body
One natural goat head, two goat horns
Respectful living noninjured devotional depiction
daksha.aura: Dignified calm gaze and grounded presence in natural morning light.

basis_claims.quote: In the Linga Purana, for insulting Shiva during this event, which caused Sati to self-immolate in fury, he was beheaded by Virabhadra, a fearsome form of Shiva. He was later resurrected with the head of a goat.

statement.id: Dalam versi Linga Purana, Virabhadra memenggalnya dan ia kemudian hidup kembali berkepala kambing.
statement.en: In the Linga Purana version Virabhadra beheads him and he later revives with a goat's head.

basis_claims.quote: His iconography depicts him as a man with a stocky body and a handsome face or the head of a goat.

statement.id: Ikonografinya berupa laki-laki bertubuh kekar dengan wajah manusia atau kepala kambing.
statement.en: His iconography is a stocky man with a human face or goat's head.

basis_claims.quote: テフヌト（Tefnut）は、エジプト神話における湿気の女神。ヘリオポリス九柱神に数えられる。テフヌト、テフヌウト、テフェネト、テフヌートなどとも表記され、ギリシア語ではトフェニスと呼ばれる。

basis_claims.quote: 雌ライオンもしくは、ライオンの頭を持った女神として描かれる。シューの妻としての伝承ばかりでテフヌト単独での伝承は、ほとんど見られない。

statement.id: Ia berupa singa betina atau dewi berkepala singa.
statement.en: She takes the form of a lioness or lion-headed goddess.

basis_claims.quote: テフヌトは、シューの妻となる前に家出をしたという神話があり、宮殿で退屈していたテフヌトは父親（ここでは太陽神ラーとされる）に何も告げず、南のヌビア砂漠へ家出してしまう。獰猛な雌ライオンとなって気ままに駆け回っていたテフヌトに父親は、息子シューと知恵の神トートに依頼し、ようやく連れ戻すことに成功した、という内容である。

statement.id: Dalam satu kisah ia pergi dari Mesir ke gurun Nubia sebagai singa betina ganas.
statement.en: In one tale she leaves Egypt for the Nubian desert as a fierce lioness.

basis_claims.quote: She is goddess of the atmosphere of the lower world, the earth, just as Shu is god of the upper atmosphere above the earth.

statement.id: Sumber ini menggambarkan Tefnut sebagai dewi atmosfer dekat bumi.
statement.en: This source describes Tefnut as goddess of the atmosphere near the earth.

basis_claims.quote: She is most often depicted as a woman seated with a lion's head or a serpent with a lion's head.

statement.id: Seni juga menggambarkannya sebagai ular berkepala singa.

statement.id: Əməgən adalah raksasa (nəhəng) dalam legenda Turk, Altai (altay), Kaukasus (qafqaz), dan Nart; juga disebut İmegen.
statement.en: Əməgən is a giant (nəhəng) in Turkic, Altaic (altay), Caucasian (qafqaz) and Nart legends; it is also called İmegen.

statement.id: Mereka digambarkan sebagai makhluk raksasa yang buruk rupa (çirkin) dan kadang berkepala lebih dari satu.

basis_claims.quote: Kafkas efsânelerinde çirkin, bazen çok başlı devasa yaratıklar olarak betimlenir.

statement.id: Dalam legenda Kaukasus (Kafkas), Emegen digambarkan sebagai makhluk raksasa yang jelek dan kadang berkepala banyak.
statement.en: In Caucasian (Kafkas) legends the Emegen is depicted as an ugly (çirkin), sometimes many-headed (çok başlı), gigantic creature.

basis_claims.quote: Anlam: (Em/İm). Dişi Dev demektir. Bu bağlamda gerçekte dişil varlıklardır.

statement.id: Menurut kamus ini, nama itu berarti raksasa perempuan (Dişi Dev), sehingga Emegen sebenarnya makhluk perempuan.
statement.en: According to this dictionary the name means female giant (Dişi Dev), so the Emegens are in fact female beings (dişil varlıklardır).

mo-o.depicted_variant: Moʻo in the recorded Kikipua tongue-bridge episode confronting Hiʻiaka and Wahineʻomaʻo at a Hawaiian ravine. Transform the tiny gecko reference into a monstrous immense wingless lizard spirit: one continuous four-legged reptile with one head and one long tail, resting at the far lip of a deep lush ravine. Its extraordinarily long broad tongue stretches out of its open mouth all the way across the ravine, forming the deceptive bridge. Two fully clothed adult Hawaiian women stand safely at the near lip, one recognizing and pointing toward the reptile. Tongue must visibly connect to its mouth, not a separate bridge. No generic European dragon wings, extra heads, horns, injury or gore.
