basis_claims.quote: Moʻo are shapeshifting lizard spirits in Hawaiian mythology.

statement.id: Moʻo adalah roh kadal (lizard spirits) yang berganti wujud dalam mitologi Hawaii (Hawaiian).
statement.en: Moʻo are shapeshifting lizard spirits in Hawaiian mythology.

basis_claims.quote: Moʻo often take the forms of monstrous reptiles, tiny geckos, and/or humans. They were revered as ʻaumakua, and could have power over the weather and water. They were amphibious, and many fishponds in Hawaii were believed to be home to a moʻo.

statement.id: Moʻo berwujud reptil raksasa, tokek kecil, atau manusia; dihormati sebagai ʻaumakua, menguasai cuaca dan air, dan kolam ikan di Hawaii dipercaya rumah moʻo.
statement.en: Moʻo take the forms of monstrous reptiles, tiny geckos or humans; revered as ʻaumakua, with power over weather and water; many fishponds in Hawaii were home to a moʻo.

basis_claims.quote: Wahineʻomaʻo starts across, but Hiʻiaka recognizes the bewitched bridge for what it is: the tongue of the man-eating moʻo Kikipua. Spanning the gorge with her magical paʻu (skirt), Hiʻiaka chases the lizard to its lair and kills it

statement.id: Hiʻiaka mengenali jembatan sihir itu sebagai lidah moʻo pemakan manusia Kikipua, lalu mengejar dan membunuhnya; Wahineʻomaʻo hampir menyeberanginya.
statement.en: Hiʻiaka recognizes the bewitched bridge as the tongue of the man-eating moʻo Kikipua, chases it and kills it; Wahineʻomaʻo had started across.

basis_claims.quote: On the windward cliffs of Molokaʻi, the young goddess and her attendant Wahineʻomaʻo come to an impassable ravine.

statement.id: Di tebing Molokaʻi, Hiʻiaka dan pengiringnya Wahineʻomaʻo tiba di jurang yang tak terseberangi.
statement.en: On the windward cliffs of Molokaʻi, Hiʻiaka and her attendant Wahineʻomaʻo reach an impassable ravine.

basis_claims.quote: is a figure from Georgian mythology, particularly the Colchian and Mingrelian ethnic groups. Instead of hair on his breast, he has a protuberance in the form of a pointed bone or a stone-axe. He attacks passers by, whom he kills by embracing them.

statement.id: Ochokochi (ოჩოკოჩი, harfiah "manusia-kambing") adalah tokoh mitologi Georgia, terutama kelompok Kolkhis (Colchian) dan Mingrelia; alih-alih bulu di dada ia memiliki tonjolan berbentuk tulang runcing atau kapak batu, dan ia menyerang orang yang lewat lalu membunuh mereka dengan memeluknya.
statement.en: Ochokochi ("goat-man") is a figure of Georgian mythology, especially the Colchian and Mingrelian groups; instead of hair on his breast he has a pointed bone or stone-axe protrusion, and he attacks passers-by, killing them by embracing them.

basis_claims.quote: в грузинской мифологии получеловек-полукозёл, злое лесное божество, находящееся в постоянном конфликте с охотниками и собирателями.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Georgia, Ochokochi (Очокочи) adalah makhluk setengah manusia setengah kambing, dewa hutan jahat yang selalu berkonflik dengan pemburu dan pengumpul.
statement.en: In Georgian mythology Ochokochi is a half-man, half-goat evil forest deity in constant conflict with hunters and gatherers.

basis_claims.quote: Согласно преданиям, Очокочи представлялся огромным, покрытым рыжей (цвета ржавчины) шерстью чудовищем с длинными острыми когтями. Отличительной особенностью Очокочи был топорообразный горб, росший из грудной клетки, используемый им, чтобы рассекать противников надвое.

statement.id: Menurut cerita, Ochokochi digambarkan sebagai monster raksasa berbulu merah karat dengan cakar panjang tajam; cirinya tonjolan seperti kapak yang tumbuh dari dada, dipakai untuk membelah lawan menjadi dua.
statement.en: By legend Ochokochi was a huge monster covered in rust-red fur with long sharp claws; his mark was an axe-like hump growing from his chest, used to cleave enemies in two.

Ancient practical robe/cloak rendering; fierce just expression. Lightning is visible and intense but body anatomy stays clear.

basis_claims.quote: In Slavic mythology, Perun (Cyrillic: Перун ) is the highest god of the pantheon and the god of sky, thunder, lightning, storms, rain, law, war, fertility and oak trees.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Slavia, Perun (Перун) adalah dewa tertinggi dalam jajaran dewa, dewa langit, guruh, petir, badai, hujan, hukum, perang, kesuburan, dan pohon ek.
statement.en: In Slavic mythology, Perun (Перун) is the highest god of the pantheon and god of sky, thunder, lightning, storms, rain, law, war, fertility and oak trees.

basis_claims.quote: His other attributes were fire, mountains, wind, iris, eagle, firmament ... horses and carts, and weapons (hammer, axe (Axe of Perun), and arrow).

statement.id: Atribut lain Perun adalah api, gunung, angin, bunga iris, elang, cakrawala, kuda dan kereta, serta senjata berupa palu, kapak (Kapak Perun), dan anak panah.
statement.en: His other attributes were fire, mountains, wind, iris, eagle, firmament, horses and carts, and weapons: hammer, axe (Axe of Perun) and arrow.

basis_claims.quote: In 980, when prince Vladimir the Great came to the throne of Kiev, he erected statues of five pagan gods in front of his palace which he soon thereafter discarded after his Christianization in 988. Perun was chief among these, represented with a silver head and a golden moustache.

statement.id: Pada tahun 980, ketika pangeran Vladimir Agung naik takhta di Kiev, ia mendirikan arca lima dewa pagan di depan istananya, yang kemudian ia singkirkan setelah masuk Kristen pada 988; Perun adalah yang utama, digambarkan berkepala perak dan berkumis emas.
statement.en: In 980, when Prince Vladimir the Great took the throne of Kiev, he erected statues of five pagan gods before his palace, discarding them after his Christianization in 988; Perun was chief among them, with a silver head and a golden moustache.

basis_claims.quote: Shrines of Perun were located either on top of mountains or hills, or in sacred groves underneath ancient oaks. These were general places of worship and sacrifices (with a bull, an ox, a ram, and eggs).

statement.id: Tempat pemujaan Perun berada di puncak gunung atau bukit, atau di hutan keramat di bawah pohon ek tua; di sana dilakukan ibadah dan persembahan berupa banteng, sapi, domba jantan, dan telur.
statement.en: Perun's shrines stood on mountain tops or hills, or in sacred groves under ancient oaks, as places of worship and sacrifice (a bull, an ox, a ram and eggs).

basis_claims.quote: 類似する多くの雷神と同じように、髭を生やした中年男性の姿をしている。 石臼に乗って空を飛びながら稲妻を放ち雷鳴を轟かせる。

statement.id: Seperti banyak dewa guruh lain, ia berwujud lelaki paruh baya berjanggut; ia terbang di atas batu gilingan sambil melepaskan kilat dan guruh.
statement.en: Like many thunder gods he has the form of a bearded middle-aged man; he flies on a millstone, hurling lightning and thunder.

basis_claims.quote: Le schimmelreiter ou schimmel reiter est, dans le folklore germanique et plus précisément en Basse-Saxe et dans l'Altmark, un cheval blanc maléfique ou un cavalier sur un cheval blanc, symboles de la catastrophe marine, qui détruit les digues pendant les tempêtes.

statement.id: Schimmelreiter, dalam cerita rakyat Jermanik (germanique), khususnya di Niedersachsen (Basse-Saxe; Lower Saxony) dan Altmark, adalah kuda putih jahat atau penunggang kuda putih, lambang bencana laut yang menghancurkan tanggul saat badai.
statement.en: The Schimmelreiter, in Germanic (germanique) folklore, specifically in Lower Saxony (Basse-Saxe) and the Altmark, is an evil white horse or a rider on one, symbols of sea disaster that destroys dykes during storms.

basis_claims.quote: Selon Katharine Briggs, le schimmelreiter est le fantôme le plus souvent mentionné dans le folklore allemand, sous le nom de « der Schimmelreiter », qui signifie « le cavalier sur le cheval blanc ».

statement.id: Menurut Katharine Briggs, Schimmelreiter adalah hantu yang paling sering disebut dalam cerita rakyat Jerman (allemand; German), dengan nama der Schimmelreiter, "penunggang di atas kuda putih".
statement.en: According to Katharine Briggs, the Schimmelreiter is the ghost most often mentioned in German (allemand) folklore, as der Schimmelreiter, 'the rider on the white horse'.

basis_claims.quote: De schimmelrijder is in de Germaanse folklore (meer specifiek in Nedersaksen en Altmark) het kwade witte paard, of een ruiter op het witte paard. Het mythisch wezen is het symbool van de ergste maritieme ramp: de vernietiging van dammen in stormen.

statement.id: Schimmelrijder dalam cerita rakyat Jermanik (Germaanse), khususnya di Niedersachsen (Nedersaksen) dan Altmark, adalah kuda putih jahat atau penunggang kuda putih, lambang bencana laut terburuk: hancurnya tanggul dalam badai.
statement.en: The schimmelrijder in Germanic (Germaanse) folklore, specifically Lower Saxony (Nedersaksen) and Altmark, is the evil white horse or a rider on it, symbol of the worst maritime disaster: dams destroyed in storms.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Slavia Ceko, Šemík adalah kuda putih legendaris yang dapat berbicara dan sangat cerdas, tunggangan tokoh legenda Horymír.
statement.en: In the Slavic mythology of Czechia, Šemík is a legendary white horse gifted with speech and great intelligence, the mount of the legendary Horymír.

basis_claims.quote: Jeho pánem byl Horymír, vladyka neumětelský, kterého Šemík zachránil před jistou smrtí odvážným skokem ze skály u Vyšehradu. Poté Horymíra dovezl do Neumětel a podlehl zraněním, která si způsobil skokem.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Ceko, Šemík menyelamatkan tuannya Horymír dari kematian dengan melompat berani dari tebing Vyšehrad, membawanya pulang ke Neumětely, lalu mati karena luka akibat lompatan itu.
statement.en: According to the Czech article, Šemík saved his master Horymír from certain death with a daring leap from the Vyšehrad rock, carried him home to Neumětely and then died of the injuries from the jump.

basis_claims.quote: — гигантское злое драконообразное существо женского пола в мифах и легендах болгар. Ламии обитают на дне озёр, рек, морей. В своих пещерах часто хранят драгоценные камни и золотые клады. Несмотря на грозный вид Ламии, болгарские герои легко расправляются с ней, отрубив голову. Однако если отрезанную голову насадить на бычий рог, то через сорок дней голова и рог вновь срастаются в змею.

statement.id: Lamia (Bulgaria: Ламя) adalah makhluk betina raksasa mirip naga yang jahat dalam mitos Bulgaria, tinggal di dasar danau, sungai, dan laut, menyimpan permata dan emas di gua; pahlawan Bulgaria mudah memenggalnya, tetapi bila kepalanya ditancapkan pada tanduk banteng, setelah empat puluh hari kepala dan tanduk menyatu menjadi ular lagi.
statement.en: The lamia is a giant evil dragon-like female being of Bulgarian myth, living at the bottom of lakes, rivers and seas, hoarding gems and gold in caves; Bulgarian heroes easily behead her, but if the head is put on a bull's horn, after forty days head and horn grow back into a serpent.

basis_claims.quote: Чаще всего Ламию изображают женственным змееподобным существом гигантских размеров, с чешуйчатыми крыльями, жёлтой чешуей, острыми когтями и зубами. Чаще всего имеет одну собачью голову на змеиной шее, но изредка её изображают трёхглавой или девятиглавой.

statement.id: Lamia biasanya digambarkan sebagai makhluk betina mirip ular berukuran raksasa, bersayap sisik, bersisik kuning, bercakar dan bergigi tajam, biasanya berkepala anjing di leher ular, kadang berkepala tiga atau sembilan.
statement.en: The lamia is usually shown as a giant female serpent-like being with scaly wings, yellow scales, sharp claws and teeth, usually a dog's head on a snake's neck, sometimes three- or nine-headed.

basis_claims.quote: is an asura featured in Hindu literature, most notably in the Bhagavata Purana. He was one of Kansa's generals,

statement.id: Aghasura adalah asura dalam Bhagavata Purana dan salah satu jenderal Kansa.
statement.en: Aghasura is an asura in the Bhagavata Purana and one of Kansa's generals.

basis_claims.quote: King Kamsa made many attempts on the life of Krishna, all of them failing. He then sent Aghasura to kill Krishna, a deed which Aghasura willingly attempted to carry out, knowing that his younger siblings Putana and Bakasura were killed by Krishna. He assumed the form of the 8-mile-long serpent, disguising his open mouth against a mountain.

statement.id: Ia berubah menjadi ular sepanjang delapan mil untuk membunuh Krishna.
statement.en: He becomes an eight mile long serpent to kill Krishna.

basis_claims.quote: All the cowherd boys entered the mouth of the demon, mistaking it to be a cavern.

statement.id: Anak-anak penggembala memasuki mulutnya karena mengira mulut itu gua.
statement.en: Cowherd boys enter his mouth, mistaking it for a cavern.

basis_claims.quote: Apasmara (Sanskrit: अपस्मार, IAST: Apasmāra) is a diminutive man who represents spiritual ignorance and ahamkara in Hindu mythology. He is also known as Muyalaka or Muyalakan.

statement.id: Apasmara adalah manusia kerdil yang melambangkan ketidaktahuan rohani dan ahamkara dalam mitologi Hindu.
statement.en: Apasmara is a diminutive man symbolizing spiritual ignorance and ahamkara in Hindu mythology.

basis_claims.quote: Apasmara, depicted as a diminutive man, is often shown in Hindu iconography clutching a cobra, which symbolizes (ahamkara) in Shaivite tradition.

statement.id: Dalam ikonografi ia sering memegang kobra yang melambangkan ahamkara dalam tradisi Shaiva.
statement.en: In iconography he often holds a cobra symbolizing ahamkara in Shaiva traditions.

basis_claims.quote: With every step in his dance, he lands on a dwarfish figure personifying ignorance.

statement.en: The Cleveland Museum describes the dwarfish figure under Nataraja's steps as personified ignorance.

basis_claims.quote: Hẹh (hẹh, also Huh, Hah, Hauh, Huah, and Hehu) was the personification of infinity or eternity in the Ogdoad in ancient Egyptian religion. His name originally meant "flood", referring to the watery chaos Nu that the Egyptians believed existed before the creation of the world.

statement.id: Heh adalah personifikasi ketakterhinggaan atau keabadian dalam Ogdoad Mesir.
statement.en: Heh personifies infinity or eternity in the Egyptian Ogdoad.

basis_claims.quote: Like the other concepts in the Ogdoad, his male form was often depicted as a frog, or a frog-headed human, and his female form as a snake or snake-headed human. The frog head symbolised fertility, creation, and regeneration, and was also possessed by the other Ogdoad males Kek, Amun, and Nun.

statement.id: Ia sering berkepala katak dan memegang batang palem sebagai lambang umur panjang.
statement.en: He is often frog-headed and holds palm stems as symbols of long life.

basis_claims.quote: Kek is the deification of the concept of primordial darkness in the ancient Egyptian Ogdoad cosmogony of Hermopolis.

statement.id: Kek adalah personifikasi kegelapan primordial dalam Ogdoad Hermopolis di Mesir.
statement.en: Kek personifies primordial darkness in Egypt’s Hermopolitan Ogdoad.

basis_claims.quote: In the Greco-Roman period, Kek's male form was depicted as a frog-headed man, and the female form as a serpent-headed woman, as were all four dualistic concepts in the Ogdoad.

statement.id: Pada masa Yunani-Romawi ia digambarkan sebagai laki-laki berkepala katak.
statement.en: In the Greco-Roman period he is shown as a frog-headed man.

basis_claims.quote: Kek and Kauket were the male/female aspects of darkness but not in any way associated with evil.

statement.id: Kegelapan Kek dan Kauket tidak dipahami sebagai kejahatan dalam sumber ini.
statement.en: Kek and Kauket’s darkness is not understood as evil in this source.

onmoraki.depicted_variant: Onmoraki, black crane spirit scolding a sleeping priest in the priest's own voice: natural adult crane-height dark crane bends its open beak toward a startled fully clothed Buddhist monk who wakes from sleeping over a low temple desk. Uncanny shining eye catches a real lantern, bird dominates foreground, temple scrolls and low lamp farther back. Documented imitation/scolding action, natural crane limbs no humanoid face or invented aura.
visual_requirements: Specific documented role/form
Coherent anatomy and source-supported scale
onmoraki.aura: Presence through source-supported iconography, narrative action, posture, scale and natural scene light; no generic magical glow.

basis_claims.quote: 古典の画図においては鳥山石燕の画集『今昔画図続百鬼』に描かれており、解説文には中国の古書『清尊録』からの引用で、姿は鶴のようで、体色が黒く、眼光は灯火のようで、羽を震わせて甲高く鳴くとある。

statement.id: Kisah Sekien memberinya tubuh hitam mirip bangau, mata bercahaya, dan suara melengking.
statement.en: Sekien’s account gives it a black crane-like body, shining eyes and a shrill voice.

basis_claims.quote: They sneak up on sleeping priests and surprise them, scolding them in a perfect imitation of their own voices.

statement.id: Kisah belakangan menyebut mereka memarahi pendeta yang tidur dengan meniru suaranya.
statement.en: A later account says they scold sleeping priests in an imitation of their voices.

sokar.depicted_variant: One monumental Egyptian Sokar in MUMMIFIED HAWK form: a single falcon head and compact hawk body wrapped in linen funerary bindings emerging from a dark necropolis mound at the underworld entrance. Beak and feathered head remain clear, no invented human arms or horns, wings concealed naturally under wrapping. Vast ancient doorway and tiny mortuary architecture, intense natural shaft of sunset on gilded cloth-edge styling, shadowy mist for underworld atmosphere. Do not blend Ptah/Osiris anatomy or alternate serpent-standing variant. No magical flame or halo.

basis_claims.quote: is a hawk or falcon god of the Memphite necropolis in the Ancient Egyptian religion

statement.id: Sokar adalah dewa elang kawasan pemakaman Memphis dalam agama Mesir.
statement.en: Sokar is a falcon god of the Memphite necropolis in Egyptian religion.

basis_claims.quote: Sokar was usually depicted as a mummified hawk and sometimes as a mound from which the head of a hawk appears. Here he is called 'he who is on his sand'. Sometimes, he is shown on his hennu barque which was an elaborate sledge for negotiating the sandy necropolis. One of his titles was 'He of Restau' which means the place of 'openings' or tomb entrances.

statement.id: Ia sering berupa elang bermumi atau kepala elang yang muncul dari bukit.
statement.en: He is often a mummified hawk or a hawk’s head emerging from a mound.

basis_claims.quote: guardian of the entrance to the underworld

statement.id: Sumber pendamping menempatkan Sokar sebagai penjaga pintu masuk dunia bawah.
statement.en: The accompanying source places Sokar as guardian of the underworld entrance.

hrimfaxi.depicted_variant: Hrímfaxi, Night's horse, carrying Nótt across the night sky while foam from its bit falls to Earth as dew. Show the dark horse with rime in its mane galloping suspended high across stars above tiny land and river valleys, carrying a clearly visible fully clothed woman Nótt in a dark cloak. Distinct white foam on the bit becomes falling droplets descending toward dewy grass far below, making its cosmic role unmistakable. Four legs, one horse head, no wings or invented extra limbs. No chariot for this riding variant, no decorative aura, no beams or magical ribbons; the dew falling is the source's magic.
hrimfaxi.visual_requirements: Correct this Hrímfaxi illustration's horse anatomy. Exactly FOUR total horse legs: TWO hind legs and TWO front legs, not five. Remove the extra front leg in the lower-right part and its duplicate hoof. Clearly render a coherent galloping horse with four legs attached at anatomically correct joints and each ending in one hoof. Keep Nótt riding, dark horse's frosty mane, star sky, bit foam dripping as dew to earth and square composition. Source hrimfaxi-c01,c03,c05. No added limbs, wings, chariot, aura, ribbons, text or watermark. Reconstruct the leg arrangement cleanly rather than hiding the error.
hrimfaxi.aura: Source-recorded dew from bit foam only, no aura.

basis_claims.quote: In Norse mythology, Skinfaxi (Old Norse: [ˈskinˌfɑkse] ) and Hrímfaxi [ˈhriːmˌfɑkse] are the horses of Dagr (day) and Nótt (night). The names Skinfaxi and Hrímfaxi mean "shining mane" and "frost mane", respectively. ... "Froth" is believed to fall from Hrímfaxi's bit to the earth and become dew.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik, Skinfaxi dan Hrímfaxi adalah kuda Dagr (siang) dan Nótt (malam); namanya berarti "surai bersinar" dan "surai berembun beku", dan buih dari kekang Hrímfaxi diyakini jatuh ke bumi menjadi embun.
statement.en: In Norse mythology Skinfaxi and Hrímfaxi are the horses of Dagr (day) and Nótt (night); the names mean 'shining mane' and 'frost mane', and froth from Hrímfaxi's bit is believed to fall to earth as dew.

basis_claims.quote: Rimfakse (Norrønt:Hrímfaxi, rim i manen) er i norrøn mytologi den hesten Natt rir på over himmelen hver natt. Morgenduggen kom dryppende fra Rimfakses bissel. Rimfakse nevnes i Den eldre Edda, der Odin sier følgende i Vavtrudnesmål:

statement.id: Rimfakse (Nordik Kuno Hrímfaxi, "embun beku di surai") adalah kuda yang ditunggangi Natt melintasi langit setiap malam; embun pagi menetes dari kekangnya, dan ia disebut Odin dalam Vafþrúðnismál di Edda Puisi.
statement.en: Rimfakse (Old Norse Hrímfaxi, 'rime in the mane') is the horse Night rides across the sky every night; morning dew drips from its bit, and Odin names it in the Vafþrúðnismál of the Elder Edda.

basis_claims.quote: Rimfakse heiter hesten som dreg natt over gjæve gudar; skumdropar han slepper kvar morgon; av det kjem dogg i dalar.

statement.id: Bait Vafþrúðnismál: "Rimfakse nama kuda yang menarik malam di atas para dewa yang mulia; tetes buih ia jatuhkan setiap pagi; dari situ datang embun di lembah-lembah."
statement.en: The Vafþrúðnismál stanza: 'Rimfakse is the horse that draws night over the noble gods; drops of foam he lets fall each morning; from them comes dew in the dales.'

hrimfaxi.artistic_changes: Costume, staging and illustrative frost/dew are artistic choices.

presentation_revision.rationale: Recorded episode or cosmic role establishes mythic identity beyond ordinary animal.

ker.depicted_variant: Documented shared bald one-eyed one-armed one-legged Ker exemplar; not named animal subtype or bearded Kerle.
visual_requirements: Bald scalp and exactly one eye
Exactly one arm and one leg
Opaque modest clothing
ker.aura: Hostile tense gaze and guarded hunched posture under natural dusk.

basis_claims.quote: Ker - türk və altay mifologiyalarında pis varlıq. Gər (Gir, Kir) olaraq da deyilir. O varlığın pis bir xüsusiyyətə sahib olduğunu göstərir.

statement.id: Ker adalah makhluk jahat (pis varlıq) dalam mitologi Turk (türk) dan Altai (altay); disebut juga Gər (Gir, Kir), dan kata ini menunjukkan bahwa suatu makhluk punya sifat jahat (pis bir xüsusiyyət).
statement.en: Ker is an evil being (pis varlıq) in Turkic (türk) and Altaic (altay) mythologies; it is also called Gər (Gir, Kir), and the word shows that a being has an evil quality (pis bir xüsusiyyət).

basis_claims.quote: Tek ayaqlı, tək gözlü, tək qollu keçəl varlıqlardır.

statement.id: Mereka makhluk botak (keçəl) yang berkaki satu, bermata satu, dan berlengan satu (tək gözlü, tək qollu).
statement.en: They are bald (keçəl) beings with one leg, one eye and one arm (tək gözlü, tək qollu).

basis_claims.quote: Hepsinde bulunan ortak bir özellik olarak tek ayaklı, tek gözlü, tek kollu, kel varlıklardır. Öteki âleme âit canlılar dâima tek gözlü olarak betimlenir.

statement.id: Ciri bersama mereka semua adalah berkaki satu, bermata satu, berlengan satu, dan botak (kel); makhluk dari alam lain (öteki âlem) selalu digambarkan bermata satu.
statement.en: Their shared feature is that they are one-legged, one-eyed, one-armed and bald (kel); creatures of the other world (öteki âlem) are always depicted as one-eyed.

statement.en: It protects sown fields; it is a grey-haired old woman (Kırsaçlı bir kocakarı) who sits in a tree called Uruk.

basis_claims.quote: Uzun kollu olduğu için göğe kadar uzanıp bulutları sıkarak yağmur yağdırır. Bazen komşu tarlaların iyeleri arasında kavga çıktığına inanılır.

statement.en: Because its arms are long, it reaches up to the sky and squeezes the clouds to make rain fall (yağmur yağdırır); sometimes fights are believed to break out between the iyes of neighbouring fields.

muscaliet.aura: Alert tense crouch at desiccated roots under natural woodland light.

basis_claims.quote: Le Bestiaire de Pierre de Beauvais, datant du XIIe siècle, comprend une description de l'animal qui a le corps d'un lièvre (mais plus petit), les pattes et la queue d'un écureuil, les oreilles d'une belette et le museau d'une taupe. Il a des dents de sanglier et sa peau est touffue comme celle d'un porc.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, Bestiaire Pierre de Beauvais dari abad ke-12 menggambarkannya bertubuh kelinci yang lebih kecil, berkaki dan berekor tupai, bertelinga musang, bermoncong tikus tanah, bergigi babi hutan, dan berkulit lebat seperti babi.
statement.en: According to the French article, Pierre de Beauvais's 12th-century Bestiaire describes it with a hare's body but smaller, a squirrel's legs and tail, a weasel's ears, a mole's snout, a boar's teeth and a pig's bristly skin.

basis_claims.quote: Il grimpe aux arbres et saute de branche en branche à l'aide de sa queue. Lorsqu'il grimpe dans un arbre, la muscaliet détruit le feuillage et les fruits. Sous les racines d'un arbre, il fait son nid. Sa chaleur naturelle fait que l'arbre se dessèche et meurt

statement.id: Ia memanjat pohon, melompat antardahan dengan bantuan ekornya, merusak daun dan buah, bersarang di bawah akar, dan panas tubuhnya membuat pohon kering lalu mati.
statement.en: It climbs trees and leaps from branch to branch with its tail, destroys leaves and fruit, nests under the roots, and its natural heat dries the tree until it dies.

basis_claims.quote: Een muscaliet is een fruitetend fabeldier dat het lichaam heeft van een haas (maar dan kleiner), de benen en de staart van een eekhoorn, de oren van een wezel en de snuit van een mol.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Belanda menyebut muscaliet hewan dongeng pemakan buah bertubuh kelinci yang lebih kecil, berkaki dan berekor tupai, bertelinga musang, dan bermoncong tikus tanah.
statement.en: The Dutch article calls the muscaliet a fruit-eating fabulous animal with a smaller hare's body, a squirrel's legs and tail, a weasel's ears and a mole's snout.

visual_requirements: Natural fish form with fins and tail
Golden crown

stinthengst.aura: Regal poised swim, clear watchful fish eye and natural underwater light.

basis_claims.quote: Der Stinthengst (polnisch Rybi Król – Fischkönig oder auch Król Sielaw – Stintkönig) ist ein Fabelwesen, das aus den masurischen Gewässern um Nikolaiken (Mikołajki) stammt.

statement.id: Stinthengst (Polandia: Rybi Król, "raja ikan", atau Król Sielaw, "raja smelt") adalah makhluk dongeng dari perairan Masuria (masurischen) sekitar Nikolaiken (Mikołajki), Polandia.
statement.en: The Stinthengst (Polish Rybi Król, 'fish king', or Król Sielaw, 'smelt king') is a fabulous being from the Masurian (masurischen) waters around Nikolaiken (Mikołajki).

basis_claims.quote: Bei dem Stinthengst handelt es sich um den König der Stinte, einer Fischart, die in den masurischen Gewässern häufig anzutreffen ist.

statement.id: Stinthengst adalah raja ikan smelt (Stinte), jenis ikan yang banyak ditemukan di perairan Masuria.
statement.en: The Stinthengst is the king of the smelt (Stinte), a fish common in the Masurian waters.

basis_claims.quote: Der Stinthengst wird alljährlich mit der sogenannten Wasserung geehrt, trägt eine goldene Krone und sorgt dafür, dass reichlich Fische an der Stelle zu fangen sind, an der ihn die Fischer festgebunden haben. Er ist auch das Wappentier der heutigen Stadt Mikołajki.

statement.id: Stinthengst dihormati setiap tahun dengan upacara Wasserung, bermahkota emas, memastikan ikan berlimpah di tempat ia diikat, dan menjadi hewan lambang kota Mikołajki.
statement.en: The Stinthengst is honoured yearly with the so-called Wasserung, wears a golden crown, ensures plenty of fish where he was tied, and is the heraldic animal of today's Mikołajki.

tinilau.aura: Quiet character presence through documented form, posture and natural light

basis_claims.quote: In Polynesian mythology, stories about Tinirau are found throughout the islands of Polynesia. He is a guardian of fish.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Polinesia, kisah tentang Tinirau ditemukan di seluruh kepulauan Polinesia; ia penjaga ikan.
statement.en: In Polynesian mythology, stories of Tinirau are found throughout the islands of Polynesia; he is a guardian of fish.

basis_claims.quote: In some traditions, he has a dual nature; one destructive as the guardian of sharks, and one a kind, handsome male youth; in others, his right side is human and his left side is a fish.

statement.id: Dalam sebagian tradisi ia berwatak ganda, sisi perusak sebagai penjaga hiu dan sisi pemuda tampan yang baik; dalam tradisi lain sisi kanannya manusia dan sisi kirinya ikan.
statement.en: In some traditions he has a dual nature, destructive as guardian of sharks and a kind, handsome youth; in others his right side is human and his left a fish.

basis_claims.quote: Tinilau ou Tinirau est un dieu polynésien gardien des poissons, dans la culture de l'île de Samoa, de Hawaï ou dans la mythologie maorie de Nouvelle-Zélande et des Îles Cook.

statement.id: Tinilau atau Tinirau adalah dewa Polinesia penjaga ikan dalam budaya Samoa, Hawaii, dan mitologi Maori Selandia Baru serta Kepulauan Cook.
statement.en: Tinilau or Tinirau is a Polynesian god, guardian of fish, in the culture of Samoa and Hawaii and in the Māori mythology of New Zealand and the Cook Islands.

ulu-toyon.aura: Presence through source-backed form and physical scene; no generic glow, ribbons or magical mist.

basis_claims.quote: Ulu Toyon (auch Ulu Toyo'n) ist im Glauben der sibirischen Jakuten ein Dämonenkönig. Er herrscht über die Abaasy, die Dämonen der Unterwelt. Demnach lebt Ulu Toyon im dritten Himmel und gab einst den Menschen das Geheimnis des Feuers.

statement.id: Dalam kepercayaan orang Yakut (Jakuten) Siberia, Ulu Toyon adalah raja iblis yang memerintah Abaasy, iblis dunia bawah; ia tinggal di langit ketiga dan pernah memberi manusia rahasia api.
statement.en: In the belief of the Siberian Yakuts (Jakuten), Ulu Toyon is a demon king ruling the Abaasy, demons of the underworld; he lives in the third heaven and once gave people the secret of fire.

basis_claims.quote: Улу Тойон (якут. Улуу Тойон; от тюрк.  — «великий господин») — антропоморфный глава злых духов (абасы), обитатель верхнего мира, покровитель шаманов в мифологии якутов.

statement.id: Ulu Toyon (Yakut: Uluu Toyon, dari bahasa Turk "tuan agung") adalah kepala antropomorfis roh jahat (abasy), penghuni dunia atas, dan pelindung dukun dalam mitologi Yakut.
statement.en: Ulu Toyon (Yakut: Uluu Toyon, Turkic for 'great lord') is the anthropomorphic head of the evil spirits (abasy), dweller of the upper world and patron of shamans in Yakut mythology.

basis_claims.quote: Улу Тойон является отцом воронов, при этом сам нередко предстаёт в обличье ворона, в связи чем его называют величайший великий ворон господин (якут. Улуутуйар Улуу Суорун Тойон).

statement.id: Ulu Toyon adalah ayah para gagak dan sering muncul sebagai gagak, sehingga disebut "tuan gagak agung terbesar" (Yakut: Uluutuyar Uluu Suorun Toyon).
statement.en: Ulu Toyon is the father of ravens and often appears as one, hence his title 'greatest great raven lord' (Yakut: Uluutuyar Uluu Suorun Toyon).

basis_claims.quote: Являясь покровителем шаманов, Улу Тойон вершит справедливый суд, разрешая споры и наказывая обидевших того или иного шамана людей.

statement.id: Sebagai pelindung dukun, Ulu Toyon mengadili dengan adil, menyelesaikan perselisihan, dan menghukum orang yang menyakiti seorang dukun.
statement.en: As patron of shamans, Ulu Toyon judges fairly, settling disputes and punishing those who wronged a shaman.

statement.id: Kubikireuma adalah yōkai kuda dalam tradisi Jepang, juga disebut Kubinashiuma.

statement.id: Svyatogor (Святогор, juga Sviatogor) adalah bogatyr mitis dalam bylina (puisi epos lisan) Rusia; namanya berasal dari kata untuk "gunung suci".
statement.en: Svyatogor (also Sviatogor) is a mythical bogatyr in Russian byliny (oral epic poems); his name derives from the words for "sacred mountain".

basis_claims.quote: в древнерусской мифологии богатырь-великан. Относится к наиболее древним героям русского былинного эпоса, находящегося вне киевского и новгородского циклов

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Rusia kuno Svyatogor adalah bogatyr raksasa, salah satu pahlawan tertua epos bylina Rusia di luar siklus Kiev dan Novgorod.
statement.en: In old Russian mythology Svyatogor is a giant bogatyr, among the oldest heroes of the Russian bylina epic, outside the Kiev and Novgorod cycles.

basis_claims.quote: Святогор в эпосе является огромным великаном, «выше леса стоячего, ниже облака ходячего». Он не ездит на Святую Русь, а живёт на высоких Святых горах; при его поездке Мать — Сыра Земля потрясается, леса колышутся и реки выливаются из берегов. Святогор является русским древнейшим богатырём, дохристианским, божественным и могучим.

statement.id: Svyatogor adalah raksasa "lebih tinggi dari hutan yang berdiri, lebih rendah dari awan yang berjalan", tinggal di Pegunungan Suci yang tinggi; bila ia berkuda Ibu Bumi berguncang, hutan bergoyang, dan sungai meluap; ia bogatyr Rusia tertua, pra-Kristen, ilahi, dan perkasa.
statement.en: Svyatogor is a huge giant "taller than the standing forest, lower than the walking cloud", living on the high Holy Mountains; when he rides Mother Earth shakes, forests sway and rivers overflow; he is the oldest Russian bogatyr, pre-Christian, divine and mighty.

basis_claims.quote: is a demigod, hero and the central character in Finnish folklore and the main character in the national epic Kalevala by Elias Lönnrot. Väinämöinen was described as an old and wise man, and he possessed a potent, magical singing voice.

statement.en: Väinämöinen is a demigod, hero and central character of Finnish folklore and the main character of Elias Lönnrot's national epic Kalevala; he was described as an old, wise man with a potent, magical singing voice.

Väinämöinen's element is water, and he is widely connected to it in many regions.

statement.id: Di Karelia, seekor burung bertelur di lutut Väinämöinen; ketika ia menggerakkannya, telur-telur jatuh dan pecah membentuk bumi dan langit. Unsur Väinämöinen adalah air, dan di banyak daerah ia dikaitkan dengannya.
statement.en: In Karelia a bird lays an egg on Väinämöinen's knee; when he moves it, the eggs fall and break, forming earth and sky. His element is water, and many regions connect him with it.

basis_claims.quote: 《山海經·北山經》載：「又北百八十里，曰渾夕之山，無草木，多銅玉。囂水出焉，而西北流注于海。有蛇一首兩身，名曰肥遺，見則其國大旱。」肥遺外貌如蛇，但同一個頭部下卻有兩條身軀。可是這形象卻與《山海經·西山經》中的近似生物不同，在《西山經》中的記載為：「又西六十里，曰太華之山，削成而四方，其高五千仞，其廣十里，鳥獸莫居。有蛇焉，名曰肥遺，六足四翼，見則天下大旱。」此處的肥遺蛇卻並非一首兩身，而是六足四翼。然而兩者相同之處是，每當此蛇出現時，附近封國（甚至全國）都會出現大旱災。

statement.id: Versi utara memberinya satu kepala dengan dua tubuh.
statement.en: The northern version gives it one head and two bodies.

酸與，是《山海经》的鸟类，长得像蛇，却有四只翅膀、六只眼睛和三只脚。叫声像是在叫自己，此鸟一旦出现，就会有恐怖的事。
象徵『災噩』。

statement.id: Makhluk ini mempunyai empat sayap.
statement.en: The creature has four wings.

basis_claims.quote:
酸與，是《山海经》的鸟类，长得像蛇，却有四只翅膀、六只眼睛和三只脚。叫声像是在叫自己，此鸟一旦出现，就会有恐怖的事。
象徵『災噩』。

statement.id: Ia juga memiliki enam mata dan tiga kaki.
statement.en: It also has six eyes and three feet.

basis_claims.quote:
酸與，是《山海经》的鸟类，长得像蛇，却有四只翅膀、六只眼睛和三只脚。叫声像是在叫自己，此鸟一旦出现，就会有恐怖的事。
象徵『災噩』。

statement.id: Kemunculannya dianggap pertanda bahwa suatu tempat akan mengalami ketakutan.
statement.en: Its appearance is regarded as an omen of fear in a locality.

basis_claims.quote: 又南三百里，曰景山，南望鹽販之澤，北望少澤。 ... 有鳥焉，其狀如蛇，而四翼、六目、三足，名曰酸與，其鳴自詨，見則其邑有恐。

statement.id: Teks klasik menempatkan Suanyu pada Gunung Jing.
statement.en: The classical text places Suanyu on Mount Jing.

ahti.depicted_variant: Ahto water god as man with moss beard
visual_requirements: Normal man with beard visibly composed of moss
No separate heroic Ahti or merfolk hybrid
ahti.aura: Character presence through documented anatomy, expression, framing and natural lighting

basis_claims.quote: Ahti is a water god in Finnish mythology. In the Kalevala, he is referred to with the name Ahto in order to not confuse him with the separate character Ahti Saarelainen.

statement.id: Ahti adalah dewa air dalam mitologi Finlandia; dalam Kalevala ia disebut Ahto agar tidak tertukar dengan tokoh lain, Ahti Saarelainen.
statement.en: Ahti is a water god in Finnish mythology; in the Kalevala he is called Ahto so as not to confuse him with the separate character Ahti Saarelainen.

basis_claims.quote: Dans la mythologie finlandaise, Ahti ou Ahto est le dieu de la mer et de la pêche. Il est représenté comme un homme avec une barbe de mousse. Il est l'époux de Vellamo et ils demeurent tous deux dans le palais sous-marin de Ahtola.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Finlandia, Ahti atau Ahto adalah dewa laut dan perikanan; ia digambarkan sebagai laki-laki berjanggut lumut, suami Vellamo, dan keduanya tinggal di istana bawah laut Ahtola.
statement.en: In Finnish mythology Ahti or Ahto is the god of the sea and fishing, depicted as a man with a beard of moss; he is Vellamo's husband and both live in the undersea palace of Ahtola.

bestial-beast.depicted_variant: Besta-fera horse body with human male torso
visual_requirements: Four-legged horse body and human torso/head/two arms
No invented horns, wings or animal head
bestial-beast.aura: Character presence through documented anatomy, expression, framing and natural lighting

basis_claims.quote: A besta-fera é um ser mítico do folclore português e brasileiro.

statement.id: Besta-fera adalah makhluk mitos dalam cerita rakyat Portugal dan Brasil.
statement.en: The besta-fera is a mythical being of Portuguese and Brazilian folklore.

basis_claims.quote: Também se diz que a besta-fera é uma versão brasileira do centauro

statement.id: Besta-fera juga disebut versi Brasil dari centaur.
statement.en: The besta-fera is also said to be a Brazilian version of the centaur.

basis_claims.quote: acredita-se que ele é o próprio Diabo, que sai do Inferno em noites de lua cheia para colocar o "sinal da besta" nas pessoas

statement.id: Menurut legenda, ia adalah Iblis sendiri yang keluar dari Neraka pada malam bulan purnama untuk memberi "tanda binatang" pada manusia.
statement.en: It is believed to be the Devil himself, leaving Hell on full-moon nights to put the "mark of the beast" on people.

basis_claims.quote: A besta-fera tem o corpo de cavalo e o dorso humano.

statement.id: Besta-fera bertubuh kuda dan berbadan atas manusia.
statement.en: The besta-fera has the body of a horse and a human torso.

basis_claims.quote: Besta-fera – a centaur-like creature, thought to be the Devil. The name can be roughly translated as "Feral Beast" or "Bestial Beast".

statement.id: Besta-fera adalah makhluk mirip centaur yang dianggap Iblis; namanya kira-kira berarti "binatang buas".
statement.en: Besta-fera is a centaur-like creature thought to be the Devil; the name roughly means "Feral Beast" or "Bestial Beast".

blo-ughofi.depicted_variant: horse safely crossing fire and darkness
visual_requirements: horse safely crossing fire and darkness
Coherent anatomy and documented mythic identity
blo-ughofi.aura: No generic glow or magical particles; physical light and source-backed scene only.

basis_claims.quote: In Nordic mythology, Blóðughófi (sometimes anglicised Blodughofi and meaning "Bloody Hoof" in Old Norse) is the horse of Freyr and is notable for his ability to pass safely through fire and darkness. He is attested in several þulur of horses.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik, Blóðughófi (kadang ditulis Blodughofi, berarti "Kuku Berdarah" dalam Nordik Kuno) adalah kuda Freyr yang dikenal mampu melintasi api dan kegelapan dengan selamat; ia tercatat dalam beberapa þulur kuda.
statement.en: In Nordic mythology Blóðughófi (sometimes Blodughofi, Old Norse 'Bloody Hoof') is Freyr's horse, notable for passing safely through fire and darkness; he is attested in several þulur of horses.

basis_claims.quote: Blóðughófi est, dans la mythologie nordique, le cheval servant de monture au dieu Freyr. Il est décrit comme capable de traverser le feu et les ténèbres. ... En vieux norrois, le nom Blóðughófi signifie « sabot sanglant ».

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik, Blóðughófi adalah kuda tunggangan dewa Freyr yang digambarkan mampu melintasi api dan kegelapan; dalam Nordik Kuno namanya berarti "kuku berdarah".
statement.en: In Norse mythology Blóðughófi is the god Freyr's mount, described as able to cross fire and darkness; in Old Norse the name means 'bloody hoof'.

artistic_changes: Painterly square composition
Setting and attire are editorial atmosphere

presentation_revision.rationale: Makes documented ability visible through physical fire-crossing rather than ordinary horse scenery.

cavall.depicted_variant: Arthur’s hound actively pursuing the great boar Twrch Trwyth, Arthur and companions following.
visual_requirements: Natural brown hound anatomy
Arthurian hunting party
Great boar clearly oversized
Non-graphic scene

basis_claims.quote: was King Arthur's dog, used in the hunt for the great boar, Twrch Trwyth (Latin: Troynt, Troit ). Cavall was Arthur's "favourite dog", and during a stag hunt, he was customarily the last dog to be let loose to chase after the game (Gereint Son of Erbin).

statement.id: Cavall (Cafall, Cabal) anjing kesayangan Raja Arthur (King Arthur), dipakai memburu Twrch Trwyth (Troynt); anjing terakhir dilepas dalam perburuan rusa (Gereint Son of Erbin); tradisi Welsh.
statement.en: Cavall (Cafall, Cabal) was King Arthur's favourite dog, used to hunt Twrch Trwyth (Troynt); last dog loosed in a stag hunt (Gereint Son of Erbin); Welsh tradition.

artistic_changes: Brown coat retained from prior illustration
Medieval garments, circlet, weapons and Welsh scenery are editorial staging rather than unique attested costume

presentation_revision.rationale: Previous image had only a dog and faint rock pawprint. The documented legendary hunt conveys its Arthurian identity at catalogue scale.

hwch-ddu-gwta.depicted_variant: Tail-less black sow beside dying bonfire in Welsh Nos Galan Gaeaf tradition.
visual_requirements: One natural black sow with NO TAIL
Welsh autumn night dying bonfire
No headless-woman variant
hwch-ddu-gwta.aura: Ominous watchful sow silhouette and natural ember/moon light.

basis_claims.quote: oruwchnaturiol yn llên gwerin Cymru a gysylltir â Nos Galan Gaeaf yw'r Hwch Ddu Gwta (Hwch Ddu Gota yn y De)

statement.id: Hwch Ddu Gwta adalah babi betina (hwch) gaib dalam cerita rakyat Wales (llên gwerin Cymru) yang dikaitkan dengan Nos Galan Gaeaf; di selatan (De) disebut Hwch Ddu Gota.
statement.en: The Hwch Ddu Gwta is a supernatural (goruwchnaturiol) sow in Welsh folklore (llên gwerin Cymru) associated with Nos Galan Gaeaf; in the south (De) she is called Hwch Ddu Gota.

basis_claims.quote: Credid bod yr Hwch Ddu Gwta yn ymrithio o wreichion olaf y goelcerth ac yn rhuthro ar ôl yr olaf i adael i'w bwyta.

statement.id: Dipercaya Hwch Ddu Gwta menjelma dari percikan terakhir api unggun (coelcerth) dan memburu orang terakhir yang pergi untuk memakannya.
statement.en: The Hwch Ddu Gwta was believed to take shape from the last sparks of the bonfire (coelcerth) and rush after the last (olaf) to leave in order to eat them.

basis_claims.quote: mainly in North Wales the tail-less black sow [hwch ddu gwta] and was associated with lighting bonfires after dark, as the fire died down they feared the appearance of the black sow

statement.id: Sosok umum lainnya, terutama di Wales Utara, adalah babi betina hitam tanpa ekor (hwch ddu gwta) yang dikaitkan dengan api unggun; saat api padam orang takut babi hitam itu muncul.
statement.en: Another common one, mainly in North Wales, was the tail-less black sow (hwch ddu gwta), associated with bonfires after dark; as the fire died down people feared the black sow's appearance.

gigiatt.depicted_variant: Lombard article's huge billy-goat-shaped variant, not uncertain three-species composite.
visual_requirements: One huge natural billy-goat-shaped creature
Documented tremendous size set by small valley trees
No arbitrary deer antler/chamois fusion
gigiatt.aura: Colossal goat presence with low framing and natural mountain light.

basis_claims.quote: Il Gigiàt o Gigiàtt sarebbe, nelle tradizioni folkloristiche alpine lombarde, nello specifico della Val Masino, un mostro di proporzioni enormi, che ha la consuetudine di integrare la sua dieta, fondamentalmente vegetariana, con qualche pasto a base di escursionisti o alpinisti solitari

statement.id: Dalam tradisi rakyat Alpen Lombardia, khususnya Val Masino, Gigiàt adalah monster raksasa yang pada dasarnya pemakan tumbuhan tetapi sesekali memakan pendaki yang berjalan sendirian.
statement.en: In the Alpine folk traditions of Lombardy, specifically the Val Masino, the Gigiàt is a huge monster whose basically vegetarian diet is supplemented now and then with lone hikers or climbers.

basis_claims.quote: El gh'ha la forma d'on gross cavron, forsi incrosaa cont on camozz, e l'è cognossuu per el sò vess bell svelt e grand.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Lombard, ia berwujud kambing jantan besar, mungkin persilangan dengan chamois, dan dikenal cepat serta besar.
statement.en: According to the Lombard article, it is shaped like a big billy goat, perhaps crossed with a chamois, and is known for its speed and size.

a.depicted_variant: Vupkan in the northern Chuvash documented dog-form evil spirit blamed for epidemics and household impoverishment. A dark dog stands squarely in foreground by a shabby house; beside the doorway a fully clothed worried adult tends another sick adult seated weakly on a bench, while a cow lies exhausted in the neglected farmyard and an empty food basket lies nearby. Dog's watchful presence and simultaneous household disease/decline dominate narrative; no actual wounds, bodies or gore. Natural dog anatomy, no wings, horns, flaming eyes or invented aura. Do not combine the southern invisible wind variant.

basis_claims.quote: «вуп, воп» — «напускать порчу, приносить несчастье») — злой дух в чувашской мифологии.

statement.id: Vupkăn adalah roh jahat dalam mitologi Chuvash; kata vup berarti "mendatangkan guna-guna, membawa sial".
statement.en: Vupkăn is an evil spirit of Chuvash mythology; vup means "to cast a curse, bring misfortune".

basis_claims.quote: По В. К. Магницкому, северные чуваши раньше представляли вупкана в виде собаки и также видели в нём причину губительных для человека и животных эпидемий.

statement.id: Menurut V. K. Magnitsky, orang Chuvash utara dulu membayangkan vupkan sebagai anjing dan juga menganggapnya penyebab wabah yang membinasakan manusia dan hewan.
statement.en: According to V. K. Magnitsky, northern Chuvash once pictured the vupkan as a dog and also blamed it for deadly epidemics among people and animals.

basis_claims.quote: Если в доме поселяется вупкан, то хозяйство приходит в упадок, начинается бедность.

statement.id: Bila vupkan menetap di sebuah rumah, rumah tangga itu merosot dan jatuh miskin.
statement.en: If a vupkan settles in a house, the household declines into poverty.

a.artistic_changes: Staging, clothing and composition are editorial; Asytakha head count three is a visual realization of unspecified many.

presentation_revision.rationale: Show recorded supernatural anatomy or defining episode instead of isolated ordinary animal.

ajatar.depicted_variant: Humanlike female Ajatar with documented heel-length hair braid, fully clothed forest staging; no dragon/hybrid variant.
visual_requirements: Adult woman with braid reaching heels
Opaque loose robe covering body entirely
No blended modern dragon/serpent anatomy
ajatar.aura: Severe unsettling human expression, dark forest depth and natural dappled light.

basis_claims.quote: In Finnish folklore Ajatar is an evil female spirit. She is described as having "hair-plait reached to her heels and whose breasts hung down to her knees"

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Finlandia, Ajatar adalah roh perempuan jahat yang digambarkan berkepang rambut sampai ke tumit dan berpayudara menjuntai sampai ke lutut.
statement.en: In Finnish folklore Ajatar is an evil female spirit described with a braid reaching her heels and breasts hanging to her knees.

basis_claims.quote: Daniel Juslenius called Ajattara an evil witch and a forest troll. According to Christian Erici Lencqvist, Ajattara is a female evil forest haltija, who is scary and fast and drives people astray.

statement.id: Daniel Juslenius menyebut Ajattara penyihir jahat dan troll hutan; menurut Christian Erici Lencqvist, Ajattara adalah haltija (roh) hutan perempuan yang jahat, menakutkan, cepat, dan menyesatkan orang.
statement.en: Daniel Juslenius called Ajattara an evil witch and forest troll; according to Christian Erici Lencqvist she is an evil female forest haltija (spirit), frightening and fast, who leads people astray.

apotamkin.depicted_variant: Fully fish-bodied long red human hair variant, giant fanged aquatic Apotamkin.
visual_requirements: One full fish body with fins/tail
Long red human hair
Documented fangs without human/ape variant mixing
apotamkin.aura: Still unsettling fish gaze and large silhouette beneath natural surface light.

basis_claims.quote: is a creature in Maliseet and Passamaquoddy mythology. It is described a giant fanged sea monster that lives in the Passamaquoddy Bay, specifically at the mouth of St. Croix River, and pulls people in to eat them, particularly careless children.

statement.id: Apotamkin adalah makhluk dalam mitologi Maliseet dan Passamaquoddy: monster laut raksasa bertaring di Teluk Passamaquoddy, di muara Sungai St. Croix, yang menyeret orang untuk dimakan, terutama anak-anak yang lengah.
statement.en: The Apotamkin is a creature of Maliseet and Passamaquoddy mythology: a giant fanged sea monster of Passamaquoddy Bay, at the mouth of the St. Croix River, that drags people in to eat them, especially careless children.

basis_claims.quote: The Apotamkin is sometimes described as being humanoid, and sometimes as having a fully fish body with human hair. It is consistently said to have long red hair, and in some versions, it was a human woman before being changed into a serpent.

statement.id: Kadang ia digambarkan mirip manusia, kadang bertubuh ikan dengan rambut manusia; rambutnya selalu disebut panjang dan merah, dan dalam beberapa versi ia dulu perempuan yang diubah menjadi ular.
statement.en: It is sometimes humanoid, sometimes fish-bodied with human hair; its hair is always long and red, and in some versions it was a woman turned into a serpent.

tac.depicted_variant: Tac in the lamb shape from Gascony, the trickster that gets carried on a passerby's back until the person is exhausted. A fully clothed adult traveler staggers and kneels in strain on a moonlit Landes forest path carrying a small white lamb across their shoulders. Lamb's placid mischievous expression contrasts with the person's inexplicably crushing burden, hands gripping its two leg pairs; the living lamb has four legs, one head and one tail, no monstrous mutation. A dropped walking stick and buckling posture make the sourced supernatural exhaustion visible. No death or injury, no aura or beams.
tac.visual_requirements: Tac in the lamb shape from Gascony, the trickster that gets carried on a passerby's back until the person is exhausted.
