basis_claims.quote: Il est capable de prendre différentes formes : panier, agneau, chevreau. Il peut également prendre parfois la forme d'un cheval, entraînant ainsi, en se jetant dans une rivière, la noyade de ceux qui ont le malheur de le monter.

statement.id: Ia dapat berubah wujud menjadi keranjang, anak domba, atau anak kambing, dan kadang menjadi kuda yang terjun ke sungai sehingga penunggangnya tenggelam.
statement.en: It can take various forms, a basket, a lamb, a kid, and sometimes a horse that throws itself into a river, drowning those unlucky enough to ride it.

basis_claims.quote: Il se manifeste la nuit dans les bois ou près des fontaines des Landes. Il peut alors siffler quand quelqu'un vient en imitant le bruit du hapchot, outil du gemmeur landais.

statement.id: Ia muncul pada malam hari di hutan atau dekat mata air Landes dan bersiul meniru bunyi hapchot, alat penyadap getah pinus Landes.
statement.en: It appears at night in the woods or near the springs of the Landes, whistling like the hapchot, the tool of the Landes resin tapper.

basis_claims.quote: Il cherche toujours  à se faire porter sur le dos de la personne qui passe et ceci jusqu'à l'épuisement et parfois le trépas de sa victime.

statement.id: Ia selalu berusaha digendong di punggung orang yang lewat sampai korbannya kelelahan dan kadang mati.
statement.en: It always tries to get carried on a passer-by's back until the victim is exhausted and sometimes dies.

basis_claims.quote: És una mena d'ésser entremaliat que enganya els humans i se'n riu de la seva credulitat

statement.id: Ia makhluk usil yang menipu manusia dan menertawakan kepolosan mereka.
statement.en: It is a mischievous being that tricks humans and laughs at their gullibility.

tac.artistic_changes: Landes path and traveler clothing/pose are editorial staging.

presentation_revision.rationale: Supernatural carrying exhaustion makes sourced trickster identity visible without modifying lamb anatomy.

nefeles.depicted_variant: Adult human Nephelai rain nymph pouring water from jug
visual_requirements: One adult beautiful human woman
Hands hold jug pouring water
No cloud-body or wing additions
nefeles.aura: Character presence through documented form, expression, framing and natural light

basis_claims.quote: Dans la mythologie grecque, les Néphélées (en grec ancien Νεφέλαι / Nephélai, de νέφος / néphos, « nuage »), filles d'Éther ou d'Océan et de Téthys, sont les nymphes des nuages et de la pluie.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Yunani, Nephelai (dari kata Yunani néphos, "awan"), putri Aither atau Okeanos dan Tethys, adalah nimfa awan dan hujan.
statement.en: In Greek mythology the Nephelai (from Greek néphos, 'cloud'), daughters of Aether or of Oceanus and Tethys, are the nymphs of clouds and rain.

basis_claims.quote: Elles s'élèvent des flots de leur père, le grand fleuve Océan qui entoure le monde, emportant avec elles vers le Ciel, ses eaux fraîches dans des cruches faites de nuages. De ces eaux, elles nourrissent la Terre et alimentent les eaux de leurs frères, les dieux fleuves.

statement.id: Mereka naik dari arus ayah mereka, sungai besar Okeanos yang mengelilingi dunia, membawa airnya ke langit dalam kendi dari awan, lalu dengan air itu menghidupi Bumi dan mengisi sungai-sungai saudara mereka.
statement.en: They rise from the waters of their father, the great river Oceanus that encircles the world, carrying its cool water to the sky in jugs of cloud, and with it nourish the Earth and feed their brothers the river gods.

basis_claims.quote: Les Néphélées, tout comme leurs sœurs les naïades, sont dépeintes comme de belles jeunes filles tenant des cruches, qui versent de l'eau.

statement.id: Seperti saudari mereka para naiad, Nephelai digambarkan sebagai gadis cantik yang memegang kendi dan menuangkan air.
statement.en: Like their sisters the naiads, the Nephelai are pictured as beautiful girls holding jugs and pouring water.

camacruda.depicted_variant: Basic lone living leg with one open eye at knee, no variant horn.
visual_requirements: One intact lone skin-covered leg/foot
Eye at knee
Haystack night setting, no wound gore
camacruda.aura: Uncanny poised leg and watchful knee eye in ordinary moonlight.

basis_claims.quote: Elle est généralement décrite comme une jambe seule, parfois munie d'un œil au genou (la camba crusa dab l'uèlh dubèrt, la jambe crue avec l'œil ouvert). Elle surgit dans la nuit pour emporter, et dévorer, les imprudents.

statement.id: Ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai sebatang kaki saja, kadang dengan mata di lutut (camba crusa dab l'uèlh dubèrt, "kaki mentah dengan mata terbuka"), yang muncul pada malam hari untuk membawa dan memakan orang yang lengah.
statement.en: It is usually described as a lone leg, sometimes with an eye on the knee (camba crusa dab l'uèlh dubèrt, 'raw leg with the open eye'), which appears at night to carry off and devour the careless.

basis_claims.quote: Selon l’abbé Vincent Foix, la came-crude se cache derrière les meules de paille ou de foin.

statement.id: Menurut Abbé Vincent Foix, came-crude bersembunyi di balik tumpukan jerami.
statement.en: According to Abbé Vincent Foix, the came-crude hides behind haystacks and straw stacks.

cegua.depicted_variant: Horse-headed transformed Cegua from c02, distinct from rotting horse-skull variant.
visual_requirements: Adult female humanlike body with horse head
Fully clothed lonely road at night
No combined skull-rot variant
cegua.aura: Unsettling horse-head gaze and still waiting posture in naturally lit lonely road.

basis_claims.quote: La Cegua (del náhuatl, cihuatl, mujer),​​ también conocida como Ceguanaba,​ Segua o Tzegua, es un personaje de las leyendas mexicanas y centroamericanas.

statement.id: Cegua (dari bahasa Nahuatl cihuatl, "perempuan"), dikenal juga sebagai Ceguanaba, Segua, atau Tzegua, adalah tokoh legenda Meksiko dan Amerika Tengah.
statement.en: The Cegua (from Nahuatl cihuatl, 'woman'), also known as Ceguanaba, Segua or Tzegua, is a figure of Mexican and Central American legend.

basis_claims.quote: Es un ser espectral que se materializa por las noches en caminos solitarios, solicitando ayuda para que la lleven a algún poblado cercano. El espanto generalmente se aparece a los hombres mujeriegos en la forma de una mujer muy hermosa, la cual luego se transforma en un monstruo con la cabeza de un caballo.

statement.id: Ia makhluk hantu yang muncul malam hari di jalan sepi, meminta diantar ke desa terdekat; biasanya ia menampakkan diri kepada lelaki hidung belang sebagai perempuan sangat cantik yang lalu berubah menjadi monster berkepala kuda.
statement.en: It is a spectral being that appears at night on lonely roads asking to be taken to a nearby village; it usually appears to womanisers as a very beautiful woman who then turns into a monster with a horse's head.

basis_claims.quote: El término cegua para designar a este ser espectral es de uso predominante en Nicaragua y Costa Rica

statement.id: Sebutan cegua terutama dipakai di Nikaragua dan Kosta Rika.
statement.en: The term cegua is used mainly in Nicaragua and Costa Rica.

visual_requirements: Normal human-looking male cave spirit
No horns/hooves or dragon mixing
Teaching books as editorial context
etsai.aura: Character presence through documented form, expression, framing and natural light

basis_claims.quote: Etsai (prononcer « etchaye») est un des diables dans la mythologie basque qui exerce la fonction de professeur dans des grottes.

statement.id: Etsai adalah salah satu iblis mitologi Basque yang berperan sebagai guru di gua-gua.
statement.en: Etsai is one of the devils of Basque mythology, who works as a teacher in caves.

basis_claims.quote: Il a tendance à prendre plusieurs formes, selon la légende: Il a souvent la forme d'un dragon ou d'un humain, mais il est aussi souvent représenté avec le corps d'un animal.

statement.id: Ia mengambil berbagai wujud: sering naga atau manusia, tetapi juga bertubuh hewan.
statement.en: He takes many forms: often a dragon or a human, but also an animal body.

basis_claims.quote: Il habitait la grotte de Leiza à Sare ou d'Akelarren-leze à Zugarramurdi où il tenait une école, en concurrence avec les universités de Salamanque et d'autres lieux, et enseignait en peu de temps les sciences, les arts et les lettres

statement.id: Ia tinggal di gua Leiza di Sare atau Akelarren-leze di Zugarramurdi, tempat ia menjalankan sekolah yang menyaingi universitas Salamanca dan mengajarkan ilmu, seni, dan sastra dalam waktu singkat.
statement.en: He lived in the Leiza cave at Sare or Akelarren-leze at Zugarramurdi, where he ran a school rivalling the universities of Salamanca and elsewhere, teaching sciences, arts and letters in a short time.

glaistig.depicted_variant: Campbell's thin grey little adult woman, heel-long yellow hair and green dress; goat account omitted.
visual_requirements: Thin grey adult woman with ordinary human anatomy
Long yellow hair to heels
Green modest dress and milk offering
glaistig.aura: Calm attentive protective presence in natural late-evening light.

basis_claims.quote: The Glaistig was a tutelary being in the shape of a thin grey (tana glas) little woman, with long yellow hair reaching to her heels, dressed in green, haunting certain sites or farms

statement.id: Glaistig adalah makhluk pelindung berwujud perempuan kecil kurus kelabu dengan rambut kuning panjang sampai tumit, berpakaian hijau, yang menghuni tempat atau pertanian tertentu.
statement.en: The Glaistig was a tutelary being shaped like a thin grey little woman with long yellow hair to her heels, dressed in green, haunting certain sites or farms.

basis_claims.quote: A portion of milk was set apart for her every evening, in a hole for the purpose in some convenient stone, and unless this was done, something was found amiss in the dairy next morning.

statement.id: Setiap malam sebagian susu disisihkan untuknya di lubang pada sebuah batu; bila tidak, keesokan paginya ada yang tidak beres di tempat pemerahan.
statement.en: Every evening a portion of milk was set apart for her in a hole in a stone; otherwise something was found amiss in the dairy next morning.

basis_claims.quote: the Glaistig and her near relation the Brownie are among the most harmless.

statement.id: Glaistig dan kerabat dekatnya, Brownie, termasuk makhluk yang paling tidak berbahaya.
statement.en: The Glaistig and her near relation the Brownie are among the most harmless beings.

hercynisch-hert.depicted_variant: Caesar's ox-sized stag shape with one central straight horn branching like palms at top.
visual_requirements: Deer form with four cloven-hoofed legs
Exactly one central forehead horn root
Straight stem with palmate branched top
hercynisch-hert.aura: Quiet imposing animal dignity in naturally lit forest.

basis_claims.quote: In zijn boek De Bello Gallico verhaalde Caesar de ontmoeting met een reusachtig hert ("zo groot als een os") in het gebied dat vandaag overeenkomt met Duitsland. Voor grote dieren schreven de Romeinen nogal gemakkelijk dat zij osvormig waren.

statement.id: Dalam De Bello Gallico, Caesar menceritakan rusa (hert) raksasa sebesar lembu (os) di wilayah yang kini Jerman (Duitsland); orang Romawi (Romeinen) mudah menyebut hewan besar berbentuk lembu.
statement.en: In De Bello Gallico Caesar told of a gigantic stag (hert) as big as an ox (os) in what is now Germany (Duitsland); the Romans (Romeinen) easily called large animals ox-shaped.

basis_claims.quote: Het hert had bovendien een hoorn op het voorhoofd. Deze hoorn waaierde uit als waren het palmbladeren.

statement.id: Rusa (hert) itu memiliki satu tanduk (hoorn) di dahi (voorhoofd) yang bercabang seperti daun palem (palmbladeren).
statement.en: The stag (hert) had a horn (hoorn) on its forehead (voorhoofd) that fanned out like palm leaves (palmbladeren).

basis_claims.quote: There is an ox of the shape of a stag, between whose ears a horn rises from the middle of the forehead, higher and straighter than those horns which are known to us. From the top of this, branches, like palms; stretch out a considerable distance. The shape of the female and of the male is the same

statement.id: Caesar: ada lembu berbentuk rusa dengan satu tanduk dari tengah dahi di antara telinganya, lebih tinggi dan lurus, bercabang seperti palem; jantan dan betinanya sama bentuknya.
statement.en: Caesar: there is an ox shaped like a stag with one horn from the middle of the forehead between the ears, higher and straighter, branching like palms; female and male have the same shape.

hippocamp.depicted_variant: Horse foreparts and serpentine fish-tail hippocamp
visual_requirements: Horse head/foreparts and exactly two hoofed forelegs
Fish lower body/tail, no hind horse legs
No winged variant mixing
hippocamp.aura: Character presence through documented form, expression, framing and natural light

basis_claims.quote: typically depicted as having the upper body of a horse with the lower body of a fish.

statement.id: Hippocamp adalah makhluk mitos yang menggabungkan tubuh atas kuda dan tubuh bawah ikan.
statement.en: The hippocamp is a mythical creature combining a horse’s upper body and a fish’s lower body.

basis_claims.quote: HIPPOKAMPOI (Hippocamps) were the fish-tailed horses of the sea.

statement.id: Hippokampoi digambarkan sebagai kuda laut berekor ikan.
statement.en: Hippokampoi are described as fish-tailed horses of the sea.

basis_claims.quote: They were depicted as composite creatures with the head and fore-parts of a horse and the serpentine-tail of a fish.

statement.id: Bentuknya menggabungkan kepala dan bagian depan kuda dengan ekor ikan menyerupai ular.
statement.en: Their form combines a horse’s head and foreparts with a serpentine fish tail.

klushund.depicted_variant: Giant black hound with documented plate-sized glowing eyes at Rhine Valley mountain road.
visual_requirements: One large black natural hound
Two large glowing eyes only, source-supported
Dark forest/old road context
klushund.aura: Lowered stalking posture and fixed gaze under natural moonlight; eye glow confined to eyeballs.

basis_claims.quote: The Klushund (Alemannic German for "dog of Klaus") is a mythical demonic dog from Vorarlberg, Austria. It is described as a giant black hound with glowing, plate-sized eyes, which haunts in dark forest around the Rhine Valley. Encountering it brings illness and misfortune.

statement.id: Klushund (bahasa Jerman Alemannik, "anjing Klaus") adalah anjing setan mitologis dari Vorarlberg, Austria: anjing hitam raksasa bermata menyala sebesar piring yang menghantui hutan gelap sekitar Lembah Rhein (Rhine Valley); bertemu dengannya membawa penyakit dan kemalangan.
statement.en: The Klushund (Alemannic German, 'dog of Klaus') is a mythical demonic dog from Vorarlberg, Austria: a giant black hound with glowing plate-sized eyes haunting the dark forest around the Rhine Valley; meeting it brings illness and misfortune.

basis_claims.quote: Wrangel habe dem Verräter für seine Tat das goldene Kegelspiel auf dem Schloss Hohenbregenz versprochen. Der Sage nach muss der Verräter für seine Freveltat nun ewig als großer schwarzer Hund, meist beschrieben mit tellergroßen leuchtenden Augen, auf der ehemaligen Römerstraße am Bergrand von Norden nach Süden durchs Land laufen.

statement.id: Wrangel menjanjikan kepada pengkhianat itu permainan boling emas di Kastel Hohenbregenz; menurut legenda, sebagai hukuman ia harus berlari selamanya sebagai anjing hitam besar bermata menyala sebesar piring di bekas jalan Romawi di kaki gunung dari utara ke selatan.
statement.en: Wrangel promised the traitor the golden skittles set at Hohenbregenz Castle; per the legend he must forever run as a great black dog with glowing plate-sized eyes along the former Roman road at the mountain edge from north to south.

geldmannlein.depicted_variant: Little grey humanlike man with red cap and green vest, documented c07 house spirit form.
visual_requirements: Little grey man, red cap, green vest
House chest/coins context
No blended animal/root/dragon forms
geldmannlein.aura: Secretive attentive face, compact stance and warm natural lamplight.

basis_claims.quote: Das Geldmännlein ist ein koboldartiges Wesen der „Niederen Mythologie“, ein Hausgeist, der seinen Eigentümer mit Geld versorgt. Nicht immer hat es die Gestalt eines kleinen Männchens, sondern kann auch als Tier erscheinen, wie z. B. als Kröte oder Frosch, oder als ein Vogel, wie Eule oder Adler, gelegentlich als Wurm oder Käfer.

statement.id: Geldmännlein adalah makhluk mirip kobold dalam "mitologi rendah", roh rumah yang memasok uang bagi pemiliknya; tak selalu berwujud lelaki kecil, ia bisa tampil sebagai kodok, katak, burung hantu, elang, cacing, atau kumbang.
statement.en: The Geldmännlein is a kobold-like being of 'lower mythology', a house spirit that provides its owner with money; not always a little man, it may appear as a toad, frog, owl, eagle, worm or beetle.

basis_claims.quote: Das Geldmännlein befand sich, je nach Gestalt und Größe, in einer Kiste, einer Schachtel oder einem Topf, in welche man am Abend Geld legte. Am nächsten Morgen nahm man das „ausgebrütete“ Geld heraus, aber niemals alles, damit sich der Rest weiter vermehren konnte. Wie anderen Hausgeistern wurden dem Geldmännlein Speiseopfer dargebracht, wie Milch, Brot oder Brei.

statement.id: Geldmännlein disimpan dalam peti, kotak, atau periuk tempat uang diletakkan pada malam hari; paginya uang yang "dierami" diambil, tetapi tak pernah semuanya agar sisanya terus berlipat; seperti roh rumah lain ia diberi sesaji susu, roti, atau bubur.
statement.en: The Geldmännlein was kept in a chest, box or pot where money was put in the evening; next morning the 'hatched' money was taken out, never all, so the rest could multiply; like other house spirits it got offerings of milk, bread or porridge.

basis_claims.quote: Má podobu šedivého mužíčka, někdy s červenou čapkou a zelenou vestou, a někdy se mění ve zvířata – žábu, ropuchu, sovu či brouka.

statement.id: Ia berwujud lelaki kecil kelabu, kadang bertopi merah dan berompi hijau, dan kadang berubah menjadi hewan seperti katak, kodok, burung hantu, atau kumbang.
statement.en: It looks like a little grey man, sometimes with a red cap and green vest, and sometimes turns into animals such as a frog, toad, owl or beetle.

gundyr.depicted_variant: Early Komi human-form male giant with three heads, separate from later serpent/iron-skin variants.
visual_requirements: One human-form giant with exactly three human heads
Two arms/two legs
No serpent tail/iron-skin mixture
gundyr.aura: Imposing sourced giant scale and stern faces in natural subterranean light.

basis_claims.quote: Гундыр — образ многоголового великана в мифологии коми. В фольклоре коми-зырян и коми-пермяков Гундыр имел человеческий образ, однако под влиянием русского фольклора превратился в гигантского змея или дракона.

statement.id: Gundyr (Гундыр) adalah raksasa berkepala banyak dalam mitologi Komi; dalam cerita rakyat Komi-Zyrian dan Komi-Permyak ia berwujud manusia, tetapi di bawah pengaruh cerita rakyat Rusia berubah menjadi ular atau naga raksasa.
statement.en: Gundyr is a many-headed giant of Komi mythology; in Komi-Zyrian and Komi-Permyak folklore he had human form but under Russian folklore influence became a giant serpent or dragon.

basis_claims.quote: По сказкам и быличкам нет однозначного ответа о количестве его голов; их может быть 3, 6, 9, 12 или даже 24.

statement.id: Dongeng dan cerita tidak sepakat tentang jumlah kepalanya: bisa 3, 6, 9, 12, atau bahkan 24 (tiga, enam, sembilan, dua belas, dua puluh empat).
statement.en: Tales disagree on the number of his heads: 3, 6, 9, 12 or even 24 (three, six, nine, twelve, twenty-four).

basis_claims.quote: Дыхание его считается пеж — нечистым. Обитает он в различных быличках под водой, землёй, в горе или на ней, либо на небе. Выходит он из своего укрытия в виде чёрной тучи, чёрного дыма или синего тумана.

statement.id: Napasnya dianggap pezh, najis; dalam berbagai cerita ia tinggal di bawah air, di bawah tanah, di dalam atau di atas gunung, atau di langit, dan keluar sebagai awan hitam, asap hitam, atau kabut biru.
statement.en: His breath is considered pezh, unclean; in tales he lives under water, underground, in or on a mountain, or in the sky, and emerges as a black cloud, black smoke or blue mist.

hofvarpnir.depicted_variant: Natural flying sea-treading horse, without invented wings or eight legs.
visual_requirements: One natural four-legged horse
Atop sea surface dynamic stride
No wings, eight legs or aura
hofvarpnir.aura: Strong airborne/treading posture, sea wind and natural daylight.

basis_claims.quote: In Norse mythology, Gná (Old Norse) is a goddess who runs errands in other worlds for the goddess Frigg and rides the flying, sea-treading horse Hófvarpnir (Old Norse "he who throws his hoofs about", "hoof-thrower" or "hoof kicker"). Gná and Hófvarpnir are attested in the Prose Edda, written in the 13th century by Snorri Sturluson.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik, Gná adalah dewi yang menjalankan tugas Frigg di dunia lain dan menunggang kuda terbang penapak laut Hófvarpnir (Nordik Kuno, "yang melempar-lempar kukunya", "pelempar kuku"); keduanya tercatat dalam Edda Prosa yang ditulis Snorri Sturluson pada abad ke-13.
statement.en: In Norse mythology Gná is a goddess running errands in other worlds for Frigg, riding the flying, sea-treading horse Hófvarpnir (Old Norse 'he who throws his hoofs about', 'hoof-thrower'); both appear in the Prose Edda written by Snorri Sturluson in the 13th century.

basis_claims.quote: In chapter 35 of the Prose Edda book Gylfaginning ... High adds that Gná rides the horse Hófvarpnir, and that this horse has the ability to ride through the air and atop the sea. High continues that "once some Vanir saw her path as she rode through the air"

statement.id: Dalam bab 35 Gylfaginning, High menambahkan bahwa Gná menunggang Hófvarpnir, kuda yang mampu melaju di udara dan di atas laut, dan bahwa "suatu kali beberapa Vanir melihat jalurnya saat ia melaju di udara".
statement.en: In chapter 35 of Gylfaginning High adds that Gná rides Hófvarpnir, a horse able to ride through the air and atop the sea, and that 'once some Vanir saw her path as she rode through the air'.

visual_requirements: Bird anatomy
Restrained fire issuing only from mouth
idittu.aura: Presence expressed through pose, gaze and natural scene lighting.

basis_claims.quote: Dans certains cas il apparaît sous forme humaine mais on le connait aussi sous d'autres aspects : âne et belier noir, le plus fréquemment sous forme de porc, souvent sous forme d'oiseau lançant du feu par son bec.

statement.id: Kadang ia berwujud manusia, tetapi juga keledai dan domba jantan hitam, paling sering babi, dan sering burung yang menyemburkan api dari paruhnya.
statement.en: Sometimes it appears as a human, but also as a donkey or black ram, most often a pig, and often a bird spitting fire from its beak.

basis_claims.quote: Resurrección María de Azkue i José Miguel de Barandiarán van descriure l'idittu com un ocell que apareixia de nit quan ningú no l'esperava ni el cridava i quan ho feia, alenava foc per la boca, com si fos un drac, abans de volar

statement.id: Resurrección María de Azkue dan José Miguel de Barandiarán menggambarkan idittu sebagai burung yang muncul pada malam hari tanpa diduga dan menyemburkan api dari mulutnya seperti naga sebelum terbang.
statement.en: Resurrección María de Azkue and José Miguel de Barandiarán described the idittu as a bird that appeared unexpectedly at night and breathed fire from its mouth like a dragon before flying off.

ihizi.depicted_variant: Natural-scale red bull guarding Mari's cave against an adult traveler.
visual_requirements: Source-supported event
Natural scale and coherent cloven-hoof anatomy
ihizi.aura: Presence through source-supported iconography, narrative action, posture, scale and natural scene light; no generic magical glow.

basis_claims.quote: Les manifestacions més habituals d'aquest animal són la vaca, el bou o el vedell vermells, de raça Betizu (Behigorri, Zezengorri i Aatxegorri, respectivament) i el cavall (Zaldi), tot i que n'hi ha d'altres.

statement.id: Wujudnya yang paling umum adalah sapi, banteng, atau anak sapi merah ras Betizu (Behigorri, Zezengorri, dan Aatxegorri) serta kuda (Zaldi).
statement.en: Its commonest forms are the red cow, bull or calf of the Betizu breed (Behigorri, Zezengorri and Aatxegorri) and the horse (Zaldi).

basis_claims.quote: Mariren Oxabiko eta Austokietako haitzuloen zaindaria, horregatik zezen gorri honi askotan Austoki edo Oxabi deitu izan zaio.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Basque, Ihizi adalah penjaga gua-gua Mari di Oxabi dan Austokieta, sehingga banteng merah ini sering disebut Austoki atau Oxabi.
statement.en: According to the Basque article, Ihizi guards Mari's caves of Oxabi and Austokieta, so this red bull is often called Austoki or Oxabi.

artistic_changes: Painterly framing and editorial garments

presentation_revision.rationale: Replace animal portrait with documented guardian/battle action without unsupported gigantism.

kamos.depicted_variant: black cat in bork cap pressing a sleeping adult
visual_requirements: black cat in bork cap pressing a sleeping adult
Coherent anatomy and documented mythic identity
kamos.aura: No generic glow or magical particles; physical light and source-backed scene only.

basis_claims.quote: Yalnız başına uyuyan insanların üzerine bütün ağırlığı ile çöker, onların çarpılmalarına bazen de ölmelerine sebep olabilirmiş.

statement.id: Ia menindih seluruh beratnya pada orang yang tidur sendirian dan konon dapat menyebabkan mereka lumpuh (çarpılma), bahkan kadang meninggal.
statement.en: It sits with its whole weight on people sleeping alone and is said to be able to cause them to be struck (çarpılma) and sometimes even to die.

basis_claims.quote: Geceleri dolaşan bu yaratık anlatımlara göre bazen iriyarı, bazen de cüce görünüşlüdür. Başında daima bir börk taşır.

statement.id: Makhluk yang berkeliaran pada malam hari ini kadang tampak bertubuh besar, kadang kerdil (cüce); di kepalanya selalu ada börk (topi).
statement.en: This creature, which roams at night, appears at times large and at times dwarfish (cüce); it always wears a börk (headgear).

basis_claims.quote: Zaman zaman kara kedi şeklinde de görülebilen kamosun bastığı kişi, kanının çekilip damarlarının kuruduğunu sanır.

statement.id: Kamos kadang terlihat berbentuk kucing hitam (kara kedi); orang yang ditindihnya merasa darahnya tersedot dan pembuluhnya mengering.
statement.en: The kamos can at times also be seen in the form of a black cat (kara kedi); the person it presses on feels that his blood is drained and his veins are drying up.

artistic_changes: Painterly square composition
Setting and attire are editorial atmosphere

presentation_revision.rationale: Replaces bedside pet portrait with sourced nightmare pressure episode and cap.

thoth.depicted_variant: Egyptian ibis-headed Thoth presiding over lunar wisdom and writing.

visual_requirements.description: One ibis-headed Egyptian deity.
Strong lunar atmosphere and moonlight from moon domain.
Presiding over writing with blank papyrus.

thoth.aura: Magnificent moonlight for documented lunar domain; cosmic composition without invented attack.

basis_claims.quote: Thoth is the Egyptian god of writing, magic, wisdom, and the moon.

statement.id: Thoth ialah dewa Mesir yang terkait dengan tulisan, sihir, kebijaksanaan, dan bulan.
statement.en: Thoth is an Egyptian god of writing, magic, wisdom and the moon.

basis_claims.quote: He is most commonly depicted as a man with the head of an ibis or a seated baboon

statement.id: Ia kerap digambarkan berkepala ibis atau sebagai babun duduk.
statement.en: He is commonly depicted ibis-headed or as a seated baboon.

basis_claims.quote: Thoth presided over writing, measuring and calculation

statement.id: Dalam kepercayaan Mesir, Thoth menaungi kegiatan menulis, mengukur, dan menghitung.
statement.en: Thoth presided over writing, measurement and calculation.

basis_claims.quote: He was the patron god of scribes

statement.id: Thoth merupakan dewa pelindung para juru tulis.
statement.en: Thoth was patron of scribes.

artistic_changes: Full linen robes, papyrus and reed pen materialize scribal role; no actual written text.
Moon in sky and moonlight are domain staging, not a beam weapon or magical alphabet.

presentation_revision.rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.

leberon.depicted_variant: Leberon in documented human wearing wolf skin form: fully clothed adult man emerging at dusk near a rural spring, donning a full wolf-hide cloak with its empty wolf head draped over his shoulder, human face and hands clearly visible. Lonely French belltower behind, uncanny secret curse identity conveyed by human wearer and animal skin, no fused human-wolf anatomy or glow. Garments editorial.
visual_requirements: Specific documented role/form
Coherent anatomy and source-supported scale
leberon.aura: Presence through source-supported iconography, narrative action, posture, scale and natural scene light; no generic magical glow.

basis_claims.quote: Homme ou femme le jour, il revêt une fois la nuit tombée une peau de bête, ou s'incarne directement en l'animal en question. Il peut s'agir d'un lièvre ou d'un mouton pour le mâle, et d'une chèvre pour la femelle, plus rare.

statement.id: Pada siang hari ia lelaki atau perempuan, dan saat malam tiba ia memakai kulit binatang atau langsung menjelma menjadi binatang itu: kelinci atau domba bagi yang lelaki, kambing bagi yang perempuan, yang lebih jarang.
statement.en: Man or woman by day, at nightfall it dons an animal skin or becomes the animal itself: a hare or sheep for a male, a goat for the rarer female.

basis_claims.quote: Il entame sa métamorphose bestiale à la tombée du jour, nécessairement près d'une fontaine.

statement.id: Ia mulai berubah menjadi binatang saat senja, selalu di dekat mata air.
statement.en: It begins its animal change at dusk, always near a spring.

basis_claims.quote: En Lemosin e Peiregòrd, lo leberon es pas un lop, mas un òme qu'es estat condemnat a se vestir, la nuèch, d'una peu de lop que quita lo jorn.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Oksitan menyebut di Limousin dan Périgord leberon bukan serigala, melainkan lelaki yang dikutuk memakai kulit serigala pada malam hari dan melepasnya pada siang hari.
statement.en: The Occitan article says that in Limousin and Périgord the leberon is not a wolf but a man condemned to wear a wolf skin at night and take it off by day.

artistic_changes: Painterly composition
Editorial props and clothes

presentation_revision.rationale: Replace ordinary animal image with documented mythic form or narrative.

leiger.depicted_variant: Human giant wading from Saaremaa toward Hiiumaa
visual_requirements: Entirely human giant
Sea-wading scene
Documented enormous scale
leiger.aura: Presence through expression, posture, framing and natural lighting.

basis_claims.quote: В одних сказаниях — племянник Большого Тылля, в других — его брат, и почти такой же могучий великан. Лейгер и Суур Тылль дружили, но иногда и ссорились, так как Тылль во всём хотел главенствовать.

statement.id: Dalam sebagian kisah ia keponakan Tõll Agung, dalam kisah lain saudaranya, dan raksasa yang hampir sama kuatnya; Leiger dan Suur Tõll bersahabat tetapi kadang bertengkar karena Tõll selalu ingin berkuasa.
statement.en: In some tales he is Big Tõll's nephew, in others his brother, and a giant almost as mighty; Leiger and Suur Tõll were friends but sometimes quarrelled, since Tõll always wanted to be in charge.

basis_claims.quote: История первая. Лейгер решил дойти пешком с Сааремаа на Хийумаа. Глубина моря составляла четыре сажени, но Лейгер всё же прошёл.

statement.id: Dalam satu kisah, Leiger memutuskan berjalan kaki dari Saaremaa ke Hiiumaa; laut sedalam empat depa, tetapi Leiger tetap menyeberanginya.
statement.en: In one tale Leiger decided to walk from Saaremaa to Hiiumaa; the sea was four fathoms deep, but Leiger crossed it anyway.

basis_claims.quote: Leiger on eesti rahvaluulest tuntud müütiline tegelane (vägilane ehk hiid). Leiger on hiiumuistendite peategelane Hiiumaa rahvaluules (Saaremaal on peategelane Suur Tõll).

statement.id: Leiger adalah tokoh mitis yang dikenal dari folklor Estonia (seorang pahlawan perkasa atau raksasa), tokoh utama legenda Hiiumaa dalam folklor pulau itu, sementara di Saaremaa tokoh utamanya Suur Tõll.
statement.en: Leiger is a mythical figure known from Estonian folklore (a strongman or giant), the main character of Hiiumaa legends, whereas on Saaremaa the main character is Suur Tõll.

lilin.depicted_variant: One representative male Lilin with documented human form and wings, at desert night.
visual_requirements: Adult male human form with wings
No borrowed demon horns/talons
Desert night setting
lilin.aura: Sombre contemplative gaze, folded wing silhouette and natural moonlight.

basis_claims.quote: are plural night spirits in Jewish mythology, male equivalent of Lilith

statement.id: Lilin adalah roh-roh malam dalam mitologi Yahudi, padanan laki-laki Lilith.
statement.en: Lilin are night spirits in Jewish mythology, described as Lilith’s male counterparts.

basis_claims.quote: They have human form with an addition of wings

statement.id: Lilin digambarkan dalam bentuk manusia dengan sayap.
statement.en: Lilin is depicted with a human form and wings.

basis_claims.quote: And you Lilin, come you from the desert

statement.id: Terjemahan Charles atas 2 Baruch 10:8 memanggil lilin dari padang gurun untuk bergabung dalam ratapan.
statement.en: Charles’s translation of 2 Baruch 10:8 calls Lilin from the desert to join a lament.

linchetto.depicted_variant: Linchetto, tiny long-eared Tuscan household sprite obsessively gathering spilled grain: one roughly eighty-centimetre adult humanoid sprite with long ears kneels beside a sleeping person's bed, rapidly collects loose grains scattered from a overturned shallow bowl beside their chest. Small scale clearly compared with adult sleeper, covered rustic clothing, human hands sorting grain, mischievous compulsive scene, no dog or cat anatomy or glow.
visual_requirements: Specific documented role/form
Coherent anatomy and source-supported scale
linchetto.aura: Presence through source-supported iconography, narrative action, posture, scale and natural scene light; no generic magical glow.

basis_claims.quote: Линкетти невысоки: их рост около 80 см. Постоянной чертой их облика являются длинные уши, в остальном он может меняться.

statement.id: Linchetti bertubuh pendek, sekitar 80 cm, dengan telinga panjang sebagai ciri tetap, sedangkan bagian lain rupanya bisa berubah.
statement.en: The linchetti are short, about 80 cm tall; long ears are their constant feature, while the rest of their appearance may vary.

basis_claims.quote: Первый способ — положить на грудь спящего сковороду с зерном. Забираясь на грудь спящего, линкетто рассыплет зерно. Тогда страсть к порядку заставит его собирать зёрна, и он утомится.
basis_claims.locator: Вред от линкетти и борьба с ними

statement.id: Salah satu cara mengatasinya adalah menaruh wajan berisi biji-bijian di dada orang tidur: linchetto yang naik akan menumpahkan biji itu, lalu kegemarannya akan keteraturan memaksanya memunguti biji-biji itu hingga kelelahan.
statement.en: One remedy is to put a pan of grain on the sleeper's chest: climbing up, the linchetto spills the grain, and its passion for order makes it gather the grains until it is exhausted.

basis_claims.quote: Il linchetto è un folletto presente nella tradizione popolare della provincia di Lucca, sia in Lucchesia, che in Versilia, che in Garfagnana.

statement.id: Linchetto adalah folletto (peri kecil usil) dalam tradisi rakyat Provinsi Lucca, baik di Lucchesia, Versilia, maupun Garfagnana.
statement.en: The linchetto is a folletto (sprite) of the folk tradition of the province of Lucca, in Lucchesia, Versilia and Garfagnana.

artistic_changes: Painterly composition
Editorial props and clothes

presentation_revision.rationale: Replace ordinary animal image with documented mythic form or narrative.

managarmr.depicted_variant: Cosmic Managarmr swallowing moon at Ragnarok
visual_requirements: Cosmic Managarmr swallowing moon at Ragnarok
Coherent anatomy and documented mythic scene
managarmr.aura: Presence through source-backed form and physical scene; no generic glow, ribbons or magical mist.

basis_claims.quote: Snorri also names a wolf named Mánagarmr ("Moon-Hound", or "Moon's Dog") as the most powerful of the giantess's progeny, and goes on to say that he will swallow the Moon and gorge on the dead. This is presumably an alternate name for Hati or Sköll that Snorri took from folklore. It can be anglicized as Managarm, Manegarm

statement.id: Snorri juga menyebut serigala bernama Mánagarmr ("Anjing Bulan") sebagai keturunan terkuat sang raksasa perempuan, yang akan menelan Bulan dan melahap orang mati; ini diduga nama lain Hati atau Sköll yang diambil Snorri dari cerita rakyat, dan dapat ditulis Managarm atau Manegarm.
statement.en: Snorri also names a wolf Mánagarmr ('Moon-Hound') as the mightiest of the giantess's progeny, who will swallow the Moon and gorge on the dead; presumably another name for Hati or Sköll taken from folklore, anglicised Managarm or Manegarm.

basis_claims.quote: Zu Ragnarök, dem Weltuntergang, stellt Hati den Mond und Managarm, durch das Leichenfleisch zum größten und stärksten seiner Brut geworden, verschlingt ihn. Das Blut des Mondes spritzt auf die Sonne und verdunkelt sie.

statement.id: Saat Ragnarök, Hati menyudutkan Bulan, dan Managarm, yang menjadi terbesar dan terkuat karena daging mayat, menelannya; darah Bulan memercik ke Matahari dan menggelapkannya.
statement.en: At Ragnarök Hati corners the Moon and Managarm, grown the biggest and strongest of the brood from corpse-flesh, swallows it; the Moon's blood splashes the Sun and darkens it.

artistic_changes: Painterly square composition
Clothing, weather and exact setting details are editorial unless identified in claims

presentation_revision.rationale: Replaces ordinary animal presentation with Cosmic Managarmr swallowing moon at Ragnarok

mandronius.depicted_variant: Human man giant about three metres tall at cave near Betlan.
visual_requirements: One normal human man
Modest documented3m height, no colossal scale
Cave and valley context
mandronius.aura: Brave calm steady gaze and grounded upright stance under natural morning light.

basis_claims.quote: Mandrònius, o Mandròni en versió aranesa –Mandroni en català–, és un gegant de la mitologia gascona pròpia de la Vall d'Aran.

statement.id: Mandrònius (Mandròni dalam versi Aran, Mandroni dalam bahasa Katalan) adalah raksasa dalam mitologi Gascon khas Val d'Aran.
statement.en: Mandrònius (Mandròni in the Aranese version, Mandroni in Catalan) is a giant of the Gascon mythology of the Val d'Aran.

basis_claims.quote: Segons diu la llegenda, Mandrònius era un home d'aproximadament tres metres d'altura. Es diu que vivia en una cova a prop de Betlan i va liderar els habitants de la Vall d'Aran en la lluita contra els romans, obtenint victòries en diverses batalles i guanyant-se el respecte per la seva valentia.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, Mandrònius adalah lelaki setinggi sekitar tiga meter yang tinggal di gua dekat Betlan dan memimpin penduduk Val d'Aran melawan bangsa Romawi, menang dalam beberapa pertempuran dan dihormati karena keberaniannya.
statement.en: By the legend Mandrònius was a man about three metres tall who lived in a cave near Betlan and led the people of the Val d'Aran against the Romans, winning several battles and respect for his courage.

marduk.depicted_variant: Babylonian divine king with source-attested spade and serpent dragon, cosmic creation firmament.

visual_requirements.description: Marduk with a serpent dragon and spade.
Monumental cosmic firmament expresses formation of heavens.

marduk.aura: Cosmic heavens formation from Enuma Elish c07, no invented weapon attack.

basis_claims.quote: He is depicted as a human in royal robes, carrying a snake-dragon and a spade.

statement.id: Marduk digambarkan dengan naga ular dan sekop.
statement.en: Marduk is depicted with a serpent dragon and spade.

basis_claims.quote: from her corpse, Marduk forms the heavens

statement.id: Marduk membentuk langit dari tubuh Tiamat.
statement.en: Marduk forms the heavens from Tiamat’s body.

artistic_changes: Humanlike fully clothed regal rendering, cloth crown and metal spade design editorial; source lacks exact bodily form.
Cosmic sky is symbolic visual staging of creation, no literal dismemberment of Tiamat or unsupported flame/lightning powers.

presentation_revision.rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.

marra.depicted_variant: Ahari ram carrying Mari from a Basque cave
visual_requirements: Ahari ram carrying Mari from a Basque cave
Coherent anatomy and documented mythic scene
marra.aura: Presence through source-backed form and physical scene; no generic glow, ribbons or magical mist.

basis_claims.quote: Ahari és un dels ireluak, genis nocturns de la mitologia basca, que de vegades s'apareix com una dona o un nen, de vegades com un animal, i que viu a la famosa cova d'Okina, a Bernedo (Àlaba), en forma de marrà.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Katalan, Ahari adalah salah satu irelu, roh malam Basque, yang kadang muncul sebagai perempuan atau anak, kadang sebagai hewan, dan tinggal di gua Okina di Bernedo (Alava) dalam wujud domba jantan.
statement.en: According to the Catalan article, Ahari is one of the ireluak, Basque night spirits, which sometimes appears as a woman or child, sometimes as an animal, and lives in the Okina cave at Bernedo (Alava) as a ram.

basis_claims.quote: De vegades, quan surt de la cova, Mari fa servir els marrans de muntura, cavalcant-hi com si anés a cavall. Aquesta creença, per exemple, s'aplica al cas de la Dama d'Aketegi (un dels molts noms de Mari), a Zegama.

statement.id: Kadang ketika keluar dari gua Mari menunggangi domba jantan seperti kuda, misalnya dalam kisah Dama d'Aketegi, salah satu nama Mari, di Zegama.
statement.en: Sometimes, leaving her cave, Mari rides the rams like horses, as in the case of the Lady of Aketegi, one of Mari's names, at Zegama.

artistic_changes: Painterly square composition
Clothing, weather and exact setting details are editorial unless identified in claims

presentation_revision.rationale: Replaces ordinary animal presentation with Ahari ram carrying Mari from a Basque cave

naga-seri-gumum.depicted_variant: Naga Seri Gumum the legendary GIANT serpent of Chini Lake in Pahang. A colossal snake rises from the middle of the broad lake, its raised one-headed neck higher than the full-size trees at the nearby shoreline. A tiny canoe with fully clothed adult paddlers far below establishes the impossible creature scale clearly: raised snake head is several canoe lengths wide. One continuous snake body loops through water with a single tail; no invented dragon wings, horns, legs or multiple heads. Broad lake setting, massive displaced waves, calm awe in boat. Canoe is only artistic scale context, no unsupported episode claim.

basis_claims.quote: which is said to inhabit Chini Lake in Pahang, Malaysia.

Four horse legs, no extra limbs
Central Asian landscape

statement.id: Tulpar adalah kuda bersayap atau kuda langit legendaris dalam mitologi Turkik.
statement.en: Tulpar is a legendary winged or celestial horse in Turkic mythology.

basis_claims.quote: Tulpar is embedded in the cultural heritage of Turkic-speaking nations, including Turks, Uzbeks, Bashkirs, Kazakhs and Kyrgyz.

statement.id: Tulpar menjadi warisan budaya bangsa-bangsa berbahasa Turkik, termasuk Turki, Uzbek, Bashkir, Kazakh, dan Kirgiz.
statement.en: Tulpar is part of the heritage of Turkic-speaking nations, including Turks, Uzbeks, Bashkirs, Kazakhs and Kyrgyz.

basis_claims.quote: Dans les contes kirghizes, « tulpar » désigne un cheval capable de voler en portant le héros sur son dos.

statement.id: Dalam dongeng Kirgiz, tulpar adalah kuda yang mampu terbang sambil membawa sang pahlawan di punggungnya.
statement.en: In Kyrgyz tales a tulpar is a horse able to fly with the hero on its back.

duneyrr.depicted_variant: One named male red deer grazing world-tree foliage, distinct individual not generic wind.
visual_requirements: One natural male red deer with antlers
Neck stretched to gnaw ash branch foliage
No etymological thunder/wind effects
duneyrr.aura: Attentive elegant stag stance and vast world-tree setting.

basis_claims.quote: In Norse mythology, four stags or harts (male red deer) eat among the branches of the world tree Yggdrasill. According to the Poetic Edda, the stags crane their necks upward to chomp at the branches. The morning dew gathers in their horns and forms the rivers of the world. Their names are given as Dáinn, Dvalinn, Duneyrr and Duraþrór.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik, empat rusa jantan (rusa merah jantan) makan di antara dahan pohon dunia Yggdrasill; menurut Edda Puitis (Poetic Edda) mereka menjulurkan leher untuk menggerogoti dahan, embun pagi terkumpul di tanduk mereka dan menjadi sungai-sungai dunia; nama mereka Dáinn, Dvalinn, Duneyrr, dan Duraþrór.
statement.en: In Norse mythology four stags (male red deer) feed among the branches of the world tree Yggdrasill; per the Poetic Edda they stretch their necks up to gnaw the branches, and dew collecting in their horns becomes the world's rivers; they are named Dáinn, Dvalinn, Duneyrr and Duraþrór.

basis_claims.quote: En fjórir hirtir renna í limum asksins ok bíta barr, þeir heita svá: Dáinn, Dvalinn, Duneyrr, Duraþrór.

statement.id: Dalam Gylfaginning, bagian Edda Prosa karya Snorri Sturluson: empat rusa berlari di dahan pohon ash dan menggigit dedaunannya; nama mereka Dáinn, Dvalinn, Duneyrr, Duraþrór.
statement.en: In Gylfaginning, part of Snorri Sturluson's Prose Edda: four harts run in the ash's limbs and bite its foliage; they are called Dáinn, Dvalinn, Duneyrr, Duraþrór.

dura-ror.depicted_variant: Duraþrór the Yggdrasil stag in its cosmic world-tree setting. A natural male red deer stands on a huge living ash branch high above the entire small world visible far below, reaching its neck to bite ash foliage. Countable four deer legs and normal antlers. Large clear dew beads gather on the antlers then fall in a long natural chain of water droplets down toward Earth, where the rivers visibly branch across valleys from the impact region. Source-recorded antler dew becoming world rivers conveyed without glowing beams or ribbons. Vast world tree branch scale and antler water must be unmistakable, not an ordinary deer in forest.
dura-ror.visual_requirements: Correct Duraþrór illustration: the source-recorded dew that becomes world rivers comes from the stag's ANTLERS, not its mouth. REMOVE the entire vertical droplet chain currently below the mouth and replace with ordinary clear landscape. Render ONE continuous descending chain of clear physical dew droplets originating visibly on the leftmost antler tip (upper left around x=480), dropping past the outside edge of the branch and down toward the world rivers below. Shift the river impact correspondingly below that antler origin. Keep stag eating foliage, four legs, enormous ash branch and tiny world below. No mouth drool, glow, magical ribbons, text or watermark. Source dura-ror-c01 antler dew forms rivers and c03 eats foliage.
dura-ror.aura: Source-recorded antler dew becoming rivers; clear water only, no aura.

Trees/landscape establishes documented large scale

basis_claims.quote: is a horse-demon, killed by Krishna, an Avatara of Vishnu.

visual_requirements: One eye and one leg
Old man body/two arms
Fine grey hair and old clothes
yamajijii.aura: Uncanny aged watchful gaze in natural mountain forest light.

basis_claims.quote: It is said to be a yōkai that takes on the appearance of an old man with one eye and one leg.

statement.id: Satu gambaran memberinya satu mata dan satu kaki.
statement.en: One description gives it one eye and one leg.

basis_claims.quote: Their bodies are covered in fine gray hair, and they can be found wearing old clothes, tattered rags, or nothing at all.

statement.id: Kisah-kisah memberi tubuhnya rambut halus berwarna kelabu.
statement.en: Accounts give its body a covering of fine gray hair.

statement.id: Ia konon hidup di pegunungan jauh dari permukiman.
statement.en: It is said to live far from settlements in the mountains.

statement.en: Oannes is a legendary fish-man sage also known as Oan or Sumerian Uanna.

basis_claims.quote: with a body like that of a fish, with feet below like those of a man, with a fish's tail

statement.en: Mackenzie quotes Berossus describing Oannes with a fish-like body, human-like feet, and a fish tail.

statement.en: In Mackenzie’s account of Berossus, Oannes lives in the Persian Gulf.

statement.en: In that account, Oannes comes ashore daily to teach Eridu’s inhabitants canal construction.

phinaert.depicted_variant: Giant human-looking local lord of Flanders in Lille founding legend.
visual_requirements: One human-looking giant lord
Ordinary human anatomy
No added ogre attributes
phinaert.aura: Stern forbidding upright figure under natural cloudy afternoon.

basis_claims.quote: Lors de leur trajet dans les Flandres, ils tombent dans une embuscade tendue par le seigneur local, le géant Phinaert. Celui-ci fait assassiner le prince et ses hommes, tandis qu'Ermengaert s'enfuit et trouve refuge auprès d'un ermite dans la forêt.

statement.id: Di Flandria (Flandres) mereka masuk perangkap (embuscade) penguasa setempat, raksasa (géant) Phinaert, yang membunuh pangeran (prince); Ermengaert lari ke pertapa (ermite) di hutan (forêt).
statement.en: In Flanders (Flandres) they fell into an ambush (embuscade) by the local lord, the giant (géant) Phinaert, who had the prince killed; Ermengaert fled to a hermit (ermite) in the forest (forêt).

basis_claims.quote: Around 620 AD, the prince of Duchy of Dijon, Salvaert, made his way to the lands that would become the Kingdom of England with his pregnant wife, Ermengaert. While traveling through Flanders, they fell into a trap laid by the local lord, the giant Phinaert.

statement.id: Sekitar 620 pangeran Dijon, Salvaert, dan istrinya yang hamil, Ermengaert, melewati Flandria (Flanders) dan masuk perangkap raksasa Phinaert.
statement.en: Around 620 the prince of Dijon, Salvaert, and his pregnant wife Ermengaert passed through Flanders and fell into a trap of the giant Phinaert.

pichal-peri.depicted_variant: Beautiful human-woman disguise with backward feet
visual_requirements: Adult human woman
Long hair
Exactly two backward feet
No inverted-face variant
pichal-peri.aura: Presence through expression, posture, framing and natural lighting.

basis_claims.quote: is the name given to the churel in northwestern South Asia and Central Asia because of their typical appearance as a woman with long hair covering the face and feet pointing backward.

statement.id: Pichal peri adalah nama untuk churel di barat laut South Asia dan Central Asia yang berwujud perempuan berambut panjang dan berkaki terbalik.
statement.en: Pichal peri is the name given to the churel in northwestern South Asia and Central Asia appearing as a woman with long hair and backward feet.

basis_claims.quote: Pichal peris are said to roam the mountains of India and Pakistan. They are said to be found in the Himalayas, though they occasionally enter some Indian villages.

statement.id: Pichal peri dikatakan berkeliaran di pegunungan India dan Pakistan, khususnya Himalayas.
statement.en: Pichal peris are said to roam the mountains of India and Pakistan, especially in the Himalayas.

basis_claims.quote: In most stories they appear as beautiful women in order to lure men and get exposed only due to their backward feet. In some cases witnesses claim to see the female form transforming into a tall demonic creature.

statement.id: Mereka kerap berwujud perempuan cantik untuk memikat pria dan dapat berubah menjadi makhluk iblis tinggi.
statement.en: They appear as beautiful women to lure men and can transform into tall demonic creatures.

basis_claims.quote: In the Indian-Pakistani folklores, it has two forms, one is of a witch who is very dark, ugly and scary, and another is of a beautiful woman who targets vulnerable men passing through the woods after the dark; they appear and vanish after a while, leaving a fearful experience to the victims.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat India-Pakistan makhluk ini menargetkan pria yang melintasi hutan setelah hari gelap.
statement.en: In Indian-Pakistani folklore this creature targets men passing through woods after dark.

puigmal.depicted_variant: Living snow-clothed giant Puigmal guarding Ribes valley, before petrification.
visual_requirements: Huge humanlike giant
Dressed in actual snow
Ribes Pyrenean mountain context and giant scale
puigmal.aura: Protective stern face, monumental giant stance and cold natural mountain light.

basis_claims.quote: Puigmal és el nom d'un gegant propi de la mitologia catalana. Era el guardià de les muntanyes de la vall de Ribes (tradicionalment se'n deia «amo i senyor») i quedà petrificat, en forma de muntanya (el Puigmal).

statement.id: Puigmal adalah raksasa dalam mitologi Katalan, penjaga pegunungan lembah Ribes (secara tradisional disebut "tuan dan penguasa") yang membatu menjadi gunung Puigmal.
statement.en: Puigmal is a giant of Catalan mythology, guardian of the mountains of the Ribes valley (traditionally called 'lord and master'), who was turned to stone as the mountain Puigmal.

basis_claims.quote: Se'l descriu sempre vestit de neu i se'l considera el protector d'arbres i animals, que defensa, si cal amb força, davant les agressions dels humans als regnes vegetal i animal.

statement.id: Ia selalu digambarkan berpakaian salju dan dianggap pelindung pohon dan hewan, yang ia bela, bila perlu dengan kekuatan, dari serangan manusia.

gogmagog.aura: Presence through pose, expression and natural scene light.

basis_claims.quote: was a legendary giant in the Matter of Britain. According to Geoffrey of Monmouth's Historia Regum Britanniae ("The History of The Kings of Britain", 12th century), he was a giant inhabitant of Cornwall who was thrown off a cliff during a wrestling match with Corineus (the legendary namesake of Cornwall and companion of Brutus of Troy).

statement.id: Gogmagog (Goemagot, Goemagog, Goëmagot, Gogmagoc) raksasa Matter of Britain; Geoffrey of Monmouth, Historia Regum Britanniae: raksasa Cornwall dilempar dari tebing oleh Corineus, rekan Brutus dari Troya (Brutus of Troy); di Britania Raya. Abad ke-12.
statement.en: Gogmagog (Goemagot, Goemagog, Goëmagot, Gogmagoc) is a giant of the Matter of Britain; in Geoffrey of Monmouth's Historia Regum Britanniae a Cornish giant thrown off a cliff by Corineus, companion of Brutus of Troy.

basis_claims.quote: Among the rest was one detestable monster, named Goëmagot, in stature twelve cubits, and of such prodigious strength that at one shake he pulled up an oak as if it had been a hazel wand.

statement.id: Terjemahan Giles: Goëmagot setinggi dua belas hasta, mencabut pohon ek seperti tongkat hazel; Old English Chronicles, Gutenberg.
statement.en: Giles's translation: Goëmagot twelve cubits tall, pulling up an oak like a hazel wand.

basis_claims.quote: broke three of his ribs, two on his right side and one on his left. At which Corineus, highly enraged, roused up his whole strength, and snatching him upon his shoulders, ran with him

statement.id: Goëmagot mematahkan tiga rusuk Corineus, yang lalu memanggulnya.
statement.en: Goëmagot broke three of Corineus's ribs; Corineus then carried him on his shoulders.

visual_requirements: Goat-like animal
Cat-sized scale

karakura.aura: Tense small creature posture in dim dwelling natural predawn light.

basis_claims.quote: Más területek hitvilága szerint kivágja és ellopja áldozatai tüdejét. Egyes mondák szerint emberalakban, más mondák szerint kecskefejű, macska nagyságú állat képében jelenik meg. Vele ijesztgetik a gyerekeket.

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan di daerah lain, ia memotong dan mencuri paru-paru korbannya; sebagian legenda menyebut ia muncul berwujud manusia, yang lain sebagai hewan berkepala kambing sebesar kucing; anak-anak ditakut-takuti dengannya.
statement.en: In the beliefs of other areas it cuts out and steals its victims' lungs; some legends say it appears in human form, others as a goat-headed animal the size of a cat; children are frightened with it.

basis_claims.quote: Konya civarında anlatıldığına göre, bu ruh, keçiye benzeyen fakat kedi büyüklüğünde olan, insanların üstüne çökerek onları boğmaya çalışan bir yaratık şeklinde düşünülür. Gün ışığından korkar, güneş doğunca kımıldayamaz; ancak o zaman yakalanabilir. Ona yemin ettirdikten sonra köle gibi kullanmak mümkün olurmuş.

statement.id: Di sekitar Konya, roh ini dibayangkan sebagai makhluk mirip kambing tetapi sebesar kucing yang menindih orang dan mencoba mencekik mereka; ia takut cahaya siang dan tak bisa bergerak saat matahari terbit, sehingga hanya saat itu bisa ditangkap, dan setelah dipaksa bersumpah ia bisa dijadikan budak.
statement.en: Around Konya this spirit is imagined as a goat-like creature the size of a cat that settles on people and tries to strangle them; it fears daylight and cannot move once the sun rises, when alone it can be caught, and after being made to swear an oath it can be used like a slave.

surma.aura: Stern watchful guard stance in natural cold dusk.

basis_claims.quote: Surma est une bête terrifiante, qui incarne la mort soudaine et violente et garde les portes de l'Enfer, le Tuonela, afin d'empêcher toute évasion.

statement.id: Surma adalah binatang mengerikan yang melambangkan kematian mendadak dan kekerasan, dan menjaga gerbang dunia bawah, Tuonela, agar tak ada yang melarikan diri.
statement.en: Surma is a terrifying beast embodying sudden and violent death, guarding the gates of the underworld, Tuonela, to prevent any escape.

basis_claims.quote: Il est souvent décrit sous les traits d'un grand chien muni d'une queue de serpent et peut transformer les gens en pierre (de son seul regard pétrifiant).

statement.id: Ia sering digambarkan sebagai anjing besar berekor ular yang dapat mengubah manusia menjadi batu dengan tatapannya.
statement.en: He is often described as a big dog with a serpent's tail who can turn people to stone with his gaze.

basis_claims.quote: Сурма — ужасный зверь, олицетворяющий внезапную (чаще всего, насильственную) смерть. Он стоит на страже ворот Туонела, чтобы предотвращать попытки побега из загробного мира.

statement.id: Surma adalah binatang mengerikan yang melambangkan kematian mendadak (paling sering karena kekerasan) dan menjaga gerbang Tuonela agar tak ada yang lari dari alam baka.
statement.en: Surma is a terrible beast personifying sudden (most often violent) death, guarding the gates of Tuonela to stop escapes from the afterlife.

basis_claims.quote: 蜚是一種記載於《山海经·東山經》的灾兽。居住於太山，具有牛的外形，蛇的尾巴，白色頭部，但只有一個眼睛。會造成周邊水源乾枯、草木枯死。

statement.id: Fei adalah hewan pembawa bencana dalam Shan Hai Jing dengan tubuh sapi dan ekor ular.
statement.en: Fei is a calamity bringing animal in the Shan Hai Jing with an ox's body and a snake's tail.

basis_claims.quote: 蜚是一種記載於《山海经·東山經》的灾兽。居住於太山，具有牛的外形，蛇的尾巴，白色頭部，但只有一個眼睛。會造成周邊水源乾枯、草木枯死。

statement.id: Kepalanya putih dan matanya hanya satu.
statement.en: Its head is white and it has only one eye.

basis_claims.quote: 蜚是一種記載於《山海经·東山經》的灾兽。居住於太山，具有牛的外形，蛇的尾巴，白色頭部，但只有一個眼睛。會造成周邊水源乾枯、草木枯死。

statement.id: Pergerakannya dikatakan mengeringkan air dan mematikan tumbuhan.
statement.en: Its passage is said to dry up water and kill vegetation.

basis_claims.quote: 又東北二百里，曰太山，上多金玉、楨木。有獸焉，其狀如牛而白首，一目而蛇尾，其名曰蜚，行水則竭，行草則死，見則天下大疫。鉤水出焉，而北流注于勞水，其中的鱃魚。

statement.id: Teks klasik menempatkan Fei pada Gunung Tai.
statement.en: The classical text places Fei on Mount Tai.

statement.id: Kamus menggambarkannya sebagai canavar bertubuh setengah, berkaki satu, bertelapak satu, bertangan satu, bermata satu, bergigi satu, dan bertanduk satu.
statement.en: The dictionary describes it as a canavar with half a body, one leg, one foot, one arm, one eye, one tooth and one horn.

basis_claims.quote: Şeytânî bir karakterdir. Bazı Ural kavimleri ve Sibirya Tatarları bu yaratığın ormanda yaşadığına inanırlar ve ondan çok korkarlar.

statement.id: Ia berwatak setani (şeytânî); sebagian kavim Ural dan Tatar Siberia (Sibirya Tatarları) percaya ia tinggal di hutan (ormanda) dan sangat takut kepadanya.
statement.en: It has a devilish (şeytânî) character; some Ural peoples and the Siberian Tatars (Sibirya Tatarları) believe it lives in the forest (ormanda) and fear it greatly.

basis_claims.quote: Glosoen kan findes ved eller på kirkegården, men har også ofte sin gang andre steder. Dens udseende beskrives forskelligt. Den kan bl.a. være sort, rød eller hovedløs og den kan være ifølge med et kuld på fx syv eller tolv smågrise.

statement.id: Gloso dapat ditemukan di atau dekat pemakaman, tetapi sering juga berkeliaran di tempat lain; wujudnya beragam, misalnya hitam, merah, atau tanpa kepala, dan bisa ditemani tujuh atau dua belas anak babi.
statement.en: The gloso is found at or in the churchyard but often roams elsewhere; its appearance varies, being black, red or headless, and it may be followed by a litter of seven or twelve piglets.

basis_claims.quote: Gravso, også kalt glumso og gloso, er ifølge folketroen et spøkelsesdyr i form av en sugge (dansk: so) som blant annet opptrådte på kirkegårder i Danmark og Skåne.

statement.id: Gravso, juga disebut glumso dan gloso, menurut kepercayaan rakyat adalah hewan hantu berwujud babi betina yang antara lain muncul di pemakaman di Denmark (Danmark) dan Skåne.
statement.en: The gravso, also called glumso and gloso, is in folk belief a ghost animal in the form of a sow that appeared in churchyards in Denmark (Danmark) and Scania (Skåne), among other places.

basis_claims.quote: Gravsoen kjentes på sine gloende øyne og en knivskarp rygg med strittende børster. Det varslet død å møte henne.

statement.id: Gravso dikenali dari matanya yang menyala dan punggungnya yang setajam pisau dengan bulu kaku; bertemu dengannya pertanda maut.
statement.en: The gravso was known by her glowing eyes and knife-sharp back with bristling hairs; meeting her foretold death.

k-obuk.depicted_variant: Kłobuk, Warmian household spirit: preserve the reference drenched hen natural anatomy. Show the wet hen deliberately dragging a little cloth sack of neighbours' stolen coins into the black-painted room at the end of an attic. A household owner receives the unusual gift with surprise. Clearly source-supported wealth-bringing theft and black attic chamber, rather than a chicken in a doorway. One head, two legs, two folded wings. This bird form is recorded, don't add human arms or demon parts.
visual_requirements: Documented variant or episode clearly visible
Coherent required anatomy
No generic aura

basis_claims.quote: Kłobuk ist der Name eines Kobolds, dessen Geschichten im südlichen Ermland (Powiat Olsztyński in der polnischen Woiwodschaft Ermland-Masuren) erzählt werden. Es handelt sich um einen Geist, der in Gestalt eines gefiederten Wesens, einer Katze oder als Mensch auftritt.

statement.id: Kłobuk adalah nama kobold (roh rumah) yang kisahnya diceritakan di Warmia selatan (Kabupaten Olsztyn, Provinsi Warmia-Masuria, Polandia); ia roh yang muncul sebagai makhluk berbulu unggas, kucing, atau manusia.
statement.en: Kłobuk is the name of a kobold (house spirit) whose stories are told in southern Warmia (Olsztyn County in Poland's Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship); it is a spirit appearing as a feathered creature, a cat or a human.

basis_claims.quote: Obwohl er als lästig beschrieben wird, bringt er dem Haushalt Glück und Wohlstand, oftmals indem er die Nachbarn des Besitzers bestiehlt.

statement.id: Meski digambarkan merepotkan, ia membawa keberuntungan dan kemakmuran bagi rumah tangga, sering dengan mencuri dari tetangga pemiliknya.
statement.en: Though described as a nuisance, it brings the household luck and prosperity, often by stealing from the owner's neighbours.

basis_claims.quote: Kłobuk, kołbuk – w wierzeniach słowiańskich demon opiekujący się dobytkiem i ogniskiem domowym. Utożsamiany z duszą martwego płodu. Przybierał najczęściej postać zmokłej kury, a także kaczki, gęsi, sroki, wrony, kota, a nawet człowieka.

statement.id: Kłobuk atau kołbuk dalam kepercayaan Slavia adalah demon penjaga harta dan perapian rumah, disamakan dengan jiwa janin yang mati, dan paling sering berwujud ayam betina basah, juga bebek, angsa, murai, gagak, kucing, bahkan manusia.
statement.en: Kłobuk or kołbuk is, in Slavic belief, a demon guarding property and the household hearth, identified with the soul of a dead foetus, most often taking the form of a drenched hen, but also a duck, goose, magpie, crow, cat or even a human.

basis_claims.quote: Kłobuk dbał o pomnożenie majątku swojego gospodarza. Czynił to jednak, okradając sąsiadów. Od swojego właściciela wymagał opieki, a także osobnego, pomalowanego na czarno pokoju, znajdującego się na końcu strychu lub w innym, trudno dostępnym miejscu. Źle potraktowany, może się mścić.

statement.id: Kłobuk melipatgandakan harta tuannya, tetapi dengan mencuri dari tetangga; ia menuntut perawatan dan kamar khusus bercat hitam di ujung loteng atau tempat sulit dijangkau, dan bila diperlakukan buruk ia bisa membalas dendam.
statement.en: The kłobuk increased its master's wealth, but by robbing the neighbours; it demanded care and a separate black-painted room at the end of the attic or another hard-to-reach place, and if badly treated it could take revenge.

artistic_changes: Clothing, coat colours, human age/appearance, material ornament and environmental arrangement are editorial staging.

presentation_revision.rationale: Replaces passive ordinary animal presentation with the stronger explicitly documented variant/episode recorded in assigned research.

basis_claims.quote: is a huge, hairy hominid dwelling in the woods. They were thought to protect flocks of livestock and teach skills such as agriculture and ironworking to humans.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Basque, Basajaun ("Tuan hutan", jamak basajaunak) adalah makhluk mirip manusia yang besar dan berbulu, tinggal di hutan, yang dipercaya melindungi kawanan ternak dan mengajari manusia bertani dan menempa besi.
statement.en: In Basque mythology Basajaun ('Lord of the forest', plural basajaunak) is a huge hairy hominid living in the woods, thought to protect flocks and teach humans farming and ironworking.

basis_claims.quote: The Basajaun is said to have a tall, human form with his face and body covered in hair, with the strands reaching the knees, walking upright like a man.

statement.id: Basajaun berwujud manusia yang tinggi, wajah dan tubuhnya tertutup rambut sampai lutut, dan berjalan tegak seperti manusia.
statement.en: The Basajaun is tall and humanlike, his face and body covered in hair reaching the knees, walking upright like a man.

basis_claims.quote: His two feet are differently shaped, thus leaving an odd set of foot tracks. While one foot is normal, the other one (left foot) is rounded like the tree stump (base of a tree trunk) and leaves circular footprints.

statement.id: Kedua kakinya berbeda bentuk: satu normal, sedangkan kaki kirinya bulat seperti tunggul pohon dan meninggalkan jejak melingkar.
statement.en: His two feet differ: one is normal, while the left is round like a tree stump and leaves circular tracks.

basis_claims.quote: The basajaunak dwell in the forests and caverns at higher altitudes or "prominent places". More specifically, it is said to inhabit the mountainside of the Gorbea in Biscay Province (or the forests of Zeanuri town nearby), around Ataun town which is the backwoods of neighboring Gipuzkoa Province, and the Irati Forest of the Pyrenees

statement.id: Basajaunak tinggal di hutan dan gua di dataran tinggi, misalnya lereng Gorbea di Biscaya, sekitar Ataun di Gipuzkoa, dan Hutan Irati di Pyrenees.
statement.en: The basajaunak live in forests and caves at higher altitudes, such as the slopes of Gorbea in Biscay, around Ataun in Gipuzkoa and the Irati Forest in the Pyrenees.

basis_claims.quote: Karakırnak, Türkmenlerin demonolojik görüşlerinde, ırmaklar ve bu anlamda suyla ilintili olan şeytanî bir karakterdir.

statement.id: Karakırnak adalah tokoh setan (şeytanî bir karakter) dalam pandangan demonologis orang Turkmen (Türkmenlerin), yang berkaitan dengan sungai (ırmaklar) dan air (su).
statement.en: Karakırnak is a devilish character (şeytanî bir karakter) in the demonological views of the Turkmens (Türkmenlerin), associated with rivers (ırmaklar) and thus with water (su).

basis_claims.quote: kadına benzeyen, bedeni baştan başa kıllarla örtülü bir varlıktır. Suda olan bir insanın üstüne gelip, zarar verebilir.

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan, Karakırnak adalah makhluk yang menyerupai perempuan (kadına benzeyen) dengan tubuh tertutup bulu (kıllarla) dari ujung ke ujung; ia dapat mendatangi orang yang berada di air dan mencelakainya (zarar verebilir).
statement.en: According to the beliefs, Karakırnak is a being resembling a woman (kadına benzeyen) whose body is covered with hair (kıllarla) from head to toe; it can come upon a person in the water and harm them (zarar verebilir).

basis_claims.quote: Se le identifica como al «Señor del Mediodía y de los Calurosos Veranos» (Demonium Meridianum); se trata de un demonio pestífero que habita el desierto de Judea

statement.id: Ia diidentikkan sebagai "Tuan Tengah Hari dan Musim Panas yang Terik" (Demonium Meridianum), iblis pembawa wabah yang menghuni gurun Yudea.
statement.en: He is identified as the 'Lord of Noon and of Hot Summers' (Demonium Meridianum), a pestilential demon dwelling in the desert of Judea.

basis_claims.quote: Ketev Merirí ataca al mediodía, cuando el sol cae a plomo. Recorre las mismas regiones que Lilith, mortífero genio de la noche, recorre al oscurecer.

statement.id: Ketev Merirí menyerang pada tengah hari ketika matahari tepat di atas kepala, menjelajahi wilayah yang sama dengan Lilith, roh maut malam yang berkeliaran setelah gelap.
statement.en: Ketev Merirí strikes at noon when the sun beats straight down, roaming the same regions that Lilith, the deadly night spirit, roams after dark.

basis_claims.quote: Внешне Кетев мерири — мохнат и страшен, во лбу у него — рог, глаз — на груди. Каждый, увидевший его, умирает (Мидраш Техилим 91, Бемидбар Рабба 12).

statement.id: Menurut midrash, Ketev meriri berbulu dan mengerikan, bertanduk di dahi dengan mata di dada, dan siapa pun yang melihatnya mati (Midrash Tehillim 91, Bemidbar Rabbah 12).
statement.en: According to the midrash, Ketev meriri is shaggy and fearsome, with a horn on its forehead and an eye on its chest, and whoever sees it dies (Midrash Tehillim 91, Bemidbar Rabbah 12).

basis_claims.quote: He was also portrayed with the head of a falcon ... adorned with the moon disk and crescent moon.

statement.id: Kurayarō adalah yōkai dalam kumpulan ilustrasi Sekien.
statement.en: Kurayarō is a yōkai in Sekien’s illustrated collection.

basis_claims.quote: 鞍（くら、馬具のひとつ）の妖怪であり、鞍に牙と目が生えた形で、紐状の手には鞭を持っている。

basis_claims.quote: Il nome Longana (o a seconda del luogo, come in Oltrepiave e Auronzo  Anguana) indica una creatura acquatica fantastica di sesso femminile tipica della tradizione del Cadore e Comelico (soprattutto Lozzo di Cadore).

statement.id: Longana (di beberapa tempat seperti Oltrepiave dan Auronzo disebut Anguana) adalah makhluk air perempuan dari tradisi Cadore dan Comelico, terutama Lozzo di Cadore.
statement.en: The Longana (in places such as Oltrepiave and Auronzo called Anguana) is a female water creature of the tradition of Cadore and Comelico, especially Lozzo di Cadore.

basis_claims.quote: Nella tradizione questo essere suole vivere in gruppo in grotte o anfratti rocciosi che nella toponimia locale prendono il suo nome: esiste a Vallesella un anfratto detto "Bùs de le Longane" e a Lozzo un sasso detto "Sass de le Longane".

statement.id: Mereka hidup berkelompok di gua atau celah batu yang dinamai menurut mereka, seperti celah Bùs de le Longane di Vallesella dan batu Sass de le Longane di Lozzo.
statement.en: They live in groups in caves or rock clefts named after them, like the Bùs de le Longane cleft at Vallesella and the Sass de le Longane rock at Lozzo.

basis_claims.quote: Sono raffigurate come donne bellissime e molto intelligenti, ma con arti inferiori di capra, e poste dalla loro duplice natura in diretta comunicazione con lo spirito silvestre che conferisce loro poteri straordinari di predizione degli eventi naturali.

statement.id: Mereka digambarkan sebagai perempuan sangat cantik dan cerdas berkaki kambing, yang karena sifat gandanya berhubungan langsung dengan roh hutan yang memberi mereka kemampuan luar biasa meramalkan peristiwa alam.
statement.en: They are depicted as very beautiful, intelligent women with goat legs whose dual nature links them directly to the forest spirit, giving them extraordinary power to foretell natural events.

perkunas.aura: Resolute posture and weathered expression under natural stormcloud light.

basis_claims.quote: Kovoja su velniu, piktosiomis galiomis. Tautosakos kūriniuose dažniausiai pasakojama, kad Perkūnas gyvena tarp dangaus ir žemės, debesyse, valdo griaustinį ir žaibus.

statement.id: Perkūnas bertarung melawan iblis (velnias) dan kekuatan jahat; dalam cerita rakyat ia paling sering dikisahkan tinggal di antara langit dan bumi, di awan, dan memerintah guruh dan petir.
statement.en: He fights the devil and evil forces; folklore most often says Perkūnas lives between heaven and earth, in the clouds, ruling thunder and lightning.

basis_claims.quote: Tautosakos kūriniuose dažniausiai pasakojama, kad Perkūnas gyvena tarp dangaus ir žemės, debesyse, valdo griaustinį ir žaibus.

statement.en: Folk works most often tell that Perkūnas lives between heaven and earth, in the clouds, and rules thunder and lightning.

basis_claims.quote: Tautosakoje vaizduojamas kaip senyvas, bet dar stiprus, aukštas rudabarzdis vyras

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat ia digambarkan sebagai lelaki tua yang masih kuat, tinggi, dan berjanggut merah.
statement.en: In folklore he is depicted as an elderly but still strong, tall, red-bearded man.

basis_claims.quote: Une hada (ou hade, c'est-à-dire une fée, du latin fatum : destin) est un être féminin légendaire des Pyrénées gasconnes que l’on appelle parfois aussi  « démaïselas » (demoiselles) ou « damas » (dames).

statement.id: Hada (atau hade, "peri", dari bahasa Latin fatum, "takdir") adalah makhluk perempuan legendaris dari Pyrenees Gascogne, kadang disebut démaïselas (nona) atau damas (nyonya).
statement.en: A hada (or hade, 'fairy', from Latin fatum, 'fate') is a legendary female being of the Gascon Pyrenees, sometimes called démaïselas (damsels) or damas (ladies).

basis_claims.quote: Créatures essentiellement nocturnes, les hadas vivent sous terre, dans des grottes ou auprès des sources et des ruisseaux.

statement.id: Hada terutama makhluk malam yang tinggal di bawah tanah, di gua, atau dekat mata air dan sungai kecil.
statement.en: Mainly nocturnal, hadas live underground, in caves or near springs and streams.

basis_claims.quote: L’imagerie populaire et la mythologie pyrénéenne décrivent aussi parfois une « hadetta » comme une femme aux pieds palmés.

statement.id: Mitologi Pyrenees kadang menggambarkan "hadetta" sebagai perempuan berkaki selaput.
statement.en: Pyrenean imagery sometimes describes a 'hadetta' as a woman with webbed feet.

adamastor.depicted_variant: Mighty storm-cloud manifestation guarding the Cape of Good Hope

Tiny sailing ship establishes scale

adamastor.aura: Presence through expression, posture, framing, scale and natural lighting; no generic luminous effects.

basis_claims.quote: Adamastor is a mythological character created by the Portuguese poet Luís de Camões in his epic poem Os Lusíadas (first printed in 1572), as a personification of the Cape of Good Hope

statement.id: Adamastor adalah tokoh mitologis ciptaan penyair Portugal Luís de Camões dalam epos Os Lusíadas (pertama dicetak 1572) sebagai personifikasi Tanjung Harapan.
statement.en: Adamastor is a mythological character created by the Portuguese poet Luís de Camões in his epic Os Lusíadas (first printed 1572) as a personification of the Cape of Good Hope.

basis_claims.quote: symbolizing the dangers of the sea and the formidable forces of nature challenged and ultimately overcome by the Portuguese during the Age of Discovery. Adamastor manifests itself out of a storm.

statement.id: Ia melambangkan bahaya laut dan kekuatan alam yang ditantang dan akhirnya diatasi bangsa Portugal pada Zaman Penjelajahan, dan ia muncul dari badai.
statement.en: He symbolises the dangers of the sea and the forces of nature challenged and finally overcome by the Portuguese in the Age of Discovery, and he appears out of a storm.

basis_claims.quote: Er sollte sich Vasco da Gama als mächtige Gewitterwolke offenbaren, die den Zugang zum Kap der Guten Hoffnung bzw. Cabo das Tormentas (Kap der Stürme) verteidigt, hinter dem sich der Indische Ozean erstreckt

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Jerman, ia menampakkan diri kepada Vasco da Gama sebagai awan badai raksasa yang menjaga jalan ke Tanjung Harapan atau Cabo das Tormentas (Tanjung Badai), yang di baliknya terbentang Samudra Hindia.
statement.en: According to the German article, he appeared to Vasco da Gama as a mighty storm cloud guarding the way to the Cape of Good Hope or Cabo das Tormentas (Cape of Storms), beyond which lies the Indian Ocean.

visual_requirements: One humanoid male giant with one head, two arms and two legs

statement.id: Blunderbore (Blunderboar, Thunderbore, Blunderbus, Blunderbuss), raksasa folklor Cornwall (Cornish) dan Inggris (English); Jack the Giant Killer; Penwith; saudara Rebecks.
statement.en: Blunderbore (Blunderboar, Thunderbore, Blunderbus, Blunderbuss), a giant of Cornish and English folklore; Jack the Giant Killer; Penwith; brother Rebecks.

basis_claims.quote: Cornish folklore remembers Blunderbore as living in Ludgvan Lese (a manor in Ludgvan), where he terrorized travelers heading north to St Ives.
