coulobre.aura: Watchful presence through framing, scale, posture and natural cloudy daylight.

basis_claims.quote: Le Coulobre est une créature fantastique, sorte de drac ou dragon, qui hantait la fontaine de Vaucluse.

statement.id: Coulobre adalah makhluk khayalan, semacam drac atau naga, yang menghantui mata air Fontaine-de-Vaucluse.
statement.en: The Coulobre is a fantastic creature, a kind of drac or dragon, that haunted the spring of Fontaine-de-Vaucluse.

basis_claims.quote: était une créature ailée qui vivait dans l'exsurgence de la Sorgue. Elle passait pour s'unir avec des dragons qui l'abandonnaient ensuite, le forçant à élever seul les petites salamandres noires tachetées d'or dont elle accouchait.

statement.id: Ia makhluk bersayap yang hidup di mata air Sorgue; konon ia kawin dengan naga-naga yang lalu meninggalkannya, sehingga ia harus membesarkan sendiri anak-anaknya, salamander hitam berbintik emas.
statement.en: It was a winged creature living in the spring of the Sorgue; it supposedly mated with dragons who then abandoned it, leaving it to raise alone the little black, gold-spotted salamanders it bore.

basis_claims.quote: По легенде Кулобр — существо женского рода. Она живёт в одиночестве и пытается найти себе пару.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Rusia, Coulobre adalah makhluk betina yang hidup sendirian dan mencari pasangan.
statement.en: According to the Russian article, the Coulobre is female, living alone and seeking a mate.

statement.en: The middle son turned into a white swan (ак куу) and flew away; researchers place the land of So by the Kuu (Lebed) River in the Altai (Алтай).

basis_claims.quote: Maide, però, és un nom que segons la zona designa criatures mitològiques diverses, en principi no relacionades: en alguns llocs és el geni de les muntanyes, mentre que en d'altres se l'equipara amb els mairuak (els mítics moros gegantins constructors de cromlecs) i es diu que porta grans pedres al cap per a construir cases, mentre broda teles a mà.

statement.id: Namun menurut daerahnya Maide juga nama makhluk lain: di beberapa tempat roh gunung, di tempat lain disamakan dengan mairuak, raksasa pembangun kromlek, yang konon menjunjung batu besar untuk membangun rumah sambil menyulam kain.
statement.en: Yet by region Maide also names other beings: in some places the mountain spirit, in others the mairuak, giant cromlech-builders said to carry great stones on their heads to build houses while embroidering cloth.

basis_claims.quote: Mairu (Mairuak au pluriel en basque) est un géant ou jentil construisant des châteaux, dolmens et autres monuments mégalithiques dans la mythologie du Pays basque.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, Mairu (jamak: Mairuak) adalah raksasa atau jentil pembangun kastel, dolmen, dan monumen megalitik lain dalam mitologi Basque.
statement.en: According to the French article, the Mairu (plural Mairuak) is a giant or jentil who builds castles, dolmens and other megalithic monuments in Basque mythology.

basis_claims.quote: Il est nommé aussi Intxitxu dans la vallée de la Bidassoa, Maide, Mairi, Saindi Maidi ou Maru selon les endroits au Pays basque.

statement.id: Ia juga disebut Intxitxu di lembah Bidasoa, serta Maide, Mairi, Saindi Maidi, atau Maru di tempat lain.
statement.en: It is also called Intxitxu in the Bidasoa valley, and Maide, Mairi, Saindi Maidi or Maru elsewhere.

basis_claims.quote: On attribue aux Mairuak la construction de certains dolmens et cromlechs comme ceux d'Ibañeta à Zugarramurdi, d'Oiartzun et de Buluntza.

statement.id: Mairuak dianggap membangun sejumlah dolmen dan kromlek, seperti di Ibañeta di Zugarramurdi, Oiartzun, dan Buluntza.
statement.en: The Mairuak are credited with building some dolmens and cromlechs, such as those of Ibañeta at Zugarramurdi, Oiartzun and Buluntza.

basis_claims.quote: Muruga is a tutelary deity mentioned in Tamil Sangam literature, of the Kurinji region.

statement.id: Artikel mengaitkan Muruga dalam sastra Sangam Tamil dengan wilayah Kurinji.

basis_claims.quote: He is typically represented as an ever-youthful man, riding or near an Peacock (named Paravani), and sometimes with an emblem of a rooster on his banner.

basis_claims.quote: He wields a spear called the vel, supposedly given to him by his mother Parvati.

statement.id: Ia membawa tombak vel yang dikaitkan dengan pemberian Parvati.
statement.en: He carries the vel spear associated with Parvati's gift.

basis_claims.quote: While most icons represent him with only one head, some have six heads, a reflection of legends surrounding his birth wherein he was fused from six boys or borne of six conceptions.

statement.id: Sebagian gambar menunjukkan satu kepala, sebagian lainnya enam.
statement.en: Some images show one head, while others show six.

basis_claims.quote: He is described to have aged quickly from childhood, becoming a warrior, leading the army of the devas and credited with destroying asuras including Tarakasura and Surapadma.

statement.id: Ia memimpin pasukan deva melawan asura termasuk Tarakasura dan Surapadma.
statement.en: He leads the devas' army against asuras including Tarakasura and Surapadma.

basis_claims.quote: Kartikeya- This statue, from the Later Gupta period, is made of red sandstone. ... He is a red god seated on a blue peacock, and his weapon, a spear, is engraved on the left of the sculpture.

statement.id: Museum Bihar membahas patung Kartikeya batu pasir merah dari masa Gupta akhir dengan tombak dan merak.
statement.en: The Bihar Museum discusses a red sandstone Kartikeya sculpture of the Later Gupta period with spear and peacock.

basis_claims.quote: Обыда — женский персонаж удмуртской мифологии. В фольклоре представляется в двух ипостасях: как лесной дух и как удмуртский аналог Бабы-Яги.

statement.id: Obyda adalah tokoh perempuan dalam mitologi Udmurt; dalam folklor ia tampil dalam dua wujud: sebagai roh hutan dan sebagai padanan Udmurt dari Baba Yaga.
statement.en: Obyda is a female figure of Udmurt mythology; in folklore she appears in two guises: as a forest spirit and as the Udmurt counterpart of Baba Yaga.

basis_claims.quote: Обыда — аяклары борылып, күкрәкләре эленеп торган урман җан иясе, ул аларны иңбашларына ыргыта һәм алар ярдәмендә кешене буып үтерә ала дип уйлаганнар.

statement.id: Obyda dibayangkan sebagai makhluk hutan dengan kaki terbalik dan payudara menggantung, yang ia lemparkan ke atas bahu dan dengannya ia bisa mencekik orang sampai mati.
statement.en: Obyda was imagined as a forest being with backward-turned feet and hanging breasts, which she throws over her shoulders and with which she can strangle a person to death.

basis_claims.quote: Удмурт фольклорында Обыда ике төрле кыяфәттә күрсәтелә: урман җан иясе буларак кеше ярдәмчесе һәм удмурт убырлы карчыгы буларак.

statement.id: Dalam folklor Udmurt, Obyda tampil dalam dua wujud: sebagai makhluk hutan yang menolong manusia dan sebagai nenek penyihir Udmurt.
statement.en: In Udmurt folklore Obyda appears in two forms: as a forest being who helps people and as an Udmurt witch-hag.

paradijsvogel.aura: Presence through expression, posture, framing and natural scene light.

basis_claims.quote: De paradijsvogel (manucodiata, "Vogels van God") is een bestaand dier (zie paradijsvogel), maar het werd vroeger fabelachtige eigenschappen toegeschreven. Het zou een wezen zonder vlees en botten zijn, levend in het paradijs, waar het zich voedt met dauw.

statement.id: Paradijsvogel (manucodiata, Vogels van God) adalah hewan nyata yang dulu diberi sifat dongeng (fabelachtige): tanpa daging (vlees) dan tulang (botten), hidup di surga (paradijs), makan embun (dauw).
statement.en: The paradijsvogel (manucodiata, Vogels van God) is a real animal once given fabulous (fabelachtige) traits: without flesh (vlees) or bones (botten), living in paradise (paradijs), feeding on dew (dauw).

basis_claims.quote: Het heeft geen poten maar haakt zich met twee draden uit zijn staart vast aan een boomtak. Zijn lange, golvende veren zijn ragfijn en stralen goud, oranje, smaragd en kastanjebruin. De vogel daalt alleen af naar de aarde om te rusten.

statement.id: Ia tak berkaki (geen poten), mengait ke dahan (boomtak) dengan benang ekor (staart); bulunya (veren) berkilau emas (goud), jingga, zamrud; ia turun ke bumi (aarde) hanya untuk beristirahat (rusten).
statement.en: It has no feet (geen poten), hooks onto a branch (boomtak) with tail (staart) threads; its feathers (veren) shine gold (goud), orange, emerald; it comes to earth (aarde) only to rest (rusten).

potrimpo.aura: Presence through expression, posture, framing and natural scene light.

basis_claims.quote: (also Potrimpus, Autrimpo, Natrimpe) was a god of seas, earth, grain, and crops in the pagan Baltic, and Prussian mythology. He was one of the three main gods worshiped by the Old Prussians. Most of what is known about this god is derived from unreliable 16th-century sources.

statement.id: Potrimpo (juga Potrimpus, Autrimpo, Natrimpe) adalah dewa laut, bumi, gandum, dan tanaman dalam mitologi pagan Baltik dan Prusia, salah satu dari tiga dewa utama Prusia Kuno; pengetahuan tentangnya kebanyakan dari sumber abad ke-16 yang kurang andal.
statement.en: Potrimpo (also Potrimpus, Autrimpo, Natrimpe) was a god of seas, earth, grain and crops in pagan Baltic and Prussian mythology, one of the three main Old Prussian gods; most knowledge comes from unreliable 16th-century sources.

basis_claims.quote: Simon Grunau claimed that Potrimpo was a god of grain and together with thunder god Perkūnas and death god Peckols formed a pagan trinity. He was depicted on the purported Flag of Widewuto as a young, merry man wearing a wreath of grain ears. Grunau further claimed that snakes, as creatures of Potrimpo, were worshipped and given milk

statement.id: Simon Grunau menyebut Potrimpo dewa gandum yang bersama dewa guntur Perkūnas dan dewa kematian Peckols membentuk tritunggal pagan; ia digambarkan sebagai pemuda riang berkalung untaian bulir gandum, dan ular sebagai makhluknya dipuja serta diberi susu.
statement.en: Simon Grunau claimed Potrimpo was a grain god forming a pagan trinity with thunder god Perkūnas and death god Peckols; he was depicted as a merry youth wearing a wreath of grain ears, and snakes, as his creatures, were worshipped and given milk.

questing-beast.depicted_variant: Serpent head, leopard body, lion hindquarters and deer legs/hooves
visual_requirements: One serpent head
Leopard torso
Lion hindquarters
Four deer legs with cloven hooves
questing-beast.aura: Presence through expression, posture, framing and natural scene light.

basis_claims.quote: Es besitzt den Kopf einer Schlange und einen Körper wie ein Leopard, mit dem Hinterteil eines Löwen und Beinen und Hufen eines Hirschs. Aus seinem Inneren kommt ein tosender Lärm, ein Bellen wie von 30 Hunden in voller Hetze.

statement.id: Berkepala ular (Schlange), bertubuh macan tutul (Leopard), pantat singa (Löwen), kaki dan kuku rusa (Hirschs); gonggongan seperti 30 anjing (Hunden).
statement.en: Serpent's head (Schlange), leopard's body (Leopard), lion's hindquarters (Löwen), deer's legs and hooves (Hirschs); baying like 30 hounds (Hunden).

sarutahiko-okami.depicted_variant: Towering ruddy-faced human guide with long nose, large beard and jeweled spear
visual_requirements: Human male, towering stature
Ruddy face, conspicuous elongated nose and beard
One jeweled spear
sarutahiko-okami.aura: Presence through expression, posture, framing and natural scene light.

basis_claims.quote: Sarutahiko/Sarudahiko/Sarutabiko Ōkami (猿田毘古大神／猿田彦大神; Japanese pronunciation: [sa.ɾɯ.taꜜ.çi̥.ko]) is a deity of the Japanese religion of Shinto; he is the leader of the earthly kami.

statement.id: Sarutahiko Ōkami adalah dewa Shinto yang memimpin kami bumi.
statement.en: Sarutahiko Ōkami is a Shinto deity who leads the earthly kami.

basis_claims.quote: Sarutahiko Ōkami is seen as a symbol of Misogi, strength and guidance, which is why he is the patron of martial arts such as aikido.

statement.id: Ia dikaitkan dengan penyucian, kekuatan, dan bimbingan.
statement.en: He is associated with purification, strength and guidance.

basis_claims.quote: He is depicted as a towering man with a large beard, jeweled spear, ruddy face, and long nose.

statement.id: Penggambarannya menyebut tubuh tinggi, janggut lebat, wajah kemerahan, dan hidung panjang.
statement.en: He is portrayed as tall with a large beard, ruddy face and long nose.

satis.depicted_variant: Human woman wearing Upper Egypt White Crown with antelope horns
visual_requirements: Human adult woman
White Crown of Upper Egypt
Two antelope horns on headdress
No animal head or solar disk
satis.aura: Dignified protective presence through expression, posture and natural Nile daylight.

basis_claims.quote: A protective deity of Egypt's southern border with Nubia, she came to personify the former annual flooding of the Nile

statement.id: Ia melindungi perbatasan Nubia dan mempersonifikasikan banjir Nil.
statement.en: She protects the Nubian border and personifies the Nile inundation.

basis_claims.quote: She is depicted as a woman wearing the White Crown of Upper Egypt with antelope horns.

statement.id: Satis digambarkan memakai Mahkota Putih Mesir Hulu dengan tanduk antelop.
statement.en: Satis is shown wearing Upper Egypt’s White Crown with antelope horns.

stolems.depicted_variant: Entirely human Kashubian giant whose head rises above mature pines
visual_requirements: Human giant, no animal or rock anatomy
Head far above mature pine tops
Great boulder emphasizes source-described strength
stolems.aura: Presence through expression, posture, framing, enormous source-supported scale and natural scene light.

basis_claims.quote: Stolemy (kaszub. Stolemë) – w kaszubskich legendach olbrzymy, które przed wiekami zamieszkiwały tereny Kaszub. Pozostałością po ich obecności są jakoby liczne wielkie głazy, które stolemowie porozrzucali podczas walk lub zawodów siłowych.

statement.id: Stolem (bahasa Kashubia: Stolemë) dalam legenda Kashubia adalah raksasa yang berabad-abad lalu menghuni tanah Kashubia; banyak batu besar konon merupakan sisa kehadiran mereka, dilemparkan saat bertarung atau beradu kekuatan.
statement.en: The stolems (Kashubian Stolemë) are, in Kashubian legend, giants who centuries ago lived in Kashubia; many large boulders are said to be traces of them, thrown about during fights or contests of strength.

basis_claims.quote: Stolemowie odznaczali się rzekomo nadzwyczajnym wzrostem i siłą, byli także okrutni i prześladowali ludzi. Lubili się popisywać swoją siłą wobec siebie i ludzi. Miewali normalne rodziny, były więc i stolemki, i stolemiątka.

statement.id: Stolem konon luar biasa tinggi dan kuat, kejam, dan suka menindas manusia; mereka gemar memamerkan kekuatan di antara sesamanya dan kepada manusia, serta punya keluarga biasa, termasuk stolem perempuan dan anak-anak stolem.
statement.en: The stolems were said to be extraordinarily tall and strong, cruel and oppressive to people; they liked to show off their strength to one another and to humans, and had ordinary families, with female stolems and stolem children.

basis_claims.quote: Przypisuje się im uformowanie obecnego krajobrazu Kaszub. Tworzyli wzgórza, mierzeje na jeziorach czy mielizny na morzu. Według jednego z podań przytoczonych przez Józefa Ceynowę za swoją niegodziwość zostali ukarani przez bogów i zamienieni w kamienne kręgi.

statement.id: Mereka dianggap membentuk bentang alam Kashubia sekarang, menciptakan bukit, tanjung pasir di danau, dan beting di laut; menurut satu legenda yang dikutip Józef Ceynowa, mereka dihukum para dewa karena kejahatannya dan diubah menjadi lingkaran batu.
statement.en: They are credited with shaping today's Kashubian landscape, creating hills, spits on lakes and sandbanks at sea; according to a legend quoted by Józef Ceynowa, they were punished by the gods for their wickedness and turned into stone circles.

basis_claims.quote: Stolem – pòdług Kaszëbów òn bëł jak lëdze, ale tak wiôldżi, że jegò głowa przewiższała nôwiąkszé chójczi.

statement.id: Menurut orang Kashubia, stolem seperti manusia tetapi begitu besar sehingga kepalanya melampaui pohon pinus tertinggi.
statement.en: According to the Kashubians, a stolem was like a person but so huge that his head rose above the tallest pines.

szelatya.depicted_variant: Turkic elderly Wind Father with long hair and silver weapon
visual_requirements: Elderly human man in Turkic variant
Long hair
Silver physical weapon
Natural wind conveyed through hair, cloak and foliage
szelatya.aura: Wind-god presence through grave expression, grounded posture, windswept clothing and stormy natural light.

basis_claims.quote: Szelatya has long hair, silver weapons, and thunder horses. He is said to appear as a youthful and handsome man in Hungarian mythology, but as an elderly man in Turkic mythology. He has a jungle or sylvan named Silver Forest.

statement.id: Szelatya berambut panjang, bersenjata perak, dan memiliki kuda guntur; dalam mitologi Hungaria ia tampil sebagai pemuda tampan, tetapi dalam mitologi Turk sebagai lelaki tua; ia memiliki hutan bernama Hutan Perak.
statement.en: Szelatya has long hair, silver weapons and thunder horses; in Hungarian mythology he appears as a handsome young man, but in Turkic mythology as an old man; he has a forest called the Silver Forest.

basis_claims.quote: Dünyadaki tüm fırtınaların, rüzgârların, kasırgaların, hortumların, tayfunların yöneticisi olan tanrıdır. Harman savurmak isteyen köylüler Yel Ata'yı yardıma çağırırlar.

statement.id: Yel Ata adalah dewa penguasa semua badai, angin, puting beliung, dan taifun di dunia; para petani yang hendak menampi hasil panen memanggilnya untuk membantu.
statement.en: Yel Ata is the god ruling all the world's storms, winds, whirlwinds, tornadoes and typhoons; villagers who want to winnow their threshing call on Yel Ata for help.

plafalgas.depicted_variant: Kind giant carries church bell full of grain with beech staff
visual_requirements: Human-looking benevolent giant
Great church bell carried on shoulder
Grain visibly inside bell
Beech wood staff
Complete bell rim and figure inside frame
plafalgas.aura: Benevolent giant presence through kind expression, strong carrying posture, scale versus village structures and natural daylight.

basis_claims.quote: Plafalgàs o Plafalgars, també dit Pare Falgars, és un gegant de la mitologia catalana famós per la seva bonhomia, la seva valentia i la seva força prodigiosa, que posa al servei dels seus veïns.

statement.id: Plafalgàs atau Plafalgars, disebut juga Pare Falgars, adalah raksasa mitologi Katalan yang terkenal karena kebaikan, keberanian, dan kekuatan luar biasanya yang ia pakai untuk menolong tetangganya.
statement.en: Plafalgàs or Plafalgars, also called Pare Falgars, is a giant of Catalan mythology famed for his kindness, courage and prodigious strength, which he puts at his neighbours' service.

basis_claims.quote: La versió més estesa de la llegenda el situa a Vallfogona de Ripollès. Plafalgàs era el masover del mas del mateix nom, avui ja enderrocat, prop de l'ermita de Santa Magdalena de Cambrils.

statement.id: Versi paling umum menempatkannya di Vallfogona de Ripollès, sebagai penggarap rumah pertanian bernama sama dekat pertapaan Santa Magdalena de Cambrils.
statement.en: The most widespread version places him in Vallfogona de Ripollès, as the tenant of the farmhouse of the same name near the hermitage of Santa Magdalena de Cambrils.

basis_claims.quote: El rector de Sant Julià, que li encarregava feines diverses, li va encomanar la tasca de transportar la campana. Plafalgàs se la va carregar a l'espatlla i va emprendre el camí de tornada al poble.

statement.id: Pastor paroki Sant Julià menugaskannya mengangkut lonceng dari pertapaan kastel Milany, dan Plafalgàs memikulnya di bahu pulang ke desa.
statement.en: The rector of Sant Julià gave him the task of carrying the bell from the Milany castle hermitage, and Plafalgàs shouldered it and set off back to the village.

basis_claims.quote: Per tenir idea de les dimensions de la campana, només cal saber que va ser fosa i en van sortir les quatre que, abans de l'any 1936, hi havia al campanar de la parròquia.

statement.id: Lonceng itu begitu besar sehingga setelah dilebur menjadi empat lonceng yang tergantung di menara gereja sampai 1936.
statement.en: The bell was so big that, when melted down, it made the four bells that hung in the parish tower until 1936.

basis_claims.quote: Plafalgàs els va desafiar a que, si li omplien la campana amb set quarteres de gra i ho transportava tot fins a la vila, es quedaria el blat. Acceptada la juguesca, valent-se d'un buscall de faig va anar fins a Vallfogona amb la campana i el gra.

statement.id: Ditantang petani yang mengejeknya, Plafalgàs bertaruh bahwa bila lonceng itu diisi tujuh quartera gandum dan ia sanggup membawanya ke desa, gandum itu menjadi miliknya; dengan bantuan sebatang kayu beech ia membawa lonceng dan gandum itu ke Vallfogona.
statement.en: Teased by farmers, Plafalgàs bet that if they filled the bell with seven quarteres of grain and he carried it all to the village, the wheat would be his; leaning on a beech staff he carried bell and grain to Vallfogona.

the-dagda.depicted_variant: Large bearded man in hooded cloak with staff, cauldron and harp
visual_requirements: Large bearded human man
Hooded cloak
Physical wooden staff
Food-filled cauldron
Wooden stringed harp
the-dagda.aura: Wise paternal presence through calm expression, grounded posture and natural Irish landscape light.

basis_claims.quote: He is associated with fertility, agriculture, masculinity and strength, as well as magic, druidry and wisdom. He can control life and death (cf. his staff), the weather and crops, as well as time and the seasons. He is often described as a large bearded man or giant wearing a hooded cloak.

statement.id: Dagda terkait kesuburan, pertanian, kekuatan, sihir, kedruidan, kebijaksanaan; menguasai hidup-mati, cuaca, panen, waktu, musim; lelaki besar berjanggut atau raksasa berjubah berkerudung.
statement.en: The Dagda is tied to fertility, agriculture, strength, magic, druidry, wisdom; controls life and death, weather, crops, time, seasons; a big bearded man or giant in a hooded cloak.

basis_claims.quote: He owns a magic staff (lorc ) of dual nature: it kills with one end and brings to life with the other. He also owns a cauldron (the coire ansic) which never runs empty, and a magic harp

statement.id: Ia memiliki tongkat sakti (lorc) yang membunuh dan menghidupkan, kuali (coire ansic) yang tak pernah kosong, dan harpa sakti.
statement.en: He owns a magic staff (lorc) that kills and revives, a cauldron (coire ansic) never empty, and a magic harp.

basis_claims.quote: He is said to dwell in Brú na Bóinne (Newgrange).

statement.id: Ia dikatakan tinggal di Brú na Bóinne (Newgrange).
statement.en: He is said to dwell in Brú na Bóinne (Newgrange).

thetis-lake-monster.depicted_variant: Reported silver-scaled clawed amphibious humanoid, later admitted hoax
visual_requirements: Silvery scales, sharp hooked claws and head spikes
Large ear-like gills
Webbed hands and feet, two arms and two legs
thetis-lake-monster.aura: Presence through expression, posture, framing and natural scene light.

basis_claims.quote: The Thetis Lake Monster is a legendary creature and admitted hoax of Victoria, British Columbia, Canada. In 1972, two teenage boys claimed to see a monster emerge from Thetis Lake beach.

statement.id: Monster Danau Thetis (Thetis Lake Monster), makhluk legenda dan tipuan dari Victoria, British Columbia, Kanada (Canada), 1972; mirip Gill-man film Creature from the Black Lagoon (1954).
statement.en: Thetis Lake Monster, a legendary creature and hoax of Victoria, British Columbia, Canada, 1972; like the Gill-man of Creature from the Black Lagoon (1954).

basis_claims.quote: On 22 August 1972, the Victoria Daily Times reported that two local teen boys claimed to have seen a creature with "silvery scaled skin, sharp claws, and spikes on its head" while swimming at Thetis Lake beach in the evening.

statement.id: Victoria Daily Times, 22 Agustus (August) 1972: kulit sisik keperakan, cakar tajam, duri di kepala.
statement.en: Victoria Daily Times, 22 August 1972: silvery scaled skin, sharp claws, head spikes.

basis_claims.quote: Loxton discovered that the boys description of the scaly monster – which specified a sharply pointed head and large, ear-like gills — exactly matched that of the monster featured in the film Monster From The Surf

statement.id: Daniel Loxton: deskripsi sama dengan monster film Monster From The Surf di televisi setempat.
statement.en: Daniel Loxton: the description matched the monster of the film Monster From The Surf on local TV.

basis_claims.quote: Sillä väitetään olevan koukkukynnet, viiltävän terävät evät ja sekä kidukset että keuhkot. Hirviöllä sanotaan olevan myös räpylät käsissään ja jaloissaan

statement.id: Artikel fi: manusia kadal bercakar, bersirip tajam, berinsang dan berparu-paru, tangan dan kaki berselaput.
statement.en: fi article: a lizard-man with hooked claws, sharp fins, gills and lungs, webbed hands and feet.

basis_claims.quote: However, when writer Daniel Loxton contacted one of the individuals years later, he admitted they had fabricated the story to get attention.

statement.id: Saksi mengaku kepada Daniel Loxton bahwa cerita itu dikarang.
statement.en: A witness admitted to Daniel Loxton the story was fabricated.

nightmare.depicted_variant: Pale young woman spirit kneeling heavily upon a sleeper like a stone in an Estonian farmhouse chamber
visual_requirements: One female spirit kneeling upon a sleeping human in bed, weighing them down like stone
Pale, uncanny unearthly facial expression and hollow staring gaze
Fully modest historical linen night shift, no nudity
Rustic wooden bedroom interior with moonlight from window
No horns, wings, generic neon glow, or colored mist
nightmare.aura: Chilling sleep paralysis dread created through the heavy suffocating kneeling posture, pale unearthly gaze, deep cabin shadows, and cold natural moonlight.

basis_claims.quote: Luupainaja on eesti mütoloogias magajaid painav vaim.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Estonia, luupainaja adalah roh yang menindih orang yang sedang tidur.
statement.en: In Estonian mythology the luupainaja is a spirit that presses down on sleepers.

basis_claims.quote: Nimelt käivad tallajad öösiti oma ohvrit painamas. Nad rõhuvad oma ohvri keha, nii et too liigutada ei saa.

statement.id: Tallaja datang pada malam hari menindih korbannya, menekan tubuh korban sehingga ia tidak bisa bergerak.
statement.en: The tallajad come at night to press on their victim, weighing down the body so the victim cannot move.

basis_claims.quote: Enamikus juttudes on öeldud, et tallajad ilmutavad end noore naisena, kuid ei pelga ära ka vana naise ja vana mehena ilmumist. Samuti on loomadega – luupainajaid kirjeldatakse nii mustade kassidena, hobustena, koertena jne.

statement.id: Dalam kebanyakan cerita, tallaja menampakkan diri sebagai perempuan muda, tetapi juga sebagai perempuan tua atau lelaki tua; luupainaja juga digambarkan sebagai kucing hitam, kuda, anjing, dan sebagainya.
statement.en: In most tales the tallajad appear as a young woman, though also as an old woman or old man; luupainajad are also described as black cats, horses, dogs and so on.

basis_claims.quote: Luupainaja valib enesele mingisuguse isiku ohvriks ja hakkab seda kas igal ööl ehk mõne öö takka painamas käima, nagu kivi rinnul ehk kehal lasudes

statement.id: Menurut M. J. Eisen, luupainaja memilih seseorang sebagai korban dan datang menindihnya setiap malam atau selang beberapa malam, seperti batu yang menimpa dada atau tubuh.
statement.en: According to M. J. Eisen, the luupainaja chooses a person as its victim and comes to press on them every night or every few nights, lying like a stone on the chest or body.

nihang-mythology.depicted_variant: Golden-maned aquatic serpent dragon rising from an alpine mountain lake in the Hindu Kush
visual_requirements: One colossal aquatic serpent dragon with scaled serpentine body
Prominent flowing golden fur-like mane running along head and neck
Formidable predatory reptilian head and jaws
Alpine mountain lake setting with snow-dusted peaks
No people, weapons, gore, or generic glowing neon envelope
nihang-mythology.aura: Formidable predatory presence conveyed through towering serpent posture rising from cold glacial waters, wild golden mane, and rugged alpine mountain setting.

basis_claims.quote: Nihang are mythical water dragons from the Chitrali mythology in northwestern Pakistan.

statement.id: Nihang adalah naga air mitos (mythical water dragons) dalam mitologi Chitrali di Pakistan barat laut.
statement.en: Nihang are mythical water dragons from the Chitrali mythology in northwestern Pakistan.

basis_claims.quote: Perhaps a better term for these creatures would be winged serpents, also found in many parts of mainland Pakistan. These gigantic scaly creatures were known for their golden manes,

statement.id: Penulis menilai makhluk ini lebih tepat disebut ular bersayap (winged serpents); mereka raksasa bersisik yang dikenal karena surai emasnya (golden manes).
statement.en: The author suggests these creatures are better called winged serpents; they were gigantic scaly creatures known for their golden manes.

basis_claims.quote: the physical description of the dragon appears to be completely East Asian with the thick furlike mane, aquatic habitat, and a long slender serpent-like body, however, unlike the Eastern dragons, the Chitrali dragon appears to be a malevolent creature bent on keeping a reign of terror upon its vicinity.

statement.id: Wujud naga Chitrali tampak sepenuhnya Asia Timur (East Asian): surai tebal seperti bulu, habitat air, dan tubuh panjang ramping seperti ular; namun tidak seperti naga Timur, ia makhluk jahat (malevolent) yang meneror sekitarnya.
statement.en: The Chitrali dragon looks wholly East Asian, with a thick fur-like mane, aquatic habitat and long slender serpent-like body, but unlike Eastern dragons it is a malevolent creature that terrorizes its vicinity.

basis_claims.quote: The river which flows by Mastuj, once formed a large lake just below the town. It is said that an enormous dragon lived in the lake. He preyed upon all living things, ranging from fish to animals. With the passage of time, he began to attack humans.

statement.id: Sungai yang mengalir di dekat Mastuj dulu membentuk danau besar di bawah kota; konon seekor naga raksasa (enormous dragon) tinggal di sana, memangsa segala makhluk hidup dari ikan hingga hewan, lalu mulai menyerang manusia.
statement.en: The river by Mastuj once formed a large lake below the town; an enormous dragon is said to have lived there, preying on all living things from fish to animals, and later began to attack humans.

pferdegreif.depicted_variant: Winged hybrid with eagle forebody and wings, and horse hindquarters standing upon an alpine mountain ledge
visual_requirements: Front half of an eagle: raptor head, hooked beak, feathered breast, two large feathered wings, and taloned forelegs
Rear half of a horse: muscular equine hindquarters, hind legs with hooves, and horse tail
Seamless anatomical transition between plumage and equine hide
Riphaean mountain alpine ledge environment with open sky
No rider, harness, gear, or glowing neon envelope
pferdegreif.aura: Noble, wild, soaring chivalric aura conveyed through sharp raptor vigilance, outstretched wings, proud stance, and crisp high-altitude alpine daylight.

basis_claims.quote: Der Hippogryph (re-gräzisierte Form des italienischen ippogrifo, Zusammensetzung aus altgriechisch ἵππος hippos „Pferd“ und italienisch grifo „Greif“, dies aus lateinisch gryphus, dies wiederum aus altgriechisch γρύψ gryps) ist ein Fabelwesen im Sinne eines Mischwesens, das zur Hälfte Greif und zur anderen Hälfte Pferd ist.

statement.id: Hippogryph, dari ippogrifo (hippos, kuda/Pferd, dan grifo, griffin/Greif), adalah makhluk dongeng campuran (Mischwesen), separuh griffin dan separuh kuda.
statement.en: The hippogryph, from ippogrifo (hippos, horse/Pferd, and grifo, griffin/Greif), is a fabulous hybrid (Mischwesen), half griffin and half horse.

basis_claims.quote: The hippogriff (Italian: ippogrifo ) or hippogryph is a legendary creature with the front half of an eagle and the hind half of a horse.

statement.id: Hippogriff (Italia: ippogrifo, Italian) adalah makhluk legenda berbagian depan elang dan belakang kuda.
statement.en: The hippogriff (Italian: ippogrifo) is a legendary creature with an eagle's front half and a horse's hind half.

basis_claims.quote: For him a filly to griffin bore; Hight hippogryph. In wings and beak and crest, Formed like his sire, as in the feet before; But like the mare, his dam, in all the rest. Such on Riphaean hills, though rarely found,

statement.id: Syair Orlando furioso: anak kuda betina dari griffin, bernama hippogryph, bersayap dan berparuh seperti ayahnya, selebihnya seperti induknya; jarang ditemukan di pegunungan Riphaean (Riphaean hills).
statement.en: Orlando furioso verse: a filly bore him to a griffin, hight hippogryph, with wings and beak like his sire, the rest like the mare; rarely found on the Riphaean hills.

the-black-dog-of-newgate.depicted_variant: Monstrous black spectral mastiff hound stalking down a vaulted stone corridor of Newgate Prison
visual_requirements: One formidable monstrous black hound with muscular mastiff anatomy and jet-black coat
Menacing snarling expression and malevolent baleful stare
Vaulted stone corridor of medieval Newgate Prison with iron gates and chains
Atmospheric dim lighting from barred skylight and distant lantern
No human victims, gore, generic neon glow, or colored mist
the-black-dog-of-newgate.aura: Malevolent prison haunting dread conveyed through muscular predatory stalking stance, bared fangs, damp stone shadows, and grim historical gaol architecture.

basis_claims.quote: The Black Dog of Newgate is a legend concerning the haunting of the former Newgate Prison of London, which was located next to the Old Bailey

statement.id: Black Dog of Newgate adalah legenda tentang hantu di bekas Penjara Newgate, London, yang terletak di sebelah Old Bailey.
statement.en: The Black Dog of Newgate is a legend concerning the haunting of the former Newgate Prison of London, which stood next to the Old Bailey.

basis_claims.quote: is an example of the English Black Dog category of supernatural manifestations, featuring a spectral hound of ill-omen or malicious intent

statement.id: Kisah ini contoh kategori Black Dog Inggris, yang menampilkan anjing pemburu hantu pertanda buruk atau berniat jahat.
statement.en: The account is an example of the English Black Dog category of supernatural manifestations, featuring a spectral hound of ill omen or malicious intent.

basis_claims.quote: Shortly after this crime was committed, the inmates guilty of his death reportedly began seeing the spectre of a monstrous black dog walking up and down the Prison

statement.id: Tak lama setelah kejahatan itu, para narapidana yang bersalah konon mulai melihat sosok hantu anjing hitam raksasa berjalan hilir mudik di penjara.
statement.en: Shortly after the crime, the inmates guilty of his death reportedly began seeing the spectre of a monstrous black dog walking up and down the prison.

carsamba-kar-s.depicted_variant: Tangled-haired frightening hag haunting a village kitchen beside an unfinished spinning wheel at night
visual_requirements: One frightening, haggard female figure with weathered features and intense menacing gaze
Wild, untidy tangled grey hair cascading around shoulders
Fully modest, ragged patched traditional garments and fraying shawl
Rustic cottage kitchen setting with unfinished spinning wheel and tangled thread
Natural night illumination from a wall oil lamp and hearth; no glowing neon aura
carsamba-kar-s.aura: Threatening folklore dread built through intense scowling gaze, tangled wild hair, ragged attire, and nocturnal shadows in a silent rustic domestic interior.

basis_claims.quote: Azerbaycan'da ve Anadolu'nun kimi yörelerinde Çarşamba gecesi iş yapılırsa öfkelenen ve o eve kötülük getiren çirkin, kötü giysili, ürkütücü bir kadın olduğu söylenen

statement.en: In Azerbaijan (Azerbaycan) and some parts of Anadolu, Çarşamba Karısı is said to be an ugly, badly dressed, frightening woman (ürkütücü bir kadın) who grows angry and brings harm to the house (eve kötülük getiren) if work is done on Wednesday night (Çarşamba gecesi).

statement.en: The Shanhaijing (Nanshan jing) records a bird shaped like a chicken with a five-coloured pattern, named fenghuang (written 鳳皇); the pattern on its head is called de (virtue), on its wings yi, on its back li, on its breast ren, and on its belly xin.

basis_claims.quote: Over time, the connection to war and thus to death led to Wepwawet also being seen as one who opened the ways to, and through, Duat, for the spirits of the dead. Through this, Wepwawet became associated with Anubis, a deity that was worshiped in Asyut, eventually being considered his brother.

statement.id: Ia membuka jalan melalui Duat bagi roh orang mati.
statement.en: He opens ways through the Duat for spirits of the dead.

basis_claims.quote: In Egyptian art, Wepwawet was depicted as a black jackal, or as a man with the head of a jackal. In the temple of Seti I at Abydos, Wepwawet appears to have grey-colored fur, though this is likely due to loss of pigmentation, as elsewhere in the temple, black paint is almost entirely faded. In rare cases, he appears in fully human form.

statement.id: Ia dapat digambarkan sebagai jakal hitam atau laki-laki berkepala jakal.
statement.en: He may be depicted as a black jackal or jackal-headed man.

mazu.depicted_variant: One majestic Mazu in respectful HUMAN FEMALE deified Lin Moniang rendering, modest uninscribed flowing Fujian-inspired robes, no unsupported imperial crown, weapon or extra body features. Ordinary two arms/two legs, compassionate powerful gaze; low-angle portrait above an immense stormy sea. MIRACULOUS SEA PROTECTION is visualized as a calm clear passage between huge waves around a tiny distant traditional fishing boat with unidentifiable covered sailors, safe rather than shipwreck deaths. Gentle warm divine light around her hands is an artistic visualization of recorded miraculous protection, not an added power type; seawater remains water rather than energy beams. No modern film/design.
visual_requirements: Respectful woman-form sea goddess based on deified Lin Moniang (mazu-c01,mazu-c02)
Miraculous protection at sea expressed through a safe water passage around a small boat (mazu-c03,mazu-c07,mazu-c08)
mazu.aura: Miraculous maritime protection, towering waves and a calm boat passage.

basis_claims.quote: Mazu or Matsu is a sea goddess in Chinese folk religion, Chinese Buddhism, Confucianism, and Taoism. She is also known by several other names and titles. Mazu is the deified form of Lin Moniang (Chinese: 林默娘; pinyin: Lín Mòniáng; Pe̍h-ōe-jī: Lîm Be̍k-niû / Lîm Bia̍k-niû / Lîm Be̍k-niô͘), a shamaness from Fujian who is said to have lived in the late 10th century.

statement.id: Mazu adalah dewi laut dalam agama rakyat Tiongkok dan tradisi keagamaan terkait.
statement.en: Mazu is a sea goddess in Chinese folk religion and related religious traditions.

basis_claims.quote: Mazu is the deified form of Lin Moniang ... a shamaness from Fujian who is said to have lived in the late 10th century.

statement.id: Ia dipahami sebagai Lin Moniang yang didewakan, seorang perempuan dari Fujian.
statement.en: She is understood as the deified Lin Moniang, a woman from Fujian.

basis_claims.quote: Her worship spread throughout China's coastal regions and overseas Chinese communities throughout Southeast Asia, where some Mazu temples are affiliated with famous Taiwanese temples. Traditionally, Mazu was believed to roam the seas, safeguarding her devotees through miraculous interventions.

statement.id: Tradisi menggambarkannya melindungi pengikut yang berlayar melalui pertolongan ajaib.
statement.en: Tradition describes miraculous interventions protecting devotees at sea.

basis_claims.quote: As the most influential goddess of the sea in China, Mazu is at the centre of a host of beliefs and customs, including oral traditions, religious ceremonies and folk practices, throughout the country’s coastal areas.

statement.id: UNESCO menyebut Mazu sebagai dewi laut paling berpengaruh di Tiongkok, yang menjadi pusat berbagai kepercayaan dan adat, termasuk tradisi lisan, upacara keagamaan, dan praktik rakyat di kawasan pesisir negeri itu.
statement.en: UNESCO describes Mazu as the most influential goddess of the sea in China, at the centre of beliefs and customs including oral traditions, religious ceremonies and folk practices throughout the country's coastal areas.

basis_claims.quote: Mazu is believed to have lived in the tenth century on Meizhou Island, where she dedicated herself to helping her fellow townspeople, and died attempting to rescue the survivors of a shipwreck. Local residents built a temple in her honour and began to venerate her as a goddess.

statement.id: Menurut deskripsi UNESCO, Mazu dipercaya hidup pada abad kesepuluh di Pulau Meizhou, mengabdikan diri membantu sesama warga, dan wafat saat berusaha menyelamatkan korban kapal karam; warga setempat membangun kuil dan mulai memujanya sebagai dewi.
statement.en: According to UNESCO, Mazu is believed to have lived in the tenth century on Meizhou Island, dedicated herself to helping her fellow townspeople, and died attempting to rescue shipwreck survivors; local residents built a temple and began to venerate her as a goddess.

moloch.depicted_variant: One overwhelming BULL-HEADED IDOL with OUTSTRETCHED HANDS OVER EXTERNAL FIRE, specifically the documented MEDIEVAL DEPICTION of Moloch, not asserted ancient Canaanite archaeological reality. Single metal bull head with two natural horns, two humanoid idol arms and two coherent idol legs/seated base; hands extended palms above two external braziers. Monumental low viewpoint, glowing fire reflection on bronze and vast empty masonry sanctuary. No children, victims, sacrifice action, blood, gore, nudity or weapon. Flames remain external below hands, not unsupported emitted attacks. Uninscribed metal/stone, no writing. Terrifying idol presence.
visual_requirements: Bull-headed idol with outstretched hands over fire in medieval depiction (moloch-c04)
Traditionally named deity depicted with no victim or ritual harm (moloch-c01,moloch-c05)
moloch.aura: Strong external fire and bronze reflections under outstretched idol hands.

basis_claims.quote: Traditionally, the name Moloch has been understood as referring to a Canaanite god.

statement.id: Moloch secara tradisional ditafsirkan sebagai nama dewa Kanaan.
statement.en: Moloch is traditionally interpreted as the name of a Canaanite deity.

basis_claims.quote: scholars have speculated that Moloch refers to the sacrifice itself

statement.en: Scholars also propose that Moloch denotes a sacrifice rather than a deity.

basis_claims.quote: This second position has grown increasingly popular, but it remains contested.

statement.id: Penafsiran sebagai pengorbanan semakin populer tetapi tetap diperdebatkan.
statement.en: The sacrifice interpretation becomes more popular but remains disputed.

basis_claims.quote: Since the medieval period, Moloch has often been portrayed as a bull-headed idol with outstretched hands over a fire

statement.en: Medieval depictions often give Moloch a bull-headed idol form with hands extended over fire.

basis_claims.quote: The Bible strongly condemns practices that are associated with Moloch

statement.id: Alkitab mengecam praktik yang dihubungkan dengan Moloch.
statement.en: The Bible condemns practices associated with Moloch.

monthu.depicted_variant: One imposing Egyptian Monthu/Montu in the FALCON-HEADED MAN variant, fully modest plain linen ceremonial clothes, ordinary human two arms/two legs and single falcon head. Crown has exactly ONE SOLAR DISK, TWO LONG FEATHERS and ONE uraeus cobra emblem, all specified iconography. No extra wings, bull head or head-count blend. SCORCHING SOLAR RADIANCE erupts behind the crown disk like a powerful sun flare, illuminating a Theban desert landscape and very small temple walls: documented Montu-Ra scorching sun association. Majestic war-god stance, open hands without unsupported staff/sword, readable anatomy through the radiance. All surfaces uninscribed; no hieroglyphs/cuneiform. Respectful divine authority, no gore.
visual_requirements: Falcon-headed human form with solar disk, two feathers and single uraeus emblem (monthu-c05)
Conquering war vitality and scorching solar effect (monthu-c01,monthu-c03)
monthu.aura: Scorching solar radiance centered on the source-described disk.

basis_claims.quote: Montu was a falcon-war god in the ancient Egyptian religion, an embodiment of the conquering vitality of the pharaoh. He was particularly worshipped in Upper Egypt and in the district of Thebes.

statement.id: Monthu atau Montu adalah dewa perang elang Mesir, terutama dipuja di Mesir Hulu dan Thebes.
statement.en: Monthu or Montu is an Egyptian falcon war god, especially worshipped in Upper Egypt and Thebes.

basis_claims.quote: A very ancient god, Montu was originally a manifestation of the scorching effect of Ra, the sun – and as such often appeared under the epithet Montu-Ra. The destructiveness of this characteristic led to him gaining characteristics of a warrior, and eventually becoming a widely revered war-god.

statement.id: Ia terkait Ra sebagai Montu-Ra dan menghadapi musuh Maat.
statement.en: He is linked with Ra as Montu-Ra and confronts enemies of Maat.

basis_claims.quote: In Egyptian art, Montu was depicted as a falcon-headed or bull-headed man, with his head surmounted by the solar disk (because of his conceptual link with Ra) with either a double or singular uraeus, and two feathers. The falcon was a symbol of the sky and the bull was a symbol of strength and war.

statement.id: Seni menggambarkannya berkepala elang atau banteng dengan cakram matahari dan bulu.
statement.en: Art depicts him as falcon- or bull-headed with a solar disk and feathers.

morgan-le-fay.depicted_variant: One majestic MORGAN LE FAY in the EARLY HEALER OF AVALON variant: ordinary human woman with two arms/two legs, completely modest medieval gown and plain simple circlet (queen role), wise ambiguous resolute expression. Stand on the Isle of Apples with enormous apple-tree branches and sea-mist horizon, low-angle monumental presence. Visible gentle HEALING LIGHT from her hands falls toward a small distant fully clothed recovering male figure on a modest couch, allegory of Arthur taken to Avalon, no injury detail or gore. visual_requirements: Ordinary woman enchantress/healer in Avalon with queenly bearing (morgan-le-fay-c01,morgan-le-fay-c03,morgan-le-fay-c07)
Healing effect visualizes source-described great healer role (morgan-le-fay-c10,morgan-le-fay-c14)
morgan-le-fay.aura: Gentle powerful healing light in monumental Avalon scene.

basis_claims.quote: is a powerful and ambiguous enchantress from the legend of King Arthur, in which most often she and he are siblings. According to the different authors, she is a fairy or a human; beneficial or harmful; either a sister, half-sister, or unrelated to Arthur.

statement.id: Morgan le Fay adalah penyihir perempuan yang kuat dan ambigu dalam legenda King Arthur, peri atau manusia, baik atau jahat, saudari atau tak berkerabat dengan Arthur.
statement.en: Morgan le Fay is a powerful, ambiguous enchantress of the King Arthur legend, a fairy or human, good or harmful, Arthur's sister or no kin.

basis_claims.quote: The earliest documented account, by Geoffrey of Monmouth in Vita Merlini (written c. 1150) refers to Morgan in association with the Isle of Apples (Avalon), to which Arthur was carried after having been fatally wounded at the Battle of Camlann, as the leader of the nine magical sisters unrelated to Arthur.

statement.id: Vita Merlini karya Geoffrey of Monmouth (sekitar 1150) mengaitkan Morgan dengan Isle of Apples (Avalon), tempat Arthur dibawa setelah Battle of Camlann, sebagai pemimpin sembilan saudari sakti.
statement.en: Geoffrey of Monmouth's Vita Merlini (c. 1150) links Morgan to the Isle of Apples (Avalon), where Arthur was carried after the Battle of Camlann, as leader of nine magical sisters.

basis_claims.quote: Medieval and Renaissance tales feature continuations from the aftermath of Camlann where Morgan appears as the immortal queen of Avalon

statement.id: Kisah abad pertengahan dan Renaisans (Renaissance) sesudah Camlann menampilkan Morgan sebagai ratu Avalon yang abadi.
statement.en: Medieval and Renaissance tales after Camlann show Morgan as the immortal queen of Avalon.

basis_claims.quote: Von Geoffrey von Monmouth wird sie sowohl als Heilerin dargestellt wie auch als jemand, der sich in unterschiedliche Gestalten verwandeln konnte.

statement.id: Geoffrey (Geoffrey von Monmouth) menggambarkannya sebagai penyembuh (Heilerin) dan yang dapat berubah wujud (Gestalten verwandeln).
statement.en: Geoffrey of Monmouth (Geoffrey von Monmouth) portrays her as a healer (Heilerin) who could change shape (Gestalten verwandeln).

basis_claims.quote: Therein, and in the early chivalric romances by Chrétien de Troyes and others, Morgan's chief role is that of a great healer.

statement.id: Dalam Vita Merlini dan roman awal Chrétien de Troyes, peran utama Morgan adalah penyembuh agung (great healer).
statement.en: In Vita Merlini and Chrétien de Troyes's early romances Morgan's chief role is a great healer.

nun-q276563.depicted_variant: NUN represented ANICONICALLY as the primordial Egyptian WATERY ABYSS at creation, an immense dark-blue sea stretching below a tiny first MOUND OF LAND emerging from the waters. Low viewpoint near huge foreground waves, cosmic curved horizon and vast precreation cloud darkness. The first sun-like dawn light at distant mound references source emergence of the creator sun, but no humanoid gods, faces in water, frog head or dragon shape. Monumental cosmic water-scale is the documented deity presence. No text, glyphs, temple inscriptions, energy beams, fire or imagined body. Powerful awe and elemental watery depth, no deity merged with ordinary human nun.
visual_requirements: Primordial watery abyss/chaos expressed as cosmic water rather than invented body (nun-q276563-c01,nun-q276563-c02,nun-q276563-c06)
First land mound emerging from Nun waters (nun-q276563-c05)
nun-q276563.aura: Primordial oceanic scale and the first emerging land mound.

basis_claims.quote: in ancient Egyptian religion, is the personification of the primordial watery abyss which existed at the time of creation and from which the creator sun god Ra arose.

statement.id: Nun adalah personifikasi jurang air primordial dalam agama Mesir, tempat Ra muncul.
statement.en: Nun personifies the primordial watery abyss in Egyptian religion, from which Ra arises.

basis_claims.quote: Nun is one of the eight deities of the Ogdoad representing ancient Egyptian primordial Chaos from which the primordial mound arose. Nun can be seen as the first of all the gods and the creator of reality and personification of the cosmos. Nun is also considered the god that will destroy existence and return everything to the Nun whence it came. No cult was addressed to Nun.

statement.id: Ia anggota Ogdoad yang mewakili kekacauan sebelum penciptaan.
statement.en: He is an Ogdoad member representing chaos before creation.

basis_claims.quote: In ancient Egyptian creation accounts, the original mound of land comes forth from the waters of the Nun.

statement.id: Bukit pertama dunia muncul dari air Nun.
statement.en: The world’s first mound emerges from Nun’s waters.

basis_claims.quote:
NU was the "father of the gods," and progenitor of the "great company
  of the gods"; he was the primeval watery mass out of which all things
  came.

statement.id: Budge menyebut Nu sebagai ayah para dewa dan sumber air primordial semua hal.
statement.en: Budge calls Nu father of the gods and primordial watery source of all things.

rudra.depicted_variant: One majestic RUDRA, Rigvedic WIND/STORM ARCHER, respectfully rendered as an ordinary humanlike masculine figure in fully modest uninscribed South Asian ceremonial robes, two arms/two legs and one ordinary head. Hold a simple BOW and ONE ARROW (source archer/arrow attribute) in coherent hands. Monumental low viewpoint over small wooded ridges, POWERFUL WIND and turbulent storm clouds visibly bend branches and drive rain/mist; distant ordinary wildlife takes shelter. No lightning beam, trident, third eye, crescent moon, blue skin, snakes, extra arms or unsupported later Shiva imagery. Fierce storm authority with compassionate undertone; no gore.
visual_requirements: Rigvedic archer with a bow and arrow, ordinary humanlike rendering (rudra-c05)
Powerful wind/storm domain and wildlife association (rudra-c01,rudra-c06)
rudra.aura: Strong storm wind, bending branches and driving rain around the archer.

basis_claims.quote: is a Rigvedic deity associated with Shiva, the wind or storms, Vayu, medicine, and wildlife.

statement.en: Rudra is a Rigvedic deity associated with Shiva, wind or storms, medicine, and wildlife.

basis_claims.quote: The adjective śiva (shiva) in the sense of 'propitious' or 'kind' is first applied to the Rudra in RV 10.92.9.

statement.id: Kata shiva yang bermakna baik atau menguntungkan digunakan untuk Rudra dalam Rigveda 10.92.9.
statement.en: The word shiva meaning kind or propitious is applied to Rudra in Rigveda 10.92.9.

basis_claims.quote: Rudra is called 'the archer' (Sanskrit: Śarva) and the arrow is an essential attribute of Rudra.

statement.id: Nama Sharva dan atribut panah berkaitan dengan penggambarannya sebagai pemanah.
statement.en: The name Sharva and the arrow attribute connect with his depiction as archer.

basis_claims.quote:
Another wind or storm god is Rudra, also the father
of the Maruts, who are called “Rudras”.

statement.id: Mackenzie menjelaskan Rudra sebagai dewa angin atau badai dan ayah para Marut.
statement.en: Mackenzie describes Rudra as a wind or storm god and father of the Maruts.

tiamat.depicted_variant: TIAMAT represented ANICONICALLY as the COSMIC OCEAN: unimaginably vast dark salt-water swells arch around a small distant emerging cosmos, star-reflecting water and enormous foaming wave crests dominate the low foreground. Waters fill the frame with violent primordial power, cosmic scale and star-lit atmospheric contrast. NO DRAGON, serpent, humanoid woman, head, eyes, horns, wings or beast-shaped waves: scholarship in the accepted claims cautions dragon form cannot be established. Water/stellar imagery alone depicts the cosmic ocean and source role in forming the cosmos after defeat; no on-screen battle, dismemberment, victims, gore, extra gods, tablets with writing or invented elemental attack.
visual_requirements: Cosmic ocean expressed entirely as immense water (tiamat-c01,tiamat-c02)
Aniconic cosmic scale references cosmos formation without assuming disputed dragon form (tiamat-c04,tiamat-c05)
tiamat.aura: Overwhelming primordial oceanic swells and cosmic scale.

basis_claims.quote: Tiamat is the cosmic ocean that mates with Abzû, the groundwater

statement.id: Tiamat adalah samudra kosmis yang berpasangan dengan Abzu.
statement.en: Tiamat is a cosmic ocean paired with Abzu.

basis_claims.quote: Tiamat gives birth to the first generation of deities after mingling her waters with those of Abzû.

statement.id: Tiamat melahirkan generasi dewa pertama setelah mencampurkan airnya dengan Abzu.
statement.en: Tiamat bears the first divine generation after mingling her waters with Abzu.

basis_claims.quote: Marduk dismembers her and constructs the elements of the cosmos from the parts.

statement.id: Marduk memotong tubuh Tiamat dan membentuk unsur kosmos darinya.

statement.id: Pada jam kedua belas Amduat, Khepri mengemudikan bahtera matahari.

basis_claims.quote: Serapis or Sarapis is a Graeco-Egyptian god. A syncretic deity derived from the worship of the Egyptian gods Osiris and Apis, Serapis was extensively popularized in the third century BC on the orders of Greek Pharaoh Ptolemy I Soter, as a means to unify the Greek and Egyptian subjects of the Ptolemaic Kingdom.

statement.id: Serapis adalah dewa Yunani-Mesir yang memadukan Osiris dan Apis.
statement.en: Serapis is a Graeco-Egyptian god combining Osiris and Apis.

basis_claims.quote: Serapis was depicted as a Greek god in general appearance with Egyptian trappings, sometimes identified either as Pluto (Hades), Osiris, Dionysus, Amun, Zeus, Jupiter, Pan, Asclepius, and Dis Pater. The depictions of Serapis combined iconography from many Egyptian Greek cults, in most cases signifying the abundance and resurrection, namely, as the cornucopia horn and Calathus basket.

statement.id: Penggambarannya memadukan penampilan dewa Yunani dengan atribut Mesir.
statement.en: His depictions combine Greek divine appearance with Egyptian attributes.

basis_claims.quote: was shown enthroned with the modius, a basket/grain-measure, on his head ... with Cerberus, gatekeeper of the underworld, resting at his feet.

statement.en: The Alexandrian cult statue shows an enthroned figure with a grain measure on his head and Cerberus at his feet.

basis_claims.quote: Yama (Sanskrit: यम, lit. 'twin'), also known as Kāla and Dharmarāja, is the Hindu god of death and justice, responsible for the dispensation of law and punishment of sinners in his abode, Naraka. He is often identified with Dharmadeva, the personification of Dharma, though the two deities have different origins and myths.

statement.en: Yama is the Hindu god of death and justice associated with punishment in Naraka.

basis_claims.quote: Yama is described as the twin of the goddess Yami, and the son of the god Surya (sun) (in earlier traditions Vivasvat) and Sanjna. statement.id: Ia menilai jiwa dan menempatkannya menurut perbuatan ke alam leluhur, Naraka, atau kelahiran kembali.
statement.en: He judges souls and assigns them according to their deeds to the ancestors' realm, Naraka, or rebirth.

basis_claims.quote: Yama is one of the Lokapalas (guardians of the realms), appointed as the protector of the south direction. He is often depicted as a dark-complexioned man riding a buffalo and carrying a noose or mace to capture souls.

statement.id: Ia sering digambarkan berkulit gelap dan menunggang kerbau.
statement.en: He is often depicted with dark skin and riding a buffalo.

basis_claims.quote: Yama is one of the Lokapalas (guardians of the realms), appointed as the protector of the south direction. He is often depicted as a dark-complexioned man riding a buffalo and carrying a noose or mace to capture souls.

statement.en: A noose or mace is equipment for capturing souls in his depictions.

basis_claims.quote: Yama is also known by many other names, including Kala ('time'), Pashi (one who carries a noose') and Dharmaraja ('lord of Dharma').

statement.id: Pashi adalah sebutan yang bermakna pembawa jerat.

statement.en: Devi and Deva are explained as referring to the divine, exalted, and shining.

basis_claims.quote: Devi is the supreme being in the Shakta tradition of Hinduism; in the Smarta tradition, she is one of the five primary forms of Brahman that is revered. In other Hindu traditions, Devi embodies the active energy and power of Deva, and they always appear together complementing each other.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi Shakta Devi adalah sosok tertinggi; tradisi Smarta memasukkannya dalam lima bentuk utama Brahman.
statement.en: In Shakta tradition Devi is supreme; Smarta tradition includes her among five primary forms of Brahman.

basis_claims.quote: Devi-inspired philosophy is propounded in many Hindu texts such as the Devi Upanishad, which teaches that Shakti is essentially Brahman (ultimate metaphysical Reality) and that from her arises prakṛti (matter) and purusha (consciousness) and that she is bliss and non-bliss, the Vedas and what is different from it, the born and the unborn and all of the universe.

statement.id: Devi Upanishad mengajarkan Shakti sebagai Brahman serta asal materi dan kesadaran.
statement.en: The Devi Upanishad teaches Shakti as Brahman and the origin of matter and consciousness.

basis_claims.quote: Devi asserts that she is the creator of earth and heaven and resides there. ... She is, states Devi, the eternal and infinite consciousness engulfing earth and heaven, and 'all forms of bliss and non-bliss, knowledge and ignorance, Brahman and Non-Brahman'.

statement.id: Dalam Devi Upanishad, Devi menyatakan dirinya pencipta bumi dan langit serta kesadaran tak terbatas.
statement.en: In the Devi Upanishad, Devi declares herself creator of earth and heaven and infinite consciousness.

basis_claims.quote: Devi's character has two opposing sides represented by various separate female deities: as Uma, the benevolent, and as Durga, the terrible.

statement.id: WHE menjelaskan sisi Uma yang ramah dan sisi Durga yang menakutkan sebagai penggambaran Devi berbeda.
statement.en: WHE explains benevolent Uma and fearsome Durga as different depictions of Devi.

deva-hinduism.depicted_variant: Representative generic benevolent male deva, no named-deity attributes.
visual_requirements: Generic male divine being — c01/c02.
Shining/heavenly nature — c03.
Benevolent role — c05; no assigned specific named-deity mount or weapon.
deva-hinduism.aura: Sacred radiance and heavenly setting grounded in shining/heavenly etymology c03.

basis_claims.quote: Deva (Sanskrit: देव, Sanskrit pronunciation: [de:ʋɐ]) means 'god', 'shiny', 'exalted', 'heavenly being', 'divine being', 'anything of excellence', and is also one of the Sanskrit terms used to indicate a deity in Hinduism. Deva is a masculine term; the feminine equivalent is Devi. The word is a cognate with Latin deus ('god') and Greek Zeus.

statement.id: Deva adalah istilah Sanskerta untuk dewa atau makhluk ilahi dalam agama Hindu.
statement.en: Deva is a Sanskrit term for a god or divine being in Hinduism.

basis_claims.quote: Deva (Sanskrit: देव, Sanskrit pronunciation: [de:ʋɐ]) means 'god', 'shiny', 'exalted', 'heavenly being', 'divine being', 'anything of excellence', and is also one of the Sanskrit terms used to indicate a deity in Hinduism. Deva is a masculine term; the feminine equivalent is Devi. The word is a cognate with Latin deus ('god') and Greek Zeus.

statement.id: Deva bersifat maskulin, dengan bentuk feminin Devi.
statement.en: Deva is masculine, with the feminine form Devi.

basis_claims.quote: Deva (Sanskrit: देव, Sanskrit pronunciation: [de:ʋɐ]) means 'god', 'shiny', 'exalted', 'heavenly being', 'divine being', 'anything of excellence', and is also one of the Sanskrit terms used to indicate a deity in Hinduism. Deva is a masculine term; the feminine equivalent is Devi. The word is a cognate with Latin deus ('god') and Greek Zeus.

statement.id: Maknanya mencakup bersinar, luhur, dan makhluk surgawi.
statement.en: Its meanings include shining, exalted, and heavenly being.

basis_claims.quote: In the earliest Vedic literature, all supernatural beings are called Devas and Asuras. The concepts and legends evolved in ancient Indian literature, and by the late Vedic period, benevolent supernatural beings are referred to as Deva-Asuras. In post-Vedic Hindu texts, such as the Puranas and the Itihasas of Hinduism, the Devas represent the good, and the Asuras the bad.

statement.id: Dalam teks pasca-Weda, deva mewakili kebaikan dan asura keburukan.
statement.en: In post Vedic texts, devas represent good and asuras evil.

basis_claims.quote: Devas, along with Asuras, Yakshas (nature spirits), and Rakshasas (ghoulish ogres/demons), are part of Indian mythology, and Devas feature in many cosmological theories in Hinduism.

statement.id: Deva termasuk dalam teori kosmologi Hindu bersama kelompok makhluk lain.
statement.en: Devas occur in Hindu cosmological theories alongside other classes of beings.

basis_claims.quote: Some devas represent the forces of nature and some represent moral values (such as the Adityas, Varuna, and Mitra), each symbolizing the epitome of a specialized knowledge, creative energy, exalted and magical powers (Siddhis).

statement.id: Sebagian deva mewakili kekuatan alam, sebagian nilai moral seperti Varuna dan Mitra.
statement.en: Some devas represent natural forces and others moral values, such as Varuna and Mitra.

dragon.depicted_variant: Chinese four-legged horned wingless rain-dragon of the Lung-Wang tradition

visual_requirements.description: One lithe serpentine dragon with one head, two natural eyes, four clearly separate clawed legs, horns, carp scales, ox ears, camel forehead, eagle claws and tiger-like paw pads; no wings.
Heavy rain and atmospheric lightning accompany the dragon's flight over water.
Water source and cloud habitat; majestic benevolent presence.

dragon.aura: Majestic rain-bringing power, conveyed by documented weather effects; no detached magical aura.

basis_claims.quote: Dragon-like creatures appear in ancient Mesopotamian art, where they could be hostile or benevolent. In East Asia, dragons were usually regarded as positive beings; Chinese dragons were thought to govern the rain, the sea, and other forms of water, and from the Han dynasty onwards they were emblems of imperial power.

statement.id: Makhluk mirip naga muncul dalam seni Mesopotamia kuno; di Asia Timur naga umumnya makhluk baik, naga Tiongkok menguasai hujan, laut, dan air, dan sejak dinasti Han menjadi lambang kekuasaan kaisar.
statement.en: Dragon-like creatures appear in ancient Mesopotamian art; in East Asia dragons were usually positive, Chinese dragons governed rain, sea and water, and from the Han dynasty were imperial emblems.

basis_claims.quote: One of the earliest creatures to appear in the tales and legends of ancient China, the dragon is most often depicted as a giant and lithe beast which dwells in either water sources or clouds. The Chinese dragon is extraordinarily powerful, and when it flies, it is usually accompanied by lightning and thunder.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, naga Tiongkok paling sering digambarkan sebagai makhluk raksasa yang lentur dan berdiam di sumber air atau awan; ia amat kuat, dan bila terbang biasanya disertai kilat dan guntur.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the Chinese dragon is most often depicted as a giant, lithe beast dwelling in water sources or clouds; it is extraordinarily powerful and, when it flies, is usually accompanied by lightning and thunder.

basis_claims.quote: The traditional description gives it the horns of a stag, the forehead of a camel, the eyes of a demon, the neck of a snake, the belly of a sea-monster, the scales of a carp, the claws of an eagle, the pads of a tiger, and the ears of an ox.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, deskripsi tradisional naga Tiongkok memberinya tanduk rusa jantan, dahi unta, mata iblis, leher ular, perut makhluk laut, sisik ikan mas, cakar elang, telapak harimau, dan telinga sapi.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, the traditional description of the Chinese dragon gives it the horns of a stag, forehead of a camel, eyes of a demon, neck of a snake, belly of a sea-monster, scales of a carp, claws of an eagle, pads of a tiger and ears of an ox.

basis_claims.quote: Despite the dragon's fearsome aspect, it was not usually seen as the bad-intentioned monster that inhabits the myths of other cultures around the world where it is typically slain by a brave hero figure. Indeed, in China, the dragon was and is regarded as being a just and benevolent creature.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, meski tampak menakutkan, naga di Tiongkok umumnya tidak dipandang sebagai monster jahat seperti dalam mitos budaya lain yang biasanya menampilkannya dibunuh pahlawan, melainkan makhluk yang adil dan baik hati.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, despite its fearsome aspect the dragon in China was not usually seen as the bad-intentioned monster of other cultures' myths, where it is typically slain by a hero, but as a just and benevolent creature.

basis_claims.quote: Further, ancient farmers thought dragons brought much-needed rains and water to aid their crops. Dragons were also thought responsible for strong winds, hailstorms, thunder, lightning, and tornadoes

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, petani kuno menganggap naga membawa hujan dan air bagi tanaman mereka, dan naga juga dianggap bertanggung jawab atas angin kencang, hujan es, guntur, kilat, dan angin puyuh.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, ancient farmers thought dragons brought the rain and water their crops needed, and dragons were also held responsible for strong winds, hailstorms, thunder, lightning and tornadoes.

basis_claims.quote: In folk-tales, there was a race of dragons led by their Dragon-king Lung-Wang. With scaly bodies, four legs, and horns they could take on human form and whisk away young girls. They are similar to Nagas, the snake-like creatures of Hindu folklore which protect water sources.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia (dalam artikel tentang naga di Tiongkok kuno), dalam cerita rakyat ada ras naga yang dipimpin Raja Naga Lung-Wang; mereka bertubuh bersisik, berkaki empat, dan bertanduk, dapat menjelma manusia dan menculik gadis, dan mirip Naga, makhluk menyerupai ular dalam cerita rakyat Hindu yang menjaga sumber air.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia (in its article on the dragon in ancient China), folk-tales tell of a race of dragons led by their Dragon-king Lung-Wang; they have scaly bodies, four legs and horns, could take human form and whisk away young girls, and are similar to the Nagas, the snake-like creatures of Hindu folklore that protect water sources.

artistic_changes: Chinese variant selected because its exact four-leg count is explicit in c16; Western fire and wings deliberately excluded.
Scale colour, low-angle perspective, river-valley layout and cinematic light are editorial choices, not literal source claims.

presentation_revision.rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.

athena.depicted_variant: Living Athena the stately armored defender above the Athenian Acropolis and coast, with a documented sea storm behind her.

visual_requirements.description: Stately human woman, one head, two arms/two legs and two eyes; long opaque robe, crested helm, shield and spear.
Snake-trimmed aegis with sculptural non-gory Gorgon face ornament.
Acropolis temple, olive tree and natural owl, her documented setting and symbols.
Wind-driven rain clouds and rough sea illustrate her documented sea-storm action.

athena.aura: Claim-grounded sea storm (athena-c25) with dark clouds, rain and rough coastal waves. Golden shafts of sunlight are ordinary cinematic lighting, not magical lightning or power beams.

basis_claims.quote: Athena was regarded as the patron and protectress of various cities across Greece, particularly the city of Athens, from which she most likely received her name. Her major symbols include owls, olive trees, snakes, and the gorgoneion. In art, she is generally depicted wearing a helmet and holding a spear.

statement.id: Athena dianggap pelindung berbagai kota Yunani, terutama Athena, asal namanya; lambangnya burung hantu, pohon zaitun, ular, dan gorgoneion, dan ia digambarkan berhelm dan memegang tombak.
statement.en: Athena was patron of many Greek cities, especially Athens, source of her name; her symbols are owls, olive trees, snakes and the gorgoneion, and she is shown helmeted with a spear.

basis_claims.quote: The Parthenon on the Athenian Acropolis is dedicated to her, along with numerous other temples and monuments.

statement.id: Parthenon di Akropolis Athena dipersembahkan kepada Athena, bersama banyak kuil dan monumen lainnya.
statement.en: The Parthenon on the Athenian Acropolis is dedicated to her, along with numerous other temples and monuments.

basis_claims.quote: was the Olympian goddess of wisdom and good counsel, war, the defence of towns, heroic endeavour, weaving, pottery and various other crafts. She was depicted as a stately woman armed with a shield and spear, and wearing a long robe, crested helm, and the famed aigis

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Athena adalah dewi Olimpus kebijaksanaan dan nasihat yang baik, perang, pertahanan kota, usaha kepahlawanan, menenun, tembikar, dan berbagai kerajinan lain; ia digambarkan sebagai perempuan agung bersenjata perisai dan tombak, berjubah panjang, berhelm berjambul, dan beraigis.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Athena was the Olympian goddess of wisdom and good counsel, war, the defence of towns, heroic endeavour, weaving, pottery and various other crafts, depicted as a stately woman armed with shield and spear, in a long robe and crested helm, and wearing the aigis.

basis_claims.quote: She was known as Polias and Poliouchos (both derived from polis, meaning "city-state"), and her temples were usually located atop the fortified acropolis in the central part of the city.

statement.id: Athena dikenal sebagai Polias dan Poliouchos (keduanya dari polis, "negara-kota"), dan kuil-kuilnya biasanya terletak di atas akropolis berbenteng di pusat kota.
statement.en: She was known as Polias and Poliouchos (both from polis, "city-state"), and her temples were usually located atop the fortified acropolis in the centre of the city.

basis_claims.quote: The Trojan War where she sided with the Greeks in battle, but attacked their ships with a storm when they failed to punish Oilean Aias (Ajax) for violating her Trojan shrine.

statement.id: Dalam Perang Troya, menurut theoi.com, Athena berpihak kepada bangsa Yunani, tetapi menyerang kapal-kapal mereka dengan badai ketika mereka tidak menghukum Aias dari Lokris yang melanggar kuilnya di Troya.
statement.en: In the Trojan War, according to theoi.com, she sided with the Greeks but attacked their ships with a storm when they failed to punish Oilean Aias (Ajax) for violating her Trojan shrine.

basis_claims.quote: the famed aigis--a snake-trimmed cape adorned with the monstrous visage of the Gorgon Medousa (Medusa)

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, aigis Athena adalah jubah berhias ular yang dihiasi wajah mengerikan Gorgon Medousa (Medusa).
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Athena's aigis is a snake-trimmed cape adorned with the monstrous visage of the Gorgon Medousa (Medusa).

basis_claims.quote: Objects associated with the goddess include an owl - symbol of wisdom - and the olive tree. She is often depicted in art with armour, a golden helmet, a shield, and holding a spear.
basis_claims.locator: What Objects Are Associated with Athena?

statement.id: Benda yang dikaitkan dengan Athena mencakup burung hantu, lambang kebijaksanaan, dan pohon zaitun; dalam seni ia sering digambarkan berzirah, berhelm emas, berperisai, dan memegang tombak.
statement.en: Objects associated with the goddess include an owl, symbol of wisdom, and the olive tree; in art she is often shown with armour, a golden helmet, a shield and a spear.

basis_claims.quote: Her armour is the aegis made, in some accounts, from the skin of a Giant, hung with tassels of gold, and featuring the head of the Gorgon given to her by Perseus.
basis_claims.locator: What Objects Are Associated with Athena?

statement.id: Zirah Athena adalah aigis yang menurut sebagian riwayat dibuat dari kulit seorang Raksasa, berumbai emas, dan bergambar kepala Gorgon yang diberikan Perseus kepadanya.
statement.en: Her armour is the aegis, made in some accounts from the skin of a Giant, hung with golden tassels and featuring the head of the Gorgon given to her by Perseus.

basis_claims.quote: Both Homer and Hesiod refer to Athena as 'bright-eyed' and 'Tritogeneia'.

statement.id: Baik Homer maupun Hesiod menyebut Athena "bermata cerah" dan "Tritogeneia".
statement.en: Both Homer and Hesiod refer to Athena as "bright-eyed" and "Tritogeneia".

artistic_changes: Selected stately long-robed shield-and-spear Athena iconography; not Medusa-transformation, birth, or modern statue variant.
Original mythic tableau combines accepted Athenian setting/symbols with documented storm ability; not a literal depiction of the Trojan-ship episode.
Low view, monumental scale, exact armor decoration and warm light opening are artistic interpretation.
Gorgon face is a sculpted medallion, avoiding gore or severed flesh.
No modern_depictions used.

presentation_revision.rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.

brahma-q11389.depicted_variant: Golden four-headed, four-armed bearded Brahma on lotus, in the split cosmic golden egg cosmogony.

visual_requirements.description: Exactly four cardinal heads, four arms, golden bearded complexion; no weapons; symbols of knowledge and creation.
Lotus seat above primordial waters.
Sun-bright golden egg divides into two halves forming heaven and earth with waters.

brahma-q11389.aura: Sun-bright golden egg creation radiance grounded in c42/c43, not weapon energy.

basis_claims.quote: is a Hindu god, referred to as "the Creator" within the Trimurti, the trinity of supreme divinity that includes Vishnu and Shiva. He is associated with creation of everything, knowledge, and the Vedas. Brahma is prominently mentioned in creation legends. In some Puranas, he created himself in a golden embryo known as the Hiranyagarbha.

statement.id: Brahma (ब्रह्मा) adalah dewa Hindu yang disebut Sang Pencipta dalam Trimurti bersama Wisnu dan Siwa, dikaitkan dengan penciptaan, pengetahuan, dan Weda; menurut beberapa Purana ia menciptakan dirinya dalam janin emas Hiranyagarbha.
statement.en: Brahma (ब्रह्मा) is a Hindu god called the Creator in the Trimurti with Vishnu and Shiva, associated with creation, knowledge and the Vedas; some Puranas say he created himself in the golden embryo Hiranyagarbha.

basis_claims.quote: Brahma is commonly depicted as a red or golden-complexioned bearded man with four heads and hands. His four heads represent the four Vedas and are pointed to the four cardinal directions. He is seated on a lotus and his vahana (mount) is a hamsa

statement.id: Brahma digambarkan sebagai laki-laki berjanggut berkulit merah atau keemasan dengan empat kepala dan tangan; kepalanya melambangkan empat Weda dan menghadap empat arah; ia duduk di atas teratai dan kendaraannya hamsa.
statement.en: Brahma is shown as a bearded red or golden man with four heads and hands; the heads represent the four Vedas and face the four directions; he sits on a lotus and rides a hamsa.

basis_claims.quote: Brahma is traditionally depicted with four faces and four arms. Each face of his points to a cardinal direction. His hands hold no weapons, rather symbols of knowledge and creation.

statement.id: Brahma secara tradisional digambarkan berwajah empat dan berlengan empat; setiap wajahnya menghadap satu arah mata angin, dan tangannya tidak memegang senjata melainkan lambang pengetahuan dan penciptaan.
