statement.en: There are guardian spirits of trees, mountains, land, houses, villages, towns, the country and roads; some overlap, e.g. Min Mahagiri, leader of the 37 and protector of the household.

basis_claims.quote: Nat Spirits who are deceased humans still in limbo between lives, stuck in their regret or bitterness. THESE are the predominant Pantheon of 37, called “Nat Sein” – those who died a violent death

statement.id: Nat yang merupakan manusia yang telah meninggal dan masih terjebak di antara kehidupan disebut nat sein, yaitu mereka yang mati secara kejam; merekalah sebagian besar jajaran 37.
statement.en: Nats who are deceased humans still in limbo between lives are called nat sein, those who died a violent death; they make up most of the 37.

oyamatsumi.depicted_variant: Respectful elderly humanlike Ōyamatsumi mountain kami in historical robe iconography above mountain shrine.

visual_requirements.description: ŌYAMATSUMI, respectful JAPANESE MOUNTAIN KAMI (c01,c04,c05), humanlike elderly masculine presentation based on inspected historical Shinbutsu-zue icon: long solemn beard, simple tall traditional court/ritual hat, enormous draped opaque old Japanese robes with wide sleeves. One head two arms two legs, NO rock skin, horns, wings or animal attributes. Foreground imposing upright figure framed against great layered Japanese mountain peaks and small shrine torii below (c01,c04), deeply commanding calm gaze and wind-moved robe silhouette provide mountain-deity presence, not an ordinary contemporary hiker. A distant natural sea visible between mountain valleys may reflect documented Toba shrine mountain/sea domain c06. Natural slanting dawn through cloud, no emitted magic, cosmic aura, elemental attack, conflation with fire birth as fire power, sword or invented fixed anatomy.

oyamatsumi.aura: Respectful elderly humanlike Ōyamatsumi mountain kami in historical robe iconography above mountain shrine.

basis_claims.quote: The term yamatsumi means a spirit dwelling within a mountain, with the result that the name Ōyamatsumi means a great deity with jurisdiction over mountains.

statement.id: Nama Ōyamatsumi mengacu pada dewa yang menguasai pegunungan.
statement.en: The name Ōyamatsumi refers to a great deity over mountains.

basis_claims.quote: Shrines to kami with this name can be found throughout Japan.

statement.id: Kuil untuk kami bernama Ōyamatsumi tersebar di Jepang.
statement.en: Shrines to kami with this name are found throughout Japan.

basis_claims.quote: In Japanese folk religion, the kami of any given mountain is sometimes called Ōyamatsumi, as is the spirit of someone who has died within the mountains; in many cases, cairns of stones are erected as a place of worship.

statement.id: Dalam kepercayaan rakyat Jepang, nama itu dapat menunjuk kami suatu gunung atau roh orang yang meninggal di pegunungan.
statement.en: In Japanese folk religion, the name can mean a mountain kami or the spirit of someone who died in the mountains.

basis_claims.quote: this shrine to Oyamazumi, the kami (Shinto deity) of mountains and seas, was located on the hilltop where construction was taking place.

statement.id: Kuil di Toba memuja Oyamazumi sebagai dewa gunung dan laut.
statement.en: The Toba shrine worships Oyamazumi as a deity of mountains and seas.

tenjin.depicted_variant: Tenjin as dignified deified court scholar with closed scroll at shrine under restrained distant thunder.

visual_requirements.description: TENJIN, respectful Japanese deified scholar SUGAWARA NO MICHIZANE (c01,c04), one living spirit with elderly scholarly face, short beard, exactly one head two arms two legs. Opaque historic Japanese court scholar robe with broad sleeves and traditional court cap inspired by inspected Sengai icon; no modern scholar clothes, war armour or weapons. Holds a plain CLOSED UNLETTERED SCROLL as editorial symbol of scholarship c04. Upright imposing guardian of learning before a small Kitano-style shrine gateway (c08), strong wise calm gaze and sweeping robe in natural wind create revered kami presence, not ordinary everyday male portrait. A few distant storm clouds with ONE faint far-off LIGHTNING FLASH express the documented thunder-deity combination c06, restrained background only; no beams from hands or eyes. Natural cool storm-break daylight, original dignified composition.

tenjin.aura: Tenjin as dignified deified court scholar with closed scroll at shrine under restrained distant thunder.

basis_claims.quote: Originally meant "Heavenly God," but later came to refer exclusively to the spirit of courtier-scholar Sugawara Michizane (845-903).

statement.id: Tenjin semula berarti dewa langit tetapi kemudian merujuk pada roh Sugawara no Michizane.
statement.en: Tenjin originally meant heavenly god but later referred to Sugawara Michizane’s spirit.

basis_claims.quote: He is revered as the patron saint of scholarship at such shrines as the Dazaifu Tenmangû in Fukuoka Prefecture and Kitano Tenjin shrines throughout Japan.

statement.id: Tenjin dihormati sebagai pelindung ilmu pengetahuan di kuil-kuil Jepang.
statement.en: Tenjin is revered as a patron of scholarship at shrines across Japan.

basis_claims.quote: The kami Tenman Daijizai Tenjin is a combination of the tenjin "thunder deity" (raijin) who rules the weather, Michizane's "vengeful spirit" (goryō ), a Chinese deity for whom oxen were killed and offered, the esoteric Buddhist (Mikkyō) "Dharma protector deity" (gohōjin), and the mythological Amatsukami (Tenjin).

statement.id: Sosok Tenjin memadukan roh Michizane dengan dewa guntur dan unsur keagamaan lain.
statement.en: The figure of Tenjin combines Michizane’s spirit with a thunder deity and other religious elements.

basis_claims.quote: This shrine was dedicated to noted scholar and poet Sugawara-no-Michizane (posthumously named Tenjin) in 947. It was revered by the court and the shogunate and spawned many branch shrines along with temple schools throughout the country.

statement.id: Kitano Tenmangū didedikasikan kepada Michizane pada 947 dan memunculkan kuil cabang.
statement.en: Kitano Tenmangū was dedicated to Michizane in 947 and gave rise to branch shrines.

poseidon.depicted_variant: Mature dark-haired bearded human Poseidon commanding a stormy sea and striking coastal rock with his three-pronged trident.

visual_requirements.description: One-headed mature bearded dark-haired human deity, two arms/two legs and two eyes; no fish tail.
Three-pronged trident, one coherent hand holding it and other hand empty.
Gathering storm clouds, violent sea waves and spray.
Trident striking ground with fractured coastal rock and fragments, illustrating earthquake/rock-shattering ability.

poseidon.aura: Source-grounded sea storm and waves (poseidon-c06,c17) plus trident-struck fractured stone (c15,c35). Natural cloud-opening sunlight; no lightning or magical energy.

basis_claims.quote: POSEIDON was the Olympian god of the sea, earthquakes, floods, drought and horses. He was depicted as a mature man with a sturdy build and dark beard holding a trident

statement.id: Theoi menyebut Poseidon dewa laut, gempa, banjir, kekeringan, dan kuda, digambarkan sebagai pria dewasa berjanggut dengan trisula.
statement.en: Theoi describes Poseidon as god of the sea, earthquakes, floods, drought, and horses, shown as a bearded mature man with a trident.

basis_claims.quote: Poseidon was the Greek god of the sea and rivers, creator of storms and floods, and the bringer of earthquakes and destruction.

statement.id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut Poseidon dewa laut dan sungai, pembuat badai dan banjir, serta pembawa gempa.
statement.en: World History Encyclopedia calls Poseidon god of seas and rivers, creator of storms and floods, and bringer of earthquakes.

basis_claims.quote: Poseidon's most distinctive attribute was the trident, a three-pronged fishing spear. He sometimes also wielded a boulder encrusted with sea creatures

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, atribut Poseidon yang paling khas adalah trisula, tombak ikan bermata tiga; kadang ia juga memegang batu karang yang dipenuhi makhluk laut.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon's most distinctive attribute was the trident, a three-pronged fishing spear; he sometimes also wielded a boulder encrusted with sea creatures.

basis_claims.quote: The symbol of Poseidon's power was the trident, or a spear with three points, with which he used to shatter rocks, to call forth or subdue storms, to shake the earth, and the like.

statement.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, lambang kekuasaan Poseidon adalah trisula, yang ia pakai untuk memecahkan batu karang, memanggil atau menenangkan badai, mengguncang bumi, dan sebagainya.
statement.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, the symbol of Poseidon's power was the trident, with which he used to shatter rocks, call forth or subdue storms, shake the earth, and the like.

basis_claims.quote: Being the ruler of the sea (the Mediterranean), he is described as gathering clouds and calling forth storms, but at the same he has it in his power to grant a successful voyage and save those who are in danger, and all other marine divinities are subject to him.

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa sebagai penguasa laut, Poseidon digambarkan mengumpulkan awan dan memanggil badai, tetapi juga mampu memberi pelayaran yang berhasil dan menyelamatkan orang yang dalam bahaya, dan semua dewa laut lain tunduk kepadanya.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says that, as ruler of the sea, Poseidon is described as gathering clouds and calling forth storms, but also as able to grant a successful voyage and save those in danger, and all other marine divinities are subject to him.

basis_claims.quote: Poseidon is most often described by both Homer and Hesiod as 'deep sounding Earth-shaker', the 'dark-haired one' and 'encircler of the earth.'

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Homeros dan Hesiodos paling sering menyebut Poseidon sebagai 'Penggoyang Bumi yang bergemuruh', 'si berambut gelap', dan 'pelingkar bumi'.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Homer and Hesiod most often describe Poseidon as 'deep sounding Earth-shaker', the 'dark-haired one' and 'encircler of the earth'.

basis_claims.quote: Poseidon is most commonly depicted in ancient Greek art as mature and bearded. He often brandishes his trident, fashioned by the Cyclopes, with which he would create earthquakes by striking it to the ground.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Yunani kuno Poseidon paling sering digambarkan dewasa dan berjanggut, sering mengacungkan trisula buatan para Kiklops yang ia pakai menciptakan gempa dengan menghantamkannya ke tanah.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in ancient Greek art Poseidon is most commonly depicted as mature and bearded, often brandishing his trident, fashioned by the Cyclopes, with which he would create earthquakes by striking it to the ground.

basis_claims.quote: Is it thus in good sooth, O Earth-Enfolder, thou dark-haired god, that I am to bear to Zeus this message, unyielding and harsh

statement.id: Dalam Iliad 15 (terjemahan Murray), Iris menyapa Poseidon sebagai "Pemeluk Bumi, dewa berambut gelap".
statement.en: In Iliad 15 (Murray translation), Iris addresses Poseidon as "O Earth-Enfolder, thou dark-haired god".

artemis.depicted_variant: Unwinged classical maiden huntress Artemis drawing her golden bow above shadowy forested hills and windy peaks, with quiver and deer.

visual_requirements.description: Familiar young adult maiden huntress with bow and quiver, one head/two arms/two legs, excluding early winged and Ephesian variants.
Golden bow physically drawn for the hunt, not a magical arrow beam; documented extraordinary huntress and mistress of wild animals.
Forests, shadowy hills and windy mountain peaks; one natural deer as sacred animal.

artemis.aura: No emitted supernatural aura. Natural dawn light and wind express grandeur; moon effects excluded because accepted claims do not establish them.

basis_claims.quote: She was often said to roam the forests and mountains, attended by an entourage of nymphs.

statement.id: Artemis sering dikisahkan berkeliaran di hutan dan gunung bersama para nimfa.
statement.en: Artemis was said to roam forests and mountains with nymphs.

basis_claims.quote: In ancient art Artemis was usually depicted as a girl or young maiden with a hunting bow and quiver of arrows.

statement.id: Dalam seni kuno Artemis lazim digambarkan sebagai gadis atau perempuan muda dengan busur dan tabung anak panah.
statement.en: Ancient art commonly shows Artemis as a girl or young woman with a hunting bow and quiver.

basis_claims.quote: Artemis' most distinctive attributes were her bow and arrows but she was also sometimes equipped with a quiver, pair of hunting spears, torch, lyre, and/or water-jug.

statement.id: Atribut Artemis yang paling khas adalah busur dan anak panah; ia kadang juga dilengkapi tabung panah, sepasang tombak berburu, obor, lira, dan/atau kendi air.
statement.en: Artemis' most distinctive attributes were her bow and arrows; she was also sometimes equipped with a quiver, a pair of hunting spears, a torch, a lyre, and/or a water-jug.

basis_claims.quote: Artemis' sacred animal was the deer. She drove a chariot drawn by a pair of the beasts and was often depicted holding or hunting a deer or with a deer-skin cape draped over her shoulders.

statement.id: Hewan suci Artemis adalah rusa; ia mengendarai kereta yang ditarik sepasang rusa dan sering digambarkan memegang atau memburu rusa atau berjubah kulit rusa.
statement.en: Artemis' sacred animal was the deer; she drove a chariot drawn by a pair of deer and was often shown holding or hunting a deer or wearing a deer-skin cape.

basis_claims.quote: Over the shadowy hills and windy peaks she draws her golden bow, rejoicing in the chase, and sends out grievous shafts.
basis_claims.locator: Classical Literature Quotes, Homeric Hymn 27 to Artemis (trans. Evelyn-White)

statement.id: Himne Homerik 27 melukiskan Artemis menarik busur emasnya di bukit berbayang dan puncak berangin, bersuka dalam perburuan, dan melepaskan anak panah yang menyakitkan.
statement.en: Homeric Hymn 27 describes Artemis drawing her golden bow over shadowy hills and windy peaks, rejoicing in the chase, and sending out grievous shafts.

basis_claims.quote: Artemis is most frequently portrayed in ancient Greek art as a beautiful maiden huntress with quiver and bow or, alternatively, a spear.
basis_claims.locator: How is Artemis Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani kuno Artemis paling sering digambarkan sebagai gadis pemburu yang cantik dengan tabung panah dan busur, atau sebagai alternatif dengan tombak.
statement.en: In ancient Greek art Artemis is most frequently portrayed as a beautiful maiden huntress with quiver and bow or, alternatively, a spear.

basis_claims.quote: The goddess Artemis has special powers which include being an extraordinary huntress and the mistress of all wild animals.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kekuatan khusus Artemis mencakup menjadi pemburu luar biasa dan penguasa semua hewan liar.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Artemis's special powers include being an extraordinary huntress and the mistress of all wild animals.

hera.depicted_variant: Dignified crowned and veiled Hera on a golden throne with lotus-tipped royal sceptre and pomegranate beneath the starry sky

visual_requirements.description: One noble adult woman, crowned and bridal-veiled, fully clothed, seated on a golden throne, holding lotus-tipped sceptre and pomegranate.
Star-filled sky expresses her sky/stars domain without invented lightning or energy beams.
Greek sanctuary setting recalling Argos/Mycenae and golden throne iconography.

hera.aura: Royal majesty conveyed by golden throne and documented starry-sky domain; warm cinematic light is editorial, no invented emitted magic.

basis_claims.quote: is the goddess of marriage, women, and family, and the protector of women during childbirth. In Greek mythology, she is queen among the twelve Olympians on Mount Olympus, sister and wife of Zeus

statement.id: Hera adalah dewi perkawinan, perempuan, dan keluarga Yunani kuno serta ratu Olimpus, saudari dan istri Zeus.
statement.en: Hera is the ancient Greek goddess of marriage, women, and family, queen of the Olympians, and Zeus's sister and wife.

basis_claims.quote: Her iconography usually presents her as a dignified, matronly figure, upright or enthroned, crowned with a polos or diadem, sometimes veiled as a married woman.

statement.id: Hera biasanya digambarkan sebagai perempuan berwibawa yang berdiri atau bertakhta, dengan mahkota.
statement.en: Hera is usually shown as a dignified woman standing or enthroned, crowned.

basis_claims.quote: HERA was the Olympian queen of the gods, and the goddess of marriage, women, the sky and the stars of heaven.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Hera adalah ratu dewa Olimpus dan dewi perkawinan, perempuan, langit, serta bintang.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Hera is queen of the Olympians and goddess of marriage, women, the sky, and stars.

basis_claims.quote: She was usually depicted as a beautiful woman wearing a crown and holding a royal, lotus-tipped sceptre, and sometimes accompanied by a lion, cuckoo or hawk.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Hera biasanya digambarkan sebagai perempuan cantik bermahkota yang memegang tongkat kerajaan berujung teratai, kadang disertai singa, burung kukuk, atau elang.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Hera was usually depicted as a beautiful woman wearing a crown and holding a royal, lotus-tipped sceptre, sometimes accompanied by a lion, cuckoo or hawk.

basis_claims.quote: Her most celebrated sanctuary was situated between Argos and Mycenae, at the foot of Mount Euboea.

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa tempat suci Hera yang paling termasyhur terletak di antara Argos dan Mycenae, di kaki Gunung Euboea.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says Hera's most celebrated sanctuary was situated between Argos and Mycenae, at the foot of Mount Euboea.

basis_claims.quote: I sing of golden-throned Hera whom Rhea bare. Queen of the Immortals is she, surpassing all in beauty: she is the sister and wife of loud-thundering Zeus

statement.id: Himne Homerik 12 (terjemahan Evelyn-White) menyanyikan Hera yang bertakhta emas, yang dilahirkan Rhea, ratu para makhluk abadi, melampaui semua dalam keindahan, saudari dan istri Zeus yang menggelegar.
statement.en: Homeric Hymn 12 (Evelyn-White translation) sings of golden-throned Hera whom Rhea bare, queen of the Immortals, surpassing all in beauty, sister and wife of loud-thundering Zeus.

basis_claims.quote: She is most often seated on a throne and sometimes wears a crown (polos), holds a royal sceptre, and wears a bridal veil. On occasion she is also depicted holding a pomegranate, a traditional symbol of fertility.
basis_claims.locator: How was Hera Represented in Art?

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Hera paling sering duduk di singgasana, kadang bermahkota (polos), memegang tongkat kerajaan, dan bercadar pengantin; kadang ia memegang delima, lambang kesuburan.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in art Hera is most often seated on a throne, sometimes wearing a crown (polos), holding a royal sceptre, and wearing a bridal veil; on occasion she holds a pomegranate, a traditional symbol of fertility.

gabriel.depicted_variant: Jewish Gabriel in the form of a linen-clothed man with wings, flying as divine messenger and prince of fire.

visual_requirements.description: Human male form with opaque linen garment; one head, two arms, two legs and two natural eyes.
Wings accompany human form, one visible pair as editorial arrangement; not Islamic six-hundred-wing variant.
Swift airborne posture expresses documented flight.
Strong physical flame plumes behind figure express documented Jewish prince-of-fire association.
Earth below descending messenger, original evening rocky landscape.

gabriel.aura: Large golden-orange physical flames visualize prince of fire (gabriel-c13); airborne winged pose visualizes wings/flight (c14,c19). Light is firelight, no arbitrary lightning or energy.

basis_claims.quote: Michael and Gabriel often work together ... while Michael, as the guardian angel of Israel and high priest of heaven, is more occupied in heaven, Gabriel is the messenger of God, who executes God's will on earth.

statement.id: Menurut Jewish Encyclopedia, Michael dan Gabriel sering bekerja sama; Michael lebih banyak berada di surga, sedangkan Gabriel adalah utusan Tuhan yang menjalankan kehendak Tuhan di bumi.
statement.en: According to the Jewish Encyclopedia, Michael and Gabriel often work together; Michael is more occupied in heaven, while Gabriel is God's messenger who executes God's will on earth.

basis_claims.quote: Gabriel has the form of a man (Dan. viii. 15, ix. 21), and is, according to the Talmud, the "man clothed with linen" mentioned in Ezek. ix. 3 and x. 2 (Yoma 77a).

statement.id: Menurut Jewish Encyclopedia, Gabriel berwujud manusia, dan menurut Talmud ia adalah "orang berpakaian lenan" yang disebut dalam Yehezkiel.
statement.en: According to the Jewish Encyclopedia, Gabriel has the form of a man and, according to the Talmud, is the "man clothed with linen" mentioned in Ezekiel.

basis_claims.quote: Michael is snow, Gabriel is fire ... As prince of fire Gabriel is also prince of the ripening of fruits

statement.id: Jewish Encyclopedia mencatat bahwa Michael adalah salju dan Gabriel adalah api; sebagai pangeran api, Gabriel juga pangeran pematangan buah.
statement.en: The Jewish Encyclopedia records that Michael is snow and Gabriel is fire; as prince of fire, Gabriel is also prince of the ripening of fruits.

basis_claims.quote: He has wings, like all the angels, but while Michael reaches the earth in one flight, Gabriel requires two

statement.id: Menurut Jewish Encyclopedia, Gabriel bersayap seperti semua malaikat; Michael sampai ke bumi dalam satu kali terbang, sedangkan Gabriel memerlukan dua kali.
statement.en: According to the Jewish Encyclopedia, Gabriel has wings like all the angels; Michael reaches the earth in one flight, Gabriel requires two.

basis_claims.quote: Yea, whiles I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan King James, Daniel 9:21 menyebut Gabriel, yang pernah dilihat Daniel dalam penglihatan, "terbang dengan cepat" dan menyentuh Daniel sekitar waktu persembahan petang.
statement.en: In the King James translation, Daniel 9:21 says the man Gabriel, whom Daniel had seen in the vision, was caused to fly swiftly and touched Daniel about the time of the evening oblation.

satan.depicted_variant: Satan in medieval Christian art iconography: horned humanoid with hairy legs, cloven hooves and tail, fully clothed and without wings or emitted fire.

visual_requirements.description: Single humanoid in historical Christian art appearance with horns, unusually hairy lower legs, cloven hooves and one tail; no wings or dragon anatomy.
Wilderness relates to the Christian temptation setting; gesture expresses temptation without depicting another religious figure.

satan.aura: No supernatural emitted aura or fire. Menace comes from camera, landscape scale and natural cinematic light.

basis_claims.quote: Satan, also known as the Devil, is an entity in Abrahamic religions who entices humans into sin or falsehood.

statement.id: Satan, juga dikenal sebagai Devil, adalah sosok dalam agama Abrahamik yang menggoda manusia menuju dosa atau kepalsuan.
statement.en: Satan, also known as the Devil, is an Abrahamic figure who tempts humans toward sin or falsehood.

basis_claims.quote: THEN was Jesus led up of the spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan King James, Matius 4:1 menyatakan bahwa Yesus dibawa oleh Roh ke padang gurun untuk dicobai oleh Iblis.
statement.en: In the King James translation, Matthew 4:1 says Jesus was led up of the spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.

basis_claims.quote: Satan's appearance is never described in the Bible, but, since the ninth century, he has often been shown in Christian art with horns, cloven hooves, unusually hairy legs, and a tail

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, rupa Satan tidak pernah dijelaskan dalam Alkitab, tetapi sejak abad kesembilan ia sering digambarkan dalam seni Kristen dengan tanduk, kuku belah, kaki yang sangat berbulu, dan ekor.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Satan's appearance is never described in the Bible, but since the ninth century he has often been shown in Christian art with horns, cloven hooves, unusually hairy legs, and a tail.

venus.depicted_variant: Fully clothed Venus as the protective mother of Rome, with evening-star emblem and a tapering altar flame recalling the favourable Pygmalion omen

visual_requirements.description: One beautiful adult goddess with natural human anatomy in fully opaque garments; modest respectful portrayal of love/fertility goddess.
One tapering altar flame represents the favourable flame omen, and one bright evening star signifies Venus's celestial guiding form; no invented spell beam.
Monumental Roman sanctuary setting presents Venus as protective mother of Roman state, with distant ships recalling Aeneas's guidance.

venus.aura: Protective maternal majesty, evening-star identity and the documented altar-flame omen, expressed in a symbolic composition.

basis_claims.quote: is a Roman goddess whose functions encompass love, beauty, desire, sex, fertility, prosperity, and victory.

statement.id: Venus adalah dewi Romawi yang dihubungkan dengan cinta, kecantikan, hasrat, seksualitas, kesuburan, kemakmuran, dan kemenangan.
statement.en: Venus is a Roman goddess associated with love, beauty, desire, sex, fertility, prosperity, and victory.

basis_claims.quote: In Roman mythology, she was the ancestor of the Roman people through her son, Aeneas, who survived the fall of Troy and fled to Italy.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Romawi, Venus disebut leluhur bangsa Romawi melalui putranya Aeneas.
statement.en: In Roman myth, Venus is the ancestor of the Roman people through her son Aeneas.

basis_claims.quote: The Trojan Aeneas, according to Virgil's Aeneid, was fated to found Rome guided by his divine mother Venus.

statement.id: Menurut Aeneid karya Virgil, Aeneas dari Troya ditakdirkan mendirikan Roma dengan dibimbing ibunya yang ilahi, Venus.
statement.en: According to Virgil's Aeneid, the Trojan Aeneas was fated to found Rome guided by his divine mother Venus.

basis_claims.quote: Pompey (who dedicated, in 55 BCE, a temple to Venus Victrix - Venus of Victory), Julius Caesar (who claimed favor with Venus Victrix and Venus Genetrix), and Hadrian (who, in 139 CE, dedicated a temple to Venus and Roma Aeterna - Eternal Rome - making Venus the protective mother of the Roman state).

statement.id: Pompeius mendedikasikan pada 55 SM sebuah kuil bagi Venus Victrix (Venus Sang Pemenang), Julius Caesar mengklaim restu Venus Victrix dan Venus Genetrix, dan Hadrianus pada 139 M mendedikasikan kuil bagi Venus dan Roma Aeterna sehingga Venus menjadi ibu pelindung negara Romawi.
statement.en: Pompey dedicated a temple to Venus Victrix (Venus of Victory) in 55 BCE, Julius Caesar claimed favor with Venus Victrix and Venus Genetrix, and Hadrian in 139 CE dedicated a temple to Venus and Roma Aeterna, making Venus the protective mother of the Roman state.

basis_claims.quote: In Virgil's Aeneid, the Trojan hero Aeneas is led to Latium by his mother in her celestial form: the evening star.

statement.id: Dalam Aeneid karya Virgil, Aeneas dituntun ke Latium oleh ibunya dalam wujud langit, yaitu bintang senja.
statement.en: In Virgil's Aeneid, Aeneas is led to Latium by his mother in her celestial form, the evening star.

basis_claims.quote: The golden Venus, as she herself was present at her own festival, understood what that prayer meant; and as an omen of the Divinity being favourable, thrice was the flame kindled up, and it sent up a tapering flame into the air.

statement.id: Dalam Metamorphoses Ovidius, Venus hadir pada festivalnya sendiri dan memahami arti doa Pygmalion; sebagai tanda restu, nyala api menyala tiga kali dan memancarkan lidah api yang runcing ke udara.
statement.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses, Venus, present at her own festival, understood the meaning of Pygmalion's prayer; as a favourable omen the flame was kindled three times and sent a tapering flame into the air.

seshat.depicted_variant: Seven-pointed-emblem woman in leopard-skin mantle and opaque linen, actively stretching the measuring cord at foundation blocks.

visual_requirements.description: Female depiction with exactly seven-pointed head emblem and leopard-skin dress/mantle over opaque robe, from exact c05 quote.
Active stretching-the-cord ritual; no source-supported emitted power is present.
Builder/foundation ritual environment, limestone blocks editorial interpretation rather than a specific claimed temple.

seshat.aura: Authority of Lady of Builders (seshat-c04) through forceful foreground cord ritual (seshat-c03), seven-pointed emblem and leopard mantle (seshat-c05); natural lighting, no emitted powers.

basis_claims.quote: She was the goddess of writing, books, notations, and measurements.

statement.id: Seshat adalah dewi buku, catatan, dan pengukuran dalam sumber pendamping.
statement.en: Seshat is the goddess of books, notations and measurements in the accompanying source.

basis_claims.quote: she was shown conducting the "stretching the cord" ritual with Khasekhemwy.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan membantu Khasekhemwy dalam ritual merentangkan tali.
statement.en: She is depicted helping Khasekhemwy in the stretching-the-cord ritual.

basis_claims.quote: In the Pyramid Texts, she is identified as an aspect of Nephthys and is invoked as the 'Lady of Builders.'

statement.id: Teks Piramida memanggilnya Nyonya Para Pembangun.
statement.en: The Pyramid Texts call her Lady of Builders.

basis_claims.quote: In ancient Egyptian art, she was depicted as a woman with a seven-pointed emblem above her head or extending from a headband. This emblem was the origin of an alternate name for Seshat, Sefkhet-Abwy, which may be translated as "seven-horned". She was frequently shown in a leopard-skin or dress, sometimes with a robe layered under a skin.

statement.id: Seni memperlihatkan lambang berujung tujuh di atas kepalanya.
statement.en: Art shows a seven-pointed emblem above her head.

maat.depicted_variant: Wingless feather-bearing young Maat delivering judgment through a foreground bronze balance.

visual_requirements.description: Young human woman wearing one ostrich feather; wingless selected alternative, fully opaque linen editorial clothing.
Large balance with feather and opaque symbolic heart vessel.
Ordered stars behind her representing regulation of stars, no new attack.
Duat judgment space.

maat.aura: Inevitable judgment through the huge scales and ordered stars (maat-c06/c07/c02), no luminous body aura.

basis_claims.quote: is the ancient Egyptian concept of truth, balance, law, morality, and justice. ... Maat was also the goddess who personified this concept

statement.id: Maat adalah dewi Mesir yang mempersonifikasikan kebenaran, keteraturan, dan keadilan.
statement.en: Maat is an Egyptian goddess personifying truth, order and justice.

basis_claims.quote: regulated the stars, seasons, and the actions of mortals and the deities who had brought order from chaos at the moment of creation.

statement.id: Ia mengatur bintang, musim, dan tindakan manusia serta dewa.
statement.en: She regulates stars, seasons and the actions of mortals and gods.

basis_claims.quote: her primary role in ancient Egyptian religion dealt with the Weighing of the Heart that took place in the Duat.

statement.id: Maat berperan dalam penimbangan hati di Duat.
statement.en: Maat plays a role in weighing the heart in the Duat.

basis_claims.quote: Her feather was the measure that determined whether the souls (considered to reside in the heart) of the departed would reach the paradise of the afterlife successfully.

statement.id: Bulunya menentukan kelayakan jiwa mencapai akhirat yang bahagia.
statement.en: Her feather measures whether a soul may reach the blessed afterlife.

basis_claims.quote: Maat was the goddess of harmony, justice, and truth represented as a young woman. Sometimes she is depicted with wings on each arm or as a woman with an ostrich feather on her head. The meaning of this emblem is uncertain, although the god Shu, who in some myths is Maat's brother, also wears it.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai perempuan muda, kadang bersayap atau memakai bulu burung unta.
statement.en: She is depicted as a young woman, sometimes winged or wearing an ostrich feather.

serket.depicted_variant: Woman with scorpion, ankh and was-sceptre physically containing Apep at the underworld path bend.

visual_requirements.description: Woman with scorpion on head, ankh in one hand and was-sceptre in the other, opaque clothing.
Physical containment of the snake deity Apep, explicitly documented in exact quote c05; no invented emitted spell.
Underworld pathway bend and canopic vessels reflect guardian and funerary roles.

serket.aura: Formidable containment of serpent Apep and path guarding (serket-c05), clear scorpion/ankh/was-sceptre (serket-c02) and funerary role (serket-c04); natural brazier lighting rather than emitted spells.

basis_claims.quote: Serket is often depicted as a woman whose head is surmounted by a scorpion ... an ankh in one hand, and a was-sceptre in her other.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan dengan kalajengking di kepala, ankh, dan tongkat was.
statement.en: She is shown with a scorpion on her head, an ankh and a was-sceptre.

basis_claims.quote: During the Old Kingdom she held a protective role around the throne of the king. However, her primary role was with the funerary cult. She was said to be the protector of the tents of embalmers and is one of the tutelary goddesses depicted on the canopic chest which contains four canopic jars.

statement.id: Ia melindungi tempat pembalseman dan Qebehsenuef penjaga bejana kanopik.
statement.en: She protects embalming tents and Qebehsenuef, a guardian of canopic jars.

basis_claims.quote: During the Middle Kingdom, Egyptian myth says that Serket's help is required in the Underworld where according to the Book of the Two Ways she guards a twist in the pathway. She is also given credit for binding and containing the snake deity, Apophis (or Apep).

statement.id: Kitab Dua Jalan menempatkannya sebagai penjaga belokan jalan dunia bawah.
statement.en: The Book of Two Ways makes her guardian of a bend in the underworld path.

wadjet.depicted_variant: Source-backed cobra form, rearing defensively from Nile Delta papyrus water.

visual_requirements.description: One living cobra as Wadjet's directly documented cobra form, no female human body or invented crown.

Nile Delta papyrus swamps from Horus protection and papyrus planting accounts.

wadjet.aura: Cobra protective form (wadjet-c04) dominates through close water-level framing and physically disturbed water in documented Nile Delta habitat (wadjet-c05/c06), without emitted magic.

basis_claims.quote: The name Wadjet is derived from the term for the symbol of her domain, Lower Egypt, the papyrus. statement.en: Her name derives from the term for papyrus as a symbol of Lower Egypt.

basis_claims.quote: Wadjet was said to be the matron and protector of Lower Egypt in her cobra form, and upon unification with her sister Nekhbet, Goddess of Upper Egypt, the joint protector and patron of all of Egypt. statement.id: Bersama Nekhbet ia menjadi pelindung seluruh Mesir.
statement.en: With Nekhbet she becomes a protector of all Egypt.

basis_claims.quote: In another myth, Wadjet was said to be the nurse of the infant god Horus. With the help of his mother Isis, they protected Horus from his treacherous uncle, Set, when they took refuge in the swamps of the Nile Delta.

statement.id: Satu mitos menjadikannya pengasuh Horus yang membantu Isis melindunginya.
statement.en: One myth makes her Horus’s nurse, helping Isis protect him.

basis_claims.quote: She planted the first papyrus plants, laid out the papyrus fields in the swamps of the Nile Delta, and helped Isis raise Horus there

statement.id: Sumber ini mengisahkan Wadjet menanam papirus pertama dan membantu Isis membesarkan Horus.
statement.en: This source tells of Wadjet planting the first papyrus and helping Isis raise Horus.

karna.depicted_variant: Human epic warrior charging into Kurukshetra combat with two conspicuous golden earrings, no supernatural attack.

statement.en: He fights on the Kaurava side and is ultimately killed by Arjuna.

statement.id: Menurut penjelasan David Slavitt, nama masa kecilnya Vasusena dan nama Karna dikaitkan dengan anting emas Surya.
statement.en: According to David Slavitt's explanation, his childhood name is Vasusena and the name Karna is linked to Surya's golden earrings.

basis_claims.quote:
As Sati, Shiva's wife is the ideal of a true and virtuous
Hindu woman. When Sati's husband was slighted by
her father, the Deva-rishi, Daksha, she cast herself on
the sacrificial fire. Widows who died on the funeral
pyres of their husbands were called Sati[184], because in performing
this rite they imitated the faithful goddess.

basis_claims.quote: Ovid, Metamorphoses 15. 385 ff (trans. Melville) ... builds a nest high on a lofty swaying palm; and lines the nest with cassia and spikenard and golden myrrh and shreds of cinnamon

statement.id: Dalam uraian Ovidius, phoenix membangun sarang di puncak pohon palem, melapisinya dengan kasia, narwastu, mur, dan serpihan kayu manis, lalu mengakhiri hidupnya di sana.
statement.en: In Ovid's account the phoenix builds a nest high on a palm, lines it with cassia, spikenard, myrrh and cinnamon, and ends its life there.

basis_claims.quote: Associated with the Sun, a phoenix obtains new life by rising from the ashes of its predecessor.

statement.id: Anubis dimohon untuk melindungi orang mati dan digambarkan dalam penimbangan hati.

statement.id: Seperti terlihat dari berbagai gelarnya, Anubis berperan sentral dalam setiap aspek pengalaman kematian seseorang sebagai pelindung, dan bahkan mendampingi jiwa setelah mati sebagai hakim yang adil dan pemandu.
statement.en: As his various epithets make clear, Anubis was central to every aspect of an individual's death experience as protector, and even stood with the soul after death as a just judge and guide.

basis_claims.quote: She is associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction, and wars; her legends center around combating evils and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.

statement.en: She is associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction and war; her legends center on combating evil and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.

statement.id: Durga secara tradisional memegang senjata berbagai dewa laki-laki yang mereka berikan agar ia melawan kejahatan karena mereka memandangnya sebagai shakti (energi, daya); di antaranya cakra, kerang, busur, anak panah, pedang, lembing, trisula, perisai, gada, bunga teratai merah muda, dan jerat.
statement.en: Durga traditionally holds the weapons of various male gods, given to her to fight evil because they regard her as shakti (energy, power); these include the discus, conch, bow, arrow, sword, javelin, trident, shield, mace, pink lotus and noose.

statement.en: In Archaic and Classical Greek art Hermes is shown holding the kerykeion or caduceus staff (signifying his role as herald), wearing winged sandals (symbolic of his role as messenger), a long tunic or leopard skin, sometimes a winged cap (petasos), and occasionally a lyre.

basis_claims.quote: Hermes' most distinctive attribute was the herald's wand (Greek kerykeion, Latin caduceus) but he was sometimes armed instead with a short sword.

statement.id: Atribut Hermes yang paling khas adalah tongkat juru warta (kerykeion dalam bahasa Yunani, caduceus dalam bahasa Latin), tetapi kadang ia dipersenjatai pedang pendek.
statement.en: Hermes' most distinctive attribute was the herald's wand (Greek kerykeion, Latin caduceus), though he was sometimes armed with a short sword instead.

statement.id: Horus Muda adalah pelindung kerajaan Mesir, pembalas kezaliman, pembela ketertiban, pemersatu dua negeri, dan dewa perang yang diseru para penguasa Mesir sebelum pertempuran.
statement.en: Horus the Younger was protector of Egypt's royalty, avenger of wrongs, defender of order, uniter of the two lands, and a war god invoked by Egyptian rulers before battle.

basis_claims.quote: Set is then banished to the desert lands beyond Egypt's borders while Horus assumes the throne of his father with his mother and aunt Nephthys as consorts.

statement.id: Dalam versi pertama, Set diusir ke gurun di luar perbatasan Mesir, sementara Horus naik takhta ayahnya dengan ibunya dan bibinya, Nephthys, sebagai permaisuri.
statement.en: In the first version Set is banished to the deserts beyond Egypt's borders while Horus takes his father's throne with his mother and aunt Nephthys as consorts.

basis_claims.quote: Having conquered Set and restored order, Horus became known as Horu-Sema-Tawy, The Horus, Uniter of the Two Lands.

statement.id: Setelah menaklukkan Set dan memulihkan ketertiban, Horus dikenal sebagai Horu-Sema-Tawy, Horus Pemersatu Dua Negeri.
statement.en: Having conquered Set and restored order, Horus became known as Horu-Sema-Tawy, the Horus who unites the Two Lands.

basis_claims.quote: In Greek mythology, the Titan Prometheus had a reputation as being something of a clever trickster and he famously gave the human race the gift of fire and the skill of metalwork, an action for which he was punished by Zeus, who ensured everyday that an eagle ate the liver of the Titan as he was helplessly chained to a rock.

statement.id: Prometheus adalah Titan dalam mitologi Yunani yang memberi manusia api lalu dihukum Zeus.
statement.en: Prometheus is a Greek Titan who gave humanity fire and was punished by Zeus.

basis_claims.quote: Feeling sorry for man's weak and naked state, Prometheus raided the workshop of Hephaistos and Athena on Mt. Olympus and stole fire, and by hiding it in a hollow fennel-stalk, he gave the valuable gift to man which would help him in life's struggle.

statement.id: Karena iba pada keadaan manusia yang lemah dan telanjang, Prometheus menyusup ke bengkel Hephaistos dan Athena di Gunung Olympus, mencuri api, menyembunyikannya dalam batang adas berongga, lalu memberikannya kepada manusia.
statement.en: Feeling sorry for humanity's weak and naked state, Prometheus raided the workshop of Hephaistos and Athena on Mount Olympus, stole fire, hid it in a hollow fennel stalk, and gave it to humans.

basis_claims.quote: Prometheus first appears in Greek art in a 7th century BCE ivory from Sparta and on Greek pottery from c. 600 BCE, usually being punished.

statement.id: Prometheus pertama kali muncul dalam seni Yunani pada gading abad ke-7 SM dari Sparta dan pada tembikar Yunani sekitar 600 SM, biasanya sedang dihukum.
statement.en: Prometheus first appears in Greek art on a 7th-century BCE ivory from Sparta and on Greek pottery from about 600 BCE, usually being punished.

basis_claims.quote: Prometheus himself is an immortal god, the friend of the human race, the giver of fire, the inventor of the useful arts, an omniscient seer, an heroic sufferer, who is overcome by the superior power of Zeus, but will not bend his inflexible mind.

statement.id: Dalam uraian ensiklopedia di Theoi tentang Aeschylus, Prometheus adalah dewa abadi, sahabat umat manusia, pemberi api, penemu seni yang berguna, peramal serba tahu, dan penderita yang gagah, yang dikalahkan kekuatan Zeus tetapi tidak mau menekuk pikirannya.
statement.en: In the encyclopedia entry on Theoi describing Aeschylus, Prometheus is an immortal god, friend of humankind, giver of fire, inventor of the useful arts, an omniscient seer, and an heroic sufferer overcome by Zeus's power but unbending in mind.

basis_claims.quote: and gave them also fire, which, unknown to Zeus, he had hidden in a stalk of fennel.

statement.id: Menurut Apollodorus, Prometheus juga memberi manusia api yang tanpa sepengetahuan Zeus disembunyikannya dalam batang adas.
statement.en: According to Apollodorus, Prometheus also gave humans fire, which, unknown to Zeus, he had hidden in a stalk of fennel.

basis_claims.quote: He is usually depicted as a bearded man wearing a headdress with a double plume or, after the New Kingdom, as a ram-headed man or simply a ram, symbolizing fertility in his role as Amun-Min.

statement.id: Amun digambarkan sebagai pria berjanggut dengan mahkota dua bulu atau sebagai domba jantan.
statement.en: Amun is depicted as a bearded man with double plumes or as a ram-headed man or ram.

basis_claims.quote: His cult originated in Thebes and his temple at Karnak remains one of the most stunning achievements of Egyptian cult and architecture, but he was worshipped in temples and shrines throughout Egypt.

statement.id: Kultus Amun berasal dari Thebes, berpusat di kuil Karnak, dan meluas ke berbagai kuil Mesir.
statement.en: Amun's cult originated in Thebes, included the Karnak temple, and spread across Egyptian temples.

basis_claims.quote: In his role as Amun-Ra, the god combines his invisible aspect (symbolized by the wind which one cannot see but is aware of) and his visible aspect as the life-giving sun.

statement.id: Sebagai Amun-Ra, sang dewa menggabungkan aspek tak kasatmata (dilambangkan angin) dan aspek kasatmata sebagai matahari pemberi kehidupan.
statement.en: As Amun-Ra the god combines his invisible aspect (symbolized by the wind) with his visible aspect as the life-giving sun.

basis_claims.quote: His presence was everywhere, unseen but felt like the wind. His oracles communicated the divine will to humanity.

statement.id: Menurut Egiptolog Geraldine Pinch, kehadiran Amun ada di mana-mana, tak terlihat tetapi terasa seperti angin, dan orakelnya menyampaikan kehendak ilahi kepada manusia.
statement.en: According to Egyptologist Geraldine Pinch, Amun's presence was everywhere, unseen but felt like the wind, and his oracles communicated the divine will to humanity.

basis_claims.quote: The main Temple of Amun at Karnak is still the largest religious structure ever built and was connected to the Southern Sanctuary of the Luxor Temple.

statement.id: Kuil utama Amun di Karnak masih merupakan bangunan keagamaan terbesar yang pernah dibangun dan terhubung dengan Tempat Suci Selatan Kuil Luxor.
statement.en: The main Temple of Amun at Karnak is still the largest religious structure ever built and was connected to the Southern Sanctuary of the Luxor Temple.

statement.id: Yeti sering digambarkan sebagai makhluk besar berkaki dua mirip manusia atau kera, berbulu cokelat, abu-abu, atau putih, dan kadang bergigi besar dan tajam.
statement.en: The yeti is often described as a large bipedal human- or ape-like creature covered with brown, grey or white hair, and sometimes with large sharp teeth.

basis_claims.quote: followers of the Bön religion once believed the blood of the "Mi rgod" or "wild man" had use in certain spiritual ceremonies. The being was depicted as an ape-like creature who carries a large stone as a weapon and makes a whistling swoosh sound.

statement.en: Followers of the Bön religion once believed the blood of the "Mi rgod" or "wild man" was used in certain spiritual ceremonies; the being was depicted as ape-like, carrying a large stone as a weapon and making a whistling swoosh.

basis_claims.quote: In ancient Greek Archaic and Classical art, Ares is most often depicted wearing full armour and helmet and carrying a shield and spear.
basis_claims.locator: How is Ares Represented in Art?

statement.id: Ares digambarkan memakai zirah dan ketopong serta membawa perisai dan tombak.
statement.en: Ancient art shows Ares armored with helmet, shield, and spear.

basis_claims.quote: In ancient Greek art he was depicted as either a mature, bearded warrior armed for battle, or a nude, beardless youth with a helm and spear.

statement.id: Penggambaran kuno Ares dapat berupa prajurit dewasa berjanggut atau pemuda berketopong dan tombak.
statement.en: Ancient depictions show Ares as a bearded warrior or a helmeted youth with spear.

basis_claims.quote: Many Greeks were ambivalent towards him. He embodies the physical valor necessary for success in war but can also personify sheer brutality and bloodlust, in contrast to his sister Athena, whose martial functions include military strategy and generalship.

statement.id: Banyak orang Yunani bersikap mendua terhadap Ares: ia mewujudkan keberanian fisik yang diperlukan untuk menang perang, tetapi juga dapat melambangkan kebrutalan dan nafsu darah, berbeda dengan saudarinya Athena yang berfungsi pada strategi dan kepemimpinan militer.
statement.en: Many Greeks were ambivalent toward Ares: he embodies the physical valor needed for success in war but can also personify sheer brutality and bloodlust, in contrast to his sister Athena, whose martial functions include strategy and generalship.

basis_claims.quote: Ares' main attribute was a peaked warrior's helm. Even in domestic scenes, such as feasts of the gods, he was depicted either wearing or holding his helm. The god's other attributes included a shield, a spear and sometimes a sheathed sword.

statement.id: Atribut utama Ares adalah ketopong prajurit berpuncak, bahkan dalam adegan rumah tangga seperti pesta para dewa; atribut lainnya perisai, tombak, dan kadang pedang bersarung.
statement.en: Ares' main attribute was a peaked warrior's helm, even in domestic scenes such as feasts of the gods; his other attributes included a shield, a spear, and sometimes a sheathed sword.

basis_claims.quote: Ares, exceeding in strength, chariot-rider, golden-helmed, doughty in heart, shield-bearer, Saviour of cities, harnessed in bronze, strong of arm, unwearying, mighty with the spear, O defender of Olympos
basis_claims.locator: Classical Literature Quotes (Homeric Hymn 8 to Ares)

statement.id: Himne Homerik 8 menyapa Ares sebagai yang luar biasa kuat, penunggang kereta, berketopong emas, pembawa perisai, penyelamat kota, berbaju perunggu, dan perkasa dengan tombak.
statement.en: Homeric Hymn 8 addresses Ares as exceeding in strength, chariot-rider, golden-helmed, shield-bearer, saviour of cities, harnessed in bronze, and mighty with the spear.

basis_claims.quote: Described by Hesiod in his Theogony as 'shield-piercing Ares' and 'city-sacking Ares,' the god represented the more brutal and bloody side of battle, which was in contrast to Athena who represented the more strategic elements of warfare.

statement.id: Dalam Theogony karya Hesiodos, Ares disebut "Ares penembus perisai" dan "Ares penjarah kota", mewakili sisi pertempuran yang lebih brutal dan berdarah, berbeda dengan Athena yang mewakili unsur strategis perang.
statement.en: Described by Hesiod in the Theogony as "shield-piercing Ares" and "city-sacking Ares", he represented the more brutal and bloody side of battle, in contrast to Athena, who represented its more strategic elements.

basis_claims.quote: In Greek mythology, the Titan Atlas was responsible for bearing the weight of the heavens on his shoulders, a burden given to him as punishment by Zeus.

statement.id: Atlas adalah Titan Yunani yang dihukum Zeus untuk menopang langit.
statement.en: Atlas is a Greek Titan punished by Zeus to hold up the heavens.

basis_claims.quote: Hesiod in his Theogony also describes Atlas as holding up the heavens and locates him in the land of the Hesperides

statement.id: Hesiod menempatkan Atlas di tanah Hesperides sambil menopang langit.
statement.en: Hesiod locates Atlas in the land of the Hesperides holding up the heavens.

basis_claims.quote: In Hellenistic and Roman times, Atlas is frequently represented in his now familiar position with bent knees and back, straining to hold the globe on his shoulders.

statement.id: Seni Helenistik dan Romawi menggambarkan Atlas membungkuk menahan bola di bahunya.
statement.en: Hellenistic and Roman art depicts Atlas straining to hold a globe on his shoulders.

basis_claims.quote: Atlas, pre-eminent in mighty strength, who moans as he supports the vault of heaven on his back.
basis_claims.locator: Classical literature quotes: Aeschylus, Prometheus Bound 407 ff

statement.id: Prometheus Bound karya Aeschylus menggambarkan Atlas sebagai yang unggul dalam kekuatan besar, mengerang sambil menopang kubah langit di punggungnya.
statement.en: Aeschylus's Prometheus Bound describes Atlas as pre-eminent in mighty strength, moaning as he supports the vault of heaven on his back.

basis_claims.quote: In Greek art, Atlas is, from the 6th century BCE, often featured in depictions of the labours of Hercules, most notably in a metope from the Temple of Zeus at Olympia (c. 460 BCE) where he stands in the gardens of the Hesperides.

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani sejak abad ke-6 SM, Atlas sering muncul dalam penggambaran kerja keras Hercules, terutama pada metope Kuil Zeus di Olympia (sekitar 460 SM) tempat ia berdiri di taman Hesperides.
statement.en: In Greek art from the 6th century BCE, Atlas often appears in depictions of the labours of Hercules, most notably on a metope from the Temple of Zeus at Olympia (c. 460 BCE) where he stands in the gardens of the Hesperides.

basis_claims.quote: Among other identities, she was known to many as Juno Sospita, the chief deity of Lanuvium, a city located in Latium southeast of Rome. She was the protector of one in confinement, often pictured wearing a goatskin, carrying a spear and shield.

statement.id: Sebagai Juno Sospita, ia dewa utama Lanuvium, kota di Latium tenggara Roma; ia pelindung orang yang terkurung dan sering digambarkan mengenakan kulit kambing serta membawa tombak dan perisai.
statement.en: As Juno Sospita she was the chief deity of Lanuvium, a city in Latium southeast of Rome; she protected those in confinement and was often pictured wearing a goatskin and carrying a spear and shield.

basis_claims.quote: Next, a storm at sea, created by Juno, failed when Neptune interfered, not for the love of Aeneas, but owing to his irritation at Juno's interference in his domain.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Aeneas, badai di laut yang diciptakan Juno gagal ketika Neptunus ikut campur, bukan karena sayang kepada Aeneas melainkan karena kesal pada campur tangan Juno di wilayahnya.
statement.en: In the Aeneas story a storm at sea created by Juno failed when Neptune interfered, not out of love for Aeneas but out of irritation at Juno meddling in his domain.

basis_claims.quote: Juno's own warlike aspect among the Romans is apparent in her attire. She was often shown armed and wearing a goatskin cloak.

statement.id: Sisi perangnya di kalangan Romawi tampak pada pakaiannya; ia sering digambarkan bersenjata dan mengenakan jubah kulit kambing.
statement.en: Her warlike aspect among the Romans is apparent in her attire; she was often shown armed and wearing a goatskin cloak.

statement.id: Lakshmi adalah dewi kekayaan, keberuntungan, kemudaan, dan kecantikan dalam Hindu.
statement.en: Lakshmi is the Hindu goddess of wealth, good fortune, youth, and beauty.

basis_claims.quote: In the Mahabharata, Lakshmi was born from the stirring of the primeval milky ocean by the gods and demons.

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Lakshmi lahir dari pengadukan samudra susu oleh dewa dan iblis.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Lakshmi is born from the churning of the milky ocean.

basis_claims.quote: The goddess is particularly associated with the lotus flower and is sometimes referred to simply as the Lotus Goddess.

statement.id: Lakshmi berkaitan dengan bunga teratai dan disebut Dewi Teratai.
statement.en: Lakshmi is associated with the lotus and called the Lotus Goddess.

basis_claims.quote: Following the intervention of Brahma and Vishnu, Lakshmi miraculously appeared from this sea of clarified butter clothed all in white and radiating youth and beauty.

statement.id: Setelah campur tangan Brahma dan Vishnu, Lakshmi muncul secara ajaib dari lautan mentega murni itu, berbalut putih dan memancarkan kemudaan serta kecantikan.
statement.en: After the intervention of Brahma and Vishnu, Lakshmi miraculously appeared from the sea of clarified butter, clothed in white and radiating youth and beauty.

basis_claims.quote: In art, Lakshmi is often represented either standing or seated on a large lotus flower and holding a water pot and single lotus flower in her hands, always either blue or pink. With her other two hands she typically gives a sign of blessing and showers coins on her loyal followers.
basis_claims.locator: How is Lakshmi Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni, Lakshmi sering digambarkan berdiri atau duduk di atas bunga teratai besar sambil memegang kendi air dan setangkai teratai; dengan dua tangan lainnya ia biasanya memberi isyarat restu dan menghujani pengikut setianya dengan koin.
statement.en: In art, Lakshmi is often shown standing or seated on a large lotus, holding a water pot and a single lotus flower; with her other two hands she typically makes a gesture of blessing and showers coins on her loyal followers.

basis_claims.quote: then from the water arose the exalted Sri, endowed with excellent grace,—seated on a blown lotus, and carrying also a lotus in her hand.

statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, the exalted Sri arises from the water, endowed with excellent grace, seated on a blown lotus and carrying a lotus in her hand.

basis_claims.quote: Another object commonly seen in Saraswati's hands is the vina (the Hindu classical music instrument) which reminds of her gift of music to humanity.

statement.id: Vina sering digambarkan berada di tangan Saraswati.
statement.en: Saraswati is often depicted holding a vina.

basis_claims.quote: Her attributes—the vina (a symbol of music and the arts), palm-sized manuscript (a symbol of learning), and rosary (a symbol of religious rites)—denote her role as a goddess of knowledge.

statement.id: Vina, manuskrip, dan tasbih menjadi atributnya yang melambangkan musik, pembelajaran, dan ritus.
statement.en: Her vina, manuscript, and rosary symbolize music, learning, and ritual.

basis_claims.quote: Saraswati is conventionally accompanied by a swan, but a peacock stands beside her here, enchanted by the divine music she creates.

statement.id: Saraswati secara konvensional ditemani angsa, sementara satu cetakan menampilkan merak.
statement.en: Saraswati is conventionally accompanied by a swan, though this print shows a peacock.

basis_claims.quote: Originally associated with an ancient lost river that bore her name, Saraswati increasingly came to be celebrated as the goddess of all waters and their life-giving and purifying powers.

statement.id: Saraswati awalnya terkait sungai kuno senama, lalu dipuja sebagai dewi seluruh perairan.
statement.en: Saraswati was associated with a lost river of the same name and later with all waters.

basis_claims.quote: The Saraswati River (modern name: Sarsuti), just like the Ganges River, flows from the Himalaya and is considered a sacred source of purification, fertility, and good fortune for those who bathe in her waters. The sacred river, again like the Ganges, then developed into a personified deity.

statement.id: Sungai Saraswati (nama modern: Sarsuti), seperti Sungai Gangga, mengalir dari Himalaya dan dianggap sumber suci penyucian, kesuburan, dan keberuntungan bagi mereka yang mandi di airnya; sungai suci itu kemudian berkembang menjadi dewi yang dipersonifikasikan.
statement.en: The Saraswati River (modern name Sarsuti), like the Ganges, flows from the Himalaya and is considered a sacred source of purification, fertility, and good fortune for those who bathe in it; the sacred river then developed into a personified deity.

basis_claims.quote: In Hindu art, Saraswati is usually depicted as a graceful youth with white skin. She most often wears a white sari (which symbolises purity) which has a blue border.

statement.id: Dalam seni Hindu, Saraswati biasanya digambarkan sebagai remaja anggun berkulit putih, paling sering berkain sari putih (lambang kesucian) bertepi biru.
statement.en: In Hindu art Saraswati is usually shown as a graceful youth with white skin, most often in a white sari (symbolizing purity) with a blue border.

basis_claims.quote: As with many Hindu deities, Saraswati is often depicted with four arms, each holding a symbolic object. In the left hands she can carry a palm-leaf manuscript and ritual water vessel. In the upper right hand she holds a white lotus flower

statement.id: Seperti banyak dewa Hindu, Saraswati sering digambarkan berlengan empat, masing-masing memegang benda lambang; di tangan kiri ia dapat membawa manuskrip daun lontar dan bejana air ritual, dan di tangan kanan atas ia memegang teratai putih.
statement.en: Like many Hindu deities, Saraswati is often shown with four arms, each holding a symbolic object; in the left hands she can carry a palm-leaf manuscript and a ritual water vessel, and in the upper right hand she holds a white lotus.

basis_claims.quote: She with her might, like one who digs for lotus-stems, hath burst with her strong waves the ridges of the hills.

statement.id: Dalam himne Rigveda (terjemahan Griffith), Sarasvati dengan kekuatannya menjebol punggung bukit dengan ombaknya yang deras, seperti orang yang menggali batang teratai.
statement.en: In a Rigveda hymn (Griffith's translation), Sarasvati with her might bursts the ridges of the hills with her strong waves, like one who digs for lotus stems.

basis_claims.quote: The temples at Amarna present vast open spaces with altars for offerings and raised platforms.

statement.id: Kuil Aten di Amarna memiliki ruang terbuka luas dan altar persembahan.
statement.en: The Amarna temples had open spaces and offering altars.

basis_claims.quote: You rise beautiful from the horizon on heaven, living disk, origin of life.

statement.id: Dalam Himne Agung, Aten menyingkirkan kegelapan dan memberikan sinarnya sehingga kedua negeri bersuka ria.
statement.en: In the Great Hymn Aten removes the darkness and grants his rays, and the two lands are in festival.

basis_claims.quote: Straying significantly from the tradition of ancient Egyptian temples being hidden and more enclosed the further one went into the site, temples of Aten were open and did not have roofs in order to allow the rays of the sun inside.

statement.en: Unlike the traditional enclosed Egyptian temple, temples of the Aten were open and unroofed so that the sun's rays could enter.

basis_claims.quote: Then the son from his ambush stretched forth his left hand and in his right took the great long sickle with jagged teeth, and swiftly lopped off his own father's members and cast them away to fall behind him.

statement.en: According to Hesiod, Cronos reached from his ambush, took the great jagged sickle in his right hand, swiftly lopped off his father's members, and cast them behind him.

basis_claims.quote: For the Titan gods and as many as sprang from Cronos had long been fighting together in stubborn war with heart-grieving toil, the lordly Titans from high Othyrs, but the gods, givers of good, whom rich-haired Rhea bare in union with Cronos, from Olympus.

statement.en: According to Hesiod, the Titan gods and those sprung from Cronos had long fought a stubborn war, the Titans from high Othyrs and the gods whom Rhea bore to Cronos from Olympus.

basis_claims.quote: Cronus would not simply allow his children to overthrow him without a fight, and so began the Titanomachy, a ten-year-long battle between the Titans and the Olympian gods. The Titans fought from Mount Othrys, while the gods fought from Mount Olympus.

statement.id: Cronus tidak mau digulingkan anak-anaknya tanpa perlawanan, sehingga dimulailah Titanomakhia, pertempuran sepuluh tahun antara para Titan dari Gunung Othrys dan para dewa Olimpus dari Gunung Olympus.
statement.en: Cronus would not let his children overthrow him without a fight, so began the Titanomachy, a ten-year battle between the Titans from Mount Othrys and the Olympian gods from Mount Olympus.

basis_claims.quote: Cronus was usually depicted with a harpe, scythe, or sickle, which was the instrument he used to castrate and depose Uranus, his father.

basis_claims.quote: Demeter was depicted as a mature woman, often wearing a crown and bearing sheafs of wheat or a cornucopia (horn of plenty), and a torch.

statement.id: Demeter digambarkan sebagai perempuan dewasa yang membawa gandum atau obor.
statement.en: Demeter is shown as a mature woman bearing wheat or a torch.

basis_claims.quote: Once the temple was completed, Demeter withdrew from the world and lived inside it; at the same time, she created a great drought to convince the other gods to release Persephone from Hades.

statement.id: Demeter menyebabkan kekeringan untuk menuntut pembebasan Persephone.
statement.en: Demeter caused a drought to demand Persephone's release.

basis_claims.quote: The sanctuary at Eleusis is dedicated to both the goddess and her daughter Persephone. This was the location of the famous Eleusinian Mysteries.

statement.id: Eleusis memiliki tempat suci Demeter dan Persephone serta ritual misteri mereka.
statement.en: Eleusis had a sanctuary for Demeter and Persephone and their mysteries.

basis_claims.quote: As the drought claimed ever more victims, crops withered

statement.id: Kekeringan dalam kisah Demeter membuat tanaman layu.
statement.en: The drought in Demeter's story withered crops.

basis_claims.quote: She was represented sometimes in a sitting attitude, sometimes walking, and sometimes riding in a chariot drawn by horses or dragons, but always in full attire.

statement.id: Demeter digambarkan kadang duduk, kadang berjalan, dan kadang naik kereta yang ditarik kuda atau naga, selalu berpakaian lengkap.
statement.en: She was represented sometimes sitting, sometimes walking, and sometimes riding in a chariot drawn by horses or dragons, but always in full attire.

basis_claims.quote: In Archaic and Classical art she is often seated, wears a crown of grain and holds a torch (signifying her search for her lost daughter) or a sceptre, a poppy (the flower that grows so abundantly in untended wheat fields) or simply stalks of grain.
basis_claims.locator: How is Demeter Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Arkais dan Klasik, Demeter sering duduk, bermahkota biji-bijian, dan memegang obor (tanda pencariannya akan putrinya), tongkat kerajaan, opium poppy, atau sekadar tangkai gandum.
statement.en: In Archaic and Classical art she is often seated, wears a crown of grain and holds a torch (signifying her search for her lost daughter) or a sceptre, a poppy, or simply stalks of grain.

basis_claims.quote: Then she caused a most dreadful and cruel year for mankind over the all-nourishing earth: the ground would not make the seed sprout, for rich-crowned Demeter kept it hid.

statement.id: Dalam Himne Homerik, Demeter menyebabkan tahun yang sangat mengerikan bagi manusia: tanah tidak menumbuhkan benih karena Demeter menyembunyikannya.
statement.en: In the Homeric Hymn, Demeter caused a most dreadful and cruel year for mankind: the ground would not make the seed sprout, for Demeter kept it hid.

hestia.depicted_variant: Veiled Hestia actively maintaining the Olympian sacred hearth with kettle attribute.

visual_requirements.description: Young veiled female in modest opaque clothing, kettle attribute.
Feeds and maintains sacred Olympian hearth fire; tangible flames and embers.
Hearth of Olympus.

hestia.aura: Sacrificial flame(c06) at Olympian hearth she feeds(c43), sacred office conveys overwhelming majesty.

basis_claims.quote: Hestia was also the goddess of the sacrificial flame and received a share of every sacrifice to the gods.

statement.id: Hestia terkait api kurban dan mendapat bagian dari setiap persembahan kepada para dewa.
statement.en: Hestia governed the sacrificial flame and received a share of each offering.

basis_claims.quote: Hestia was depicted in Athenian vase painting as a modestly veiled woman sometimes holding a flowered branch (perhaps a chaste-tree).

statement.id: Lukisan vas Athena menggambarkan Hestia sebagai perempuan berkerudung, kadang memegang dahan berbunga.
statement.en: Athenian vase paintings show Hestia veiled and sometimes holding a flowering branch.

basis_claims.quote: Hestia is usually presented in Greek art as a young female wearing a head covering & modest clothing.

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani, Hestia biasanya ditampilkan sebagai perempuan muda berpenutup kepala dan berpakaian sederhana.
statement.en: In Greek art Hestia is usually presented as a young woman wearing a head covering and modest clothing.

basis_claims.quote: In classical sculpture she was also veiled, with a kettle as her attribute.

statement.id: Dalam patung klasik Hestia juga berkerudung, dengan ketel sebagai atributnya.
statement.en: In classical sculpture she was also veiled, with a kettle as her attribute.

basis_claims.quote: Zeus assigned Hestia a duty to feed and maintain the fires of the Olympian hearth with the fatty, combustible portions of animal sacrifices to the gods.

statement.id: Zeus menugaskan Hestia memberi makan dan memelihara api perapian Olimpus dengan bagian lemak kurban hewan yang mudah terbakar.
statement.en: Zeus assigned Hestia the duty of feeding and maintaining the fires of the Olympian hearth with the fatty, combustible portions of animal sacrifices.

basis_claims.quote: Like Athena and Artemis, Hestia elected never to marry and remained an eternal virgin goddess instead, forever tending to the hearth of Olympus.

statement.id: Seperti Athena dan Artemis, Hestia memilih tidak pernah menikah dan tetap menjadi dewi perawan abadi yang selalu merawat perapian Olimpus.
statement.en: Like Athena and Artemis, Hestia chose never to marry and remained an eternal virgin goddess, forever tending the hearth of Olympus.

basis_claims.quote: sometimes she is pouring a libation, as in a c. 500 BCE red-figure kylix now in the Berlin Staatliche Museen which shows her in the company of Apollo and Hermes as they lead Hercules to Mount Olympus.

statement.id: Hestia kadang digambarkan menuang persembahan, misalnya pada kylix figur merah sekitar 500 SM di Berlin bersama Apollo dan Hermes yang menuntun Hercules ke Gunung Olimpus.
statement.en: Hestia is sometimes shown pouring a libation, as on a c. 500 BCE red-figure kylix in Berlin where she is with Apollo and Hermes as they lead Hercules to Mount Olympus.
