persephone.aura: No generic aura; strength through documented attributes, physical action and source-linked domain: persephone-c03, persephone-c10, persephone-c21, persephone-c23, persephone-c28, persephone-c35

basis_claims.quote: In Greek mythology, the goddess, as wife of Hades, is the Queen of the Underworld and takes her other name, Persephone.
basis_claims.locator: What are the Different Names of Persephone?

statement.id: Sebagai istri Hades, Persephone adalah ratu dunia bawah.
statement.en: As Hades's wife, Persephone is queen of the underworld.

basis_claims.quote: Hades, god of the Underworld, fell in love with beautiful Persephone when he saw her picking flowers one day in a meadow. The god then carried her off in his chariot to live with him in the dark Underworld.

statement.id: Hades, dewa dunia bawah, jatuh cinta pada Persephone yang cantik ketika melihatnya memetik bunga di padang rumput, lalu membawanya dengan kereta ke dunia bawah yang gelap.
statement.en: Hades, god of the Underworld, fell in love with the beautiful Persephone when he saw her picking flowers in a meadow, then carried her off in his chariot to the dark Underworld.

basis_claims.quote: Persephone rarely appears in art before the 6th century BCE, and then she is usually shown with Demeter; often both wear crowns and hold a torch, sceptre, or stalks of grain.
basis_claims.locator: How is Persephone Represented in Art?

statement.id: Persephone jarang muncul dalam seni sebelum abad ke-6 SM, dan kemudian biasanya ditampilkan bersama Demeter; keduanya sering bermahkota dan memegang obor, tongkat kerajaan, atau tangkai gandum.
statement.en: Persephone rarely appears in art before the 6th century BCE, then is usually shown with Demeter; both often wear crowns and hold a torch, sceptre or stalks of grain.

basis_claims.quote: A famous relief slab from Eleusis depicts Demeter and Persephone (holding a torch) either side of Triptolemos; it dates to the 5th century BCE.
basis_claims.locator: How is Persephone Represented in Art?

statement.id: Sebuah lempeng relief terkenal dari Eleusis menampilkan Demeter dan Persephone (memegang obor) di kedua sisi Triptolemos; berasal dari abad ke-5 SM.
statement.en: A famous relief slab from Eleusis shows Demeter and Persephone (holding a torch) on either side of Triptolemos; it dates to the 5th century BCE.

basis_claims.quote: And while you are here, you shall rule all that lives and moves and shall have the greatest rights among the deathless gods: those who defraud you and do not appease your power with offerings, reverently performing rites and paying fit gifts, shall be punished for evermore.

statement.id: Dalam Himne Homerik, Hades berkata kepada Persephone bahwa selama di sana ia akan memerintah semua yang hidup dan bergerak dan memiliki hak terbesar di antara para dewa; mereka yang menipunya dan tidak menenangkan kuasanya dengan persembahan akan dihukum selamanya.
statement.en: In the Homeric Hymn Hades tells Persephone that while she is there she shall rule all that lives and moves and have the greatest rights among the gods; those who defraud her and do not appease her power with offerings shall be punished for evermore.

basis_claims.quote: In Classical Greek art, Persephone is invariably portrayed robed, often carrying a sheaf of grain. She may appear as a mystical divinity with a sceptre and a little box, but she was mostly represented in the process of being carried off by Hades.

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani Klasik, Persephone selalu digambarkan berjubah, sering membawa seikat gandum; ia dapat tampil sebagai dewi mistik dengan tongkat dan kotak kecil, tetapi paling sering ditampilkan saat dibawa pergi Hades.
statement.en: In Classical Greek art Persephone is invariably robed, often carrying a sheaf of grain; she may appear as a mystical divinity with a sceptre and a little box, but was mostly shown being carried off by Hades.

balarama.depicted_variant: Balarama actively diverts the Yamuna with a monumental plough weapon, in a tight low-angle devotional action portrait.

visual_requirements.description: Balarama as Hindu deity with unmistakable immense plough weapon; one head/two arms are restrained editorial rendering, clothing opaque.
The plough draws the Yamuna into a newly torn channel, water physically redirected by the deity rather than routine agriculture.
Yamuna river approaching Vrindavan, torn riverbank and surging water during the documented deed.

balarama.aura: Superhuman physical river redirection from balarama-c08, direct commanding gaze and foreshortened plough; no generic glow.

basis_claims.quote: Balarama (Sanskrit: बलराम, IAST: Balarāma) is a Hindu god, and the elder brother of Krishna. He is particularly significant in the Jagannath tradition, as one of the triad deities. He is also known as Haladhara, Halayudha, Baladeva, Balabhadra, and Sankarshana.

statement.id: Balarama adalah dewa Hindu dan kakak Krishna.
statement.en: Balarama is a Hindu deity and Krishna's elder brother.

basis_claims.quote: The first two epithets associate him with hala (langala, "plough") from his strong associations with farming and farmers, as the deity who used farm equipment as weapons when needed, and the next two refer to his strength.

statement.id: Epitet Haladhara dan Halayudha berhubungan dengan bajak dan pertanian.
statement.en: The epithets Haladhara and Halayudha connect him with the plough and farming.

basis_claims.quote: The plough is Balarama's weapon. In the Bhagavata Purana, he uses it to fight asuras, dig a way for Yamuna river to bring it closer to Vrindavan, and he also availed it to drag the entire capital of Hastinapura into the Ganga river.

statement.id: Bajak adalah senjata Balarama; dalam Bhagavata Purana ia memakainya untuk melawan asura, menggali jalan bagi Sungai Yamuna agar lebih dekat ke Vrindavan, dan menyeret seluruh ibu kota Hastinapura ke Sungai Gangga.
statement.en: The plough is Balarama's weapon; in the Bhagavata Purana he uses it to fight asuras, to dig a channel bringing the Yamuna closer to Vrindavan, and to drag the whole capital of Hastinapura into the Ganga.

chandra.depicted_variant: Respectful white Chandra actively driving a three-wheeled chariot drawn by exactly three white horses, holding a large mace under the moon.

visual_requirements.description: White male deity holding a clearly readable mace, wearing an opaque ivory high-neck long-sleeved under-tunic with ceremonial outer robes; one head and two arms as conservative humanlike depiction.
A physically coherent three-wheeled chariot pulled by exactly three white horses; all three wheels made legible through oblique forward view.
Moonlight shines onto the active chariot procession and surrounding foliage; no invented destruction, magical beams or elemental storm.
Night sky with lunar disk and dark vegetation, drawn from his moon/night/plants domain.

chandra.aura: His documented white deity, mace and moving three-wheeled horse chariot make the divine identity unmistakable (chandra-c09); physical moonlight over night plants supplies lunar grandeur (chandra-c01,chandra-c03).

basis_claims.quote: Chandra (Sanskrit: चन्द्र, romanized: Chandra, lit. 'shining' or 'moon'), also known as Soma (Sanskrit: सोम), is the Hindu god of the Moon, and is associated with the night, plants and vegetation. He is one of the Navagraha (nine planets of Hinduism).

statement.id: Chandra adalah dewa Bulan dalam Hindu yang terkait malam dan tumbuhan.
statement.en: Chandra is the Hindu Moon god associated with night and plants.

basis_claims.quote: The word "Chandra" literally means "bright, shining or glittering" and is used for the "Moon" in Sanskrit and other Indo-Aryan languages. It is also the name of various other figures in Hindu mythology, including an asura and a Suryavamsha king. It is also a common Indian name and surname.

statement.id: Chandra berarti terang atau berkilau dalam bahasa Sanskerta.
statement.en: Chandra means bright or shining in Sanskrit.

basis_claims.quote: The most common is one where he is a white-coloured deity, holding a mace in his hand, riding a chariot with three wheels and three or more white horses (up to ten).

statement.id: Ikonografinya yang paling umum: dewa berwarna putih yang memegang gada dan mengendarai kereta beroda tiga yang ditarik tiga atau lebih kuda putih (sampai sepuluh).
statement.en: His most common iconography is a white deity holding a mace, riding a three-wheeled chariot drawn by three or more white horses (up to ten).

radha.depicted_variant: Respectful symbolic monumental queen Radha in a full-body rasa-dance turn above a subordinate sacred royal assembly of Goloka/Braj.

visual_requirements.description: Human-form Radha as an opaquely robed divine queen, one head, two eyes, two arms, two legs; precise anatomy and royal costume editorial because research does not specify them.

Forceful sweeping rasa dance filling the frame, one arm extending outward and one lifting an edge of opaque robe; action based on queen of Raslila / fond of the rasa dance. No magical energy effect.

Sacred grandeur through editorial hierarchical scale, compassionate but commanding gaze, full-body diagonal movement and one natural backlight; no supernatural power emissions.

radha.aura: Sacred queenly authority comes from rasa-dance movement (radha-c17) and editorial devotional scale over a subordinate worshipful court, conveying queen of Goloka/Braj (radha-c08) revered as supreme being (radha-c07); natural backlight, no magical emission.

sita.depicted_variant: Sita in the Agni Pariksha version, striding through the surrounding ordeal fire toward the viewer with sacred resolve; no Maya Sita or return-to-earth variant is blended.

The fire ordeal itself supplies the immediate setting; no forest, landscape, invented temple or unrelated return-to-earth episode.

basis_claims.quote: Sita (Sanskrit: सीता; IAST: Sītā), also known as Siya, Jānaki and Maithili, is a Hindu goddess and the female protagonist of the Hindu epic Ramayana. statement.en: Sita is a Hindu goddess and the principal female character of the Ramayana.

basis_claims.quote: Sita (Sanskrit: सीता; IAST: Sītā), also known as Siya, Jānaki and Maithili, is a Hindu goddess and the female protagonist of the Hindu epic Ramayana. basis_claims.quote: is the second avatar of the Hindu preserver deity, Vishnu.

statement.en: He prominently appears in the legend of the churning of the Ocean of Milk.

basis_claims.quote: Matsya (the fish) Kurma (the tortoise) Varaha (the boar)

statement.id: Dalam daftar avatar, Kurma disebut sebagai kura-kura, bersama Matsya (ikan) dan Varaha (babi hutan).
statement.en: In the list of avatars, Kurma is named as the tortoise, alongside Matsya (the fish) and Varaha (the boar).

basis_claims.quote: To mix the ocean they decided to use the holy Mt. Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a turning rope; one end to be pulled by Demons and the other by the gods.

statement.id: Untuk mengaduk samudra mereka memakai Gunung Mandara yang suci dengan ular raksasa Vasuki (atau Ananta) sebagai tali; satu ujung ditarik para iblis dan ujung lain oleh para dewa.
statement.en: To mix the ocean they used the holy Mt. Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a rope, one end pulled by the demons and the other by the gods.

basis_claims.quote: However, neither group could handle such a weight and they called for Vishnu to hold it. This he did in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise, supporting the mountain on his shell.

statement.id: Namun tak satu pun pihak sanggup menanggung beban itu sehingga mereka memanggil Wisnu untuk menahannya; ia melakukannya dalam wujud Kurma, kura-kura raksasa, menopang gunung di cangkangnya.
statement.en: Neither group could handle such a weight, so they called for Vishnu to hold it; he did so in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise, supporting the mountain on his shell.

basis_claims.quote: In the Hindu religion, Kurma (Sanskrit: meaning "Tortoise") is the second avatar of Vishnu, the preserver god in the Hindu Trimurti (trinity), who appeared in the Satya Yuga as a giant turtle to save the earth from destruction.

statement.id: Dalam agama Hindu, Kurma (Sanskerta: berarti "kura-kura") adalah avatar kedua Wisnu, dewa pemelihara dalam Trimurti Hindu, yang muncul pada Satya Yuga sebagai kura-kura raksasa untuk menyelamatkan bumi dari kehancuran.
statement.en: In Hinduism Kurma (Sanskrit: "Tortoise") is the second avatar of Vishnu, the preserver god in the Hindu Trimurti, who appeared in the Satya Yuga as a giant turtle to save the earth from destruction.

basis_claims.quote: His enormous back was said to have provided a foundation for the mythical Mount Mandara, which was used by the gods (and demons) as a churning rod to stir the primordial milk-ocean thereby obtaining the purported nectar of immortality.

statement.id: Punggungnya yang besar dikatakan menjadi landasan bagi Gunung Mandara yang mitis, yang dipakai para dewa (dan iblis) sebagai tongkat pengaduk samudra susu purba untuk memperoleh nektar keabadian.
statement.en: His enormous back was said to provide a foundation for the mythical Mount Mandara, used by the gods (and demons) as a churning rod to stir the primordial milk-ocean and obtain the nectar of immortality.

basis_claims.quote: As the churning continued, Mt. Mandara began to gradually sink into the mud at the bottom of the milk-ocean. In order to provide support for the mountain so it would not sink any further, Vishnu took the form of Kurma, the tortoise, and supported the mountain upon his broad back.

statement.id: Seiring pengadukan, Gunung Mandara perlahan tenggelam ke lumpur dasar samudra susu; agar tidak tenggelam lebih dalam, Wisnu mengambil wujud Kurma, sang kura-kura, dan menopang gunung di punggungnya yang lebar.
statement.en: As the churning continued Mt. Mandara began to sink into the mud at the bottom of the milk-ocean; so it would sink no further, Vishnu took the form of Kurma, the tortoise, and supported the mountain upon his broad back.

basis_claims.quote: In Hindu iconography, Kurma is depicted as a tortoise, or else as a human being with a tortoise head or a tortoise body. His colour is black, although sometimes he is depicted as golden in colour.

statement.id: Dalam ikonografi Hindu, Kurma digambarkan sebagai kura-kura, atau sebagai manusia berkepala atau bertubuh kura-kura; warnanya hitam, meski kadang digambarkan keemasan.
statement.en: In Hindu iconography Kurma is depicted as a tortoise, or as a human being with a tortoise head or body; his colour is black, although sometimes he is shown as golden.

selene.depicted_variant: Wingless crescent-crowned Selene driving her two-white-horse chariot toward the viewer.

visual_requirements.description: Wingless woman with crescent crown and long robe; exactly two white unwinged horses.
Moonlight and chariot journey across sky, without magical beams.
Night sky.

selene.aura: Keagungan berasal dari dewi bulan dan perjalanan kereta langit malam (selene-c01/c02), mahkota bulan sabit (c06) serta dua kuda putih (c05/c25); cahaya hanya moonlight tanpa pancaran rekaan.

basis_claims.quote: Selene (also known as Mene) is the personification and goddess of the moon in Greek mythology.

statement.id: Selene adalah dewi sekaligus personifikasi bulan dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Selene is the Greek goddess and personification of the moon.

basis_claims.quote: Every night, she travels across the sky in her chariot, pulling the moon behind her.

statement.id: Setiap malam Selene dikisahkan melintasi langit dengan keretanya.
statement.en: Each night Selene is said to cross the sky in her chariot.

basis_claims.quote: Selene's moon chariot was pulled across the night sky by a pair of white-silvery horses or sometimes by a pair of oxen.

statement.id: Kereta bulan Selene ditarik sepasang kuda putih keperakan atau kadang sepasang lembu.
statement.en: Selene's moon chariot is drawn by silver-white horses or sometimes oxen.

basis_claims.quote: In Greek art, Selene was usually depicted with a crescent moon crown and without wings.

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani, Selene kerap dimahkotai bulan sabit dan tanpa sayap.
statement.en: Greek art often depicts Selene with a crescent crown and no wings.

basis_claims.quote: Selene is described as a very beautiful goddess, with long wings and a golden diadem

statement.id: Selene digambarkan sebagai dewi yang sangat cantik, bersayap panjang, dan bermahkota emas.
statement.en: Selene is described as a very beautiful goddess with long wings and a golden diadem.

basis_claims.quote: She rode, like her brother Helios, across the heavens in a chariot drawn by two white horses, cows, or mules

statement.id: Seperti saudaranya Helios, ia melintasi langit dengan kereta yang ditarik dua ekor kuda putih, sapi, atau begal.
statement.en: Like her brother Helios, she rode across the heavens in a chariot drawn by two white horses, cows, or mules.

basis_claims.quote: In works of art, however, the two divinities are usually distinguished; the face of Selene being more full and round, her figure less tall, and always clothed in a long robe

statement.id: Dalam karya seni keduanya biasanya dibedakan: wajah Selene lebih penuh dan bulat, tubuhnya kurang tinggi, dan selalu berjubah panjang.
statement.en: In works of art the two divinities are usually distinguished: Selene's face is fuller and rounder, her figure less tall, and she is always clothed in a long robe.

basis_claims.quote: In the Homeric Hymn to Selene, Selene is described as a kindly and beautiful winged goddess who is crowned with gold and drives her chariot across the night sky as a sign to humans.

statement.id: Dalam Homeric Hymn to Selene, ia digambarkan sebagai dewi bersayap yang ramah dan cantik, bermahkota emas, yang mengendarai keretanya melintasi langit malam sebagai tanda bagi manusia.
statement.en: In the Homeric Hymn to Selene she is described as a kindly and beautiful winged goddess crowned with gold who drives her chariot across the night sky as a sign to humans.

count-dracula.depicted_variant: Stoker's elderly black-clothed Count descending his castle wall head-first in lizard fashion, fully human anatomy.

visual_requirements.description: Stoker's tall old pale man, clean-shaven except long white moustache; black head-to-foot clothing, aquiline nose, pointed ears, sharp white teeth over lips.
Long fine sharp nails clearly visible on hands gripping castle masonry; hairs at center of palm are documented but hidden in this selected hand orientation, shown in alternative A only.
Moves down castle masonry in lizard fashion as a fully human vampire, not a literal lizard; natural rain/fog frame the castle.
Decaying Carpathian castle, tight view rather than distant scenic landscape.

count-dracula.aura: Predatory pallor, sharp teeth/nails and unnatural wall descent (count-dracula-c02/c03/c04/c19), with physical storm/fog of c09; no generic aura.

basis_claims.quote: Within, stood a tall old man, clean shaven save for a long white moustache, and clad in black from head to foot, without a single speck of colour about him anywhere.

statement.id: Harker melihat seorang lelaki tua yang tinggi, tercukur bersih kecuali kumis putih panjang, dan berpakaian hitam dari kepala sampai kaki.
statement.en: Harker sees a tall old man, clean shaven except for a long white moustache, clad in black from head to foot.

basis_claims.quote: His face was a strong—a very strong—aquiline, with high bridge of the thin nose and peculiarly arched nostrils ... with peculiarly sharp white teeth; these protruded over the lips ... his ears were pale, and at the tops extremely pointed ... The general effect was one of extraordinary pallor.

statement.id: Harker mencatat wajah sang Count yang sangat berhidung bengkok, gigi putih yang sangat runcing dan menonjol di atas bibir, telinga pucat yang sangat runcing di bagian atas, dan kesan umum berupa kepucatan luar biasa.
statement.en: Harker notes the Count's strongly aquiline face, peculiarly sharp white teeth protruding over the lips, pale ears extremely pointed at the tops, and a general effect of extraordinary pallor.

basis_claims.quote: Strange to say, there were hairs in the centre of the palm. The nails were long and fine, and cut to a sharp point.

statement.id: Harker mencatat ada rambut di tengah telapak tangan sang Count, dan kukunya panjang, halus, dan dipotong runcing.
statement.en: Harker notes hairs in the centre of the Count's palm, and nails that are long and fine and cut to a sharp point.

basis_claims.quote: he can, within his range, direct the elements; the storm, the fog, the thunder; he can command all the meaner things: the rat, and the owl, and the bat—the moth, and the fox, and the wolf; he can grow and become small; and he can at times vanish and come unknown.

statement.id: Menurut Van Helsing, dalam jangkauannya sang Count dapat mengarahkan badai, kabut, dan guntur, memerintah tikus, burung hantu, kelelawar, ngengat, rubah, dan serigala, menjadi kecil, dan kadang-kadang lenyap serta datang tanpa diketahui.
statement.en: According to Van Helsing, within his range the Count can direct the storm, the fog and the thunder, command the rat, the owl, the bat, the moth, the fox and the wolf, grow and become small, and at times vanish and come unknown.

basis_claims.quote: Once more have I seen the Count go out in his lizard fashion. He moved downwards in a sidelong way, some hundred feet down, and a good deal to the left.

statement.id: Harker kembali melihat sang Count keluar dengan cara seperti cicak, bergerak ke bawah menyamping sekitar seratus kaki dan agak jauh ke kiri.
statement.en: Harker again sees the Count go out in lizard fashion, moving downwards in a sidelong way some hundred feet down and a good deal to the left.

basis_claims.quote: Count Dracula is an undead, centuries-old vampire, and a Transylvanian nobleman who claims to be a Székely descended from Attila the Hun. He inhabits a decaying castle in the Carpathian Mountains near the Borgo Pass.

statement.id: Count Dracula adalah vampir mayat hidup berusia berabad-abad dan bangsawan Transylvania yang mengaku Székely keturunan Attila si Hun, dan ia mendiami sebuah kastel yang lapuk di Pegunungan Karpatia dekat Borgo Pass.
statement.en: Count Dracula is an undead, centuries-old vampire and a Transylvanian nobleman who claims to be a Székely descended from Attila the Hun, and he inhabits a decaying castle in the Carpathian Mountains near the Borgo Pass.

cthulhu.depicted_variant: Lovecraft's green sticky, tentacle-faced scaly mountainlike Cthulhu emerging through displaced ocean waves, narrow rudimentary wings behind.

visual_requirements.description: Vaguely anthropoid green sticky creature, pulpy octopus head with mass of feelers, scaly rubbery body, prodigious clawed fore/hind feet and long narrow rudimentary wings.
Mountainlike size and vast swimming strokes physically raising waves.
Awakens at sea near R'lyeh, dark stone city ruins peripheral beneath the main creature.

cthulhu.aura: Mountainlike body c09, massive claw/feeler anatomy c01/c02 and physically wave-raising movement c10 convey cosmic threat without generic glow.

basis_claims.quote: It represented a monster of vaguely anthropoid outline, but with an octopus-like head whose face was a mass of feelers, a scaly, rubbery-looking body, prodigious claws on hind and fore feet, and long, narrow wings behind.
basis_claims.locator: Part I, The Horror in Clay (the small statue)

statement.id: Patung kecil itu menggambarkan monster berbentuk samar mirip manusia dengan kepala seperti gurita yang wajahnya berupa gumpalan sulur, tubuh bersisik dan berkesan seperti karet, cakar besar pada kaki depan dan belakang, dan sayap panjang yang sempit di belakang.
statement.en: The small statue represented a monster of vaguely anthropoid outline, with an octopus-like head whose face was a mass of feelers, a scaly, rubbery-looking body, prodigious claws on hind and fore feet, and long, narrow wings behind.

basis_claims.quote: If I say that my somewhat extravagant imagination yielded simultaneous pictures of an octopus, a dragon, and a human caricature, I shall not be unfaithful to the spirit of the thing. A pulpy, tentacled head surmounted a grotesque and scaly body with rudimentary wings
basis_claims.locator: Part I, The Horror in Clay (the carving)

statement.id: Narator berkata bahwa membayangkan gurita, naga, dan karikatur manusia sekaligus tidak mengkhianati semangat benda itu, dengan kepala bertentakel yang gembung di atas tubuh ganjil bersisik yang bersayap kasar.
statement.en: The narrator says that imagining an octopus, a dragon, and a human caricature at once would not be unfaithful to the spirit of the thing, with a pulpy, tentacled head surmounting a grotesque and scaly body with rudimentary wings.

basis_claims.quote: until the time when the great priest Cthulhu, from his dark house in the mighty city of R’lyeh under the waters, should rise and bring the earth again beneath his sway.
basis_claims.locator: Part II, The Tale of Inspector Legrasse

statement.id: Kultus itu tersembunyi sampai saatnya imam agung Cthulhu bangkit dari rumah gelapnya di kota perkasa R'lyeh di bawah air dan membawa bumi kembali di bawah kekuasaannya.
statement.en: The cult remains hidden until the time when the great priest Cthulhu, from his dark house in the mighty city of R'lyeh under the waters, should rise and bring the earth again beneath his sway.

basis_claims.quote: The Thing of the idols, the green, sticky spawn of the stars, had awaked to claim his own. The stars were right again ... After vigintillions of years great Cthulhu was loose again, and ravening for delight.
basis_claims.locator: Part III, The Madness from the Sea

statement.id: Benda dari arca-arca itu, keturunan bintang yang hijau dan lengket, terbangun untuk menuntut miliknya; bintang-bintang kembali tepat dan setelah vigintillions tahun Cthulhu yang agung lepas lagi dan rakus akan kesenangan.
statement.en: The Thing of the idols, the green, sticky spawn of the stars, had awaked to claim his own; the stars were right again and after vigintillions of years great Cthulhu was loose again and ravening for delight.

basis_claims.quote: The Thing can not be described—there is no language for such abysms of shrieking and immemorial lunacy, such eldritch contradictions of all matter, force, and cosmic order. A mountain walked or stumbled.
basis_claims.locator: Part III, The Madness from the Sea

statement.id: Narasi menyatakan bahwa Benda itu tidak dapat dilukiskan karena tidak ada bahasa untuk jurang teriakan dan kegilaan yang demikian, dan sebuah gunung berjalan atau terhuyung.
statement.en: The narration states that the Thing cannot be described, as there is no language for such abysms of shrieking and immemorial lunacy, and that a mountain walked or stumbled.

basis_claims.quote: great Cthulhu slid greasily into the water and began to pursue with vast wave-raising strokes of cosmic potency.
basis_claims.locator: Part III, The Madness from the Sea

statement.id: Cthulhu yang agung meluncur licin ke dalam air dan mulai mengejar dengan ayunan besar yang menimbulkan gelombang dengan daya kosmik.
statement.en: Great Cthulhu slid greasily into the water and began to pursue with vast wave-raising strokes of cosmic potency.

oceanus.depicted_variant: Bull-horned Oceanus with a serpentine fish tail rising through a wall of freshwater waves.

visual_requirements.description: Human torso, bull-horned head and serpentine fish tail variant, without legs; cloth editorial.
Great physically curling waves raised to impede passage.
Freshwater world-encircling river, western shore.

oceanus.aura: Kekuatan nyata adalah gelombang besar yang Oceanus sebabkan (oceanus-c27), dengan tubuh bertanduk banteng/ekor ikan serpentin (c08/c12) di sungai air tawar dunia (c02/c04), tanpa trident atau lightning.

basis_claims.quote: He was the god and personification of the freshwater river Oceanus, which was thought to encircle the earth

statement.id: Oceanus adalah dewa sekaligus personifikasi sungai air tawar yang dipercaya mengelilingi bumi.
statement.en: Oceanus is god and personification of a freshwater river believed to encircle the earth.

basis_claims.quote: The ancient Greeks believed that the great freshwater river Oceanus surrounded the world.

statement.id: Orang Yunani kuno percaya sungai air tawar Oceanus mengelilingi dunia.
statement.en: Ancient Greeks believed the freshwater Oceanus river surrounded the world.

basis_claims.quote: Oceanus is depicted in Greek art with a long fishtail, a man's torso, and a horned head

statement.id: Seni Yunani menggambarkan Oceanus dengan ekor ikan, tubuh manusia, dan kepala bertanduk.
statement.en: Greek art depicts Oceanus with a fish tail, human torso, and horned head.

basis_claims.quote: Okeanos was depicted in ancient Greek vase painting as a bull-horned god with the tail of a serpentine fish

statement.id: Lukisan vas menampilkan Oceanus bertanduk banteng dan berekor ikan menyerupai ular.
statement.en: Vase painting depicts Oceanus with bull horns and a serpentine fish tail.

basis_claims.quote: He was said to dwell on the western shores of the earth and never left his home, not even to attend the assemblies of the gods.

statement.id: Oceanus dikatakan tinggal di tepi barat bumi dan tidak pernah meninggalkan rumahnya, bahkan untuk menghadiri sidang para dewa.
statement.en: Oceanus was said to dwell on the western shores of the earth and never left his home, not even to attend the assemblies of the gods.

basis_claims.quote: In an attempt to stop Hercules from reaching his grandson, Oceanus caused great waves to overcome the golden vessel that Hercules clung to. Hercules drew his bow and frightened Oceanus into calming the waters so he could reach Erytheia safely.

statement.id: Untuk menghentikan Hercules mencapai cucunya, Oceanus menimbulkan ombak besar yang menimpa kapal emas tempat Hercules berpegangan; Hercules menarik busurnya dan menakuti Oceanus hingga menenangkan air sehingga ia tiba dengan selamat di Erytheia.
statement.en: To stop Hercules from reaching his grandson, Oceanus caused great waves to overcome the golden vessel Hercules clung to; Hercules drew his bow and frightened Oceanus into calming the waters so he could reach Erytheia safely.

visual_requirements.description: one youthful usually beardless male head, exactly two arms, fully opaque PURPLE robes; documented shining solar aureole/crown of sun rays at head; ONE golden chariot drawn by EXACTLY FOUR WINGED HORSES, count all four distinct horses with one head/two wings/four legs each
the actual sun carried across the sky is behind his head and golden chariot; solar glare burns across clouds and sea, crown rays allowed documented solar aureole, no random flame beams or lightning
emerge at dawn from golden palace on River Okeanos at earth's far eastern ends, sky chariot above the river

helios.aura: Sun-bearing chariot c02/c12 with four winged horses and solar crown, one actual dominant sun, no generic aura

basis_claims.quote: Helios (also Helius) was the god of the Sun in Greek mythology.

statement.id: Helios adalah dewa matahari dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Helios is the Greek sun god.

basis_claims.quote: Helios rode a golden chariot which brought the Sun across the skies each day from the east (Ethiopia) to the west (Hesperides).

statement.id: Helios mengendarai kereta emas yang membawa matahari dari timur ke barat setiap hari.
statement.en: Helios drove a golden chariot bearing the sun from east to west each day.

basis_claims.quote: he emerged each dawn, crowned with the aureole of the sun, driving a chariot drawn by four winged steeds.

statement.id: Helios muncul setiap fajar dengan mahkota cahaya dan kereta empat kuda bersayap.
statement.en: Helios appears at dawn with a solar aureole and a chariot drawn by four winged horses.

basis_claims.quote: He dwelt in a golden palace in the River Okeanos (Oceanus) at the far ends of the earth from which he emerged each dawn

statement.id: Helios tinggal di istana emas di Sungai Okeanos di ujung bumi, tempat ia muncul setiap fajar.
statement.en: Helios dwelt in a golden palace in the River Okeanos (Oceanus) at the far ends of the earth, from which he emerged each dawn.

basis_claims.quote: Helios was depicted as a handsome, usually beardless, man clothed in purple robes and crowned with the shining aureole of the sun.

statement.id: Helios digambarkan sebagai pria tampan, biasanya tak berjanggut, berjubah ungu dan bermahkota lingkar cahaya matahari.
statement.en: Helios was depicted as a handsome, usually beardless man in purple robes, crowned with the shining aureole of the sun.

huitzilopochtli.depicted_variant: Blue-painted Huitzilopochtli stepping toward the low viewer on Mt Coatepec, with hummingbird-feather helmet, shield, and fire-serpent atlatl contacting rock.

visual_requirements.description: One humanlike deity with blue-painted visible forearms/hands/lower legs; snake-shaped atlatl and a distinct shield in two hands.
Helmet bearing hummingbird feathers, whole feather silhouette in frame.
The physical fire-serpent weapon burns and contacts volcanic stone with sparks and smoke.
Inert rocky slopes of Mt Coatepec, without unclaimed erupting volcanoes.

huitzilopochtli.aura: His fire-serpent weapon (huitzilopochtli-c02/c21) physically burns foreground stone; blue-painted limbs and hummingbird-feather helmet (c21/c22) identify the formidable solar-war deity (c06).

basis_claims.quote: He wielded Xiuhcoatl, the fire serpent, as a weapon, thus also associating Huitzilopochtli with fire.

statement.id: Ia menggunakan Xiuhcoatl sang ular api sebagai senjatanya.
statement.en: He wielded Xiuhcoatl, the fire serpent, as a weapon.

basis_claims.quote: He was the god of the sun and war, considered the patron of the Aztec capital Tenochtitlán and associated with gold, warriors and rulers.

statement.id: Ia dewa matahari dan perang, dianggap pelindung ibu kota Aztec Tenochtitlán, serta dikaitkan dengan emas, prajurit, dan penguasa.
statement.en: He was the god of the sun and war, considered the patron of the Aztec capital Tenochtitlán and associated with gold, warriors and rulers.

basis_claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli famously avenged the murder of his mother Coatlίcue (or in some versions actually saved her) when he defeated his siblings the 400 Centzonhuitznahuac and Centzonmimizcoa on Mt. Coatepec, the snake mountain.

statement.id: Huitzilopochtli terkenal membalas pembunuhan ibunya, Coatlícue (atau dalam beberapa versi justru menyelamatkannya), dengan mengalahkan saudara-saudaranya, 400 Centzonhuitznahuac dan Centzonmimizcoa, di Gunung Coatepec, gunung ular.
statement.en: Huitzilopochtli famously avenged the murder of his mother Coatlícue (or in some versions actually saved her) when he defeated his siblings, the 400 Centzonhuitznahuac and Centzonmimizcoa, on Mt. Coatepec, the snake mountain.

basis_claims.quote: Huitzilopochtli may be depicted carrying his snake-shaped spear-thrower (atl-atl) which represents the fire-serpent Xiuhcóatl. He may also carry a shield, hold feathered arrows or darts and be painted with blue arms and legs.

statement.id: Huitzilopochtli dapat digambarkan membawa pelontar tombak berbentuk ular (atl-atl) yang melambangkan ular api Xiuhcóatl; ia juga bisa membawa perisai atau anak panah berbulu dan dilukis dengan lengan dan kaki biru.
statement.en: Huitzilopochtli may be depicted carrying his snake-shaped spear-thrower (atl-atl), which represents the fire-serpent Xiuhcóatl; he may also carry a shield or feathered arrows or darts and be painted with blue arms and legs.

basis_claims.quote: The god could be symbolised by either a hummingbird (huitzilin) - whose feathers he wore in his helmet - or an eagle sitting on a prickly pear cactus holding a snake in one of its talons, an image seen today in the national flag of Mexico.

statement.id: Sang dewa dapat dilambangkan dengan kolibri (huitzilin), yang bulunya ia kenakan di helmnya, atau elang di atas kaktus pir berduri yang mencengkeram ular, gambar yang kini terlihat pada bendera nasional Meksiko.
statement.en: The god could be symbolised by a hummingbird (huitzilin), whose feathers he wore in his helmet, or by an eagle sitting on a prickly pear cactus holding a snake, an image seen today on the national flag of Mexico.

visual_requirements.description: one head, exactly two arms; Corinthian helmet pushed back to expose face, opaque belted chiton, a broad aegis bearing a clearly carved Medusa face, one shield on her left arm and one lance in right hand
No emitted supernatural effect; danger through forceful shield-and-lance movement and documented war/victory domain, no petrifying beam
her Capitol temple in Rome, stone pillars only as secondary framing

minerva.aura: War/victory domain c01 and shield/lance/aegis iconography c18/c37, no invented effect

basis_claims.quote: Minerva was the Roman goddess of wisdom, medicine, commerce, handicrafts, poetry, the arts in general, and later, war.

statement.id: Minerva adalah dewi Romawi yang dikaitkan dengan kebijaksanaan, kerajinan, seni, dan kemudian perang.
statement.en: Minerva was a Roman goddess of wisdom, crafts, arts, and later war.

basis_claims.quote: One of the most impressive representations of Minerva in art is the 3 metre high statue of the goddess which now resides in the Capitoline Museums in Rome. Dating to the 2nd century BCE, the standing figure wears a chiton and belt, an aegis with Medusa, carries a shield on her left arm and wears a Corinthian helmet pushed to the back of the head.

statement.id: Arca Minerva setinggi tiga meter di Museum Capitolini, Roma, bertarikh abad ke-2 SM; sosok berdirinya mengenakan chiton dan ikat pinggang, aegis dengan Medusa, membawa perisai di lengan kiri, dan mengenakan helm Korintus yang didorong ke belakang kepala.
statement.en: The 3 metre high statue of Minerva in the Capitoline Museums in Rome, dating to the 2nd century BCE, shows a standing figure who wears a chiton and belt and an aegis with Medusa, carries a shield on her left arm, and wears a Corinthian helmet pushed to the back of the head.

basis_claims.quote: Her oldest sanctuary at Rome was in the temple built by Tarquin on the Capitol, where she was worshipped with Jupiter and Juno.

statement.id: Tempat suci tertua Minerva di Roma berada di kuil yang dibangun Tarquin di Capitol, tempat ia dipuja bersama Jupiter dan Juno.
statement.en: Minerva's oldest sanctuary at Rome was in the temple built by Tarquin on the Capitol, where she was worshipped with Jupiter and Juno.

basis_claims.quote: And then she wove a portrait of herself, bearing a shield, and in her hand a lance,

statement.id: Dalam Ovid, Minerva menenun potret dirinya yang membawa perisai dan tombak di tangannya.
statement.en: In Ovid, Minerva wove a portrait of herself bearing a shield and a lance in her hand.

succubus.depicted_variant: Fully clothed adult woman-form succubus with two bird-taloned feet crouching forward as a nightmare visitor.

visual_requirements.description: Adult human woman with two bird-taloned feet clearly visible, otherwise human hands/head; no invented horns or wings, fully opaque clothing. Serpent tail occurs in alternative B only.
Appears within a nightmare/sleep-paralysis context; no physical magic emission invented.
Editorial dim European sleeping chamber presents documented dream visitation without sexual contact.

succubus.aura: Uncanny documented bird claws c07 and predatory dream-visitor posture in c01/c04 context establish menace; no invented power glow.

basis_claims.quote: A succubus ... succubi) is a female demon who was described in various European folklore as appearing in the dreams of male humans in order to seduce them.

statement.id: Succubus (jamak: succubi) adalah iblis perempuan yang dalam berbagai cerita rakyat Eropa digambarkan muncul dalam mimpi lelaki untuk merayu mereka.
statement.en: A succubus (plural succubi) is a female demon described in various European folklore as appearing in men's dreams to seduce them.

basis_claims.quote: Historically, folkloric belief in succubi was motivated by distressing nighttime phenomena, chiefly wet dreams and sleep paralysis.

statement.id: Secara historis, kepercayaan pada succubi didorong gejala malam yang meresahkan, terutama mimpi basah dan kelumpuhan tidur.
statement.en: Historically, belief in succubi was driven by distressing night phenomena, chiefly wet dreams and sleep paralysis.

basis_claims.quote: A succubus may take the form of a beautiful woman, but closer inspection may reveal deformities of her body, such as bird-like claws or serpentine tails.

statement.id: Succubus dapat berwujud perempuan cantik, tetapi bila diamati lebih dekat tampak cacat tubuhnya seperti cakar burung atau ekor ular.
statement.en: A succubus may look like a beautiful woman, but a closer look may reveal deformities such as bird-like claws or a serpent's tail.

visual_requirements.description: exactly TWO distinct heads side by side, both faces entirely visible, FOUR arms and FOUR hands separated clearly with ONE implement in each: fan, sacrificial ladle, axe, flaming javelin. Dark skin, opaque sacred tunic and long lower drapery. ONE goat mount with exactly one head, two horns and four legs, not a horse
sacrificial fire physically rises from offerings below and reflects on both faces; javelin bears real fire as documented attribute; no generic aura, no random destructive lightning
sacred offering ground with a great sacrificial fire, atmospheric devotional staging rather than ordinary campfire

agni.aura: Two-headed four-armed goat-mounted form c08 and fire/offerings c01/c06 with actual flaming attribute c26

basis_claims.quote: Agni is the Hindu god of fire.

statement.id: Agni adalah dewa api dalam tradisi Hindu.
statement.en: Agni is the Hindu god of fire.

basis_claims.quote: Agni is perhaps most closely associated with sacrificial fires where he is thought to carry the offerings of humans to the gods.

statement.id: Agni diyakini membawa persembahan manusia kepada para dewa melalui api kurban.
statement.en: Agni is believed to carry human offerings to the gods through sacrificial fire.

basis_claims.quote: In art, Agni is often depicted with black skin, two heads, four arms, and riding either a goat

statement.id: Dalam seni, Agni kerap ditampilkan berkulit gelap, berkepala dua, berlengan empat, dan menunggang kambing.
statement.en: In art, Agni is often shown with dark skin, two heads, four arms, and a goat mount.

basis_claims.quote: Typically he carries a fan (which he uses to build up fires), a sacrificial ladle, an axe, and a flaming torch or javelin.

statement.id: Dalam seni Hindu Agni biasanya membawa kipas untuk membesarkan api, sendok kurban, kapak, serta obor menyala atau lembing.
statement.en: In Hindu art Agni typically carries a fan used to build up fires, a sacrificial ladle, an axe, and a flaming torch or javelin.

visual_requirements.description: one human head, exactly two arms; striking Brisingamen necklace broad and clear; opaque dark red gown with high covered torso, falcon-feather cloak; holds one seidr staff; in the chariot variant EXACTLY TWO great cats draw one chariot, both cats clearly distinct

Her documented golden tears appear as actual small molten-looking gold droplets on cheeks in portrait, not beams or ribbons; in chariot scene only physical dust kicked by the two cats; no lightning or generic magic
Folkvangr, her heavenly dwelling and field where she receives half the battle dead; no modern designs or corpses/gore

freyja.aura: Documented two-cat chariot c05, seidr staff c03 and golden tears c21 convey divine identity without invented energy

basis_claims.quote: Freyja often carries a staff, a sign of her mastery of seiðr, a form of magic through which one can see into the future.

statement.id: Tongkat Freyja melambangkan penguasaannya atas seiðr, sihir untuk melihat masa depan.
statement.en: Freyja's staff signifies mastery of seiðr, a magic associated with foresight.

basis_claims.quote: When Freyja travels, she does so in a chariot drawn by two great cats

statement.id: Kereta Freyja ditarik oleh dua kucing besar.
statement.en: Freyja travels in a chariot drawn by two great cats.

basis_claims.quote: Freyja wore a jewel called Brísingamen. It was the most beautiful necklace in the world and greatly coveted.

statement.id: Freyja memiliki kalung Brísingamen yang sangat diinginkan.
statement.en: Freyja wore the coveted necklace Brísingamen.

basis_claims.quote: Another is a garment - a coat, cloak or dress-like thing - made out of falcon feathers.

statement.id: Salah satu atribut Freyja adalah pakaian dari bulu elang.
statement.en: One of Freyja's attributes is a garment of falcon feathers.

basis_claims.quote: Freyja is the most famous of the goddesses. She has in heaven a dwelling which is called Folkvang, and when she rides to the battle, one half of the slain belong to her, and the other half to Odin.

statement.id: Menurut Edda Muda, Freyja adalah dewi paling termasyhur; ia punya tempat tinggal di surga bernama Folkvang, dan ketika ia berkuda ke pertempuran separuh yang gugur menjadi miliknya dan separuh lagi milik Odin.
statement.en: According to the Younger Edda, Freyja is the most famous of the goddesses; she has a dwelling in heaven called Folkvang, and when she rides to battle half of the slain belong to her and half to Odin.

basis_claims.quote: Oder went far away. Freyja weeps for him, but her tears are red gold.

statement.id: Menurut Edda Muda, Oder pergi jauh dan Freyja menangisinya, tetapi air matanya adalah emas merah.
statement.en: According to the Younger Edda, Oder went far away and Freyja weeps for him, but her tears are red gold.

viracocha.depicted_variant: Alive bearded human-form Viracocha interpreting Tiwanaku sun-ray crown and two hand-held thunderbolts, striding out through rain and storm.

visual_requirements.description: Bearded human-form creator in fully opaque editorial woven robe, broad solar-ray crown, one thunderbolt in each of two visible hands; no staff in selected variant.
Physical forked lightning from thunderbolt-bearing hands into storm sky, rain/wet cheeks and water splashing under active step; no generic glow.
Alive deity before monumental Tiwanaku gateway, stone details editorial rather than a reproduction of archaeological structure.

viracocha.aura: Tiwanaku solar ray crown and thunderbolts c19, rain/physical storm lightning c19/c22, bearded creator c02/c01 and low active stride provide sacred grandeur.

basis_claims.quote: Viracocha (also Wiraqocha, Huiracocha; Quechua Wiraqucha) is the creator and supreme deity in the pre-Inca and Inca mythology in the Andes region of South America.

statement.id: Viracocha adalah dewa pencipta tertinggi dalam mitologi Inca di Andes.
statement.en: Viracocha is the creator and supreme deity in pre-Inca and Inca mythology in the Andes.

basis_claims.quote: According to the myth Viracocha had human appearance and was generally considered as bearded.

statement.id: Menurut mitos, Viracocha berwujud manusia dan umumnya digambarkan berjanggut.
statement.en: According to myth, Viracocha had human appearance and was generally considered bearded.

basis_claims.quote: Viracocha's decision to create the sun, moon and stars and so bring light to the world. These heavenly bodies were created from islands in Lake Titicaca.

statement.id: Viracocha menciptakan matahari, bulan, dan bintang sehingga membawa cahaya ke dunia; benda-benda langit itu dibuat dari pulau-pulau di Danau Titicaca.
statement.en: Viracocha created the sun, moon and stars and so brought light to the world; these heavenly bodies were created from islands in Lake Titicaca.

basis_claims.quote: In art Viracocha is often depicted as an old bearded man wearing a long robe and supported by a staff.

statement.id: Dalam seni, Viracocha sering digambarkan sebagai lelaki tua berjanggut berjubah panjang yang ditopang tongkat.
statement.en: In art Viracocha is often depicted as an old bearded man wearing a long robe and supported by a staff.

basis_claims.quote: One of his earliest representations may be the weeping statue at the ruins of Tiwanaku, close to Lake Titicaca, the traditional Inca site where all things were first created. Here, sculpted on the lintel of a massive gateway, the god holds thunderbolts in each hand and wears a crown with rays of the sun whilst his tears represent the rain.

statement.id: Pada ambang gerbang besar di Tiwanaku, sang dewa dipahat memegang petir di kedua tangan dan bermahkota sinar matahari, sementara air matanya melambangkan hujan.
statement.en: Sculpted on the lintel of a massive gateway at Tiwanaku, the god holds thunderbolts in each hand and wears a crown with rays of the sun, while his tears represent the rain.

basis_claims.quote: Viracocha created the universe, sun, moon, and stars, time (by commanding the sun to move over the sky) and civilization itself. Viracocha was worshipped as god of the sun and of storms.

statement.id: Viracocha menciptakan alam semesta, matahari, bulan, bintang, waktu (dengan memerintahkan matahari bergerak di langit), dan peradaban itu sendiri, serta dipuja sebagai dewa matahari dan badai.
statement.en: Viracocha created the universe, sun, moon and stars, time (by commanding the sun to move over the sky) and civilization itself, and was worshipped as god of the sun and of storms.

basis_claims.quote: According to a myth recorded by Juan de Betanzos, Viracocha rose from Lake Titicaca (or sometimes the cave of Paqariq Tampu) during the time of darkness to bring forth light.

statement.id: Menurut mitos yang dicatat Juan de Betanzos, Viracocha bangkit dari Danau Titicaca (atau kadang gua Paqariq Tampu) pada masa kegelapan untuk memunculkan cahaya.
statement.en: According to a myth recorded by Juan de Betanzos, Viracocha rose from Lake Titicaca (or sometimes the cave of Paqariq Tampu) during the time of darkness to bring forth light.

bull-demon-king.depicted_variant: The Bull Demon King's true giant white bull form lunging toward the viewer, mountain-sized head and two iron-tower horns.

visual_requirements.description: Giant white bull true form with mountain-like head and two tower horns, natural four-legged anatomy.
Physical rubble and dust under hoof impact, no supernatural visual effect.
Moyun Cave on Jilei Mountain.

bull-demon-king.aura: Ancaman berasal dari true form white bull bertubuh >1000 zhang dan tinggi800 zhang, kepala seperti gunung serta dua tanduk seperti iron towers (bull-demon-king-c13); hanya rubble/dust akibat fisik langkah, bukan kekuatan api.

basis_claims.quote: is a character and demon from the 16th century novel Journey to the West.

statement.id: Bull Demon King adalah tokoh dan iblis (demon) dari novel abad ke-16 Journey to the West (Perjalanan ke Barat).
statement.en: Bull Demon King is a character and demon from the 16th-century novel Journey to the West.

basis_claims.quote: 大力王乃羅剎女丈夫。他這向撇了羅剎，現在積雷山摩雲洞。有個萬年狐王，那狐王死了，遺下一個女兒，叫做玉面公主。

statement.id: Dalam novel, dewa bumi berkata bahwa Dàliwáng (大力王) adalah suami Luocha Nü (羅剎女), lalu meninggalkannya dan kini berada di Gua Moyun (摩雲洞) di Gunung Jilei (積雷山). Di sana tinggal Yumian Gongzhu (玉面公主), putri seorang raja rubah yang telah wafat.
statement.en: In the novel, the local earth deity says that Dàliwáng (大力王) is the husband of Luocha Nü (羅剎女), has abandoned her, and is now at Moyun Cave (摩雲洞) on Jilei Mountain (積雷山). There lives Yumian Gongzhu (玉面公主), the daughter of a fox king who has died.

basis_claims.quote: 牛王嘻嘻的笑了一笑，現出原身：一隻大白牛，頭如峻嶺，眼若閃光，兩隻角似兩座鐵塔，牙排利刃，連頭至尾有千餘丈長短，自蹄至背有八百丈高下。

statement.id: Dalam novel, Bull Demon King (牛王) menampakkan wujud aslinya (原身): seekor banteng putih besar (大白牛) dengan kepala bagai gunung terjal, dua tanduk bagai dua menara besi, panjang lebih dari seribu zhang dan tinggi delapan ratus zhang.
statement.en: In the novel, Bull Demon King (牛王) reveals his original form (原身): a great white bull (大白牛) with a head like a steep mountain and two horns like iron towers, more than a thousand zhang long and eight hundred zhang high.

visual_requirements.description: one fair male human face, exactly two arms and two legs, fully opaque rough charcoal tunic and dark trousers; bound wrists with old rope; NO horns, NO horned helmet, no modern movie costume. One small snake overhead belongs to venom punishment setting

Loki twists so violently that the earth shakes: the rock slabs below rupture physically, grit cascades from cavern roof and dusty fissures widen, documented earthquakes not random magic; small venom drops from snake, no gore
his punishment cave where Sigyn catches dripping venom; Sigyn can be omitted rather than invent an appearance, the snake and cave clearly present

loki.aura: Documented twisting that shakes earth c24, confinement c23 and venom punishment c11; danger through active earthquake and cunning gaze

basis_claims.quote: Loki is a god in Norse mythology who is often simply described as the 'trickster' god

statement.id: Loki adalah dewa penipu atau pengacau dalam mitologi Nordik.
statement.en: Loki is a trickster god in Norse myth.

basis_claims.quote: his wife Sigyn catches the worst of it in a bowl.

statement.id: Saat Loki dihukum dengan tetesan bisa, Sigyn menadah sebagian besarnya dalam mangkuk.
statement.en: When Loki is punished with dripping venom, Sigyn catches much of it in a bowl.

basis_claims.quote: Loke is fair and beautiful of face, but evil in disposition, and very fickle-minded.

statement.id: Edda Prosa menggambarkan Loke berparas rupawan, tetapi berwatak jahat dan sangat labil.
statement.en: The Prose Edda describes Loke as fair of face but evil in disposition and very fickle-minded.

basis_claims.quote: Now Loke was taken without truce and was brought to a cave.

statement.id: Loke akhirnya ditangkap tanpa gencatan dan dibawa ke sebuah gua.
statement.en: Loke was finally taken without truce and brought to a cave.

basis_claims.quote: Then he twists his body so violently that the whole earth shakes, and this you call earthquakes. There he will lie bound until Ragnarok.

statement.id: Dalam Edda Prosa, Loke menggeliat sampai seluruh bumi bergetar, yang disebut gempa bumi, dan ia terikat di sana sampai Ragnarok.
statement.en: In the Prose Edda, Loke twists so violently that the whole earth shakes, which is called earthquakes, and he lies bound there until Ragnarok.

nymph.depicted_variant: A freshwater Naiad rushing toward the viewer while a mortal is driven into nympholeptic madness at midday.

visual_requirements.description: Young Naiad woman with freshwater habitat attributes; normal human body and opaque robe.
Secondary mortal is driven into nympholeptic madness at midday, clutching temples; no rays or physical water-control.
Freshwater spring.

nymph.aura: Kesan supernatural berasal dari nympholepsy yang mengacaukan mortal (nymph-c21), wanita beratribut habitat mata air (c02/c06) dan langkah/close framing; tidak ada water-control atau aura generik.

basis_claims.quote: NYMPHAI (Nymphs) were female spirits of the natural world--minor goddesses of the forests, rivers, springs, meadows, mountains and seas.

statement.id: Nymph adalah dewi kecil atau roh perempuan alam dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Nymphs are minor female nature deities or spirits in Greek myth.

basis_claims.quote: The nymphs were depicted as beautiful young women with attributes matching their abode.

statement.id: Nymph digambarkan sebagai perempuan muda dengan ciri sesuai tempat tinggalnya.
statement.en: Nymphs are depicted as young women with attributes of their habitats.

basis_claims.quote: NAIADES (Naiads) were nymphs of the earthly sources of fresh-water, including springs, rivers, streams, wells and fountains.

statement.id: Naiad adalah Nymph air tawar yang terkait mata air, sungai, dan sumur.
statement.en: Naiads are freshwater nymphs of springs, rivers, streams, wells, and fountains.

basis_claims.quote: DRYADES (Dryads) were the nymphs of the trees, forests and groves.

statement.id: Dryad adalah Nymph pepohonan dan hutan.
statement.en: Dryads are nymphs of trees and forests.

basis_claims.quote: Nymphs of forests, groves, and glens, were believed sometimes to appear to and frighten solitary travellers.

statement.id: Nymph hutan, hutan kecil, dan lembah dipercaya kadang menampakkan diri dan menakuti pelancong yang sendirian.
statement.en: Nymphs of forests, groves, and glens were believed sometimes to appear to and frighten solitary travellers.

basis_claims.quote: Like Pan, nymphs within their natural habitat may drive mortals insane or insensate (known as nympholepsy), particularly at midday.

statement.id: Seperti Pan, nymph di habitat alaminya dapat membuat manusia gila atau tak sadarkan diri (nympholepsy), terutama pada tengah hari.
statement.en: Like Pan, nymphs in their natural habitat may drive mortals insane or insensate (nympholepsy), particularly at midday.

pluto-q152262.depicted_variant: Dark-bearded Pluto leaning forward from the underworld throne with his unworn helmet.

visual_requirements.description: Dark-bearded regal male counterpart of Hades in opaque editorial robe; unworn invisibility helmet.
No supernatural visual effect; fierce inexorable command and inactive helmet.
Throne in the dark lower world.

pluto-q152262.aura: Kesan kuasa datang dari penguasa Tartarus dan dunia bawah (pluto-q152262-c01/c04/c16), sosok regal berjanggut gelap serta sifat inexorable (c17/c18), dengan helm terdokumentasi c08 tidak diaktifkan.

basis_claims.quote: Pluto is the god of the Underworld in Roman mythology.

statement.id: Pluto adalah dewa dunia bawah dalam mitologi Romawi.
statement.en: Pluto is the Roman god of the underworld.

basis_claims.quote: His Greek counterpart was Hades.

statement.id: Padanan Yunani Pluto adalah Hades.
statement.en: Pluto's Greek counterpart is Hades.

basis_claims.quote: Pluto gained control of Tartarus and the Lower World

statement.id: Pluto memperoleh kuasa atas Tartarus dan dunia bawah.
statement.en: Pluto gained control of Tartarus and the lower world.

basis_claims.quote: Pluto held court seated on an ebony throne next to his queen Proserpina (Persephone), but she was a reluctant queen.

statement.id: Pluto duduk di takhta di sisi Ratu Proserpina, yang menjadi ratu dengan enggan.
statement.en: Pluto sits on a throne beside his reluctant queen Proserpina.

basis_claims.quote: Whenever he was on earth in search of a victim, Pluto rode in a chariot of gold drawn by four coal-black steeds.

statement.id: Pluto dikisahkan mengendarai kereta emas dengan empat kuda hitam ketika berada di bumi.
statement.en: Pluto is described as riding a golden chariot drawn by four black horses on earth.

basis_claims.quote: The helmet could give its wearer the power of invisibility.

statement.id: Helm milik Pluto membuat pemakainya tidak terlihat.
statement.en: Pluto's helmet could make its wearer invisible.

basis_claims.quote: When the three victorious brothers then drew lots for the division of the cosmos, Haides received the third portion, the dark dismal realm of the underworld, as his domain.

statement.id: Ketika tiga bersaudara pemenang mengundi pembagian kosmos, Hades menerima bagian ketiga, yaitu dunia bawah yang gelap dan suram.
statement.en: When the three victorious brothers drew lots for the division of the cosmos, Hades received the third portion, the dark dismal realm of the underworld.

basis_claims.quote: Haides was depicted as a dark-bearded, regal god.

statement.id: Hades digambarkan sebagai dewa berjanggut gelap dan berwibawa seperti raja.
statement.en: Hades was depicted as a dark-bearded, regal god.

basis_claims.quote: His character is described as fierce and inexorable, whence of all the gods he was most hated by mortals.
basis_claims.locator: Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology excerpt (Hades)

statement.id: Karakter Hades digambarkan garang dan tak kenal ampun, sehingga di antara semua dewa ia paling dibenci manusia.
statement.en: Hades's character is described as fierce and inexorable, so that of all the gods he was most hated by mortals.

basis_claims.quote: The smitten earth made way to Tartarus;
basis_claims.locator: Metamorphoses 5, Calliope sings of Ceres, Pluto and Proserpine

statement.id: Dalam Metamorphoses, bumi yang terhantam membuka jalan menuju Tartarus.
statement.en: In the Metamorphoses, the smitten earth makes way to Tartarus.

tlaloc.depicted_variant: Ring-eyed, jaguar-fanged Tlaloc leaning over a mountain spring, wielding a lightning bolt that strikes wet foreground rock.

visual_requirements.description: Two ringed/goggled eyes and large jaguar-like fangs on one readable face.
One deity wielding a lightning bolt, with conservative two-arm clothed presentation.
Lightning makes physical contact with wet rock while rain falls and spring water splashes.
Mountain rock and spring water.

tlaloc.aura: Documented rain and lightning (tlaloc-c03,c06,c15) physically strike wet stone; two ringed eyes and jaguar-like fangs (tlaloc-c16,c19) identify the imposing deity.

basis_claims.quote: is the god of rain in Aztec religion.

statement.id: Tláloc adalah dewa hujan dalam agama Aztec.
statement.en: Tláloc is the god of rain in Aztec religion.

basis_claims.quote: He was also a deity of earthly fertility and water, and worshipped as a giver of life and sustenance; many rituals and sacrifices predicated upon these aspects were held in his name.

statement.id: Ia adalah dewa kesuburan tanah dan air yang dipuja sebagai pemberi kehidupan.
statement.en: He was also a deity of earthly fertility and water, worshipped as a giver of life.

basis_claims.quote: He was feared—albeit not as a malicious figure—for his power over hail, thunder, lightning, and rain.

statement.id: Ia ditakuti karena kekuasaannya atas hujan es, guntur, dan kilat.
statement.en: He was feared for his power over hail, thunder, and lightning.

basis_claims.quote: He is also associated with caves, springs, and mountains, most specifically the sacred mountain where he was believed to reside.

statement.id: Ia diasosiasikan dengan gua, mata air, dan puncak gunung tinggi.
statement.en: He is also associated with caves, springs, and mountains.

basis_claims.quote: Tlaloc was seen as both a benevolent god providing life-giving rain but also as an unforgiving and destructive deity when he sent storms and drought.

statement.id: Tlaloc dipandang sebagai dewa yang murah hati karena memberi hujan penghidupan, tetapi juga sebagai dewa yang tak kenal ampun dan merusak ketika mengirim badai dan kekeringan.
statement.en: Tlaloc was seen both as a benevolent god providing life-giving rain and as an unforgiving, destructive deity when he sent storms and drought.

basis_claims.quote: The earliest representations of Tláloc in art belong to 1st century BCE vases from Tlapacoya where the god wields a lightning bolt.

statement.id: Penggambaran tertua Tláloc dalam seni berasal dari vas abad ke-1 SM di Tlapacoya, tempat sang dewa memegang petir.
statement.en: The earliest representations of Tláloc in art belong to 1st-century BCE vases from Tlapacoya, where the god wields a lightning bolt.

basis_claims.quote: Tláloc is commonly depicted in the company of snakes. He most often has goggled eyes and large fangs like a jaguar

statement.id: Tláloc lazim digambarkan bersama ular; ia paling sering bermata bulat besar seperti kacamata renang dan bertaring besar seperti jaguar.
statement.en: Tláloc is commonly depicted in the company of snakes, most often with goggled eyes and large fangs like a jaguar.

basis_claims.quote: Tláloc's two main identifiers are fangs, along with ringed eyes.

statement.id: Dua penanda utama Tláloc adalah taring dan mata bercincin.
statement.en: Tláloc's two main identifiers are fangs and ringed eyes.

vulcan.depicted_variant: Close hammer impact in volcanic forge

visual_requirements.description: one head, exactly two arms and two legs; weathered powerful lame blacksmith, one leg visibly unevenly braced rather than extra limbs; fully opaque soot-stained tunic and heavy leather apron covering chest and legs; hammer and tongs ordinary smithing tools

real forge fire and volcanic furnace heat flare while he forges arms for Aeneas; hot metal sparks explode at hammer impact, no generic magic aura; Jupiter's thunderbolt metalwork may rest on anvil as documented craft, not lightning fired by Vulcan
Vulcan's forge at Mount Aetna, black volcanic rock, subordinate molten furnace openings

vulcan.aura: Physical fire/volcanic forge c01/c05/c16 and making Aeneas' arms c08, not a mundane workshop

basis_claims.quote: Vulcan or Volcanus was the Roman god of fire and forge, the equivalent of Hephaestus from Greek mythology.

statement.id: Vulcan adalah dewa api dan penempaan Romawi, dipadankan dengan Hephaestus Yunani.
statement.en: Vulcan is the Roman god of fire and forge, equivalent to Greek Hephaestus.

basis_claims.quote: According to the Roman account, Vulcan withdrew to Mount Aetna where he established a great forge and partnered with the Cyclopes Bronte, Steropes, and Pyraemon.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Romawi, Vulcan menempa di Gunung Aetna bersama para Cyclopes.
statement.en: In a Roman account Vulcan established a forge at Mount Aetna with Cyclopes.

basis_claims.quote: Venus is concerned for her son Aeneas' safety and appeals to her husband Vulcan to make him weapons and armor.

statement.id: Dalam Aeneid, Venus meminta Vulcan membuat senjata dan zirah bagi Aeneas.
statement.en: In the Aeneid Venus asks Vulcan to forge arms for Aeneas.

basis_claims.quote: In Renaissance art, the Roman god of fire is usually shown in the character of a crippled blacksmith.

statement.id: Seni Renaisans sering menampilkan Vulcan sebagai pandai besi yang pincang.
statement.en: Renaissance art often depicts Vulcan as a lame blacksmith.

basis_claims.quote: Angry with his son's interference, Jupiter threw him out of heaven. Vulcan fell to earth for one full day and night, landing on the summit of Mount Mosychulus on the island of Lemnos. The severity of the fall left him lame and deformed

statement.id: Marah pada campur tangan putranya, Jupiter melemparkannya dari surga; Vulcan jatuh sehari semalam dan mendarat di puncak Gunung Mosychulus di pulau Lemnos, dan jatuhnya itu membuatnya pincang dan cacat.
statement.en: Angry with his son's interference, Jupiter threw him out of heaven; Vulcan fell for a full day and night, landing on the summit of Mount Mosychulus on Lemnos, and the fall left him lame and deformed.

basis_claims.quote: As the god of the forge and the devastating fire of both the environment and nature (volcanoes), Vulcan was probably among the most dreaded of all the gods.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa tempa dan api yang menghancurkan di lingkungan dan alam (gunung berapi), Vulcan mungkin termasuk dewa yang paling ditakuti.
statement.en: As god of the forge and of the devastating fire of environment and nature (volcanoes), Vulcan was probably among the most dreaded of all the gods.

basis_claims.quote: Vulcan returned to his forge where the Cyclopes were working on Jupiter's thunderbolts and Mars' chariot.

statement.id: Vulcan kembali ke bengkelnya tempat para Cyclopes mengerjakan petir Jupiter dan kereta Mars.
statement.en: Vulcan returned to his forge where the Cyclopes were working on Jupiter's thunderbolts and Mars' chariot.

ardhanarisvara.depicted_variant: Respectful single equal vertical Shiva-Parvati union, subject right male/viewer-left and subject left female/viewer-right, stepping forward in opaque robes.

visual_requirements.description: One unified equally vertically divided form: anatomical right half male Shiva (viewer-left), anatomical left half female Parvati (viewer-right), not two adjacent people or two heads.

ardhanarisvara.aura: Equal visibly united body c01/c02/c04/c07 and active sovereign stride symbolize universal synthesis c03; low natural backlight and editorial sacred scale, no invented power glow.

basis_claims.quote: Ardhanarishvara (Sanskrit: अर्धनारीश्वर, romanized: Ardhanārīśvara, lit. 'the half-female Lord') is a form of the Hindu deity Shiva combined with his consort Parvati. Ardhanarishvara is depicted as half-male and half-female, equally split down the middle.

statement.id: Ardhanarisvara adalah bentuk Shiva yang menyatu dengan Parvati.
statement.en: Ardhanarishvara is a form of Shiva united with Parvati.

basis_claims.quote: Ardhanarishvara (Sanskrit: अर्धनारीश्वर, romanized: Ardhanārīśvara, lit. 'the half-female Lord') is a form of the Hindu deity Shiva combined with his consort Parvati. Ardhanarishvara is depicted as half-male and half-female, equally split down the middle.

statement.id: Wujudnya dibagi sama rata menjadi setengah laki-laki dan setengah perempuan.
statement.en: The form is divided equally into half male and half female.

basis_claims.quote: Ardhanarishvara represents the synthesis of masculine and feminine energies of the universe (Purusha and Prakriti) and illustrates how Shakti, the female principle of God, is inseparable from (or the same as, according to some interpretations) Shiva, the male principle of God, and vice versa. The union of these principles is exalted as the root and womb of all creation.

statement.id: Ia melambangkan penyatuan energi maskulin dan feminin atau Purusha dan Prakriti.
statement.en: It symbolizes the union of masculine and feminine energies or Purusha and Prakriti.

basis_claims.quote: The right half is usually the male Shiva, illustrating his traditional attributes.

statement.id: Bagian kanan biasanya Shiva laki-laki.
statement.en: The right half is usually male Shiva.

basis_claims.quote: his form in which the left side is female and the right side is male.

statement.id: Deskripsi Cleveland tentang Ardhanarisvara memperlihatkan sisi kiri perempuan dan sisi kanan laki-laki.
statement.en: Cleveland's description of Ardhanarishvara shows the left side female and the right side male.

meretseger.depicted_variant: Meretseger as a living one-headed cobra guardian lunging from a Valley of Kings tomb doorway, expanded hood and visible venom fangs.

visual_requirements.description: Living single cobra-form protector, one head and one continuous legless serpentine body, expanded hood and normal natural cobra fangs; no human body, crown or fantasy extra heads.
Active warning/lunge with visible poisonous fangs and non-glowing liquid venom bead, source poisonous bite; no unsupported poison cloud or magical aura.
Protects Theban necropolis/Valley of Kings, rock-cut tomb/temple entrance and workers' worn stone appropriate peripheral setting.

meretseger.aura: Protective cobra form c01/c06 and immediate poisonous-bite threat c05, close hood/fang dominance and dark tomb staging c01/c04; no generic aura.

basis_claims.quote: Meretseger (also known as Mersegrit' or Mertseger) was a Theban cobra-goddess in ancient Egyptian religion, in charge with guarding and protecting the vast Theban Necropolis — on the west bank of the Nile, in front of Thebes — and especially the heavily guarded Valley of the Kings. Her cult was typical of the New Kingdom of Egypt (1550–1070 BC).

statement.id: Meretseger adalah dewi kobra Thebes yang melindungi nekropolis dan Lembah Para Raja.
statement.en: Meretseger is a Theban cobra goddess protecting the necropolis and Valley of the Kings.

basis_claims.quote: Meretseger was the patron of the artisans and workers of the village of Deir el-Medina, who built and decorated the great royal and noble tombs.

statement.id: Ia menjadi pelindung perajin dan pekerja Deir el-Medina.
statement.en: She is patron of Deir el-Medina’s artisans and workers.

basis_claims.quote: only small rock temples were dedicated to her

statement.id: Kuil batu kecil didedikasikan kepada Meretseger.
statement.en: Small rock temples are dedicated to Meretseger.

basis_claims.quote: It was believed that Meretseger punished the workers who committed a sacrilege (by stealing something from the royal graves or the building sites — copper instruments were particularly precious — as well as those who failed in an oath) poisoning them with her bite.

statement.id: Ia dipercaya menghukum pelanggaran dengan gigitan beracun tetapi menyembuhkan orang yang bertobat.
statement.en: She is believed to punish transgressions with a poisonous bite but heal the repentant.

basis_claims.quote: Meretseger - A protector goddess in the form of a cobra venerated at Thebes. Specifically, she guarded the necropolis of the Valley of the Kings.

statement.id: Ensiklopedia pendamping menegaskan perlindungannya atas Lembah Para Raja.
statement.en: The accompanying encyclopedia confirms her protection of the Valley of the Kings.

visual_requirements.description: one human female head, exactly two arms; clear mural crown like a small battlemented city, long veil and opaque dark gold full gown; documented throne with exactly two lions crouching one to each side; a large stone tightly wrapped in white swaddling cloth, NOT a real baby
No emitted magical power: she actively offers the disguised stone in the documented rescue ruse; overwhelming divine hierarchy, crown and lions convey might
Crete, site of her rescue of Zeus and worship; cavernous royal setting is editorial staging

rhea.aura: Documented Titan mother c01, mural crown/throne/two lions c21 and swaddled-stone rescue c05

basis_claims.quote: Rhea (also spelt Rheia) is a Titan and a mother goddess in Greek mythology.

statement.id: Rhea adalah Titan perempuan dan dewi ibu dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Rhea is a female Titan and mother goddess in Greek myth.

basis_claims.quote: Rhea meanwhile gave Kronos a stone wrapped in the swaddling-cloths to swallow in place of his newborn son.

statement.id: Rhea memberi Kronos batu berbalut kain sebagai pengganti Zeus bayi.
statement.en: Rhea gave Kronos a swaddled stone instead of infant Zeus.

basis_claims.quote: Cronos is said to have devoured all his children by Rhea, but when she was on the point of giving birth to Zeus, she, by the advice of her parents, went to Lyctus in Crete.

statement.id: Cronos dikisahkan menelan semua anaknya dari Rhea, tetapi ketika Rhea hampir melahirkan Zeus, atas saran orang tuanya ia pergi ke Lyctus di Kreta.
statement.en: Cronos is said to have devoured all his children by Rhea, but when she was about to give birth to Zeus she went, on her parents' advice, to Lyctus in Crete.

basis_claims.quote: she was seldom represented in a standing posture, but generally seated on a throne, adorned with the mural crown, from which a veil hangs down. Lions usually appear crouching on the right and left of her throne

statement.id: Rhea jarang digambarkan berdiri, umumnya duduk di singgasana dengan mahkota tembok dan cadar menjuntai; singa biasanya berjongkok di kanan dan kiri singgasananya.
statement.en: She was seldom represented standing, but generally seated on a throne, wearing the mural crown with a veil hanging down; lions usually appear crouching to the right and left of her throne.

hubal.depicted_variant: Human-shaped red-agate Hubal icon with its replacement gold right hand looming above a physical divination-arrow cast before the sacred treasure pit.

visual_requirements.description: One human-shaped red-agate cult statue with exactly one solid-gold replacement RIGHT hand, the rest red agate.
Divination arrows being physically cast and falling before the icon, without levitation or invented magical force.
Historical shrine interior over the sacred treasure pit.

hubal.aura: The red-agate human-shaped icon and single gold right hand (hubal-c02,c05,c06,c09) dominate the shrine; arrows physically cast before it convey its documented divination role (hubal-c03,c10).

basis_claims.quote: Hubal (bahasa Arab: هُبَل) adalah salah satu dewa yang dipuja masyarakat Arab Pra-Islam, terutama Bani Quraisy di Mekah.

statement.id: Hubal adalah dewa Arab pra-Islam yang terutama dipuja Quraisy di Mekah.
statement.en: Hubal is a pre-Islamic Arabian god particularly worshipped by the Quraysh in Mecca.

basis_claims.quote: Hubal dipuja dalam bentuk arca menyerupai manusia yang disemayamkan di dalam Ka'bah

statement.id: Hubal dipuja melalui arca menyerupai manusia di Ka’bah.
statement.en: Hubal is worshipped through a human-shaped statue in the Kaaba.

basis_claims.quote: meramal yang dilakukan dengan melemparkan anak-anak panah di hadapan arcanya.

statement.id: Ramalan dilakukan menggunakan anak panah di depan arca Hubal.
statement.en: Divination uses arrows placed before Hubal’s statue.

basis_claims.quote: arca Hubal dikatakan menyerupai manusia dan terbuat dari batu akik merah

statement.id: Ibn al-Kalbi menggambarkan arca Hubal sebagai sosok manusia dari akik merah.
statement.en: Ibn al-Kalbi describes Hubal’s statue as a human figure made of red agate.

basis_claims.quote: tangan kanannya sudah patah dan diganti dengan tangan dari emas.

statement.id: Dalam uraian itu, tangan kanan arca yang patah diganti dengan emas.
statement.en: In that account, the statue’s broken right hand is replaced with gold.

basis_claims.quote: Hobal was set up within the Temple over the pit that contained the sacred treasures. His chief function was connected with the sacred lot to which the Meccans were accustomed to betake themselves in all matters of difficulty.

statement.id: Britannica 1911 mencatat Hobal ditempatkan di dalam Bait di atas lubang yang berisi harta suci, dan fungsi utamanya terkait undian suci yang ditempuh orang Mekah dalam segala urusan sulit.
statement.en: The 1911 Britannica notes that Hobal was set up within the Temple over the pit containing the sacred treasures, and that his chief function was connected with the sacred lot to which the Meccans resorted in all matters of difficulty.

basis_claims.quote: Hisham Ibn Al-Kalbi's Book of Idols describes the image as shaped like a human, with the right hand broken off and replaced with a golden hand.

statement.id: Kitab al-Asnam karya Hisham Ibn Al-Kalbi menggambarkan arca itu berbentuk manusia, dengan tangan kanan yang patah diganti tangan emas.
statement.en: Hisham Ibn Al-Kalbi's Book of Idols describes the image as human-shaped, with the broken right hand replaced by a golden one.

basis_claims.quote: The god's icon was a human figure believed to control acts of divination, which was performed by tossing arrows before the statue.

statement.id: Arca Hubal berupa sosok manusia yang diyakini mengendalikan ramalan, yang dilakukan dengan melemparkan anak panah di hadapan arca.
statement.en: Hubal's icon was a human figure believed to control divination, performed by tossing arrows before the statue.

basis_claims.quote: More recent scholars have rejected this view, partly because it is speculation

statement.id: Sarjana yang lebih baru menolak pandangan dewa bulan itu, antara lain karena sifatnya spekulatif.
statement.en: More recent scholars have rejected the lunar-deity view, partly because it is speculation.

mothman.depicted_variant: Mothman in six-foot no-obvious-head/no-neck eyewitness form, shining red eyes in upper body and unmoving avian wings gliding beside a fleeing car.

visual_requirements.description: About-six-foot man-shaped body without obvious head/neck, two shining red eyes in upper torso, broad continuous shoulder contour and avian wings; no clear facial features or insect parts. White-wing seven-foot form occurs in alternative A only.
Silent gliding alongside car with rigid unmoving wings and localized shining red body-eyes; no magic beams or technology-disruption effect.
