Editorial nighttime Point Pleasant roadside/car-window viewpoint, industrial munitions-site context peripheral; no bridge-collapse scene.

mothman.aura: Uncanny headless shoulder/body with shining red torso eyes c31, silent rigid-wing pursuit c32; avian features c01, no invented magic beams or bridge-disaster power.

basis_claims.quote: Despite its name, the original sightings of the creature described avian, not lepidopteran, features.

statement.id: Meskipun dinamai Mothman, penampakan awal makhluk ini menggambarkan ciri burung dan bukan serangga.
statement.en: Despite its name, original sightings of the creature described avian, not lepidopteran, features.

basis_claims.quote: On November 15, 1966, two young couples from Point Pleasant-Roger and Linda Scarberry, Steve and Mary Mallette-told police they had seen a large black creature whose eyes "glowed red", standing at the side of the road near "the TNT area", the site of a former munitions plant from World War II.

statement.id: Pada 15 November 1966, dua pasangan muda dari Point Pleasant, Roger dan Linda Scarberry serta Steve dan Mary Mallette, memberi tahu polisi bahwa mereka melihat makhluk hitam besar bermata "menyala merah" di tepi jalan dekat "area TNT", bekas pabrik amunisi Perang Dunia II.
statement.en: On November 15, 1966, two young couples from Point Pleasant, Roger and Linda Scarberry and Steve and Mary Mallette, told police they had seen a large black creature whose eyes "glowed red" at the side of the road near "the TNT area", the site of a former World War II munitions plant.

basis_claims.quote: Linda Scarberry described it as a "slender, muscular man" about seven feet (2.1 m) tall with white wings. However, she was unable to discern its face due to the hypnotic effect of its eyes.

statement.id: Linda Scarberry menggambarkannya sebagai "lelaki langsing berotot" setinggi sekitar tujuh kaki dengan sayap putih, tetapi ia tidak dapat melihat wajahnya karena efek hipnotis dari matanya.
statement.en: Linda Scarberry described it as a "slender, muscular man" about seven feet tall with white wings, but she could not make out its face because of the hypnotic effect of its eyes.

basis_claims.quote: Distressed, the witnesses claimed they sped away at 100 miles per hour (160 km/h), reporting that the creature took flight and kept pace with their car, making a screeching sound during the pursuit.

statement.id: Para saksi mengaku melaju kabur dengan kecepatan 100 mil per jam, dan melaporkan bahwa makhluk itu terbang dan mengimbangi mobil mereka sambil mengeluarkan suara melengking selama pengejaran.
statement.en: The witnesses claimed they sped away at 100 miles per hour, reporting that the creature took flight and kept pace with their car, making a screeching sound during the pursuit.

basis_claims.quote: There the headlights glanced off something in the dark: a six-foot-tall, man-shaped thing. Shining red eyes stared back at them from a body without an obvious head or neck.

statement.id: Lampu depan mobil menyorot sesuatu di kegelapan: benda berbentuk manusia setinggi enam kaki, dengan mata merah menyala yang menatap dari tubuh tanpa kepala atau leher yang jelas.
statement.en: The headlights glanced off something in the dark: a six-foot-tall, man-shaped thing with shining red eyes staring from a body without an obvious head or neck.

basis_claims.quote: Spooked, the couples sped away, only to see the thing following them on silent, unmoving wings.

statement.id: Ketakutan, pasangan itu kabur, tetapi melihat benda itu mengikuti mereka dengan sayap yang senyap dan tak bergerak.
statement.en: Spooked, the couples sped away, only to see the thing following them on silent, unmoving wings.

visual_requirements.description: One living Chinese dragon with blue-green skin, one head and one long coiling body; restrained naturalistic dragon rendering, no additional heads or borrowed franchise design.
Rain strikes scales and splashes from the moving body as an environmental association of the eastern Azure Dragon; no claim that it generates lightning, fire or magical beams.
Variant A at a Taoist temple threshold reflecting its door-deity use; variant B above the eastern mountain landscape of Kyoto reflecting its protection of the east.

azure-dragon.aura: Dominance through blue-green Chinese dragon form (azure-dragon-c01/c14), low-angle guardian staging (azure-dragon-c05/c11) and environmental rain (azure-dragon-c07); no emitted aura or added supernatural attack.

basis_claims.quote: The Azure Dragon (simplified Chinese: 青龙; traditional Chinese: 青龍; pinyin: Qīnglóng) is one of the Dragon Gods who represent the mounts or chthonic forces of the Five Regions' Highest Deities (五方上帝; Wǔfāng Shàngdì). It is also one of the Four Symbols of the Chinese constellations, which are the astral representations of the Wufang Shangdi.

statement.id: Azure Dragon adalah naga Tiongkok yang termasuk Empat Lambang rasi.
statement.en: The Azure Dragon is a Chinese dragon counted among the Four Symbols of the constellations.

basis_claims.quote: The Azure Dragon represents the east and the spring season.

statement.id: Ia mewakili timur dan musim semi.
statement.en: It corresponds to the eastern direction and spring.

basis_claims.quote: The Azure Dragon appears as a door god at Taoist temples. He was represented on the tomb of Wang Hui (stone coffin, east side) at Xikang in Lushan. A rubbing of this was collected by David Crockett Graham and is in the Field Museum of Natural History. The dragon featured on the Chinese national flag in 1862–1912, and on the Twelve Symbols national emblem from 1913 to 1928.

statement.id: Azure Dragon juga muncul sebagai dewa pintu di kuil Tao.
statement.en: The Azure Dragon also appears as a door deity in Taoist temples.

basis_claims.quote: According to Dr Groot, the colour blue is chosen in China because this is the colour of the East, from where the rain must come; this quarter is represented by the Azure Dragon, the highest in rank among all the dragons.

statement.id: De Visser, mengutip De Groot, menulis bahwa warna biru dipilih di Tiongkok karena merupakan warna timur, asal hujan; penjuru ini diwakili Naga Biru-Hijau, yang tertinggi dalam peringkat di antara semua naga.
statement.en: De Visser, citing De Groot, writes that blue is chosen in China because it is the colour of the East, from where the rain must come; this quarter is represented by the Azure Dragon, the highest in rank among all the dragons.

basis_claims.quote: In Japan, the Azure Dragon is one of the four guardian spirits of cities and is believed to protect the city of Kyoto on the east.

statement.id: Di Jepang, Naga Biru-Hijau adalah satu dari empat roh penjaga kota dan dipercaya melindungi sisi timur Kyoto.
statement.en: In Japan, the Azure Dragon is one of the four guardian spirits of cities and is believed to protect the city of Kyoto on the east.

basis_claims.quote: It is also sometimes referred to as the Blue-Green Dragon, Green Dragon, or the Blue Dragon

statement.id: Naga ini kadang disebut juga Naga Biru-Hijau, Naga Hijau, atau Naga Biru.
statement.en: The dragon is also sometimes called the Blue-Green Dragon, Green Dragon, or Blue Dragon.

qilin.depicted_variant: The QI of Shuowen quoted by Kangxi: benevolent deer-bodied ox-tailed beast with exactly ONE horn, not Guo Pu's hornless version.

visual_requirements.description: Exact c10 Shuowen QI source variant: deer body, ox tail, one horn; distinct from Guo Pu hornless reading.
No documented power effect; dynamic physical movement of benevolent beast only.

qilin.aura: Keagungan berasal dari benevolent composite QI dengan satu tanduk, tubuh deer dan ox tail (qilin-c10); tidak ada fire/lightning atau kekuatan visual supernatural yang direka.

basis_claims.quote: is a legendary hooved chimerical creature that appears in Chinese mythology, and is said to appear with the imminent arrival or death of a sage or illustrious ruler. Qilin are a specific type of the lin mythological family of one-horned beasts.

statement.id: Qilin adalah makhluk campuran berkuku dalam mitologi Tiongkok.
statement.en: The qilin is a hoofed composite creature in Chinese mythology.

basis_claims.quote: 《說文》大麚也。麕身牛尾，狼額馬蹄，五彩腹下黃，高丈二。《玉篇》仁獸也。

statement.id: Kamus Kangxi mengutip Shuowen (說文) tentang lin (麟): disebut 大麚, berbadan 麕, berekor sapi, berdahi serigala, berkuku kuda, berwarna lima dengan perut kuning, dan tingginya tercatat 丈二. Kutipan lalu mengawali Yupian (玉篇) yang menyebutnya 仁獸.
statement.en: The Kangxi Dictionary, quoting the Shuowen (說文), describes the lin (麟) as a 大麚 with a 麕 body, an ox tail, a wolf forehead and horse hooves, five colours with a yellow belly, and a height recorded as 丈二. The quotation then begins the Yupian (玉篇) entry, which calls it a 仁獸 ("benevolent beast").

basis_claims.quote: 《玉篇》仁獸也。《詩·周南》麟之趾。《傳》麟信而應禮，以足至者也。

statement.id: Kamus Kangxi mengutip Yupian (玉篇) bahwa lin adalah 仁獸 ("binatang berbudi"), lalu menyebut syair Zhounan "Lin zhi zhi" (麟之趾) dari kitab Shi (詩) dan komentar Zhuan (傳) bahwa lin bersifat tepercaya dan menanggapi tata upacara.
statement.en: The Kangxi Dictionary quotes the Yupian (玉篇) that the lin is a 仁獸 ("benevolent beast"), then cites the Zhounan poem "Lin zhi zhi" (麟之趾) of the Shi (詩) and the Zhuan (傳) commentary that the lin is trustworthy and responds to ritual propriety.

basis_claims.quote: 《說文》仁獸也。麕身牛尾，一角。張揖云：牡曰麒，牝曰麟。郭璞曰：麒似麟而無角。

statement.id: Kamus Kangxi mengutip Shuowen (說文) bahwa qi (麒) adalah 仁獸 berbadan 麕, berekor sapi, dan bertanduk satu (一角); Zhang Yi (張揖) menyebut qi jantan (牡) dan lin betina (牝); Guo Pu (郭璞) menyatakan qi mirip lin tetapi tanpa tanduk (無角).
statement.en: The Kangxi Dictionary quotes the Shuowen (說文) that the qi (麒) is a 仁獸 ("benevolent beast") with a 麕 body, an ox tail and one horn (一角); Zhang Yi (張揖) says the qi is the male (牡) and the lin the female (牝); Guo Pu (郭璞) says the qi resembles the lin but has no horn (無角).

basis_claims.quote: 十四年春．西狩于大野．叔孫氏之車子鉏商獲麟．以為不祥．以賜虞人．仲尼觀之．曰．麟也．然後取之．

statement.id: Zuo Zhuan (春秋左氏傳) mencatat bahwa pada musim semi tahun keempat belas, dalam perburuan di Daye (大野) di barat, Chu Shang (鉏商) dari keluarga Shusun (叔孫氏) menangkap seekor lin (獲麟); hewan itu dianggap pertanda buruk (不祥) dan diberikan kepada penjaga hutan (虞人), lalu Zhongni (仲尼) memeriksanya dan berkata "麟也" ("itu lin"), sesudahnya hewan itu diambil.
statement.en: The Zuo Zhuan (春秋左氏傳) records that in the spring of the fourteenth year, during a hunt in the west at Daye (大野), Chu Shang (鉏商) of the Shusun clan (叔孫氏) caught a lin (獲麟); it was taken as inauspicious (不祥) and given to the forester (虞人), then Zhongni (仲尼) examined it and said "麟也" ("it is a lin"), after which it was taken.

makara.depicted_variant: The complete Ganapati Sthapati source version of the Makara, a living fish-bodied elephant-trunked lion-footed monkey-eyed pig-eared peacock-tailed guardian.

visual_requirements.description: Complete Ganapati Sthapati c15 variant: fish body, elephant trunk, lion feet, monkey eyes, pig ears and peacock tail; no traits imported from other variants.
Protective forward movement only, no documented supernatural visual power.
Temple gateway threshold guarded by living Makara.

makara.aura: Keagungan datang dari hybrid guardian anatomy lengkap Ganapati Sthapati (makara-c15) dan momen perlindungan ambang kuil (c03); tidak ada kuasa supernatural yang direka.

basis_claims.quote: is a legendary sea-creature in Hindu mythology. In Hindu astrology, Makara is equivalent to the Zodiac sign Capricorn.

statement.id: Makara adalah makhluk laut legendaris dalam mitologi Hindu; dalam astrologi Hindu, Makara setara dengan zodiak Capricorn.
statement.en: Makara is a legendary sea creature in Hindu mythology; in Hindu astrology, Makara is equivalent to the Zodiac sign Capricorn.

basis_claims.quote: Makara are considered guardians of gateways and thresholds, protecting throne rooms as well as entryways to temples;

statement.id: Makara dianggap penjaga gerbang dan ambang kuil serta ruang takhta.
statement.en: Makaras are regarded as guardians of gateways and thresholds of temples and throne rooms.

basis_claims.quote: During Vedic times when Indra was the god of heaven, Varuna (the Vedic water god) became the God of the seas and rode on makara, which was called "the water monster vehicle".
basis_claims.locator: Article text, section Vedic era iconography

statement.id: Pada masa Weda, Varuna (dewa air Weda) menjadi dewa lautan dan menunggang makara, yang disebut "kendaraan monster air".
statement.en: In Vedic times Varuna (the Vedic water god) became the god of the seas and rode on makara, which was called "the water monster vehicle".

basis_claims.quote: It is often depicted with a terrestrial (elephant, antelope etc.) front half and an aquatic (fish, crocodile etc.) back half.

statement.id: Makara sering digambarkan dengan separuh depan hewan darat (gajah, antelop, dan sebagainya) dan separuh belakang hewan air (ikan, buaya, dan sebagainya).
statement.en: Makara is often depicted with a terrestrial front half (elephant, antelope etc.) and an aquatic back half (fish, crocodile etc.).

basis_claims.quote: The leading Hindu temple architect and builder Ganapati Sthapati describes Makara as a mythical animal with the body of a fish, trunk of an elephant, feet of a lion, eyes of a monkey, ears of a pig, and the tail of a peacock.
basis_claims.locator: Article text, section Later Hindu iconography

statement.id: Arsitek dan pembangun kuil Hindu terkemuka, Ganapati Sthapati, menggambarkan makara sebagai hewan mitos bertubuh ikan, berbelalai gajah, berkaki singa, bermata kera, bertelinga babi, dan berekor merak.
statement.en: The leading Hindu temple architect and builder Ganapati Sthapati describes the makara as a mythical animal with the body of a fish, trunk of an elephant, feet of a lion, eyes of a monkey, ears of a pig, and the tail of a peacock.

mokele-mbembe.depicted_variant: Grey-brown long-necked elephant-bodied river cryptid physically pressing an empty canoe at a Congo swamp bend.

visual_requirements.description: Elephant-like four-leg body, long neck, one small head, one tail and smooth grey-brown skin; elephant/hippo size.
Physical approach/attack on an empty canoe causes river spray, without victims or magic.
Congo River swamp and eroded river-cut clay cave/bend.

mokele-mbembe.aura: Elephant/hippo bulk and unusual long-neck/small-head body (c03/c19) physically attack the canoe and raise heavy water spray (c04).

basis_claims.quote: is a mythical water-dwelling cryptid that is believed to exist in the Congo River Basin. It is variously described as a reptilian creature, a spirit, or a member of the extinct lineage of sauropods.

statement.id: Mokele-mbembe adalah kriptid mitos penghuni air yang dipercaya ada di Lembah Sungai Kongo, digambarkan beragam sebagai makhluk reptil, roh, atau anggota garis keturunan sauropoda yang punah.
statement.en: Mokele-mbembe is a mythical water-dwelling cryptid believed to exist in the Congo River Basin, variously described as a reptilian creature, a spirit, or a member of the extinct lineage of sauropods.

basis_claims.quote: The animal is said to be of a brownish-gray color with a smooth skin, its size is approximately that of an elephant; at least that of a hippopotamus.

statement.id: Dalam laporan yang dikutip, hewan itu dikatakan berwarna abu-abu kecokelatan, berkulit halus, dan berukuran kira-kira sebesar gajah, setidaknya sebesar kuda nil.
statement.en: In the quoted report, the animal is said to be brownish-gray with smooth skin and about the size of an elephant, at least that of a hippopotamus.

basis_claims.quote: Canoes coming near it are said to be doomed; the animal is said to attack the vessels at once and to kill the crews but without eating the bodies.

statement.id: Perahu yang mendekatinya dikatakan celaka; hewan itu disebut langsung menyerang perahu dan membunuh awaknya tanpa memakan jasadnya.
statement.en: Canoes that come near it are said to be doomed; it is said to attack the vessels at once and kill the crews without eating the bodies.

basis_claims.quote: The creature is said to live in the caves that have been washed out by the river in the clay of its shores at sharp bends.

statement.id: Makhluk itu dikatakan tinggal di gua-gua yang terkikis sungai pada tanah liat tepiannya di tikungan tajam.
statement.en: The creature is said to live in caves washed out by the river in the clay of its shores at sharp bends.

basis_claims.quote: its diet is said to be entirely vegetable.

statement.id: Makanannya dikatakan sepenuhnya nabati.
statement.en: Its diet is said to be entirely vegetable.

basis_claims.quote: Berdasarkan tradisi rakyat di lembah Sungai Kongo, Mokele-mbembe diketahui sebagai mahkluk pemakan tanaman dengan ukuran sebesar gajah atau kuda nil.

statement.id: Menurut tradisi rakyat di lembah Sungai Kongo, mokele-mbembe dikenal sebagai makhluk pemakan tanaman sebesar gajah atau kuda nil (gajah atau kuda nil).
statement.en: In the folk tradition of the Congo basin, the mokele-mbembe is known as a plant-eating creature as large as an elephant or hippopotamus (gajah atau kuda nil).

basis_claims.quote: Ia tinggal di Sungai Kongo dan wilayah rawa-rawa di sekitarnya

statement.id: Ia tinggal di Sungai Kongo dan wilayah rawa di sekitarnya (rawa-rawa).
statement.en: It lives in the Congo River and the swampy areas around it (rawa-rawa).

basis_claims.quote: Beberapa legenda menyebutkannya memiliki tubuh seperti gajah dengan leher panjang, ekor dan kepala kecil, berwarna coklat abu-abu

statement.id: Beberapa legenda menyebutnya bertubuh seperti gajah dengan leher panjang, ekor panjang, dan kepala kecil, berwarna cokelat keabu-abuan (coklat abu-abu).
statement.en: Some legends describe an elephant-like body with a long neck, a tail and a small head, grey-brown in colour (coklat abu-abu).

sesa.depicted_variant: Shesha the Hindu divine naga, in the exactly FIVE-hood iconographic form, unfolding above a great coiled body in cosmic space.

visual_requirements.description: Exact five-hood iconographic Shesha: one coiled limbless serpent body, five necks/heads/hoods, ten eyes.
No supernatural power effect: physical unfolding of heads and documented floating coiled form only.
Cosmic space explicitly named in accepted c05 quote; no unresearched beings or light aura.

sesa.aura: Keagungan berasal dari divine naga/king of serpents (sesa-c01) dan tepat lima hood heads serta coiled form di cosmic space (c05); tidak ada kuasa elemental atau aura rekaan.

basis_claims.quote: is a serpentine naga (serpent deity), and king of the serpents (Nagaraja), and a primordial being of creation in Hinduism.

statement.id: Shesha adalah naga ilahi, raja ular, dan makhluk primordial penciptaan dalam Hindu.
statement.en: Shesha is a divine naga, king of serpents, and primordial creation being in Hinduism.

basis_claims.quote: Vishnu, in his Narayana form, is traditionally depicted as resting on Shesha alongside his consort Lakshmi.

statement.id: Vishnu dalam bentuk Narayana lazim digambarkan beristirahat di atas Shesha bersama Lakshmi.
statement.en: Vishnu as Narayana is commonly depicted resting on Shesha with Lakshmi.

basis_claims.quote: Shesha is generally depicted with a large coiled form floating through cosmic space or upon the Ocean of Milk, forming the bed upon which Vishnu rests. In iconography, he is depicted with multiple hoods—often five, seven or ten—though classical texts frequently describe him with one thousand crowned heads.

statement.id: Ikonografinya dapat berkepala lima, tujuh, atau sepuluh, sementara teks klasik sering menyebut seribu kepala.
statement.en: His iconography can have five, seven, or ten hoods, while classical texts often describe a thousand heads.

adad.depicted_variant: Clothed storm deity driving lightning toward wet rock with a bull alongside.

visual_requirements.description: Conservative clothed deity carrying one lightning bolt, alongside one separate bull; not riding.
Real storm lightning contacts wet rock with rain and water spray.
Plain editorial storm ground expressing storm domain.

adad.aura: Storm identity and held lightning (adad-c01/c04) act physically through rain and lightning contact; separate bull follows c03.

basis_claims.quote: ADAD - The Babylonian god of storms

statement.id: Adad adalah dewa badai Babilonia.
statement.en: Adad is a Babylonian storm deity.

basis_claims.quote: he is depicted with a lion-headed dragon or a bull

statement.id: Adad digambarkan bersama naga berkepala singa atau banteng.
statement.en: Adad is depicted with a lion-headed dragon or a bull.

basis_claims.quote: carrying a hammer or lightning bolt.

statement.id: Adad digambarkan membawa palu atau petir.
statement.en: Adad is depicted carrying a hammer or lightning bolt.

black-tortoise.depicted_variant: Living dark turtle intertwined with one coherent snake, advancing toward low viewer on winter-frosted ground.

visual_requirements.description: One living turtle with one head/two eyes/four legs, intertwined with exactly one coherent limbless snake with one separate head and continuous body/tail.
No invented elemental magic; sacred authority through living bodily action of documented spiritual turtle/snake.
Minimal cold/frosty ground as editorial northern/winter association, no claimed specific habitat.

black-tortoise.aura: The sacred living turtle/snake conjunction (black-tortoise-c01/c08) dominates through close bodily advance; northern/winter association (c03/c04) informs ordinary frost without elemental magic.

basis_claims.quote: The Black Turtle-Snake (Chinese: 玄武; pinyin: Xuánwǔ) is one of the Four Symbols of the Chinese constellations. It is usually depicted as a tortoise or turtle, intertwined with a snake.

statement.id: Black Tortoise atau Xuanwu adalah lambang rasi Tiongkok berupa kura-kura yang dililit ular.
statement.en: Black Tortoise, or Xuanwu, is a Chinese constellation symbol showing a turtle intertwined with a snake.

basis_claims.quote: It represents the north, thus it is sometimes called Black Warrior of the North (北方玄武; Běifāng Xuánwǔ).

statement.id: Xuanwu dikaitkan dengan arah utara.
statement.en: Xuanwu is associated with the northern direction.

basis_claims.quote: While neither character xuan (玄) or wu (武) literally means turtle, tortoise or snake, tortoises and snakes are known to hibernate during winter, so xuanwu (玄武) as a whole represents the season of winter.

statement.id: Kura-kura dan ular yang berhibernasi mendasari hubungannya dengan musim dingin.
statement.en: The winter association draws on the hibernation of turtles and snakes.

basis_claims.quote: In ancient China, the tortoise (or turtle) and the serpent were thought to be spiritual creatures symbolizing longevity.

statement.id: Di Tiongkok kuno, kura-kura dan ular dianggap makhluk spiritual yang melambangkan umur panjang.
statement.en: In ancient China, the tortoise (or turtle) and the serpent were thought to be spiritual creatures symbolizing longevity.

inti.depicted_variant: Inti as living solar golden-mask visage integrated into a physically blazing sun above a tiny editorial Coricancha court, no human body.

visual_requirements.description: Living sun manifestation with central golden-mask visage, one integrated face and no human torso/arms/legs; editorial face details from source mask representation.
Physical solar radiance/blazing photosphere lights subordinate world; no lasers or unrelated magic, eclipse occurs only in alternative A.
Tiny editorial Coricancha temple courtyard/assembly below dominating solar manifestation, temple dedicated to Inti.

inti.aura: Actual sun manifestation c08 with golden-mask/disk source form c16, physical solar radiance and world-governing sacred authority c05; no invented adult anatomy or unrelated magical aura.

basis_claims.quote: Inti was the Inca god of the sun and considered all-powerful but he was also a benevolent god and capable of great generosity.

statement.id: Inti adalah dewa matahari Inca yang dianggap mahakuasa, tetapi juga dewa yang murah hati dan mampu bersikap sangat dermawan.
statement.en: Inti was the Inca god of the sun, considered all-powerful, but also a benevolent god capable of great generosity.

basis_claims.quote: However, Inti could be angered and he would demonstrate his displeasure through solar eclipses which necessitated sacrifices to win back the god's good favour.

statement.id: Inti dapat murka dan menunjukkan ketidaksenangannya lewat gerhana matahari, yang menuntut persembahan untuk memulihkan kembali kemurahan sang dewa.
statement.en: Inti could be angered and showed his displeasure through solar eclipses, which called for sacrifices to win back the god's good favour.

basis_claims.quote: Inti was the sun, which in Inca mythology was created by the supreme Inca deity Viracocha from an island on Lake Titicaca.

statement.id: Inti adalah matahari, yang dalam mitologi Inca diciptakan oleh dewa tertinggi Inca, Viracocha, dari sebuah pulau di Danau Titicaca.
statement.en: Inti was the sun, which in Inca mythology was created by the supreme Inca deity Viracocha from an island on Lake Titicaca.

basis_claims.quote: The Coricancha temple ('House of the Sun') and Sacsahuaman sacred precinct at the Inca capital of Cuzco were dedicated to Inti.

statement.id: Kuil Coricancha ('Rumah Matahari') dan kawasan suci Sacsahuaman di ibu kota Inca, Cuzco, dipersembahkan kepada Inti.
statement.en: The Coricancha temple ('House of the Sun') and the Sacsahuaman sacred precinct at the Inca capital Cuzco were dedicated to Inti.

basis_claims.quote: Inti was not often represented in Inca art but when he was it was usually as a gold statue, a sun disk or a golden mask. Gold was particularly associated with the god as it was believed that the precious metal was the sweat of the sun.

statement.id: Inti jarang digambarkan dalam seni Inca, dan bila digambarkan biasanya sebagai patung emas, cakram matahari, atau topeng emas; emas dikaitkan dengan sang dewa karena dipercaya sebagai keringat matahari.
statement.en: Inti was not often represented in Inca art, and when he was it was usually as a gold statue, a sun disk or a golden mask; gold was associated with the god because it was believed to be the sweat of the sun.

pachamama.depicted_variant: Pachamama in source woman-with-potato-harvest form, cosmic-mother devotional hierarchy above small Andean terraces and flourishing earth.

visual_requirements.description: Source woman bearing clearly visible harvest of potatoes in both hands, one head/two arms/hands, fully opaque editorial Andean shawl/skirt. Coca leaves occur in alternative B only.
Earth visibly flourishes with living shoots, roots and plants, interpreting cosmic fertility/life sustenance; no generic magical emission.
Andean earthly sacred landscape with rocks/tree shrine motifs; monumentality uses editorial cosmic-mother hierarchy rather than documented giant anatomy.

pachamama.aura: Potato-bearing source woman c08 and visibly flourishing living earth c04/c14, with editorial cosmic-mother hierarchy and natural light, no unrelated magical aura.

basis_claims.quote: or Mama Pacha ... is the Andean deity representing space-time, revered by the peoples of the Andes.

statement.id: Pachamama atau Mama Pacha adalah dewa Andes yang mewakili ruang-waktu dan dipuja oleh bangsa-bangsa Andes.
statement.en: Pachamama or Mama Pacha is the Andean deity representing space-time, revered by the peoples of the Andes.

basis_claims.quote: She is considered an omnipresent deity with creative power, capable of sustaining life in the cosmos.

statement.id: Ia dianggap dewa yang hadir di mana-mana dan memiliki daya cipta untuk menopang kehidupan di kosmos.
statement.en: She is considered an omnipresent deity with creative power, capable of sustaining life in the cosmos.

basis_claims.quote: Pachamama was commonly worshipped in her earthly manifestation or form called Allpamama or Mama Allpa (goddess of the earth), her shrines consisted of sacred rocks or the trunks of legendary trees, and artists depicted her as a woman bearing harvests of potatoes or coca leaves.

statement.id: Pachamama umum dipuja dalam wujud duniawinya yang disebut Allpamama atau Mama Allpa (dewi bumi); kuilnya berupa batu keramat atau batang pohon legendaris, dan seniman menggambarkannya sebagai perempuan pembawa hasil panen kentang atau daun koka.
statement.en: Pachamama was commonly worshipped in her earthly form called Allpamama or Mama Allpa (goddess of the earth); her shrines were sacred rocks or the trunks of legendary trees, and artists depicted her as a woman bearing harvests of potatoes or coca leaves.

basis_claims.quote: Pachamama plays the role of cosmic mother; from Pachamama's fertility, the cosmos is born, the earth is fertilized, and then it flourishes.

statement.id: Pachamama berperan sebagai ibu kosmik; dari kesuburannya kosmos lahir, bumi disuburkan, dan kemudian berkembang.
statement.en: Pachamama plays the role of cosmic mother; from her fertility the cosmos is born, the earth is fertilized, and it then flourishes.

vajrapani.depicted_variant: Wrathful human-form Vajrapani stepping toward viewer with a double-ended vajra in the right hand and empty left protective palm.

visual_requirements.description: Documented human form holding one vajra in RIGHT hand; conservative one head/two eyes/two arms, complete opaque Buddhist robes.
No unsupported physical magic; wrathful protective expression and purposeful body movement only.

vajrapani.aura: Documented human form and right-hand vajra (vajrapani-c05), wrathful expression (c06), and protective role (c01) create forceful authority without invented elemental effects.

basis_claims.quote: is one of the earliest-appearing bodhisattvas in Mahayana Buddhism. He is the protector and guide of Gautama Buddha and rose to symbolize the Buddha's power.

statement.id: Vajrapani adalah bodhisatwa dalam Buddhisme Mahayana dan pelindung serta pembimbing Buddha Gautama.
statement.en: Vajrapani is a Mahayana bodhisattva and protector and guide of Gautama Buddha.

basis_claims.quote: Manjushri manifests all the Buddhas' wisdom, Avalokiteśvara manifests all the Buddhas' immense compassion, and Vajrapāni protects Buddha and manifests all the Buddhas' power

statement.id: Ia melambangkan daya Buddha, bersama Manjushri yang melambangkan kebijaksanaan dan Avalokiteshvara yang melambangkan belas kasih.
statement.en: He symbolizes the Buddha's power alongside Manjushri symbolizing wisdom and Avalokiteshvara symbolizing compassion.

basis_claims.quote: In human form Vajrapāni is depicted holding the vajra in his right hand.

statement.id: Wujud manusianya digambarkan memegang vajra di tangan kanan.
statement.en: His human form is depicted holding a vajra in the right hand.

basis_claims.quote: Vajrapani is more typically shown in a wrathful form and known as Guhyapati - 'the Lord of Secrets.'

statement.id: HAR menyatakan Vajrapani dalam tradisi Vajrayana sering digambarkan murka dan dikenal sebagai Guhyapati.
statement.en: HAR states that Vajrapani in Vajrayana is often depicted wrathfully and known as Guhyapati.

mahishasura.depicted_variant: Mahishasura in the WHE human-body/buffalo-head form, charging toward viewer without a weapon.

visual_requirements.description: One buffalo head with two natural horns and two eyes on a fully clothed human body with two arms/two legs and human hands.
No supernatural effects; physical charge/emergence and ordinary dust, no duplicated transformation anatomy.

mahishasura.aura: The buffalo head on human body (mahishasura-c07) and hostile purposeful charge express the asura with evil intentions (c02), without added power effects.

basis_claims.quote: is a bovine asura in Hinduism. He is depicted in Hindu literature as a deceitful demon who pursued his evil ways by shape-shifting.

statement.id: Mahishasura adalah asura berwujud kerbau dalam Hindu.
statement.en: Mahishasura is a bovine asura in Hinduism.

basis_claims.quote: Mahishasura (Sanskrit: महिषासुर, IAST: Mahiṣāsura), (Kannada: ಮಹಿಷಾಸುರ) is a bovine asura in Hinduism. He is depicted in Hindu literature as a deceitful demon who pursued his evil ways by shape-shifting. Mahishasura was the son of the asura Rambha and the brother of buffalo-demoness named Mahishi.

statement.id: Cerita menggambarkannya menggunakan perubahan wujud untuk menjalankan niat jahat.
statement.en: The narrative depicts him using shape shifting to pursue evil intentions.

basis_claims.quote: Mahisa, the demon who had the body of a man and the head of a buffalo

statement.id: Versi WHE menggambarkan Mahisa bertubuh manusia dan berkepala kerbau.
statement.en: WHE's version depicts Mahisa with a human body and buffalo head.

rahu.depicted_variant: Immortal head-only Rahu in oblique close profile physically swallowing a partly occluded moon disk.

visual_requirements.description: One immortal humanlike HEAD only, no Ketu body, no cut/wound/gore and conservative two-eye face.
A single sun or moon disk visibly enters mouth and is partly occluded, depicting documented eclipse swallowing.
Eclipse sky from the documented celestial deed.

rahu.aura: Immortal head separated conceptually from Ketu body (rahu-c05) swallows the sun/moon in eclipse deed (c06); physically occluded disk supplies cosmic grandeur and light.

basis_claims.quote: Vishnu, as Mohini, cut off Svarbhanu's head with his discus, the Sudarshana Chakra. ... his head came to be known as Rahu, while his body came to be known as Ketu.

statement.id: Kepala yang dipotong Vishnu disebut Rahu, sedangkan tubuhnya disebut Ketu.
statement.en: The head severed by Vishnu is called Rahu, while the body is called Ketu.

basis_claims.quote:
One of the terrible Asuras is the demon Rahu, who
causes eclipses by swallowing the sun and the moon, like
the Chinese dragon, the wolf Managarm of Teutonic
mythology, and the Grecian demons who devour Helena,
the sun maiden, sister of the twin Dioscuri. In the
Vedic period Rahu was represented by the demon Svarbhanu.

statement.id: Mackenzie menggambarkan Rahu sebagai demon yang menyebabkan gerhana dengan menelan Matahari dan Bulan.
statement.en: Mackenzie depicts Rahu as a demon causing eclipses by swallowing the sun and moon.

white-dragon-horse.depicted_variant: Wujud naga akhir novel dengan tanduk, sisik emas, dan janggut perak, terbang mengitari tiang gerbang gunung.

visual_requirements.description: Naga bertanduk, sisik emas, janggut perak; satu kepala, tanpa sayap atau kepala tambahan.
Terbang dan mulai melingkar pada tiang tinggi; debu dan kain kabut bergerak sebagai konsekuensi geraknya, tanpa energi generik.
Tiang tinggi di gerbang gunung setelah pengangkatan surgawi.

white-dragon-horse.aura: Keagungan hadir dari transformasi naga bertanduk dan sisik emas yang terbang mengitari tiang tinggi (white-dragon-horse-c23).

basis_claims.quote: 又叫那白馬：「汝本是西洋大海廣晉龍王之子，因汝違逆父命，犯了不孝之罪。幸得皈身皈法，皈我沙門，每日家虧你馱負聖僧來西，又虧你馱負聖經去東，亦有功者，加陞汝職正果，為八部天龍馬。」

statement.id: Di akhir novel, Buddha memanggil kuda putih itu dan berkata ia putra Raja Naga Guangjin (廣晉) dari Samudra Barat, bersalah tidak berbakti karena melawan perintah ayahnya; karena jasanya memikul biksu ke barat dan kitab ke timur, ia dinaikkan menjadi Kuda Naga Delapan Bagian Surgawi (八部天龍馬).
statement.en: At the end of the novel the Buddha addresses the white horse and says he is a son of the Dragon King Guangjin (廣晉) of the Western Ocean, guilty of unfilial conduct for defying his father's order; for carrying the holy monk west and the scriptures east he is raised to the Dragon Horse of the Eight Heavenly Sections (八部天龍馬).

basis_claims.quote: 須臾間，那馬打個展身，即退了毛皮，換了頭角，渾身上長起金鱗，腮頷下生出銀鬚，一身瑞氣，四爪祥雲，飛出化龍池，盤繞在山門裡擎天華表柱上。

statement.id: Setelah dimasukkan ke Kolam Perubahan Naga, kuda itu meregangkan tubuh, menanggalkan bulu dan kulit, bertanduk, bersisik emas, berjanggut perak, lalu terbang dan melingkar di tiang tinggi di gerbang gunung.
statement.en: After being put into the Dragon-Transforming Pool the horse stretches, sheds its hair and skin, grows horns, gold scales and a silver beard, and flies out to coil around a tall pillar at the mountain gate.

melon-heads.depicted_variant: Satu humanoid berkepala balon besar dari legenda hutan malam, menerobos semak untuk mengejar orang.

visual_requirements.description: Humanoid satu kepala sangat besar seperti balon, dua mata, dua lengan, dua kaki; pakaian penuh buram.
Mengejar manusia; tidak menambahkan kekuatan supernatural.
Hutan pada malam hari.

melon-heads.aura: Ancaman berasal dari siluet berkepala besar dan pengejaran hutan malam (c01/c12/c17) (klaim: melon-heads-c12, melon-heads-c17).

basis_claims.quote: In the American folklore of Ohio, Michigan and Connecticut, melon heads are beings generally described as large-headed humanoids with bulbous large craniums who occasionally emerge from hiding places to attack people.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Ohio, Michigan, dan Connecticut, melon heads adalah makhluk mirip manusia berkepala sangat besar yang sesekali keluar dari persembunyian untuk menyerang orang.
statement.en: In the folklore of Ohio, Michigan and Connecticut, melon heads are large-headed humanoids who sometimes emerge from hiding to attack people.

basis_claims.quote: Melon Heads allegedly prey upon humans who wander into their territory.

statement.id: Melon heads konon memangsa manusia yang tersesat ke wilayah mereka.
statement.en: Melon Heads allegedly prey upon humans who wander into their territory.

basis_claims.quote: children with great big balloon-like heads, chasing people through the forests at night, appearing by the side of the road to frighten motorists, and striking fear into the hearts of those unlucky enough to encounter them.

statement.id: Skeptoid menggambarkan legenda urban melon heads sebagai anak-anak berkepala besar seperti balon yang mengejar orang di hutan pada malam hari dan muncul di pinggir jalan untuk menakuti pengendara.
statement.en: Skeptoid describes the melon head urban legend as children with great balloon-like heads who chase people through forests at night and appear by the roadside to frighten motorists.

ma-bong.depicted_variant: Roh Lanna dalam varian tubuh kuda dan kepala manusia laki-laki c14, bermata merah c13, mengejar di pekarangan rumah.

visual_requirements.description: Satu kepala laki-laki manusia di tubuh kuda berbulu, empat kaki kuda; mata merah bagai cahaya api.
Mengejar dan berputar marah; jejak kuku di tanah, tanpa api atau efek kuasa lain.
Pekarangan rumah dan tangga rumah malam hari.

ma-bong.aura: Ancaman dari hibrida kepala manusia/tubuh kuda bermata merah dan derap dekat rumah (c13/c14/c15) (klaim: ma-bong-c13, ma-bong-c14, ma-bong-c15).

basis_claims.quote: ราวอ้ายคำเป็นอีกคนหนึ่งไปแล้ว ตาแดงเป็นแสงไฟ วิ่งไล่ตามมาติดๆ
basis_claims.locator: เรื่องเล่าผีม้าบ้อง

statement.id: Sahabat itu seolah telah menjadi orang lain, bermata merah seperti cahaya api, dan mengejar dari dekat.
statement.en: The friend seemed to have become someone else, with eyes red like firelight, and chased close behind.

basis_claims.quote: เห็นอ้ายคำงุ่นง่านโกรธจัด เดินวนรอบเรือน พลางพูดซ้ำๆ ว่า “บ้านใช่ บันไดไม่ใช่” “บ้านใช่ บันไดไม่ใช่” ทว่า ใบหน้าและหัวเป็นของอ้ายคำ แต่ลำตัวเป็นม้า
basis_claims.locator: เรื่องเล่าผีม้าบ้อง

statement.id: Sahabat itu berjalan mengitari rumah dengan marah sambil mengulang bahwa rumahnya benar tetapi tangganya bukan; wajah dan kepalanya masih milik sahabat itu, tetapi tubuhnya tubuh kuda.
statement.en: The friend circles the house in a rage, repeating that the house is right but the ladder is not; his face and head are still the friend's, but his body is a horse's.

basis_claims.quote: ตกรุ่งเช้า ที่ลานดินรอบบ้าน ก็ปรากฏเป็นดั่งรอยตีนม้าย่ำแวดล้อม
basis_claims.locator: เรื่องเล่าผีม้าบ้อง

statement.id: Keesokan paginya, di tanah halaman sekeliling rumah tampak seperti jejak kaki kuda yang mengitarinya.
statement.en: The next morning, on the dirt yard around the house, what looked like horse hoofprints were found all around it.

basis_claims.quote: เวลาตกกลางค่ำกลางคืน สมัยที่บันไดยึดติดถาวรแล้ว ก็ยังมีคำสอนว่า ระวังจะลงไปเจอผีม้าบ้องซุ่มอยู่
basis_claims.locator: ส่วนท้ายของบทความ

statement.id: Pada malam hari, bahkan setelah tangga rumah dipasang permanen, masih ada nasihat agar berhati-hati jangan sampai turun dan bertemu phi ma bong yang bersembunyi.
statement.en: At night, even after ladders came to be fixed permanently, there was still a warning to take care not to go down and meet a phi ma bong lying in wait.

beast-of-bladenboro.depicted_variant: Kucing misterius berwarna hitam licin sekitar 1,5 meter, menyerbu dari rawa/hutan.

visual_requirements.description: Makhluk menyerupai kucing, hitam licin, panjang sekitar 1,5m; satu kepala, empat kaki, dua mata.
Aksi serangan dan jeritan; tanpa efek vampir visual, darah atau kuasa tak tercatat.
Hutan dan rawa di sekitar Bladenboro pada malam hari.

beast-of-bladenboro.aura: Serbuan kucing hitam dan jeritan mengancam mengikuti laporan c05/c18, tanpa kepastian spesies (klaim: beast-of-bladenboro-c05, beast-of-bladenboro-c18).

basis_claims.quote: Witnesses described a creature that was "sleek, black, about 5 feet (1.5 m) long", which killed a dog in Clarkton, North Carolina, approximately eight miles (13 km) from Bladenboro.

statement.id: Saksi menggambarkan makhluk yang "ramping, hitam, panjang sekitar 5 kaki (1,5 m)" yang membunuh seekor anjing di Clarkton, North Carolina, sekitar delapan mil (13 km) dari Bladenboro.
statement.en: Witnesses described a creature "sleek, black, about 5 feet (1.5 m) long" that killed a dog in Clarkton, North Carolina, about eight miles (13 km) from Bladenboro.

basis_claims.quote: On the night of January 5, more than 500 people and dogs hunted through the woods and swamps for the creature.

statement.id: Pada malam 5 Januari, lebih dari 500 orang dan anjing memburu makhluk itu di hutan dan rawa.
statement.en: On the night of January 5, more than 500 people and dogs hunted through the woods and swamps for the creature.

basis_claims.quote: Many reported accounts describe the Beast of Bladenboro as feline, but do not agree on any one species.

statement.id: Banyak laporan menggambarkan Beast of Bladenboro sebagai kucing, tetapi tidak sepakat soal jenisnya.
statement.en: Many reported accounts describe the Beast of Bladenboro as feline, but do not agree on any one species.

basis_claims.quote: Supposed sightings described the beast as a cat-like creature with a terrible scream. The attacks drew national news coverage.

statement.id: Penampakan yang dilaporkan menggambarkan makhluk mirip kucing dengan jeritan mengerikan, dan serangannya menarik liputan berita nasional.
statement.en: Supposed sightings described a cat-like creature with a terrible scream, and the attacks drew national news coverage.

itsumade.depicted_variant: Burung Taiheiki berwajah manusia, paruh bergigi gergaji, tubuh ular, dua sayap dan dua kaki bercakar tajam, berseru di atas Shishinden.

visual_requirements.description: Satu kepala berwajah manusia dan paruh melengkung bergigi gergaji; tubuh ular, dua kaki dengan taji tajam, dua sayap rentang sekitar4,8m.
Ketika berseru seperti menyemburkan nyala dari mulut dan kilat dari suara.
Di langit malam atas Shishinden pada musim gugur.

itsumade.aura: Keanehan anatomi c10 dan nyala/kilat dalam seruan c11 membuatnya berbahaya (klaim: itsumade-c11).

basis_claims.quote: 今年天下に疫癘有て、病死する者甚多し。是のみならず、其秋の比より紫宸殿の上に怪鳥出来て、「いつまで／＼。」とぞ鳴ける。

statement.id: Taiheiki: pada tahun itu wabah melanda negeri dan banyak orang meninggal; selain itu, sejak musim gugur seekor burung aneh muncul di atas Shishinden dan berseru 「いつまで、いつまで」.
statement.en: Taiheiki: that year an epidemic spread through the land and many died; moreover, from that autumn an eerie bird appeared above the Shishinden crying 「いつまで、いつまで」.

basis_claims.quote: 頭は如人して、身は蛇の形也。嘴の前曲て歯如鋸生違。両の足に長距有て、利如剣。羽崎を延て見之、長一丈六尺也。

statement.id: Taiheiki: kepalanya seperti manusia dan tubuhnya berbentuk ular; paruhnya bengkok ke depan dengan gigi seperti gergaji, kedua kakinya bertaji panjang setajam pedang, dan bila sayapnya dibentangkan panjangnya satu jō enam shaku.
statement.en: Taiheiki: its head was like a human's and its body snake-shaped; its beak curved forward with saw-like teeth, both feet had long spurs sharp as swords, and its outstretched wings measured one jō six shaku.

basis_claims.quote: 鳴時口より火炎を吐歟と覚て、声の内より電して、其光御簾の内へ散徹す。

statement.id: Taiheiki: saat berseru, seakan-akan api keluar dari mulutnya dan kilat memancar dari dalam suaranya, cahayanya menembus hingga ke dalam tirai istana.
statement.en: Taiheiki: when it cried, it seemed to spit flames from its mouth, lightning flashed from within its voice, and the light penetrated through to the inside of the blinds.

mapinguari.depicted_variant: Varian berukuran manusia besar, satu mata di dahi dan mulut raksasa di perut, bulu merah kusut dan kaki terbalik.

visual_requirements.description: Satu mata di dahi, mulut besar di tengah perut, bulu kemerahan panjang, dua tangan berkuku kait, dua kaki yang menghadap belakang.
Menerkam dari cahaya redup hutan, tanpa efek bau berwarna atau aura.
Hutan dalam dengan cahaya redup.

mapinguari.aura: Satu mata, mulut perut dan kaki terbalik c20 serta terkam c10 menyampaikan bahaya tanpa efek generik (klaim: mapinguari-c10).

basis_claims.quote: Descriptions further allege that the cryptid is a man-eating creature with hook-shaped nails, backwards-facing feet, a bipedal gait, a gaping mouth in its abdomen, and a single eye like the mythological Cyclops.

statement.id: Makhluk ini digambarkan memangsa manusia dengan kuku kait, kaki terbalik, dan mulut menganga di perut.
statement.en: Descriptions further allege that the cryptid is a man-eating creature with hook-shaped nails, backwards-facing feet, a bipedal gait, a gaping mouth in its abdomen, and a single eye like the mythological Cyclops.

basis_claims.quote: The Mapinguari is a man-eater that eats its victims head-first. ... It is variously said to be nocturnal, crepuscular, or diurnal, and to lay in wait in the dim light of the deep forest before lunging to attack. It announces itself with loud screaming, frightening humans into flight

statement.id: Mapinguari dikatakan aktif pada malam, senja, atau siang, dan menunggu dalam cahaya redup hutan dalam sebelum menerkam; ia menandai kehadirannya dengan jeritan keras yang membuat manusia lari ketakutan.
statement.en: The Mapinguari is variously said to be nocturnal, crepuscular, or diurnal and to lie in wait in the dim light of the deep forest before lunging to attack; it announces itself with loud screaming, frightening humans into flight.

basis_claims.quote: The mapinguari is said to be quite remarkable in its appearance. ... It's the size of a large human, with a frightening single large eye on the front of its head, its mouth enormous and located way down in the middle of its belly, its feet turned backwards to make it difficult to track, and covered in long, shaggy, reddish fur.

statement.id: Mapinguari dikatakan berpenampilan sangat mencolok: sebesar manusia besar, bermata tunggal besar yang menakutkan di depan kepala, bermulut raksasa di tengah perut, berkaki terbalik agar sulit dilacak, dan berbulu merah panjang yang lebat.
statement.en: The mapinguari is said to be quite remarkable in appearance: the size of a large human, with a frightening single large eye on the front of its head, an enormous mouth in the middle of its belly, feet turned backwards to make it difficult to track, and long, shaggy, reddish fur.

nine-headed-bird.depicted_variant: Jiufeng Shanhaijing: sembilan kepala berwajah manusia pada satu tubuh burung, turun secara agung.

visual_requirements.description: Satu tubuh burung, tepat sembilan kepala berwajah manusia, dua sayap dan dua kaki burung.
Tidak memakai kuasa Guiche dari varian lain; kesan agung dari gerakan sayap dan anatomi.
Konteks Chu/Hubei diwakili latar abstrak gelap tanpa tempat baru spesifik.

nine-headed-bird.aura: Keagungan datang dari sembilan wajah Jiufeng c10, tanpa menggabungkan varian Guiche berleher berdarah (klaim: nine-headed-bird-c10).

basis_claims.quote: The nine-headed bird (Chinese: 九頭鳥), also called the "Nine Phoenix" (九鳳), is one of the earliest forms of the fenghuang, worshipped by ancient natives in Hubei Province, which during the Warring States period was part of the kingdom of Chu (楚).

statement.id: Burung ini dipuja oleh penduduk kuno Hubei yang wilayahnya pernah termasuk kerajaan Chu.
statement.en: The bird was worshipped by ancient Hubei inhabitants whose territory belonged to Chu.

basis_claims.quote: 有神，九首人面鳥身，名曰九鳳。又有神衘蛇操蛇，其狀虎首人身，四蹏長肘，名曰彊良。

statement.id: Teks Shanhaijing menyebut dewa berkepala sembilan, berwajah manusia dan bertubuh burung, bernama Jiufeng (九鳳, Sembilan Phoenix); juga disebut dewa lain berkepala harimau yang menggigit dan memegang ular, bernama Qiangliang.
statement.en: The Shanhaijing text mentions a deity with nine heads, a human face and a bird's body, named Jiufeng (九鳳, Nine Phoenix); it also mentions another deity with a tiger's head that holds snakes, named Qiangliang.

nukekubi.depicted_variant: Kepala perempuan terlepas sepenuhnya dan melayang mendekat; tubuh tidur berpakaian penuh di latar.

visual_requirements.description: Satu kepala manusia perempuan benar-benar terlepas dari satu tubuh; tidak ada leher memanjang, jaringan terbuka atau kepala kedua.
Kepala terbang dengan ekspresi haus darah; tanpa korban atau darah.
Tubuh tidur saat kepala berkeliaran; interior sederhana editorial.

nukekubi.aura: Kepala terbang terpisah c02/c05 dan tatapan memburu c06 memberi keanehan mengancam (klaim: nukekubi-c02, nukekubi-c06).

basis_claims.quote: her head can go flying off, either at the end of a greatly extended snakelike neck or completely detached from her body (in which case she may be called a nukekubi

statement.id: Nukekubi adalah rokurokubi yang kepalanya dapat terlepas.
statement.en: Nukekubi names a rokurokubi whose head detaches completely.

basis_claims.quote: her head can go flying off, either at the end of a greatly extended snakelike neck or completely detached from her body

statement.id: Kepala itu dapat terbang meninggalkan tubuhnya.
statement.en: Its separated head can fly away from the body.

basis_claims.quote: Nukekubi are a variant type of rokurokubi. They are similar in most respects, except that a nukekubi's head detaches itself completely from its body rather than elongating like a rokurokubi's neck.

statement.id: Menurut Yokai.com, nukekubi adalah jenis varian rokurokubi yang serupa dalam banyak hal, kecuali bahwa kepalanya terlepas sepenuhnya dari tubuh, bukan lehernya yang memanjang.
statement.en: According to Yokai.com, nukekubi are a variant type of rokurokubi, similar in most respects except that the head detaches completely from the body instead of the neck elongating.

basis_claims.quote: Nukekubi possess a thirst for blood, and are more violent than rokurokubi. Their flying head sucks the blood of victims like a vampire.

statement.id: Menurut Yokai.com, nukekubi haus darah dan lebih ganas daripada rokurokubi; kepalanya yang terbang mengisap darah korban seperti vampir.
statement.en: According to Yokai.com, nukekubi thirst for blood and are more violent than rokurokubi; their flying head sucks the blood of victims like a vampire.

basis_claims.quote: in the Sorori Monogatari (曾呂利物語, 1663 CE), in the chapter A Woman's Wild Thoughts Wandering Around (女の妄念迷ひ歩く事, Onna no Mōnen Mayoiaruku Koto) the head separating from the body interpreted to be the woman's soul wandering while asleep.

statement.id: Dalam Sorori Monogatari (1663), bab tentang pikiran liar seorang perempuan yang mengembara, kepala yang terpisah dari tubuh ditafsirkan sebagai jiwa perempuan itu yang mengembara saat tidur.
statement.en: In the Sorori Monogatari (1663), in the chapter on a woman's wild thoughts wandering, the head separating from the body is interpreted as the woman's soul wandering while asleep.

jenglot.depicted_variant: Manifestasi siluman melalui benda menjadi sosok kecil berkulit gelap kasar, wajah tengkorak bertaring, rambut dan kuku panjang.

visual_requirements.description: Humanoid kecil10–20cm, kulit gelap kasar seperti mumi, wajah tengkorak bertaring, rambut panjang dan kuku panjang.
Mengambil bentuk melalui benda menjadi sesuatu yang menakutkan; tidak menampilkan kuasa perlindungan/balas dendam dengan efek yang tidak terdokumentasi.
Latar gelap abstrak editorial agar sosok kecil terbaca.

jenglot.aura: Keganjilan manifestasi siluman c25 dan wajah tengkorak/taring/kuku c24 memberi ancaman pada skala kecil (klaim: jenglot-c25).

basis_claims.quote: They have long hair which grows sparse and stiff through the legs, and long nails.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Inggris, jenglot berambut panjang yang tumbuh jarang dan kaku sampai ke kaki, dan berkuku panjang.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, jenglots have long hair that grows sparse and stiff through the legs, and long nails.

basis_claims.quote: Jenglot adalah boneka berwujud mirip manusia yang memiliki ukuran kecil bervariasi (sekitar 10–20 cm), berkulit gelap dengan tekstur kasar (seperti mumi), berwajah seperti tengkorak dan bertaring mencuat serta memiliki rambut dan kuku yang panjang.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Indonesia, jenglot adalah boneka mirip manusia berukuran kecil bervariasi (sekitar 10-20 cm), berkulit gelap bertekstur kasar seperti mumi, berwajah seperti tengkorak dan bertaring mencuat, serta berambut dan berkuku panjang.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, the jenglot is a humanlike doll of varying small size (about 10-20 cm), with dark, rough, mummy-like skin, a skull-like face with protruding fangs, and long hair and nails.

basis_claims.quote: Beberapa orang memercayai bahwa Jenglot merupakan jelmaan manusia, atau siluman yang mewujudkan dengan benda membentuk sesuatu yang menyeramkan bagi kalangan tertentu.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Indonesia, sebagian orang percaya jenglot adalah jelmaan manusia, atau siluman yang mewujud lewat benda menjadi sesuatu yang menyeramkan bagi kalangan tertentu.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, some people believe the jenglot is the incarnation of a human, or a siluman that takes shape through an object into something frightening to certain people.

ogopogo.depicted_variant: Varian roh danau bertubuh ular gelap, kepala kuda dan tanduk rusa c17, melaju dengan undulasi vertikal c05.

visual_requirements.description: Satu kepala kuda dengan sepasang tanduk rusa, tubuh ular gelap tanpa kaki, ekor kuat; satu kepala dua mata.
Melaju dengan undulasi vertikal dan dorongan ekor; percikan hanya dari berenang, tidak memakai cerita demonisasi badai korban.
Danau Okanagan dekat Rattlesnake Island/Squally Point.

ogopogo.aura: Gerak kuat dan anatomi roh danau c17/c05 terasa agung, mengikuti penghormatan roh pelindung c10 (klaim: ogopogo-c05).

basis_claims.quote: The monster has said to move at incredible speeds, coiling its body in vertical undulations, and propelling itself with a powerful tail.

statement.id: Monster itu dikatakan bergerak dengan kecepatan luar biasa, melingkarkan tubuhnya dalam gelombang vertikal, dan melaju dengan ekornya yang kuat.
statement.en: The monster is said to move at incredible speeds, coiling its body in vertical undulations and propelling itself with a powerful tail.

basis_claims.quote: According to Pat Raphael of the Westbank First Nation, a member nation of the larger Okanagan Nation Alliance, the demonic view of Naitaka came about through miscommunication between Canada's early European settlers and the Syilx/Okanagan people. To the Syilx, it's ... a sacred spirit of the lake that protects the valley.

statement.id: Menurut Pat Raphael dari Westbank First Nation, pandangan yang menganggap Naitaka iblis muncul dari salah komunikasi antara pemukim Eropa awal di Kanada dan orang Syilx/Okanagan. Bagi orang Syilx, ia adalah roh suci danau yang melindungi lembah.
statement.en: According to Pat Raphael of the Westbank First Nation, the demonic view of Naitaka arose from miscommunication between early European settlers and the Syilx/Okanagan people; to the Syilx it is a sacred spirit of the lake that protects the valley.

basis_claims.quote: To the Syilx, the creature was known as N’ha-a-itk, which means “sacred spirit of the lake.” N’ha-a-itk was said to be dark in color with the head of a horse and the antlers of a deer. According to local legend, N’ha-a-itk was a spirit that could also take physical form.

statement.id: Bagi orang Syilx, makhluk itu dikenal sebagai N'ha-a-itk, yang berarti "roh suci danau". N'ha-a-itk dikatakan berwarna gelap dengan kepala kuda dan tanduk rusa. Menurut legenda setempat, N'ha-a-itk adalah roh yang juga dapat mengambil wujud fisik.
statement.en: To the Syilx the creature was known as N'ha-a-itk, meaning "sacred spirit of the lake", said to be dark with the head of a horse and the antlers of a deer, and according to local legend a spirit that could also take physical form.

basis_claims.quote: The spirit was said to dwell in caves under Rattlesnake Island (a.k.a. Monster Island) or adjacent to Squally Point.

statement.id: Roh itu dikatakan berdiam di gua-gua di bawah Rattlesnake Island (alias Monster Island) atau di dekat Squally Point.
statement.en: The spirit was said to dwell in caves under Rattlesnake Island (a.k.a. Monster Island) or adjacent to Squally Point.

rainbow-serpent.depicted_variant: Ngalyod sebagai ular pencipta perempuan, menampakkan diri agung di aliran air deras dan hujan tanpa menyalin pola seni sakral.

visual_requirements.description: Satu tubuh ular, satu kepala dengan dua mata, tanpa kaki/tanduk/sayap; bentuk ular dipilih tanpa menggabungkan seluruh tradisi.
Air terjun bergemuruh sebagai suara, hujan/banjir terkait kekuatannya; tanpa petir, aura atau korban.
Air terjun dan tepian berbatu Escarpment Country.

rainbow-serpent.aura: Ngalyod pencipta c16 menjulang sebagai tubuh ular di air terjun yang merupakan suaranya c18; megah dan menggetarkan, bukan jahat c20 (klaim: rainbow-serpent-c18, rainbow-serpent-c11).

basis_claims.quote: For all the people of western Arnhem Land, the Rainbow Snake is traditionally a symbol of monsoon storms, rain, floods, and of danger;
basis_claims.locator: Human Contact with Rainbow Snake Power

statement.id: Bagi seluruh masyarakat Arnhem Land bagian barat, Ular Pelangi secara tradisional adalah simbol badai monsun, hujan, banjir, dan bahaya.
statement.en: For all the people of western Arnhem Land, the Rainbow Snake is traditionally a symbol of monsoon storms, rain, floods and danger.

basis_claims.quote: Ngalyod, the Rainbow Serpent is an all-powerful female ancestral creator of the Bininj people, capable of benevolent and malevolent actions that are embedded in the animate topography of djang

statement.id: Ngalyod, Ular Pelangi, adalah leluhur pencipta perempuan yang mahakuasa bagi orang Bininj, mampu melakukan tindakan baik maupun jahat yang tertanam dalam topografi hidup yang disebut djang.
statement.en: Ngalyod, the Rainbow Serpent, is an all-powerful female ancestral creator of the Bininj people, capable of benevolent and malevolent actions embedded in the animate topography of djang.

basis_claims.quote: For Kuninjku, Ngalyod is visible standing in the sky as the rainbow and, similar to the Yawkyawk, is mostly associated with bodies of water such as billabongs, creeks, rivers and waterfalls, where she resides.

statement.id: Bagi orang Kuninjku, Ngalyod tampak berdiri di langit sebagai pelangi dan, seperti Yawkyawk, terutama dikaitkan dengan perairan seperti billabong, anak sungai, sungai, dan air terjun tempat ia tinggal.
statement.en: For the Kuninjku, Ngalyod is visible standing in the sky as the rainbow and, like the Yawkyawk, is mostly associated with bodies of water such as billabongs, creeks, rivers and waterfalls, where she resides.

basis_claims.quote: The roar of waterfalls in the Escarpment Country is said to be her voice and large holes in the stony banks of rivers and cliff faces are said to be her tracks.

statement.id: Gemuruh air terjun di Escarpment Country dikatakan suaranya, dan lubang-lubang besar di tepi berbatu sungai serta tebing dikatakan jejaknya.
statement.en: The roar of waterfalls in the Escarpment Country is said to be her voice, and large holes in the stony banks of rivers and cliff faces are said to be her tracks.

basis_claims.quote: The Rainbow Snake is not necessarily a destroyer, to go back to Radcliffe-Brown's comment, but rather a symbol and a reminder of the potentially destructive and overpowering, as well as revitalizing, forces of nature, which can be fearsome as well as splendid.
basis_claims.locator: The Rainbow Snake as Catalyst and Symbol

statement.id: Ular Pelangi belum tentu perusak, melainkan simbol dan pengingat akan kekuatan alam yang berpotensi merusak dan mendominasi sekaligus menghidupkan kembali, yang bisa menakutkan sekaligus megah.
statement.en: The Rainbow Snake is not necessarily a destroyer, but rather a symbol and reminder of the potentially destructive and overpowering, as well as revitalizing, forces of nature, which can be fearsome as well as splendid.

korean-dragon.depicted_variant: Naga Korea berjanggut sangat panjang membawa yeouiju di cakar dan muncul dari kabut Laut Timur.

visual_requirements.description: Satu kepala naga, janggut panjang menonjol, bola yeouiju pada satu cakar; tubuh naga serpentin dan kaki sebagai detail artistik konvensional.
Awan dan kabut menggelapkan jalan sebagai transformasi naga Laut Timur; tanpa kilat atau kuasa bola yang tidak diklaim.
Laut dan jalan pesisir terhalang awan/kabut.

korean-dragon.aura: Janggut panjang dan yeouiju c05/c06 serta kabut transformasi c11 memberi keagungan, tanpa menambahkan kuasa orb (klaim: korean-dragon-c11).

basis_claims.quote: Whereas most dragons in European mythology are linked to the elements of fire and destruction, dragons in Korean mythology are primarily benevolent beings related to water and agriculture, often considered bringers of rain and clouds. Hence, many Korean dragons are said to have resided in rivers, lakes, oceans, or even deep mountain ponds.

statement.id: Naga ini terutama dikaitkan dengan air, pertanian, hujan, dan awan.
statement.en: These dragons are primarily associated with water, agriculture, rain, and clouds.

basis_claims.quote: The Korean dragon is in many ways very similar in appearance to other East Asian dragons such as the Chinese and Japanese dragons. It differs from the Chinese dragon in that it developed a longer beard.

statement.id: Naga Korea digambarkan memiliki janggut lebih panjang dibanding naga Tiongkok.
statement.en: Korean dragons are described with longer beards than Chinese dragons.

basis_claims.quote: Occasionally a dragon may be depicted as carrying a giant orb known as the yeouiju (여의주), the Korean name for the mythical Cintamani, in its claws or its mouth.

statement.id: Penggambaran dapat menyertakan bola yeouiju pada cakar atau mulutnya.
statement.en: Depictions may include a yeouiju orb in the claws or mouth.

basis_claims.quote: 忽雲霧冥曀。迷失道路。怪問左右。日官奏云。此東海龍所變也。宜行勝事以解之。於是敕有司為龍刱佛寺。近境施令已出。雲開霧散。

statement.id: Ketika awan dan kabut tiba-tiba menggelapkan jalan hingga rombongan tersesat, seorang pejabat (日官) berkata bahwa itu perubahan wujud naga Laut Timur dan perlu dilakukan perbuatan baik; setelah perintah mendirikan kuil Buddha untuk sang naga dikeluarkan, awan dan kabut menghilang.
statement.en: When clouds and fog suddenly darkened the way so that the party lost its path, an official (日官) said it was a transformation of the East Sea dragon and that a good deed should be performed; once the order to build a Buddhist temple for the dragon was issued, the clouds and fog cleared.

longma.depicted_variant: Kuda bersayap di sisi tubuh bersisik naga, berjalan di permukaan sungai tanpa tenggelam.

visual_requirements.description: Tubuh dan kepala kuda, sisik naga, dua sayap di sisi, empat kaki kuda; satu kepala dan dua mata.
Berjalan di air tanpa tenggelam; kuku menyentuh permukaan dengan percikan nyata.
Permukaan air sebagai latar tindakan berjalan di air.

longma.aura: Sayap/sisik dan langkah di atas air c07 memberi keagungan sebagai pertanda baik c02 (klaim: longma-c07).

basis_claims.quote: The longma is a fabled winged horse with dragon scales in Chinese mythology. Seeing a longma was an omen of a legendary sage-ruler, particularly one of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors.

statement.id: Longma adalah kuda bersayap dengan sisik naga dalam mitologi Tiongkok.
statement.en: Longma is a winged horse bearing dragon scales in Chinese mythology.

basis_claims.quote: The longma is a fabled winged horse with dragon scales in Chinese mythology. Seeing a longma was an omen of a legendary sage-ruler, particularly one of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors.

statement.id: Kemunculannya dipandang sebagai pertanda seorang penguasa bijak.
statement.en: Its appearance is regarded as an omen of a sage ruler.

basis_claims.quote: As a being its shape consists of a horse's body, yet it has dragon scales. Therefore it is called 'dragon horse'. Its height is eight ch'ih five ts'un. A true dragon horse has wings at its sides and walks upon the water without sinking.

statement.id: Komentar kuno yang dikutip artikel ini menyatakan bahwa bentuknya bertubuh kuda tetapi bersisik naga, tingginya delapan chi lima cun, dan longma sejati bersayap di sisinya serta berjalan di atas air tanpa tenggelam.
statement.en: An ancient commentary quoted in the article states that its shape is a horse's body with dragon scales, its height is eight ch'ih five ts'un, and a true dragon horse has wings at its sides and walks on water without sinking.

piuchen.depicted_variant: Large bat-winged lizard variant; threat from the predatory dive rather than invented power

visual_requirements.description: one head, two eyes, four lizard legs, a long reptilian tail and exactly two membranous bat wings; retain lizard anatomy without horns
No visible supernatural power; nocturnal flight only, wing downstroke drives loose leaves
the dark forest and a hollow old tree

piuchen.aura: Kesan kuat berasal dari dive out of a hollow trunk toward the viewer with jaws open, front claws foreshortened (piuchen-c07).

basis_claims.quote: This blood-sucker often assumes the guise of a flying snake, or a large lizard with bat wings, that emits strange whistling sounds or hisses that stun or kill its enemy or prey.

statement.id: Pengisap darah ini sering berwujud ular terbang atau kadal besar bersayap kelelawar yang siulan atau desisnya melumpuhkan atau membunuh mangsa.
statement.en: It often appears as a flying snake or a bat-winged lizard whose whistles or hisses stun or kill prey.

basis_claims.quote: It flies off at night, sucking the blood of animals and humans asleep in the forest. It prefers the season when the roble tree sprouts, and is considered a forest spirit.

statement.id: Ia terbang pada malam hari dan mengisap darah hewan dan manusia yang tertidur di hutan; ia menyukai musim ketika pohon roble bertunas dan dianggap roh hutan.
statement.en: It flies off at night, sucking the blood of animals and humans asleep in the forest; it prefers the season when the roble tree sprouts and is considered a forest spirit.

basis_claims.quote: In various versions with local variations, it may be a serpent with feathered wings (as told in Vichuquén), or alternatively a large lizard with bat wings.

statement.id: Dalam berbagai versi lokal, ia dapat berupa ular bersayap berbulu (seperti diceritakan di Vichuquén) atau kadal besar bersayap kelelawar.
statement.en: In various local versions it may be a serpent with feathered wings (as told in Vichuquén), or a large lizard with bat wings.

basis_claims.quote: to kill a Pihuchén living in a Tree hollow (hueco), it is suggested the hole be plugged with hefty cloth then to set the tree on fire.

statement.id: Untuk membunuh Pihuchén yang tinggal di lubang pohon, disarankan menyumbat lubang dengan kain tebal lalu membakar pohonnya.
statement.en: To kill a Pihuchén living in a tree hollow, it is suggested to plug the hole with heavy cloth and then set the tree on fire.

tarantasio.depicted_variant: Living serpentine dragon following the documented biscione emblem; no graphic feeding

visual_requirements.description: one serpentine head, two eyes, continuous coiling limbless serpent body; no legs, wings or extra horns; no child victim
Foul nonluminous grey breath fouls the air; broken boat planks scatter from the physical attack
Lake Gerundo in Lombardy

tarantasio.aura: Kesan kuat berasal dari rise from lake gerundo and smash an empty wooden boat beneath a muscular coil (tarantasio-c02,tarantasio-c03).

basis_claims.quote: Tarantasio è il nome di un drago leggendario che terrorizzava gli abitanti dell'antico e ipotetico lago Gerundo (poi prosciugato, secondo la leggenda), nella zona di Lodi, in Lombardia.

statement.id: Tarantasio adalah naga legendaris yang dikaitkan dengan Danau Gerundo di Lombardia.
statement.en: Tarantasio is a legendary dragon associated with Lake Gerundo in Lombardy.

basis_claims.quote: Si riteneva che questo animale mitologico divorasse i bambini, distruggesse le imbarcazioni e ammorbasse l'aria con il suo fiato pestilenziale, causando una strana malattia denominata febbre gialla.

statement.id: Cerita-cerita menggambarkannya merusak perahu dan mengancam anak-anak.
statement.en: Stories describe it as destroying boats and threatening children.

basis_claims.quote: Si riteneva che questo animale mitologico divorasse i bambini, distruggesse le imbarcazioni e ammorbasse l'aria con il suo fiato pestilenziale, causando una strana malattia denominata febbre gialla.

statement.id: Napas busuknya konon mencemari udara sekitarnya.
statement.en: Its foul breath is said to contaminate the surrounding air.

basis_claims.quote: La più suggestiva riguarda l'uccisione del drago da parte del capostipite dei Visconti, il quale avrebbe poi adottato come simbolo la creatura sconfitta, ovvero il biscione con il bambino in bocca.

statement.id: Versi yang paling memikat menyebut naga itu dibunuh oleh leluhur keluarga Visconti, yang kemudian memakai makhluk yang dikalahkan itu, yaitu ular besar dengan anak di mulutnya, sebagai lambang.
statement.en: The most evocative version has the dragon killed by the progenitor of the Visconti, who then adopted the defeated creature, the biscione with a child in its mouth, as an emblem.

tigmamanukan.depicted_variant: Respectful creation action; small size preserved by macro composition

visual_requirements.description: one blue bird, thrush-sized, one head, two eyes, two feathered wings, two bird legs, pointed natural beak; no horns
A physical split in the bamboo caused by its beak; wood fibres and splinters visible, no magical light
close to the primordial bamboo of the creation tale, surrounding dark vegetation

tigmamanukan.aura: Kesan kuat berasal dari strike the thick primordial bamboo with its beak as the bamboo splits toward the viewer (tigmamanukan-c13,tigmamanukan-c18).

basis_claims.quote: The Tagalos adored a blue bird, as large as a thrush, and called it Bathala, which was among them a term of divinity.

statement.id: Menurut teks ini, orang Tagalos (ejaan teks itu) memuja seekor burung biru sebesar thrush dan menyebutnya Bathala, istilah ilahi di kalangan mereka.
statement.en: According to this text, the Tagalos (as the text spells the name) adored a blue bird as large as a thrush and called it Bathala, a term of divinity among them.

basis_claims.quote: In some Philippine creation myths, the tigmamanukan bird was sent by Bathala to split open the primordial bamboo whence the first man and woman came out.

statement.id: Dalam beberapa mitos penciptaan Filipina, burung tigmamanukan diutus Bathala untuk membelah bambu purba tempat laki-laki dan perempuan pertama keluar.
statement.en: In some Philippine creation myths, the tigmamanukan bird was sent by Bathala to split open the primordial bamboo from which the first man and woman came out.

basis_claims.quote: In any case, most of the sources which describe the tigmamanukan agree that it is distinguished by a "blue" color.

statement.id: Kebanyakan sumber yang menggambarkan tigmamanukan sepakat bahwa burung ini dicirikan oleh warna "biru".
statement.en: Most of the sources that describe the tigmamanukan agree that it is distinguished by a "blue" color.

basis_claims.quote: In at least one telling of the Filipino creation myth, the Tigmamanukan was responsible for opening the bamboo from which emerged the first man, Malakas, and first woman, Maganda.

statement.id: Dalam sedikitnya satu versi mitos penciptaan Filipina, Tigmamanukan bertugas membuka bambu tempat keluar laki-laki pertama, Malakas, dan perempuan pertama, Maganda.
statement.en: In at least one telling of the Filipino creation myth, the Tigmamanukan was responsible for opening the bamboo from which the first man, Malakas, and first woman, Maganda, emerged.

tiyanak.depicted_variant: One baby-shaped fang-and-claw variant only; cloth is editorial coverage

visual_requirements.description: one infantlike monstrous head, two eyes, two arms, two legs; unmistakable sharp fangs and claws; full opaque weathered cloth wrap covering torso and lower body
No visible supernatural power; attacking anatomy and close framing only
a dark jungle roadside where its crying lures travelers

tiyanak.aura: Kesan kuat berasal dari lunge off a roadside root directly toward the viewer, clawed hand enlarged by close perspective and fang-filled mouth opening (tiyanak-c04).

basis_claims.quote: is a vampiric creature in Philippine mythology that takes on the form of a toddler or baby. Although there are various types, it typically takes the form of a newborn baby and cries in the jungle to attract unwary travelers. Once it is picked up by an unfortunate passerby, it reverts to its true form and attacks the victim.

statement.id: Tiyanak adalah makhluk pengisap darah dalam mitologi Filipina yang berwujud balita atau bayi, biasanya bayi baru lahir yang menangis di hutan untuk memikat pejalan; begitu diangkat ia kembali ke wujud asli dan menyerang korbannya.
statement.en: The tiyanak is a vampiric creature of Philippine mythology in the form of a toddler or baby, usually a newborn crying in the jungle to attract travellers; once picked up it reverts to its true form and attacks the victim.

basis_claims.quote: In one version, it retains the general shape of a baby but then forms sharp claws and fangs to attack its victim.

statement.id: Dalam satu versi tiyanak tetap berbentuk umum seperti bayi tetapi menumbuhkan cakar dan taring tajam untuk menyerang korbannya.
statement.en: In one version the tiyanak retains the general shape of a baby but forms sharp claws and fangs to attack its victim.

basis_claims.quote: a cry resembling that of an abandoned infant draws a traveller toward the roadside, forest, field, or swamp, where the helpless child proves to be something dangerous.

statement.id: Tangisan menyerupai bayi terlantar memikat pejalan menuju tepi jalan, hutan, ladang, atau rawa, tempat anak yang tak berdaya itu ternyata berbahaya.
statement.en: A cry resembling that of an abandoned infant draws a traveller toward the roadside, forest, field or swamp, where the helpless child proves to be something dangerous.

wakwak.depicted_variant: Bat-winged birdlike variant, avoiding other incompatible regional forms

visual_requirements.description: one birdlike head, two eyes, one intact body, exactly two batlike membranous wings, two feet ending in long sharp talons; no human torso, no detached body
No magical energy; nocturnal hunting flight and threatening talons only
above a rural Philippine roof at night

wakwak.aura: Kesan kuat berasal dari swoop down at the viewer with both long talons extended and wings beating hard (wakwak-c01,wakwak-c02,wakwak-c03).

basis_claims.quote: The Wakwak is a vampiric, bird-like creature in Philippine mythology. It is said to snatch humans at night as prey, similar to the manananggal and the Ekek in rural areas of the Philippines. The difference between the Manananggal and the Wakwak is that Wakwak cannot separate its torso from its body while the Manananggal can.

statement.id: Wakwak adalah makhluk mirip burung pengisap darah dalam mitologi Filipina yang konon menyambar manusia pada malam hari sebagai mangsa, seperti manananggal dan ekek di pedesaan Filipina; berbeda dari manananggal, wakwak tidak dapat memisahkan torsonya dari tubuhnya.
statement.en: The wakwak is a vampiric, bird-like creature of Philippine mythology said to snatch humans at night as prey, like the manananggal and the ekek in rural areas of the Philippines; unlike the manananggal, it cannot separate its torso from its body.

basis_claims.quote: It is also believed that this monster is called "Wakwak" due to the sound it makes when it flaps its wings while flying. This sound is only heard when the Wakwak is hunting and becomes softer the closer it becomes.

statement.id: Monster ini dipercaya dinamai wakwak dari bunyi kepakan sayapnya saat terbang; bunyi itu hanya terdengar saat berburu dan makin pelan saat mendekat.
statement.en: This monster is believed named wakwak after the sound of its wings in flight; it is heard only when hunting and grows softer as it approaches.

basis_claims.quote: The Wakwak is often described as having long sharp talons and a pair of wings similar to those of a bat. It uses its talons or claws to slash its victims and to get their heart

statement.id: Wakwak sering digambarkan memiliki cakar panjang yang tajam dan sepasang sayap seperti sayap kelelawar; ia memakai cakarnya untuk mencabik korban dan mengambil jantungnya.
statement.en: The wakwak is often described as having long sharp talons and a pair of wings like those of a bat; it uses its talons or claws to slash its victims and take their hearts.

basis_claims.quote: Aswang are often heard before they are seen: their attacks are presaged by bird cries emitted either by aswang themselves or their animal familiars (tiktik, kikik), or by the sound of flapping wings on the roof (wakwak or kaskas).

statement.id: Menurut artikel jurnal ini, aswang sering terdengar sebelum terlihat: serangannya didahului pekik burung atau bunyi kepakan sayap di atap (wakwak atau kaskas).
statement.en: According to this journal article, aswang are often heard before they are seen: their attacks are presaged by bird cries or by the sound of flapping wings on the roof (wakwak or kaskas).

winged-cat.depicted_variant: Big-cat eagle-wing variant; rocky setting is editorial rather than researched geography

visual_requirements.description: one lionlike feline head, two eyes, four feline legs, one tail, exactly two eagle wings; strong visible feline jaws and hooked claws
No documented supernatural power; no power effects, motion and feline anatomy only
an editorial unmarked rocky ledge in near darkness; no asserted historical location

winged-cat.aura: Kesan kuat berasal dari launch from a dark rocky ledge toward the viewer, clawed forepaws thrust forward, broad feathered wings flaring (winged-cat-c01).

basis_claims.quote: The winged cat – a feline with wings like a bird, bat or other flying creature – is a theme in artwork and legend going back to prehistory, especially mythological depictions of big cats with eagle wings in Eurasia and North Africa.
