statement.id: Kucing bersayap, yaitu felid dengan sayap seperti burung, kelelawar, atau makhluk terbang lain, adalah tema seni dan legenda sejak prasejarah, terutama gambaran mitologis kucing besar bersayap elang di Eurasia dan Afrika Utara.
statement.en: The winged cat, a feline with wings like a bird, bat or other flying creature, is a theme in art and legend going back to prehistory, especially mythological depictions of big cats with eagle wings in Eurasia and North Africa.

basis_claims.quote: Pantherines with wings, especially winged lions, are a common theme in ancient religious and mythological art of the Sumerians and other Mesopotamians, Akkadians, Persians, and Scythians

statement.id: Pantherin bersayap, terutama singa bersayap, adalah tema umum dalam seni religius dan mitologis kuno bangsa Sumeria dan Mesopotamia lain, Akkadia, Persia, dan Skithia.
statement.en: Winged pantherines, especially winged lions, are a common theme in the ancient religious and mythological art of the Sumerians and other Mesopotamians, Akkadians, Persians and Scythians.

zennyo-ryuo.depicted_variant: Respectful sacred woman manifestation; claw size is sourced, human scale preserved

visual_requirements.description: one dignified woman's head, two eyes, two arms, two legs under full opaque Japanese layered robes; one little finger extends into a claw longer than three metres, no extra fingers, no dragon body
Heavy rain falls across the scene; the documented immense claw casts restrained five-coloured light physically onto the wet robes and rocks
the dragon cave on Mount Murō, its rocky entrance and rain-filled darkness

zennyo-ryuo.aura: Kesan kuat berasal dari extend her immense little-finger claw downward across the foreground as heavy rain pours around her (zennyo-ryuo-c11,zennyo-ryuo-c13).

basis_claims.quote: Zennyo or Zentatsu 善達 supposedly lived in the Ryūketsu 龍穴 "Dragon Hole/Cave" on Murōyama 室生山 "Mount Murō" in Nara Prefecture, which was an ancient locale of Japanese dragon worship and rainmaking ceremonies.

statement.id: Zennyo atau Zentatsu (善達) konon tinggal di Ryūketsu (龍穴, "gua naga") di Gunung Murō (室生山) di Prefektur Nara, tempat kuno pemujaan naga dan upacara pemanggil hujan di Jepang.
statement.en: Zennyo or Zentatsu (善達) supposedly lived in the Ryūketsu (龍穴, "dragon cave") on Mount Murō (室生山) in Nara Prefecture, an ancient site of dragon worship and rainmaking ceremonies in Japan.

basis_claims.quote: Kokan Shiren's c. 1322 CE Genkō Shakusho "the Genkō era History of Buddhism" has a story about the priest Keien 慶圓 (1143–1223 CE) encountering a beautiful woman who was actually a shapeshifting Zennyo.

statement.id: Genkō Shakusho karya Kokan Shiren (sekitar 1322) memuat kisah pendeta Keien (慶圓, 1143-1223) yang bertemu seorang perempuan cantik yang sebenarnya Zennyo yang mengubah wujud.
statement.en: Kokan Shiren's Genkō Shakusho (c. 1322) has a story of the priest Keien (慶圓, 1143-1223) meeting a beautiful woman who was in fact a shapeshifting Zennyo.

basis_claims.quote: she answered: "I am the Dragon Zennyo". ... It proved to be a claw, more than ten shaku long, which spread a five-coloured light.

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu perempuan tersebut menjawab "Aku adalah Naga Zennyo", dan jari kelingkingnya yang terulur ternyata sebuah cakar lebih dari sepuluh shaku panjangnya yang memancarkan cahaya lima warna.
statement.en: In that story the woman answers "I am the Dragon Zennyo", and the little finger she stretches out proves to be a claw more than ten shaku long that spreads a five-coloured light.

basis_claims.quote: 調べると空海の名声を妬む守敏により国中の龍神が瓶に閉じ込められていた。しかしただ1体、善女龍王だけは守敏の手から逃れていたので天竺の無熱池（むねっち）から呼び寄せて国中に大雨を降らせたという。

statement.id: Setelah diselidiki, dewa naga seluruh negeri ternyata dikurung dalam guci oleh 守敏 yang iri pada nama baik 空海; hanya Zennyo Ryūō yang lolos dari tangan 守敏, sehingga ia dipanggil dari kolam 無熱池 di India dan konon menurunkan hujan lebat ke seluruh negeri.
statement.en: On investigation, the dragon gods of the whole land had been shut in a pitcher by 守敏, who envied 空海's fame; only Zennyo Ryūō had escaped 守敏's hand, so he was summoned from the pond 無熱池 in India and is said to have sent heavy rain over the whole country.

balaha.depicted_variant: Faithful Jataka crow-beaked white horse, benevolent rather than monstrous

visual_requirements.description: one crow-beaked horse head, two eyes, white horse body, exactly four legs, one horse tail, coarse pale mane like munja grass; no wings, no horns; several fully clothed merchants cling to its flanks
Unwinged supernatural flight only; ordinary sea spray below, no control of ocean or lightning
the sea beside the island of Ceylon during the rescue

balaha.aura: Kesan kuat berasal dari fly toward the viewer above a churning sea carrying rescued merchants safely against its white flanks (balaha-c04,balaha-c06,balaha-c09).

basis_claims.quote: Tous les marchands s'accrochent aux flancs du cheval comme à ceux d'un navire pour s'échapper et traverser la mer.

statement.id: Semua pedagang berpegangan pada sisi kuda itu seperti pada kapal untuk melarikan diri menyeberangi laut.
statement.en: All the merchants cling to the horse's flanks as if to a ship to escape across the sea.

basis_claims.quote: Now at that time, the Bodhisatta had come into the world as a flying horse ... white all over, and beaked like a crow, with hair like muñja grass ... possessed of Supernormal Powers, able to fly through the air.

statement.id: Dalam Valāhassajātaka (Ja 196) Bodhisatta lahir sebagai kuda terbang, putih seluruhnya, berparuh seperti gagak, berambut seperti rumput muñja, memiliki kekuatan adiduniawi dan mampu terbang di udara.
statement.en: In the Valāhassajātaka (Ja 196) the Bodhisatta had come into the world as a flying horse, white all over, beaked like a crow, with hair like muñja grass, possessed of supernormal powers and able to fly through the air.

basis_claims.quote: In the past, there was in the island of Ceylon a Yakkha town called Sirīsavatthu, peopled by Yakkhinis.

statement.id: Menurut Jātaka ini, di pulau Ceylon ada kota Yakkha bernama Sirīsavatthu yang dihuni para Yakkhini.
statement.en: According to the Jātaka, in the island of Ceylon there was a Yakkha town called Sirīsavatthu, peopled by Yakkhinis.

basis_claims.quote: Then the Bodhisatta took up even those who stood still saluting him, and conveyed all of them, even two hundred and fifty, to their own country

statement.id: Bodhisatta membawa seluruh dua ratus lima puluh pedagang, termasuk yang berdiri memberi hormat, kembali ke negeri mereka sendiri.
statement.en: The Bodhisatta conveyed all two hundred and fifty merchants, even those who stood saluting him, to their own country.

champ-folklore.depicted_variant: Horse-headed approximately twenty-foot variant; realistic body disturbance only

visual_requirements.description: one recognizably horse-shaped head, two eyes, elongated approximately twenty-foot sea-serpent body; no legs, wings, horns, dragon face or glowing eyes
No supernatural power; splashes caused only by its body emerging
Lake Champlain, distant wooded shore

champ-folklore.aura: Kesan kuat berasal dari rear up very close to the viewer out of the dark lake, serpentine neck curved and horse jaws parted (champ-folklore-c14).

basis_claims.quote: In American folklore, Champ or Champy is the name of a lake monster said to live in Lake Champlain, a 125-mile (201 km)-long body of fresh water shared by New York and Vermont, with a portion extending into Quebec, Canada.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Amerika, Champ atau Champy adalah nama monster danau yang dikatakan hidup di Danau Champlain, perairan tawar sepanjang 125 mil (201 km) yang dibagi antara New York dan Vermont, dengan sebagian membentang ke Quebec, Kanada.
statement.en: In American folklore, Champ or Champy is the name of a lake monster said to live in Lake Champlain, a 125-mile (201 km)-long body of fresh water shared by New York and Vermont, with a portion extending into Quebec, Canada.

basis_claims.quote: As of 2015, there have been over 300 alleged sightings of Champ: it is described as an approximately 20-foot-long sea serpent with the head of a horse. Cryptozoologists report that Champ may be of the same lineage as the famous Loch Ness Monster of Scotland.

statement.id: Hingga 2015 ada lebih dari 300 dugaan penampakan Champ; ia digambarkan sebagai ular laut sepanjang sekitar 20 kaki berkepala kuda, dan para kriptozoolog menyebut Champ mungkin segaris keturunan dengan Monster Loch Ness yang terkenal di Skotlandia.
statement.en: As of 2015 there have been over 300 alleged sightings of Champ; it is described as an approximately 20-foot-long sea serpent with the head of a horse, and cryptozoologists report that Champ may be of the same lineage as the famous Loch Ness Monster of Scotland.

guhuoniao.depicted_variant: Wujud burung malam betina dengan dua tonjolan dada tertutup bulu penuh sesuai Bencao Gangmu.

visual_requirements.description: Satu burung roh betina, satu kepala dua mata dua sayap dua kaki; dua tonjolan dada tertutup bulu penuh.
Terbang malam dan menandai pakaian anak kosong dengan noda darah kecil non-grafis.
Jemuran luar rumah Jingzhou malam hari.

guhuoniao.aura: Ancaman burung malam yang menandai pakaian anak hingga menyebabkan penyakit (guhuoniao-c07).

basis_claims.quote: 藏器曰︰姑獲能收人魂魄。《玄中記》云︰姑獲鳥，鬼神類也。衣毛為飛鳥，脫毛為女人。
basis_claims.locator: Bencao Gangmu (本草綱目), bagian Burung bab 4, entri 姑獲鳥

statement.id: Bencao Gangmu mengutip Chen Zangqi (藏器) bahwa 姑獲 dapat merenggut roh dan jiwa orang, serta Xuanzhong Ji (玄中記) bahwa burung ini tergolong makhluk gaib (鬼神類): memakai bulu ia menjadi burung terbang, menanggalkan bulu ia menjadi perempuan.
statement.en: The Bencao Gangmu quotes Zangqi (藏器) that 姑獲 can take away people's souls, and the Xuanzhong Ji (玄中記) that the bird belongs to the class of spirits (鬼神類): wearing feathers it is a flying bird, shedding them it becomes a woman.

basis_claims.quote: 凡有小兒家，不可夜露衣物。此鳥夜飛，以血點之為志。兒輒病驚癇及疳疾，謂之無辜疳也。
basis_claims.locator: Bencao Gangmu (本草綱目), bagian Burung bab 4, entri 姑獲鳥

statement.id: Menurut kutipan itu, rumah yang punya anak kecil tidak boleh menjemur pakaian di luar pada malam hari, sebab burung ini terbang malam dan menandai dengan setetes darah; anak yang ditandai jatuh sakit kejang dan gizi buruk, penyakit yang disebut 無辜疳.
statement.en: According to the quotation, homes with small children should not leave clothing out at night, because this bird flies by night and marks it with blood; the child then falls ill with convulsions and wasting, an illness called 無辜疳.

basis_claims.quote: 脫毛為女人。云是產婦死後化作，故胸前有兩乳，喜取人子養為己子。
basis_claims.locator: Bencao Gangmu (本草綱目), bagian Burung bab 4, entri 姑獲鳥

statement.id: Kutipan itu menyebut burung ini dikatakan berasal dari perempuan yang meninggal saat bersalin, sehingga ada dua payudara di dadanya, dan ia gemar mengambil anak orang untuk diasuh sebagai anaknya.
statement.en: The quotation says the bird is said to be formed from a woman who died in childbirth, hence two breasts on its chest, and it likes to take other people's children to raise as its own.

basis_claims.quote: 時珍曰︰昔人言此鳥產婦所化，陰慝為妖，故有諸名。 ... 時珍曰︰此鳥純雌無雄，七八月夜飛，害人尤毒也。
basis_claims.locator: Bencao Gangmu (本草綱目), bagian Burung bab 4, entri 姑獲鳥

statement.id: Li Shizhen (時珍) menulis bahwa orang dahulu mengatakan burung ini berasal dari perempuan yang meninggal saat bersalin, bahwa burung ini seluruhnya betina tanpa jantan, terbang pada malam hari di bulan ketujuh dan kedelapan, dan sangat berbisa dalam mencelakai orang.
statement.en: Li Shizhen (時珍) writes that people of old said this bird came from a woman who died in childbirth, that it is entirely female with no males, flies at night in the seventh and eighth months, and is especially venomous in harming people.

basis_claims.quote: 荊州多有之。亦謂之鬼鳥。《周禮》庭氏「以救日之弓，救月之矢，射夭鳥」，即此也。
basis_claims.locator: Bencao Gangmu (本草綱目), bagian Burung bab 4, entri 姑獲鳥

statement.id: Kutipan Bencao Gangmu menyebut burung ini banyak terdapat di Jingzhou (荊州) dan juga disebut 鬼鳥.
statement.en: The Bencao Gangmu quotation says the bird is common in Jingzhou (荊州) and is also called 鬼鳥.

headless-horseman.depicted_variant: Irving textual head-seeking horseman; no fire pumpkin, film sword or invented lightning

visual_requirements.description: one fully clothed headless rider with exactly two arms and two legs, closed dry cloth neckline with no gore, no head carried and no pumpkin; one horse with one head, two eyes and four legs
No power effects; speed throws ordinary dust and damp earth from hooves
Sleepy Hollow churchyard with graves and distant shadowed trees

headless-horseman.aura: Kesan kuat berasal dari gallop directly at the viewer from the churchyard, horse front hooves lifted and rider gripping reins (headless-horseman-c20).

basis_claims.quote: The figures are traditionally depicted as riders on horseback who are missing their heads.

statement.id: Sosok-sosok ini secara tradisional digambarkan sebagai penunggang kuda yang kehilangan kepala.
statement.en: The figures are traditionally depicted as riders on horseback who are missing their heads.

basis_claims.quote: The dominant spirit, however, that haunts this enchanted region, and seems to be commander-in-chief of all the powers of the air, is the apparition of a figure on horseback, without a head. It is said by some to be the ghost of a Hessian trooper, whose head had been carried away by a cannon-ball, in some nameless battle during the Revolutionary War

statement.id: Roh dominan yang menghantui wilayah terpesona itu, tampaknya panglima semua kekuatan udara, adalah penampakan sosok berkuda tanpa kepala, yang oleh sebagian orang dikatakan hantu seorang prajurit Hessian yang kepalanya terbawa bola meriam dalam pertempuran tanpa nama selama Perang Revolusi.
statement.en: The dominant spirit that haunts this enchanted region, seemingly commander-in-chief of all the powers of the air, is the apparition of a figure on horseback without a head, said by some to be the ghost of a Hessian trooper whose head had been carried away by a cannon-ball in some nameless battle during the Revolutionary War.

basis_claims.quote: allege that the body of the trooper having been buried in the churchyard, the ghost rides forth to the scene of battle in nightly quest of his head, and that the rushing speed with which he sometimes passes along the Hollow, like a midnight blast, is owing to his being belated, and in a hurry to get back to the churchyard before daybreak.

statement.id: Menurut para penutur setempat, jasad prajurit itu dikubur di pemakaman gereja, dan hantunya berkuda ke medan pertempuran setiap malam mencari kepalanya; kecepatan menderunya di Hollow, seperti embusan angin tengah malam, karena ia terlambat dan terburu-buru kembali ke pemakaman sebelum fajar.
statement.en: According to local historians, the trooper's body was buried in the churchyard and the ghost rides forth to the scene of battle in nightly quest of his head; the rushing speed with which he passes along the Hollow like a midnight blast is owing to his being belated and in a hurry to get back to the churchyard before daybreak.

basis_claims.quote: the Headless Horseman, who had been heard several times of late, patrolling the country; and, it was said, tethered his horse nightly among the graves in the churchyard.

statement.id: Penunggang Kuda Tanpa Kepala beberapa kali terdengar berpatroli di pedesaan dan konon menambatkan kudanya setiap malam di antara makam di pemakaman gereja.
statement.en: The Headless Horseman had been heard several times of late patrolling the country and, it was said, tethered his horse nightly among the graves in the churchyard.

imbunche.depicted_variant: Backward head and one bound leg must be explicitly legible; no depicted injury ritual

visual_requirements.description: one backwards-facing twisted head, two eyes, sharp teeth and forked tongue; exactly two twisted arms with hands on ground, one supporting left leg, the right leg bent over its back and attached behind the neck; blue skin and thick back hair; opaque ragged waist covering
No visible magic; claws scrape wet stone and its mouth opens in a guttural warning
the Cueva de Quicavi warlock cave entrance on Chiloe

imbunche.aura: Kesan kuat berasal dari scramble out of the cave on two hands and one foot, with back toward the camera but backwards-twisted face confronting the viewer; the right foot clearly ends behind its neck (imbunche-c05).

basis_claims.quote: In the Chilote folklore and Chilote mythology of Chiloé Island in southern Chile, the imbunche (Mapudungun: ifünche, lit. "short person") is a legendary monster that protects the entrance to a warlock's cave.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat dan mitologi Chilote dari Pulau Chiloé di Chili selatan, imbunche (Mapudungun: ifünche, "orang pendek") adalah monster legendaris yang melindungi pintu masuk gua seorang penyihir.
statement.en: In the Chilote folklore and mythology of Chiloé Island in southern Chile, the imbunche (Mapudungun: ifünche, "short person") is a legendary monster that protects the entrance to a warlock's cave.

basis_claims.quote: The imbunche is a deformed human with its head twisted backwards, along with having twisted arms, fingers, nose, mouth and ears.

statement.id: Imbunche adalah manusia cacat dengan kepala terpelintir ke belakang serta anggota tubuh yang bengkok.
statement.en: The imbunche is a deformed human with head twisted backwards and twisted limbs.

basis_claims.quote: The creature walks on one foot or on three feet (actually one leg and two hands) because one of its legs is attached to the back of its neck. It has blue skin and sharp teeth.

statement.id: Makhluk ini berjalan dengan satu kaki atau tiga kaki (sebenarnya satu kaki dan dua tangan) karena salah satu kakinya melekat di belakang lehernya. Kulitnya biru dan giginya tajam.
statement.en: The creature walks on one foot or three feet (actually one leg and two hands) because one of its legs is attached to the back of its neck. It has blue skin and sharp teeth.

basis_claims.quote: The imbunche cannot talk, and communicates only by guttural, rough and unpleasant sounds.

statement.id: Imbunche tidak dapat berbicara dan hanya berkomunikasi dengan bunyi parau, kasar, dan tidak enak didengar.
statement.en: The imbunche cannot talk and communicates only through guttural, rough and unpleasant sounds.

basis_claims.quote: The Brujo chilote transforms the child into a deformed hairy monster by breaking their right leg and twisting it over their back. When the child is three months old their tongue is forked, their teeth turn sharp, their skin turns blue, and the warlock applies a magic cream over the child's back to cause thick hairs.

statement.id: Brujo chilote mengubah anak itu menjadi monster cacat berbulu dengan mematahkan kaki kanannya dan memelintirnya ke punggung. Pada usia tiga bulan lidahnya dibelah, giginya meruncing, kulitnya membiru, dan sang penyihir mengoleskan krim ajaib di punggungnya agar tumbuh bulu tebal.
statement.en: The Brujo chilote turns the child into a deformed hairy monster by breaking its right leg and twisting it over its back. At three months its tongue is forked, its teeth become sharp, its skin turns blue, and the warlock applies a magic cream to its back to make thick hair grow.

basis_claims.quote: The seat of the King was in the Cueva de Quicaví or Casa Grande, in the surroundings of Quicaví, in the commune of Quemchi. According to legend, the society worked out of a cave that was guarded by a deformed being, the Imbunche.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, perkumpulan para penyihir bekerja dari sebuah gua, Cueva de Quicaví atau Casa Grande, yang dijaga oleh makhluk cacat bernama Imbunche.
statement.en: According to legend, the warlocks' society worked out of a cave, the Cueva de Quicaví or Casa Grande, which was guarded by a deformed being, the Imbunche.

lembuswana.depicted_variant: Living sacred guardian rather than statue; golden bull variant of c02, respectful strength

visual_requirements.description: one crowned bull head, two eyes, one elephant trunk, two elephant tusks, golden bull body covered in dragon scales, four rooster-clawed legs with clear spurs, one dragonlike tail, exactly two garuda feathered wings
Water cascades from the body during emergence, documented ability to live in water and air and fly; no lightning generated
Mahakam River at Tepian Batu, Kutai Lama

lembuswana.aura: Kesan kuat berasal dari surge out from the mahakam river toward the viewer and spread its wings to begin taking flight, trunk lifted and foreclaws reaching forward (lembuswana-c09,lembuswana-c26,lembuswana-c27).

basis_claims.quote: Lembuswana merupakan sosok berwana keemasan berwujud binatang lembu atau sapi yang mengenakan mahkota di atas kepalanya, memiliki belalai dan gading seperti gajah, sayap yang mengepak seperti garuda, kuku dan taji yang menyerupai ayam jantan dengan bagian badan yang bersisik seperti naga.

statement.id: Lembuswana berwarna keemasan, berwujud lembu atau sapi bermahkota, berbelalai dan bergading seperti gajah, bersayap seperti garuda, berkuku dan bertaji seperti ayam jantan, dan bersisik seperti naga.
statement.en: The lembuswana is golden, a crowned bull or cow with an elephant's trunk and tusks, garuda-like wings, a rooster's claws and spurs and dragon-like scales.

basis_claims.quote: Lembuswana dipercaya menjaga Sungai Mahakam terhadap bahaya serta memastikan bahwa air sungai Mahakam tetap bersih dan jernih. Selain itu, sosok ini dipercaya dapat membantu nelayan dalam mencari rezeki dengan memberikan petunjuk lokasi untuk menangkap ikan.

statement.id: Lembuswana dipercaya menjaga Sungai Mahakam dari bahaya, menjaga airnya tetap bersih, dan membantu nelayan menemukan lokasi menangkap ikan.
statement.en: The lembuswana is believed to guard the Mahakam River from danger, keep its water clean and help fishermen find fishing spots.

basis_claims.quote: Hewan ini diyakini memiliki kekuatan luar biasa yang dapat hidup di darat, air, maupun udara.

statement.id: Hewan ini diyakini memiliki kekuatan luar biasa dan dapat hidup di darat, air, maupun udara.
statement.en: The animal is believed to have extraordinary power and to be able to live on land, in water and in the air.

basis_claims.quote: Lembusuana diriwayatkan sebagai makhluk perkasa yang digambarkan secara filosofis sebagai tunggangan Puteri Karang Melenu dan Aji Batara Agung Dewa Sakti cikal bakal rajaraja Kutai Kartanegara yang dapat terbang secepat kilat di angkasa

statement.id: Lembusuana diriwayatkan sebagai makhluk perkasa yang digambarkan secara filosofis sebagai tunggangan Puteri Karang Melenu dan Aji Batara Agung Dewa Sakti, cikal bakal raja-raja Kutai Kartanegara, dan dapat terbang secepat kilat di angkasa.
statement.en: Lembusuana is recounted as a mighty creature philosophically depicted as the mount of Puteri Karang Melenu and Aji Batara Agung Dewa Sakti, progenitors of the Kutai Kartanegara kings, able to fly as fast as lightning through the sky.

basis_claims.quote: Dengan demikian dapat disimpulkan bahwa Lembusuana adalah makhluk yang luar biasa yang muncul dari dasar sungai di Tepian Batu, Kutai Lama.

statement.id: Artikel ini menyimpulkan bahwa Lembusuana adalah makhluk luar biasa yang muncul dari dasar sungai di Tepian Batu, Kutai Lama.
statement.en: The article concludes that Lembusuana is an extraordinary creature that emerged from the river bed at Tepian Batu, Kutai Lama.

meitei-dragons.depicted_variant: Pakhangba dalam wujud ular besar pada malam hari, bukan gabungan naga Meitei.

visual_requirements.description: Pakhangba in his documented serpentine dragon/snake form: one snake head, two eyes, one long limbless scaled body, no invented horns or wings
No visible magical effects; displeasure is expressed by the documented great-sized snake form
Darkness of Manipur at night; minimal shadowed earth beneath the coils

meitei-dragons.aura: No visible magical effects; displeasure is expressed by the documented great-sized snake form [meitei-dragons-c13]

basis_claims.quote: Dragons play a significant role in the legendary accounts of Meitei folklore, literature, mythology and religion of ancient, medieval and modern Manipur.

statement.id: Naga memiliki peran dalam cerita, sastra, mitologi, dan agama Meitei di Manipur.
statement.en: Dragons feature in Meitei stories, literature, mythology and religion in Manipur.

basis_claims.quote: Because of his divine power to be able to move about at night as dragon he is also known as Sanahing Pakhangba.

statement.id: Karena kekuatan ilahinya untuk bergerak pada malam hari sebagai naga, ia juga dikenal sebagai Sanahing Pakhangba.
statement.en: Because of his divine power to move about at night as a dragon, he is also known as Sanahing Pakhangba.

basis_claims.quote: Pakhangba is the youngest son of Leimarel Sidabi, the supreme mother earth goddess. He was given the throne of the universe to protect and rule the world by Atingkok, his father. He could change himself into both a serpentine dragon and a human.

statement.id: Pakhangba adalah putra bungsu Leimarel Sidabi, dewi ibu bumi tertinggi; ayahnya Atingkok memberinya takhta alam semesta untuk melindungi dan memerintah dunia, dan ia dapat mengubah dirinya menjadi naga berbentuk ular maupun manusia.
statement.en: Pakhangba is the youngest son of the supreme mother earth goddess Leimarel Sidabi; his father Atingkok gave him the throne of the universe to protect and rule the world, and he could change himself into both a serpentine dragon and a human.

basis_claims.quote: Around the personage of Pakhangba legends have grown up which declare him to have had the power of changing his shape into that of a snake
basis_claims.locator: Chapter on origins (text near 'Around the personage of Pakhangba')

statement.id: Menurut sumber ini, di sekitar tokoh Pakhangba tumbuh legenda yang menyatakan ia memiliki kekuatan mengubah wujudnya menjadi ular.
statement.en: According to this source, legends have grown up around Pakhangba declaring that he had the power of changing his shape into that of a snake.

basis_claims.quote: This snake appears, they say, sometimes of great size, and when he does so it is indicative of his being displeased with something. But as long as he remains of diminutive form it is a sign that he is in good humour.
basis_claims.locator: Chapter on religion (passage quoted from an earlier account)

statement.id: Dalam kutipan catatan lama di sumber ini, ular itu kadang tampak sangat besar, yang dianggap tanda ia tidak senang; selama tetap kecil, itu tanda suasana hatinya baik.
statement.en: In an older account quoted in this source, the snake sometimes appears of great size, taken as a sign of displeasure, while a diminutive form is a sign that it is in good humour.

ratoshikamuy.depicted_variant: Gurita raksasa Rātoshikamuy dilihat melintasi permukaan air, kepala tetap terendam.

visual_requirements.description: One immense octopus with one mantle/head, two eyes, exactly eight sucker-lined arms, no other appendages; head stays underwater
Black ink physically pours from the octopus mouth into the water; arms wrench up seawater
The sea at the mouth of the Ishikari River, a close split-level underwater view showing the head submerged

ratoshikamuy.aura: Black ink physically pours from the octopus mouth into the water; arms wrench up seawater [ratoshikamuy-c03, ratoshikamuy-c04]

basis_claims.quote: ラートシカムイ（ラードシカムイ）は、アイヌ民話に伝わる巨大な蛸。

statement.id: Ratoshikamuy (Rātoshikamuy, juga Rātoshikamuy/Rādoshikamuy) adalah kamuy berupa gurita raksasa dalam cerita rakyat Ainu.
statement.en: Ratoshikamuy (Rātoshikamuy, also written Rādoshikamuy) is a giant octopus in Ainu folktales.

basis_claims.quote: 説話によれば、海で一番力の強いのはラードシカムイ〔ママ〕、そして"陸での力もちは片翼が七里もあるという巨鳥フリー"とされていた。互いに怪力を自負して対立していたが、あるとき石狩川の河口で二頭（一羽と一杯？）が遭遇した。

statement.id: Menurut kisah itu, yang terkuat di laut adalah Ratoshikamuy dan yang terkuat di darat adalah burung raksasa Huri (Furi) yang satu sayapnya sepanjang tujuh ri; keduanya saling membanggakan kekuatan dan berseteru, lalu bertemu di muara Sungai Ishikari.
statement.en: According to the tale, the strongest in the sea was Ratoshikamuy and the strongest on land was the giant bird Huri (Furi), one of whose wings is seven ri long; each prided itself on its strength and they were at odds, and they once met at the mouth of the Ishikari River.

basis_claims.quote: 蛸は墨を吐き、口を尖らせ、目を怒らせると、フリーは鋼鉄のような翼を広げて身構えると、水面上に出ていた触手をついばみ攻撃を開始し、ずるずると蛸を引き揚げにかかったが、頭までは水面現れなかった。

statement.id: Gurita itu menyemburkan tinta, memonyongkan mulut, dan melotot marah; Huri membentangkan sayapnya, mematuk tentakel yang muncul di atas air, dan mencoba menariknya dari laut, tetapi kepala gurita itu tidak sampai muncul.
statement.en: The octopus spits ink, pouts its mouth and glares in anger; Huri spreads its wings, pecks at the tentacles above the water and tries to haul it up, but the octopus’s head never surfaces.

basis_claims.quote: こんどは蛸が押収して、触手を折り曲げて引っ張ったが、鳥はふんばって耐えた（詳細は、「石狩」地名由来とまとめて後述）。けっきょく力は両者とも互角で、決着がつくことはなかったという。

statement.id: Kemudian gurita itu menarik balik dengan menekuk tentakelnya, tetapi burung itu bertahan; kekuatan keduanya seimbang dan pertandingan tidak berakhir dengan pemenang.
statement.en: Then the octopus pulled back by bending its tentacles, but the bird held its ground; the two were evenly matched and the contest was never settled.

sundel-bolong.depicted_variant: Hantu perempuan berambut panjang dengan lubang punggung tembus yang disederhanakan tanpa gore.

visual_requirements.description: One adult female ghost, one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs, very long black hair, fully opaque long white dress. A large clean dark hole pierces the upper back through her body, readable as an empty opening, with zero blood or visible organs
No power beams or environmental destruction; menace is from her documented vengeful haunting and impossible back opening
A deserted Indonesian country road after dark

sundel-bolong.aura: No power beams or environmental destruction; menace is from her documented vengeful haunting and impossible back opening [sundel-bolong-c05, sundel-bolong-c18]

basis_claims.quote: In Indonesian mythology, a sundel bolong is a mythical ghost from the archipelago which is a woman with beautiful long, black hair and a long white dress (her form is similar to Pontianak).

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Indonesia, sundel bolong adalah hantu dari Nusantara berupa perempuan berambut panjang hitam yang indah dan bergaun putih panjang, mirip pontianak.
statement.en: In Indonesian mythology, the sundel bolong is a ghost of the archipelago, a woman with beautiful long black hair and a long white dress, similar to the pontianak.

basis_claims.quote: The myth is closely linked to prostitutes, meaning a "prostitute with a hole in her", in reference to the large hole which is said to appear in her back.

statement.id: Mitos ini terkait erat dengan pelacur; namanya berarti 'pelacur yang berlubang', merujuk lubang besar di punggungnya.
statement.en: The myth is tied to prostitutes; the name means 'prostitute with a hole', referring to the large hole in her back.

basis_claims.quote: The victims of sundel bolong supposedly consist mainly of men and children. As a vengeful spirit, if rejected by a man, she is said to castrate him. Children, especially newborns are said to be taken to replace her lost child.

statement.id: Korban sundel bolong terutama laki-laki dan anak-anak; sebagai arwah pendendam ia dikatakan mengebiri laki-laki yang menolaknya dan mengambil bayi baru lahir sebagai pengganti anaknya.
statement.en: Her victims are mainly men and children; as a vengeful spirit she is said to castrate men who reject her and take newborns to replace her lost child.

basis_claims.quote: Hantu sundel bolong dikatakan sering menjelma sebagai wanita cantik yang berjalan seorang diri di jalan yang sunyi.

statement.id: Hantu sundel bolong dikatakan sering menjelma sebagai wanita cantik yang berjalan seorang diri di jalan yang sunyi.
statement.en: The sundel bolong is said to often appear as a beautiful woman walking alone on a quiet road.

basis_claims.quote: Sundel Bolong sering menampakkan diri terutama pada laki-laki di area tempat dia dibunuh sebagai peringatan. Selain itu juga akan muncul pada laki-laki yang berniat jahat pada perempuan dengan penampilan seperti terakhir kali dia hidup.

statement.id: Sundel bolong sering menampakkan diri, terutama kepada laki-laki di tempat ia dibunuh, sebagai peringatan; ia juga muncul kepada laki-laki yang berniat jahat terhadap perempuan, dengan penampilan seperti terakhir kali ia hidup.
statement.en: The sundel bolong often appears, especially to men, at the place where she was killed, as a warning; she also appears to men who intend harm to women, looking as she did when last alive.

basis_claims.quote: hantu sundel bolong yang mempunyai lubang di bagian punggungnya yang terlihat tembus ke depan. Letak lubang bergantung pada luka terakhir saat meninggal

statement.id: Hantu sundel bolong digambarkan punya lubang di punggung yang tembus ke depan; letak lubang itu disebut bergantung pada luka terakhir saat ia meninggal.
statement.en: The sundel bolong is pictured with a hole in her back that goes through to the front; the position of the hole is said to depend on the last wound at the time of death.

ao-bing.depicted_variant: Ao Bing berwujud naga putih penguasa hujan di Laut Timur.

visual_requirements.description: Ao Bing in his documented white dragon form, one dragon head, two eyes, one long sinuous white-scaled dragon body, four consistent limbs; no human form, no film costume, no borrowed modern design
Dense rain and physical rain clouds pour over the sea, water splashes around his moving coils
East Sea with a distant shadow of the Crystal Palace below the water

ao-bing.aura: Dense rain and physical rain clouds pour over the sea, water splashes around his moving coils [ao-bing-c06, ao-bing-c14]

basis_claims.quote: Ao Bing (Chinese: 敖丙; pinyin: Áo Bǐng) is a character in the classic Chinese novel Investiture of the Gods (Fengshen Yanyi). He is a dragon prince and the third son of Ao Guang, the Dragon King of the East Sea. Ao Bing is a major antagonist in the Nezha story. He is often shown as arrogant, spoiled, and cruel, abusing his power as a dragon prince.

statement.id: Ia disebut putra ketiga Ao Guang, Raja Naga Laut Timur.
statement.en: He is identified as the third son of Ao Guang, the East Sea Dragon King.

basis_claims.quote: The third son of Ao Guang, the Dragon King of the East Sea, Ao Bing lives in the Crystal Palace with his brothers, Ao Jia and Ao Yi. Both of them are older than him.

statement.id: Ao Bing tinggal di Istana Kristal bersama kakaknya Ao Jia dan Ao Yi.
statement.en: Ao Bing dwells in the Crystal Palace with his older brothers Ao Jia and Ao Yi.

basis_claims.quote: Ao Bing was originally revered as a rain god who would bestow the rain at his command upon any individual in need, but, as time passed, his father became corrupt, and soon the people were living in fear of the stormy malevolence of Ao Guang and his three sons.

statement.id: Ao Bing semula dihormati sebagai dewa hujan yang menurunkan hujan atas perintahnya kepada siapa pun yang membutuhkan, tetapi seiring waktu ayahnya menjadi korup dan rakyat hidup dalam ketakutan akan kebengisan badai Ao Guang dan ketiga putranya.
statement.en: Ao Bing was originally revered as a rain god who would bestow rain at his command on anyone in need, but over time his father became corrupt and the people lived in fear of the stormy malevolence of Ao Guang and his three sons.

basis_claims.quote: According to folklore, when Nezha caused havoc in the East Sea, he used the Universe Ring (Qiankun Quan) to kill the white dragon, Ao Bing. Later, the immortal Taiyi Zhenren revived Ao Bing using tendon-relaxing vines and white pine bark.

statement.id: Menurut cerita rakyat, ketika Nezha mengacau di Laut Timur ia memakai Cincin Semesta (Qiankun Quan) untuk membunuh naga putih Ao Bing; kemudian sang abadi Taiyi Zhenren menghidupkannya kembali dengan sulur pelemas otot dan kulit pinus putih.
statement.en: According to folklore, when Nezha caused havoc in the East Sea he used the Universe Ring (Qiankun Quan) to kill the white dragon Ao Bing; later the immortal Taiyi Zhenren revived Ao Bing using tendon-relaxing vines and white pine bark.

basis_claims.quote: 哪吒急了，把七尺混天綾望空一展，似火塊千團，往下一裹，將三太子裹下逼水獸來。哪吒搶一步趕上去，一腳踏住敖丙的頸項，提起乾坤圈，照頂門一下，把三太子的元身打出，是一條龍，在地上挺直。

statement.id: Dalam teks klasik ini, Nezha (哪吒) membentangkan selendang Hun Tian (七尺混天綾) yang seperti seribu gumpal api dan menggulung sang pangeran jatuh dari binatangnya; ia lalu menginjak leher Ao Bing (敖丙) dan memukul ubun-ubunnya dengan Cincin Qiankun (乾坤圈), sehingga wujud asli sang pangeran terlihat sebagai seekor naga yang terbujur di tanah.
statement.en: In this classical text, Nezha (哪吒) spreads his seven-foot Hun Tian scarf (七尺混天綾), like a thousand lumps of fire, and wraps the prince off his beast; he then steps on Ao Bing's (敖丙) neck and strikes his crown with the Qiankun Ring (乾坤圈), so that the prince's original body shows as a dragon lying stretched on the ground.

basis_claims.quote: 「陳塘關李靖之子哪吒把三太子打死，連筋都抽去了。」敖光聽報，大驚曰：「吾兒乃興雲布雨滋生萬物正神，怎說打死了！

statement.id: Ketika dilapori bahwa Nezha (哪吒), putra Li Jing (李靖) dari Pass Chentang (陳塘關), memukul mati sang putra ketiga (三太子) dan mencabut uratnya, Ao Guang (敖光) terkejut dan berseru bahwa putranya adalah dewa lurus yang membuat awan dan hujan serta menghidupi segala makhluk.
statement.en: When told that Nezha (哪吒), son of Li Jing (李靖) of Chentang Pass (陳塘關), has beaten the third prince (三太子) to death and pulled out his sinews, Ao Guang (敖光) is startled and cries that his son is a proper god who makes clouds and rain and nourishes all things.

cipactli.depicted_variant: Monster laut primordial gabungan buaya, ikan dan katak, dengan mulut pada sendi.

visual_requirements.description: One primeval monster combining crocodilian head and hide, fishlike tail and a squat toad body: one main head, two eyes, four limbs. Clearly readable small gnashing mouths at every visible limb joint, especially elbows and knees, plus huge fangs in the main mouth; no human body
No magical energy; the monster physically heaves seawater with its body and snapping mouths
The primordial ocean before the earth was formed

cipactli.aura: No magical energy; the monster physically heaves seawater with its body and snapping mouths [cipactli-c02]

basis_claims.quote: In Aztec mythology, Cipactli was a primeval sea monster, part crocodilian, part fish, and part toad or frog.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Aztec, Cipactli adalah monster laut purba perpaduan buaya, ikan, dan kodok.
statement.en: In Aztec mythology, Cipactli was a primeval sea monster, part crocodilian, part fish, and part toad or frog.

basis_claims.quote: In Aztec mythology, Cipactli was a primeval sea monster, part crocodilian, part fish, and part toad or frog. Always hungry, every joint on its body was adorned with an extra mouth.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Aztec, Cipactli adalah monster laut purba, sebagian buaya, sebagian ikan, dan sebagian kodok; selalu lapar, setiap sendi tubuhnya dihiasi mulut tambahan.
statement.en: In Aztec mythology, Cipactli was a primeval sea monster, part crocodilian, part fish, and part toad or frog; always hungry, every joint on its body was adorned with an extra mouth.

basis_claims.quote: In Aztec cosmology, the crocodile symbolized the earth floating in the primeval waters. According to one Aztec tradition, Teocipactli "Divine Crocodile" was the name of a survivor of the flood who rescued himself in a canoe and again repopulated the earth.

statement.id: Dalam kosmologi Aztec, buaya melambangkan bumi yang mengapung di perairan purba; menurut satu tradisi Aztec, Teocipactli 'Buaya Ilahi' adalah nama penyintas banjir yang menyelamatkan diri dengan kano dan kembali mengisi bumi dengan manusia.
statement.en: In Aztec cosmology the crocodile symbolized the earth floating in the primeval waters; according to one Aztec tradition, Teocipactli 'Divine Crocodile' was the name of a survivor of the flood who rescued himself in a canoe and again repopulated the earth.

basis_claims.quote: In the creation mythology of the Aztecs and other Mesoamerican cultures of the Late Postclassic period (13th-16th century CE), the gods Quetzalcoatl and Tezcatlipoca, taking the form of gigantic snakes, descended from the heavens one day and found Tlaltecuhtli sitting astride the ocean. In some versions, this creature is known as Cipactl or 'spiny one.'

statement.id: Dalam mitos penciptaan Aztec, Quetzalcoatl dan Tezcatlipoca dalam wujud ular raksasa turun dari langit dan menemukan Tlaltecuhtli duduk mengangkangi samudra; dalam beberapa versi makhluk ini disebut Cipactl atau 'si berduri'.
statement.en: In the Aztec creation myth, Quetzalcoatl and Tezcatlipoca, taking the form of gigantic snakes, descended from the heavens and found Tlaltecuhtli sitting astride the ocean; in some versions this creature is known as Cipactl or 'spiny one'.

basis_claims.quote: The hideous monster, with large fangs, crocodile skin, and gnashing mouths at her elbows and knees, called menacingly for flesh to feast on.

statement.id: Monster mengerikan itu, bertaring besar, berkulit buaya, dan bermulut mengatup di siku serta lututnya, menyeru dengan mengancam meminta daging untuk disantap.
statement.en: The hideous monster, with large fangs, crocodile skin, and gnashing mouths at her elbows and knees, called menacingly for flesh to feast on.

damballa.depicted_variant: Damballa sebagai ular putih agung yang berganti kulit dan menghadirkan air.

visual_requirements.description: One great white serpent: one natural serpent head, two eyes, one immense limbless coiling body, no horns or wings; benevolent and wise, not evil
Real freshwater cascades from the shedding skin and joins the spring, expressing the documented creation of Earth's waters
A great tree beside a spring and river

damballa.aura: Real freshwater cascades from the shedding skin and joins the spring, expressing the documented creation of Earth's waters [damballa-c06]

basis_claims.quote: He is traditionally portrayed as a great white or black serpent

statement.id: Ia secara tradisional digambarkan sebagai ular besar berwarna putih atau hitam (serpent).
statement.en: He is traditionally portrayed as a great white or black serpent.

basis_claims.quote: By shedding the serpent skin, Damballa created all the waters on the Earth.

statement.id: Dengan berganti kulit ular, Damballa menciptakan semua perairan di bumi.
statement.en: By shedding his serpent skin, Damballa created all the waters on Earth.

basis_claims.quote: Damballa is seen as benevolent and patient, wise and kind, yet detached and removed from the trials and tribulations of daily human life.

statement.id: Damballa dipandang baik hati (benevolent), sabar, bijak, dan ramah, tetapi berjarak dari urusan sehari-hari manusia.
statement.en: Damballa is seen as benevolent, patient, wise and kind, yet detached from the trials of daily human life.

basis_claims.quote: As a serpent, and due to his extreme wisdom, he does not speak, but may whistle or make a soft, hissing sound.

statement.id: Sebagai ular dan karena kebijaksanaannya yang luar biasa, ia tidak berbicara, tetapi dapat bersiul atau mendesis pelan.
statement.en: As a serpent and because of his great wisdom, he does not speak but may whistle or hiss softly.

basis_claims.quote: Der Legende nach lebt Damballah in Schlangengestalt auf einem Baum in der Nähe einer Quelle oder er fährt in ein Becken, das man für ihn erbaut hat.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, Damballah dalam wujud ular tinggal di pohon dekat mata air (Quelle) atau masuk ke kolam yang dibangun untuknya.
statement.en: According to legend, Damballah in serpent form lives in a tree near a spring (Quelle) or enters a basin built for him.

basis_claims.quote: Il représente le principe du bien, et vit près des rivières et des sources.

statement.id: Ia mewakili prinsip kebaikan (principe du bien) dan tinggal dekat sungai dan mata air (rivières et sources).
statement.en: He represents the principle of good (principe du bien) and lives near rivers and springs (rivières et sources).

flathead-lake-monster.depicted_variant: Kepala monster bertanduk raksasa dari legenda Kutenai, tanpa mencampurkan wujud belut penampakan modern.

visual_requirements.description: One enormous lake-monster head bearing a single symmetrical pair of gigantic branching antlers; two eyes; body remains hidden under the frozen lake so do not invent limbs or torso
The frozen lake visibly splits open and heavy ice plates rear up as the head rises
Frozen Flathead Lake, Montana, with small distant shoreline pines

flathead-lake-monster.aura: The frozen lake visibly splits open and heavy ice plates rear up as the head rises [flathead-lake-monster-c03]

basis_claims.quote: The Flathead Lake Monster is a lake monster of Indigenous legend and Montana folklore that is purported to dwell in Flathead Lake in northwestern Montana, United States.

statement.id: Flathead Lake Monster adalah monster danau dari legenda pribumi dan cerita rakyat Montana yang konon hidup di Flathead Lake, Montana barat laut, Amerika Serikat.
statement.en: The Flathead Lake Monster is a lake monster of Indigenous legend and Montana folklore said to live in Flathead Lake, northwestern Montana, United States.

basis_claims.quote: The frozen surface of the lake split open around them, and the head of a monster appeared through the ice, shaking its giant antlers.

statement.id: Dalam legenda itu, permukaan danau yang beku terbelah dan kepala monster bertanduk rusa raksasa muncul dari balik es.
statement.en: In the legend, the frozen lake split open and a monster's head with giant antlers rose through the ice.

hatmehit.depicted_variant: Hatmehit berwujud perempuan berpakaian buram dengan ikan besar di atas kepalanya.

visual_requirements.description: One Egyptian goddess in woman form with one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs; fully opaque long ancient Egyptian linen gown. A large unmistakable complete fish rests horizontally on her head as her documented headdress, clearly silhouetted Correction: all gown panels densely woven and fully opaque; no sheer fabric.
No supernatural effects; real perfumed myrrh smoke expresses her documented association with scents and Lady of myrrh
A shadowed sacred precinct at Mendes in the Nile Delta

hatmehit.aura: No supernatural effects; real perfumed myrrh smoke expresses her documented association with scents and Lady of myrrh [hatmehit-c10]

basis_claims.quote: Sie wird als Frau mit einem welsartigen Fisch auf dem Kopf dargestellt, den sie dann auch über einem Uräus-Diadem trägt. Auf Amuletten erscheint sie als Fisch.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai perempuan dengan ikan di kepala atau sebagai ikan pada jimat.
statement.en: She is depicted as a woman with a fish on her head, or as a fish on amulets.

basis_claims.quote: Verehrt wurde Hatmehit in Mendes, jedoch finden sich auch Darstellungen im Amun-Tempel von Hibis. Die Göttin wurde in der Spätzeit als Gattin des Widder von Mendes angesehen. Seit der 3. Zwischenzeit bilden beide mit Harpokrates die sogenannte Dreiheit von Mendes.

statement.id: Ia dipuja di Mendes dan digambarkan di kuil Amun di Hibis.
statement.en: She is worshipped at Mendes and depicted in Amun’s temple at Hibis.

basis_claims.quote: Hatmehit (Hatmehyt) - She was a fish goddess worshipped in the Delta region of Mendes.

statement.id: Hatmehit (juga ditulis Hatmehyt) adalah dewi ikan yang dipuja di kawasan Delta, di Mendes.
statement.en: Hatmehit (also written Hatmehyt) was a fish goddess worshipped in the Delta region of Mendes.

basis_claims.quote: Due to Mendes' role as a center for perfume production, Hatmehit gained an association with good scents and perfumery. Some of her epithets included "Lady of Punt", "Lady of myrrh", and "She who creates everyone's scent".

statement.id: Karena Mendes menjadi pusat pembuatan parfum, Hatmehit dikaitkan dengan aroma harum dan parfum; gelarnya antara lain "Nyonya Punt", "Nyonya mur", dan "Dia yang menciptakan aroma setiap orang".
statement.en: Because Mendes was a centre of perfume production, Hatmehit became associated with good scents and perfumery; her epithets included "Lady of Punt", "Lady of myrrh" and "She who creates everyone's scent".

sirena-philippine-mythology.depicted_variant: Sirena berekor ikan mengangkat air di pantai berbatu saat menyanyi.

visual_requirements.description: One adult mermaid with one woman's head and torso, two eyes and two arms, very long flowing wavy black hair, one fish tail from the waist down and no legs. Fully opaque weathered dark cloth covers the entire chest and torso
The water rises rapidly into a real engulfing surge around her, physically drowning the rocky shore; no music symbols or magical beams
Rocky Philippine shore in the darkness beside the sea

sirena-philippine-mythology.aura: The water rises rapidly into a real engulfing surge around her, physically drowning the rocky shore; no music symbols or magical beams [sirena-philippine-mythology-c03, sirena-philippine-mythology-c24]

basis_claims.quote: In Philippine mythology, the Sirena is a mythological aquatic legendary creature with the head and torso of a human female from waist down and the tail of a fish. The Sirena is an Engkanto –' the Filipino counterpart of English mermaids.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Filipina, sirena adalah makhluk air legendaris berkepala dan bertubuh atas perempuan dengan ekor ikan dari pinggang ke bawah; sirena adalah engkanto, padanan Filipina bagi putri duyung Inggris.
statement.en: In Philippine mythology, the sirena is a legendary water creature with a woman's head and torso and a fish's tail from the waist down; she is an engkanto, the Filipino counterpart of the English mermaid.

basis_claims.quote: The Sirena has a beautiful and enchanting voice that can attract and hypnotize males, especially fishermen. Sirena sing to sailors and enchant them, distracting them from their work and causing them to walk off ship decks or cause shipwrecks.

statement.id: Sirena bersuara indah yang memikat dan menghipnotis laki-laki, terutama nelayan; ia bernyanyi kepada pelaut hingga mereka lalai, terjatuh dari geladak, atau kapalnya karam.
statement.en: The sirena's beautiful voice lures and hypnotizes men, especially fishermen; she sings to sailors until they neglect their work, walk off decks or are shipwrecked.

basis_claims.quote: They sing with enchanting voices while hiding among the rocks by the shore. When the men hear these songs, they are hypnotized and abducted by the Sirena.

statement.id: Sirena bernyanyi dengan suara memikat sambil bersembunyi di antara batu di tepi pantai; ketika para pria mendengar lagu itu, mereka terhipnotis dan diculik oleh sirena.
statement.en: Sirena sing with enchanting voices while hiding among the rocks by the shore; when men hear the songs they are hypnotized and abducted by the sirena.

basis_claims.quote: Sirena are beautiful sea creatures with the upper body of a human with long, flowing hair that is often curly or wavy and the lower body of a fish or a tail of a fish. In pre-Hispanic Philippines, Sirena were regarded as beautiful aquatic creatures.

statement.id: Sirena adalah makhluk laut yang cantik, bertubuh atas manusia dengan rambut panjang mengalir yang sering ikal atau bergelombang dan bertubuh bawah ikan atau berekor ikan; pada Filipina prakolonial mereka dipandang sebagai makhluk akuatik yang indah.
statement.en: Sirena are beautiful sea creatures with a human upper body and long, flowing, often curly or wavy hair, and a fish's lower body or tail; in pre-Hispanic Philippines they were regarded as beautiful aquatic creatures.

basis_claims.quote: Informants from Zambales and elsewhere told Ramos that the sirena made the water rise quickly and engulfed her victim

statement.id: Informan dari Zambales dan tempat lain memberi tahu Ramos bahwa sirena membuat air naik cepat dan menelan korbannya.
statement.en: Informants from Zambales and elsewhere told Ramos that the sirena made the water rise quickly and engulfed her victim.

skin-walker.depicted_variant: Skin-walker dalam wujud coyote bermata manusia yang menggores pintu rumah.

visual_requirements.description: Fully transformed coyote with unmistakably human eyes: broad white sclera, pale human irises and human-shaped eyelids; natural four-pawed animal body, rear body cropped.
No glowing effects; human eyes in animal form express the documented unnatural transformation
Outside a hogan home in deep night, tight view of a dark wooden doorway

skin-walker.aura: No glowing effects; human eyes in animal form express the documented unnatural transformation [skin-walker-c01, skin-walker-c12]

basis_claims.quote: In Navajo culture, a skin-walker (Navajo: yee naaldlooshii ) or skinwalker is a type of harmful witch who has the ability to turn into, possess, or disguise themselves as an animal.

statement.id: Dalam budaya Navajo, skin-walker adalah jenis penyihir jahat yang mampu berubah wujud menjadi binatang.
statement.en: In Navajo culture, a skin-walker (Navajo: yee naaldlooshii ) or skinwalker is a type of harmful witch who has the ability to turn into, possess, or disguise themselves as an animal.

basis_claims.quote: Skinwalkers usually appear as bears, cougars, coyotes, dogs, foxes, or wolves, but can take any animal’s shape. They choose their shape based on the abilities they need, such as claws, stealth, speed, strength, and teeth, and may transform into another animal if they need to elude pursuit.

statement.id: Skinwalker biasanya tampil sebagai beruang, puma, koyote, anjing, rubah, atau serigala, tetapi dapat mengambil wujud hewan apa pun; mereka memilih wujud menurut kemampuan yang dibutuhkan, seperti cakar, kesenyapan, kecepatan, kekuatan, dan gigi, dan dapat berganti wujud bila perlu menghindari kejaran.
statement.en: Skinwalkers usually appear as bears, cougars, coyotes, dogs, foxes, or wolves but can take any animal's shape; they choose a shape for the abilities they need, such as claws, stealth, speed, strength, and teeth, and may transform into another animal to elude pursuit.

basis_claims.quote: Skinwalkers often rap on windows and doors of homes, or make scraping noises. In their human form, they have eyes that look like animal eyes, while in animal form, their eyes look human.

statement.id: Skinwalker sering mengetuk jendela dan pintu rumah atau menimbulkan bunyi menggores; dalam wujud manusia matanya tampak seperti mata hewan, sedangkan dalam wujud hewan matanya tampak seperti mata manusia.
statement.en: Skinwalkers often rap on windows and doors of homes or make scraping noises; in human form their eyes look like animal eyes, while in animal form their eyes look human.

basis_claims.quote: Animals associated with witchcraft usually include tricksters such as the coyote; however, it may include other creatures, usually those associated with death or bad omens. They might also possess living animals or people and walk around in their bodies.

statement.id: Hewan yang dikaitkan dengan ilmu sihir biasanya mencakup penipu seperti koyote, tetapi dapat mencakup makhluk lain, biasanya yang dikaitkan dengan kematian atau pertanda buruk; mereka juga dapat merasuki hewan hidup atau orang dan berjalan dalam tubuhnya.
statement.en: Animals associated with witchcraft usually include tricksters such as the coyote but may include other creatures, usually those associated with death or bad omens; they might also possess living animals or people and walk around in their bodies.

basis_claims.quote: Skin-walker stories told among Navajo children may be complete life and death struggles that end in either skin-walker or Navajo killing the other, or partial encounter stories that end in a stalemate. Encounter stories may be composed as Navajo victory stories, with the skin-walkers approaching a hogan and being scared away.

statement.id: Kisah skin-walker yang diceritakan kepada anak-anak Navajo dapat berupa pergulatan hidup-mati yang berakhir dengan salah satu pihak membunuh yang lain, atau kisah perjumpaan sebagian yang berakhir buntu; kisah perjumpaan dapat berupa kisah kemenangan Navajo, ketika skin-walker mendekati hogan lalu ditakuti hingga pergi.
statement.en: Skin-walker stories told among Navajo children may be complete life-and-death struggles ending with either the skin-walker or the Navajo killing the other, or partial encounter stories ending in a stalemate; encounter stories may be Navajo victory stories, with the skin-walkers approaching a hogan and being scared away.

thunderbird.depicted_variant: Thunderbird burung pemangsa raksasa yang mengepakkan sayap dan melepaskan kilat dari mata.

visual_requirements.description: One enormous supernatural bird of prey, one raptor head, two eyes, exactly two immense feathered wings, two taloned feet, one fan tail; original naturalistic bird, no human hybrid or cultural art patterns
Real lightning forks from the flashing eyes through the storm, thunder-driving wing strokes buffet the rain
The upper storm sky over a distant dark landscape

thunderbird.aura: Real lightning forks from the flashing eyes through the storm, thunder-driving wing strokes buffet the rain [thunderbird-c05, thunderbird-c10, thunderbird-c16]

basis_claims.quote: The thunderbird is a mythological birdlike spirit in North American Indigenous peoples' history and culture.

statement.id: Thunderbird adalah roh serupa burung mitologis dalam sejarah dan kebudayaan masyarakat pribumi Amerika Utara.
statement.en: The thunderbird is a mythological birdlike spirit in North American Indigenous peoples' history and culture.

basis_claims.quote: In Algonquian mythology, the thunderbird controls the upper world while the underworld is governed by the underwater panther or Great Horned Serpent.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Algonquian, thunderbird menguasai alam atas sementara dunia bawah diperintah makhluk lain.
statement.en: In Algonquian mythology, the thunderbird controls the upper world while the underworld is governed by the underwater panther or Great Horned Serpent.

basis_claims.quote: Across cultures, thunderbirds are generally depicted as birds of prey, or hybrids of humans and birds.

statement.id: Di berbagai kebudayaan makhluk ini digambarkan sebagai burung pemangsa atau perpaduan manusia dan burung.
statement.en: Across cultures, thunderbirds are generally depicted as birds of prey, or hybrids of humans and birds.

basis_claims.quote: The thunderbird is said to create thunder by flapping its wings in Algonquian tellings, and lightning by flashing its eyes in both Algonquian and Iroquois tellings.

statement.id: Dalam penuturan Algonquian, thunderbird dikatakan menciptakan guntur dengan mengepakkan sayap; dalam penuturan Algonquian dan Iroquois, ia menciptakan petir dengan mengerjapkan matanya.
statement.en: The thunderbird is said to create thunder by flapping its wings in Algonquian tellings, and lightning by flashing its eyes in both Algonquian and Iroquois tellings.

basis_claims.quote: The thunderbird creates not just thunder (with its wing-flapping) but also lightning bolts, which it casts at the underworld creatures.

statement.id: Thunderbird menciptakan bukan hanya guntur (dengan kepakan sayap) tetapi juga sambaran petir yang ia lemparkan kepada makhluk-makhluk dunia bawah.
statement.en: The thunderbird creates not just thunder (with its wing-flapping) but also lightning bolts, which it casts at the underworld creatures.

basis_claims.quote: In some Indigenous traditional stories, thunder and lightning are attributed to the thunderbird. It produces thunder by flapping its wings and lightning by opening and closing its eyes.

statement.id: Dalam sebagian kisah tradisional Pribumi, guntur dan petir dikaitkan dengan thunderbird; ia menghasilkan guntur dengan mengepakkan sayap dan petir dengan membuka dan menutup mata.
statement.en: In some Indigenous traditional stories, thunder and lightning are attributed to the thunderbird, which produces thunder by flapping its wings and lightning by opening and closing its eyes.

basis_claims.quote: Thunderbird is described as an enormous bird (according to many Northwestern tribes, large enough to carry a killer whale in its talons as an eagle carries a fish) who is responsible for the sound of thunder (and in some cases lightning as well.)

statement.id: Thunderbird digambarkan sebagai burung raksasa (menurut banyak suku di barat laut, cukup besar untuk membawa paus pembunuh dalam cakarnya seperti elang membawa ikan) yang bertanggung jawab atas bunyi guntur (dan dalam beberapa kasus petir juga).
statement.en: Thunderbird is described as an enormous bird (according to many Northwestern tribes, large enough to carry a killer whale in its talons as an eagle carries a fish) responsible for the sound of thunder (and in some cases lightning as well).

unhcegila.depicted_variant: Unhcegila ular air bertanduk bersisik tebal, muncul dari banjir.

visual_requirements.description: One massive horned water serpent, one fanged head, two eyes burning like fire, one long heavily armored scaly body; a pair of horns on the head. No visible limbs in this close coil-and-head composition, no extra heads
Primordial water floods the land around the rising serpent; the documented eyes of fire cast tiny localized orange reflections, never a glowing body aura
Flooded land with dark Black Hills ridges

unhcegila.aura: Primordial water floods the land around the rising serpent; the documented eyes of fire cast tiny localized orange reflections, never a glowing body aura [unhcegila-c05, unhcegila-c06, unhcegila-c10]

basis_claims.quote: is a serpentoid creature which was responsible for many unexplained disappearances and deaths. Her male counterpart is known as Unk Tehi.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Lakota, Unhcegila adalah makhluk mirip ular yang dianggap penyebab banyak kematian dan kehilangan misterius; pasangan jantannya bernama Unk Tehi.
statement.en: In Lakota mythology, Unhcegila is a serpent-like creature blamed for many unexplained disappearances and deaths; her male counterpart is Unk Tehi.

basis_claims.quote: As time went on further, her form was exposed as being massive, with a long scaly body whose natural armor was almost impenetrable.

statement.id: Belakangan wujudnya terungkap sangat besar, bertubuh panjang bersisik dengan pelindung alami yang hampir tak tertembus.
statement.en: Her form was later revealed as massive, with a long scaly body whose armor was almost impenetrable.

basis_claims.quote: She was described at first as having no real shape or form; she had eyes of fire, and a fanged mouth that was shrouded in a smoky or cloudy mass.

statement.id: Pada mulanya ia digambarkan tanpa bentuk yang nyata, bermata api, dengan mulut bertaring yang diselubungi massa seperti asap atau awan.
statement.en: She was first described as having no real shape or form, with eyes of fire and a fanged mouth shrouded in a smoky or cloudy mass.

basis_claims.quote: Her eyes burned with wrathful hunger, her claws were like iron, and her voice raged like thunder rolling in the clouds.

statement.id: Matanya menyala dengan kelaparan murka, cakarnya seperti besi, dan suaranya mengamuk seperti guntur bergulung di awan.
statement.en: Her eyes burned with wrathful hunger, her claws were like iron and her voice raged like thunder rolling in the clouds.

basis_claims.quote: Until they made their way to the Black Hills (Pahá Sápa) and sought a new home in the mountains.

statement.id: Menurut kisah-kisah itu, makhluk ini dan pasangannya akhirnya sampai ke Black Hills (Pahá Sápa) dan mencari rumah baru di pegunungan.
statement.en: According to the accounts, the creature and her companion finally made their way to the Black Hills (Pahá Sápa) and sought a new home in the mountains.

basis_claims.quote: In another myth, Unk Cekula emerged from the primordial waters to flood the land. The resulting devastation angered Wakinyan, who flapped his wings to create a great storm to dry up the land and shoot lightning, killing Unk Cekula.

statement.id: Dalam mitos lain, Unk Cekula muncul dari perairan purba dan membanjiri daratan; kehancuran itu membuat Wakinyan murka, yang mengepakkan sayapnya menciptakan badai besar untuk mengeringkan tanah dan menembakkan petir sehingga membunuh Unk Cekula.
statement.en: In another myth Unk Cekula emerged from the primordial waters and flooded the land; the devastation angered Wakinyan, who flapped his wings to create a great storm to dry the land and shoot lightning, killing Unk Cekula.

basis_claims.quote: Unktehila is the horned water serpent of Lakota and Dakota mythology. It is the diametrical opponent of the Thunderbird Wakinyan, and there are many legends about epic fights between the two.

statement.id: Menurut Native Languages of the Americas, Unktehila adalah ular air bertanduk dalam mitologi Lakota dan Dakota, lawan utama Burung Guntur Wakinyan, dan ada banyak legenda tentang pertarungan dahsyat keduanya.
statement.en: According to Native Languages of the Americas, Unktehila is the horned water serpent of Lakota and Dakota mythology, the diametrical opponent of the Thunderbird Wakinyan, with many legends of epic fights between the two.

Its documented legs physically elongate; no colored aura or invented magic effects
A cemetery roadside in Azerbaijan as darkness falls at dusk

unuqay.aura: Its documented legs physically elongate; no colored aura or invented magic effects [unuqay-c04]

basis_claims.quote: Unuqay və ya Hal anasının keçi dönərgəsi — Azərbaycan mifologiyasında bədheybət.

statement.id: Unuqay, atau wujud kambing (keçi dönərgəsi) Hal anası, adalah makhluk mengerikan (bədheybət) dalam mitologi Azerbaijan (Azərbaycan).
statement.en: Unuqay, or the goat transformation (keçi dönərgəsi) of Hal anası, is a monster (bədheybət) in Azerbaijan (Azərbaycan) mythology.

basis_claims.quote: Unuqay qəbiristanlıq ətrafı ərazilərdə görülür. O, əsasən axşamüstü, qaranlıq çökərkən insanların rastına çıxır.

statement.id: Unuqay terlihat di sekitar kuburan (qəbiristanlıq) dan terutama menjumpai orang saat senja, ketika gelap turun (qaranlıq çökərkən).
statement.en: Unuqay is seen around cemeteries (qəbiristanlıq) and meets people mainly at dusk, as darkness falls (qaranlıq çökərkən).

basis_claims.quote: Yolçu keçinin bədheybət olduğunu bildikdən sonra onun ayaqları uzanmağa başlayır. Ayaqlarının uzanması ilə birlikdə Unuqayın gücü də artır.

statement.id: Setelah pengembara tahu kambing itu makhluk mengerikan, kakinya mulai memanjang (ayaqları uzanmağa), dan seiring itu kekuatan (gücü) Unuqay bertambah.
statement.en: Once the traveller realises the goat is a monster, its legs begin to lengthen (ayaqları uzanmağa), and with this Unuqay's strength (gücü) grows.

basis_claims.quote: Erkək keçi, oğlaq formasındadır. Keçinin rəngi mifoloji mətnlərin çoxunda ağ, yalnız bircə mətndə qaradır.

statement.id: Wujud hewannya kambing jantan atau anak kambing (oğlaq); dalam sebagian besar teks warnanya putih (ağ), hanya dalam satu teks hitam (qara).
statement.en: Its animal form is a billy goat or kid (oğlaq); in most texts it is white (ağ), and in only one text black (qara).

basis_claims.quote: It was usually bearded and had a rounded snout. It was also often depicted as having two heads or with the spirit of a god or ancestor emerging from its jaws.

statement.id: Ia biasanya digambarkan berjenggot dan berhidung bulat, sering berkepala dua atau dengan roh dewa atau leluhur muncul dari rahangnya.
statement.en: It was usually bearded with a rounded snout, and was frequently shown double-headed, or with a god's or ancestor's spirit coming out of its mouth.

basis_claims.quote: During Maya bloodletting rituals, participants would experience visions in which they communicated with the ancestors or gods. These visions took the form of a giant serpent which served as a gateway to the spirit realm.

statement.id: Dalam ritual pengeluaran darah Maya, peserta mengalami penglihatan tempat mereka berkomunikasi dengan leluhur atau dewa; penglihatan itu berwujud ular raksasa yang menjadi gerbang ke alam roh.
statement.en: In Maya bloodletting rituals, participants experienced visions in which they communicated with ancestors or gods; the visions took the form of a giant serpent serving as a gateway to the spirit realm.

basis_claims.quote: The vision serpent thus came to be the method in which ancestors or gods manifested themselves to the Maya. Thus for them, the Vision Serpent was a direct link between the spirit realm of the gods and the physical world.

statement.id: Vision Serpent menjadi cara leluhur atau dewa menampakkan diri kepada orang Maya, sehingga bagi mereka ia penghubung langsung antara alam roh para dewa dan dunia fisik.
statement.en: The Vision Serpent became the way ancestors or gods manifested themselves to the Maya, a direct link between the spirit realm of the gods and the physical world.

basis_claims.quote: Once the actual bloodletting was over, the blood soaked ceremonial papers were burned, releasing a column of smoke. The smoke provided the perfect medium for the Vision Serpent to appear.

statement.id: Setelah pengeluaran darah selesai, kertas upacara yang berlumur darah dibakar dan menghasilkan kolom asap; asap itu menjadi medium sempurna bagi Vision Serpent untuk muncul.
statement.en: Once the bloodletting was over, the blood-soaked ceremonial papers were burned, releasing a column of smoke that provided the perfect medium for the Vision Serpent to appear.

the precipitous Caucasus coastal mountain landscape, a small distant sailing ship for the documented scene

basis_claims.quote: Zeus merantai Prometheus di sebuah tebing di pegunungan Kaukasus dan setiap hari akan datang seekor elang yang memakan hati Prometheus.

statement.id: Zeus merantai Prometheus di tebing pegunungan Kaukasus, dan setiap hari seekor elang datang memakan hatinya.
statement.en: Zeus chained Prometheus to a Caucasus cliff, and every day an eagle came to eat his liver.

basis_claims.quote: THE AETOS KAUKASIOS (Caucasian Eagle) was a gigantic eagle sent by Zeus to feed upon the ever-regenerating liver of the Titan Prometheus after he was chained to a peak of the Kaukasos (Caucasus) Mountains as punishment for stealing fire from the gods.

statement.id: Aetos Kaukasios (Elang Kaukasus) adalah elang raksasa yang diutus Zeus untuk memakan hati Titan Prometheus yang terus memulihkan diri setelah ia dirantai di puncak pegunungan Kaukasos (Kaukasus) sebagai hukuman karena mencuri api dari para dewa.
statement.en: The Aetos Kaukasios (Caucasian Eagle) was a gigantic eagle sent by Zeus to feed upon the ever-regenerating liver of the Titan Prometheus after he was chained to a peak of the Kaukasos (Caucasus) Mountains as punishment for stealing fire from the gods.

basis_claims.quote: The eagle was variously described as a bronze automaton constructed by the god Hephaistos (Hephaestus), or as a fell creature spawned by the drakaina Ekhidna (Echidna).

statement.id: Elang itu digambarkan beragam: sebagai automaton perunggu buatan dewa Hephaistos (Hephaestus), atau sebagai makhluk ganas yang dilahirkan drakaina Ekhidna (Echidna).
statement.en: The eagle was variously described as a bronze automaton constructed by the god Hephaistos (Hephaestus), or as a fell creature spawned by the drakaina Ekhidna (Echidna).

basis_claims.quote: Hesiod, Theogony 507 ff (trans. Evelyn-White) ... Ready-witted Prometheus he [Zeus] bound with inextricable bonds, cruel chains ... set on him a long-winged eagle, which used to eat his immortal liver; but by night the liver grew as much again everyway as the long-winged bird devoured in the whole day. That bird Herakles (Heracles), the valiant son of shapely-ankled Alkmene (Alcmena), slew

statement.id: Dalam Theogony karya Hesiodos (terjemahan Evelyn-White), seekor elang bersayap panjang yang biasa memakan hati abadi Prometheus ditempatkan padanya, tetapi pada malam hari hati itu tumbuh sebanyak yang dimakan burung itu sepanjang hari; burung itu dibunuh Herakles (Heracles), putra gagah Alkmene (Alcmena).
statement.en: In Hesiod's Theogony (trans. Evelyn-White), a long-winged eagle was set on Prometheus to eat his immortal liver, but by night the liver grew as much again as the bird devoured in the whole day; Herakles (Heracles), the valiant son of Alkmene (Alcmena), slew that bird.

basis_claims.quote: Apollonius Rhodius, Argonautica 2. 1238 ff (trans. Rieu) ... They saw it in the afternoon flying high above the ship with a strident whirr. It was near the clouds, yet it made all their canvas quiver to its wings as it beat by. For its form was not that of an ordinary bird : the long quill-feathers of each wing rose and fell like a bank of polished oars.

statement.id: Dalam Argonautica karya Apollonius Rhodius (terjemahan Rieu), mereka melihat elang itu pada sore hari terbang tinggi di atas kapal dengan desing nyaring; ia dekat awan, tetapi sayapnya membuat seluruh layar mereka bergetar saat ia melintas. Bentuknya bukan bentuk burung biasa: bulu-bulu sayap panjangnya naik turun seperti deretan dayung yang digosok.
statement.en: In Apollonius Rhodius' Argonautica (trans. Rieu), they saw it in the afternoon flying high above the ship with a strident whirr; it was near the clouds, yet its wings made all their canvas quiver as it beat by. Its form was not that of an ordinary bird: the long quill-feathers of each wing rose and fell like a bank of polished oars.

basis_claims.quote: He is a giant, several times larger than a normal human being.

statement.id: Ia adalah raksasa, beberapa kali lebih besar dari manusia normal.
statement.en: He is a giant, several times larger than a normal human being.

basis_claims.quote: In one story, he is depicted as so huge that he cannot fit his shoulders into a cave in which a normal human being can pass easily.

statement.id: Dalam satu kisah, ia digambarkan sedemikian besar sehingga pundaknya tidak muat ke dalam gua yang dapat dilalui manusia biasa.
statement.en: In one story, he is depicted as so huge that he cannot fit his shoulders into a cave that a normal human easily passes.

basis_claims.quote: to this day it is called the “Cave of Átahsaia,” and there, in the times I tell of, lived Átahsaia himself.

statement.id: Menurut penuturan Cushing, gua itu hingga kini disebut "Gua Átahsaia", dan di sanalah Átahsaia sendiri tinggal pada masa yang dikisahkan.
statement.en: In Cushing's telling, the cave is still called the "Cave of Átahsaia", and there Átahsaia himself lived in the times of the tale.

basis_claims.quote: Uhh! what an ugly demon he was! His body was as big as the biggest elk’s, and his breast was shaggy with hair as stiff as porcupine-quills.

statement.id: Dalam penuturan Cushing, tubuhnya sebesar tubuh rusa elk terbesar dan dadanya berbulu kaku seperti duri landak.
statement.en: In Cushing's telling his body was as big as the biggest elk's and his breast was shaggy with hair as stiff as porcupine quills.

basis_claims.quote: Now, although Átahsaia was ugly and could not speak without chattering his teeth, or laugh without barking like a wolf, he was a very polite demon. But, like many ugly and polite people nowadays, he was a great liar.

statement.id: Dalam penuturan Cushing, Átahsaia buruk rupa, tak bisa bicara tanpa gigi bergemeletuk atau tertawa tanpa menggonggong seperti serigala, tetapi ia iblis yang sangat sopan dan pembohong besar.
statement.en: In Cushing's telling Átahsaia was ugly, could not speak without chattering his teeth or laugh without barking like a wolf, yet he was a very polite demon and a great liar.
