basis_claims.quote: Chiwen is also the name of a Chinese dragon that mixes features of a fish, and in Chinese mythology is one of the nine sons of the dragon, which are also used as imperial roof decorations.

statement.id: Chiwen juga nama seekor naga Tiongkok yang memadukan ciri-ciri ikan, dan dalam mitologi Tiongkok merupakan salah satu dari sembilan anak naga yang juga dipakai sebagai hiasan atap kekaisaran.
statement.en: Chiwen is also the name of a Chinese dragon that mixes features of a fish, and in Chinese mythology is one of the nine sons of the dragon, which are also used as imperial roof decorations.

basis_claims.quote: According to the Ming Dynasty Wuzazu ( 五雜俎) "The ch'i-wen, which like swallowing, are placed on both ends of the ridgepoles of roofs (to swallow all evil influences)."

statement.id: Menurut Wuzazu dari zaman Ming, chiwen yang suka menelan diletakkan di kedua ujung bubungan atap (untuk menelan semua pengaruh jahat).
statement.en: According to the Ming Dynasty Wuzazu, the ch'i-wen, which like swallowing, are placed on both ends of the ridgepoles of roofs (to swallow all evil influences).

basis_claims.quote: This is the fish-like, hornless dragon with a very truncated body and large, wide mouth usually found along roof ridges (as if swallowing the roof beams). His presence on roofs is also said to guard against fires.

statement.id: Chiwen adalah naga tanpa tanduk mirip ikan dengan tubuh sangat pendek dan mulut lebar yang biasanya ada di sepanjang bubungan atap; kehadirannya di atap juga dikatakan menjaga dari kebakaran.
statement.en: The chiwen is the fish-like, hornless dragon with a very truncated body and large wide mouth usually found along roof ridges; its presence on roofs is also said to guard against fires.

basis_claims.quote: A paragraph in the Tang dynasty book Su Shi Yan Yi ( 蘇氏演義) by Su E ( 蘇鶚) says that a mythical sea creature called the chi wen [sic] was put on the roofs of buildings during the Han dynasty to protect the structures from fire hazards.

statement.id: Sebuah paragraf dalam buku Su Shi Yan Yi karya Su E dari zaman Tang menyebut makhluk laut mitos yang dipasang pada atap bangunan pada zaman Han untuk melindungi bangunan dari bahaya kebakaran.
statement.en: A paragraph in the Tang dynasty book Su Shi Yan Yi by Su E says a mythical sea creature called the chi wen was put on the roofs of buildings during the Han dynasty to protect the structures from fire hazards.

basis_claims.quote: In Fengshui theory, a chiwen or chiwei supposedly protects against not only fires, but also floods and typhoons.

statement.id: Dalam teori fengshui, chiwen atau chiwei dipercaya melindungi bukan hanya dari kebakaran, tetapi juga dari banjir dan topan.
statement.en: In Fengshui theory, a chiwen or chiwei supposedly protects not only against fires but also against floods and typhoons.

basis_claims.quote: This tile originally decorated one end of the roof ridge of a temple. Facing inwards, the large dragon appears to be swallowing the roof ridge.

statement.id: Menurut label museum, ubin ini semula menghiasi salah satu ujung bubungan atap sebuah kuil, dan naga besar yang menghadap ke dalam tampak seperti menelan bubungan atap.
statement.en: According to the museum label, this tile originally decorated one end of the roof ridge of a temple, and the large dragon, facing inwards, appears to be swallowing the roof ridge.

basis_claims.quote: The larger dragon is biting the roof ridge with wide-open jaws and its winding tail turns upward.

statement.id: Uraian museum tentang ubin itu menyatakan bahwa naga yang lebih besar menggigit bubungan atap dengan rahang terbuka lebar dan ekornya yang berliku mengarah ke atas.
statement.en: The museum's description of the tile states that the larger dragon bites the roof ridge with wide-open jaws and its winding tail turns upward.

basis_claims.quote:
「気づかなかったか? 貴行が先ほどまで乗っていたものが、火のように赤い目玉を開き、口をあけてあくびをしたのだ」と恐れながら答えた。

statement.id: Dalam satu kisah, benda yang dikira batu tempat seorang bernama Fujita duduk dikatakan membuka mata merah seperti api dan menguap, lalu lenyap tanpa bekas; diduga itu katak puru raksasa dan tonjolan yang dikira batu adalah kutil katak.

basis_claims.quote: Hatsadiling (Thai: หัสดีลิงค์; Burmese: ဟတ္ထီလိင်္ဂ; Pali: hatthīliṅga; Sanskrit: hastilinga) is a mythical bird commonly featured in Northern Thai art. The creature is considered to be the size of a house, with the head and body of a lion, trunk and tusks of an elephant, the comb of a cock, and the wings of a bird.

statement.id: Hatsadiling adalah burung mitos yang umum muncul dalam seni Thailand utara.
statement.en: Hatsadiling is a mythical bird commonly found in Northern Thai art.

basis_claims.quote: The creature is considered to be the size of a house, with the head and body of a lion, trunk and tusks of an elephant, the comb of a cock, and the wings of a bird.

statement.id: Rupanya memadukan singa, belalai dan gading gajah, jengger ayam, serta sayap burung.
statement.en: Its form combines a lion, an elephant's trunk and tusks, a cock's comb and bird wings.

basis_claims.quote: According to an oral myth in northeastern Thailand, the bird once inhabited the legendary forest of Himavanta.

statement.id: Tradisi lisan Thailand timur laut menempatkan burung ini di hutan Himavanta.
statement.en: Northeastern Thai oral tradition places this bird in Himavanta forest.

basis_claims.quote: Buddhaghoṣa mentions it as an animal which possesses the strength of five elephants.

statement.id: Buddhaghosa menyebutnya memiliki kekuatan lima gajah.
statement.en: Buddhaghosa describes it as possessing the strength of five elephants.

basis_claims.quote: A characteristic of the Hatsadiling Bird is its big shape and being as powerful as five elephants. It is said to have originated in the good land of the so-called moral people, Uttarakuru Continent.

statement.id: Menurut abstrak makalah ini, ciri burung Hatsadiling ialah tubuhnya yang besar dan kekuatannya yang setara lima gajah; ia dikatakan berasal dari tanah yang baik milik orang-orang bermoral, Benua Uttarakuru.
statement.en: According to the paper's abstract, a characteristic of the Hatsadiling bird is its big shape and being as powerful as five elephants; it is said to have originated in the good land of the so-called moral people, the Uttarakuru Continent.

basis_claims.quote: The Buddhist texts and literature only mention the bird’s characteristic big shape and having five elephants worth of power, and that the bird took people away because it thought that people were victims, but it had no intention of harm.

statement.id: Menurut abstrak makalah ini, teks dan sastra Buddhis hanya menyebut tubuh burung yang besar dan kekuatan setara lima gajah, serta bahwa burung itu membawa pergi orang karena mengira mereka mangsa, tanpa niat mencelakai.
statement.en: According to the paper's abstract, the Buddhist texts and literature only mention the bird's big shape and five elephants' worth of power, and that it took people away because it thought they were victims, with no intention of harm.

statement.id: Jiaolong adalah naga mirip ular dalam mitologi Tiongkok yang dikaitkan dengan perairan.
statement.en: Jiaolong is a serpentine Chinese mythological dragon associated with water.

basis_claims.quote: is a serpent-like dragon in Chinese mythology, often defined as a "scaled dragon"; it is hornless according to certain scholars and said to be aquatic or river-dwelling. It may have referred to a species of crocodile.

statement.id: Sebagian penafsiran menggambarkannya tanpa tanduk.
statement.en: Certain scholars describe the scaled dragon as hornless.

basis_claims.quote: A number of scholars point to non-Sinitic southern origins for the legendary creature and ancient texts chronicle that the Yue people once tattooed their bodies to ward against these monsters.

statement.id: Teks kuno menyebut tato masyarakat Yue sebagai perlindungan dari makhluk ini.
statement.en: Ancient texts describe Yue tattoos as protection against these creatures.

basis_claims.quote: Several texts allude to the jiao being the lord of aquatic beings. The jiaolong is called the "god of the water animals".

statement.id: Sejumlah teks menyiratkan bahwa jiao adalah penguasa makhluk air, dan jiaolong disebut "dewa hewan-hewan air".
statement.en: Several texts allude to the jiao as lord of aquatic beings, and the jiaolong is called the "god of the water animals".

basis_claims.quote: people in the southern state of Wu called it fahong 發洪 "swell into a flood" because they believed flooding resulted when jiao hatched.

statement.id: Menurut sumber ini, orang di negara bagian selatan Wu menyebutnya fahong ("membengkak menjadi banjir") karena mereka percaya banjir terjadi ketika jiao menetas.
statement.en: According to the source, people in the southern state of Wu called it fahong ("swell into a flood") because they believed flooding resulted when jiao hatched.

basis_claims.quote: Guo adds that the jiao possesses a "small head and a narrow neck with a white goiter " and that it is oviparous, and "large ones were more than ten arm spans in width and could swallow a person whole".

statement.id: Menurut komentar Guo Pu, jiao berkepala kecil dan berleher ramping dengan gondok putih, bertelur, dan yang besar dapat menelan seseorang bulat-bulat.
statement.en: According to Guo Pu's commentary, the jiao has a small head and narrow neck with a white goiter, is oviparous, and large ones could swallow a person whole.

basis_claims.quote: 裴淵《廣州記》云︰蛟長丈餘，似蛇而四足，形廣如楯, 小頭細頸，頸有白嬰。胸前赭色, 背上靑斑, 脇邊若錦, 尾有肉環, 大者數圍

statement.id: Menurut kutipan dari Pei Yuan dalam Bencao Gangmu karya Li Shizhen, jiao panjangnya satu zhang lebih, mirip ular tetapi berkaki empat, berkepala kecil dan berleher ramping dengan "rumbai putih" di leher, dada cokelat kemerahan, punggung berbintik biru-hijau, dan ekor bercincin daging.
statement.en: According to a passage from Pei Yuan quoted in Li Shizhen's Bencao Gangmu, the jiao is over a zhang long, snake-like but four-legged, with a small head and thin neck bearing white tassels, a sienna chest, blue-green spots on its back, and fleshy rings on its tail.

kukulkan.depicted_variant: living feathered serpent descending over Chichen Itza

visual_requirements.description: exactly one serpent head, two eyes, one continuous feather-covered serpentine body, feathered crest and mantle, NO legs or arms, NO separate wings in this selected feathered-snake variant
The serpent tail drives physical wind: rain tilts, leaves and dust sweep across the stone steps; storm clouds and rainfall follow documented rain and wind domain
Chichen Itza with the El Castillo temple stairway subordinate to the living feathered serpent; no glyphs or lettering

kukulkan.aura: The serpent tail drives physical wind: rain tilts, leaves and dust sweep across the stone steps; storm clouds and rainfall follow documented rain and wind domain Basis klaim: kukulkan-c03, kukulkan-c05, kukulkan-c16, kukulkan-c11, kukulkan-c17, kukulkan-c18, kukulkan-c02, kukulkan-c10.

basis_claims.quote: Prominent temples to Kukulkan are found at archaeological sites in the Yucatán Peninsula, such as Chichen Itza, Uxmal and Mayapan.

statement.id: Kuil untuk Kukulkan ditemukan di situs arkeologi Chichen Itza, Uxmal, dan Mayapan.
statement.en: Prominent temples to Kukulkan are found at archaeological sites in the Yucatán Peninsula, such as Chichen Itza, Uxmal and Mayapan.

basis_claims.quote: The depiction of the Feathered Serpent is present in other cultures of Mesoamerica.

statement.id: Penggambaran Ular Bersayap ada dalam kebudayaan lain di Mesoamerika.
statement.en: The depiction of the Feathered Serpent is present in other cultures of Mesoamerica.

basis_claims.quote: The Yucatec form of the name is formed from the word kuk "feather" with the adjectival suffix -ul, giving kukul "feathered", combined with kan "snake" (Tzotzil chon), giving a literal meaning of "feathered snake".

statement.id: Bentuk Yucatec dari nama itu dibentuk dari kata kuk 'bulu' dengan akhiran sifat -ul sehingga menjadi kukul 'berbulu', digabung dengan kan 'ular', yang berarti harfiah 'ular berbulu'.
statement.en: The Yucatec form of the name is formed from the word kuk 'feather' with the adjectival suffix -ul, giving kukul 'feathered', combined with kan 'snake', giving a literal meaning of 'feathered snake'.

basis_claims.quote: El Castillo, Chichen Itza served as a temple to Kukulkan. During the spring and fall equinoxes the shadow cast by the angle of the sun and edges of the nine steps of the pyramid combined with the northern stairway and the stone serpent head carvings create the illusion of a massive serpent descending the pyramid.

statement.id: El Castillo di Chichen Itza berfungsi sebagai kuil Kukulkan. Pada ekuinoks musim semi dan gugur, bayangan dari sudut matahari dan tepi sembilan undakan piramida, dipadukan dengan tangga utara dan ukiran kepala ular batu, menciptakan ilusi ular raksasa yang menuruni piramida.
statement.en: El Castillo at Chichen Itza served as a temple to Kukulkan. At the spring and fall equinoxes the shadow cast by the sun on the edges of the nine steps of the pyramid, combined with the northern stairway and the stone serpent head carvings, creates the illusion of a massive serpent descending the pyramid.

basis_claims.quote: A modern collection of folklore from Yucatán tells how Kukulkan was a winged serpent that flew to the sun and tried to speak to it but the sun, in its pride, burnt his tongue. The same source relates how Kukulkan always travels ahead of the Yucatec Maya rain god Chaac, helping to predict the rains as his tail moves the winds and sweeps the earth clean.

statement.id: Kumpulan cerita rakyat modern dari Yucatán menuturkan Kukulkan sebagai ular bersayap yang terbang ke matahari dan mencoba berbicara dengannya, tetapi matahari yang congkak membakar lidahnya. Sumber yang sama menyebut Kukulkan selalu berjalan di depan dewa hujan Maya Yucatec, Chaac, membantu meramalkan hujan karena ekornya menggerakkan angin dan menyapu bumi hingga bersih.
statement.en: A modern collection of folklore from Yucatán tells how Kukulkan was a winged serpent that flew to the sun and tried to speak to it, but the sun, in its pride, burnt his tongue; the same source says Kukulkan always travels ahead of the Yucatec Maya rain god Chaac, helping to predict the rains as his tail moves the winds and sweeps the earth clean.

basis_claims.quote: Kukulcan (pron. Koo-kool-kan) is the name of a feathered serpent god in the mythology and religion of Mesoamerica, in particular, the Yucatec Maya. He is also identified as the feathered serpent god Quetzalcóatl by the Toltecs and Aztecs, as Gucumatz to the Quiché Maya of Guatemala, and Ehecatl, the wind god of the Huastecs of the Gulf Coast.

statement.id: Kukulcan adalah nama dewa ular berbulu dalam mitologi dan agama Mesoamerika, khususnya Maya Yucatec. Ia juga diidentifikasi sebagai dewa ular berbulu Quetzalcóatl oleh bangsa Toltec dan Aztec, sebagai Gucumatz oleh Maya Quiché di Guatemala, dan sebagai Ehecatl, dewa angin bangsa Huastec di Pesisir Teluk.
statement.en: Kukulcan is the name of a feathered serpent god in the mythology and religion of Mesoamerica, in particular the Yucatec Maya; he is also identified as Quetzalcóatl by the Toltecs and Aztecs, as Gucumatz to the Quiché Maya of Guatemala, and as Ehecatl, the wind god of the Huastecs of the Gulf Coast.

basis_claims.quote: The Yucatec Maya were (and still are) speakers of the Yucatec language, and they settled the Yucatan peninsula in the north of ancient Mesoamerica. Their chief god was the feathered serpent Kukulcan whose name means just that: feathered (k'uk'ul) and serpent (kan). He was a creator god, and the god of rain, wind, storms, and life.

statement.id: Dewa utama Maya Yucatec, yang menetap di semenanjung Yucatan di utara Mesoamerika kuno, adalah ular berbulu Kukulcan, yang namanya berarti 'berbulu' (k'uk'ul) dan 'ular' (kan). Ia adalah dewa pencipta serta dewa hujan, angin, badai, dan kehidupan.
statement.en: The chief god of the Yucatec Maya, who settled the Yucatan peninsula in the north of ancient Mesoamerica, was the feathered serpent Kukulcan, whose name means feathered (k'uk'ul) and serpent (kan); he was a creator god and the god of rain, wind, storms, and life.

basis_claims.quote: Kukulcan and his other manifestations are all unified by the belief that each was considered a creator god and a bringer of rain and winds. The god is particularly associated with Chichen Itza where a large temple was built in his honour.

statement.id: Kukulcan dan wujud-wujud lainnya dipersatukan oleh keyakinan bahwa masing-masing dianggap dewa pencipta dan pembawa hujan serta angin. Sang dewa terutama dikaitkan dengan Chichen Itza, tempat kuil besar dibangun untuk menghormatinya.
statement.en: Kukulcan and his other manifestations are unified by the belief that each was considered a creator god and a bringer of rain and winds; the god is particularly associated with Chichen Itza, where a large temple was built in his honour.

limokon.depicted_variant: omen fruit dove actively halting a traveller

visual_requirements.description: one living natural fruit-dove head, two natural eyes, one feathered pigeon body, exactly two wings and two feet, modest earthy plumage, normal bird proportions; no aura or invented anatomy
The prophetic call is represented by the physically halted traveller and raised fist only; no visible sound rings or magical glow
the wooded Mindanao trail of the Mandaya omen account

limokon.aura: The prophetic call is represented by the physically halted traveller and raised fist only; no visible sound rings or magical glow Basis klaim: limokon-c03, limokon-c16, limokon-c04, limokon-c05, limokon-c09, limokon-c10, limokon-c01.

basis_claims.quote: In Philippine mythology, the Limokon was believed by the Mandaya, Bagobo, and Manobo people of Mindanao to be an omen bird. In Luzon, a blue bird called the Tigmamanukan was similarly believed by the Tagalog people to be an omen bird.

statement.id: Orang Mandaya, Bagobo, dan Manobo di Mindanao meyakini limokon sebagai burung pertanda, seperti tigmamanukan bagi orang Tagalog di Luzon.
statement.en: The Mandaya, Bagobo and Manobo of Mindanao believed the limokon an omen bird, like the tigmamanukan among the Tagalog of Luzon.

basis_claims.quote: Likely the term 'limokon' applied to various types of wild pigeons in the various languages in the Philippines, some of which were considered 'magical' and or 'omen birds'.

statement.id: Istilah limokon kemungkinan dipakai untuk berbagai merpati hutan dalam berbagai bahasa di Filipina, sebagian dianggap sakti atau burung pertanda.
statement.en: The term limokon likely named various wild pigeons in the Philippine languages, some thought magical or omen birds.

basis_claims.quote: A common method used by the spirits to communicate with mortals is through the call of the limokon. All the people know the meaning of its calls and all respect its warnings. If a man is starting to buy or trade for an article and this bird gives its warning the sale is stopped.

statement.id: Menurut Fay Cooper Cole (1913), roh biasa berbicara kepada manusia lewat suara limokon; semua orang memahami dan menghormati peringatannya, dan jual beli dihentikan bila ia memberi peringatan.
statement.en: According to Fay Cooper Cole (1913), spirits commonly speak to mortals through the limokon's call; all understand and respect its warnings, and a sale is stopped if it warns.

basis_claims.quote: Should the limokon call when a person is on the trail he at ones doubles his fist and thrusts it in the direction from which the warning comes.

statement.id: Jika limokon berbunyi ketika seseorang berada di jalan setapak, ia segera mengepalkan tinju dan mengacungkannya ke arah datangnya peringatan itu.
statement.en: If the limokon calls when a person is on the trail, he at once doubles his fist and thrusts it in the direction from which the warning comes.

basis_claims.quote: This close relationship of the limokon to the Mandaya is given as the reason why its calls are given such heed. A traveler on the trail hearing the cooing of this bird at once doubles his fist and points it in the direction from whence the sound came.

statement.id: Hubungan dekat limokon dengan orang Mandaya disebut sebagai alasan mengapa bunyinya begitu diindahkan; pelancong yang mendengar kicau burung ini segera mengepalkan tinju dan mengarahkannya ke arah suara itu.
statement.en: The close relationship of the limokon to the Mandaya is given as the reason its calls are heeded so closely; a traveler hearing the cooing of this bird at once doubles his fist and points it toward the sound.

basis_claims.quote: If, however, it points to the left, in front, or in back, the Mandaya knows that the omen bird is warning him of danger or failure, and he delays or gives up his mission.

statement.id: Jika tinjunya menunjuk ke kiri, depan, atau belakang, orang Mandaya tahu bahwa burung pertanda itu memperingatkannya tentang bahaya atau kegagalan, lalu ia menunda atau membatalkan tugasnya.
statement.en: If the fist points to the left, in front or behind, the Mandaya knows the omen bird is warning him of danger or failure, and he delays or gives up his mission.

basis_claims.quote: Li-mo-kon. (Phabitreron brevirostris Tweedale). Generally called fruit dove.

statement.id: Catatan kaki dalam buku ini mencantumkan nama Li-mo-kon dengan nama ilmiah Phabitreron brevirostris Tweedale, yang umumnya disebut merpati buah.
statement.en: A footnote in this book gives the name Li-mo-kon with the scientific name Phabitreron brevirostris Tweedale, generally called fruit dove.

medjed-fish.depicted_variant: living sharp-snouted sacred fish with horned sun-disc

visual_requirements.description: one living elephantfish with a long DOWNWARD-curving sharp snout, two natural eyes, coherent fish body and ordinary fish fins, ONE crown consisting of an antique golden SUN DISC held between TWO curved horns; no human arms or legs
river water at Per-Medjed in Upper Egypt, a shadowed riverbank hinted above the waterline

medjed-fish.aura: No documented active power; sacred presence through the clearly visible horned sun-disc crown and commanding close framing only, no electric beams Basis klaim: medjed-fish-c01, medjed-fish-c03, medjed-fish-c04, medjed-fish-c05.

basis_claims.quote: Medžed je staroegyptská posvátná ryba, zástupce čeledi rypounovitých. Uctívána byla hlavně ve městě Oxyrhynchu (Permedžedu), jehož egyptský název znamená „Dům Medžedův“.

statement.id: Medjed adalah ikan suci Mesir kuno dari keluarga ikan gajah yang terutama dipuja di Oxyrhynchus (Per-Medjed), yang nama Mesirnya berarti "Rumah Medjed".
statement.en: Medjed is a sacred ancient Egyptian fish of the elephantfish family, worshipped mainly in Oxyrhynchus (Per-Medjed), whose Egyptian name means "House of Medjed".

basis_claims.quote: Medjed were a kind of elephantfish worshipped at Oxyrhynchus ... A settlement in Upper Egypt, Per-Medjed, was named after them. They are now better known by their Greek name Oxyrhynchus, meaning "sharp-nosed", a nod to the Egyptian depiction of the fish.

statement.id: Sebuah permukiman di Mesir Hulu, Per-Medjed, dinamai menurut ikan itu. Kini ikan itu lebih dikenal dengan nama Yunani Oxyrhynchus, yang berarti "berhidung tajam", mengacu pada penggambaran Mesir atas ikan itu.
statement.en: A settlement in Upper Egypt, Per-Medjed, was named after them. They are now better known by their Greek name Oxyrhynchus, meaning "sharp-nosed", a nod to the Egyptian depiction of the fish.

basis_claims.quote: Medjed were a kind of elephantfish worshipped at Oxyrhynchus ... As a sacred fish, they are frequently depicted wearing horned sun-discs. Some figurines have rings to enable their wear as pendant amulets.

statement.id: Sebagai ikan suci, ikan itu sering digambarkan mengenakan cakram matahari bertanduk. Sebagian patung kecilnya memiliki cincin agar dapat dipakai sebagai jimat liontin.
statement.en: As a sacred fish, they are frequently depicted wearing horned sun-discs. Some figurines have rings so that they can be worn as pendant amulets.

basis_claims.quote: The Oxyrhynchus fish depicted as bronze figurines, mural paintings, or wooden coffins in the shape of fish with downturned snouts, with horned sun-disc crowns like those of the goddess Hathor, have been described as resembling members of the genus Mormyrus.

statement.id: Ikan Oxyrhynchus yang digambarkan sebagai patung perunggu, lukisan dinding, atau peti kayu berbentuk ikan dengan moncong menurun dan mahkota cakram matahari bertanduk seperti milik dewi Hathor telah dideskripsikan menyerupai anggota marga Mormyrus.
statement.en: The Oxyrhynchus fish depicted as bronze figurines, mural paintings or wooden fish-shaped coffins with downturned snouts and horned sun-disc crowns like those of the goddess Hathor have been described as resembling members of the genus Mormyrus.

milton-lizard.depicted_variant: Biawak besar15kaki dengan corak hitam-putih dan mata mirip katak, muncul dari tumpukan hood mobil.

visual_requirements.description: Badan biawak sepanjang15kaki, hitam-putih bergaris/berbintik, bawah mulut putih, dua mata besar seperti katak; satu kepala empat kaki dan ekor.
Kepala/bahu muncul dan menggerakkan tumpukan hood mobil; mendesis tanpa kuasa tambahan.
Junkyard kendaraan rusak dekat Milton.

milton-lizard.aura: Corak/mata ganjil milton-lizard-c05 dan muncul menggeser hood mobil milton-lizard-c06 memberi ancaman tanpa efek kuasa.

basis_claims.quote: In Kentucky folklore, the Milton Lizard is a creature described as resembling a 15-foot monitor lizard that purportedly sighted in Cable Creek, near the town of Milton

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Kentucky, Kadal Milton adalah makhluk yang digambarkan menyerupai biawak sepanjang 15 kaki yang konon terlihat di Cable Creek, dekat kota Milton.
statement.en: In Kentucky folklore, the Milton Lizard is a creature described as resembling a 15-foot monitor lizard that was purportedly sighted in Cable Creek near the town of Milton.

basis_claims.quote: he saw the lizard emerge from behind the wrecked vehicles and it hissed at him several times.

statement.id: Ia melihat kadal itu keluar dari balik bangkai kendaraan dan mendesis kepadanya beberapa kali.
statement.en: He saw the lizard emerge from behind the wrecked vehicles and it hissed at him several times.

basis_claims.quote: Entities skin color: Black and white stripes and speckles. Entities body: Lizard body. Entities head: White beneath the mouth. Entities eyes: Large, similar to a frog's eyes.

statement.id: Katalog itu mencatat makhluk tersebut berbadan kadal dengan garis dan bintik hitam putih, bagian bawah mulut berwarna putih, dan mata besar mirip mata katak.
statement.en: The catalog records the entity as having a lizard body with black and white stripes and speckles, white beneath the mouth, and large eyes similar to a frog's.

basis_claims.quote: Cable's brother Garrett was the next to see the creature on July 27. While working in the junkyard, he saw a pile of old car hoods begin to vibrate and move as the lizard's head and shoulders emerged from underneath the debris.

statement.id: Garrett, saudara Cable, orang berikutnya yang melihatnya pada 27 Juli: ia melihat tumpukan kap mobil tua bergetar dan bergerak ketika kepala dan bahu kadal itu muncul dari bawah puing.
statement.en: Cable's brother Garrett was the next to see it, on July 27: he saw a pile of old car hoods begin to vibrate and move as the lizard's head and shoulders emerged from beneath the debris.

mujina.depicted_variant: Wujud alamiah bermuka rakun dan tubuh badger dengan ghost-fire tanuki-bi, close-up agung namun tidak jahat.

visual_requirements.description: Satu kepala bermuka rakun, tubuh badger Jepang, empat kaki dan ekor tanpa fitur faceless.
Menciptakan ghost-fire mirip will-o'-the-wisps, api kecil terpisah yang memantul pada tanah.
Latar tanah gelap editorial, tidak diklaim lokasi cerita.

mujina.aura: Wujud hibrida mujina-c02 dan api ghost-fire mujina-c04 memberi keagungan ganjil dengan hati lembut mujina-c15.

basis_claims.quote: The mujina is said to be a raccoon-faced creature in its natural form, with the main body being that of a Japanese badger.

statement.id: Mujina dikatakan berwajah seperti rakun dalam wujud aslinya, dengan tubuh utama berupa teledu Jepang.
statement.en: The mujina is said to be a raccoon-faced creature in its natural form, with a Japanese badger's body.

basis_claims.quote: At times, the mujina will also create a "ghost-fire", also called tanuki-bi (狸火), which resembles will-o'-the-wisps.

statement.id: Kadang-kadang mujina juga menciptakan "api hantu", disebut juga tanuki-bi (狸火), yang menyerupai will-o'-the-wisp.
statement.en: At times the mujina will also create a "ghost-fire", also called tanuki-bi (狸火), which resembles will-o'-the-wisps.

basis_claims.quote: It is believed that although these creatures can be extremely chaotic, they have a gentle heart, and know how to be grateful.

statement.id: Dipercaya bahwa walau bisa sangat kacau, makhluk ini berhati lembut dan tahu berterima kasih.
statement.en: It is believed that although these creatures can be extremely chaotic, they have a gentle heart and know how to be grateful.

nguruvilu.depicted_variant: Nguruvilu berkepala rubah dan tubuh ular, ekor panjang bercakar mencengkeram air whirlpool.

visual_requirements.description: Satu kepala rubah, dua mata, tubuh ular tanpa kaki; satu ekor panjang dengan ujung bercakar.
Ekor bercakar menyambar dan whirlpool berbahaya berputar; tanpa korban.
Sungai dengan whirlpool.

nguruvilu.aura: Kepala rubah/tubuh ular nguruvilu-c02, sabetan ekor bercakar nguruvilu-c03 dan whirlpool nguruvilu-c07 memberi bahaya.

basis_claims.quote: It is a lake- or river-dwelling creature that appears in the form with a fox-like head and snake-like body

statement.id: Ia tinggal di danau atau sungai, berkepala mirip rubah dan bertubuh mirip ular.
statement.en: It lives in lakes or rivers, with a fox-like head and a snake-like body.

basis_claims.quote: which snatches wading people with its (clawed) long tail, and devours or blood-sucks its victim.

statement.id: Ia menyambar orang yang mengarungi air dengan ekor panjangnya yang bercakar, lalu memangsa atau mengisap darah korbannya.
statement.en: It snatches waders with its long clawed tail and devours or drains its victims.

basis_claims.quote: Nguruvilus live in dangerous whirlpools which kill people who try to cross rivers. The creatures make the water shallow on either ford, to encourage people to try to cross it making it seem safe.

statement.id: Nguruvilu hidup di pusaran air berbahaya yang membunuh orang yang mencoba menyeberangi sungai; mereka membuat air dangkal di kedua sisi arungan agar penyeberangan tampak aman.
statement.en: Nguruvilus live in dangerous whirlpools that kill people trying to cross rivers; they make the water shallow on either ford so that crossing seems safe.

ninki-nanka.depicted_variant: Varian9m tubuh buaya, leher jerapah, kepala kuda dan3tanduk serta sisik reflektif, tanpa varian crowned serpent.

visual_requirements.description: Tubuh buaya9m, leher panjang jerapah, satu kepala kuda, tepat3tanduk, dua mata, empat kaki buaya dan ekor; sisik mirip cermin.
Tatapan fatal disampaikan tatap langsung; tidak ada eye-beam atau korban. Sisik reflektif berwarna mengamuflase.
Rawa habitat varian9m.

ninki-nanka.aura: Tatapan fatal ninki-nanka-c06 dan tubuh9m/3tanduk/sisik cermin ninki-nanka-c05 memberi ancaman tanpa eye-beam.

basis_claims.quote: Some accounts of the legendary creature describe it as a 9m or 30-foot long marsh-dwelling beast having a body like that of a crocodile, mirror-like scales and long neck like that of a giraffe with a horse's head along with three horns.

statement.id: Sebagian kisah menyebutnya binatang rawa sepanjang 9 m (30-foot) bertubuh seperti buaya, bersisik seperti cermin, berleher panjang seperti jerapah, berkepala kuda, dan bertanduk tiga.
statement.en: Some accounts describe a 9m (30-foot) marsh-dwelling beast with a crocodile-like body, mirror-like scales, a giraffe-like long neck, a horse's head and three horns.

basis_claims.quote: Common across descriptions is its believed fatal stare, akin to Medusa, which is said to cause death upon eye contact. Folklore advises carrying mirrors to deflect its gaze.

statement.id: Hampir semua kisah menyebut tatapannya mematikan (fatal stare), seperti Medusa; cerita rakyat menganjurkan membawa cermin untuk menangkis tatapannya.
statement.en: Most descriptions credit it with a fatal stare, akin to Medusa, causing death on eye contact; folklore advises carrying mirrors to deflect its gaze.

basis_claims.quote: Another belief is that it has the ability to camouflage, using its scales which shimmer in various colors. ... The animal is said to be extremely large and very dangerous.

statement.id: Ia juga dipercaya mampu menyamarkan diri (camouflage) dengan sisik yang berkilau aneka warna, serta disebut sangat besar dan sangat berbahaya.
statement.en: It is also believed able to camouflage itself with scales that shimmer in various colours, and is said to be extremely large and very dangerous.

nuno-sa-punso.depicted_variant: Ansisit varian orang tua kecil dengan sendi/perut/kepala/mata besar, keluar dari gundukan tanah dan mengutuk pengganggu.

visual_requirements.description: Orang tua setinggi anak3tahun, sendi/perut/kepala/mata/hidung/mulut besar; satu kepala2lengan2kaki, pakaian buram.; tangan terangkat tepat5jari terlihat.
Meludah ke kaki pengganggu dalam jangkauan sehingga sakit/bengkak, tanpa darah/gore.
Gundukan sarang semut habitat tanah.

nuno-sa-punso.aura: Anatomi Ansisit nuno-sa-punso-c27 dan kutukan ludah/pembengkakan nuno-sa-punso-c10/nuno-sa-punso-c03 memberi otoritas pelindung nuno-sa-punso-c12.

basis_claims.quote: The nuno is described to be a tiny old man, but differs from a dwende or dwarf of Philippine folklore. The dwende is a playful hobgoblin who shows himself to children, while the nuno is a goblin easily angered that will do harm to those who damage or disturb his mound, and will seek retribution, for example by causing the foot of someone who kicked his mound to become swollen.

statement.id: Nuno digambarkan sebagai kakek mungil yang berbeda dari dwende, makhluk jahil yang menampakkan diri kepada anak-anak; nuno adalah goblin yang mudah marah, mencelakai orang yang merusak atau mengganggu gundukannya, dan membalas, misalnya dengan membuat kaki orang yang menendang gundukannya membengkak.
statement.en: The nuno is described as a tiny old man who differs from the dwende, a playful hobgoblin who shows himself to children; the nuno is an easily angered goblin who harms those who damage or disturb his mound and seeks retribution, for example by making swollen the foot of someone who kicked his mound.

basis_claims.quote: In order for a nuno to successfully curse a person, the trespasser must be in close proximity to the nuno. If the trespasser is within range, the Nuno can spit on any part of the trespasser's body. The trespasser will then experience aches or soreness on the affected part of the body

statement.id: Agar kutukan berhasil, penyusup harus berada dekat dengan nuno; jika dalam jangkauan, nuno dapat meludahi bagian tubuh mana pun, dan penyusup lalu merasakan nyeri atau pegal di bagian itu.
statement.en: For a curse to succeed the trespasser must be close to the nuno; if within range the nuno can spit on any part of the trespasser's body, and the trespasser then feels aches or soreness there.

basis_claims.quote: Nunos are protectors of the Earth, and have the ability to sense goodness and evil. If you radiate purity, they are able to tell, and will often reveal themselves. If you have skepticism, cynicism or darkness, they will avoid you or make you ill so you stay away from the area.

statement.id: Nuno disebut pelindung bumi yang mampu merasakan kebaikan dan kejahatan; orang yang memancarkan kemurnian akan mereka kenali dan sering mereka temui, sedangkan orang yang skeptis atau gelap dihindari atau dibuat sakit agar menjauh.
statement.en: Nunos are called protectors of the Earth able to sense goodness and evil; those who radiate purity are recognised and often met, while those with skepticism or darkness are avoided or made ill so they stay away.

basis_claims.quote: The Ilokanos call him ansisit. He is an old man who is as short as a boy of three. His joints, belly, head, eyes, nose, and mouth are large. He lives underground and owns all the land. He lives in caves and anthills, too.

statement.id: Orang Ilokano menyebutnya ansisit: seorang kakek sependek anak tiga tahun, bersendi, perut, kepala, mata, hidung, dan mulut besar, yang tinggal di bawah tanah dan memiliki semua tanah, serta tinggal di gua dan sarang semut.
statement.en: The Ilokanos call him ansisit: an old man as short as a boy of three, with large joints, belly, head, eyes, nose and mouth, who lives underground and owns all the land, and also lives in caves and anthills.

seri-pahang.depicted_variant: Buaya air asin putih raksasa Seri Pahang menyambar melalui laut gelap dalam duel, bukan naga serpentin.

visual_requirements.description: Buaya air asin putih raksasa, satu kepala2mata4kaki1ekor, tanpa tanduk naga.
Dalam pertarungan laut menjadi gelap, guruh dan kilat; ombak dari serbuan tubuh.
Laut di lepas pantai Pahang dalam duel Seri Kemboja.

seri-pahang.aura: Buaya putih raksasa seri-pahang-c01, tekad menantang demon seri-pahang-c08, laut gelap/kilat duel seri-pahang-c12 memberi keagungan.

basis_claims.quote: In Pahang Malay folklore, Seri Pahang (Jawi: سري ڤهڠ) was a legendary giant white saltwater crocodile thought to have lived in the Chini Lake, Pekan District, Pahang. He was famous for his duel with a black sea demon called Seri Kemboja that took place off the coast of Pahang.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Melayu Pahang, Seri Pahang adalah buaya muara putih raksasa yang konon hidup di Tasik Chini, Distrik Pekan, Pahang, dan terkenal karena duelnya dengan iblis laut hitam bernama Seri Kemboja di lepas pantai Pahang.
statement.en: In Pahang Malay folklore, Seri Pahang (سري ڤهڠ) was a legendary giant white saltwater crocodile thought to have lived in Chini Lake, Pekan District, Pahang, famous for his duel with a black sea demon called Seri Kemboja off the coast of Pahang.

basis_claims.quote: According to the legend, news had reached Seri Pahang about a devastating black sea demon, Seri Kemboja (the Glory of Kemboja). He vowed to fight the demon and get rid of him.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, kabar sampai kepada Seri Pahang tentang iblis laut hitam yang merusak, Seri Kemboja ("Kemuliaan Kemboja"); ia bersumpah melawan dan menyingkirkannya.
statement.en: According to the legend, news reached Seri Pahang of a devastating black sea demon, Seri Kemboja ("the Glory of Kemboja"); he vowed to fight and get rid of him.

basis_claims.quote: The fight between Seri Pahang and Seri Kemboja lasted long. The sea became dark, thunder rolled and lightning flashed. After a fierce battle, Seri Pahang managed to kill Seri Kemboja but he was wounded badly himself.

statement.id: Pertarungan itu berlangsung lama: laut menjadi gelap, guruh bergemuruh, dan kilat menyambar; setelah pertempuran sengit Seri Pahang berhasil membunuh Seri Kemboja tetapi sendiri terluka parah.
statement.en: The fight lasted long: the sea turned dark, thunder rolled and lightning flashed; after a fierce battle Seri Pahang killed Seri Kemboja but was himself badly wounded.

shadow-person.depicted_variant: Siluet manusia hidup gelap yang mendekat dan menghilang di ambang pintu, tanpa menggabungkan Hat Man/Watchers.

visual_requirements.description: Satu bayang humanoid hitam featureless, satu kepala dua lengan dua kaki; wajah tanpa detail.
Mendekat pada pengalaman lumpuh tidur dan melintas/menghilang melalui pintu; tepi siluet flickering tanpa aura.
Ambang pintu saat pengamat di tempat tidur, ruang editorial sederhana.

shadow-person.aura: Siluet hidup shadow-person-c01/c04 mendekat shadow-person-c18 dan menghilang di pintu shadow-person-c07 menciptakan keganjilan tanpa kuasa rekaan.

basis_claims.quote: beings resembling animate human shadows, sometimes interpreted as the presence of a spirit.

statement.id: Shadow person adalah sosok dalam keyakinan paranormal yang menyerupai bayangan manusia hidup, kadang dianggap roh.
statement.en: A shadow person is a paranormal belief figure resembling a living human shadow, sometimes interpreted as a spirit.

basis_claims.quote: Hollis describes shadow people as dark silhouettes with human shapes and profiles that flicker in and out of peripheral vision

statement.id: Hollis menggambarkan shadow people sebagai siluet gelap yang berkedip pada penglihatan tepi.
statement.en: Hollis describes shadow people as dark human silhouettes flickering in peripheral vision.

basis_claims.quote: He's most often a man, and may be wearing a hat or a hood. A lot of times you'll only catch a glimpse of him out of the corner of your eye, as he flits across the wall or disappears through a doorway.

statement.id: Dalam laporan yang dikutip, sosok ini paling sering berupa seorang pria yang mungkin bertopi atau berkerudung, dan sering hanya terlihat sekilas dari sudut mata saat melintas di dinding atau menghilang lewat ambang pintu.
statement.en: In the reports described, the figure is most often a man who may wear a hat or a hood, and is often glimpsed only out of the corner of the eye as it flits across a wall or disappears through a doorway.

basis_claims.quote: A sleep paralysis sufferer may perceive a "shadowy or indistinct shape" approaching them when they lie awake paralyzed and become increasingly alarmed.

statement.id: Penderita lumpuh tidur dapat merasakan "bentuk berbayang atau samar" mendekat ketika ia terbaring terjaga dalam keadaan lumpuh dan makin cemas.
statement.en: A sleep paralysis sufferer may perceive a "shadowy or indistinct shape" approaching when lying awake paralyzed and growing increasingly alarmed.

skunk-ape.depicted_variant: Kera humanoid bipedal1,5–2,1m berbulu merah-cokelat menerjang dari semak dan memukul pintu mobil.

visual_requirements.description: Bipedal humanoid/kera1,5–2,1m, bulu merah-cokelat bercak, satu kepala2mata2lengan2kaki.
Menerjang dari semak dan meraih/memukul pintu/running-board kendaraan; tidak visual bau sebagai gas.
Jalan terpencil berbatas semak.

skunk-ape.aura: Wujud bipedal skunk-ape-c06 serta serbuan/pukulan ke kendaraan skunk-ape-c09 membuatnya berbahaya tanpa efek supernatural.

basis_claims.quote: The skunk ape is commonly described as a bipedal human or ape-like creature, approximately 1.5–2.1 m (5–7 feet) tall, and covered in mottled reddish-brown hair.

statement.id: Skunk ape umumnya digambarkan sebagai makhluk berkaki dua mirip manusia atau kera, setinggi sekitar 1,5–2,1 m (5–7 kaki), dan berbulu cokelat kemerahan berbintik.
statement.en: The skunk ape is commonly described as a bipedal human or ape-like creature, approximately 1.5–2.1 m (5–7 feet) tall, and covered in mottled reddish-brown hair.

basis_claims.quote: In 1942, a man in Suwanee County reported a similar creature rushing out from the brush line while he was driving down an isolated road. It was alleged to have grabbed onto his vehicle and beat on the running board and door for half a mile before departing.

statement.id: Pada 1942, seorang pria di Suwanee County melaporkan makhluk serupa menerjang keluar dari semak saat ia mengemudi di jalan sepi; makhluk itu konon mencengkeram kendaraannya dan memukul papan injak serta pintu sejauh setengah mil sebelum pergi.
statement.en: In 1942, a man in Suwanee County reported a similar creature rushing out from the brush line while he drove down an isolated road; it was alleged to have grabbed onto his vehicle and beat on the running board and door for half a mile before departing.

tianma.depicted_variant: Kuda terbang bersayap varian folklore, turun dari langit pada gerbang surgawi, tanpa menggabungkan sisik/bloodsweat.

visual_requirements.description: Kuda satu kepala2mata4kaki, sayap sepasang dipilih literal dari varian wings.
Terbang turun dan berkelana gerbang langit; tanpa glow atau redblood.
Gerbang langit/jade terrace hanya fragmen di belakang kuda.

tianma.aura: Terbang tianma-c01 dan bergerak di gerbang langit tianma-c11 memberi keagungan tanpa mengarang efek aura.

basis_claims.quote: Tianma (天馬 Tiānmǎ, "heavenly horse") was a winged (perhaps metaphorically) flying horse in Chinese folklore.

statement.id: Tianma adalah kuda terbang dalam cerita rakyat Tiongkok, dengan sayap yang mungkin bersifat kiasan.
statement.en: Tianma is a flying horse in Chinese folklore, with wings possibly understood metaphorically.

basis_claims.quote: 天馬徠，開遠門，竦予身，逝昆侖。天馬徠，龍之媒，游閶闔，觀玉臺。〈太初四年誅宛王獲宛馬作。〉

statement.id: Himne berikutnya menyebut kuda langit (天馬) datang menuju Kunlun (昆侖), menjadi perantara bagi naga (龍之媒), mengembara di gerbang langit (閶闔) dan memandang teras giok (玉臺); anotasinya menyebut himne itu dibuat pada tahun keempat Taichu (太初四年) ketika raja Dayuan (宛王) dihukum dan kuda Dayuan diperoleh.
statement.en: The next hymn says the heavenly horse (天馬) comes toward Kunlun (昆侖), acts as the dragon's matchmaker or guide (龍之媒), roams the gate of heaven (閶闔) and views the jade terrace (玉臺); its annotation says it was composed in the fourth year of Taichu (太初四年) when the king of Dayuan (宛王) was executed and Dayuan horses were obtained.

wendigo.depicted_variant: Varian humanoid raksasa berhati es, mengancam penonton dalam dingin musim dingin, tanpa tanduk popculture.

visual_requirements.description: Humanoid raksasa satu kepala2mata2lengan2kaki; tanpa deerhead/tanduk; berpakaian penuh.
Dingin dan hati es tanpa glow; ancaman/taunting dalam mulut terbuka.
Utara musim dingin berhubungan kelaparan; hutan dingin editorial.

wendigo.aura: Gigantisme wendigo-c09, dingin hati es wendigo-c04 serta ancaman bicara wendigo-c12 menegaskan bahaya tanpa deerhorns.

basis_claims.quote: In some representations, the wendigo is described as a giant humanoid with a heart of ice, whose approach is signaled by a foul stench or sudden unseasonable chill.

statement.id: Dalam beberapa penggambaran, wendigo dilukiskan sebagai sosok raksasa berhati es dengan bau busuk atau hawa dingin tiba-tiba.
statement.en: In some representations, the wendigo is described as a giant humanoid with a heart of ice signaled by foul stench or chill.

basis_claims.quote: common to all these cultures is the view that the wendigo is a malevolent, cannibalistic, supernatural being. They were strongly associated with the north, winter, cold, famine, and starvation.

statement.id: Pandangan yang sama di semua budaya itu adalah bahwa wendigo makhluk gaib jahat pemakan manusia, yang sangat dikaitkan dengan utara, musim dingin, hawa dingin, kelaparan, dan paceklik.
statement.en: Common to all these cultures is the view that the wendigo is a malevolent, cannibalistic, supernatural being, strongly associated with the north, winter, cold, famine and starvation.

basis_claims.quote: In Ojibwe, Eastern Cree, Westmain Swampy Cree, Naskapi, and Innu lore, wendigos are often described as giants that are many times larger than human beings

statement.id: Dalam kisah Ojibwe, Cree Timur, Cree Rawa Westmain, Naskapi, dan Innu, wendigo sering digambarkan sebagai raksasa yang berkali-kali lipat lebih besar daripada manusia.
statement.en: In Ojibwe, Eastern Cree, Westmain Swampy Cree, Naskapi and Innu lore, wendigos are often described as giants many times larger than human beings.

basis_claims.quote: A wendigo need not lose the human's powers of cognition or speech and in some depictions may clearly communicate with its prospective victims or even threaten or taunt them.

statement.id: Wendigo tidak harus kehilangan daya pikir atau bicara manusia, dan dalam sebagian gambaran ia dapat berkomunikasi dengan calon korbannya, bahkan mengancam atau mengejek mereka.
statement.en: A wendigo need not lose the human's powers of cognition or speech, and in some depictions may communicate with prospective victims or even threaten or taunt them.

aderyn-y-corff.depicted_variant: Corpse bird tradisi Sikes tanpa bulu/sayap, terbang tanpa tumpuan dan memanggil di pintu orang sekarat.

visual_requirements.description: Burung satu kepala2mata2kaki dan paruh, TANPA bulu dan TANPA sayap; kulitgelapeditorial.
Terbang tanpa tumpuan dan chirpsdewch sebagai pertanda, tanpa memvisualkan kematian korban.
Di luar pintu orang sekarat, malameditorial.

aderyn-y-corff.aura: Burung tanpa bulu/sayap aderyn-y-corff-c06 tetap airborne dan panggilan pertanda di pintu aderyn-y-corff-c02 memberi keganjilan.

basis_claims.quote: It is said to chirp outside a soon-to-be deceased person's door with a cry that sounds similar to dewch (Welsh for 'come'). The bird has no feathers or wings.

statement.id: Berkicau di pintu orang yang akan meninggal, mirip dewch (datanglah); tanpa bulu dan sayap; hidup di alam lain.
statement.en: Chirps at a dying person's door, like dewch (come); no feathers or wings; lives on another plane.

basis_claims.quote: In ancient tradition, it had no feathers nor wings, soaring without support high in the heavens, and, when not engaged upon some earthly message, dwelling in the land of illusion and phantasy.

statement.id: Menurut tradisi kuno yang dicatat Sikes, burung ini tidak berbulu dan tidak bersayap, melayang tanpa tumpuan tinggi di langit, dan ketika tidak mengemban pesan duniawi ia tinggal di negeri ilusi dan khayal.
statement.en: In the ancient tradition recorded by Sikes, the bird had no feathers or wings, soared without support high in the heavens, and, when not engaged on an earthly message, dwelt in the land of illusion and phantasy.

bahamut.depicted_variant: Ikan raksasa kosmogoni Bahamoot di bawah fondasi bumi, tanpa naga game atau bullvariancommentary.

visual_requirements.description: Ikan luar biasa besar,satu kepala2matafish,fin/tail ikan konvensional,tidak dragon.
Menopang fondasi di air,mataflash greatness berupa refleksi kuat bukan eyebeam.
Air bawahbumi dan darkness beneath.

bahamut.aura: Ikan sangat besar dengan mata greatness bahamut-c13 menopang fondasi bahamut-c01 dalam water/darkness bahamut-c14 menciptakan keagungan.

basis_claims.quote: is a monster that lies deep below, underpinning the support structure that holds up the earth.

statement.id: Dalam uraian al-Qazwini, Bahamut adalah monster jauh di bawah bumi yang menopang struktur penyangganya.
statement.en: In al-Qazwini’s account, Bahamut is a monster deep below the earth supporting its foundation.

basis_claims.quote: created an enormous fish, that no one could look upon on account of its vast size, and the flashing of its eyes, and their greatness

statement.id: Untuk menopang banteng itu, Tuhan menciptakan ikan yang sangat besar; tak seorang pun sanggup memandangnya karena ukurannya yang luar biasa serta kilatan dan besarnya matanya.
statement.en: To support the bull, God created an enormous fish that no one could look upon because of its vast size and the flashing and greatness of its eyes.

basis_claims.quote: The name of this fish is Bahamoot [Behemoth]. He placed, as its support, water; and under the water, darkness: and the knowledge of mankind fails as to what is under the darkness

statement.id: Ikan itu bernama Bahamoot [Behemoth]; sebagai penopangnya Tuhan menaruh air, dan di bawah air ada kegelapan, yang isinya tidak diketahui manusia.
statement.en: The fish is named Bahamoot [Behemoth]; as its support God placed water, and under the water darkness, whose contents human knowledge cannot reach.

cactus-cat.depicted_variant: Bobcat berduri dengan blades tulang di forearms dan armoredbranchedtail, menyayat giant cactus pada malam.

visual_requirements.description: Bobcatdenganthornyhair,earspines,4kakipanjang,tailbercabangarmor dan blades tulang di atasfrontpaws.
Boneblades menyayatpangkalgiantcactus, sapmenetes; tanpa supernaturalpower.
Distrikgiantcactus malam.

cactus-cat.aura: Blades/spines cactus-cat-c06 menyayatgiantcactus cactus-cat-c07 memberi ancamananatomi cactus-cat-c02.

basis_claims.quote: The cactus cat was generally described being a bobcat-like creature, covered in hair-like thorns, with particularly long spines extending from the legs and its armored, branching tail.

statement.id: Makhluk ini bertubuh mirip bobcat yang tertutup duri, dengan kaki berduri panjang dan ekor lapis baja bercabang.
statement.en: It resembles a bobcat covered in thorns with long spiny legs and an armored branched tail.

basis_claims.quote: The cactus cat has thorny hair, the thorns being especially long and rigid on its ears. Its tail is branched, and upon the forearms above its front feet are sharp, knifelike blades of bone.

statement.id: Kucing kaktus berambut berduri, duri pada telinganya sangat panjang dan kaku; ekornya bercabang, dan pada lengan bawah di atas kaki depannya terdapat bilah tulang tajam seperti pisau.
statement.en: The cactus cat has thorny hair, with especially long, rigid thorns on its ears; its tail is branched, and on the forearms above its front feet are sharp, knifelike blades of bone.

basis_claims.quote: With these blades it slashes the base of giant cactus trees, causing the sap to exude. This is done systematically, many trees being slashed in the course of several nights as the cat makes a big circuit.

statement.id: Dengan bilah itu ia menyayat pangkal pohon kaktus raksasa sehingga getahnya keluar; ini dilakukan secara sistematis pada banyak pohon selama beberapa malam saat ia berkeliling dalam lingkaran besar.
statement.en: With these blades it slashes the base of giant cactus trees so that the sap exudes, doing this systematically to many trees over several nights as it makes a big circuit.

chamunda.depicted_variant: Chamunda laterdepiction perempuan tua skeletal bersunkeneyes berdiri di atas demon kalah dekat sacredfig,tidak mixedKali.

visual_requirements.description: Perempuantua skeletal,sunkeneyes,onehead2eyes,2arms/2legs editorial,fullopaqueclothing.
Berdiri menguasai demon kalah,gerak turun dan gesturecommand; tanpa bloodmagic atau senjata Kali.
Dekat sacredfig/cremationgrounds.

chamunda.aura: Fiercegoddess chamunda-c01 dengan skeletalaged/sunkeneyes chamunda-c05 dan vanquisheddemon chamunda-c06 memberi otoritas megah.

basis_claims.quote: Chamunda (Sanskrit: चामुण्डा, IAST: Cāmuṇḍā), also known as Chamundeshwari, Chamundi or is a fearsome form of Chandi, the Hindu mother goddess, Mahadevi and is one of the seven Matrikas.

statement.id: Chamunda adalah wujud ganas Chandi atau Mahadevi dan anggota tujuh Matrika.
statement.en: Chamunda is a fierce form of Chandi or Mahadevi and a member of the seven Matrikas.

basis_claims.quote: The goddess is often portrayed as residing in cremation grounds or near holy fig trees. The goddess is worshipped by ritual animal sacrifices along with offerings of wine. The practice of animal sacrifices has become less common with Vaishnavite influences.

statement.id: Ia sering digambarkan tinggal di tempat pembakaran jenazah atau dekat pohon ara suci.
statement.en: She is often depicted living in cremation grounds or near sacred fig trees.

basis_claims.quote: In  early representations of Chamunda, she is given a ferocious visage, but with a feminine figure and elegant features. However, in later representations she is generally depicted as a skeletal old women wearing an elephant or tiger hide. She is shown to have sunken eyes, dishevelled hair.

statement.id: Penggambaran belakangan memperlihatkannya sebagai perempuan tua menyerupai kerangka dengan mata cekung.
statement.en: Later depictions show her as a skeletal old woman with sunken eyes.

basis_claims.quote: She is standing or sitting upon a 'shava' or corpse or sitting on a 'preta' or vanquished demon.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan berdiri atau duduk di atas jasad atau demon yang dikalahkan.
statement.en: She is depicted standing or sitting on a corpse or a vanquished demon.

dragons-in-greek-mythology.depicted_variant: Varian Colchian Dragon serpentgiant mengapit GoldenFleece di jaw dalam sacredgroveAres,tidak hundredheadsLadon.

visual_requirements.description: Serpent giant satuhead2eyes,bodyconstrictorsnake tanpa wings/legs/horns; sangatbesar dari ship50oars.
GuardingGoldenFleece di fiercejaws,coiling/advancephysik tanpa venomglow/fire.
Deepthicket sacredgroveAres Kolkhis.

dragons-in-greek-mythology.aura: Colchian serpentgiant dragons-in-greek-mythology-c07 dan fiercejaws mengapitfleece dragons-in-greek-mythology-c08 memberi ancaman tanpa hybriddragon.

basis_claims.quote: THE DRAKON KHOLKIKOS (Colchian Dragon) was a giant, watchful serpent which guarded the Golden Fleece in the sacred grove of Ares in Kolkhis (Colchis). When Jason and the Argonauts came to fetch the fleece, the beast was either slain by the hero or put to sleep by the witch Medea.

statement.id: Naga Kolkhis (Colchian Dragon) adalah ular raksasa yang waspada yang menjaga Bulu Domba Emas di hutan suci Ares di Kolkhis (Colchis). Ketika Jason dan para Argonaut datang mengambil bulu itu, makhluk tersebut dibunuh sang pahlawan atau ditidurkan oleh penyihir Medea.
statement.en: The Colchian Dragon was a giant, watchful serpent that guarded the Golden Fleece in the sacred grove of Ares in Kolkhis (Colchis). When Jason and the Argonauts came to fetch the fleece, the beast was either slain by the hero or put to sleep by the witch Medea.

basis_claims.quote: Pindar, Pythian Ode 4. 241 ff (trans. Conway) ... For the fleece was laid in a deep thicket, held within the fierce jaws of a ravenous drakon (dragon-serpent), far surpassing in length and breadth a ship of fifty oars

statement.id: Dalam Pythian Ode 4 karya Pindar (terjemahan Conway), bulu domba itu diletakkan di semak lebat, dipegang di antara rahang ganas seekor drakon (ular naga) yang rakus, yang panjang dan lebarnya jauh melampaui kapal berdayung lima puluh.
statement.en: In Pindar's Pythian Ode 4 (trans. Conway), the fleece was laid in a deep thicket, held within the fierce jaws of a ravenous drakon (dragon-serpent), far surpassing in length and breadth a ship of fifty oars.

gogfran-gawr.depicted_variant: Gogfran sebagai raksasa humanoid Welsh yang keluar dari caer di atas sungai.

visual_requirements.description: Raksasa humanoid satu kepala dua mata dua lengan dua kaki; tubuh tertutup pakaian buram penuh, tanpa tanduk/sayap.
Caer di atas sungai Aber Ysgyr, Brycheiniog; ukuran raksasa dibanding benteng.

gogfran-gawr.aura: Skala raksasa mendominasi caer saat melangkah dari gerbang (gogfran-gawr-c02, gogfran-gawr-c15).

basis_claims.quote: Cysylltir y cawr â hen deyrnasoedd Powys a Brycheiniog.

statement.id: Raksasa (cawr) ini dikaitkan dengan kerajaan lama Powys dan Brycheiniog.
statement.en: The giant (cawr) is linked with the old kingdoms of Powys and Brycheiniog.

basis_claims.quote: cyfeiria Siôn Dafydd Rhys at y cawr dan yr enw Gogfran Gawr a dweud ei fod yn trigo ger Aberhonddu ym Mrycheiniog.

statement.id: Siôn Dafydd Rhys menyebut raksasa (cawr) itu Gogfran Gawr dan mengatakan ia tinggal dekat Aberhonddu di Brycheiniog.
statement.en: Siôn Dafydd Rhys refers to the giant (cawr) as Gogfran Gawr and says he dwelt near Aberhonddu in Brycheiniog.

basis_claims.quote: In the land of Brycheiniog near to the town of Aber Hodni: Gogfran Gawr lived in Aber Ysgyr in the caer above the river.

statement.id: Di tanah Brycheiniog dekat kota Aber Hodni, Gogfran Gawr tinggal di Aber Ysgyr, di benteng (caer) di atas sungai.
statement.en: In the land of Brycheiniog near the town of Aber Hodni, Gogfran Gawr lived in Aber Ysgyr in the caer above the river.

hoyau.depicted_variant: Living winged turtle variant c12, no mixed narrow-snouted serpent anatomy; wing material editorial

visual_requirements.description: one living TURTLE head, two eyes, stout shell-backed turtle body, four turtle legs, a short narrow turtle tail and exactly two wings; no serpent body or invented extra heads
Foul nonluminous body vapor spreads downwind and nearby plants shrivel; no burning aura or humans injured
Lake Toya shore with reeds and dark water

hoyau.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Rear out of Lake Toya toward the viewer with wings spread and forefeet pressing wet shore stones (hoyau-c12, hoyau-c07).

basis_claims.quote: The sak-somo-ayep not only issues a foul smell, but contact with this body odor or musk causes plants to shrivel and die. Humans situated downwind of the dragon may lose their body hair, or develop swells on their skin

statement.id: Sak-somo-ayep tidak hanya mengeluarkan bau busuk; kontak dengan bau badannya membuat tumbuhan layu dan mati, dan manusia di arah angin naga itu dapat kehilangan bulu badan atau kulitnya bengkak.
statement.en: The sak-somo-ayep not only gives off a foul smell; contact with its body odor makes plants shrivel and die, and humans downwind of the dragon may lose their body hair or develop swellings on the skin.

basis_claims.quote: Specifically, when the Hōsōshin (smallpox deity) descended upon Abuta (now Tōyako town) and caused smallpox to spread, the people fled to the shores of Lake Tōya, and the hoyau with its horrible stench dispelled the Hōsōshin, saving the townsfolk.

statement.id: Ketika dewa cacar Hōsōshin turun ke Abuta (kini kota Tōyako) dan menyebarkan cacar, orang-orang mengungsi ke tepi Danau Tōya, dan hoyau dengan bau busuknya mengusir Hōsōshin sehingga penduduk selamat.
statement.en: When the smallpox deity Hōsōshin descended on Abuta (now Tōyako town) and spread smallpox, the people fled to the shore of Lake Tōya, and the hoyau dispelled the Hōsōshin with its horrible stench, saving the townsfolk.

basis_claims.quote: この洞爺湖のホヤウカムイは蛇神ではなく羽の生えた亀のような姿ともいわれ、流行病のあるときには、人々は有珠山の山霊（山の神霊）イケエウセグルとホヤウカムイに酒を捧げ、病気平癒を祈ったと言う。

statement.id: Hoyau Kamui di Danau Tōya juga dikatakan berwujud seperti kura-kura bersayap, bukan dewa ular; saat wabah, orang mempersembahkan sake kepada roh gunung Usu, Ikeeuseguru, dan Hoyau Kamui untuk berdoa agar penyakit sembuh.
statement.en: The Hoyau Kamui of Lake Tōya is also said to look like a winged turtle rather than a serpent deity; during epidemics people offered sake to the mountain spirit of Mt. Usu, Ikeeuseguru, and to Hoyau Kamui, praying for recovery.

huay-chivo.depicted_variant: Goat transformation variant; no victims or gore, red eyes documented c01

visual_requirements.description: one goat head, two intensely burning RED eyes, goat horns, four goat legs with hooves, shaggy goat body and short goat tail; no wings, no extra heads, no human torso
Only the documented burning red eyes; no fire breath, flaming body or magic ribbons; ordinary shattered fence from the attack
a rural livestock enclosure near Valladolid in Yucatan at night

huay-chivo.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Bound across the livestock enclosure toward the viewer, head low and eyes burning, front hooves striking the fence as it hunts (huay-chivo-c01, huay-chivo-c02, huay-chivo-c07).

basis_claims.quote: is a legendary Maya beast. It is a half-man, half-beast creature, with burning red eyes, and is specific to the Yucatán Peninsula.

statement.id: Huay Chivo adalah binatang legendaris Maya, setengah manusia setengah binatang bermata merah menyala, khas Semenanjung Yucatán.
statement.en: The Huay Chivo is a legendary Maya beast, half man and half beast with burning red eyes, specific to the Yucatán Peninsula.

basis_claims.quote: It is reputed to be an evil sorcerer who can transform himself into a supernatural animal, usually a goat, dog or deer, in order to prey upon livestock.

statement.id: Ia konon penyihir jahat yang dapat berubah menjadi hewan gaib, biasanya kambing, anjing, atau rusa, untuk memangsa ternak.
statement.en: It is said to be an evil sorcerer who turns into a supernatural animal, usually a goat, dog or deer, to prey on livestock.

basis_claims.quote: Local Maya near the town of Valladolid, in Yucatán, believe the Huay Chivo is an evil sorcerer that is capable of transforming into a goat to do mischief and eat livestock.

statement.id: Orang Maya setempat di dekat kota Valladolid, Yucatán, percaya Huay Chivo adalah penyihir jahat yang mampu berubah menjadi kambing untuk berbuat onar dan memakan ternak.
statement.en: Local Maya near the town of Valladolid, Yucatán, believe the Huay Chivo is an evil sorcerer able to turn into a goat to do mischief and eat livestock.

ichchhadhari-nag.depicted_variant: Respectful cobra form protecting possessed nagamani; jewel placement in coil and rocky scenery editorial

visual_requirements.description: one living cobra, one head, two eyes, broad cobra hood, one continuous legless snake body; one precious nagamani jewel resting inside its protective coil, no humanoid torso or extra heads
No magical aura or regeneration scene; menace only from documented cobra bite guarding nagamani; jewel catches natural moonlight without emitting beams
Naglok, depicted minimally as an unmarked shadowed rocky realm with no added temples or glyphs

ichchhadhari-nag.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Rear sharply from its coils and lean its cobra head close toward the viewer while protecting the jewel; mouth opens in warning, hood stretches full width (ichchhadhari-nag-c01, ichchhadhari-nag-c04, ichchhadhari-nag-c09).

basis_claims.quote: ಇಚ್ಛಧಾರಿ ನಾಗ್ (ಸ್ತ್ರೀಲಿಂಗ: ಇಚ್ಛಧಾರಿ ನಾಗಿನ್) ಭಾರತೀಯ ಜಾನಪದ ಮತ್ತು ಪೌರಾಣಿಕೆ ಕಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ ಆಕಾರವನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುವ ನಾಗರಹಾವುಗಳಾಗಿವೆ.

statement.id: Ichchhadhari Nag adalah ular kobra pengubah wujud dalam cerita rakyat dan mitologi India.
statement.en: Ichchhadhari Nag are shapeshifting cobras of Indian folklore and mythology.

basis_claims.quote: ಇಚ್ಛಧಾರಿ ನಾಗಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನಾಗಿಣಿಯರು ನಾಗಮಣಿ ಎಂಬ ಆಭರಣವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಇವು ಯಾವುದೇ ಅಮೂಲ್ಯವಾದ ಕಲ್ಲುಗಳಿಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಮೌಲ್ಯಯುತವಾಗಿದೆ. ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಅದು ತನ್ನ ಮಾಲೀಕರನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಬದುಕಿಸುವ ಮತ್ತು ಅಪಾರವಾದ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ನೀಡುವ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ.

statement.id: Ichchhadhari nag dan nagin memiliki permata bernama nagamani, yang lebih berharga daripada batu mulia mana pun karena dapat menghidupkan kembali pemiliknya dan memberi kekuatan yang sangat besar.
statement.en: Ichchhadhari nags and nagins have a jewel called the nagamani, said to be more valuable than any precious stone because it can bring its owner back to life and grant immense power.

basis_claims.quote: ಈ ನಾಗಮಣಿಯನ್ನು ಕದಿಯಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿದಾಗ ಆ ಜನರು ಹಾವು ಕಡಿತದಿಂದ ಸಾಯುತ್ತಾರೆ ಎಂದು ದಂತಕಥೆಗಳು ಹೇಳುತ್ತವೆ.

statement.id: Legenda menyebut bahwa orang yang mencoba mencuri nagamani itu mati karena gigitan ular.
statement.en: Legends say that people who try to steal the nagamani die of snakebite.

basis_claims.quote: ನಾಗಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನಾಗಿನಗಳ ಲೋಕವನ್ನು ನಾಗ್ಲೋಕ್ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ನಾಗ್ಲೋಕ್ ಅನ್ನು ನಾಗರಾಜ್ (ರಾಜ) ಅಥವಾ ನಾಗ್ರಾಣಿ (ರಾಣಿ) ಆಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.

statement.id: Dunia para nag dan nagin disebut Naglok, yang diperintah oleh Nagraj (raja) atau Nagrani (ratu).
statement.en: The world of nags and nagins is called Naglok, ruled by a Nagraj (king) or Nagrani (queen).

inkanyamba.depicted_variant: Giant horse-headed serpent variant, no modern artisan wings; scale sourced c06

visual_requirements.description: one horse-shaped head, two eyes, huge continuous coiling serpent body stretching from pool toward storm sky, no legs or wings; dark wet scales, no invented horns
Documented storm and tornado cloud funnel, driving rain and hail force water spray outward and bend shore vegetation; no neon or bodily glow
pool of Howick Falls on Umgeni River, waterfall small beside immense serpent

inkanyamba.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Rise in enormous coiling loops from the pool beneath Howick Falls and loom downward toward the viewer (inkanyamba-c06, inkanyamba-c17, inkanyamba-c07, inkanyamba-c09).

basis_claims.quote: It is especially said to dwell in the pool of Howick Falls (on the Umgeni River), thus known locally by the nickname

statement.id: Makhluk ini terutama dikatakan tinggal di kolam Air Terjun Howick (Howick Falls) di Sungai Umgeni dan punya julukan lokal.
statement.en: It is especially said to live in the pool of Howick Falls on the Umgeni River and has a local nickname.

basis_claims.quote: Inkanyamba is described to be a huge serpent or serpentine dragon whose coiling body extends from heaven to earth;

statement.id: Inkanyamba digambarkan sebagai ular raksasa atau naga berwujud ular (serpentine dragon) yang tubuhnya melilit dari langit sampai bumi.
statement.en: Inkanyamba is described as a huge serpent or serpentine dragon whose coiling body stretches from heaven to earth.

basis_claims.quote: it is the root cause of tornados, a goddess of storm, water, and hail in Zulu belief.

statement.id: Dalam kepercayaan Zulu, ia adalah penyebab tornado dan dewi badai, air, serta hujan es.
statement.en: In Zulu belief it is the root cause of tornados and a goddess of storm, water and hail.

basis_claims.quote: Most active in the summer months, it is believed that the inkanyamba's anger causes the seasonal storms.

statement.id: Ia paling aktif pada bulan-bulan musim panas, dan amarahnya dipercaya menyebabkan badai musiman.
statement.en: It is most active in the summer months, and its anger is believed to cause the seasonal storms.

basis_claims.quote: Las tribus zulúes de la zona creen que es una serpiente de gran tamaño con una cabeza de caballo.

statement.id: Suku-suku Zulu (zulúes) setempat percaya ia ular berukuran besar (serpiente) dengan kepala kuda (caballo).
statement.en: The local Zulu tribes (zulúes) believe it is a very large serpent (serpiente) with a horse's head (caballo).

jivajivaka.depicted_variant: Two-headed eagle variant c08; plumage colors and male/female visual distinction editorial

visual_requirements.description: EXACTLY TWO eagle heads on two separate necks joined to ONE shared bird body, one male and one female distinguished only by subtle plumage variation; four eyes total, exactly two feathered wings, two bird feet and one feathered tail; no human musician, no extra bodies
No supernatural power effects; physical wingbeat and harmonious singing represented by open beaks only, no visual sound waves or glyphs
the Pure Land represented by a restrained cloud-filled sky, no invented religious buildings or figures

jivajivaka.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Descend toward the viewer in a powerful wingbeat, both eagle heads raised with open beaks singing together; both faces clear, neither obscured (jivajivaka-c01, jivajivaka-c08, jivajivaka-c02, jivajivaka-c07).

basis_claims.quote: 共命鳥（ぐみょうちょう、jīvaṃjīvaka）は、体は一つ、頭が二つある鳥で、仏教における想像上の生物。

statement.id: Jīvajīvaka adalah burung Buddha dengan dua kepala yang berbagi satu tubuh.
statement.en: Jīvajīvaka is a Buddhist bird with two heads sharing one body.

basis_claims.quote: 『阿弥陀経』では、迦陵頻伽とともに極楽浄土に住むとされる。美しい羽根を持ち、妙なる声で囀ると伝えられている。命命鳥（めいめいちょう、みょうみょうちょう）・耆婆耆婆（ぎばぎば）とも呼ばれる。

statement.id: Sutra Amitabha menempatkannya di Tanah Suci dan menggambarkan bulu serta nyanyian indah.
statement.en: The Amitabha Sutra places it in the Pure Land and describes beautiful feathers and song.

basis_claims.quote: 彼国常有种种奇妙杂色之鸟。白鶴、孔雀、鹦鹉、舍利、迦陵频伽、共命之鸟，是诸众鸟。昼夜六时。出和雅音。

statement.id: Sutra Amitabha menyebut negeri itu selalu memiliki burung-burung ajaib beraneka warna, termasuk bangau putih, merak, nuri, śāri, kalaviṅka (迦陵频伽), dan burung gongming, yang siang malam enam kali mengeluarkan suara merdu.
statement.en: The Amitabha Sutra says that land always has wondrous birds of many colours, including white cranes, peacocks, parrots, śāri, kalaviṅka (迦陵频伽) and the gongming bird, which six times day and night produce harmonious sounds.

basis_claims.quote: 共命鸟的头部分为一雄一雌，共用一个身体。由于没有固定形象，在有些画作中共命鸟却是双头凤凰或者双头鹰。

statement.id: Kedua kepala burung gongming terdiri atas satu jantan dan satu betina yang berbagi satu tubuh; karena tidak punya rupa baku, sebagian lukisan menggambarkannya sebagai feniks berkepala dua (双头凤凰) atau elang berkepala dua (双头鹰).
statement.en: The gongming bird’s heads are one male and one female sharing a single body; having no fixed image, some paintings show it as a two-headed phoenix (双头凤凰) or a two-headed eagle (双头鹰).

khamot.depicted_variant: Active documented luminous manifestation, not landscape only; bright dominant ball with physical reflections

visual_requirements.description: no bodily form, no face, head, eyes, mouth or limbs; one LARGE floating ball of flickering warm fire-light as the central spirit manifestation, with a few smaller reappearances of the same light surrounding one distant fully clothed traveler
Documented fire-like light reflects physically on water, trunks and reeds and misleading light surrounds traveler; not a glowing humanoid, no generic aura or rainbow mist
damp marshy forest at night with a lost traveler

khamot.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Flare directly ahead at the viewer above swamp water while additional distant flickering lights surround a lost traveler behind it (khamot-c02, khamot-c06, khamot-c07, khamot-c10).

basis_claims.quote: In some accounts, it appears as a floating ball of light, a large flickering glow seen at night, especially in damp or marshy areas. It is said to lure travelers in the forest into losing their way, making them believe that someone ahead is carrying a torch or that there is a fire.

statement.id: Dalam sebagian kisah khamot tampak sebagai bola cahaya melayang yang berkedip di malam hari, terutama di daerah lembap atau berawa, dan menyesatkan pengembara di hutan seolah ada orang membawa obor atau api di depan; saat didekati cahaya itu lenyap lalu muncul mengelilingi.
statement.en: In some accounts khamot appears as a floating, flickering light at night, especially in damp or marshy areas, misleading forest travellers into thinking someone ahead carries a torch or there is a fire; approached, it vanishes and reappears all around.

basis_claims.quote: It has no definite form. In some accounts, it appears as a floating ball of light, a large flickering glow seen at night, especially in damp or marshy areas.

statement.id: Khamot tidak berwujud tetap; dalam sebagian kisah ia tampak sebagai bola cahaya melayang, pendar besar yang berkedip pada malam hari, terutama di daerah lembap atau berawa.
statement.en: The khamot has no definite form; in some accounts it appears as a floating ball of light, a large flickering glow seen at night, especially in damp or marshy areas.

basis_claims.quote: When they approach, the light suddenly disappears, only to reappear surrounding them from all directions.

statement.id: Ketika para pelancong mendekat, cahaya itu tiba-tiba lenyap lalu muncul kembali mengelilingi mereka dari segala arah.
statement.en: When travelers approach, the light suddenly disappears, only to reappear surrounding them from all directions.

basis_claims.quote: ทำให้เกิดแสงแวววาวกระทบกับผิวน้ำในคืนวันเพ็ญคล้ายกับดวงไฟของผีโขมด ซึ่งผีโขมดนี้ เป็นชื่อเรียก ผีป่า ที่ออกหากินในเวลากลางคืน มีพะเนียงไฟมองเห็นเป็นระยะอย่างผีกระสือ ชาวล้านนา จึงเรียกว่า ลอยโขมด

statement.id: Menurut situs Departemen Seni Rupa Thailand, khamot (ผีโขมด) adalah nama hantu hutan yang keluar mencari makan pada malam hari, dengan kobaran api yang terlihat sesekali seperti hantu krasue; karena itu orang Lanna menyebut perayaan lampu apung itu "loy khamot".
statement.en: According to the Thai Fine Arts Department site, the khamot (ผีโขมด) is a name for a forest ghost that goes out at night, with a glow of fire seen at intervals like the krasue ghost; hence the Lanna people call the floating-lantern festival "loy khamot".

kishi-folklore.depicted_variant: Two-faced c05 variant only, no many-headed c01 blending; both faces immediately countable

visual_requirements.description: ONE SINGLE SHARED SKULL ON ONE NECK with TWO OPPOSITE FACES, handsome adult African mans face at FRONT and distinct hyena face at BACK, long sharp hyena teeth; one fully opaque clothed humanlike body, two arms two legs; no separate animal head or multiple necks
No regeneration or magic; threat from rear hyena bite jaws and documented deception only, no victim or gore
a shadowed Angolan clearing, neutral editorial background with no specific invented buildings

kishi-folklore.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Twist the shared skull into clear side three-quarter view showing human face looking LEFT and hyena face looking RIGHT; step close toward viewer, rear hyena jaws open menacingly while front human expression invites (kishi-folklore-c05, kishi-folklore-c07, kishi-folklore-c06).

basis_claims.quote: Il kishi è un demone a due volti della mitologia angolana. Secondo la leggenda, un kishi ha il volto di un uomo umano attraente sulla parte anteriore del corpo e quello di una iena sulla parte posteriore.

statement.id: Artikel kedua menyebut kishi sebagai iblis (demone) bermuka dua dalam mitologi Angola: di bagian depan tubuhnya ada wajah lelaki tampan dan di bagian belakang wajah hiena (iena).
statement.en: The second article calls the kishi a two-faced demon (demone) of Angolan mythology: a handsome man's face on the front of its body and a hyena's face (iena) on the back.

basis_claims.quote: Si dice che i kishi usino il loro volto umano, oltre che per parlare e per attrarre delle giovani donne, che poi mangiano con il volto di iena.

statement.id: Konon kishi memakai wajah manusianya untuk berbicara dan memikat perempuan muda (giovani donne), yang kemudian dimakannya dengan wajah hienanya.
statement.en: Kishi are said to use their human face to speak and to attract young women (giovani donne), whom they then eat with the hyena face.

basis_claims.quote: Si dice che la faccia della iena abbia lunghi denti affilati e mascelle così forti da non poter essere staccate da ciò che morde.

statement.id: Wajah hiena itu konon bergigi panjang dan tajam dengan rahang (mascelle) yang begitu kuat sehingga tak dapat dilepaskan dari apa yang digigitnya.
statement.en: The hyena face is said to have long sharp teeth and jaws (mascelle) so strong they cannot be pulled off whatever it bites.

krasnoludek.depicted_variant: Helpful pointy-red-hat small humanoid variant, no mixed insect-size giant krosnalek; scale kept small with close camera

visual_requirements.description: one very small human-shaped adult dwarf, one head two eyes two arms two legs, unmistakable pointy RED hat; full opaque rough clothes and boots; normal human eyes, no horns, no giant transformation
No magic effects; protective presence from close-up, movement and documented helpful guardian role
a dark hole in an old human dwelling with rough earth and stone

krasnoludek.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Emerge forcefully from a dark wall hole at the viewers floor-level camera, brace hands on the jagged opening and stride protectively toward viewer; sharp focused kindly stern gaze, not evil (krasnoludek-c01, krasnoludek-c06, krasnoludek-c05).

basis_claims.quote: Krasnoludek or krasnal is the Polish name for a mythological type of gnome or dwarf, common in many Polish and translated folk tales. They resemble small humans and wear pointy red hats.

statement.id: Krasnoludek (krasnal), nama Polandia (Polish) untuk gnome atau kurcaci mitologis, topi merah runcing.
statement.en: Krasnoludek (krasnal), Polish name for a mythical gnome or dwarf, pointy red hats.

basis_claims.quote: в польской и белорусской мифологии народ карликов. По своей мифологии аналогичны западноевропейским гномам и серболужицким людкам. Предполагается, что антропологически мифология краснолюдков происходит от веры в души умерших предков или младенцев. Считаются защитниками человеческих жилищ.

statement.id: Artikel ru: bangsa kerdil mitologi Polandia dan Belarus (Skrzaty), dari kepercayaan jiwa leluhur; pelindung rumah.
