statement.en: ru article: a dwarf folk of Polish and Belarusian mythology (Skrzaty), from belief in ancestors' souls; home guardians.

basis_claims.quote: krasnyludek, kraśnoludek / kraśnyludek 'a small human-shaped being who wears pointy red hat, dwells in the earth, in pits, ruins and all kinds of holes; helpful to humans when they are in need'

statement.id: Dalam daftar bentuk dialek Polandia yang disusun Kregždys, krasnyludek/kraśnoludek diberi arti makhluk kecil berwujud manusia yang memakai topi merah runcing, tinggal di dalam tanah, lubang, dan reruntuhan, serta menolong manusia yang membutuhkan.
statement.en: In Kregždys's list of Polish dialect forms, krasnyludek/kraśnoludek is glossed as a small human-shaped being who wears a pointy red hat, dwells in the earth, in pits, ruins and all kinds of holes, and is helpful to humans when they are in need.

kun.depicted_variant: Colossal fish form only, not whale interpretation or Peng hybrid

visual_requirements.description: one colossal FISH with one fish head two eyes, one continuous fish body, paired pectoral fins and single tail; no mammal blowhole, no bird wings or dragon horns
No magical transformation shown and no power beams; ocean water displaced by immense fish body
the northern dark sea Tianchi north of Qiongfa, tiny distant waves and horizon as scale reference

kun.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Rise just below the surface so its enormous fish head breaks through the dark northern sea, an immense back and fin extend toward horizon (kun-c01, kun-c02, kun-c05).

basis_claims.quote: 鯤（こん）は、中国に伝わる伝説の魚。頭から尾の先までの大きさがわからないほど、非常に体が大きいとされる。

statement.id: Kun adalah ikan legenda Tiongkok yang digambarkan sangat besar.
statement.en: Kun is a Chinese legendary fish described as immensely large.

basis_claims.quote: 『荘子』逍遥遊篇にある寓話で、鯤は北の果ての海（北冥）にいる体の大きさが数千里もある巨大な魚として登場する。

statement.id: Dalam perumpamaan Zhuangzi, Kun hidup di laut paling utara dan ukurannya mencapai ribuan li.
statement.en: In a Zhuangzi parable, Kun dwells in the far northern sea and spans thousands of li.

basis_claims.quote: 北冥有魚，其名爲鯤。鯤之大，不知其幾千里也，化而爲鳥，其名爲鵬。

statement.id: Dalam Zhuangzi, di Laut Utara ada ikan bernama Kun yang besarnya tidak diketahui berapa ribu li; ia berubah menjadi burung bernama Peng.
statement.en: In the Zhuangzi, in the Northern Darkness there is a fish named Kun whose size is not known to be how many thousand li; it transforms into a bird named Peng.

basis_claims.quote: 窮髮之北，有冥海者，天池也。有魚焉，其廣數千里，未有知其脩者，其名爲鯤。

statement.id: Dalam Zhuangzi, di utara Qiongfa ada laut gelap bernama Tianchi, tempat ikan bernama Kun yang lebarnya ribuan li dan panjangnya tidak diketahui siapa pun.
statement.en: In the Zhuangzi, north of Qiongfa lies the dark sea called Tianchi, where there is a fish named Kun, thousands of li wide, whose length no one knows.

manaul.depicted_variant: Tagalog bamboo omen-bird narrative only, no Pavon revenge-rocks or fixed modern eagle design

visual_requirements.description: one living bird head two eyes, pointed natural bird beak, one bird body, exactly two feathered wings and two legs, no secure fixed eagle species claimed; natural unspecified bird plumage
Physical bamboo splitting only; no gods, humans emerging, sound glyphs or magic glow
the bamboo stalk of the Tagalog creation narrative, dark surrounding sky and vegetation editorial

manaul.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Drive its beak hard into primordial bamboo while wings sweep toward viewer, wood fibers split open from physical impact, strong revered gaze (manaul-c04, manaul-c24).

basis_claims.quote: In Tagalog folklore, it is said that Bathala sent a tigmamanukan omen bird he named "Manaul" to peck on the bamboo. Manaul flew from one side to the other before settling on the bamboo. When Manaul pecked on the bamboo, it opened in half and released the first man, Malakas, and the first woman, Maganda.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Tagalog, Bathala mengirim burung pertanda tigmamanukan yang ia beri nama Manaul untuk mematuk bambu; bambu itu terbelah dan melepaskan laki-laki pertama, Malakas, dan perempuan pertama, Maganda.
statement.en: In Tagalog folklore, Bathala sent a tigmamanukan omen bird he named Manaul to peck the bamboo; it split open and released the first man, Malakas, and the first woman, Maganda.

basis_claims.quote: Modern illustrations variously depict an eagle, kite or another powerful bird, but the surviving narrative does not securely make that zoological identification.

statement.id: Menurut artikel The Aswang Project, ilustrasi modern menggambarkan Manaul sebagai elang, layang-layang, atau burung perkasa lain, tetapi narasi yang bertahan tidak memastikan identifikasi spesiesnya.
statement.en: According to the Aswang Project article, modern illustrations depict Manaul as an eagle, kite or another powerful bird, but the surviving narrative does not securely identify its species.

mokumokuren.depicted_variant: Harmless but uncanny many-eyed wall being, active eyes rather than ordinary empty landscape

visual_requirements.description: no humanoid body, heads, mouth, arms or legs; COUNTLESS separate ghostly eyes with normal irises and pupils emerge directly from holes in torn shoji paper, each eye connected to paper hole without gore; eyes fully open and directed toward viewer
Documented eyes emerge and stare; no magical glowing pupils, energy or injured humans
torn neglected shoji screen in a ruined haunted Japanese house, wood grid and deep interior shadows

mokumokuren.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Pop dozens of watchful eyes out from deep paper holes toward the viewers low camera; nearest bulging eye huge by close perspective, other eyes densely cover whole shoji screen; torn paper edges flutter (mokumokuren-c02, mokumokuren-c07, mokumokuren-c11).

basis_claims.quote: The Mokumokuren usually lives in torn shoji (Japanese paper sliding walls), although they can also be found in tatami floor mats and in walls.

statement.id: Mokumokuren biasanya tinggal di shoji (dinding geser kertas Jepang) yang sobek, meski juga dapat ditemukan di tikar tatami dan dinding.
statement.en: The Mokumokuren usually lives in torn shoji (Japanese paper sliding walls), though it can also be found in tatami floor mats and in walls.

basis_claims.quote: The Mokumokuren is considered by the Japanese to be one of the traditional inhabitants of haunted houses.

statement.id: Orang Jepang menganggap Mokumokuren sebagai salah satu penghuni tradisional rumah berhantu.
statement.en: The Japanese consider the Mokumokuren one of the traditional inhabitants of haunted houses.

basis_claims.quote: When shōji have gone too long without repair, ghostly eyes begin to pop out of the holes, watching all that goes on inside of the house.

statement.id: Bila shōji terlalu lama tidak diperbaiki, mata-mata gaib mulai muncul dari lubangnya dan mengawasi segala yang terjadi di dalam rumah.
statement.en: When shōji go too long without repair, ghostly eyes begin to pop out of the holes, watching everything that goes on inside the house.

basis_claims.quote: 荒れ果てた家の障子に無数の目が浮かび上がった姿で描かれており、解説文によれば碁打ち師の念が碁盤に注がれ、さらに家全体に現れたものとある。

statement.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai banyak mata yang muncul di shoji rumah terbengkalai; menurut teks penjelasnya, ia berasal dari tekad seorang pemain go yang tercurah ke papan go lalu muncul di seluruh rumah.
statement.en: It is depicted as countless eyes rising on the shoji of a ruined house; according to the explanatory text, a go player's fixation poured into the go board and then appeared throughout the house.

oozlum-bird.depicted_variant: One-winged weejy variant c09, tight close framing; no comic film design or explicit self-disappearance

visual_requirements.description: one fully feathered bird, one head two eyes, exactly ONE feathered WING on one side, opposite shoulder naturally smooth feathered with no wound or stump; two bird feet and one beautiful feather tail; no extra wings, no monstrous teeth
Documented tight backwards circular flight; only ordinary dust displaced by wingbeat, no energy ring or disappearance vortex
a neutral shadowed open-air backdrop, no asserted geographic landmark

oozlum-bird.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Bank sharply toward viewer in a tight circular backwards flight with tail leading and head craned back to admire its own beautiful tail; single wing beats hard, feathered body twists around its curve (oozlum-bird-c01, oozlum-bird-c09, oozlum-bird-c03).

basis_claims.quote: The oozlum bird, also spelled ouzelum, is a legendary creature found in Australian and British folk tales and legends.

statement.id: Burung oozlum atau ouzelum adalah makhluk legendaris dalam dongeng rakyat Australian dan British.
statement.en: The oozlum bird is a legendary creature found in Australian and British folk tales.

basis_claims.quote: Other sources state that the bird flies backwards so that it can admire its own beautiful tail feathers, or because while it does not know where it is going, it likes to know where it has been.

statement.id: Sumber lain menyebut burung ini terbang mundur agar dapat mengagumi bulu ekornya yang indah.
statement.en: Other sources state the bird flies backwards to admire its own beautiful tail feathers.

basis_claims.quote: A variant of the oozlum, possibly a mutation, is the weejy weejy bird, which has only one wing which causes it to fly in tighter, faster, smaller circles, until it disappears up its own fundament.

statement.id: Varian oozlum, mungkin hasil mutasi, adalah burung weejy weejy yang hanya punya satu sayap sehingga terbang dalam lingkaran yang lebih sempit dan cepat sampai lenyap ke dalam dirinya sendiri.
statement.en: A variant of the oozlum, possibly a mutation, is the weejy weejy bird, which has only one wing and so flies in tighter, faster, smaller circles until it disappears up itself.

pugot.depicted_variant: Relatively harmless huge headless spirit, not cigar-bearing headed giant or human racial caricature

visual_requirements.description: one large black headless humanoid spirit, exactly two arms and two legs, no head, eyes or facial features; dry non-graphic empty cloth collar, fully opaque dark tunic and trousers, no blood or exposed neck wound
No magic transformation effects; speed and imposing headless anatomy only, ordinary leaves displaced by movement
a dark tamarind tree beside an abandoned house at night

pugot.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Move rapidly down from a huge tamarind branch directly toward low camera, one hand grips branch overhead and the other reaches toward viewer; cloth and leaves jerk with its fast movement (pugot-c01, pugot-c16, pugot-c03).

basis_claims.quote: The Pugot ("decapitated one") is a mythical fiend that is found in the folklore of the Ilocos region of the Philippines. It can assume various shapes such as hogs, dogs or even as humans. However, it usually appears as a black, big headless being.

statement.id: Pugot ('yang terpenggal') adalah makhluk jahat mitos dalam cerita rakyat Ilocos, Filipina, yang dapat menjelma babi, anjing, atau manusia, tetapi biasanya tampak sebagai sosok besar hitam tanpa kepala.
statement.en: The pugot ('decapitated one') is a mythical fiend of Ilocos folklore in the Philippines that can become hogs, dogs or humans but usually appears as a big black headless being.

basis_claims.quote: The creature usually resides in dark places or deserted houses. However, they especially like living in trees such as the duhat (Eugenia cumini), santol (Sandoricum koetjape), and tamarind.

statement.id: Pugot tinggal di tempat gelap atau rumah kosong, dan terutama suka tinggal di pohon seperti duwet, sentul, dan asam.
statement.en: The pugot lives in dark places or deserted houses, especially liking trees such as the duhat, santol and tamarind.

basis_claims.quote: Aside from its shapeshifting abilities, the pugot can also move at great speeds, feeding on snakes and insects that it finds among the trees. It feeds by thrusting food through its neck stump. Although frightening, the pugot is otherwise relatively harmless.

statement.id: Selain dapat berubah wujud, pugot dapat bergerak sangat cepat dan memakan ular serta serangga di antara pepohonan dengan menyodorkan makanan ke tunggul lehernya; meski menakutkan, ia relatif tidak berbahaya.
statement.en: Besides shapeshifting, the pugot can move at great speed, feeding on snakes and insects among the trees by thrusting food through its neck stump; though frightening, it is relatively harmless.

basis_claims.quote: Among the Ilocanos and Pampangos, the Pugot was a nocturnal spirit, usually in the form of a gigantic negro figure, terrifying, but not particularly harmful.

statement.id: Menurut The Aswang Project, di antara orang Ilocano dan Pampango, pugot adalah roh malam hari, biasanya berbentuk sosok negro raksasa, menakutkan tetapi tidak terlalu berbahaya.
statement.en: According to The Aswang Project, among the Ilocanos and Pampangos the pugot was a nocturnal spirit, usually a gigantic dark figure, terrifying but not particularly harmful.

basis_claims.quote: It lived either in large trees or in abandoned houses.

statement.id: Pugot tinggal di pohon besar atau rumah terbengkalai.
statement.en: The pugot lived either in large trees or in abandoned houses.

qiuniu.depicted_variant: Living small yellow dragon close-up raised-head/open-mouth c07; horn/scale anatomy only, music visible as physical instrument

visual_requirements.description: one living SMALL YELLOW DRAGON HEAD, two eyes, horns and yellow scales, head raised with mouth open; frame is a CLOSE-UP OF HEAD AND NECK ONLY with rest of body outside frame, do not invent limb count or wings
No supernatural music beams; ordinary qin strings visibly vibrating, no floating notes, text, glyphs or magical light
beside a qin string instrument in a neutral dark indoor musical space, no invented palace or specific geography

qiuniu.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Lift its horned head sharply beside the wooden head of a qin while opening mouth in intense musical response; the small dragon is alive, eyes focused and scale texture taut, not a carved instrument ornament (qiuniu-c02, qiuniu-c06, qiuniu-c07, qiuniu-c03).

basis_claims.quote: 囚牛（しゅうぎゅう）は、李東陽が著した『懐麓堂集』の説による竜生九子の一つ。姿は黄色い小さな龍の角と鱗を持つ。

statement.id: Gambarnya memiliki tanduk dan sisik naga kuning kecil.
statement.en: Its image includes a small yellow dragon’s horns and scales.

basis_claims.quote: 音楽を好み、琴や鼓の飾りになっている。イー族の月琴、ペー族（白族：雲南省）の琴、他チベット系民族のいくつか楽器で見られる。

statement.id: Ia dikaitkan dengan musik dan menghiasi alat musik petik serta perkusi.
statement.en: It is associated with music and decorates string and percussion instruments.

basis_claims.quote: 形狀為有鱗角的黃色小龍，平生很喜歡音樂，酷愛彈琴，對音樂有很高的造詣，所以很多琴頭都用祂的造像。

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Mandarin, bentuknya naga kecil kuning bersisik dan bertanduk; ia sangat menyukai musik dan gemar memainkan qin dengan keahlian tinggi, sehingga banyak kepala qin memakai wujudnya.
statement.en: According to Chinese Wikipedia, its shape is a small yellow dragon with scales and horns; it loved music and playing the qin and was highly skilled in music, so many qin heads use its likeness.

basis_claims.quote: 例如：漢族的胡琴、彝族的龍頭月琴、白族的三弦琴以及藏族的一些樂器上也有其揚頭張口的形象。

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Mandarin, wujudnya dengan kepala terangkat dan mulut terbuka juga terdapat pada huqin suku Han, yueqin berkepala naga suku Yi, sanxian suku Bai, dan sebagian alat musik suku Tibet.
statement.en: According to Chinese Wikipedia, its raised-head, open-mouthed image is also found on the Han huqin, the Yi dragon-head yueqin, the Bai sanxian and some Tibetan instruments.

rhita-gawr.depicted_variant: Rhita Gawr menantang duel di Yr Wyddfa dengan jubah dari janggut para raja.

visual_requirements.description: One adult humanoid giant, one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs; a heavy cloak entirely made of many clearly distinct long cut kingly beards sewn together, over a fully opaque rough tunic; natural giant anatomy, no extra limbs
No magical effects are documented; menace comes from giant strength and the king-beard trophy cloak, physical wind and grit
The rugged mountain Yr Wyddfa in Wales, rocky summit with a small distant path

rhita-gawr.aura: No magical effects are documented; menace comes from giant strength and the king-beard trophy cloak, physical wind and grit [rhita-gawr-c05, rhita-gawr-c06, rhita-gawr-c07]

basis_claims.quote: Cymeriad mewn chwedlau gwerin Cymreig oedd Rhita Gawr. Dywedir fod gan y cawr hwn fantell wedi ei gwneud o farfau brenhinoedd. Hawliodd farf y Brenin Arthur. Gwrthododd Arthur, a bu ymladdfa rhyngddynt ar yr Wyddfa.

statement.id: Rhita Gawr, raksasa (cawr) cerita rakyat Welsh (Cymreig, Wales); mantel janggut raja; menuntut janggut Raja (Brenin) Arthur; bertarung di Yr Wyddfa (Snowdon); dimakamkan di bawah carnedd; gŵydd + ma = Gwyddfa.
statement.en: Rhita Gawr, a giant of Welsh folk tales (Wales); cloak of kings' beards; demanded King Arthur's beard; fought on Yr Wyddfa (Snowdon); buried under a carnedd; gŵydd + ma = Gwyddfa.

basis_claims.quote: He told them he had found none of so great strength, since he killed the giant Ritho, who had challenged him to fight, upon the mountain Aravius.

statement.id: Dalam Geoffrey of Monmouth, Arthur menyatakan bahwa ia tidak menemukan lawan sekuat itu sejak ia membunuh raksasa Ritho, yang menantangnya bertarung di gunung Aravius.
statement.en: In Geoffrey of Monmouth, Arthur says he had found none of such strength since he killed the giant Ritho, who had challenged him to fight on the mountain Aravius.

basis_claims.quote: This giant had made himself furs of the beards of kings he had killed, and had sent word to Arthur carefully to cut off his beard and send it to him

statement.id: Raksasa itu membuat bulu pakaian dari janggut raja-raja yang dibunuhnya, dan mengirim pesan kepada Arthur agar memotong janggutnya dan mengirimkannya kepadanya.
statement.en: The giant had made furs for himself from the beards of kings he had killed, and sent word to Arthur to cut off his beard and send it to him.

basis_claims.quote: But if he refused to do it, he challenged him to a duel, with this offer, that the conqueror should have the furs, and also the beard of the vanquished for a trophy of his victory.

statement.id: Jika Arthur menolak, ia menantangnya berduel dengan taruhan bahwa pemenang mendapat bulu pakaian itu dan janggut yang dikalahkan sebagai piala kemenangan.
statement.en: If Arthur refused, he challenged him to a duel, offering that the conqueror should have the furs and the beard of the vanquished as a trophy of victory.

seelkee.depicted_variant: Seelkee varian satu kepala kuda dan tubuh ular panjang c03/c08, tidak dicampur varian dua kepala.

visual_requirements.description: Exactly ONE horse head with a long horse mouth and two long horse ears, two eyes; one long smooth sea-serpent body, entirely limbless, no mane of tentacles, no wings; ten-to-fifteen-foot creature. NOT the separate two-headed variant
No curse victim or magical effects; motion of the serpent physically parts reeds and throws swamp water into the air
Winding swamp channels and marsh reeds in present-day Chilliwack, British Columbia

seelkee.aura: No curse victim or magical effects; motion of the serpent physically parts reeds and throws swamp water into the air [seelkee-c03, seelkee-c08]

basis_claims.quote: In Canadian folklore, Seelkee (transcribed in English from Halqemeylem, the local indigenous language) is a lake monster reported to have lived in the swamps of what is now Chilliwack, in British Columbia, Canada.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Kanada, Seelkee (dari bahasa Halqemeylem) adalah monster danau yang konon hidup di rawa-rawa wilayah yang kini menjadi Chilliwack, British Columbia.
statement.en: In Canadian folklore, Seelkee (from the Halqemeylem language) is a lake monster said to have lived in the swamps of present-day Chilliwack, British Columbia.

basis_claims.quote: The most common description of Seelkee is a 10- to 15-foot-long (3.0 to 4.6 m) sea serpent-like beast with the head of a horse.

statement.id: Gambaran paling umum adalah makhluk mirip ular laut sepanjang 10 hingga 15 kaki berkepala kuda.
statement.en: Most commonly it is a 10- to 15-foot sea-serpent-like beast with a horse's head.

basis_claims.quote: Living in winding channels and marshlands, s’í:lhqey are normally described as serpents with two heads.

statement.id: Hidup di saluran berkelok dan rawa, s’í:lhqey biasanya digambarkan sebagai ular berkepala dua.
statement.en: Living in winding channels and marshlands, s’í:lhqey are normally described as serpents with two heads.

basis_claims.quote: It was like a big snake only the head like a horse’s head - long and smooth - a long mouth - long ears like a horse’s

statement.id: Dalam kesaksian yang dikutip museum, makhluk itu seperti ular besar, hanya kepalanya seperti kepala kuda, panjang dan halus, dengan mulut panjang dan telinga panjang seperti kuda.
statement.en: In a recollection quoted by the museum, it was like a big snake, only with a horse's head, long and smooth, with a long mouth and long ears like a horse's.

shenlong.depicted_variant: Shenlong bersisik biru-azure memerintah awan hujan, bukan naga pop-culture.

visual_requirements.description: One original naturalistic Chinese spirit dragon with azure scales: exactly one dragon head, two eyes, one long scaly sinuous body, four natural clawed limbs, no wings, no modern cartoon design; head and long neck dominate
Dense physical rain and storm cloud fronts surge across the sky under the rain-governing dragon; no lightning bolts from eyes or magical beams
Above rain-bearing clouds, the heavens into which the dragon rises

shenlong.aura: Dense physical rain and storm cloud fronts surge across the sky under the rain-governing dragon; no lightning bolts from eyes or magical beams [shenlong-c01, shenlong-c02, shenlong-c04]

basis_claims.quote: Shenlong (simplified Chinese: 神龙; traditional Chinese: 神龍; pinyin: shén lóng, literally "god dragon" or "divine dragon", Japanese: 神龍, shinryū) is the spirit dragon from Chinese mythology who is the dragon god of the tempest and also a master of rain.

statement.id: Shenlong adalah naga roh dalam mitologi Tiongkok yang menguasai hujan dan badai.
statement.en: Shenlong is a Chinese mythological spirit dragon governing rain and tempests.

basis_claims.quote: is the spirit dragon from Chinese mythology who is the dragon god of the tempest and also a master of rain.

statement.id: Shenlong disebut dewa badai dan penguasa hujan.
statement.en: Shenlong is described as a god of tempest and master of rain.

basis_claims.quote: 龍生於水，被五色而游，故神。欲小則化如蠶蠋，欲大則藏於天下，欲上則凌於雲氣，欲下則入於深泉。變化無日，上下無時，謂之神。

statement.id: Teks klasik Guanzi ini menyatakan naga (龍) lahir di air dan mengembara dengan lima warna sehingga disebut "shen" (ilahi); ia dapat mengecil menjadi seperti ulat sutra, membesar hingga bersembunyi di bawah langit, naik melampaui awan, atau turun ke mata air dalam, dan perubahannya tak terikat hari maupun waktu.
statement.en: This classical text, the Guanzi, states that the dragon (龍) is born in water and roams wearing five colors, hence it is "shen" (divine); it can shrink to a silkworm, grow so large it hides beneath heaven, rise above the clouds or descend into deep springs, and its changes are not bound to day or time.

basis_claims.quote: The spiritual dragon is azure-scaled and governs the storms, clouds, and rain on which all agricultural life depends.

statement.id: Naga roh ini bersisik biru langit dan menguasai badai, awan, dan hujan yang menjadi sandaran seluruh kehidupan pertanian.
statement.en: The spiritual dragon is azure-scaled and governs the storms, clouds and rain on which all agricultural life depends.

basis_claims.quote: 龍（ ）：鱗蟲之長。能幽，能明，能細，能巨，能短，能長；春分而登天，秋分而潛淵。

statement.id: Dalam teks kamus klasik Shuowen Jiezi, naga (龍) adalah yang tertua di antara makhluk bersisik; ia dapat tersembunyi atau terang, kecil atau besar, pendek atau panjang, naik ke langit pada ekuinoks musim semi dan menyelam ke samudra pada ekuinoks musim gugur.
statement.en: In the classical dictionary text Shuowen Jiezi, the dragon (龍) is the chief of scaly creatures; it can be hidden or bright, small or huge, short or long, rising to heaven at the spring equinox and diving into the deep at the autumn equinox.

shippeitaro.depicted_variant: Shippeitaro menyerang kucing hitam besar Spirit of the Mountain pada varian Violet Fairy Book.

visual_requirements.description: Shippeitaro is ONE great natural dog, one canine head, two eyes, four legs and one tail, coarse tawny-white fur. One secondary huge black monster cat is partly visible, with natural feline anatomy; dog is clearly the main subject. No humanoid dog, no extra heads or limbs
Physical attack with the dog teeth seizing the mountain cat spirit; fur, splinters and dust scatter, absolutely no blood or gore
At midnight in the shadowed forest chapel where the cat spirits gathered, plain uninscribed wooden entrance and forest behind

shippeitaro.aura: Physical attack with the dog teeth seizing the mountain cat spirit; fur, splinters and dust scatter, absolutely no blood or gore [shippeitaro-c03, shippeitaro-c11]

basis_claims.quote: Shippeitaro or Shippei Taro (German spelling: Schippeitaro; Japanese: しっぺい太郎 or 竹篦太郎 ) is the name of a helper dog in the Japanese fairy tale by the same name.

statement.id: Shippeitarō adalah anjing penolong dalam cerita rakyat Jepang.
statement.en: Shippeitarō is a helper dog in a Japanese folktale.

basis_claims.quote: This dog is substituted for the maiden to be placed inside the sacrificial container, and when the spirits arrive, the warrior and dog attack the cats and vanquish them.

statement.id: Pendekar dan anjing mengalahkan para roh setelah anjing menggantikan perempuan yang akan dikorbankan.
statement.en: The warrior and dog defeat spirits after the dog replaces a sacrificial maiden.

basis_claims.quote: he saw a troop of hideous cats, dancing furiously, making the night horrible with their yells. ... he could make out the words, ‘Do not tell Schippeitaro! Keep it hidden and secret! Do not tell Schippeitaro!’

statement.id: Dalam versi The Violet Fairy Book, di kapel hutan sang pemuda melihat sekawanan kucing buruk rupa menari beringas dan mendengar mereka berseru agar jangan memberi tahu Schippeitaro dan merahasiakannya.
statement.en: In the Violet Fairy Book version, in the forest chapel the youth sees a troop of hideous cats dancing furiously and hears them cry that Schippeitaro must not be told and it must be kept hidden.

basis_claims.quote: ‘Schippeitaro is the great dog that belongs to the overseer of our prince,’

statement.id: Penduduk menjawab bahwa Schippeitaro adalah anjing besar milik pengawas pangeran mereka.
statement.en: The villagers answer that Schippeitaro is the great dog belonging to their prince's overseer.

basis_claims.quote: But this time they had in their midst a huge black cat who seemed to be their king, and whom the young man guessed to be the Spirit of the Mountain.

statement.id: Pada tengah malam berikutnya para kucing membawa seekor kucing hitam raksasa yang tampak seperti raja mereka dan diduga sang pemuda sebagai Roh Gunung.
statement.en: At the next midnight the cats bring a huge black cat who seems to be their king and whom the young man guesses to be the Spirit of the Mountain.

basis_claims.quote: But instead of fastening his teeth in the neck of a beautiful maiden, Schippeitaro’s teeth were fastened in HIM, and the youth ran up and cut off his head with his sword.

statement.id: Alih-alih menggigit leher seorang gadis, gigi Schippeitaro menancap pada kucing raksasa itu, dan sang pemuda memenggal kepalanya dengan pedang.
statement.en: Instead of biting a maiden's neck, Schippeitaro's teeth fastened in the monster cat, and the youth cut off its head with his sword.

siuru.depicted_variant: Siuru burung dua sayap biru berbulu sutra dalam perjalanan melintasi tiga dunia.

visual_requirements.description: Exactly ONE fabulous bird, one head, two eyes, one beak, exactly TWO expansive BLUE feathered wings, two ordinary bird feet tucked naturally, one feathered tail. Silken feathers and wind-light wings; no human face or body; no extra wings
Fly and glide through the three-world journey with wings lighter than wind; only physical wind sweeps the silken feathers and tears ordinary mist around the wings, no light trails or magic aura
High air during her flight over the three worlds; dark layered cloud horizons beneath the bird, not a literal map or labeled diagram

siuru.aura: Fly and glide through the three-world journey with wings lighter than wind; only physical wind sweeps the silken feathers and tears ordinary mist around the wings, no light trails or magic aura [siuru-c04, siuru-c09, siuru-c10]

basis_claims.quote: — сказочная птица в старинных эстонских народных песнях. Упоминается также в девятнадцатой песни эстонского народного эпоса «Калевипоэг».

statement.id: Siuru (Siurulind) adalah burung dongeng dalam lagu-lagu rakyat Estonia lama, dan juga disebut dalam nyanyian kesembilan belas epos rakyat Estonia Kalevipoeg.
statement.en: Siuru (Siurulind) is a fabulous bird of old Estonian folk songs, also mentioned in the nineteenth canto of the Estonian folk epic Kalevipoeg.

basis_claims.quote: Птица Сиуру, дочка Таары, Синекрылая летунья, С шёлковыми пёрышками, Проклевалась без родимой, Выросла без милых братев И без ласковых сестричек ... Это видел старый Уку, Подарил тебе он крылья, Сделал крылья легче ветра, Чтоб на них дитя скользило, Чтоб на крылышках летало

statement.id: Dalam nyanyian Kalevipoeg: "Burung Siuru, putri Taara, si penerbang bersayap biru berbulu sutra, menetas tanpa ibu, tumbuh tanpa saudara dan saudari"; Uku tua melihatnya dan memberinya sayap yang lebih ringan dari angin agar sang anak melayang dan terbang.
statement.en: In the Kalevipoeg canto: "The bird Siuru, daughter of Taara, blue-winged flier with silken feathers, hatched without a mother, grew up without brothers or kind sisters"; old Uku saw this and gave her wings lighter than the wind so the child could glide and fly.

basis_claims.quote: Nagu tütarlast kodukanaks nimetatakse, samuti nimetab Kreutzwald Siurut Taara tütreks. Kõigiti ei saa me Siurut arvata inimeste kilda, vaid peame teda jätma lindude suguvõsa liikmeks.

statement.id: Eisen berpendapat bahwa Kreutzwald menyebut Siuru "putri Taara" seperti seorang gadis disebut "ayam rumah"; menurutnya Siuru tidak dapat digolongkan sebagai manusia dan harus tetap dianggap anggota keluarga burung.
statement.en: Eisen argues that Kreutzwald calls Siuru "Taara's daughter" just as a girl is called a "house hen"; in his view Siuru cannot be counted among humans and must remain a member of the bird family.

basis_claims.quote: Vanaisa valmisteli Tütterelle tuuletiivad, Tuuletiivad, pilveviivad, Miska lapsi liugunekse

statement.id: Dalam nyanyian kesembilan belas Kalevipoeg, sang kakek menyiapkan sayap angin bagi si anak perempuan agar ia dapat meluncur.
statement.en: In canto XIX of the Kalevipoeg the grandfather prepares wind-wings for the daughter so that she may glide.

basis_claims.quote: Siuru-lindu, sinisiiba, Lendas palju, liugles palju, Lendas, liugles lõuna alla, Pööras põiki põhja poole, Lendas üle kolme ilma.

statement.id: Dalam nyanyian kesembilan belas Kalevipoeg, burung Siuru terbang jauh, meluncur ke selatan, berbelok ke utara, dan terbang melintasi tiga dunia.
statement.en: In canto XIX of the Kalevipoeg the bird Siuru flies far, glides south, turns north, and flies over three worlds.

strix-mythology.depicted_variant: Strix varian Ovid dengan kepala besar, goggle eyes, sayap abu-putih dan cakar kait, menyerbu kamar tanpa korban.

visual_requirements.description: ONE menacing bird with an abnormally large single head, exactly two wide staring goggle eyes, a sharply rapacious hooked beak, exactly two greyish-white wings with grey-blotched feathers, two feet ending in long hooked claws, one tail; no human witch torso
No magical effects; night-flight and screeching predatory attack, feathers and real dust burst through the air. No baby, victim, injury, blood or gore
Dark ancient Roman chambers of Proca with a small plain uninscribed window, no cradle or infant in view

strix-mythology.aura: No magical effects; night-flight and screeching predatory attack, feathers and real dust burst through the air. No baby, victim, injury, blood or gore [strix-mythology-c04, strix-mythology-c05, strix-mythology-c06]

basis_claims.quote: The strix is described as a large-headed bird with transfixed eyes, rapacious beak, greyish white wings, and hooked claws in Ovid's Fasti.

statement.id: Dalam Fasti karya Ovidius, strix digambarkan berkepala besar, bermata menatap tajam, berparuh pemangsa, bersayap putih keabuan, dan bercakar bengkok.
statement.en: In Ovid's Fasti the strix is a large-headed bird with staring eyes, a rapacious beak, greyish-white wings and hooked claws.

basis_claims.quote: OVID, FASTI 6 ... There are greedy birds ... Big is their head, goggle their eyes, their beaks are formed for rapine, their feathers blotched with grey, their claws fitted with hooks. They fly by night and attack nurseless children

statement.id: Dalam Fasti karya Ovidius, burung-burung rakus itu berkepala besar, bermata melotot, berparuh untuk merampas, berbulu kelabu berbercak, dan bercakar berkait; mereka terbang pada malam hari dan menyerang anak-anak tanpa pengasuh.
statement.en: In Ovid's Fasti, the greedy birds have big heads, goggle eyes, beaks formed for rapine, feathers blotched with grey and claws fitted with hooks; they fly by night and attack nurseless children.

basis_claims.quote: OVID, FASTI 6 ... There are greedy birds ... They are said to rend the flesh of sucklings with their beaks, and their throats are full of the blood which they have drunk. Screech-owl is their name, but the reason of the name is that they are wont to screech horribly by night.

statement.id: Dalam Fasti karya Ovidius, burung-burung itu dikatakan mencabik daging bayi susuan dengan paruh mereka dan kerongkongan mereka penuh darah yang telah mereka minum; nama mereka burung hantu pekik, karena mereka biasa memekik mengerikan pada malam hari.
statement.en: In Ovid's Fasti, the birds are said to rend the flesh of sucklings with their beaks, and their throats are full of the blood they have drunk; their name is screech-owl because they are wont to screech horribly by night.

basis_claims.quote: OVID, FASTI 6 ... Whether, therefore, they are born birds, or are made such by enchantment and are nothing but beldames transformed into fowls by a ... spell, they came into the chambers of Proca.

statement.id: Dalam Fasti karya Ovidius, entah mereka lahir sebagai burung atau dijadikan demikian oleh sihir dan tak lain nenek-nenek yang diubah menjadi unggas oleh mantra, mereka masuk ke kamar Proca.
statement.en: In Ovid's Fasti, whether they are born birds or are made such by enchantment and are nothing but beldames transformed into fowls by a spell, they came into the chambers of Proca.

basis_claims.quote: OVID, FASTI 6 ... In the chambers Proca, a child five days old, was a fresh prey for the birds. They sucked the infant with their greedy tongues, and the poor child squalled and craved help.

statement.id: Dalam Fasti karya Ovidius, di kamar Proca, seorang anak berusia lima hari menjadi mangsa segar burung-burung itu; mereka menyedot sang bayi dengan lidah rakus mereka, dan anak malang itu menjerit meminta tolong.
statement.en: In Ovid's Fasti, in the chambers of Proca a child five days old was a fresh prey for the birds; they sucked the infant with their greedy tongues, and the poor child squalled and craved help.

basis_claims.quote: OVID, FASTI 6 ... A rod of Janus, taken from the white-thorn, was placed where a small window gave light to the chambers. After that, it is said that the birds did not violate the cradle, and the boy recovered his former colour.

statement.id: Dalam Fasti karya Ovidius, sebatang tongkat Janus dari semak duri putih diletakkan di tempat jendela kecil menerangi kamar; sesudah itu dikatakan burung-burung itu tidak lagi mengganggu buaian, dan anak itu pulih warna kulitnya semula.
statement.en: In Ovid's Fasti, a rod of Janus taken from the white-thorn was placed where a small window gave light to the chambers; after that, it is said, the birds did not violate the cradle, and the boy recovered his former colour.

teng-mythology.depicted_variant: Tengshe varian ular terbang tanpa kaki atau sayap yang menunggang awan.

visual_requirements.description: ONE long flying snake-serpent with a single serpentine head, two eyes, one continuous coiling scaly body and tail; absolutely ZERO feet, ZERO legs, ZERO arms, ZERO wings, no horns; the documented footless flying-snake form
Ride the physical clouds and mist, flying without feet; strong ordinary cloud currents pour around its coils, no colored ribbons or magic aura
High clouds and mist through which Teng drifts and rides

teng-mythology.aura: Ride the physical clouds and mist, flying without feet; strong ordinary cloud currents pour around its coils, no colored ribbons or magic aura [teng-mythology-c04, teng-mythology-c06, teng-mythology-c08, teng-mythology-c09]

basis_claims.quote: This legendary creature's names include teng (螣; "a flying dragon") and tengshe (螣蛇; "flying-dragon snake" or 騰蛇; "soaring snake").

statement.id: Sebutan Tengshe dapat bermakna ular naga terbang atau ular yang melayang.
statement.en: Tengshe may denote a flying-dragon snake or soaring snake.

basis_claims.quote: The (3rd–2nd centuries BCE) Erya dictionary (16) defines teng (螣) as tengshe (螣蛇; "teng-snake"), and Guo Pu's commentary glosses it as a "[飛龍; feilong] flying dragon that drifts in the clouds and mist".

statement.id: Komentar Guo Pu atas Erya menggambarkannya melayang dalam awan dan kabut.
statement.en: Guo Pu's Erya commentary describes it drifting through clouds and mist.

basis_claims.quote: Confucianist Xunzi ... first records the Classical Chinese idiom tengshe wuzu er fei ... "flying dragon is without feet yet flies", which figuratively means "success results from concentrating on one's abilities".

statement.id: Xunzi, seorang Konfusianis, pertama kali mencatat idiom Tionghoa klasik tengshe wuzu er fei, "naga terbang tidak berkaki namun terbang", yang secara kiasan berarti "keberhasilan datang dari memusatkan diri pada kemampuan sendiri".
statement.en: The Confucianist Xunzi first records the Classical Chinese idiom tengshe wuzu er fei, "flying dragon is without feet yet flies", which figuratively means "success results from concentrating on one's abilities".

basis_claims.quote: Huainanzi uses both tengshe graphic variants ... The ascending snake can drift in the mist, yet it is endangered by the centipede.

statement.id: Dalam Huainanzi, ular yang naik (tengshe) dapat melayang di dalam kabut, namun terancam oleh kelabang.
statement.en: In the Huainanzi, the ascending snake (tengshe) can drift in the mist yet is endangered by the centipede.

basis_claims.quote: The (1578 CE) Bencao Gangmu ... "There are flying snakes without feet such as the 螣蛇 (T'eng She)." ... The t'eng-she changes into a dragon. This divine snake can ride upon the clouds and fly about over a thousand miles.

statement.id: Dalam Bencao Gangmu (1578), ular terbang tanpa kaki seperti 螣蛇 (T'eng She) disebut; komentarnya menyatakan bahwa t'eng-she berubah menjadi naga, ular ilahi ini dapat menunggangi awan dan terbang lebih dari seribu mil.
statement.en: The Bencao Gangmu (1578) mentions flying snakes without feet such as the 螣蛇 (T'eng She); its commentary says the t'eng-she changes into a dragon, and this divine snake can ride the clouds and fly over a thousand miles.

basis_claims.quote: 慎子曰：飛龍乘雲，騰蛇遊霧，雲罷霧霽，而龍蛇與螾螘同矣，則失其所乘也。

statement.id: Shenzi (慎子) berkata bahwa naga terbang (飛龍) menunggangi awan dan ular terbang (騰蛇) mengembara di kabut, tetapi ketika awan bubar dan kabut cerah, naga dan ular itu sama saja dengan cacing dan semut karena kehilangan apa yang ditungganginya.
statement.en: Shenzi (慎子) says the flying dragon (飛龍) rides the clouds and the rising snake (騰蛇) wanders in the mist, but when clouds disperse and mist clears, the dragon and snake become the same as earthworms and ants because they lose what they ride.

thunderdell.depicted_variant: Thunderdell tepat dua kepala mengejar di jembatan angkat yang pecah oleh beratnya.

visual_requirements.description: ONE enormous humanoid giant with exactly TWO distinct heads and TWO necks on ONE body, each head has two eyes and one mouth; both heads fully visible side by side and turned toward viewer. Exactly TWO arms and TWO legs; full opaque rough wool tunic and leather trousers. No extra heads or arms
His documented great weight physically breaks the wooden drawbridge; splintered timbers fall into the moat with real water spray. No magical effects or gore
The drawbridge and moat of the house in the Jack the Giant-Killer tale, plain uninscribed stone walls

thunderdell.aura: His documented great weight physically breaks the wooden drawbridge; splintered timbers fall into the moat with real water spray. No magical effects or gore [thunderdell-c08, thunderdell-c09]

basis_claims.quote: Thunderdell (Welsh: Taranau ), also recorded as Thunderdel, Thunderel, Thundrel, Thunderdale, or Thunderbore, was a two-headed giant of Cornwall slain by Jack the Giant-Killer in the stories of Tabart and others.

statement.id: Thunderdell (Welsh: Taranau; Thunderdel, Thunderel, Thundrel, Thunderdale, Thunderbore), raksasa berkepala dua Cornwall dibunuh Jack the Giant-Killer (Jack the Giant Killer) dalam kisah Tabart.
statement.en: Thunderdell (Welsh: Taranau; Thunderdel, Thunderel, Thundrel, Thunderdale, Thunderbore), a two-headed Cornish giant slain by Jack the Giant-Killer in Tabart's stories.

basis_claims.quote: In Jack the Giant Killer, Thunderdell first appeared where he crashed a banquet that was prepared for Jack. During this time, he chanted "fee fau fum." Jack defeats and beheads the two-headed giant with a trick involving the house's moat and drawbridge.

statement.id: Dalam Jack the Giant Killer, Thunderdell muncul dengan mengacau perjamuan yang disiapkan untuk Jack sambil menyerukan "fee fau fum"; Jack mengalahkan dan memenggal raksasa berkepala dua itu dengan tipu daya yang memakai parit dan jembatan angkat rumah itu.
statement.en: In Jack the Giant Killer, Thunderdell first appears crashing a banquet prepared for Jack, chanting "fee fau fum"; Jack defeats and beheads the two-headed giant with a trick involving the house's moat and drawbridge.

basis_claims.quote: that one Thunderdell, a giant with two heads, having heard of the death of his kinsmen, had come from the northern dales to be revenged on Jack

statement.id: Dalam cerita ini, Thunderdell, raksasa berkepala dua, mendengar kematian sanak-saudaranya dan datang dari lembah-lembah utara (northern dales) untuk membalas dendam kepada Jack.
statement.en: In the tale, Thunderdell, a giant with two heads, having heard of the death of his kinsmen, came from the northern dales to be revenged on Jack.

basis_claims.quote: Art thou that villain who killed my kinsmen? Then I will tear thee with my teeth, suck thy blood, and grind thy bones to powder.

statement.id: Si raksasa berkepala dua menuduh Jack membunuh sanak-saudaranya dan mengancam akan mencabik Jack dengan giginya, mengisap darahnya, dan menggiling tulangnya menjadi bubuk.
statement.en: The two-headed giant accuses Jack of killing his kinsmen and threatens to tear him with his teeth, suck his blood, and grind his bones to powder.

basis_claims.quote: Then, coming to the middle of the bridge, the giant's great weight broke it down, and he tumbled headlong into the water, where he rolled and wallowed like a whale.

statement.id: Ketika si raksasa mengejar Jack di jembatan, beratnya yang besar mematahkan jembatan itu dan ia jatuh tersungkur ke air.
statement.en: As the giant chased Jack over the drawbridge, his great weight broke the bridge and he tumbled headlong into the water.

tiangou.depicted_variant: Tiangou varian anjing hitam membesar dan memakan Bulan, tidak dicampur meteor atau rubah putih.

visual_requirements.description: ONE BLACK DOG with one canine head, two eyes, exactly four natural legs and one tail, black coarse fur, huge canine jaws. No white fox head, no wings, no extra heads; ordinary dog anatomy at documented increasing cosmic size
Physically eat the Moon during an eclipse, a real cratered lunar sphere visibly entering the jaws; no fire, meteor trail, eye beams or glowing energy aura
The dark sky at the lunar eclipse, sparse natural stars and one cratered Moon

tiangou.aura: Physically eat the Moon during an eclipse, a real cratered lunar sphere visibly entering the jaws; no fire, meteor trail, eye beams or glowing energy aura [tiangou-c02, tiangou-c04, tiangou-c10]

basis_claims.quote: is a legendary creature from China. The tiangou resembles a black dog or meteor, and is thought to eat the Sun or Moon during an eclipse.

statement.id: Tiangou adalah makhluk legenda Tiongkok berupa anjing hitam atau meteor.
statement.en: Tiangou is a Chinese legendary creature resembling a black dog or meteor.

basis_claims.quote: is a legendary creature from China. The tiangou resembles a black dog or meteor, and is thought to eat the Sun or Moon during an eclipse.

statement.id: Makhluk ini dipercaya memakan matahari atau bulan saat gerhana.
statement.en: This creature is believed to eat the sun or moon during an eclipse.

basis_claims.quote: As a bad spirit, it is a black dog that eats the Moon. According to the legends, as an interpretation of a lunar eclipse, after Houyi shot down the nine Suns in the sky, he was awarded with an immortality-granting pill by the Queen Mother of the West. Before he could eat it, his wife Chang'e consumed the elixir of immortality. Chang'e felt her body getting lighter and flew away.

statement.id: Varian buruk menggambarkannya sebagai anjing hitam pemakan bulan.
statement.en: The adverse variant portrays it as a black dog that eats the moon.

basis_claims.quote: Seeing this, a black dog that Hou Yi was rearing went inside her room and licked the remains of the pill. He then chased after Chang'e, getting bigger and bigger. Chang'e, terrified, hid on the Moon. The black dog then ate the Moon, along with Chang'e.

statement.id: Dalam legenda, seekor anjing hitam milik Hou Yi menjilat sisa pil keabadian di kamar Chang'e, mengejarnya sambil terus membesar, lalu memakan Bulan bersama Chang'e.
statement.en: In the legend, a black dog Hou Yi was rearing went into Chang'e's room and licked the remains of the immortality pill, chased after her getting bigger and bigger, and ate the Moon along with Chang'e.

basis_claims.quote: Tiangou spat the Moon and Chang'e back out, and Chang'e continued living on the Moon.

statement.id: Menurut kisah itu, Tiangou memuntahkan kembali Bulan dan Chang'e, dan Chang'e terus hidup di Bulan.
statement.en: In the tale, Tiangou spat the Moon and Chang'e back out, and Chang'e continued living on the Moon.

tianlong.depicted_variant: Tianlong varian nāga penjaga Mahayana yang menopang Heavenly Palace agar tidak jatuh.

visual_requirements.description: ONE living heavenly dragon/naga, one original serpentine dragon head, two eyes, one long coiled body, natural rough scales. Only the head, long neck and supporting body coils are visible; any limbs remain naturally occluded beneath the palace foundation and clouds. No visible wings, no added horn crown, no armor or modern dragon design

The dragon carries and holds up the Heavenly Palace so it does not fall; the weight visibly rests against supporting coils and dense clouds stream around the lifted foundation. No unrelated storm control or energy beams
The Heavenly Palace aloft in heaven, a plain uninscribed stone-and-wood celestial palace supported by the dragon; no glyphs, symbols, statues or decorative lettering

tianlong.aura: The dragon carries and holds up the Heavenly Palace so it does not fall; the weight visibly rests against supporting coils and dense clouds stream around the lifted foundation. No unrelated storm control or energy beams [tianlong-c06, tianlong-c09]

basis_claims.quote: Tianlong (simplified Chinese: 天龙; traditional Chinese: 天龍; pinyin: tiānlóng; Wade–Giles: t'ien lung; lit. "heavenly dragon") is a flying dragon in Chinese mythology, a star in Chinese astrology, and a proper name.

statement.id: Tianlong adalah naga terbang dalam mitologi Tiongkok; nama yang sama juga memiliki penggunaan astronomis.
statement.en: Tianlong is a flying dragon in Chinese mythology, with the same name also used astronomically.

basis_claims.quote: From originally denoting "heavenly dragon", Tianlong 天龍 semantically developed meanings as Buddhist "heavenly Nāgas" or "Devas and Nāgas", "centipede", and "proper names" of stars, people, and places.

statement.id: Maknanya berkembang dalam Buddhisme menjadi naga surgawi atau kelompok dewa dan naga.
statement.en: Its Buddhist senses developed to include heavenly nagas or devas and nagas.

basis_claims.quote: First, tianlong 天龍 means "heavenly dragon/nāga" as the first of four nāga classes in Mahayana tradition. ... who guard the Heavenly Palace and carry it so that it does not fall.

statement.id: Menurut artikel ini, dalam tradisi Mahayana tianlong adalah kelas nāga pertama dari empat kelas, yang menjaga Istana Langit dan memikulnya agar tidak jatuh.
statement.en: According to the article, in the Mahayana tradition tianlong is the first of four nāga classes, who guard the Heavenly Palace and carry it so that it does not fall.

basis_claims.quote: 别行䟽云龍有四種一守天宫殿持令不落人間屋上作龍像之爾二興雲致雨〉 〈益人間者三地龍決江開瀆四伏藏守轉輪王大福人藏也龍有四生俱舎云𡖉生金翅鳥能食四生龍〉 〈罵意經云

statement.id: Teks Fanyi Mingyi Ji mengutip sebuah komentar yang menyebut naga ada empat jenis, yang pertama menjaga istana langit dan menahannya agar tidak jatuh; patung naga dibuat di atas atap rumah manusia, dan jenis lain membawa awan dan hujan, membuka sungai dan saluran, atau menjaga harta karun.
statement.en: The Fanyi Mingyi Ji text quotes a commentary saying dragons are of four kinds, the first guarding heavenly palaces and holding them so they do not fall; dragon images are made on human roofs, and the other kinds bring clouds and rain, open rivers and channels, or guard treasure.

tuchulcha.depicted_variant: Tuchulcha berchiton buram dengan paruh besar, telinga runcing dan rambut ular, gender ambigu sesuai riset.

visual_requirements.description: ONE sexually ambiguous humanoid daemon with one head, two eyes, a huge unmistakable large-bird BEAK in place of a human mouth, two long pointed donkey-or-wolf ears, writhing diamond-marked adder snakes as hair. Exactly two arms and two legs, pale pinkish skin, fully opaque simple unisex full-length chiton, no exposed chest and no emphasis on sexual anatomy. No wings, no extra humanoid heads Hands have short natural fingernails, no added claws.
No documented magical effects; the writhing snake-hair and beaked animal anatomy supply physical menace and chthonic authority
The shadowed underworld Aita, austere dark uninscribed stone passage with no tomb paintings or writing

tuchulcha.aura: No documented magical effects; the writhing snake-hair and beaked animal anatomy supply physical menace and chthonic authority [tuchulcha-c01, tuchulcha-c08, tuchulcha-c10]

basis_claims.quote: Tuchulcha was a chthonic daemon (not to be confused with the Christian term  "demon") of Etruscan mythology,  with pointed ears (perhaps those of a donkey), hair made of snakes, and a beak (perhaps that of a vulture).

statement.id: Tuchulcha adalah daemon dunia bawah dalam mitologi Etruria, bertelinga runcing, berambut ular, dan berparuh.
statement.en: Tuchulcha was a chthonic daemon of Etruscan mythology with pointed ears, snake hair and a beak.

basis_claims.quote: Tuchulcha lived in the underworld known as Aita.

statement.id: Tuchulcha tinggal di dunia bawah bernama Aita.
statement.en: Tuchulcha lived in the underworld called Aita.

basis_claims.quote: According to Nancy de Grummond, "This monster is often referred to as male but in fact is very likely female (or neither gender), for she wears a woman’s dress, has decidedly pale pinkish skin (compare the standard brick-red male flesh of These), and even appears to have breasts."

statement.id: Menurut Nancy de Grummond, sosok ini sering disebut laki-laki tetapi sangat mungkin perempuan (atau tak berjenis kelamin), karena memakai busana perempuan, berkulit merah muda pucat, dan tampak berpayudara.
statement.en: According to Nancy de Grummond, this monster is often referred to as male but is very likely female (or neither gender), for she wears a woman's dress, has decidedly pale pinkish skin, and even appears to have breasts.

basis_claims.quote: She also identifies the diamond-marking of Tuchulcha's serpents as identifying the poisonous adder (Vipera berus berus).

statement.id: Penanda berbentuk belah ketupat pada ular-ular Tuchulcha dikenali sebagai ciri ular berbisa jenis adder (Vipera berus berus).
statement.en: The diamond-marking of Tuchulcha's serpents has been identified as that of the poisonous adder (Vipera berus berus).

basis_claims.quote: A similar debate also surrounds the gender and sex of the figure of Tuchulca, as seen in the Tomb of Orcus II, in Tarquinia. Illustrated wearing a simple chiton associated with female attire, this depiction also possesses various theriomorphic attributes, such as the beak of a large bird, the ears of a wolf or donkey and writhing snakes representing hair.

statement.id: Sebuah abstrak makalah konferensi menulis bahwa jenis kelamin dan gender sosok Tuchulca (ejaan yang dipakainya) di Makam Orcus II, Tarquinia, juga diperdebatkan; sosok itu berbusana chiton sederhana yang lazim bagi perempuan dan berciri binatang, yakni paruh burung besar, telinga serigala atau keledai, serta ular menggeliat sebagai rambut.
statement.en: A conference abstract writes that the gender and sex of the figure of Tuchulca (its spelling) in the Tomb of Orcus II, Tarquinia, are likewise debated; the figure wears a simple chiton associated with female attire and has animal features: the beak of a large bird, the ears of a wolf or donkey and writhing snakes as hair.

basis_claims.quote: Tuchulca also seems to be depicted with the suggestion of breasts, which has led many scholars to label it as a “female” figure. However, I argue that Tuchulca exhibits both male and female characteristics, and thus is intentionally more sexually ambiguous.

statement.id: Tuchulca tampak digambarkan dengan kesan payudara, yang membuat banyak sarjana menyebutnya sosok "perempuan"; penulis abstrak itu berpendapat bahwa Tuchulca menampilkan ciri laki-laki sekaligus perempuan sehingga sengaja dibuat ambigu secara seksual.
statement.en: Tuchulca seems to be depicted with the suggestion of breasts, which has led many scholars to label it as a "female" figure; the abstract's author argues that Tuchulca shows both male and female characteristics and is thus intentionally sexually ambiguous.

basis_claims.quote: Their portrayal as chthonic beings is seen when they are integrated into Greek mythological narratives in tomb paintings, funerary statuary and cinerary urns. Demons also performed a psychopomp role in tomb paintings and on sarcophagi, where they are often shown alongside Etruscan elites,

statement.id: Menurut abstrak yang sama, demon Etruria digambarkan sebagai makhluk chthonic ketika dipadukan dengan kisah mitologi Yunani pada lukisan makam, patung pemakaman, dan guci abu; mereka juga berperan sebagai psychopomp pada lukisan makam dan sarkofagus, sering ditunjukkan bersama kaum elite Etruria.
statement.en: According to the same abstract, Etruscan demons are portrayed as chthonic beings when integrated into Greek mythological narratives in tomb paintings, funerary statuary and cinerary urns; they also performed a psychopomp role in tomb paintings and on sarcophagi, often shown alongside Etruscan elites.

ubagabi.depicted_variant: Ubagabi hi-no-tama satu kaki lebarnya dengan wajah perempuan tua di dalam nyala, terbang di riverbank hujan.

visual_requirements.description: ONE roughly ONE-FOOT-wide ball of real flame containing exactly one old woman's face, two eyes, weathered elderly features. No torso, no arms, no legs, no extra faces, no chicken mixed into this fireball variant
The documented fireball flies at great speed; real orange flame burns inside the sphere while rain physically steams and falls across the moving fire, no neon energy ribbons
A dark riverbank on a rainy night in Kawachi/Tanba folklore, river water and wet reeds behind the hovering fireball

ubagabi.aura: The documented fireball flies at great speed; real orange flame burns inside the sphere while rain physically steams and falls across the moving fire, no neon energy ribbons [ubagabi-c05, ubagabi-c08, ubagabi-c10]

basis_claims.quote: The ubagabi (姥ヶ火 or 姥火, "old woman's fire") is an atmospheric ghost light in legends of Kawachi Province (now Osaka Prefecture) and Tanba Province (now northern Kyoto Prefecture).

statement.id: Ubagabi adalah cahaya gaib dalam legenda Kawachi dan Tanba.
statement.en: Ubagabi is a ghost light in Kawachi and Tanba legends.

basis_claims.quote: According to the Shokoku Rijin Dan, on a rainy night, in Hiraoka, Kawachi (now Higashiōsaka, Osaka Prefecture), it would appear as a ball of fire with a length of one shaku (about 30 centimeters).

statement.id: Satu kisah menggambarkan bola api pada malam hujan di Hiraoka.
statement.en: One account describes a ball of fire on rainy nights at Hiraoka.

basis_claims.quote: It is said that when the ubagabi eventually flew away, it turned back into its original appearance as a ball of fire.

statement.id: Ia kembali ke wujud bola api ketika terbang pergi.
statement.en: It returns to a fireball form when flying away.

basis_claims.quote: Ubagabi 姥ヶ火 うばがび Translation: old hag fire Habitat: riverbanks

statement.id: Yokai.com menulis namanya 姥ヶ火, menerjemahkannya "api nenek tua", dan menyebut habitatnya tepi sungai.
statement.en: Yokai.com writes the name as 姥ヶ火, translates it "old hag fire", and gives the habitat as riverbanks.

basis_claims.quote: Ubagabi is a kind of hi-no-tama, or fireball yokai. It appears on rainy nights near riverbanks, and takes the form of a 1 foot diameter ball of flame with the face of an old woman in it. It can also appear as a chicken, but does not remain in this form for long.

statement.id: Menurut Yokai.com, ubagabi adalah yōkai bola api (hi-no-tama) yang muncul pada malam hujan di dekat tepi sungai, berupa bola api berdiameter sekitar 1 kaki dengan wajah nenek di dalamnya; ia juga dapat tampil sebagai ayam tetapi tidak lama.
statement.en: According to Yokai.com, the ubagabi is a fireball (hi-no-tama) yokai that appears on rainy nights near riverbanks as a ball of flame about 1 foot across with an old woman's face in it; it can also appear as a chicken but does not remain so for long.

basis_claims.quote: Ubagabi have the uncanny ability to fly long distances — up to 4 kilometers — in the blink of an eye. Occasionally they graze a person’s shoulder and then continue off into the darkness. The unfortunate people whom they bounce off of invariably end up dying somehow within three years.

statement.id: Menurut Yokai.com, ubagabi dapat terbang jauh, hingga 4 kilometer, dalam sekejap; kadang menyerempet bahu seseorang, dan orang itu pasti mati dalam waktu tiga tahun.
statement.en: According to Yokai.com, ubagabi can fly long distances, up to 4 kilometers, in the blink of an eye; they sometimes graze a person's shoulder, and that person invariably dies within three years.

basis_claims.quote: It is also titled "Ubagabi" (here written as 姥が火) in the Gazu Hyakki Yagyō, and it is depicted with an old woman's face within the mysterious flames, but since there is the statement "it's said to be in Kawachi Province" within accompanying description, this makes it a depiction of a Kawachi Province legend.

statement.id: Dalam Gazu Hyakki Yagyō ia digambarkan dengan wajah nenek di dalam api, dan keterangan "dikatakan di Provinsi Kawachi" menjadikannya gambaran legenda Kawachi.
statement.en: In the Gazu Hyakki Yagyō it is depicted with an old woman's face within the flames, and the statement "it's said to be in Kawachi Province" makes it a depiction of a Kawachi legend.

wani-dragon.depicted_variant: Wani bentuk buaya laut delapan fathom c06/c17, tidak mencampur interpretasi shark atau naga Tiongkok.

visual_requirements.description: ONE enormous eight-fathom CROCODILE-like sea monster: one crocodilian head, two eyes, exactly four robust reptile legs, one long muscular tail, broad armor-covered body. No horns, wings, fins, fish tail, human torso or extra heads
No undocumented magical powers; its huge eight-fathom body physically churns sea surf while crawling and writhing as described
The sea meeting land in the Wani narrative; dark rocky coast and rolling surf, no river swamp or palace ornaments

wani-dragon.aura: No undocumented magical powers; its huge eight-fathom body physically churns sea surf while crawling and writhing as described [wani-dragon-c06, wani-dragon-c17]

basis_claims.quote: Wani (鰐) was a dragon or sea monster in Japanese mythology.

statement.id: Wani adalah monster laut atau naga dalam mitologi Jepang.
statement.en: Wani is a sea monster or dragon in Japanese mythology.

basis_claims.quote: Since it is written using the kanji 鰐 (from Chinese e 鰐 or 鱷 "crocodile; alligator") wani is translated as "crocodile", or sometimes "shark" (from wanizame 鰐鮫 "shark").

statement.id: Terjemahan memakai buaya atau hiu.
statement.en: Translations variously use crocodile or shark.

basis_claims.quote: Second, wani is a fundamental theme in the myth of the demigod brothers Hoori and Hoderi. The sea god Watatsumi or Ryūjin "summoned together all the crocodiles" and chose one to escort his pregnant daughter Toyotama-hime and her husband Hoori from the Ryūgū-jō palace back to land.

statement.id: Wani adalah tema pokok dalam mitos saudara-saudara setengah dewa Hoori dan Hoderi: dewa laut Watatsumi atau Ryūjin mengumpulkan semua wani, lalu memilih satu untuk mengantar putrinya Toyotama-hime yang sedang hamil dan suaminya Hoori dari istana kembali ke daratan.
statement.en: Wani is a fundamental theme in the myth of the demigod brothers Hoori and Hoderi: the sea god Watatsumi or Ryūjin summons all the wani and chooses one to escort his pregnant daughter Toyotama-hime and her husband Hoori from the palace back to land.

basis_claims.quote: the beautiful Toyatama-hime made a bizarre request concerning her shapeshifting into a wani ... when she turned into a crocodile eight fathoms [long], and crawled and writhed about

statement.id: Putri dewa laut meminta agar ia dapat berubah menjadi wani, dan pada saat melahirkan ia berubah menjadi "buaya" sepanjang delapan depa yang merayap dan menggeliat.
statement.en: The sea god's daughter makes a request concerning her shapeshifting into a wani, and at the moment of delivery she turns into a "crocodile" eight fathoms long that crawls and writhes about.

basis_claims.quote: Chamberlain justified translating "crocodile" in a footnote. ... the accounts point rather to an amphibious creature, conceived of as being somewhat similar to the serpent, than to a fish

statement.id: Chamberlain membenarkan terjemahan "buaya" dalam catatan kaki dan menilai bahwa keterangan lama menunjuk pada makhluk amfibi yang agak mirip ular, bukan ikan.
statement.en: Chamberlain justified translating wani as "crocodile" in a footnote, judging that the accounts point to an amphibious creature somewhat similar to the serpent rather than to a fish.

basis_claims.quote: William George Aston justified not translating wani as "crocodile". ... The wani, too, inhabits the sea and not rivers, and is plainly a mythical creature.

statement.id: Aston berpendapat bahwa wani tinggal di laut dan bukan di sungai, dan jelas merupakan makhluk mitos; karena itu ia tidak menerjemahkannya sebagai "buaya".
statement.en: Aston, who argued against translating wani as "crocodile", held that the wani inhabits the sea and not rivers and is plainly a mythical creature.

basis_claims.quote: At this time Toyo-tama-hime had become changed into an enormous sea-monster of eight fathoms, and was wriggling about on her belly.

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Nihongi ini, Toyo-tama-hime berubah menjadi "monster laut" raksasa sepanjang delapan depa yang menggeliat di atas perutnya.
statement.en: In this Nihongi translation, Toyo-tama-hime changes into an enormous "sea-monster" of eight fathoms that wriggles about on her belly.

wd-q10566254.depicted_variant: Feitouman varian Lingnan berkepala terbang dengan sayap dan cincin merah leher, bukan varian Java tanpa pupil.

visual_requirements.description: ONE detached adult human head, two natural eyes with pupils, one mouth, winglike ears/head wings as one small symmetrical pair. A thin red ringlike mark circles the closed smooth neck base; no exposed wound, no blood, no organs, no torso or hands or extra head. Do not use the separate pupil-less Java variant
Documented head detachment and night flight; physical head-wings beat and stir small mud droplets as it searches for crabs and worms, no generic aura
A dark muddy riverbank in the valleys of Lingnan at night, small crabs and wet reeds as close environmental detail

wd-q10566254.aura: Documented head detachment and night flight; physical head-wings beat and stir small mud droplets as it searches for crabs and worms, no generic aura [wd-q10566254-c01, wd-q10566254-c05, wd-q10566254-c06]

basis_claims.quote: 飛頭蛮（ひとうばん）は、中国の妖怪。古典の記述によれば、通常は人間の姿と変わりないが、夜になると首（頭部）だけが胴体から離れて空中を飛び回るものとされる。

statement.id: Feitouman adalah sosok gaib Tiongkok yang kepalanya lepas dan terbang pada malam hari.
statement.en: Feitouman is a Chinese supernatural figure whose head detaches and flies at night.

basis_claims.quote: 唐代の書『南方異物誌』によれば、嶺南（中国南部からベトナムにかけての地方）の洞穴の中にいる飛頭蛮は、首に赤い傷跡があることが特徴で、夜には耳を翼のように使って飛び回り、虫を食べ、夜が明けると元の体に戻ってくるという。

statement.id: Kisah selatan memberi mereka tanda merah di leher, telinga mirip sayap, dan kepulangan pada fajar.
statement.en: A southern account gives them red neck marks, winglike ears and a dawn return.

basis_claims.quote: 嶺南溪洞中往往有飛頭者，故有飛頭獠子之號。頭將飛一日前，頸有痕匝，項如紅縷，妻子遂看守之。
basis_claims.locator: 酉陽雜俎 卷四 境異

statement.id: Youyang Zazu (酉陽雜俎) mencatat bahwa di lembah-lembah Lingnan (嶺南) sering ada orang yang kepalanya terbang, sehingga muncul sebutan feitou liaozi (飛頭獠子); sehari sebelum kepalanya terbang, lehernya berbekas melingkar seperti benang merah, dan istri serta anaknya lalu menjaganya.
statement.en: The Youyang Zazu (酉陽雜俎) records that in the valleys of Lingnan (嶺南) there are often people whose heads fly, hence the name feitou liaozi (飛頭獠子); a day before the head flies, a ring-like mark like a red thread appears on the neck, and the wife and children then keep watch.

basis_claims.quote: 其人及夜狀如病，頭忽生翼，脫身而去，乃於岸泥尋蟹蚓之類食，將曉飛還，如夢覺，其腹實矣。
basis_claims.locator: 酉陽雜俎 卷四 境異

statement.id: Pada malam hari orang itu tampak seperti sakit, kepalanya tiba-tiba bersayap dan lepas dari tubuh, mencari kepiting dan cacing di lumpur tepi sungai untuk dimakan, lalu terbang kembali menjelang fajar; ia bangun seperti dari mimpi dengan perut kenyang.
statement.en: At night the person looks ill, the head suddenly sprouts wings and leaves the body to look for crabs and worms in the riverbank mud, then flies back near dawn; the person wakes as if from a dream with a full stomach.

wd-q89656688.depicted_variant: Renmianyu varian tradisional ikan besar berwajah manusia yang tertawa, bukan grilled tilapia urban1995.

visual_requirements.description: ONE large living fish body with exactly ONE adult HUMAN FACE seamlessly forming the front of the fish head: two human eyes, one human nose and one laughing human mouth, scaled cheeks merging into the fish body. Two pectoral fins, one dorsal fin and one caudal tail, normal fish fins only; no human torso, hands, legs or extra faces
No documented magical effects in the selected traditional human-face variant; its impossible human face visibly laughs c02, physical swimming throws water and bubbles
Dark freshwater in Taiwanese folklore, location intentionally unspecified, water surface and plain bank rocks behind; not grilled or served on a plate

wd-q89656688.aura: No documented magical effects in the selected traditional human-face variant; its impossible human face visibly laughs c02, physical swimming throws water and bubbles [wd-q89656688-c02]

basis_claims.quote: 人面魚，是台湾民間傳說和都市传说中的妖怪，兩種同名但外貌相異，也都和日本的人面魚不同。

statement.id: 人面魚 adalah nama dua varian makhluk ikan berwajah manusia dalam cerita dan legenda urban Taiwan.
statement.en: 人面魚 names two fish-being variants in Taiwanese folklore and urban legends.

basis_claims.quote: 人面魚是人臉魚身的水棲妖怪，又名「淵魚」、「海童」，身軀為大魚，但卻擁有人面雙眼口鼻的臉龐，型態詭異萬分。若人面魚浮立於水面，只要見到人，就會開口呵呵嘻笑，甚至以魚鰭做合掌的模樣。

statement.id: Varian tradisional memiliki tubuh ikan besar dengan wajah manusia dan tertawa saat melihat orang.
statement.en: The traditional variant has a large fish body with a human face and laughs on seeing people.

wind-horse.depicted_variant: Wind Horse sebagai kuda hidup terbang lambang soul/well-being, tanpa banner, permata atau sayap yang tidak didokumentasikan.

visual_requirements.description: ONE living natural horse, one equine head, two eyes, exactly four strong horse legs ending in ordinary single hooves, one flowing mane and one tail. A wingless horse flying through the air; no invented feather wings, jewel on back, saddle, rider, banner or flag, no extra legs
The documented flying-horse form moves actively through the sky; real wind drives mane and tail and parts clouds, no generic divine glow, beams or ribbons
High open air in East and Central Asian tradition, dark indistinct cloud masses and a far shadowed high horizon; no flags or written symbols

wind-horse.aura: The documented flying-horse form moves actively through the sky; real wind drives mane and tail and parts clouds, no generic divine glow, beams or ribbons [wind-horse-c01, wind-horse-c09]

basis_claims.quote: The wind horse is a flying horse that is the symbol of the human soul in the shamanistic tradition of East Asia and Central Asia. In Tibetan Buddhism, it was included as the pivotal element in the center of the four animals symbolizing the cardinal directions and a symbol of the idea of well-being or good fortune.

statement.id: Wind Horse adalah gambaran kuda terbang yang melambangkan jiwa dalam tradisi Asia Timur dan Tengah.
statement.en: Wind Horse is a flying-horse image symbolizing the soul in East and Central Asian traditions.

basis_claims.quote: The wind horse is a flying horse that is the symbol of the human soul in the shamanistic tradition of East Asia and Central Asia. In Tibetan Buddhism, it was included as the pivotal element in the center of the four animals symbolizing the cardinal directions and a symbol of the idea of well-being or good fortune.

statement.id: Dalam Buddhisme Tibet, kuda ini juga menjadi lambang kesejahteraan dan keberuntungan.
statement.en: In Tibetan Buddhism, the horse also symbolizes well-being and good fortune.

basis_claims.quote: Windhorse has several meanings in the Tibetan context. As Karmay notes, "the word [windhorse] is still and often mistakenly taken to mean only the actual flag planted on the roof of a house or on a high place near a village. In fact, it is a symbol of the idea of well-being or good fortune.

statement.id: Istilah Wind Horse mengacu pada keberuntungan, selain bendera yang dipasang di tempat tinggi.
statement.en: The term Wind Horse denotes good fortune beyond the flags placed in high locations.

basis_claims.quote: A person’s lungta is a register of their relative synchronization with their own body and mind, and the world around them. So in this regard, lungta also has a protective function when successfully invoked.

statement.id: Warren menulis bahwa lungta seseorang mencerminkan keselarasannya dengan tubuh, pikiran, dan dunia di sekitarnya, sehingga lungta juga memiliki fungsi pelindung bila berhasil diundang.
statement.en: Warren writes that a person's lungta registers their relative synchronization with their own body and mind and the world around them, so lungta also has a protective function when successfully invoked.

zhulong-mythology.depicted_variant: Zhuyin dari Shanhaijing: wajah manusia, tubuh ular merah seribu li, berdiam di kaki Gunung Zhong; mata membuka siang dan napas menjadi angin.

visual_requirements.description: Satu wajah manusia dan tubuh ular merah tanpa anggota tubuh; skala seribu li.
Mata terbuka membawa siang, hembusan napas menggerakkan angin di lereng.
Kaki Gunung Zhong, tubuh memanjang menutup jajaran pegunungan.

zhulong-mythology.aura: Keagungan datang dari tubuh seribu li dan siang serta angin yang bergerak bersama tatapan dan napas Zhuyin (zhulong-mythology-c07, zhulong-mythology-c08).

basis_claims.quote: 鍾山之神名曰燭陰，視為晝，瞑為夜，吹為冬，呼為夏，不飲，不食，不息，息為風，身長千里。

statement.id: Teks Shanhaijing menyebut dewa Gunung Zhong (鍾山) bernama Zhuyin (燭陰): ketika ia melihat jadilah siang, ketika memejam jadilah malam, tiupannya menjadi musim dingin dan embusannya musim panas; ia tidak minum, makan, atau bernapas (beristirahat), napasnya menjadi angin, dan panjang tubuhnya seribu li.
statement.en: The Shanhaijing text names the god of Mount Zhong (鍾山) as Zhuyin (燭陰): when he looks it is day, when he closes his eyes it is night, his blowing makes winter and his exhaling makes summer; he does not drink, eat or breathe (rest), his breath becomes wind, and his body is a thousand li long.

basis_claims.quote: 鍾山之神名曰燭陰 ... 其為物，人面，蛇身，赤色，居鍾山下。

statement.id: Teks yang sama menggambarkan dewa Gunung Zhong bernama Zhuyin (燭陰) itu berwajah manusia, bertubuh ular, berwarna merah, dan tinggal di kaki Gunung Zhong.
statement.en: The same text describes the god of Mount Zhong named Zhuyin (燭陰) as having a human face and a snake body, red in colour, and dwelling at the foot of Mount Zhong.

aigamuxa.depicted_variant: Aigamuxa kurus besar menyerupai kera, dengan gigi sepanjang jari dan mata di punggung kaki, berdiri terbalik untuk melihat pemburuannya.

visual_requirements.description: Satu kepala kera kurus, gigi panjang; tanpa mata pada wajah, mata hanya di punggung dua kaki.
Berdiri di kepala/tangan untuk melihat, mengintai pelintas malam; ancaman anatomi tanpa efek magis tambahan.
Pasir dan bukit pasir gurun tempat mengintai.

aigamuxa.aura: Ancaman dari mata kaki yang melihat saat tubuh terbalik serta gigi sepanjang jari untuk memburu manusia (aigamuxa-c04, aigamuxa-c13, aigamuxa-c14, aigamuxa-c03).

basis_claims.quote: The bushmen are said to target lone desert travelers at night.

statement.id: Makhluk ini konon mengincar pengembara gurun yang sendirian pada malam hari (desert travelers at night).
statement.en: They are said to target lone desert travellers at night.

basis_claims.quote: The monster is said to have eyes on its feet, meaning that it cannot see the humans it preys upon as it hunts. In order to see, it must stand on its hands or head, or lie in the sand.

statement.id: Monster ini konon bermata di kakinya (eyes on its feet) sehingga tidak dapat melihat mangsanya saat berburu; untuk melihat ia harus bertumpu pada tangan atau kepala, atau berbaring di pasir.
statement.en: The monster is said to have eyes on its feet, so it cannot see its prey while hunting; to see, it must stand on its hands or head, or lie in the sand.

basis_claims.quote: в готтентотской мифологии, чудовище-людоед, выглядящее как большая, худая обезьяна с длинными клыками

statement.id: Dalam artikel ketiga ia digambarkan sebagai monster pemakan manusia (людоед) yang tampak seperti kera (обезьяна) besar dan kurus bertaring panjang.
statement.en: The third article describes it as a man-eating monster (людоед) that looks like a big, thin ape (обезьяна) with long fangs.

basis_claims.quote: Согласно легендам, айгамукса прячется за песчаными дюнами и подстерегает беспечных и неосторожных путешественников.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, aigamuxa (айгамукса) bersembunyi di balik bukit pasir dan menyergap pengembara yang lengah.
statement.en: According to legend, the aigamuxa (айгамукса) hides behind sand dunes and lies in wait for careless travellers.

basis_claims.quote: weil es seine Augen (mütti) nicht im Gesicht, sondern auf dem Rücken (fgäfb) der Füße (i=aiti) hat.
basis_claims.locator: a) Abenteuer in der Wildnis, S. 392

statement.id: Namanya berasal dari letak matanya (Augen), yang bukan di wajah melainkan di punggung kaki (Rücken der Füße).
statement.en: Its name comes from where its eyes (Augen) are: not in its face but on the top of its feet (Rücken der Füße).

basis_claims.quote: Diese Fabelwesen leben gesellig beisammen und machen auf Menschen, die sie für Zebras halten, Jagd, um sie mit ihren fingerlangen, spitzen,

statement.id: Makhluk-makhluk ini hidup berkelompok dan memburu manusia (Menschen) yang mereka kira zebra, untuk dicabik dengan gigi sepanjang jari (fingerlangen).
statement.en: These creatures live together in groups and hunt people (Menschen), whom they take for zebras, to tear them with finger-long (fingerlangen) teeth.

alan-legendary-creature.depicted_variant: Alan ukuran manusia: roh perempuan tua bersayap, wajah berkerut keras, lengan panjang dan jari tangan/kaki mengarah ke belakang.

visual_requirements.description: Ukuran manusia, bersayap, jari mengarah ke belakang dari pergelangan dan jari kaki di belakang kaki; perempuan tua berwajah berkerut keras dan lengan panjang.
Terbang turun dari pohon; keagungan roh ibu asuh tanpa pemangsaan.
Hutan gelap, mata air dan rumah emas di latar jauh.

alan-legendary-creature.aura: Keagungan roh ibu asuh berasal dari turunnya tubuh bersayap dengan jari berbalik dan wajah keras, bukan sifat kanibal aran (alan-legendary-creature-c03, alan-legendary-creature-c22, alan-legendary-creature-c04).

basis_claims.quote: The alan, just mentioned, are to-day considered as deformed spirits who live in the forests: “They are as large as people but have wings and can fly; their toes are at the back of their feet and their fingers point backwards from their wrists.”

statement.id: Menurut koleksi ini, alan kini dianggap roh bercacat yang tinggal di hutan: sebesar manusia, bersayap dan dapat terbang, dengan jari kaki di belakang telapak dan jari tangan menghadap ke belakang dari pergelangan.
statement.en: According to this collection the alan are today considered deformed spirits who live in the forests: as large as people, with wings and able to fly, with toes at the back of their feet and fingers pointing backwards from their wrists.

basis_claims.quote: These spirits appear time after time as the foster mothers of the leading characters: Generally they secure a drop of menstrual blood, a miscarriage, or the afterbirth, and all unknown to the real parents, change them into children and raise them

statement.id: Roh-roh ini berulang kali muncul sebagai ibu asuh tokoh-tokoh utama kisah: umumnya mereka mengambil setetes darah haid, keguguran, atau ari-ari, lalu tanpa sepengetahuan orang tua sebenarnya mengubahnya menjadi anak dan membesarkannya.
statement.en: These spirits appear time after time as the foster mothers of the leading characters: generally they secure a drop of menstrual blood, a miscarriage or the afterbirth and, unknown to the real parents, change them into children and raise them.
