basis_claims.quote: These foster children are pictured as living in houses of gold situated near springs, the pebbles of which are of gold or beads

statement.id: Anak-anak asuh itu digambarkan tinggal di rumah emas di dekat mata air yang kerikilnya terbuat dari emas atau manik-manik.
statement.en: These foster children are pictured as living in houses of gold situated near springs whose pebbles are of gold or beads.

basis_claims.quote: In the depths of a dark forest where people seldom went, lived a wizened old Alan.

statement.id: Dalam satu kisah, seorang alan tua yang keriput tinggal di kedalaman hutan gelap yang jarang dikunjungi orang.
statement.en: In one tale a wizened old alan lived in the depths of a dark forest where people seldom went.

basis_claims.quote: The skin on her wrinkled face was as tough as a carabao hide, and her long arms with fingers pointing back from the wrist were horrible to look at. Now this frightful creature had a son whose name was Sayen, and he was as handsome as his mother was ugly.

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu, kulit wajah alan yang keriput sekeras kulit kerbau, lengannya panjang dengan jari menghadap ke belakang dari pergelangan, dan ia memiliki putra bernama Sayen yang setampan ibunya seburuk rupa.
statement.en: In the tale the alan's wrinkled face had skin as tough as carabao hide, her long arms had fingers pointing back from the wrist, and she had a son named Sayen who was as handsome as she was ugly.

amarok.depicted_variant: Amarok sebagai serigala raksasa tunggal yang memburu pelintas/pemburu malam.

visual_requirements.description: Satu serigala raksasa, bukan kawanan; anatomi serigala normal.
Mengintai lalu menerjang pemburu yang sendirian pada malam hari.
Lingkungan Arktik malam, satu pemburu sebagai pembanding kecil.

amarok.aura: Bahaya dari skala serigala raksasa dan perburuan tunggal malam (amarok-c01, amarok-c09), tanpa kekuatan Waheela yang tidak dijadikan basis.

basis_claims.quote: An Amarok, or Amaroq, is a gigantic wolf in Inuit religion, said to stalk and devour any person foolish enough to hunt alone at night. Unlike wolves who hunt in packs, amaroks hunt alone.

statement.id: Amarok atau Amaroq adalah serigala raksasa dalam agama Inuit yang dikatakan menguntit dan melahap siapa pun yang cukup bodoh berburu sendirian pada malam hari; tidak seperti serigala yang berburu dalam kawanan, amarok berburu sendiri.
statement.en: An Amarok, or Amaroq, is a gigantic wolf in Inuit religion, said to stalk and devour any person foolish enough to hunt alone at night; unlike wolves who hunt in packs, amaroks hunt alone.

basis_claims.quote: Amarok targets human hunters or wolf packs who are either alone or careless enough to come out at night.
basis_claims.locator: Tales and Traditions of the Eskimo

statement.id: Amarok menyasar pemburu manusia atau kawanan serigala yang sendirian atau cukup ceroboh keluar pada malam hari.
statement.en: Amarok targets human hunters or wolf packs who are either alone or careless enough to come out at night.

andrealphus.depicted_variant: Andrealphus pada kemunculan awal sebagai merak yang membuat suara keras, menurut Goetia.

visual_requirements.description: Wujud merak pada kemunculan awal, anatomi burung tanpa atribut humanoid.
Mulut terbuka mengeluarkan suara keras saat muncul; tanpa lingkaran suara atau glyph geometri.

andrealphus.aura: Ancaman marquis iblis datang dari merak yang muncul dengan suara keras dan konfrontasi jarak dekat (andrealphus-c09, andrealphus-c12).

basis_claims.quote: The 65 spirit is called Andrealphus,75 he is a Mighty great Marquiz appearing at first in ye forme of [a] Peacock, with great Noises but afterward he putteth on humane shape

statement.id: Dalam Goetia, roh ke-65 itu disebut Andrealphus, markis agung yang mula-mula tampil sebagai merak disertai bunyi gaduh, tetapi kemudian mengenakan wujud manusia.
statement.en: In the Goetia the 65th spirit is called Andrealphus, a mighty great marquis who appears at first as a peacock with great noises but afterward puts on human shape.

basis_claims.quote: Andrealphus [*Androalphus] is a great marquesse, appearing as a pecocke, he raiseth great [*bass, heavy] noises, and in humane shape perfectlie teacheth geometrie

statement.id: Dalam Pseudomonarchia Daemonum (terjemahan Scot), Andrealphus adalah markis agung yang tampil sebagai merak, menimbulkan bunyi berat, dan dalam wujud manusia mengajarkan geometri dengan sempurna.
statement.en: In the Pseudomonarchia Daemonum (Scot's translation) Andrealphus is a great marquis who appears as a peacock, raises great heavy noises, and in human shape perfectly teaches geometry.

azumi-no-isora.depicted_variant: Azumi-no-Isora dalam Taiheiki: messenger dari dasar laut, tubuh terselubung kerang, clam dan serangga rumput laut, membawa dua permata pasang-surut.

visual_requirements.description: Sosok encrusted kerang, clam dan serangga rumput laut sehingga tidak seperti manusia.
Muncul dari tempat laut menuju pertemuan dewa dan membawa dua permata yang diterima dari dragon palace.
Tepi laut sebagai transisi visual dari dasar laut menuju playing ground dewa.

azumi-no-isora.aura: Keagungan messenger Shinto datang dari kemunculan tubuh berkerang dari laut dan dua permata pasang-surut (azumi-no-isora-c13, azumi-no-isora-c14, azumi-no-isora-c15), tanpa mengarang kendali gelombang.

basis_claims.quote: 皇后諸の天神地祇を請じ給ふに、日本一万の大小の神祇冥道、皆勅請に随て常陸の鹿島に来給ふ。雖然、海底に迹を垂給阿度部の磯良一人不応召。

statement.id: Menurut Taiheiki, Permaisuri Jingū memanggil para dewa langit dan bumi ke Kashima di Hitachi; semuanya datang, kecuali Atobe no Isora yang menampakkan diri di dasar laut.
statement.en: According to the Taiheiki, Empress Jingū summoned the gods of heaven and earth to Kashima in Hitachi; all came except Atobe no Isora, who had manifested himself on the sea floor.

basis_claims.quote: 磯良感に堪兼て、神遊の庭にぞ参たる。其貌を御覧ずるに、細螺・石花貝・藻に棲虫、手足五体に取付て、更に人の形にては無りけり。

statement.id: Taiheiki mencatat bahwa setelah para dewa menyanyi, Isora tak tahan lagi dan datang ke tempat pesta dewa; tubuhnya ditempeli kerang, kerang laut, dan serangga rumput laut sehingga sama sekali tidak tampak seperti manusia.
statement.en: The Taiheiki records that, after the gods sang, Isora could not hold back and came to the gods' playing ground; shellfish, clams and seaweed-dwelling insects clung to his body so that he did not look like a human at all.

basis_claims.quote: 軈て是を御使にて、竜宮城に宝とする干珠・満珠を被借召。竜神即応神勅二の玉を奉る。

statement.id: Isora kemudian dijadikan utusan untuk meminjam permata surut dan pasang (kanju dan manju) yang menjadi harta istana naga; dewa naga segera menyerahkan kedua permata itu.
statement.en: Isora was then made the messenger to borrow the ebb and flood jewels (kanju and manju) treasured in the dragon palace, and the dragon god promptly presented the two jewels.

bajang.depicted_variant: Bajang sebagai pole-cat familiar yang muncul dari tabung bambu dan menerjang karena diabaikan tuannya.

visual_requirements.description: Wujud pole-cat sesuai Skeat, bukan cricket/lizard atau hantu humanoid gabungan.
Mengganggu rumah dan menyerang tuan jika kelaparan/diabaikan; aksi menerjang, tanpa aura atau possession beam.
Interior rumah dengan tabung bambu sebagai tempat menyimpan familiar.

bajang.aura: Ancaman familiar datang dari pole-cat yang mengganggu rumah dan dapat menyerang tuannya jika diabaikan (bajang-c04, bajang-c09, bajang-c07).

basis_claims.quote: Bajang akan dikawal oleh pemiliknya dan akan disimpan di dalam tabung buluh. Sejenis daun khusus akan digunakan sebagai penyumbat tabungan tersebut dan dikunci dengan tangkal.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Melayu, bajang dikawal pemiliknya dan disimpan dalam tabung buluh yang disumbat daun khusus dan dikunci dengan tangkal.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, the bajang is controlled by its owner and kept in a bamboo tube stoppered with a special leaf and locked with a charm.

basis_claims.quote: These are four in number: the Bajang, which generally takes the form of a pole-cat (musang) and disturbs the household by mewing like a great cat; the Langsuir, which takes the form of an owl with long claws

statement.id: Walter William Skeat dalam Malay Magic (1900) mencatat empat roh kelahiran; salah satunya bajang, yang biasanya berwujud musang dan mengganggu rumah tangga dengan mengeong seperti kucing besar.
statement.en: Walter William Skeat in Malay Magic (1900) lists four birth-spirits; one is the bajang, usually a pole-cat that disturbs the household by mewing like a great cat.

basis_claims.quote: In all parts of the Peninsula the Bajang is said to be of the male gender, while the Langsuir is supposed to be a female. It is usually believed by Malays that the Bajang is merely a malignant spirit which haunts mankind, and whose presence foretells disaster.

statement.id: Di seluruh Semenanjung Malaya bajang dianggap laki-laki dan langsuir perempuan; orang Melayu umumnya percaya bajang roh jahat yang menghantui manusia dan kehadirannya pertanda malapetaka.
statement.en: Across the Malay Peninsula the bajang is male and the langsuir female; Malays generally believe the bajang is a malignant spirit haunting people, its presence foretelling disaster.

basis_claims.quote: Bajang yang dipelihara itu akan diberi makan telur dan juga susu. Sekiranya tidak dijaga dengan baik dan diberi makan, Bajang yang kelaparan itu akan menyerang tuannya.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Melayu, bajang yang dipelihara diberi makan telur dan susu; bila tidak dijaga dan diberi makan, bajang yang kelaparan akan menyerang tuannya.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, the kept bajang is fed eggs and milk; if not looked after and fed, the hungry bajang attacks its master.

black-dragon.depicted_variant: Naga timur bersisik hitam dengan tepat dua kaki depan sebagai penjaga utara yang diasosiasikan dengan air.

visual_requirements.description: Naga timur bersisik hitam dengan dua forelegs; tidak otomatis empat kaki.
Kemunculan aktif di air dan sikap penjagaan utara, tidak mengarang fire-breath atau water-control.
Air dan orientasi alam utara dari asosiasi five-phase.

black-dragon.aura: Keagungan penjaga utara hadir melalui naga bersisik hitam, dua forelegs yang maju dan kemunculan air (black-dragon-c04, black-dragon-c02, black-dragon-c03).

basis_claims.quote: 五行思想においては、黒は北と同じく水に対応するので、黒竜を玄武と同様、「北方を守護する神聖な竜」としている。

statement.id: Dalam pemikiran lima unsur ia dikaitkan dengan air dan utara.
statement.en: In five-phase thought it is associated with water and the north.

basis_claims.quote: 五行思想においては、黒は北と同じく水に対応するので、黒竜を玄武と同様、「北方を守護する神聖な竜」としている。

statement.id: Ia ditafsirkan sebagai penjaga suci utara.
statement.en: It is interpreted as a sacred guardian of the north.

basis_claims.quote: 名前通り全身の鱗が黒く、前足が2本しかない東洋の竜として描かれる事が多い。驪竜（りりょう）とも呼ばれ、これは顎の下に貴重な珠を持っているともされる 。

statement.id: Gambarnya sering memberi naga timur sisik hitam dan dua kaki depan.
statement.en: Its depictions often give an eastern dragon black scales and two forelegs.

cabraboc.depicted_variant: Cabraboc varian hutan bersayap kelelawar: bagian atas manusia berpakaian dan bagian bawah kambing, mengejar pelintas malam di tebing.

visual_requirements.description: Setengah manusia di atas, kambing di bawah; varian dua sayap kelelawar.
Mengejar pelintas malam hingga dekat tebing; langkah aktif menuju penonton tanpa korban jatuh terlihat.
Hutan pada malam hari dengan tepi tebing.

cabraboc.aura: Bahaya berasal dari sosok campuran manusia/kambing bersayap yang memburu pelintas hutan malam ke tebing (cabraboc-c01, cabraboc-c02, cabraboc-c03).

basis_claims.quote: Un cabraboc és un ésser fantàstic propi de l'imaginari popular català, mig humà per la part de dalt i mig cabra o boc per la part de baix.

statement.id: Cabraboc adalah makhluk khayalan imajinasi rakyat Katalan, setengah manusia di bagian atas dan setengah kambing di bagian bawah.
statement.en: A cabraboc is a fantastic being of Catalan folk imagination, half human above and half goat below.

basis_claims.quote: Es diu que els cabrabocs persegueixen els homes com si fossin cabres i les dones com si fossin bocs. Són éssers del bosc i cal evitar-los quan es viatja de nit

statement.id: Para cabraboc konon mengejar lelaki seperti kambing betina dan perempuan seperti kambing jantan; mereka makhluk hutan yang harus dihindari saat bepergian malam.
statement.en: Cabrabocs are said to chase men as if they were nanny goats and women as if they were billy goats; they are forest beings to be avoided when travelling at night.

basis_claims.quote: sovint, les persecucions acaben fent estimbar la víctima per un penya-segat. Algunes vegades, se'ls descrivia amb ales de ratapinyada.

statement.id: Pengejaran itu sering berakhir dengan korban terjatuh dari tebing, dan kadang mereka digambarkan bersayap kelelawar.
statement.en: The chases often end with the victim falling off a cliff, and they were sometimes described with bat wings.

camahueto.depicted_variant: Camahueto Chiloé Mitológico sebagai anak sapi hijau dengan satu tanduk kecil, muncul dari bumi di bukit dekat laut.

visual_requirements.description: Anak sapi hijau dengan hanya satu tanduk kecil di dahi, bukan banteng dewasa atau tanduk lateral.
Lahir dari kedalaman tanah bukit; longsor ditampilkan sebagai visualisasi tafsir penulis dan konteks destruktif darat.
Bukit tepi laut Chiloé, menuju laut yang menjadi tempatnya.

camahueto.aura: Kekuatan destruktif datang dari kemunculan anak sapi hijau bertanduk tunggal dari bukit laut serta longsor dalam tafsir sumber (camahueto-c07, camahueto-c08, camahueto-c12, camahueto-c15), tanpa membesarkan calf atau mengarang kuasa waktu.

basis_claims.quote: tiene el aspecto de un ternero, de color verde, con un solo cuerno pequeño en la frente; a semejanza de su congénere griego el Unicornio.

statement.id: Menurut Chiloé Mitológico, Camahueto berwujud anak sapi berwarna hijau dengan satu tanduk kecil di dahi, mirip unicorn Yunani.
statement.en: According to Chiloé Mitológico, the Camahueto looks like a green calf with a single small horn on its forehead, like its Greek counterpart the Unicorn.

basis_claims.quote: Nace desde las profundidades de la tierra, en lo alto de un cerro vecino al mar.

statement.id: Camahueto lahir dari kedalaman bumi, di puncak sebuah bukit dekat laut.
statement.en: The Camahueto is born from the depths of the earth, on top of a hill near the sea.

basis_claims.quote: se recurrió a este animal imaginario, para explicar los frecuentes y aparentemente espontáneos derrumbes de tierra, que ocasionan las aguas que se van acumulando bajo tierra

statement.id: Menurut penafsiran penulis situs ini, hewan imajiner ini dipakai untuk menjelaskan longsor tanah yang sering terjadi dan tampak spontan, akibat air yang menumpuk di bawah tanah.
statement.en: In the site author's interpretation, this imaginary animal was used to explain the frequent, apparently spontaneous landslides caused by water accumulating underground.

basis_claims.quote: De la vida acuática el camahueto, se sabe muy poco y por tal motivo lo incluimos entre los mitos terrestres; se dice que regresa al mar, porque a él pertenece y allí realizará su verdadera existencia.

statement.id: Kehidupan akuatik Camahueto hampir tidak diketahui sehingga ia digolongkan sebagai mitos darat; konon ia kembali ke laut karena laut adalah miliknya dan di sanalah ia menjalani keberadaan sejatinya.
statement.en: Little is known of the Camahueto's aquatic life, so it is classed among the land myths; it is said to return to the sea because it belongs there and will live its true existence there.

basis_claims.quote: Y que su estadía en la tierra, sólo representa una forma de venganza, que dejó en su retirada, el espíritu de las aguas, Coicoi-vilu, para continuar su obra destructora en la tierra.

statement.id: Menurut sumber ini, keberadaannya di darat hanyalah bentuk pembalasan yang ditinggalkan roh air Coicoi-vilu saat mundur, untuk melanjutkan karya perusaknya di darat.
statement.en: According to this source, its stay on land is only a form of revenge left behind by the water spirit Coicoi-vilu on his retreat, to continue his destructive work on land.

visual_requirements.description: One large black dog: one canine head, two natural eyes, four legs, one tail; no horns or wings
A forceful stream of real fire emerges directly from the open canine mouth, scorching ground immediately ahead; no bodily glow
Southern wilderness near Black Kunlun, only dark earthen ground and distant slopes

huodou.aura: A forceful stream of real fire emerges directly from the open canine mouth, scorching ground immediately ahead; no bodily glow [huodou-c02, huodou-c09]

basis_claims.quote: It is described as having the appearance of a large black dog that can emit flames from its mouth. Fire would break out wherever the Huodou went, so the ancients saw it as a sign of fire and often an ominous symbol. It is probably a demonized tribal symbol of southern China.

statement.id: Penggambarannya berupa anjing hitam besar yang mengeluarkan api dari mulut.
statement.en: Its portrayal is a large black dog emitting fire from its mouth.

basis_claims.quote: 南荒有厭火之民（國近黑昆侖，人能食火炭）、食火之獸（《原化記》云︰禍斗獸，狀如犬而食火
basis_claims.locator: Bencao Gangmu (本草綱目), bagian Api, komentar Li Shizhen pada 陽火、陰火

statement.id: Li Shizhen menyebut adanya bangsa pemakan api di Nanhuang (南荒, wilayah liar selatan) yang negerinya dekat Heikunlun (黑昆侖) dan orang-orangnya dapat memakan bara, serta binatang pemakan api.
statement.en: Li Shizhen mentions a fire-eating people in the southern wilderness (南荒), whose country is near Black Kunlun (黑昆侖) and who can eat fire-charcoal, and also a fire-eating beast.

basis_claims.quote: 禍斗似犬而食犬糞，噴火作殃，不祥甚矣〈一本云「不祥之獸」〉。
basis_claims.locator: Chiya (赤雅) edisi cetak Daoguang, juan 3, entri 禍斗

statement.id: Chiya (赤雅) edisi ini menulis bahwa Huodou (禍斗) mirip anjing dan memakan kotoran anjing, menyemburkan api dan mendatangkan malapetaka, sangat tidak membawa keberuntungan; edisi lain berbunyi 不祥之獸 (binatang pembawa sial).
statement.en: This edition of the Chiya (赤雅) says the Huodou (禍斗) resembles a dog and eats dog dung, spits fire and brings disaster, and is greatly ill-omened; another edition reads 不祥之獸 (an ill-omened beast).

kapre.depicted_variant: the benign but unsettling giant tree-dweller of Philippine folklore

visual_requirements.description: One gigantic dark humanlike muscular tree being with thick body hair, one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs; large glowing-red eyes, a large cigar, fully opaque bahag wrapped securely around hips; no caricature of living Indigenous people
Thick physical tobacco smoke billows from the cigar and curls around the inhabited branches, with falling cigar embers
Night in the canopy of a large Philippine balete tree

kapre.aura: Thick physical tobacco smoke billows from the cigar and curls around the inhabited branches, with falling cigar embers [kapre-c08, kapre-c15, kapre-c28]

basis_claims.quote: A kapre is a mythical creature with a human-like appearance that is often described as a tree giant, being a tall, dark-coloured, hairy, and muscular creature. In Philippine folklore, kapres are giants that often dwell atop fruitless tree branches and smoke large cigars, behaving mischievously but benignly around nearby travelers.

statement.id: Kapre adalah makhluk mitos mirip manusia yang digambarkan sebagai raksasa pohon yang tinggi, gelap, berbulu, dan berotot; dalam cerita rakyat Filipina kapre tinggal di dahan pohon tak berbuah, mengisap cerutu besar, dan usil tetapi tidak jahat terhadap pejalan.
statement.en: The kapre is a humanlike mythical creature described as a tall, dark, hairy, muscular tree giant; in Philippine folklore kapres dwell atop fruitless tree branches, smoke large cigars and are mischievous but benign toward travellers.

basis_claims.quote: Kapres are believed to be nocturnal and omnivorous. They are not necessarily considered to be evil. However, they may turn vengeful when the tree that they are inhabiting is cut down.

statement.id: Kapre dipercaya aktif pada malam hari dan omnivora, tidak selalu dianggap jahat, tetapi dapat menjadi pendendam bila pohon tempat tinggalnya ditebang.
statement.en: Kapres are believed to be nocturnal and omnivorous, not necessarily considered evil, but they may turn vengeful when the tree they inhabit is cut down.

basis_claims.quote: Reports of experiencing Kapre enchantment include that of witnessing rustling tree branches, even if the wind is not strong. Some more examples would be hearing loud laughter coming from an unseen being, witnessing thick smoke from the top of a tree, seeing big red glaring eyes during night time from a tree

statement.id: Laporan tentang tanda kehadiran kapre antara lain dahan pohon yang bergoyang meski angin tidak kencang, tawa keras dari sosok yang tak terlihat, asap tebal dari puncak pohon, dan mata merah besar yang menyala di pohon pada malam hari.
statement.en: Reported signs of a kapre include rustling tree branches even when the wind is not strong, loud laughter from an unseen being, thick smoke from the top of a tree, and big red glaring eyes in a tree at night.

basis_claims.quote: Kapres are said to dwell in big trees like acacias, mangoes, bamboo, and banyan (known in the Philippines as balete). It is also commonly observed sitting beneath those trees.

statement.id: Kapre dikatakan tinggal di pohon besar seperti akasia, mangga, bambu, dan beringin (balete di Filipina), dan sering terlihat duduk di bawah pohon-pohon itu.
statement.en: Kapres are said to dwell in big trees such as acacias, mangoes, bamboo and banyan (balete in the Philippines), and are commonly seen sitting beneath those trees.

basis_claims.quote: The Kapre is said to wear the indigenous Northern Philippine loincloth known as bahag, and according to some, often wears a belt which gives the kapre the ability to be unseen to humans.

statement.id: Kapre dikatakan memakai cawat bahag dari Filipina utara, dan menurut sebagian orang sering memakai sabuk yang membuatnya tak terlihat oleh manusia.
statement.en: The kapre is said to wear the northern Philippine loincloth known as bahag and, according to some, often wears a belt that lets it go unseen by humans.

basis_claims.quote: It is also believed that abundant fireflies in woody areas are the embers from the Kapre's lit cigars or tobacco pipe.

statement.id: Dipercaya pula bahwa kunang-kunang yang melimpah di daerah berhutan adalah bara cerutu atau pipa tembakau kapre yang menyala.
statement.en: It is also believed that abundant fireflies in wooded areas are the embers of the kapre's lit cigars or tobacco pipe.

basis_claims.quote: In popular accounts, the Kapre is a giant humanlike being that inhabits a large tree, often a balete, acacia, or mango. It may be detected through the smell of tobacco, the glow of a cigar, laughter, falling ash, or the sense of being watched.

statement.id: Dalam kisah populer kapre adalah makhluk raksasa mirip manusia yang tinggal di pohon besar, sering balete, akasia, atau mangga; kehadirannya dapat dikenali dari bau tembakau, nyala cerutu, tawa, abu yang jatuh, atau perasaan sedang diawasi.
statement.en: In popular accounts the kapre is a giant humanlike being living in a large tree, often a balete, acacia or mango; it may be detected by the smell of tobacco, the glow of a cigar, laughter, falling ash or the sense of being watched.

kasogonaga.depicted_variant: the multicolored sky-elephant variant of the Qom weather being

visual_requirements.description: One multicolored elephant form: one elephant head, two eyes, two ears, one trunk, four legs and one tail; no human body, no mixing pig or anteater variants
A branching white-gold lightning discharge originates in the open mouth, visibly crossing the dark clouds; rain falls around her
Sky above dark clouds

kasogonaga.aura: A branching white-gold lightning discharge originates in the open mouth, visibly crossing the dark clouds; rain falls around her [kasogonaga-c04, kasogonaga-c09]

basis_claims.quote: According to some members of the Toba people, Kasogonagá appears as a multicolored elephant that throws lightning from her mouth. These attributes are related to the rain and rainbows.

statement.id: Menurut sebagian orang Toba, Kasogonagá tampil sebagai gajah berwarna-warni yang melontarkan petir dari mulutnya; ciri-ciri ini dikaitkan dengan hujan dan pelangi.
statement.en: According to some Toba people, Kasogonagá appears as a multicolored elephant that throws lightning from her mouth; these attributes are related to rain and rainbows.

basis_claims.quote: En ellos, se observa también una asociación entre dicho ser celestial y la lluvia, los truenos y relámpagos; como dueño de tales fenómenos atmosféricos, qasoxonaxa puede ayudar a los seres humanos ante situaciones de sequía e inundaciones.

statement.id: Dalam kisah-kisah itu, makhluk langit tersebut dikaitkan dengan hujan, guntur, dan kilat; sebagai pemilik gejala cuaca itu, qasoxonaxa dapat menolong manusia ketika kemarau dan banjir.
statement.en: In those accounts this celestial being is associated with rain, thunder and lightning; as owner of these atmospheric phenomena, qasoxonaxa can help people in droughts and floods.

basis_claims.quote: En los relatos, situaciones fragmentarias y dibujos que registré en el barrio qom de Derqui, dicho ser es conceptualizado como un elefante del cielo, como un pequeño animalito o como un oso hormiguero, dueño o dueña de la lluvia y los truenos, que habita en el cielo sobre las nubes

statement.id: Dalam catatan Sarra di lingkungan qom di Derqui, makhluk ini dibayangkan sebagai gajah langit, hewan kecil, atau beruang semut, pemilik atau penguasa hujan dan guntur yang tinggal di langit di atas awan.
statement.en: In Sarra's records from the qom neighbourhood of Derqui, the being is conceived as a sky elephant, a small animal or an anteater, owner of rain and thunder, that lives in the sky above the clouds.

manaia-mythological-creature.depicted_variant: the eagle-headed serpent variant described by Hamilton

visual_requirements.description: One living serpent with one eagle head, hooked bird beak, two eyes, one continuous legless serpentine body and tapering tail; no wings, hands, horns or human torso

manaia-mythological-creature.aura: No documented visible power; reverent guardian awe through anatomy, active coil and light only [manaia-mythological-creature-c07]

basis_claims.quote: The Manaia, or lizard, or snake, is a remarkable deviation from the general law stated here. There are several varieties : probably the snake form with the eagle's head is one of the most interesting, carrying us back to some of the older mythologies.

statement.id: Hamilton menyebut manaia sebagai bentuk kadal atau ular dengan beberapa varian; salah satu yang paling menarik ialah bentuk ular berkepala elang.
statement.en: Hamilton describes the Manaia as a lizard or snake form with several varieties, one of the most interesting being the snake form with the eagle's head.

many-finned-sea-serpent.depicted_variant: Aelian scolopendra sea-monster with nostril hairs and paired rowing appendages

visual_requirements.description: One enormous long marine serpent: one head with two eyes, very long hairs protruding from the nostrils, numerous paired paddle-like feet or fins in rows on either side of the body, one flat crayfish-like tail; no horns, wings or extra heads
Natural seawater churned by its numerous rowing appendages; spray from the head surfacing, no supernatural power
Open sea in the ancient Aelian account

many-finned-sea-serpent.aura: Natural seawater churned by its numerous rowing appendages; spray from the head surfacing, no supernatural power [many-finned-sea-serpent-c06, many-finned-sea-serpent-c07]

basis_claims.quote: I have ascertained that the Skolopendra (Scolopendra) is a Ketos (Cetus, Sea-Monster), and of Sea-Monsters it is the biggest, and if cast up on the shore no one would have the courage to look at it.

statement.id: Aelian menulis bahwa ia memastikan skolopendra adalah sejenis ketos (monster laut) dan yang terbesar di antara monster laut, dan bila terdampar di pantai tak seorang pun berani memandangnya.
statement.en: Aelian writes that he ascertained the skolopendra to be a ketos (sea-monster) and the biggest of sea-monsters, and that if cast up on the shore no one would have the courage to look at it.

basis_claims.quote: they extend the whole of their head above the sea, exposing hairs of immense length protruding from their nostrils, and the tail is flat and resembles that of a crayfish.

statement.id: Menurut mereka yang ahli urusan laut dalam tulisan Aelian, makhluk itu menjulurkan seluruh kepalanya di atas laut dengan rambut sangat panjang menyembul dari lubang hidungnya, dan ekornya pipih seperti ekor udang karang.
statement.en: According to those expert in marine matters in Aelian's account, the creature extends its whole head above the sea, exposing hairs of immense length protruding from its nostrils, and its tail is flat and resembles that of a crayfish.

basis_claims.quote: And at times the rest of their body is to be seen floating on the surface, and its bulk is comparable to a full-sized trireme. And they swim with numerous feet in line on either side as though they were rowing themselves (though the expression is somewhat harsh) with tholepins hung alongside.

statement.id: Dalam tulisan Aelian, sisa tubuhnya kadang terlihat mengapung di permukaan dengan ukuran sebanding trireme penuh, dan ia berenang dengan banyak kaki berderet di kedua sisi seakan mendayung dirinya sendiri.
statement.en: In Aelian's account the rest of its body is at times seen floating on the surface, its bulk comparable to a full-sized trireme, and it swims with numerous feet in line on either side as though rowing itself.

namaka.depicted_variant: Visible female sea goddess actively sends destructive tidal flood across volcanic coast

visual_requirements.description: Visible female chiefess actor with physical arms in hand-to-hand narrative; normal human appearance/clothing editorial,fullyopaque.
Sea goddess sends tidal waves/floods that overwhelmPeleland/homes.
Kahikinui coast beneath western Haleakala.

namaka.aura: Presence through active source-grounded subject: namaka-c05, namaka-c13, namaka-c04, namaka-c09, namaka-c11

basis_claims.quote: When Pele quarrels with her powerful sister Nāmaka, Nāmaka sends tidal waves to destroy Pele's lands and homes. Helped by her family, Pele fights Nāmaka, but Nāmaka defeats her.

statement.id: Ketika Pele bertengkar dengan saudarinya yang perkasa, Nāmaka, Nāmaka mengirim gelombang pasang untuk menghancurkan tanah dan rumah Pele; Pele yang dibantu keluarganya melawan Nāmaka, tetapi dikalahkan.
statement.en: When Pele quarrels with her powerful sister Nāmaka, Nāmaka sends tidal waves to destroy Pele's lands and homes; Pele, helped by her family, fights Nāmaka but is defeated.

basis_claims.quote: In Thrum's Kane-huna-moku myth, Nāmaka is called the chiefess of the Mu and Menehune people when they are summoned to build the watercourse for Kikiaola at Waimea on Kauaʻi.

statement.id: Dalam mitos Kane-huna-moku dari Thrum, Nāmaka disebut kepala perempuan orang Mu dan Menehune ketika mereka dipanggil membangun saluran air Kikiaola di Waimea, Kauaʻi.
statement.en: In Thrum's Kane-huna-moku myth, Nāmaka is called the chiefess of the Mu and Menehune people when they are summoned to build the watercourse for Kikiaola at Waimea on Kauaʻi.

basis_claims.quote: Na-maka-o-ka-hai, a sea-goddess, as a result of family trouble, became Pele's most bitter enemy, fighting her with floods of water, according to the legends. Thus the original household represented the two eternal enemies, fire and water.
basis_claims.locator: Ch. X, Genealogy of the Pele family

statement.id: Na-maka-o-ka-hai, dewi laut, karena perselisihan keluarga menjadi musuh terpahit Pele dan melawannya dengan banjir air, menurut legenda; rumah tangga asal itu mewakili dua musuh abadi, api dan air.
statement.en: Na-maka-o-ka-hai, a sea-goddess, became Pele's most bitter enemy as a result of family trouble, fighting her with floods of water, according to the legends; the original household thus represented the two eternal enemies, fire and water.

basis_claims.quote: High tides and floods from the seas destroyed Pele's home and lands. Then the elder brother of Pele-Ka-moho-alii, the shark-god-called for all the family to aid Pele. Na-maka-o-ka-hai fought the whole family and defeated them. She broke down their houses and drove them into the ocean.
basis_claims.locator: Ch. I, Pele and her family

statement.id: Pasang tinggi dan banjir dari laut menghancurkan rumah dan tanah Pele; Ka-moho-alii, dewa hiu dan kakak Pele, memanggil seluruh keluarga membantu Pele, tetapi Na-maka-o-ka-hai melawan dan mengalahkan mereka semua, merobohkan rumah mereka dan mengusir mereka ke samudra.
statement.en: High tides and floods from the seas destroyed Pele's home and lands; Ka-moho-alii, the shark-god and Pele's elder brother, called the whole family to aid Pele, but Na-maka-o-ka-hai fought and defeated them all, broke down their houses and drove them into the ocean.

basis_claims.quote: The battle was fought by the two sisters hand to hand. The conflict lasted for a long time along the western slope of the mountain Hale-a-ka-la. Na-maka-o-ka-hai tore the body of Pele and broke her lava bones into great pieces which lie to this day along the seacoast of the district called Kahiki-nui.
basis_claims.locator: Ch. I, Pele and her family

statement.id: Kedua saudari itu bertarung tangan kosong lama di lereng barat gunung Hale-a-ka-la; Na-maka-o-ka-hai mencabik tubuh Pele dan mematahkan tulang lavanya menjadi bongkahan besar yang hingga kini terletak di pesisir distrik Kahiki-nui.
statement.en: The two sisters fought hand to hand for a long time along the western slope of the mountain Hale-a-ka-la; Na-maka-o-ka-hai tore the body of Pele and broke her lava bones into great pieces which lie to this day along the seacoast of the district called Kahiki-nui.

nine-eared-hound.depicted_variant: the nine-ear Guangdong Xinyu hunting-dog variant

visual_requirements.description: One hunting hound, one head, two eyes, four legs and one tail, exactly nine clearly separated ears; countable five on image-left and four on image-right.
The quivering nine ears indicate the documented hunting omen; no visible supernatural lightning or magical light
Wild land and a thorn thicket in the Guangdong Xinyu account

nine-eared-hound.aura: The quivering nine ears indicate the documented hunting omen; no visible supernatural lightning or magical light [nine-eared-hound-c10, nine-eared-hound-c11]

basis_claims.quote: 陳時雷州人陳鉷無子，其業捕獵，家有九耳犬甚靈。凡將獵，卜諸犬耳。一耳動，則獲一獸，動多則三四耳，少則一二耳。

statement.id: Guangdong Xinyu menulis bahwa Chen Kun dari Leizhou, yang tidak punya anak dan berprofesi pemburu, memiliki anjing bertelinga sembilan yang sangat sakti; satu telinga yang bergerak berarti satu buruan.
statement.en: The Guangdong Xinyu says that Chen Kun of Leizhou, who had no son and made his living by hunting, kept a very efficacious nine-eared dog; each ear that moved meant one animal caught.

basis_claims.quote: 一日出獵，而九耳俱動，鉷大喜，以為必多得獸矣。既之野，有叢棘一區，九耳犬圍繞不去。異之，得一巨卵徑尺，攜以歸，雷雨暴作，卵開，乃一男子，其手有文，左曰雷，右曰州

statement.id: Pada suatu hari kesembilan telinga bergerak dan anjing itu terus mengitari semak berduri; Chen Kun menemukan telur besar, membawanya pulang, dan ketika badai petir datang telur itu terbuka menjadi seorang laki-laki yang di telapak tangannya tertulis aksara untuk Lei dan Zhou.
statement.en: One day all nine ears moved and the dog kept circling a thicket; Chen Kun found a huge egg and took it home, and in a thunderstorm it opened to reveal a boy with the characters for Lei and Zhou written on his hands.

nure-onna.depicted_variant: the armless enormous sea-serpent variant of the wet-haired yōkai

visual_requirements.description: One woman head on a continuous enormous snake body, one head, two eyes, no human arms, no legs, no human torso, long dripping black hair, visibly forked snake tongue; no extra head or horns
Natural spray driven by the surfacing snake body; predatory hunt documented, no blood-draining scene and no invented magical beams
Shoreline of Kyushu with shallow dark water

nure-onna.aura: Natural spray driven by the surfacing snake body; predatory hunt documented, no blood-draining scene and no invented magical beams [nure-onna-c07, nure-onna-c14]

basis_claims.quote: Nure-onna (濡女; "wet woman") is a Japanese yōkai which resembles a reptilian creature with the head of a woman and the body of a snake.

statement.id: Nure-onna adalah yōkai Jepang berkepala perempuan dan bertubuh ular.
statement.en: Nure-onna is a Japanese yōkai with a woman’s head and a snake’s body.

basis_claims.quote: They are similar to the yōkai called isoonna of Kyushu, and like the isoonna, they are said to appear at seas or rivers.

statement.id: Kisahnya menempatkan nure-onna di laut atau sungai.
statement.en: Tales place nure-onna at seas or rivers.

basis_claims.quote: Their name comes from how their hair is always wet in legends.

statement.id: Namanya dikaitkan dengan rambut yang selalu basah.
statement.en: Its name is linked to hair that is always wet.

basis_claims.quote: Nure onna are vampiric sea serpents who haunt shores and rivers looking for humans to eat.

statement.id: Nure onna digambarkan sebagai ular laut penghisap darah yang menghantui pantai dan sungai untuk mencari manusia yang bisa dimakan.
statement.en: Nure onna are described as vampiric sea serpents who haunt shores and rivers looking for humans to eat.

basis_claims.quote: They are most commonly found on the shores of the island of Kyūshū, but there are stories of nure onna encounters as far north as Niigata Prefecture and as far east as Fukushima Prefecture.

statement.id: Nure onna paling sering dijumpai di pesisir pulau Kyūshū, tetapi ada cerita perjumpaan hingga sejauh Prefektur Niigata di utara dan Prefektur Fukushima di timur.
statement.en: Nure onna are most commonly found on the shores of Kyūshū, with stories of encounters as far north as Niigata Prefecture and as far east as Fukushima Prefecture.

basis_claims.quote: There are two variations of this yōkai: one without arms, which resembles an enormous sea serpent with a woman’s head, and one with human-like arms.

statement.id: Yokai.com menyebut dua ragam nure onna: yang tanpa lengan, mirip ular laut raksasa berkepala perempuan, dan yang berlengan seperti manusia.
statement.en: Yokai.com describes two variations of nure onna: one without arms, resembling an enormous sea serpent with a woman's head, and one with human-like arms.

basis_claims.quote: Their faces are hideous and betray serpent-like features such as a forked tongue. They have long black hair which sticks to their dripping bodies.

statement.id: Wajahnya buruk rupa dengan ciri ular seperti lidah bercabang, dan rambut hitamnya yang panjang menempel pada tubuhnya yang basah menetes.
statement.en: Their faces are hideous with serpent-like features such as a forked tongue, and long black hair sticks to their dripping bodies.

basis_claims.quote: The nure onna is then free to attack her helpless victim, feeding by draining his blood with her long, serpentine tongue.

statement.id: Nure onna lalu bebas menyerang korban yang tak berdaya dan menghisap darahnya dengan lidahnya yang panjang menyerupai ular.
statement.en: The nure onna is then free to attack her helpless victim, draining his blood with her long, serpentine tongue.

oseichu.depicted_variant: the small forehead-horned lizard-like creature in the Shiojiri summary

visual_requirements.description: One small lizard-shaped strange creature, one head with two eyes, four small lizard legs and one tail, exactly one small horn on its forehead; no wings, no human mouth on body, no spikes or added horns

oseichu.aura: No documented visible physical power suitable for this scene; menace through anomalous forehead horn, macro confrontation and light only [oseichu-c06]

basis_claims.quote: その後、医者の菅玄際が様々な書物からこの病は応声虫の仕業と見立てた。そこで雷丸の入った薬湯を飲ませようとしたところ、腹の声は大いに拒んでいたが、飲んだ次の日は声がやや涸れた。そしてさらに飲ませると声は絶えた。便所に行くと肛門から虫が下った。形はトカゲのようで、額に小さい角があり、親は殺した。息子は6月末に本復したという。

statement.id: Dalam ringkasan itu, dokter 菅玄際 menyimpulkan dari berbagai buku bahwa penyakit tersebut ulah Ōseichū. Ketika ia hendak memberi ramuan berisi raigan (雷丸), suara dari perut menolak keras, tetapi sehari setelah diminum suaranya agak serak, dan setelah diminum lagi suara itu lenyap. Saat anak itu ke toilet, seekor serangga keluar dari anusnya, berbentuk seperti kadal dengan tanduk kecil di dahi, dan orang tuanya membunuhnya; anak itu pulih sepenuhnya pada akhir bulan keenam.
statement.en: In the summary, the physician 菅玄際 concluded from various books that the illness was the work of an Ōseichū. When he tried to give a decoction containing raigan (雷丸), the voice in the belly strongly refused, but the day after it was drunk the voice grew hoarse, and when it was given again the voice ceased. When the boy went to the toilet an insect came down through the anus, shaped like a lizard with a small horn on its forehead, and his parent killed it; the boy fully recovered at the end of the sixth month.

panhu.depicted_variant: the dog-headed HUMAN ancestor at the end of an incomplete transformation

visual_requirements.description: ONE natural adult canine head with TWO dog ears/TWO eyes and a human neck/body, TWO HUMAN arms with natural FIVE-finger hands, TWO HUMAN legs. Entire body below head human, NO dog torso/forepaws/hindlegs/tail. Wear fullyOPAQUE heavy dark ancient robe over human chest/hips and legs. NO horns, wings, armor or inventeddragonfeatures. ONE plain large GOLDEN VESSEL with open lid from the transformation story.
Documented dog-to-human transformation left only the doghead unchanged; show the resulting doghead on fullyhuman body emerging from goldenvessel, no magicrays or extra anatomy.
Uninscribed palace chamber suggested by royal transformation story, golden vessel foreground and dark plainstone behind; no princess or severed heads.

panhu.aura: Documented dog-to-human transformation left only the doghead unchanged; show the resulting doghead on fullyhuman body emerging from goldenvessel, no magicrays or extra anatomy. [panhu-c02, panhu-c04]

basis_claims.quote: The basic Panhu myth is about a dragon-dog who transformed into a man and married a princess. In the myth, there was an old woman in an ancient Chinese king's palace who had ear pain for many years. A royal physician plucked out a small, golden worm from her ear, and placed it inside of a gourd covered with a plate.

statement.id: Kisah dasarnya menceritakan anjing naga yang menjadi manusia dan menikahi putri.
statement.en: The central tale describes a dragon-dog becoming a man and marrying a princess.

basis_claims.quote: The basic Panhu myth is about a dragon-dog who transformed into a man and married a princess. In the myth, there was an old woman in an ancient Chinese king's palace who had ear pain for many years. A royal physician plucked out a small, golden worm from her ear, and placed it inside of a gourd covered with a plate.

statement.id: Sebuah versi bermula dari cacing emas yang dikeluarkan dari telinga perempuan di istana.
statement.en: One version begins with a golden worm removed from a palace woman's ear.

basis_claims.quote: There are also variant versions. In some variants, the dragon-dog became transformed into a human, except for his head. This is sometimes attributed to the princess worrying that he was starving inside the golden vessel he was placed inside of for seven days and seven nights to transform into a human, which resulted in the process being incomplete.

statement.id: Dalam varian tertentu, perubahan menjadi manusia tidak selesai dan kepala anjing tetap ada.
statement.en: In some variants, the human transformation remains incomplete and the dog head persists.

pihi.depicted_variant: the paired one-eyed one-winged blue-red ducklike biyi form connected with Pihi

visual_requirements.description: TWO separate living ducklike birds side by side, each has one head, EXACTLY ONE EYE and EXACTLY ONE WING, blue-red feathers; TWO heads, TWO individual bodies, TWO eyes total, TWO wings total, two legs per bird and one tail per bird. The left bird has only its outer left wing, the right bird only its outer right wing; inner flanks touch but bodies are not fused
Paired flight only: each bird alone cannot fly, together they fly; natural feather movement, no elemental power

pihi.aura: Paired flight only: each bird alone cannot fly, together they fly; natural feather movement, no elemental power [pihi-c02, pihi-c07]

basis_claims.quote: De Pihi is een mythologische vogel met maar één vleugel; in het westen gepopulariseerd door de Franse dichter Guillaume Apollinaire, die een beschrijving vond in een obscuur boek over Chinese mythologie. Omdat de vogel maar één vleugel heeft, kan het dier alleen als stelletje vliegen.

statement.id: Pihi adalah burung mitologis bersayap satu yang dikaitkan dengan cerita Tiongkok.
statement.en: Pihi is a one winged mythological bird associated with Chinese lore.

basis_claims.quote: De Pihi is een mythologische vogel met maar één vleugel; in het westen gepopulariseerd door de Franse dichter Guillaume Apollinaire, die een beschrijving vond in een obscuur boek over Chinese mythologie. Omdat de vogel maar één vleugel heeft, kan het dier alleen als stelletje vliegen.

statement.id: Karena hanya mempunyai satu sayap, Pihi dikatakan dapat terbang ketika berpasangan.
statement.en: Because it has only one wing, Pihi is said to fly only as a pair.

basis_claims.quote: Or il existe dans la mythologie chinoise des oiseaux similaires, nommés 比翼鸟, en pinyin biyi niao ... il est donc très probable que Apollinaire, à la suite selon Claude Debon de la lecture d'un numéro de la Revue asiatique de 1896, ait simplement transcrit le mot biyi en langue romane, ce qui aurait donné Pihi.

statement.id: Menurut sumber ini, dalam mitologi Tiongkok ada burung serupa bernama 比翼鸟 (biyi niao), dan sangat mungkin Apollinaire, setelah membaca sebuah nomor Revue asiatique tahun 1896 menurut Claude Debon, hanya menuliskan kata biyi dalam bahasa Roman (langue romane) sehingga menjadi Pihi.
statement.en: According to this source, Chinese mythology has similar birds called 比翼鸟 (biyi niao), and it is very probable that Apollinaire, after reading an issue of the Revue asiatique of 1896 according to Claude Debon, simply transcribed the word biyi in a Romance language, giving Pihi.

basis_claims.quote: 《爾雅·釋鳥》南方有比翼鳥焉，不比不飛，其名謂之鶼鶼。《郭註》似鳧，靑赤色，一目一翼，相得乃飛。

statement.id: Kamus Kangxi mengutip Erya: di selatan ada burung 比翼鳥 yang tidak terbang bila tidak berpasangan, bernama 鶼鶼; catatan Guo menyebutnya menyerupai bebek, berwarna biru kemerahan, bermata satu dan bersayap satu, dan terbang hanya bila bersama.
statement.en: The Kangxi Dictionary quotes the Erya: in the south there is a 比翼鳥 that cannot fly unless paired, named 鶼鶼; Guo's note says it resembles a duck, is blue-red, has one eye and one wing, and flies only when together.

qianliyan.depicted_variant: the green-skinned far-seeing Mazu temple guardian

visual_requirements.description: One green-skinned guardian figure with one head, two sharp natural eyes, two arms and two hands; fully opaque layered plain ceremonial general robe, no added horns, fangs, wings or extra eyes; one hand shields his eyes from glare
Far-seeing vigilance protects sailors in fog and bad weather; show no eye beams, glowing magical eyes or physical weather control
Mazu temple doorway by the sea, distant fog obscuring the water

qianliyan.aura: Far-seeing vigilance protects sailors in fog and bad weather; show no eye beams, glowing magical eyes or physical weather control [qianliyan-c08]

basis_claims.quote: Qianliyan is a Chinese sea and door god. He usually appears with Shunfeng'er as a guardian of the temples of the sea goddess Mazu.

statement.id: Qianliyan adalah dewa laut dan pintu Tiongkok yang menjaga kuil Mazu bersama Shunfeng'er.
statement.en: Qianliyan is a Chinese sea and door god guarding Mazu temples with Shunfeng'er.

basis_claims.quote: 即命千里眼、順風耳開南天門觀看。二將果奉旨出門外，看的真，聽的明。

statement.id: Dalam teks novel ini, Kaisar Giok memerintahkan Qianliyan (千里眼) dan Shunfeng'er (順風耳) membuka Gerbang Langit Selatan untuk mengamati; kedua jenderal itu keluar dan "melihat dengan jelas, mendengar dengan terang".
statement.en: In the novel's text, the Jade Emperor commands Qianliyan (千里眼) and Shunfeng'er (順風耳) to open the South Heavenly Gate and look; the two generals go out and see clearly and hear distinctly.

basis_claims.quote: Qianliyan's sharp vision is employed to help protect sailors at night and during fog and other inclement weather. In some accounts, he is capable of seeing everything in the world.

statement.id: Penglihatan tajam Qianliyan dipakai untuk melindungi pelaut pada malam hari serta saat kabut dan cuaca buruk; dalam beberapa kisah ia dapat melihat segala sesuatu di dunia.
statement.en: Qianliyan's sharp vision is employed to protect sailors at night and during fog and other bad weather; in some accounts he can see everything in the world.

basis_claims.quote: Qianliyan typically appears as a green-skinned demon shielding his eyes from the sun's glare.

statement.id: Dalam seni, Qianliyan biasanya tampil sebagai iblis berkulit hijau yang menaungi matanya dari silau matahari.
statement.en: In art, Qianliyan typically appears as a green-skinned demon shielding his eyes from the sun's glare.

qiqirn.depicted_variant: the large bald canine spirit of Inuit folklore, not Kipling many-legged Quiquern

visual_requirements.description: One large bald canine spirit with one dog head, two eyes, four dog legs and one tail. Almost entirely hairless, hair ONLY on feet, around mouth, ear tips and tail tip; bare wrinkled skin everywhere else. No extra legs, second head or ordinary fur coat
Its presence causes convulsions, but no victim or visible magical effect shown; uncanny anatomy and sudden flight alone
Around Baffin Island, dark Arctic ground with sparse windblown snow

qiqirn.aura: Its presence causes convulsions, but no victim or visible magical effect shown; uncanny anatomy and sudden flight alone [qiqirn-c02, qiqirn-c03]

basis_claims.quote: Qiqirn is a large, bald dog spirit in Inuit mythology, from around the area of Baffin Island.

statement.id: Qiqirn adalah roh anjing besar tak berbulu dalam mitologi Inuit dari sekitar Pulau Baffin.
statement.en: Qiqirn is a large, bald dog spirit of Inuit mythology from around Baffin Island.

basis_claims.quote: It has hair only on its feet, mouth and the tips of its ears and tail. Its presence will send men and dogs into convulsions, sometimes fatal.

statement.id: Bulunya hanya ada di kaki, mulut, serta ujung telinga dan ekor; kehadirannya membuat manusia dan anjing kejang, kadang sampai mati.
statement.en: It has hair only on its feet, mouth and ear and tail tips; its presence sends men and dogs into sometimes fatal convulsions.

basis_claims.quote: However, it is frightened of humans and will run away if an angakkuq sees it.

statement.id: Namun ia takut pada manusia dan akan lari jika dilihat angakkuq (dukun).
statement.en: But it fears humans and runs away if an angakkuq sees it.

qiulong.depicted_variant: the hornless green qiu definition paired with Huainanzi whirlwind ascent

visual_requirements.description: One hornless green Chinese dragon head, two natural eyes and a powerful curling scaled neck; absolutely NO HORNS, no antlers, no crest spikes or wings. Lower body and limbs remain naturally obscured in cloud below the crop; no limb count invented
A physical whirlwind carries the green qiu upward amid dark clouds and freezing rain, its voice and might shaking the realm; no lightning breath or fire
Sky above Jizhou, rising out of the Huainanzi storm passage

qiulong.aura: A physical whirlwind carries the green qiu upward amid dark clouds and freezing rain, its voice and might shaking the realm; no lightning breath or fire [qiulong-c09]

basis_claims.quote: Qiulong (simplified Chinese: 虬龙; traditional Chinese: 虯龍; pinyin: qíulóng; Wade–Giles: ch'iu-lung; lit. 'curling dragon') or qiu was a Chinese dragon that is contradictorily defined as "horned dragon" and "hornless dragon".

statement.id: Qiulong adalah naga Tiongkok dengan definisi yang bertentangan mengenai keberadaan tanduk.
statement.en: Qiulong is a Chinese dragon with conflicting definitions about the presence of horns.

basis_claims.quote: 【駟玉虯以乘鷖兮，】有角曰龍，無角曰虯。鷖，鳳皇別名也。山海經曰：鷖，身有五采。
basis_claims.locator: Chuci Zhangju (楚辭章句), juan 1, Lisao (離騷), komentar Wang Yi

statement.id: Komentar Wang Yi (王逸) pada larik 駟玉虯以乘鷖兮 menyatakan bahwa yang bertanduk disebut long (龍) dan yang tak bertanduk disebut qiu (虯).
statement.en: Wang Yi's (王逸) commentary on the line 駟玉虯以乘鷖兮 states that one with horns is called long (龍) and one without horns is called qiu (虯).

basis_claims.quote: 今夫赤螭、青虯之游冀州也，天清地定，毒獸不作，飛鳥不駭，入榛薄，食薦梅，噆味含甘，步不出頃畝之區
basis_claims.locator: Huainanzi (淮南子), bab Lanming Xun (覽冥訓)

statement.id: Huainanzi menggambarkan 赤螭 dan 青虯 (qiu hijau) berkelana di Jizhou (冀州) ketika langit cerah dan bumi tenang, binatang berbisa tidak bertindak dan burung tidak ketakutan; mereka masuk semak, makan tanaman, dan langkahnya tidak keluar dari satu petak lahan.
statement.en: The Huainanzi describes the 赤螭 and the 青虯 (green qiu) roaming Jizhou (冀州) when the sky is clear and the earth settled, venomous beasts do not act and birds are not startled; they enter thickets, eat plants, and their steps do not leave a plot of land.

basis_claims.quote: 今夫赤螭、青虯之游冀州也 ... 若乃至於玄雲之素朝，陰陽交爭，降扶風，雜凍雨，扶搖而登之，威動天地，聲震海內，蛇鱔著泥百仞之中，熊羆匍匐丘山盤岩，虎豹襲穴而不敢咆
basis_claims.locator: Huainanzi (淮南子), bab Lanming Xun (覽冥訓)

statement.id: Dalam bagian yang sama, ketika pagi bermendung gelap dan yin-yang bertarung, mereka (赤螭 dan 青虯) naik di atas angin puyuh sehingga wibawanya menggerakkan langit dan bumi dan suaranya mengguncang negeri; belut menyusup ke lumpur, beruang bersujud, dan harimau serta macan tutul tidak berani mengaum.
statement.en: In the same passage, on a morning of dark clouds when yin and yang contend, they (the 赤螭 and 青虯) rise on the whirlwind so that their might moves heaven and earth and their sound shakes the realm; eels sink into the mud, bears crouch, and tigers and leopards dare not roar.

rep-un-kamuy.depicted_variant: the youthful harpoon-bearing sea kamuy directing marine bounty toward human shore

visual_requirements.description: ONE YOUNG adult HUMAN sea deity with ONE head/TWO eyes/TWO arms/FIVE fingers per hand/TWO legs, black windblown hair, fullyOPAQUE coarse dark long robe covering all chest/stomach/hips. ONE long plain unlettered wooden HARPOON, no crown/tattoos/armor or orcaparts. Behind him exactly TWO natural whales in sea: ONE adult whale and ONE calf, normal cetacean anatomy, intact skin/no blood.
Sea bounty c04 portrayed as two intact whales swimming towardhuman shore within heavy breakingsea under oceanlord direction; no gore, levitation orrays.
Sea and humanshore near an Ainu village; distant modest uninscribed woodenroofs, no ritualsymbols or named sacredsite.

rep-un-kamuy.aura: Sea bounty c04 portrayed as two intact whales swimming towardhuman shore within heavy breakingsea under oceanlord direction; no gore, levitation orrays. [rep-un-kamuy-c01, rep-un-kamuy-c04, rep-un-kamuy-c05, rep-un-kamuy-c06]

basis_claims.quote: Rep-un-Kamuy is the Ainu kamuy (god) of the sea.

statement.id: Rep-un-kamuy menguasai laut dalam mitologi Ainu.
statement.en: Rep-un-kamuy governs the sea in Ainu mythology.

basis_claims.quote: In other instances, he is a carefree, somewhat mischievous young man armed with a harpoon.

statement.id: Penampilan lain berupa pemuda pembawa harpun.
statement.en: Another appearance is a young harpoon-bearing man.

basis_claims.quote: In the story, he harpoons a whale and her young, and throws them ashore near a human village.

statement.id: Kisah berburu menyebutnya mengirim paus dan anaknya ke pantai manusia.
statement.en: A hunting story has him send a whale and its young to human shores.

basis_claims.quote: Rather than growing angry, he laughs, saying that the meat belongs to the humans and they can do with it as they like.

statement.en: He laughs and allows humans to use the whale meat as they wish.
statement.id: Ia tertawa dan mengizinkan manusia memakai daging paus sesuka mereka.

basis_claims.quote: Moved by this display of piety, Rep-un-Kamuy assures the humans that the bounty of the sea will keep them from famine.

statement.en: Rep-un-Kamuy promises sea bounty that prevents famine after seeing proper ritual respect.
statement.id: Rep-un-Kamuy menjanjikan kelimpahan laut yang mencegah kelaparan setelah melihat penghormatan ritual yang tepat.

basis_claims.quote: Rep-un-Kamuy is an important figure in Ainu mythology because the sea represents opportunities for harvests that could not be found on land:  fishing, the hunting of whales, and maritime trading expeditions.

statement.id: Wikipedia bahasa Inggris menyatakan Rep-un-kamuy adalah tokoh penting dalam mitologi Ainu karena laut menyediakan kesempatan panen yang tidak ada di darat: menangkap ikan, berburu paus, dan pelayaran dagang.
statement.en: English Wikipedia states that Rep-un-kamuy is an important figure in Ainu mythology because the sea offers opportunities for harvests not found on land: fishing, whale hunting, and maritime trading expeditions.

shuzi.depicted_variant: the tiger-shaped leopard-marked long-tailed auspicious beast

visual_requirements.description: One huge tiger-like cat with leopard rosette markings, one head, two eyes, four feline legs and one VERY LONG tail longer than the entire body; show entire tail as one continuous broad curve crossing behind and around the cat with its tip visible. No horns, wings or extra tails
Documented hunting of tigers, shown before contact; no supernatural elemental power or bloody prey
Mount Yinglin, with a rocky mountain path

shuzi.aura: Documented hunting of tigers, shown before contact; no supernatural elemental power or bloody prey [shuzi-c03]

basis_claims.quote: 酋耳（しゅうじ）とは古代中国の伝説上の生き物。大きな虎のようなすがたをしているとされる。

statement.id: Shuzi atau Shūji adalah hewan legendaris Tiongkok kuno menyerupai harimau besar.
statement.en: Shuzi, also called Shūji, is an ancient Chinese legendary animal resembling a large tiger.

basis_claims.quote: 見た目は虎のようで体はとても大きく尾もとても長いが、決して生きた獣を捕食しないという。ただし、虎や豹を目にすると態度は変わり必ず襲ってそれを殺すと伝えられていた。狩り捕った虎や豹は食べるとされる場合もあるが、酋耳は狩るのみでその肉を食べたりはしないとも語られる。

statement.id: Tubuh dan ekornya digambarkan sangat besar serta panjang.
statement.en: It is described with a very large body and a long tail.

basis_claims.quote: 見た目は虎のようで体はとても大きく尾もとても長いが、決して生きた獣を捕食しないという。ただし、虎や豹を目にすると態度は変わり必ず襲ってそれを殺すと伝えられていた。狩り捕った虎や豹は食べるとされる場合もあるが、酋耳は狩るのみでその肉を食べたりはしないとも語られる。

statement.id: Ia umumnya tidak memburu hewan hidup, tetapi menyerang harimau dan macan tutul.
statement.en: It generally avoids hunting living animals but attacks tigers and leopards.

basis_claims.quote: 英林山有酋耳，周成王時曾獻之。尾長於身，食虎豹。 王者威及四夷，則此獸至。
basis_claims.locator: 騶虞部彙考〈酋耳附〉, 《三才圖會》 section

statement.id: Kutipan dari 《三才圖會》 dalam Gujin Tushu Jicheng menyebut 酋耳 ada di gunung 英林山, pernah dipersembahkan pada masa Raja Cheng dari Zhou, berekor lebih panjang dari tubuhnya, memakan harimau dan macan tutul, dan muncul ketika wibawa raja menjangkau empat penjuru bangsa asing.
statement.en: The 《三才圖會》 passage in the Gujin tushu jicheng says the 酋耳 lives on Mount 英林山, was once presented in the time of King Cheng of Zhou, has a tail longer than its body, eats tigers and leopards, and appears when a ruler's might reaches the four barbarian quarters.

basis_claims.quote: 《冊府元龜》：「開元二十四年三月，獲瑞獸，酋耳形類虎， 尾長於身，有豹文，能食虎。」
basis_claims.locator: 騶虞部彙考〈酋耳附〉, 《冊府元龜》

statement.id: Kutipan dari 《冊府元龜》 mencatat bahwa pada bulan ketiga tahun 開元二十四 seekor binatang pertanda baik ditangkap; 酋耳 itu berbentuk seperti harimau, berekor lebih panjang dari tubuh, bercorak macan tutul, dan mampu memakan harimau.
statement.en: A passage from the 《冊府元龜》 records that in the third month of the 24th year of Kaiyuan (開元二十四年) an auspicious beast was captured; the 酋耳 was tiger-like, had a tail longer than its body, leopard markings, and could eat tigers.

skinfaxi.depicted_variant: Skinfaxi drawing Day through the sky, gold-shining mane and tail account.

visual_requirements.description: Horse; gold-shining mane and tail; harnessed to Day chariot
Mane illuminates sky and earth
Sky with earth below

skinfaxi.aura: Awe comes from light shed by the gold-shining mane onto sky and earth (skinfaxi-c01, skinfaxi-c02, skinfaxi-c09).

basis_claims.quote: In Norse mythology, Skinfaxi (Old Norse: [ˈskinˌfɑkse] ) and Hrímfaxi [ˈhriːmˌfɑkse] are the horses of Dagr (day) and Nótt (night). The names Skinfaxi and Hrímfaxi mean "shining mane" and "frost mane", respectively. Skinfaxi pulls Dagr's chariot across the sky every day and his mane lights up the sky and earth below.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik, Skinfaxi dan Hrímfaxi adalah kuda Dagr (siang) dan Nótt (malam); namanya berarti "surai bersinar" dan "surai berembun beku", dan Skinfaxi menarik kereta Dagr melintasi langit setiap hari sementara suainya menerangi langit dan bumi.
statement.en: In Norse mythology Skinfaxi and Hrímfaxi are the horses of Dagr (day) and Nótt (night); the names mean 'shining mane' and 'frost mane', and Skinfaxi pulls Dagr's chariot across the sky every day, its mane lighting sky and earth.

basis_claims.quote: Skinfaxe (Oldnordisk: Skinfaxi, 'skinnende manke') er hesten, der i nordisk mytologi er forspændt Dags vogn. Han bliver på denne kørt hen over himlen hver dag. Hestens manke og hale skinner som guld og oplyser verden.

statement.id: Skinfaxe (Nordik Kuno Skinfaxi, "surai bersinar") adalah kuda yang ditambatkan pada kereta Dag dalam mitologi Nordik dan dikendarai melintasi langit setiap hari; surai dan ekornya bersinar seperti emas dan menerangi dunia.
statement.en: Skinfaxe (Old Norse Skinfaxi, 'shining mane') is the horse harnessed to Dag's chariot in Norse mythology, driven across the sky each day; its mane and tail shine like gold and light up the world.

basis_claims.quote: The horse made use of by Day is named Skinfaxi, from whose mane is shed light over the earth and the heavens.

statement.id: Kuda yang dipakai Siang bernama Skinfaxi; dari suainya cahaya memancar ke bumi dan langit.
statement.en: The horse Day uses is named Skinfaxi, from whose mane light is shed over the earth and the heavens.

snallygaster.depicted_variant: Composite folklore description, central-eye enormous-wing account with metallic toothed beak and reported tentacles.

visual_requirements.description: Bird-reptile hybrid with metallic toothed beak
Octopus-like tentacles
Huge wings, hooked claws, central forehead eye
Silent swoop toward prey
Frederick County woods

snallygaster.aura: Threat comes from the toothed beak, hooked claws and silent swoop (snallygaster-c04, snallygaster-c05, snallygaster-c08).

basis_claims.quote: The snallygaster was described as being half-reptile and half-bird, possessing a metallic beak lined with razor-sharp teeth.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan setengah reptil setengah burung, berparuh logam dengan gigi setajam silet.
statement.en: It was described as half reptile, half bird, with a metallic beak lined with razor-sharp teeth.

basis_claims.quote: The snallygaster was rumored to swoop silently from the sky to pick up and carry off its victims.

statement.id: Ia konon menukik diam-diam dari langit untuk menyambar dan membawa pergi korbannya.
statement.en: It reportedly swooped silently from the sky to carry off its victims.

basis_claims.quote: It was also said to have octopus-like tentacles.

statement.id: Makhluk ini juga dikatakan memiliki tentakel seperti gurita.
statement.en: It was also said to have octopus-like tentacles.

basis_claims.quote: Newspaper accounts throughout February and March 1909 describe encounters between local residents and a beast with "enormous wings, a long pointed bill, claws like steel hooks, and an eye in the center of its forehead."

statement.id: Laporan surat kabar sepanjang Februari dan Maret 1909 menggambarkan perjumpaan warga dengan binatang bersayap sangat besar, berparuh panjang runcing, bercakar seperti kait baja, dan bermata satu di tengah dahi.
statement.en: Newspaper accounts throughout February and March 1909 describe encounters between residents and a beast with enormous wings, a long pointed bill, claws like steel hooks and an eye in the center of its forehead.

basis_claims.quote: Reports of the Snallygaster, a strange beast prowling the woods of Frederick County, have been made since the 1730s, making it one of Maryland’s oldest legends.

statement.id: Laporan tentang Snallygaster, binatang aneh yang berkeliaran di hutan Frederick County, sudah ada sejak 1730-an sehingga menjadi salah satu legenda tertua Maryland.
statement.en: Reports of the Snallygaster, a strange beast prowling the woods of Frederick County, have been made since the 1730s, making it one of Maryland's oldest legends.

tangaroa.depicted_variant: the personified Māori sea atua rising and wielding a spear amid the tide

visual_requirements.description: ONE adult HUMAN-form male atua, ONE head/TWO eyes/TWO arms with naturalFIVE-finger hands/TWO legs, black windtornhair. FullyOPAQUE coarse dark wovencloak/tunic covering torso/hips/thighs, no exposedchest. ONE simple long wooden SPEAR in a humanhand with ONE plainlyvisible pointedstonehead (materialeditorial). No whalehead/tail, crown/trident/tattoos or borrowed sacredpatterns.

Documented tidalcontrol creates TWO physically rising walls ofsea curling inward at his gesture, real massivewaves/spray and flowingfish under sea-domain; spear isdocumented in Shortland battle and risingpersonifiedaction in Dixon. No lightbeams/runes, no victim/spearingwound; sea cannot be merely background.
Ocean and wetrock coast within Māori sea atua domain, dark horizon, no temples/inscriptions/culturalmotifs invented.

tangaroa.aura: Documented tidalcontrol creates TWO physically rising walls ofsea curling inward at his gesture, real massivewaves/spray and flowingfish under sea-domain; spear isdocumented in Shortland battle and risingpersonifiedaction in Dixon. No lightbeams/runes, no victim/spearingwound; sea cannot be merely background. [tangaroa-c01, tangaroa-c02, tangaroa-c14, tangaroa-c16]

basis_claims.quote: Tangaroa (Māori; Takaroa in the South Island dialect; cognate with Tagaloa in Sāmoan) is the great atua of the sea, lakes, rivers, and creatures that live within them, especially fish, in Māori mythology.

statement.id: Tangaroa adalah atua laut, danau, sungai, dan ikan dalam mitologi Māori.
statement.en: Tangaroa is the great atua of the sea, lakes, rivers, and fish in Māori mythology.

basis_claims.quote: As Tangaroa-whakamau-tai, he exercises control over the tides. He is sometimes depicted as a whale.

statement.id: Sebagai Tangaroa-whakamau-tai ia mengatur pasang surut dan terkadang digambarkan sebagai paus.
statement.en: As Tangaroa-whakamau-tai he governs tides and is sometimes depicted as a whale.

basis_claims.quote: Tangaroa warded it off, and it missed him. Then Tangaroa made a thrust at Rangi, and pierced him quite through the thigh, and he fell.

statement.id: Dalam versi yang dicatat Shortland, Tangaroa menangkis tusukan itu hingga meleset, lalu menusuk Rangi menembus pahanya hingga ia jatuh.
statement.en: In the version recorded by Shortland, Tangaroa warded off the thrust so that it missed him, then thrust at Rangi and pierced him quite through the thigh, so that he fell.

basis_claims.quote: which Powers are regarded by the Maori as their own primitive ancestors, and are invoked in their karakia by all the Maori race; for we find the names of Rangi, Rongo, Tangaroa, &c., mentioned as Atua or Gods of the Maori of the Sandwich Islands and other Islands of the Pacific inhabited by the same race.

statement.id: Menurut Shortland, kekuatan-kekuatan alam personifikasi itu dianggap orang Māori sebagai leluhur purba mereka dan dipanggil dalam karakia oleh seluruh bangsa Māori; nama Rangi, Rongo, Tangaroa, dan lainnya disebut sebagai Atua atau dewa orang Māori di Kepulauan Sandwich dan pulau-pulau Pasifik lain yang dihuni ras yang sama.
statement.en: According to Shortland, these personified Powers of Nature are regarded by the Maori as their primitive ancestors and invoked in karakia by the whole Maori race; the names of Rangi, Rongo, Tangaroa and others are mentioned as Atua or gods of the Maori of the Sandwich Islands and other Pacific islands inhabited by the same race.

basis_claims.quote: Lo, next Tangaroa, the god and father of fish and reptiles rises up, that he may rend apart the heavens and the earth, but he rends them not apart.
basis_claims.locator: Myths of origins (account quoted from Grey)

statement.id: Dalam kisah yang dikutip Dixon, Tangaroa, dewa dan ayah ikan serta reptil, bangkit untuk memisahkan langit dan bumi tetapi tidak berhasil.
statement.en: In the account Dixon quotes, Tangaroa, the god and father of fish and reptiles, rises up to rend heaven and earth apart but does not succeed.

teju-jagua.depicted_variant: Single dog-headed enormous lizard variant explicitly accepted by teju-jagua-c05/c10, with fiery gaze and gold-dusted skin.

visual_requirements.description: Single giant dog-head variant, enormous lizard body, limited mobility
Fire from eyes
Gold-dust-shining skin
Cavern of Yaguarón hill
Hidden treasure of gold and precious stones

teju-jagua.aura: Awe comes from enormous lizard anatomy and the feared fire-shooting gaze (teju-jagua-c02, teju-jagua-c05, teju-jagua-c10).

basis_claims.quote: Thus, the pair's first son was a huge lizard with seven dog-heads and eyes that shoot out fire.

statement.id: Putra pertama itu berupa kadal raksasa berkepala tujuh anjing dengan mata yang memancarkan api.
statement.en: Their first son was a huge lizard with seven dog heads and fire-shooting eyes.

basis_claims.quote: His seven dog-heads make any movement difficult. Some versions of the story say Teju Jagua has only one giant dog-head. But all versions agree that he has a limited ability to move around.

statement.id: Tujuh kepala anjingnya membuat setiap gerakan sulit. Sebagian versi menyebut Teju Jagua hanya berkepala satu anjing raksasa, tetapi semua versi sepakat bahwa kemampuannya bergerak terbatas.
statement.en: His seven dog heads make any movement difficult. Some versions say Teju Jagua has only one giant dog head, but all versions agree he has a limited ability to move around.

basis_claims.quote: TEJU JAGUA fue el primer hijo de TAU y KERANA; tenía la forma de un enorme lagarto con cabeza de perro. Se le consideraba el dominador de las cavernas.

statement.id: Teju Jagua adalah putra pertama Tau dan Kerana, berbentuk kadal raksasa berkepala anjing, dan dianggap penguasa gua-gua.
statement.en: Teju Jagua was the first son of Tau and Kerana, shaped like an enormous lizard with a dog's head, and was considered the master of the caverns.

basis_claims.quote: Su guarida la tenía en uno de los abismos del legendario cerro de Yaguarón.

statement.id: Sarangnya berada di salah satu jurang di bukit legendaris Yaguarón.
statement.en: His lair was in one of the abysses of the legendary Yaguarón hill.

basis_claims.quote: También se le consideraba el monstruo que protegía los tesoros ocultos de la raza guaraní. Por haberse revolcado sobre polvo aurífero (Itaju), su piel brillaba como oro y piedras preciosas.

statement.id: Ia juga dianggap monster yang melindungi harta tersembunyi bangsa Guaraní; karena berguling di atas debu emas (Itaju), kulitnya berkilau seperti emas dan batu mulia.
statement.en: He was also considered the monster who protected the hidden treasures of the Guaraní people; having rolled on gold dust (Itaju), his skin shone like gold and precious stones.

tenghuang.depicted_variant: Shanhaijing Chenghuang foxlike back-horned form, without wings or horse-body mixture.

visual_requirements.description: Foxlike creature with horns on its back
Land of Bai-min, otherwise unspecified terrain

tenghuang.aura: Auspicious awe comes from startling back-horned fox anatomy and forceful close framing (tenghuang-c06); no invented magic.

basis_claims.quote: 白民之國在龍魚北，白身披髮。有乘黃，其狀如狐，其背上有角，乘之壽二千歲。

statement.id: Shanhaijing (Haiwai Xi Jing) menyebut 乘黃 (Chenghuang) di Negeri 白民: bentuknya seperti rubah, di punggungnya ada tanduk, dan yang menungganginya berumur dua ribu tahun.
statement.en: The Shanhaijing (Overseas West section) names the 乘黃 (Chenghuang) in the land of the 白民: it looks like a fox, has horns on its back, and whoever rides it lives two thousand years.

tepegoz.depicted_variant: Adult single-forehead-eyed giant ogre before the blinding episode.

visual_requirements.description: One-eyed ogre with single forehead eye
Giant with very hard skin
Cave lair

tepegoz.aura: Threat comes from the giant cave ogre and single staring eye with tough skin (tepegoz-c01, tepegoz-c05, tepegoz-c06).

basis_claims.quote: In Turkic mythology, Tepegoz or Tepegöz is a legendary creature who has only one eye on his forehead – a kind of cyclops. He is an ogre that appears in the Book of Dede Korkut, a famous epic story of the Oghuz Turks.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Turkik, Tepegöz adalah raksasa bermata satu di dahi, semacam kiklop, yang muncul dalam Kitab Dede Korkut, epos terkenal bangsa Turk Oghuz.
statement.en: In Turkic mythology Tepegöz is a one-eyed ogre with an eye on his forehead, a kind of cyclops, appearing in the Book of Dede Korkut, a famous epic of the Oghuz Turks.

basis_claims.quote: одноглазый великан (дэв) в тюркской мифологии, рассказ о котором сводится к тому, что Тепегёз загоняет человека в пещеру, своё логово, собираясь съесть, но человек ослепляет его, вонзив в его единственный глаз остриё, и выбирается из пещеры, накинув на себя овечью шкуру.

statement.id: Kisahnya pada intinya: Tepegöz menggiring seseorang ke guanya untuk dimakan, tetapi orang itu membutakannya dengan menusuk matanya yang tunggal, lalu lolos dengan berselubung kulit domba.
statement.en: The core of its story: Tepegöz drives a man into his cave to eat him, but the man blinds his single eye with a sharp point and escapes wrapped in a sheepskin.

basis_claims.quote: Nobody is able to kill him. The sword can not cut him. The arrow can not kill him. Tepegoz's skin is very hard.

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu tak seorang pun mampu membunuhnya: pedang tidak melukainya, panah tidak membunuhnya, dan kulitnya sangat keras.
statement.en: In the story nobody can kill him: the sword cannot cut him, the arrow cannot kill him, and his skin is very hard.

tulevieja.depicted_variant: MINED Costa Rican bat-winged, hawk-legged old woman account, modestly clothed editorially.

visual_requirements.description: Ghost woman wearing tule hat
Hawk legs, witch face, bat wings and firewood
Taking flight and descending
Virilla river near dilapidated shack

tulevieja.aura: Threat comes from the bird talons and sudden descending flight (tulevieja-c03, tulevieja-c08, tulevieja-c09).

basis_claims.quote: La Tulevieja (also spelled Tulivieja) is a legendary figure from Costa Rican and Panamanian folklore. She is a ghost who wears a distinctive hat called a tule.

statement.id: La Tulevieja (juga Tulivieja) adalah tokoh legenda cerita rakyat Kosta Rika dan Panama, hantu bertopi khas yang disebut tule.
statement.en: La Tulevieja (also Tulivieja) is a legendary figure of Costa Rican and Panamanian folklore, a ghost wearing a distinctive hat called a tule.

basis_claims.quote: her most characteristic features are her legs and claws of an eagle or hawk instead of human legs, which leave reversed footprints so that she cannot be followed.

statement.id: Ciri utamanya adalah kaki dan cakar elang yang meninggalkan jejak terbalik sehingga ia tidak bisa diikuti.
statement.en: Her hallmark is eagle or hawk legs and claws that leave reversed footprints so she cannot be followed.

basis_claims.quote: Esta era una viejita que vivía cerca del río Virilla en una casucha destartalada por el tiempo, usaba para taparse del sol un gran sombrero de

statement.id: Dalam versi yang disusun kementerian pendidikan Kosta Rika ini, ia adalah seorang nenek yang tinggal dekat Sungai Virilla di gubuk reyot dan memakai topi besar dari tule untuk melindungi diri dari matahari.
statement.en: In this version published by the Costa Rican education ministry, she was a little old woman who lived near the Virilla river in a dilapidated shack and wore a big tule hat to shield herself from the sun.

basis_claims.quote: pechos al desnudo, patas de gavilán, alas de murciélago, rostro de bruja y carga de leña.

statement.id: Dalam versi ini ia dilukiskan dengan dada telanjang, kaki elang pemangsa (gavilán), sayap kelelawar, wajah penyihir, dan membawa kayu bakar.
statement.en: In this version she is described with bare breasts, hawk legs (gavilán), bat wings, a witch's face and a load of firewood.

basis_claims.quote: Se dice que alza vuelo y cae sobre la persona despedazándola cuando esta se encuentra en pecado mortal.

statement.id: Dikatakan ia terbang lalu jatuh menimpa orang yang sedang berdosa berat dan mencabik-cabiknya.
statement.en: It is said that she takes flight and falls upon a person in mortal sin, tearing the person to pieces.

u-scultone.depicted_variant: Su Sterru serpent account rather than the modern comic basilisk.

visual_requirements.description: Reptile-like dragon, selected serpent account
Deadly gaze represented without invented rays
Golgo chasm with nearby shrubs

u-scultone.aura: Danger comes from lethal direct gaze and serpent emerging from its chasm (u-scultone-c02, u-scultone-c08, u-scultone-c09).

basis_claims.quote: Le leggende folcloristiche sarde riferiscono dell'esistenza dello Scultone, un animale rettiliforme simile ad un drago che uccideva uomini e animali: presso Baunei (NU), la fuga di un drago chiamato Scultone avrebbe aperto la voragine del Golgo.

statement.id: Legenda rakyat Sardinia menyebut Scultone, hewan mirip reptil seperti naga yang membunuh manusia dan hewan; di dekat Baunei, kaburnya naga ini konon membuka jurang Golgo.
statement.en: Sardinian folk legends tell of the Scultone, a reptile-like, dragon-like animal that killed people and animals; near Baunei the dragon's flight is said to have opened the Golgo chasm.

basis_claims.quote: poiché lo sguardo dello  Scultone aveva il potere di uccidere, Pietro lo avrebbe guardato per mezzo di un piccolo specchio, neutralizzando tale potere e facendo sprofondare il Drago nelle viscere della Terra.

statement.id: Karena tatapan Scultone dapat membunuh, Rasul Petrus memandangnya lewat cermin kecil, sehingga kekuatan itu hilang dan naga itu tenggelam ke perut bumi.
statement.en: Because the Scultone's gaze could kill, the apostle Peter looked at it through a small mirror, neutralising that power and sinking the dragon into the bowels of the earth.

basis_claims.quote: U Scultone ghjè un animale rettiliforme simile à un dracone chì uccidìa omi è animali, vivìa trà l'arbusti è era immortale.

statement.id: Menurut artikel Wikipedia berbahasa Korsika, U Scultone adalah hewan mirip reptil seperti naga yang membunuh manusia dan hewan, hidup di antara semak-semak, dan abadi.
statement.en: According to the Corsican-language Wikipedia article, U Scultone is a reptile-like, dragon-like animal that killed people and animals, lived among the shrubs and was immortal.
