basis_claims.quote: Legend has it that once upon a time the entire plateau was at the mercy of a vicious monster, “Sa Serpente”, a sort of evil dragon who would sometimes come out of the chasm of Golgo (“Su Sterru”) demanding human sacrifices.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, dahulu seluruh dataran tinggi berada di bawah ancaman monster ganas, "Sa Serpente", sejenis naga jahat yang kadang keluar dari jurang Golgo ("Su Sterru") dan menuntut korban manusia.
statement.en: Legend has it that the whole plateau was once at the mercy of a vicious monster, "Sa Serpente", a sort of evil dragon that sometimes came out of the Golgo chasm ("Su Sterru") demanding human sacrifices.

basis_claims.quote: si diceva fosse tana di un serpente (su scultone), la cui minaccia fu allontanata con la costruzione (XVII secolo) della vicina chiesa di san Pietro.
basis_claims.locator: Su Sterru – Il Golgo di Baunei

statement.id: Su Sterru, jurang di dataran tinggi Golgo, konon adalah sarang seekor ular (su scultone), yang ancamannya dijauhkan dengan pembangunan gereja Santo Petrus di dekatnya pada abad ke-17.
statement.en: Su Sterru, the chasm on the Golgo plateau, was said to be the lair of a serpent (su scultone), whose threat was averted by building the nearby church of Saint Peter in the 17th century.

basis_claims.quote: lo scultone, come il basilisco, può uccidere con lo sguardo e viene combattuto con uno specchio

statement.id: Menurut catatan "lihat pula" pada artikel itu, scultone, seperti basilisk, dapat membunuh dengan tatapan dan dilawan dengan cermin.
statement.en: According to the "see also" note in the article, the scultone, like the basilisk, can kill with its gaze and is fought with a mirror.

wd-q11244093.depicted_variant: Chinese celestial emperor servant dragon in fast flight

visual_requirements.description: ONE living WHITE CHINESE DRAGON, one head/two eyes and one continuous coiling scaled neck/body. Clearly dragon physiognomy: broad raised muzzle, strong ridged brow, long whiskers, coarse beard/mane, two antlerlike horns as conventional editorial dragon-category rendering, not claim-specific horn count. Limbs and tail end outside close crop. No wings.
Fast flight physically displaces cloud vapor beside the neck; no controlled storms, waterspout, golden breath or novel powers.
High open sky crossed by cloud vapor, background minimal because dragon dominates.

wd-q11244093.aura: SWOOP rapidly down past the low viewer, head thrust forward and neck whipped into a vigorous airborne curve; white mane and whiskers stream backward. Supported by wd-q11244093-c01, wd-q11244093-c02, wd-q11244093-c02, wd-q11244093-c02.

basis_claims.quote: 白竜（はくりゅう、白龍、拼音: báilóng パイロン）は、古代中国で、天上界の皇帝である天帝に仕えているとされた竜の一種。名前のとおり、全身の鱗が白い。

statement.id: Naga putih adalah naga Tiongkok yang secara tradisional melayani kaisar langit.
statement.en: The white dragon is a Chinese dragon traditionally serving the celestial emperor.

basis_claims.quote: 竜は基本的に空を飛べるが、白竜は特に空を飛ぶ速度が速く、これに乗っていれば他の竜に追いつかれないともいう。ときおり魚に化けて地上の泉などで泳いでいることもある。

statement.id: Kisah memberinya penerbangan sangat cepat dan perubahan sesekali menjadi ikan.
statement.en: Accounts give it especially fast flight and occasional transformations into a fish.

wd-q757989.depicted_variant: living dragon-shaped literary offspring coiling around a stone stele

visual_requirements.description: ONE living Chinese dragon-shaped creature, one head/two eyes and a long neck/body COILED around the TOP of a plain stone stele. Proud broad dragon muzzle, ridged brow, long whiskers, bristling beard and two antlerlike horns are conventional editorial rendering of dragon shape, not sourced anatomical counts. Limbs cropped outside frame. Not snake/turtle/petrified ornament.
No documented magical power. Dust shakes from stone where living coil physically contacts its edge; no magical writing or energy.
TOP edge of weathered plain stone stele, blank face without inscriptions.

wd-q757989.aura: UNCOIL and BEND its fierce alert head down toward low viewer, neck rubbing the stele edge; mouth opening in a powerful exhale, whiskers thrown forward. Supported by wd-q757989-c02, wd-q757989-c07, wd-q757989-c02, wd-q757989-c02.

basis_claims.quote: 負屓（ふき、拼音：Fùxì）は、李東陽が著した『懐麓堂集』の説による竜生九子の一つ。文章の読み書きを好み、故に石碑の頂に絡み付いているという。

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Jepang, ia digambarkan melilit bagian atas prasasti batu.
statement.en: According to Japanese Wikipedia, it is depicted coiling around the tops of stone steles.

basis_claims.quote: 负屃是中国神话中龙的第八个儿子。似龙形，排行老八，平生好文，石碑两旁的文龙是其遗像。

statement.id: Catatan dalam Wikipedia bahasa Tionghoa menyebut 负屃 (Fùxì) sebagai putra kedelapan naga dalam mitologi Tiongkok, berbentuk seperti naga, gemar sastra (平生好文), dan naga-naga bersastra di kedua sisi prasasti adalah sosoknya.
statement.en: A note in Chinese Wikipedia calls 负屃 (Fùxì) the eighth son of the dragon in Chinese mythology, dragon-shaped, fond of literature (平生好文), with the literary dragons at both sides of steles as its likeness.

wd-q9602528.depicted_variant: Patterned white, red-maned marsh horse form; not yellow Tenghuang alias.

visual_requirements.description: Patterned white horse with red mane
Great marsh

wd-q9602528.aura: Awe comes from the unusual patterned white coat and scarlet mane in vigorous marsh emergence (wd-q9602528-c02, wd-q9602528-c05).

basis_claims.quote: 吉光被認為是一種馬，出生在大澤中，身體是白的，帶著花紋，但是鬃毛是紅的。

statement.id: Salah satu uraian memberinya bentuk kuda putih berpola dengan surai merah yang lahir di rawa besar.
statement.en: One description gives it the form of a patterned white horse with a red mane, born in a great marsh.

basis_claims.quote: 澤馬，一曰吉良。《山海經》曰：大封國有文馬，縞身朱鬛，名曰吉良，乘之壽千歲。

statement.id: Himpunan 名馬記 menyebut 澤馬 juga bernama 吉良 dan mengutip 《山海經》: di negeri 大封國 ada kuda berpola bertubuh putih dan bersurai merah bernama 吉良, yang penunggangnya berumur seribu tahun.
statement.en: The compilation 名馬記 says the 澤馬 is also called 吉良 and quotes the 《山海經》: in the country 大封國 there is a patterned horse with a white body and red mane named 吉良, whose rider lives a thousand years.

xiaotian-quan.depicted_variant: Loyal black thin celestial hunting dog, not the wicked-woman variant.

visual_requirements.description: Black dog
Thin hunting dog appearance
Bite and howl used to subdue demons
Southern Heavenly Gate in loyal dog legend

xiaotian-quan.aura: Awe comes from the loyal dog violent forward movement and documented battle bite/howl (xiaotian-quan-c01, xiaotian-quan-c02).

basis_claims.quote: Xiaotian Quan (Chinese: 哮天犬 or 嘯天犬; pinyin: Xiàotiān Quǎn; lit. 'Howling/Barking Celestial Dog') is a Chinese mythological beast and companion of the Chinese god Erlang Shen. Depicted as a black dog, it assists Erlang Shen in battle by using its powerful bite and howl to attack, maul, or subdue demons.

statement.id: Xiaotian Quan adalah anjing mitologis China yang menyertai dewa Erlang Shen.
statement.en: Xiaotian Quan is a Chinese mythological dog accompanying the god Erlang Shen.

basis_claims.quote: Depicted as a black dog, it assists Erlang Shen in battle by using its powerful bite and howl to attack, maul, or subdue demons.

statement.id: Ia membantu Erlang Shen melawan iblis melalui gigitan dan lolongannya.
statement.en: It helps Erlang Shen fight demons through its bite and howl.

basis_claims.quote: The Queen Mother of the West, moved by the dog's devotion to its master, spared it from punishment and granted it the title of "Tiangou", appointing it as guardian of the Southern Heavenly Gate. The dog later released the moon and eventually entered the service of the deity Erlang Shen, where it became known as Xiaotian Quan.

statement.id: Ibu Suri Barat, tersentuh oleh kesetiaan anjing itu kepada tuannya, mengampuninya dari hukuman dan menganugerahinya gelar "Tiangou" sebagai penjaga Gerbang Surga Selatan; anjing itu kemudian melepaskan bulan dan akhirnya mengabdi kepada dewa Erlang Shen, tempat ia dikenal sebagai Xiaotian Quan.
statement.en: The Queen Mother of the West, moved by the dog's devotion to its master, spared it from punishment and granted it the title "Tiangou" as guardian of the Southern Heavenly Gate; the dog later released the moon and eventually entered the service of Erlang Shen, where it became known as Xiaotian Quan.

basis_claims.quote: 爬將起來就跑。被二郎爺爺的細犬趕上，照腿肚子上一口，又扯了一跌。他睡倒在地，罵道：「這個亡人！你不去妨家長，卻來咬老孫！」

statement.id: Dalam teks 西遊記 bab ini, ketika seseorang berlari kabur, anjing kurus milik Erlang (二郎爺爺的細犬) mengejarnya, menggigit betisnya, dan menariknya jatuh; yang digigit mengumpat. Teks bab ini menyebutnya 細犬 dan tidak menyebut nama Xiaotian Quan.
statement.en: In this chapter of Journey to the West, as someone runs away, Erlang's thin dog (二郎爺爺的細犬) catches up, bites the calf and drags him down; the bitten one curses. The chapter calls it 細犬 and does not use the name Xiaotian Quan.

xolotl.depicted_variant: Dog-headed psychopomp with empty eye sockets and conch wind jewel.

visual_requirements.description: Dog-headed human deity
Empty eye sockets
Conch-like twisted wind jewel
Lightning from documented divine domain
Mictlan underworld route

xolotl.aura: Awe comes from lightning domain and dog-headed psychopomp protecting the sun (xolotl-c01, xolotl-c05, xolotl-c08).

basis_claims.quote: In Aztec mythology, Xolotl ... was a god of fire and lightning. He was commonly depicted as a dog-headed man and was a psychopomp. He was also god of twins, monsters, death, misfortune, sickness, and deformities.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Aztec, Xolotl adalah dewa api dan petir yang lazim digambarkan sebagai pria berkepala anjing dan menjadi psikopomp (pengantar jiwa). Ia juga dewa kembar, monster, kematian, kemalangan, penyakit, dan kecacatan.
statement.en: In Aztec mythology, Xolotl was a god of fire and lightning, commonly depicted as a dog-headed man and a psychopomp, and also god of twins, monsters, death, misfortune, sickness, and deformities.

basis_claims.quote: Xolotl was the sinister god of monstrosities who wears the conch-like ehēcailacacōcatl "twisted wind jewel" of Quetzalcōātl. His job was to protect the sun from the dangers of the underworld.

statement.id: Xolotl disebut dewa kengerian (monstrosities) yang sinis dan mengenakan permata angin berbentuk kerang milik Quetzalcōātl. Tugasnya melindungi matahari dari bahaya dunia bawah.
statement.en: Xolotl was the sinister god of monstrosities who wears the conch-like "twisted wind jewel" of Quetzalcōātl, and his job was to protect the sun from the dangers of the underworld.

basis_claims.quote: His empty eye sockets are explained in the legend of Teotihuacan, in which the gods decided to sacrifice themselves for the newly created sun. Xolotl withdrew from this sacrifice and wept so much that his eyes fell out of their sockets.

statement.id: Rongga matanya yang kosong dijelaskan dalam legenda Teotihuacan: ketika para dewa memutuskan mengorbankan diri demi matahari yang baru diciptakan, Xolotl mundur dari pengorbanan itu dan menangis begitu lama hingga matanya jatuh dari rongganya.
statement.en: Xolotl's empty eye sockets are explained by the Teotihuacan legend in which the gods decided to sacrifice themselves for the newly created sun; Xolotl withdrew from the sacrifice and wept so much that his eyes fell out of their sockets.

basis_claims.quote: As a psychopomp, Xolotl would guide the dead on their journey to Mictlān, the afterlife in myths. His two spirit animal forms are the xoloitzcuintle breed of dog and the aquatic salamander species known as the axolotl.

statement.id: Sebagai psikopomp, Xolotl menuntun orang mati dalam perjalanan ke Mictlān, alam baka dalam mitos. Dua wujud hewan rohnya adalah anjing ras xoloitzcuintle dan salamander air yang disebut axolotl.
statement.en: As a psychopomp, Xolotl would guide the dead on their journey to Mictlān, the afterlife in myths; his two spirit animal forms are the xoloitzcuintle dog breed and the aquatic salamander known as the axolotl.

basis_claims.quote: Xolotl was the dog god of the Mexica people, commonly known as the Aztecs. He is represented in codices, statuary, and other extant examples of Aztec art as a dog or a god with the head of a dog.

statement.id: Xolotl adalah dewa anjing bangsa Mexica, yang lazim dikenal sebagai Aztec. Dalam kodeks, arca, dan karya seni Aztec lain yang masih ada, ia digambarkan sebagai anjing atau dewa berkepala anjing.
statement.en: Xolotl was the dog god of the Mexica people, commonly known as the Aztecs, and is represented in codices, statuary, and other surviving Aztec art as a dog or a god with a dog's head.

yara-ma-yha-who.depicted_variant: Four-foot red toothless snake-headed humanoid with hand and foot suckers, daytime fig-tree ambush.

visual_requirements.description: Small red figure with huge snake-like head, belly and toothless mouth
Cup suckers at fingers and toes
Dropping tree ambush; no gore
Wild fig tree, daytime activity

yara-ma-yha-who.aura: Threat comes from oversized toothless swallowing mouth and octopus-like fingertip/toe suckers in descending ambush (yara-ma-yha-who-c04, yara-ma-yha-who-c05, yara-ma-yha-who-c15).

basis_claims.quote: The Yara-ma-yha-who is said to live in fig trees.

statement.id: Yara-ma-yha-who konon dikatakan bertempat tinggal di pepohonan ara.
statement.en: The Yara-ma-yha-who is said to dwell in fig trees.

basis_claims.quote: Yara-ma-yha-who A strange little red man who stands about four feet high. The biggest parts of him are his head, his mouth, and his stomach. He has no teeth in his mouth and simply swallows his food, and can even swallow a grown man.

statement.id: Yara-ma-yha-who adalah lelaki merah kecil yang tingginya sekitar empat kaki; bagian terbesarnya kepala, mulut, dan perut; mulutnya tak bergigi, ia menelan makanannya begitu saja, bahkan dapat menelan orang dewasa.
statement.en: Yara-ma-yha-who is a strange little red man about four feet high; the biggest parts of him are his head, mouth and stomach; he has no teeth, simply swallows his food, and can even swallow a grown man.

basis_claims.quote: He has no teeth in his mouth and simply swallows his food, and can even swallow a grown man. His head is something like a snake's, and he open his mouth just as a snake does. The points of his fingers and the tips of his toes are cup-shaped, like the suckers of an octopus.

statement.id: Kepalanya agak mirip kepala ular dan ia membuka mulut seperti ular; ujung jari tangan dan kakinya berbentuk cawan seperti pengisap gurita.
statement.en: His head is something like a snake's and he opens his mouth just as a snake does; the points of his fingers and the tips of his toes are cup-shaped, like the suckers of an octopus.

basis_claims.quote: They live mostly in thick, leafy trees, and prefer the wild fig tree. They do not hunt for their food but simply pounce upon a person, and place their hands and feet upon the victim, draining his blood.

statement.id: Makhluk-makhluk ini sebagian besar tinggal di pohon rimbun dan lebih suka pohon ara liar; mereka tidak berburu, melainkan menerkam seseorang, menempelkan tangan dan kaki ke korban, dan menguras darahnya.
statement.en: These creatures live mostly in thick, leafy trees and prefer the wild fig tree; they do not hunt but pounce upon a person, place their hands and feet upon the victim, and drain his blood.

basis_claims.quote: According to legend, the Yara-ma-yha-who is only active during the day and only targets living prey. "Playing dead" until sunset is offered as a ploy to avoid attack.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, Yara-ma-yha-who hanya aktif pada siang hari dan hanya menyasar mangsa yang hidup; "pura-pura mati" sampai matahari terbenam disebut sebagai siasat untuk menghindari serangan.
statement.en: According to legend, the Yara-ma-yha-who is only active during the day and only targets living prey; "playing dead" until sunset is offered as a ploy to avoid attack.

basis_claims.quote: Instead of hunting for food, it is described as waiting for an unsuspecting traveller to rest under the tree. The creature then drops down and uses its suckers to drain the victim's blood.

statement.id: Alih-alih berburu, makhluk ini digambarkan menunggu pengelana yang tak curiga beristirahat di bawah pohon, lalu menjatuhkan diri dan memakai pengisapnya untuk menguras darah korban.
statement.en: Instead of hunting, it is described as waiting for an unsuspecting traveller to rest under the tree, then dropping down and using its suckers to drain the victim's blood.

yazi.depicted_variant: Wild-dog-headed living Yazi in head-and-neck crop without invented lower-body anatomy.

visual_requirements.description: Wild dog head
Weapons/sword-hilt association, background otherwise unspecified

yazi.aura: Threat comes from fierce combat character and snarling wild-dog head (yazi-c02, yazi-c03).

basis_claims.quote: 睚眦（がいさい、拼音：Yázì）は、竜生九子の一つ。ヤマイヌの首をもち、気性が激しく荒く、争いや殺す事を好む。

statement.id: Ia memiliki kepala anjing liar.
statement.en: It has a wild dog’s head.

basis_claims.quote: 睚眦（がいさい、拼音：Yázì）は、竜生九子の一つ。ヤマイヌの首をもち、気性が激しく荒く、争いや殺す事を好む。

statement.id: Sifatnya ganas dan dikaitkan dengan pertempuran.
statement.en: Its character is fierce and associated with combat.

basis_claims.quote: よって、刀の環（刀を佩びるための輪）や、剣の鯉口、武器や罪人を処刑するための鎌や矛に彫られ、古代（三国志時代）には軍旗などの図案に多く用いられた。

statement.id: Gambarnya terdapat pada senjata dan panji militer.
statement.en: Its image appears on weapons and military banners.

basis_claims.quote: 龍生九子，不成龍，各有所好。囚牛，好音樂，以飾胡琴。睚眦，好殺，以飾刀柄。嘲風，好險，在殿角。蒲牢，好鳴，取為鐘紐。狻猊，好座，取為佛座。霸下，好負重，為碑座。狴犴，好訟，為獄門。屓屭，好文，在碑兩傍。蚩吻，好吞，在殿脊。

statement.id: Menurut Shuolue, sembilan putra naga bukan naga dan masing-masing punya kegemaran: Yazi gemar membunuh dan dipakai menghiasi gagang pedang; delapan lainnya adalah Qiuniu, Chaofeng, Pulao, Suanni, Baxia, Bi'an, Xixi, dan Chiwen.
statement.en: According to the Shuolue, the nine sons of the dragon are not dragons and each has its own fondness: Yazi likes killing and is used to adorn sword hilts; the others are Qiuniu, Chaofeng, Pulao, Suanni, Baxia, Bi'an, Xixi and Chiwen.

yellow-dragon.depicted_variant: animal-form Yellow Emperor manifestation embodying earth

visual_requirements.description: ONE living YELLOW CHINESE DRAGON head/two eyes with powerful scaled coiling neck. Broad noble dragon muzzle, ridged brow, long ochre whiskers, coarse beard/mane and two branching antlerlike horns are conventional editorial rendering of dragon category, not claimed exact source iconography. Body/limbs outside close crop. No wings.
Earth association represented by soil clinging to neck and ordinary contact dust only. No earthquake, cracking earth, beam, glowing aura or breath weapon.
Ordinary dark earthen ground at Chengji, where its appearance is recorded.

yellow-dragon.aura: RISE and turn its imposing head down toward the low viewer from dark ordinary soil, protective commanding gaze, dust rolling off neck; mouth open in a reverent powerful breath. Supported by yellow-dragon-c01, yellow-dragon-c03, yellow-dragon-c02, yellow-dragon-c03, yellow-dragon-c06.

basis_claims.quote: The Yellow Dragon (simplified Chinese: 黄龙; traditional Chinese: 黃龍; pinyin: Huánglóng; Cantonese Yale: Wong4 Lung4)  is the zoomorphic incarnation of the Yellow Emperor of the center of the universe in Chinese religion and mythology.

statement.id: Yellow Dragon adalah perwujudan berbentuk hewan dari Kaisar Kuning dalam mitologi Tiongkok.
statement.en: The Yellow Dragon is the animal-form manifestation of the Yellow Emperor in Chinese mythology.

basis_claims.quote: The Yellow Dragon is a part of Wuxing and the Four Symbols as the embodiment of the element of earth.

statement.id: Dalam Wuxing, naga ini melambangkan unsur bumi.
statement.en: In Wuxing, this dragon embodies the earth element.

basis_claims.quote: 中央，土也，其帝黃帝，其佐后土，執繩而制四方。其神為鎮星，其獸黃龍，其音宮，其日戊己。

statement.id: Huainanzi bab Tianwen xun (天文訓) menyebut bahwa pusat (中央) adalah tanah (土), kaisarnya Huangdi (黃帝), pembantunya Houtu (后土) yang memegang tali dan mengatur empat penjuru; rohnya adalah Zhenxing (鎮星) dan binatangnya (獸) adalah Naga Kuning (黃龍).
statement.en: The Huainanzi chapter Tianwen xun (天文訓) says the centre (中央) is earth (土), its emperor is Huangdi (黃帝), its assistant Houtu (后土), who holds the cord and governs the four directions; its spirit is Zhenxing (鎮星) and its beast (獸) is the Yellow Dragon (黃龍).

basis_claims.quote: 後三歲，黃龍見成紀。文帝乃召公孫臣，拜為博士，與諸生草改歷服色事。

statement.id: Shiji mencatat bahwa tiga tahun kemudian naga kuning muncul di Chengji (成紀); Kaisar Wen (文帝) lalu memanggil Gongsun Chen, mengangkatnya sebagai cendekiawan (博士), dan bersama para sarjana menyusun perubahan kalender dan warna busana.
statement.en: The Shiji records that three years later a yellow dragon appeared at Chengji (成紀); Emperor Wen (文帝) then summoned Gongsun Chen, appointed him an erudite (博士), and with the scholars drafted changes to the calendar and the colour of dress.

al-ana.depicted_variant: Oral-narrative elderly hairy woman variant, with the documented chest fully covered.

visual_requirements.description: An ugly elderly woman with a hairy body visible on her covered neck and hands, very long straight hair, a red hat carrying one fern twig; one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs. Fully opaque heavy clothing conceals her enormous chest; no bare breasts.
No supernatural visual effects; the documented baby-stealing menace is conveyed by her approach only, with no child depicted.
Thickets beside a river.

al-ana.aura: Push through dense wet riverside thickets, bending toward the viewer with one grasping hand thrust forward. Supported by al-ana-c02, al-ana-c03, al-ana-c01.

basis_claims.quote: is a female fatal spirit or demon in Turkic folklore. Al Ana was said to live in thickets near rivers, streams and lakes.

statement.id: Al Ana adalah roh atau iblis perempuan pembawa maut dalam cerita rakyat Turkik yang konon tinggal di semak dekat sungai, kali, dan danau.
statement.en: Al Ana is a deadly female spirit or demon of Turkic folklore said to live in thickets by rivers, streams and lakes.

basis_claims.quote: According to some oral narratives, she took the form of an ugly, old woman with a hairy body, long straight hair and breasts so huge that she uses them to wash her clothes. On her head she wore a red hat with a fern twig attached to it.

statement.id: Menurut sebagian cerita lisan, ia berwujud perempuan tua buruk rupa, berbulu, berambut panjang lurus, dengan payudara begitu besar hingga dipakai mencuci pakaiannya, serta bertopi merah berhias ranting pakis.
statement.en: In some oral tales she is an ugly old woman with a hairy body, long straight hair and breasts so huge she washes her clothes with them, wearing a red hat with a fern twig.

basis_claims.quote: Al Ana was said to kidnap human babies just after they were born and replace them with her own children, known as foundlings or changelings.

statement.id: Al Ana konon menculik bayi manusia sesaat setelah lahir dan menggantinya dengan anaknya sendiri, anak tukaran.
statement.en: Al Ana was said to steal newborn babies and replace them with her own children, changelings.

animikii.depicted_variant: Giant thunderbird in reverent awe, without unrecorded iconography.

visual_requirements.description: One enormous bird with one head, two eyes, two powerful wings and two bird legs; no invented horns, extra faces or ornaments.
Enormous wingbeats churn the storm clouds physically; thunder is the documented power, without invented lightning bolts or fire.
Storm clouds surrounding the giant thunderbird; no specific landscape invented.

animikii.aura: Beat both immense wings downward toward the viewer, descending through dense clouds. Supported by animikii-c01, animikii-c02, animikii-c04.

basis_claims.quote: Animikii (Binesi, Wapoothi, Waputhi), Animikii je divovska mitološka ptica gromovnik uobičajena za sjeverna i zapadna plemena sjevernoameričkih Indijanaca Ojibwe, Algonquin, Ottawa i Shawnee.

statement.id: Animikii adalah burung petir raksasa mitologis bagi suku Ojibwe, Algonquin, Ottawa, dan Shawnee.
statement.en: Animikii is a giant mythological thunderbird common to the Ojibwe, Algonquin, Ottawa, and Shawnee tribes.

basis_claims.quote: Uzrokuju grmaljavinu udarcima njihovih golemih krila.

statement.id: Mereka menyebabkan guntur dengan kepakan sayap raksasa mereka.
statement.en: They cause thunder with the beating of their enormous wings.

basis_claims.quote: Animikii is a giant mythological thunder-bird common to the northern and western tribes. Thunder is caused by the beating of their immense wings.

statement.id: Animikii adalah burung guntur mitologis raksasa yang dikenal di suku-suku utara dan barat. Guntur disebabkan oleh kepakan sayap mereka yang sangat besar.
statement.en: Animikii is a giant mythological thunderbird common to the northern and western tribes. Thunder is caused by the beating of their immense wings.

basis_claims.quote: Although thunderbirds are very powerful beings, they rarely bother humans, and are treated with reverence by Ojibwe people.

statement.id: Meski burung guntur adalah makhluk yang sangat kuat, mereka jarang mengganggu manusia dan diperlakukan dengan hormat oleh orang Ojibwe.
statement.en: Although thunderbirds are very powerful beings, they rarely bother humans and are treated with reverence by the Ojibwe.

visual_requirements.description: One dog head, two eyes, a red-feathered bird body, two huge red wings and two tiger-clawed legs; only one head.
Rebirth from its own ashes: real embers and ash scatter from the nest beneath the rising bird, no magical ribbons.
A summit nest on Mount Kaf.

anka.aura: Rise from hot ash at the mountain summit with wings heaving upward and tiger claws reaching toward camera. Supported by anka-c02, anka-c02, anka-c03.

basis_claims.quote: Anka (Farsça, Anka): Kızıl renkli devasa kuş. Kaf dağında yaşar. Köpek başlı, kaplan pençeli olarak tasvir edildiği de olur. Kendi küllerinden yeniden doğar.

statement.id: Kamus Mitologi Turki karya Karakurt mendefinisikan Anka (dari bahasa Persia) sebagai burung raksasa berwarna merah, yang tinggal di Gunung Kaf, kadang digambarkan berkepala anjing dan bercakar harimau, dan lahir kembali dari abunya sendiri.
statement.en: Karakurt's Dictionary of Turkic Mythology defines Anka (Persian) as a giant red-coloured bird that lives on Mount Kaf, sometimes depicted with a dog's head and tiger claws, and is reborn from its own ashes.

basis_claims.quote: Anka Kuşu (eski Türk inancında Toğrul ve Kongrul Kuşları) burada yaşar ve yuvasını bu dağın zirvesine kurmuştur.

statement.id: Dalam entri Gunung Kaf, burung Anka (dalam kepercayaan Turki lama adalah burung Toğrul dan Kongrul) disebut hidup di sana dan membuat sarangnya di puncak gunung itu.
statement.en: In the Mount Kaf entry, the Anka bird (in old Turkic belief the Toğrul and Kongrul birds) is said to live there and to have built its nest on the summit.

ao-guang.depicted_variant: East Sea Dragon King coming out of his palace to greet his guest

visual_requirements.description: ONE royal Dragon King portrayed as an anthropomorphic Chinese dragon ruler, one dragon head/two eyes, two human-shaped arms/two legs within fully OPAQUE layered royal robes, ordinary hands with five fingers. Dragon muzzle, beard, whiskers and two modest horns are conventional editorial rendering of Dragon King category, not claim-specific anatomy. Crown and opaque antique-gold/sea-green brocade are editorial king-costume choices. No tiny snake.
TORRENTIAL RAIN descends physically around the King, who provides rain in Journey to the West c10; no fire, iron staff, aura or water-energy ribbons.
Palace of the East Sea Dragon King; threshold and open doors with falling water visible, royal architecture editorial and uninscribed.

ao-guang.aura: RISE from the palace threshold and stride toward the low viewer in a powerful royal greeting, one open hand welcoming, other hand held outward as rain pours across the palace approach; robes pulled by weather. Supported by ao-guang-c01, ao-guang-c11, ao-guang-c10, ao-guang-c01, ao-guang-c11.

basis_claims.quote: Ao Guang (Chinese: 敖光; pinyin: Áo Guāng; or traditional Chinese: 敖廣; simplified Chinese: 敖广; pinyin: Áo Guǎng) is the Dragon King of the East Sea in Chinese folklore. He is a famous figure in Asian mythology, folk-lore and folk-religion combined. He featured prominently in different classical works including Fengshen Yanyi and Journey to the West.

statement.id: Ao Guang adalah Raja Naga Laut Timur dalam cerita rakyat Tiongkok.
statement.en: Ao Guang is the East Sea Dragon King in Chinese folklore.

basis_claims.quote: Ao Guang provides torrential rain in an attempt to stop Red Boy's fire, but the fire cannot be stopped by ordinary water.

statement.id: Dalam Journey to the West, Ao Guang menurunkan hujan deras untuk menghentikan api Red Boy, tetapi api itu tidak dapat dipadamkan air biasa.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, Ao Guang provides torrential rain to try to stop Red Boy's fire, but the fire cannot be stopped by ordinary water.

basis_claims.quote: 外面有個花果山天生聖人孫悟空，口稱是大王緊鄰，將到宮也。」東海龍王敖廣即忙起身，與龍子、龍孫、蝦兵、蟹將出宮迎道：「上仙請進，請進。」

statement.id: Dalam teks bab ini, seorang penjaga melapor bahwa Sun Wukong dari gunung 花果山 telah datang; Raja Naga Laut Timur Ao Guang bergegas bangkit dan, bersama putra naga, cucu naga, prajurit udang, dan jenderal kepiting, keluar dari istana menyambutnya dengan "Silakan masuk".
statement.en: In this chapter's text, an attendant reports that Sun Wukong of the mountain 花果山 has arrived; the Dragon King of the East Sea Ao Guang hurriedly rises and, with his dragon sons, dragon grandsons, shrimp soldiers and crab generals, comes out of the palace to greet him, saying "Please come in".

bai-ze.depicted_variant: History of Yuan tiger-headed, red-maned dragon-bodied variant without unrecorded horn.

visual_requirements.description: One tiger head with two eyes, a red mane and no horn, joined to a long dragon body; one head only, no cow body or human faces.
No invented power effect; reverent authority comes from the documented divine-beast anatomy and knowledge.
The coast below Mount Huan.

bai-ze.aura: Turn and lean its tiger head down toward the viewer, red mane moving as the long dragon body coils behind. Supported by bai-ze-c04, bai-ze-c07, bai-ze-c07.

basis_claims.quote: In the Ming Dynasty book SanCai TuHui (三才圖會), Bai Ze’s appearance is described as having green hair on a loong head, with a horn growing on the top and the ability to fly. In the History of Yuan (元史), it is recorded as having the head of a tiger, red mane, loong’s body, and a horn. Bai Ze’s image in China combines features of both the loong and tiger.

statement.id: History of Yuan memberikan varian kepala harimau, surai merah, dan tubuh naga.
statement.en: The History of Yuan gives a variant with a tiger head, red mane, and dragon body.

basis_claims.quote: 帝巡狩東至海，登桓山，於海濱得白澤神獸，能言，達於萬物之情。因問天下鬼神之事，自古精氣為物，游魂為變者，凡萬一千五百二十種，白澤言之，帝令以圖寫之以示天下，帝乃作《祝邪之文》以祝之。

statement.id: Menurut Yunji Qiqian, Kaisar Kuning dalam perjalanan keliling ke timur sampai laut, mendaki Gunung Huan, dan di pantai mendapatkan binatang gaib Bai Ze yang dapat berbicara dan memahami keadaan segala hal. Ia bertanya tentang urusan hantu dan roh; Bai Ze menyebutkan 11.520 jenis, kaisar memerintahkan agar digambar untuk ditunjukkan ke seluruh dunia, dan menyusun naskah penangkal kejahatan.
statement.en: According to the Yunji Qiqian, the Yellow Emperor, touring east to the sea and climbing Mount Huan, obtained the divine beast Bai Ze on the coast; it could speak and understood the nature of all things. He asked about ghosts and spirits; Bai Ze named 11,520 kinds, the emperor had them drawn to show the world, and composed a text for warding off evil.

bal-bal.depicted_variant: Older Tagbanua winged manlike thatch-tearing variant.

visual_requirements.description: One manlike head, two eyes, two arms with large curved claws, two wings, two legs, and one exceptionally long tongue; body covered with fully opaque worn cloth.
Physical tearing of thatch by curved nails, with the long tongue probing the opening; no corpses or gore visible.
A thatched house during a burial vigil, shown only as the roof and dark interior.

bal-bal.aura: Claw open a thatch roof, one wing raised, its long tongue thrust down through the opening toward the dark room. Supported by bal-bal-c15, bal-bal-c16, bal-bal-c12.

basis_claims.quote: In Philippine mythology, a Bal-Bal is an undead monster that steals corpses whether it is in a funeral or grave and feeds on them. It has a strong sense of smell for dead human bodies. It also has claws and teeth sharp enough to rip the clothing of the dead. Since it eats nothing but corpses, it has a foul breath.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Filipina, bal-bal adalah monster mayat hidup yang mencuri dan memakan jenazah di rumah duka atau kubur, berpenciuman tajam terhadap mayat, bercakar dan bergigi tajam, dan bernapas busuk.
statement.en: In Philippine mythology, the bal-bal is an undead monster that steals and eats corpses from wakes or graves, with a keen nose for bodies, sharp claws and teeth, and foul breath.

basis_claims.quote: Dean C. Worcester (Philippine Islands) wrote a vivid description of the balbal which the Tagbanua believe in: ... In form it is manlike, with curved nails which it uses to tear up the thatch houses, and a long tongue with which it reaches down to “lick up” the bodies

statement.id: Dalam uraian Dean C. Worcester, balbal berwujud mirip manusia, dengan kuku melengkung yang dipakai untuk merobek rumah beratap rumbia dan lidah panjang untuk "menjilat" jenazah.
statement.en: In Dean C. Worcester's description the balbal is manlike, with curved nails used to tear up thatch houses and a long tongue with which it reaches down to "lick up" the bodies.

basis_claims.quote: While a Tagbanua corpse is above ground it is liable to be eaten by a vampire called the balbal that lives on Mindanao, has the form of a man with wings and great claws

statement.id: Menurut buku itu, selama jenazah Tagbanua masih di atas tanah, jenazah itu dapat dimakan oleh vampir bernama balbal yang tinggal di Mindanao dan berwujud manusia bersayap dengan cakar besar.
statement.en: According to the book, while a Tagbanua corpse is above ground it is liable to be eaten by a vampire called the balbal that lives on Mindanao and has the form of a man with wings and great claws.

basis_claims.quote: tears open the thatch of houses and consumes bodies by means of a long tongue, which it thrusts through the opening in the roof.

statement.id: Balbal merobek atap rumbia rumah dan melahap jenazah dengan lidah panjang yang dijulurkannya melalui lubang di atap.
statement.en: The balbal tears open the thatch of houses and consumes bodies by means of a long tongue which it thrusts through the opening in the roof.

ball-tailed-cat.depicted_variant: Smooth solid ball-tail variant; no spiked Sliver Cat features.

visual_requirements.description: One cougar-like cat with one head, two eyes, four paws, and one exceptionally long tail terminating in a single solid smooth heavy ball; no spikes.
The ball tail strikes a dead branch and throws physical wood splinters, a non-gory illustration of its documented striking use.
A dim wooded logging-camp edge.

ball-tailed-cat.aura: Lunge directly forward while the long tail swings its enormous ball end across the foreground toward the viewer. Supported by ball-tailed-cat-c01, ball-tailed-cat-c07, ball-tailed-cat-c06.

basis_claims.quote: is a fearsome critter of North American folklore most commonly described as having similar traits to that of a mountain lion, except with an exceedingly long tail to which there is affixed a solid, bulbous mass for striking its prey.

statement.id: Ball-tailed cat adalah "fearsome critter" Amerika Utara yang mirip singa gunung, tetapi berekor sangat panjang dengan gumpalan padat di ujungnya untuk memukul mangsa.
statement.en: The ball-tailed cat is a North American fearsome critter like a mountain lion but with a very long tail ending in a solid ball for striking prey.

basis_claims.quote: Fearsome critters were an integral part of oral tradition in North American logging camps during the turn of the twentieth century, principally as a means to pass time (such as in tall tales) or as a jest for hazing newcomers.

statement.id: Fearsome critters adalah bagian penting tradisi lisan di kamp penebangan kayu Amerika Utara pada pergantian abad ke-20, terutama untuk mengisi waktu (seperti dalam cerita bual) atau sebagai lelucon untuk mengerjai pendatang baru.
statement.en: Fearsome critters were an integral part of oral tradition in North American logging camps around the turn of the twentieth century, principally as a way to pass time (as in tall tales) or as a jest for hazing newcomers.

basis_claims.quote: Ball-tailed cat, a feline similar to a mountain lion, except with a long tail with a bulbous end used for striking its prey.

statement.id: Ball-tailed cat adalah kucing besar yang mirip puma, kecuali berekor panjang dengan ujung membulat yang dipakai untuk memukul mangsanya.
statement.en: The ball-tailed cat is a feline similar to a mountain lion, except with a long tail with a bulbous end used for striking its prey.

beaman-monster.depicted_variant: Sasquatch-like reported variant; no transfer of its alleged father's twelve-foot height.

visual_requirements.description: One ape-like hairy Sasquatch figure with one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs; no wolf head, no invented horns or glowing eyes.
No documented power; natural stalks bend and dust rises from its movement only.
A cornfield near Beaman and Sedalia.

beaman-monster.aura: Force apart tall corn stalks with both hands and surge toward the viewer with bared ordinary ape teeth. Supported by beaman-monster-c06, beaman-monster-c08, beaman-monster-c08.

basis_claims.quote: Most describe or think of the Beaman Monster as a type of Sasquatch, but one Sedalia man remembers it as being shaped like a wolf or coyote.

statement.id: Menurut laporan itu, kebanyakan orang menganggap Beaman Monster sejenis Sasquatch, tetapi seorang pria Sedalia mengingatnya berbentuk seperti serigala atau koyote.
statement.en: According to the report, most people think of the Beaman Monster as a type of Sasquatch, but one Sedalia man remembers it as shaped like a wolf or coyote.

basis_claims.quote: Holman also remembers an uncle, who lived on Glenn Road, telling a story about a commotion in his cornfield in the late 1950s. "People were out there with all kinds of shotguns walking through his cornfield," he said. "They were hunting that Beaman Monster."

statement.id: Seorang warga mengingat pamannya bercerita tentang keributan di ladang jagungnya pada akhir 1950-an, ketika orang-orang membawa berbagai senapan berburu menyisir ladang itu untuk memburu Beaman Monster.
statement.en: A resident recalled an uncle telling of a commotion in his cornfield in the late 1950s, when people with all kinds of shotguns walked through the field hunting the Beaman Monster.

bramrachokh.depicted_variant: Documented forehead-eye and fire-pot manifestation; unstated lower anatomy omitted.

visual_requirements.description: A tight head-and-shoulder spirit close-up with one head balancing a large pot full of real fire and exactly one clearly visible bright eye centered on the forehead; ordinary eye area entirely concealed in shadow under an opaque hood, no invented extra eyes.
The documented forehead eye shines brightly and the pot contains physical flames; their deceptive light illuminates the dangerous edge.
A desolate waste place beside a ditch and cave.

bramrachokh.aura: Lean from the dark beside a chasm toward the viewer, forehead eye facing camera as the fiery pot tilts forward without spilling. Supported by bramrachokh-c03, bramrachokh-c04, bramrachokh-c05.

basis_claims.quote: is a demon or mythical creature who inhabits desolate areas and fools travellers by pretending to be a light, in the manner of a will-o'-the-wisp.

statement.id: Bramrachokh adalah makhluk Kashmir yang mendiami tempat sepi dan memperdaya pelancong dengan cahaya.
statement.en: Bramrachokh is a Kashmiri creature inhabiting desolate places and misleading travelers with light.

basis_claims.quote: Bramrachokh has a pot full of fire balanced on his head,

statement.id: Ia membawa periuk penuh api di atas kepala.
statement.en: He balances a pot full of fire on his head.

basis_claims.quote: and on his forehead a strong, shining eye.

statement.id: Di dahinya terdapat mata yang bersinar terang.
statement.en: On his forehead is a brightly shining eye.

basis_claims.quote: It is said that if a traveller encounters Bramrachokh's light in a remote location, it will lead them to a ditch or a cave, or to their death.

statement.id: Cahayanya dikatakan menuntun pelancong ke parit, gua, atau kematian.
statement.en: His light is said to lead travelers to a ditch, cave, or death.

bulgasari-creature.depicted_variant: Korean Encyclopedia documented bear-shaped variant, shown actively eating metal.

visual_requirements.description: One enormous bear-shaped mythical beast, one bear head with two eyes, four bear legs, no elephant trunk or rhinoceros horn borrowed from alternative composite variants.
Physically devour bent metal with broken iron fragments beneath its mouth, reflecting metal consumption and bodily growth; no invented fire immunity effect.
A dark grounded setting filled with discarded iron implements from the documented metal-eating tale.

bulgasari-creature.aura: Crush and bite iron swords and metal implements while planting its forepaws toward the camera. Supported by bulgasari-creature-c12, bulgasari-creature-c10, bulgasari-creature-c10.

basis_claims.quote: 중은 벽장에 숨어 밥을 먹으며 밥풀로 괴상한 짐승을 만들었다. ... 쇠붙이를 닥치는 대로 먹어치워서 몸집이 점점 거대해졌고

statement.id: Dalam kisah ini, seorang biksu yang bersembunyi di lemari dinding membuat binatang aneh dari butir nasi; binatang itu memakan logam apa saja sehingga tubuhnya terus membesar.
statement.en: In this tale a monk hiding in a wall cupboard makes a strange beast out of grains of rice; the beast eats any metal it finds and its body grows ever larger.

basis_claims.quote: 나라에서 괴물을 죽이려고 활과 칼을 써봐도 소용이 없자 불을 질러 없애려고 했다. 그러나 괴물은 죽지 않고 불덩이가 된 몸으로 돌아다녀 곳곳이 불바다가 되었다.

statement.id: Ketika busur dan pedang yang dipakai negara untuk membunuh makhluk itu tidak berguna, mereka mencoba membakarnya; tetapi ia tidak mati dan berkeliling dengan tubuh yang menjadi bola api sehingga banyak tempat menjadi lautan api.
statement.en: When the bows and swords the state used to kill the creature proved useless, they tried to burn it away; but it did not die and roamed about with its body turned into a ball of fire, so that places everywhere became seas of flame.

basis_claims.quote: 『대동운부군옥(大東韻府群玉)』에 따르면 불가사리는 상상의 짐승으로 곰같이 생겼으며 악몽과 요사한 기운을 물리친다고 했다고 했다. 불가사리는 설화에서는 환상 속 괴물로 형상화 되지만, 민속에서는 재앙과 화재를 예방해 주는 존재로 여겨 병풍이나 굴뚝에 그려넣기도 한다.

statement.id: Menurut 『대동운부군옥』, bulgasari adalah binatang khayalan yang berwujud seperti beruang dan menangkal mimpi buruk serta energi jahat; dalam adat rakyat ia dianggap pencegah bencana dan kebakaran sehingga digambar pada paravan atau cerobong.
statement.en: According to the 『대동운부군옥』, the bulgasari is an imaginary beast shaped like a bear that wards off nightmares and evil energy; in folk custom it is regarded as preventing disaster and fire and is drawn on folding screens or chimneys.

caboclo-de-agua.depicted_variant: Giant bronze one-eyed variant, choosing it over the conflicting short copper-coloured account.

visual_requirements.description: One giant muscular humanoid with bronze skin, exactly one huge eye centered on its head, two arms and two legs; fully opaque dark waist cloth covers all intimate anatomy.
Physically overturn a canoe and churn river spray, a documented deed; no invented beams or glowing skin.
The Sao Francisco River.

caboclo-de-agua.aura: Rear out of river water toward the viewer while one immense hand tips a small canoe sideways. Supported by caboclo-de-agua-c02, caboclo-de-agua-c10, caboclo-de-agua-c01.

basis_claims.quote: El Caboclo de Agua es un ser mitológico del nordeste de Brasil que supuestamente habita en el fondo de las aguas del Río São Francisco en una gruta de oro y se dedica a asustar a pescadores y navegantes.

statement.id: Caboclo de Agua adalah makhluk mitologi dari timur laut Brasil yang konon tinggal di dasar Sungai São Francisco dalam gua emas dan menakut-nakuti nelayan serta pelaut.
statement.en: The Caboclo de Agua is a mythological being of northeastern Brazil said to live at the bottom of the São Francisco River in a golden grotto, frightening fishermen and boatmen.

basis_claims.quote: Los nativos lo describen como un ser gigante y musculoso, con piel de color bronce y un único ojo gigante en la cabeza.

statement.id: Penduduk setempat menggambarkannya sebagai makhluk raksasa berotot, berkulit perunggu, dengan satu mata besar di kepala.
statement.en: Locals describe it as a giant, muscular being with bronze skin and a single huge eye.

basis_claims.quote: compadres do caboclo-d'água, e persegue ferozmente aos pescadores e barranqueiros, com que antipatiza, virando canoas,

statement.id: Menurut Cascudo, ia berpihak pada para sahabat dan kompadrenya, tetapi memburu dengan ganas para nelayan dan penghuni tepi sungai yang tidak disukainya, antara lain dengan membalikkan kano.
statement.en: According to Cascudo, it favours its friends and compadres but fiercely pursues the fishermen and riverbank dwellers it dislikes, among other things by overturning canoes.

cavalo-do-pensamento.depicted_variant: Sarmento fire-eyed, fire-mouthed horse variant; speed depicted as grounded galloping, not unsupported flight.

visual_requirements.description: One horse with one head, two eyes, four legs and one tail, no wings or horns.
Real fire jets from both eyes and the mouth as explicitly documented; sparks and kicked earth stream behind, no flight or wings.
The grounded route toward a home entrance and a fig tree, both small behind the galloping horse.

cavalo-do-pensamento.aura: Gallop toward the viewer at overwhelming speed, forelegs driving into the earth. Supported by cavalo-do-pensamento-c02, cavalo-do-pensamento-c02, cavalo-do-pensamento-c04.

basis_claims.quote: Bem, agora escolhe: em qual queres ir, no cavalo do vento ou no do pensamento? –O rapaz escolheu o do pensamento, e apareceu-lhe logo um cavalo que deitava fogo pelos olhos e pela boca.

statement.id: Dalam sebuah kisah, seorang pemuda diminta memilih pergi dengan kuda angin atau kuda pikiran; ia memilih kuda pikiran, dan muncullah seekor kuda yang menyemburkan api dari mata dan mulutnya.
statement.en: In a tale a youth is asked to choose whether to go on the horse of the wind or the horse of thought; he chooses the horse of thought, and a horse appears that spits fire from its eyes and mouth.

basis_claims.quote: Enquanto o diabo esfrega um olho, viu-se à porta de casa. Pendurou-se como o Mouro tinha mandado, num dos ramos da figueira e disse: arre burro com todos os diabos! O cavalo deu um estoiro e desapareceu, como coisa má

statement.id: Dalam sekejap ia sudah berada di depan pintu rumahnya; ketika ia mengucapkan kata-kata yang dipesankan, kuda itu meledak dengan dentuman dan lenyap, seperti sesuatu yang jahat.
statement.en: In the blink of an eye he found himself at his front door; when he spoke the words he had been told, the horse burst with a bang and disappeared, like an evil thing.

chashkel.depicted_variant: Living giant before defeat, with his trained hunting dogs; no mutilation or dead victims.

visual_requirements.description: One enormous humanlike giant, one head with two eyes, two arms and two legs, fully opaque rough hide garments; no invented horns, extra eyes or weapons.
No magical power effect; natural mud splashes from his stride, and the documented hunting dogs follow without gore.
The bank of the Mac Lelan river beside the giant's hut.

chashkel.aura: Stride from the riverside hut toward the viewer, bending down with one powerful grasping hand, dogs rushing behind his feet. Supported by chashkel-c01, chashkel-c07, chashkel-c03.

basis_claims.quote: En la mitología selknam, Chashkel, Cháskilts o Čáskels era un gigante antropófago.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Selknam, Chashkel adalah raksasa pemakan manusia.
statement.en: In Selknam mythology, Chashkel was an anthropophagous giant.

basis_claims.quote: Chashkel vivía a orillas del río Mac Lelan

statement.id: Chashkel berdiam di sepanjang tepi sungai Mac Lelan di Tierra del Fuego.
statement.en: Chashkel inhabited the banks along the Mac Lelan river.

basis_claims.quote: Chashkel tenía varios perros a los cuales adiestraba especialmente para perseguir y matar personas. Estos perros devoraban a sus presas, o bien las llevaban a la choza del gigante.

statement.id: Chashkel memiliki beberapa anjing yang ia latih khusus untuk memburu dan membunuh manusia; anjing-anjing itu memakan mangsanya atau membawanya ke gubuk sang raksasa.
statement.en: Chashkel had several dogs he specially trained to hunt and kill people; the dogs devoured their prey or brought it to the giant's hut.

chullachaki.depicted_variant: Short ragged fist-challenger variant with one hoof foot; preserve shortness through close camera, not giant scale.

visual_requirements.description: One very short ugly adult man in fully opaque ragged clothes, one head, two eyes, two arms and two unequal-length legs; one ordinary human foot and one clearly exposed larger hoof-shaped foot.
No visible curse or invented shapeshifting glow; the documented challenge and anatomy provide the unsettling moment.
Dense Amazonian forest.

chullachaki.aura: Advance with both clenched fists raised in a direct challenge to the viewer, the mismatched feet planted visibly in the foreground. Supported by chullachaki-c02, chullachaki-c10, chullachaki-c01.

basis_claims.quote: is a mythical forest creature of the Peruvian and Brazilian Amazonian jungle.

statement.id: Chullachaki adalah makhluk hutan mitos dari rimba Amazon Peru dan Brasil.
statement.en: The Chullachaki is a mythical forest creature of the Peruvian and Brazilian Amazon.

basis_claims.quote: He is generally described as short and ugly, with one leg shorter than the other and one foot either larger than the other, pointed backward or in the form of a hoof.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan pendek dan buruk rupa, dengan satu kaki lebih pendek dan satu telapak lebih besar, terbalik, atau berbentuk kuku.
statement.en: He is short and ugly, with one leg shorter and one foot larger, backward-pointing or hoof-shaped.

basis_claims.quote: Others say that he appears in the shape of a very short man dressed in rags, waving his closed fists in the air looking for a fight.

statement.id: Menurut sebagian orang, ia tampil sebagai lelaki sangat pendek berpakaian compang-camping yang mengacungkan kepalan tangan sambil mencari perkelahian.
statement.en: Others say he appears as a very short man dressed in rags, waving his closed fists in the air looking for a fight.

chuzalongo.depicted_variant: the small pale blond backward-footed Andean humanoid

visual_requirements.description: One small humanoid about one metre tall, one head, two pale-blue eyes, long blond hair, white skin, two arms and two legs, both feet rotated180degrees with toes pointing backwards; fully opaque rough cloak and trousers, bare reversed feet clearly visible
A violent physical gust lifts grit and small stones across the ledge, grounded in the documented blow of wind; no victims, no sexual scenario
Andean crags in Ecuador

chuzalongo.aura: A violent physical gust lifts grit and small stones across the ledge, grounded in the documented blow of wind; no victims, no sexual scenario [chuzalongo-c11]

basis_claims.quote: El chuzalongo o chuhuajinu, chiro o indio del monte es una criatura fantástica de la mitología del Ecuador, habitante de las peñas de los Andes.

statement.id: Chuzalongo adalah makhluk gaib dalam mitologi Ekuador yang menghuni tebing bebatuan Andes.
statement.en: The Chuzalongo is a creature in Ecuadorian mythology inhabiting Andean crags.

basis_claims.quote: siempre es descrito como un ser de rasgos humanoides, pequeño como un niño de 6 años

statement.id: Selalu digambarkan berwujud humanoid kerdil seukuran anak berusia enam tahun.
statement.en: It is consistently described as a humanoid being, small as a six-year-old child.

basis_claims.quote: siempre es descrito como un ser de rasgos humanoides, pequeño como un niño de 6 años, y de larga cabellera, que puede ser rubia, y de tez blanca y ojos celestes.

statement.id: Ia selalu digambarkan sebagai makhluk berciri mirip manusia, sekecil anak berusia 6 tahun, berambut panjang yang bisa pirang, berkulit putih, dan bermata biru muda.
statement.en: It is always described as a being with humanoid features, small as a 6-year-old child, with long hair that may be blond, white skin and light-blue eyes.

basis_claims.quote: Hay versiones que lo describen con sus pies vueltos hacia atrás, lo cual le serviría para burlar a sus perseguidores.

statement.id: Ada versi yang menggambarkannya dengan kaki terbalik ke belakang, yang membantunya mengelabui para pengejarnya.
statement.en: Some versions describe it with its feet turned backwards, which would help it elude its pursuers.

basis_claims.quote: Se le considera que no es un ser malhumorado, aunque, en caso de irritarse, puede llegar a asesinar a las personas con un golpe de viento.

statement.id: Ia dianggap tidak berwatak pemarah, tetapi bila terganggu ia dapat membunuh orang dengan satu embusan angin.
statement.en: It is considered not to be ill-tempered, but if irritated it can kill people with a blow of wind.

basis_claims.quote: Su descripción física, aunque variable, lo asimila a un "duende de un metro de altura"

statement.id: Sebuah laporan independen menyatakan bahwa rupa fisiknya, meski bervariasi, menyerupai "duende setinggi satu meter".
statement.en: An independent report says its physical description, though variable, likens it to a "duende one metre tall".

ciguapa.depicted_variant: the long-haired backward-footed adult forest being

visual_requirements.description: One adult womanlike being, one head, two eyes, knee-length long hair, two arms and two long legs, both bare feet reversed180degrees so toes point behind the direction of travel; both feet fully visible. Fully opaque loose high-neck long-sleeved dark dress ending above ankles, no exposed torso
No visible magical beams or aura: predatory attraction expressed by documented eyes and song through focused gaze and parted lips
Mountain forest and river in El Cibao at night

ciguapa.aura: No visible magical beams or aura: predatory attraction expressed by documented eyes and song through focused gaze and parted lips [ciguapa-c06, ciguapa-c08]

basis_claims.quote: it is typically described as a back-footed nude woman with knee-length hair, with siren-like magic powers of attraction, seducing men that wander the forests at night.

statement.id: Ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai perempuan telanjang berkaki terbalik dan berambut sepanjang lutut yang memikat laki-laki di hutan pada malam hari.
statement.en: She is typically a backward-footed nude woman with knee-length hair who seduces men wandering the forests at night.

basis_claims.quote: The ciguapa's legendary home are the forests and rivers in the mountains of El Cibao.

statement.id: Rumahnya dalam legenda adalah hutan dan sungai di pegunungan El Cibao.
statement.en: Her legendary home is the forests and rivers of the El Cibao mountains.

basis_claims.quote: mirar a sus pies, pues los tienen al ... dejan huellas contrarias al rumbo que llevan.

statement.id: Menurut Instituto Cervantes, cara mengenali ciguapa adalah melihat kakinya, yang meninggalkan jejak berlawanan dengan arah jalannya.
statement.en: According to the Instituto Cervantes, a ciguapa is identified by looking at her feet, which leave tracks contrary to the direction she is heading.

basis_claims.quote: Ellas embrujan a los hombres con su hermosura, sus ojos y su canto, los aman hasta la saciedad y luego los matan.

statement.id: Ciguapa memikat laki-laki dengan keindahan, mata, dan nyanyiannya, mencintai mereka sampai puas, lalu membunuh mereka.
statement.en: Ciguapas bewitch men with their beauty, eyes, and song, love them to satiety, and then kill them.

basis_claims.quote: Nunca se les ha visto hablar, pero ... emitir una suerte rara de aullidos suaves y musicales

statement.id: Ciguapa tidak pernah terlihat berbicara, tetapi (menurut artikel itu) mengeluarkan sejenis lolongan lembut dan merdu.
statement.en: Ciguapas have never been seen to speak, but they emit a strange sort of soft, musical howls.

basis_claims.quote: otros indican que tienen el cuerpo cubierto de vellos muy finos, otros ... afirman que son altas, delgadas y de piernas largas

statement.id: Menurut artikel itu, sebagian orang menyebut tubuh ciguapa tertutup bulu yang sangat halus, sedangkan yang lain menyebutnya tinggi, ramping, dan berkaki panjang.
statement.en: According to the article, some say the ciguapa has a body covered in very fine hair, while others say she is tall, slender, and long-legged.

cihuateteo.depicted_variant: one of the Cihuateteo divine women in documented white-faced orange-haired iconography

visual_requirements.description: One representative female spirit with one head, two eyes, two arms and two legs; face dead-white and arms/hands powdered white, swirling unkempt orange hair, bared ordinary human teeth and gums, fists clenched clawlike; opaque skirt with snake-shaped belt and fully opaque high-neck long-sleeved blouse
No invented visible magic; formidable presence through sourced aggressive pose, white face and swirling orange hair
Night crossroads with a small roadside shrine

cihuateteo.aura: No invented visible magic; formidable presence through sourced aggressive pose, white face and swirling orange hair [cihuateteo-c11, cihuateteo-c12]

basis_claims.quote: While on earth, they were considered to be demons of the night, and often haunted crossroads.

statement.id: Di bumi mereka dianggap iblis malam dan sering menghantui persimpangan jalan.
statement.en: While on earth, they were considered to be demons of the night, and often haunted crossroads.

basis_claims.quote: Cihuateteo can be characterized as “fearsome figures with clenched, claw-like fists, macabre, bared teeth and gums and aggressive poses.”

statement.id: Cihuateteo dicirikan sebagai 'sosok menakutkan dengan kepalan mirip cakar, gigi dan gusi menyeringai yang seram, dan sikap agresif'.
statement.en: Cihuateteo can be characterized as 'fearsome figures with clenched, claw-like fists, macabre, bared teeth and gums and aggressive poses'.

basis_claims.quote: Oftentimes, cihuateteo are also depicted with swirling, unkempt orange hair and skirts fastened with snake belts.

statement.id: Cihuateteo juga sering digambarkan berambut jingga acak-acakan yang berputar dan berok yang diikat sabuk ular.
statement.en: Cihuateteo are also often depicted with swirling, unkempt orange hair and skirts fastened with snake belts.

basis_claims.quote: Strangely enough, these spirits were actively malevolent ... They were said to haunt the cross-roads, and even to enter the bodies of weakly people, the better to work their evil will. The insane were supposed to be under their especial visitation. Temples were raised at the cross-roads in order to placate them, and loaves of bread, shaped like butterflies, were dedicated to them.

statement.id: Roh-roh itu dikatakan menghantui persimpangan jalan dan bahkan memasuki tubuh orang lemah demi menjalankan kehendak jahatnya; orang gila dianggap berada di bawah kunjungan khusus mereka, dan kuil dibangun di persimpangan untuk menenangkan mereka dengan roti berbentuk kupu-kupu yang dipersembahkan.
statement.en: These spirits were said to haunt the crossroads and even to enter the bodies of weakly people to work their evil will; the insane were supposed to be under their especial visitation, and temples were raised at the crossroads to placate them, with loaves of bread shaped like butterflies dedicated to them.

basis_claims.quote: such beings as the Ciuapipiltin (Honoured Women) ... They were represented as having faces of a dead white, and as blanching their arms and hands with a white powder known as tisatl.

statement.id: Ciuapipiltin digambarkan berwajah putih pucat seperti mayat dan memutihkan lengan serta tangan dengan bubuk putih bernama tisatl.
statement.en: The Ciuapipiltin were represented as having faces of a dead white and as blanching their arms and hands with a white powder known as tisatl.

dirawong.depicted_variant: the Bundjalung goanna Creator Being physically shaping the river toward the coast

NO horns/wings/spines/crown/humanparts or sacredpatterns. Natural rainwetdarkgoannascales, not a statue. Landscape-scale presence comes from bodyidentifiedwith GoannaHeadland, not from extraanatomy.

dirawong.aura: The documented pursuit jointlyformed RichmondRiversections c03/c09: show banks physically tearing/rising under creatorsteps, darkearth slabs sliding outward, water rushing into a NEW winding channel. Former windingsection behind acknowledges prior co-creation without depicting unknownSnakeanatomy. GoannaHeadland isidentifiedwithitsbody c04/c13, supporting coast-sizedancestralpresence. Rain c05, no glow/energy/magicfog. [dirawong-c03, dirawong-c04, dirawong-c05, dirawong-c09, dirawong-c13]

basis_claims.quote: In Australian Aboriginal mythology (specifically Bundjalung, from the northern New South Wales coast and South-East Queensland) Dirawong is a goanna Ancestral Being who taught humans how to live on the land, as well as important ceremonies and rituals.

statement.id: Dirawong adalah Leluhur goanna dalam mitologi Bundjalung yang mengajarkan upacara dan cara hidup pada manusia.
statement.en: Dirawong is an ancestral goanna being in Bundjalung mythology who taught rituals and survival.

basis_claims.quote: Dirawong and the Rainbow Serpent together created parts of the Richmond River, Goanna Headland, Snake Island, and Pelican Island.

statement.id: Dirawong bersama Ular Pelangi membentuk Sungai Richmond dan Tanjung Goanna.
statement.en: Dirawong and the Rainbow Serpent created portions of the Richmond River and Goanna Headland.

basis_claims.quote: Dirawong is also believed to have been transformed into, and still resides within, the Goanna Headland.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Dirawong juga dipercaya berubah menjadi dan masih tinggal di dalam Goanna Headland.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Dirawong is also believed to have been transformed into, and still resides within, the Goanna Headland.

basis_claims.quote: Dirawong is associated with rain, and there is a rain cave on Goanna Headland where the elders of the Bundjalung people went in the past to organise ceremonies for rain.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Dirawong dikaitkan dengan hujan, dan ada gua hujan di Goanna Headland tempat para tetua Bundjalung dahulu mengatur upacara hujan.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Dirawong is associated with rain, and there is a rain cave on Goanna Headland where Bundjalung elders once organised rain ceremonies.

basis_claims.quote: Goanna chased Rainbow Snake down towards the coast and as they went they formed parts of the Richmond River.

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu, Goanna mengejar Ular Pelangi ke arah pantai dan dalam perjalanan keduanya membentuk bagian-bagian Sungai Richmond.
statement.en: In the story, Goanna chased Rainbow Snake towards the coast and as they went they formed parts of the Richmond River.

basis_claims.quote: Goanna reached the coast. He lay down facing the sea, waiting for Rainbow Snake to come back.

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu, Goanna mencapai pantai dan berbaring menghadap laut, menunggu Ular Pelangi kembali.
statement.en: In the story, Goanna reached the coast and lay down facing the sea, waiting for Rainbow Snake to come back.

basis_claims.quote: The Headland is believed to be the body of the mythical 'Dirawong'.

statement.id: Menurut Ballina Historical Society, Goanna Headland dipercaya sebagai tubuh Dirawong yang mitos.
statement.en: According to Ballina Historical Society, the Headland is believed to be the body of the mythical Dirawong.

basis_claims.quote: Mythology says the 'Dirawong', an unseen spiritual creature also known as the goanna spirit, is one of the Creator Beings of the Bundjalung, that protects, guards, battles the Rainbow Snake, and helps the people.

statement.id: Menurut Ballina Historical Society, Dirawong, makhluk roh tak terlihat yang juga disebut roh goanna, adalah salah satu Makhluk Pencipta Bundjalung yang melindungi, menjaga, melawan Ular Pelangi, dan menolong orang.
statement.en: According to Ballina Historical Society, Dirawong, an unseen spiritual creature also known as the goanna spirit, is one of the Creator Beings of the Bundjalung that protects, guards, battles the Rainbow Snake and helps the people.

visual_requirements.description: One natural enormous scorpion of pipa-lute size, exactly EIGHT walking legs plus TWO large separate pincer pedipalps; one compact scorpion head, two tiny eyes, segmented abdomen and ONE arched segmented tail ending in ONE hooked stinger. No woman face, no wings, no extra pincers
Venomous tailhook poised to sting c07, no poisonous vapor or colored magic emitted
Pipa Cave on Venom Mountain

scorpion-demoness.aura: Venomous tailhook poised to sting c07, no poisonous vapor or colored magic emitted [scorpion-demoness-c07]

basis_claims.quote: Scorpion Demoness, also known as Xiezijing (Chinese: 蝎子精; pinyin: Xiēzǐ jīng), is a major antagonist from the 16th-century Chinese classic novel Journey to the West and its media adaptations. Her true form is a giant scorpion as large as a pipa. In the narrative, the Scorpion Demoness stands out as the sole character capable of harming both the Buddha and Sun Wukong.

statement.id: Wujud asli tokoh ini adalah kalajengking raksasa sebesar pipa.
statement.en: The character's true form is a giant scorpion the size of a pipa.

basis_claims.quote: The Scorpion Demoness resides in Pipa Cave (琵琶洞) on Venom Mountain (毒敵山), near the Women's Kingdom. When Tang Sanzang and his disciples are about to leave the Women's Kingdom, the scorpion demoness suddenly appears, abducting Sanzang to her cave. There, she attempts to seduce and persuade him into marriage, leading him into the bridal suite she has prepared.

statement.id: Ia menghuni Pipa Cave di Venom Mountain, dekat Women's Kingdom.
statement.en: She lives in Pipa Cave on Venom Mountain near the Women's Kingdom.

statement.id: Di novel itu, sang penguasa bintang tampil sebagai ayam jantan besar berjengger ganda setinggi sekitar enam atau tujuh chi (尺); ketika ia berkokok, siluman itu menampakkan wujud aslinya, kalajengking sebesar pipa, lalu lemas dan mati setelah kokokan kedua.

basis_claims.quote: 形状は 鴟 （ フクロウ ） に似て、人の手をもつ怪鳥が、 柜山 （ くさん ） （「ヤナギ」の意の山）に棲んでいると『南山経』に記される。

statement.id: Bagian pegunungan selatan menempatkannya di Gunung Ju.

basis_claims.quote: あくまで『山海経』じたいの文にしたがうならば、人の手を持つ鳥には属すが、人面鳥には属さない。

statement.id: Pembacaan harfiah membedakan burung bertangan manusia dari burung berwajah manusia.
statement.en: A literal reading distinguishes a human-handed bird from a human-faced bird.

basis_claims.quote: 有鳥焉，其狀如鴟而人手。〈其腳如人手，鴟音處脂反〉其音如痺，〈未詳〉其名曰鴸

statement.id: Teks Nanshan Jing (南山經): ada burung seperti burung hantu (鴟) dengan tangan manusia (人手) — komentarnya menjelaskan kakinya seperti tangan manusia — suaranya seperti puyuh betina (痺), dan namanya Zhu (鴸).
statement.en: The Nanshan Jing (南山經) text: there is a bird like an owl (鴟) with human hands (人手) — the commentary explains its feet are like human hands — its voice is like a female quail (痺), and its name is Zhu (鴸).

statement.id: Dalam Kitab Gunung dan Laut, di Gunung Gufeng yang tanpa rumput dan pohon serta kaya emas dan batu giok terdapat binatang berbentuk seperti rubah yang bersayap.
statement.en: In the Classic of Mountains and Seas, on Mount Gufeng, which has no grass or trees and abundant gold and jade, there is a beast shaped like a fox with wings.

basis_claims.quote: 有獸焉，其狀如狐而有翼，其音如鴻鴈，其名曰獙獙，見則天下大旱。
basis_claims.locator: Dong shan jing, Dong ci er jing

statement.id: Kitab Gunung dan Laut menyebut binatang itu bernama Bibi, bersuara seperti angsa liar besar, dan kemunculannya membuat seluruh negeri dilanda kekeringan besar.
statement.en: The Classic of Mountains and Seas names the beast Bibi, with a voice like a wild goose, and says that when it appears the land suffers a great drought.

basis_claims.quote: 獙獙，是中国传说的妖兽，生活在姑逢之山，像狐狸但是有翅膀，声音像鸿雁，见到会天下大旱。

statement.id: Wikipedia bahasa Tionghoa menyebut bibi (獙獙) binatang siluman legenda Tiongkok yang hidup di Gunung Gufeng (姑逢之山), mirip rubah bersayap, bersuara seperti angsa liar, dan kemunculannya membawa kemarau besar (大旱).
statement.en: Chinese Wikipedia calls the bibi (獙獙) a monster beast of Chinese legend living on Mount Gufeng (姑逢之山), like a fox with wings, with a voice like a wild goose, whose sighting brings great drought (大旱).

basis_claims.quote: Wuzhiqi is also described in the Song dynasty anthology Taiping guangji as a "monkey-like demon" residing in the Huai River; it is defeated by Yu the Great and imprisoned under Turtle Mountain (龜山) as part of his effort to control the Great Flood.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Li Tang (李湯), puluhan nelayan dan perenang menemukan rantai besi di kaki gunung dan tidak mampu menariknya sampai lebih dari lima puluh lembu ditambahkan, hingga rantai itu bergerak dan sedikit demi sedikit mendekati tepi.
statement.en: In the Li Tang (李湯) story, dozens of fishermen and swimmers got hold of an iron chain and could not control it until more than fifty oxen were added, when the chain stirred and gradually drew toward the bank.

statement.id: Di ujung rantai itu muncul seekor binatang berbentuk seperti kera dengan kepala putih, surai panjang, taring seputih salju, dan cakar emas, yang naik ke darat dengan tinggi sekitar lima zhang.
statement.en: At the end of the chain appeared a beast shaped like an ape, with a white head, long mane, snow-white teeth and golden claws, which burst ashore about five zhang tall.

basis_claims.quote: 久乃引頸伸欠，雙目忽開，光彩若電。顧視人焉，欲發狂怒。觀者奔走。獸亦徐徐引鎖拽牛，入水去，竟不復出。
basis_claims.locator: Taiping Guangji (太平廣記), juan 467, bagian Li Tang (李湯), mengutip Yue Du Jing (岳瀆經)

statement.id: Binatang itu akhirnya menjulurkan leher dan membuka matanya yang berkilau seperti kilat, menoleh ke orang-orang seolah hendak mengamuk sehingga para penonton lari, lalu perlahan menarik rantai beserta lembu-lembu itu masuk ke air dan tidak muncul lagi.
statement.en: The beast finally stretched its neck and opened eyes that flashed like lightning, glared at the people as if to rage so that the onlookers fled, then slowly dragged the chain and the oxen into the water and never reappeared.

statement.id: Xelhua adalah salah satu dari tujuh raksasa dalam mitologi Aztek yang selamat dari air bah dengan mendaki gunung Tlaloc, lalu membangun Piramida Besar Cholula.
statement.en: Xelhua is one of seven Aztec giants who escaped the flood by climbing the mountain of Tlaloc and then built the Great Pyramid of Cholula.

basis_claims.quote: Xelhua, el gigante, fue al sitio que después se le llamó Cholollan y con grandes adobes fabricados en Tlalmanalco y conducidos de mano en mano por una fila de hombres

statement.id: Menurut legenda pendirian pada sebuah plakat peringatan, Xelhua si raksasa pergi ke tempat yang kemudian disebut Cholollan, dengan bata besar buatan Tlalmanalco yang dioper dari tangan ke tangan oleh barisan orang.
statement.en: According to the founding legend on a commemorative plaque, Xelhua the giant went to the place later called Cholollan, with great adobes made in Tlalmanalco and passed from hand to hand by a line of men.

statement.id: Xiangliu adalah monster ular berbisa berkepala sembilan yang membawa banjir dalam mitologi Tiongkok.
statement.en: Xiangliu is a venomous nine-headed serpent monster bringing floods in Chinese mythology.

basis_claims.quote: Everywhere he rested or breathed upon (or that his tongue touched, depending on the telling) became boggy with poisonously bitter water, devoid of human and animal life.

statement.id: Tempat yang disentuh atau diembusnya menjadi rawa berair pahit beracun.
statement.en: Places it touches or breathes upon become bogs of poisonous bitter water.

basis_claims.quote: 共工之臣曰相柳氏，九首，以食于九山。相柳之所抵，厥為澤谿。禹殺相柳，其血腥，不可以樹五穀種。

statement.id: Shanhaijing (山海經), Haiwai bei jing, menyebut menteri Gonggong (共工) bernama Xiangliu (相柳氏) berkepala sembilan (九首) yang makan di sembilan gunung; tempat yang dijangkaunya (所抵) menjadi rawa dan lembah berair (澤谿); Yu (禹) membunuhnya dan darahnya berbau amis sehingga lima jenis biji-bijian tidak dapat ditanam di sana.
statement.en: The Shanhaijing (山海經), Haiwai bei jing, says Gonggong's (共工) minister is named Xiangliu (相柳氏), has nine heads (九首) and eats from nine mountains; where it reaches (所抵) there become marshes and watery valleys (澤谿); Yu (禹) killed it and its blood was foul, so the five grains could not be planted there.

basis_claims.quote: 相柳者，九首人面，蛇身而青。不敢北射，畏共工之臺。臺在其東，臺四方，隅有一蛇，虎色，首衝南方。

statement.id: Shanhaijing, Haiwai bei jing, menggambarkan Xiangliu sebagai makhluk berkepala sembilan dan berwajah manusia (九首人面), bertubuh ular berwarna biru (蛇身而青); teks menambahkan frasa "tidak berani memanah ke utara" (不敢北射) karena segan pada menara Gonggong (共工之臺); menara itu persegi empat dan di sudutnya ada seekor ular berwarna harimau yang kepalanya menghadap ke selatan.
statement.en: The Shanhaijing, Haiwai bei jing, describes Xiangliu as nine-headed with human faces (九首人面) and a blue snake body (蛇身而青); the text adds the phrase "dares not shoot northward" (不敢北射), in awe of Gonggong's terrace (共工之臺); the terrace is square and at a corner there is a tiger-coloured snake whose head faces south.

basis_claims.quote: 共工臣名曰相繇，九首蛇身，自環，食于九土。其所歍所尼，即為源澤，不辛乃苦，百獸莫能處。禹湮洪水，殺相繇，其血腥臭，不可生榖；其地多水，不可居也。

statement.id: Shanhaijing, Dahuang bei jing, menyebut menteri Gonggong bernama Xiangyao (相繇) berkepala sembilan dan bertubuh ular, melingkar sendiri (自環) dan makan di sembilan negeri (九土); tempat yang dikenainya menjadi mata air dan rawa yang rasanya pahit (不辛乃苦) sehingga tak satu pun binatang dapat tinggal di sana. Yu membendung banjir dan membunuhnya; darahnya amis dan busuk, biji-bijian tak dapat tumbuh, dan tanahnya terlalu berair untuk dihuni.
statement.en: The Shanhaijing, Dahuang bei jing, names a minister of Gonggong as Xiangyao (相繇), with nine heads and a snake body, coiling itself (自環) and eating from nine lands (九土); where it passes the places become springs and marshes whose water is bitter (不辛乃苦), so no beast can live there. Yu dammed the floods and killed it; its blood was rank, grain could not grow, and the land was too watery to inhabit.

statement.en: The Western section of the Shanhaijing describes a beast shaped like a 禺 (a kind of ape) with long arms, good at throwing, named 嚻; an annotation adds that it also appears in paintings of dreaded beasts and resembles a macaque throwing things.

basis_claims.quote: Amalanhig (also called 'Maranhig' or 'Amaranhig') are creatures in Visayan mythology, particularly among Hiligaynon speaking groups. Amalanhig are Aswangs who failed to transfer their monstrosity causing them to rise from their graves to kill humans by biting their necks.

statement.en: Amalanhig (also called maranhig or amaranhig) are creatures in Visayan mythology, particularly among Hiligaynon speakers; they are aswangs that failed to transfer their monstrosity, causing them to rise from their graves to kill humans by biting their necks.

basis_claims.quote: The Amalanhig are depicted as externally identical to humans, though there is an enlargement of the upper canines in most individuals. The Amalanhig is a variant of the vampire native to the Philippines.

statement.id: Amalanhig tampak sama seperti manusia, meski kebanyakan bertaring atas yang membesar, dan merupakan varian vampir asli Filipina.
statement.en: Amalanhig look identical to humans, though most have enlarged upper canines, and are a vampire variant native to the Philippines.

statement.en: The name Ame no Wakahiko means "a young boy in heaven," and he is thought to be an exceptionally handsome youth.

basis_claims.quote: Eight years later, after receiving no report back, the gods sent a bird named Nakime down to earth to check in on him. Following the advice of a wise woman, Ame no Wakahiko used his bow to shoot the bird. The bird was killed but the arrow flew all the way to heaven.

statement.id: Delapan tahun kemudian, karena tak ada kabar, para dewa mengirim burung bernama Nakime ke bumi untuk menengoknya. Atas saran seorang perempuan bijak, Ame no Wakahiko memanah burung itu; burung itu mati, tetapi anak panahnya melesat hingga ke surga.
statement.en: Eight years later, with no report, the gods sent a bird named Nakime to earth to check on him. On a wise woman's advice Ame no Wakahiko shot the bird with his bow; the bird was killed but the arrow flew all the way to heaven.

basis_claims.quote: Ame-waka-hiko, son of Ame no Kuni-dama. He is a valorous person. Let him be tried.

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Aston atas Nihongi, para dewa berkata: "Ame-waka-hiko, putra Ame no Kuni-dama. Ia orang yang gagah berani. Biarlah ia dicoba."
statement.en: In Aston's translation of the Nihongi, the gods say: "Ame-waka-hiko, son of Ame no Kuni-dama. He is a valorous person. Let him be tried."

basis_claims.quote: Then Ame-waka-hiko took the heavenly deer-bow and the heavenly feathered arrows which had been given him by Taka-mi-musubi no Mikoto, and shot the pheasant, so that it died.

statement.id: Dalam Nihongi, Ame-waka-hiko mengambil busur rusa surgawi dan anak panah berbulu surgawi pemberian Taka-mi-musubi no Mikoto, lalu memanah burung pegar itu hingga mati.
statement.en: In the Nihongi, Ame-waka-hiko took the heavenly deer-bow and heavenly feathered arrows given him by Taka-mi-musubi no Mikoto and shot the pheasant so that it died.

FULLY OPAQUE coarse dark tunic and leggings cover chest/hips. ONE adult human observer partly visible at lowerforeground, normalhumanface/arms, shields eyes fromchild light.
