anchimayen.aura: Small child-form approaches airborne with cold fixedgaze and its actual brilliant light confounds/stuns the adult who shields eyes, c01/c07.

basis_claims.quote: is a mythical creature in Mapuche mythology. Anchimayens are described as little creatures that take the form of small children, and can transform into flying fireballs that emit bright light.

statement.id: Anchimayen adalah makhluk mitos Mapuche berwujud anak kecil yang dapat berubah menjadi bola api terbang bercahaya terang.
statement.en: The Anchimayen is a Mapuche mythical creature in the form of small children that can turn into bright flying fireballs.

basis_claims.quote: They are the servants of a kalku (a type of Mapuche sorcerer).

statement.id: Mereka pelayan kalku, sejenis penyihir Mapuche.
statement.en: They are servants of a kalku, a type of Mapuche sorcerer.

basis_claims.quote: El anchimallén se alimentaría con leche, sangre o miel, siendo la misión del anchimallén la de proteger y obedecer a su dueño haciendo el bien o el mal; según los deseos de quién lo controla.

statement.id: Anchimallén dikatakan makan susu, darah, atau madu, dan tugasnya melindungi serta menaati pemiliknya, berbuat baik atau jahat sesuai keinginan pengendalinya.
statement.en: The anchimallén is said to feed on milk, blood or honey, its mission being to protect and obey its owner, doing good or evil according to the wishes of whoever controls it.

basis_claims.quote: el anchimallén utilizaría su luz para confundir y desorientar, dejando aturdido momentáneamente a la persona; o incluso dejándola ciega, enferma de la vista o tuerta o tartamuda.

statement.id: Bila seseorang melihatnya dari dekat, anchimallén dikatakan memakai cahayanya untuk membingungkan dan menyesatkan, membuat orang itu terpana sesaat atau bahkan buta, sakit mata, picak, atau gagap.
statement.en: If someone sees it up close, the anchimallén is said to use its light to confuse and disorient, leaving the person momentarily stunned or even blind, with sick eyes, one-eyed or stuttering.

basis_claims.quote: In English folklore, Ascapart (also spelled Ascupart, Ascapard, Ascopard, Ascopart and Asgapard) was a legendary giant supposedly conquered by Bevis of Hampton, so huge as to carry Bevis, his wife, and horse under his arm.

statement.id: Ascapart (Ascupart, Ascapard, Ascopard, Ascopart, Asgapard), raksasa folklor Inggris (English), ditaklukkan Bevis dari (of) Hampton; mengepit Bevis, istri, kuda.
statement.en: Ascapart (Ascupart, Ascapard, Ascopard, Ascopart, Asgapard), giant of English folklore conquered by Bevis of Hampton; carried Bevis, wife, horse.

basis_claims.quote: He was 30 feet tall but the smallest of his land, and was defeated after his club (made from a whole tree) was swung at Sir Bevis and became stuck in soft ground. Rather than slaying the giant however, Sir Bevis decided to make him his Squire.

statement.id: 30 kaki, terkecil di negerinya; gada pohon tertancap; Sir Bevis menjadikannya pengawal.
statement.en: 30 feet, smallest of his land; tree club stuck; Sir Bevis made him squire.

basis_claims.quote: Alongside the story of Bevis of Hampton, the giant appears in the local folklore of Hampshire and the New Forest; large medieval painted oak panels of Sir Bevis and Ascupart can be found in the Southampton Bargate Monument Gallery

statement.id: Folklor Hampshire dan New Forest; panel lukisan Sir Bevis dan Ascupart di Southampton Bargate Monument Gallery.
statement.en: Folklore of Hampshire and the New Forest; painted panels of Sir Bevis and Ascupart in the Southampton Bargate Monument Gallery.

basis_claims.quote: Ascapart was a small giants compared to those of his day and stood a mere 30 foot tall.

statement.id: Menurut halaman Taman Nasional South Downs, Ascapart tergolong kecil dibanding raksasa-raksasa zamannya dan tingginya hanya sekitar 30 kaki.
statement.en: According to the South Downs National Park page, Ascapart was small compared with the giants of his day and stood a mere 30 feet tall.

basis_claims.quote: Nevertheless, Ascapart was more than capable of terrifying the local villages around Southampton.

statement.id: Halaman yang sama menyebut Ascapart sangat mampu menakut-nakuti desa-desa di sekitar Southampton.
statement.en: The same page says Ascapart was more than capable of terrifying the local villages around Southampton.

basis_claims.quote: In a more cosmic mythical context, the deities are thought to have existed before the Earth, Ayida Wedo assisted the creator goddess Mawu-Lisa in the formation of the world,

statement.id: Dalam konteks mitos kosmis, para dewa ini dianggap sudah ada sebelum Bumi, dan Ayida Wedo membantu dewi pencipta Mawu-Lisa membentuk dunia.
statement.en: In a cosmic mythical context the deities are thought to have existed before the Earth, and Ayida Wedo assisted the creator goddess Mawu-Lisa in forming the world.

basis_claims.quote: As Mawu-Lisa created the world, the serpent carried the goddess in its mouth as she shaped the Earth with her creations.

statement.id: Ketika Mawu-Lisa menciptakan dunia, ular itu membawa sang dewi di mulutnya selagi ia membentuk Bumi dengan ciptaannya.
statement.en: As Mawu-Lisa created the world, the serpent carried the goddess in its mouth while she shaped the Earth with her creations.

basis_claims.quote: As they went across the land, the rainbow serpent's body left behind the canyons, rivers, valleys, and mountains.

statement.id: Ketika mereka melintasi daratan, tubuh ular pelangi meninggalkan ngarai, sungai, lembah, dan gunung.
statement.en: As they went across the land, the rainbow serpent's body left behind canyons, rivers, valleys and mountains.

basis_claims.quote: Comme lui, elle imite les mouvements de la couleuvre. Ses symboles sont la couleuvre et aussi l'arc-en-ciel

statement.id: Ia meniru gerakan ular (couleuvre), dan lambangnya adalah ular dan pelangi (arc-en-ciel).
statement.en: She imitates the movements of the snake (couleuvre), and her symbols are the snake and the rainbow (arc-en-ciel).

basis_claims.quote: Barak - Türk mitolojisinde Kutsal Köpek. Anadoluda tüylü av köpeklerine de bu ad verilir.

statement.id: Barak adalah anjing suci (Kutsal Köpek) dalam mitologi Turk; di Anadolu nama ini juga dipakai untuk anjing pemburu berbulu.
statement.en: Barak is the Sacred Dog (Kutsal Köpek) in Turkic mythology (Türk mitolojisinde); in Anadolu the name is also given to hairy hunting dogs (tüylü av köpeklerine).

basis_claims.quote: Efsânevî bir köpek türüdür. Barak sıradan bir köpek olmayıp kutlu sayılır.

statement.id: Barak adalah jenis anjing legendaris; ia bukan anjing biasa melainkan dianggap suci (kutlu).
statement.en: Barak is a legendary kind of dog (efsânevî bir köpek türü); it is not an ordinary dog (sıradan bir köpek) but is considered blessed (kutlu).

basis_claims.quote: Tüylü ve kıllı, çok hızlı koşan av köpeklerine de bu ad verilir.

statement.id: Nama ini juga diberikan kepada anjing pemburu yang berbulu lebat dan berlari sangat cepat.
statement.en: The name is also given to hairy, shaggy hunting dogs (av köpeklerine) that run very fast (çok hızlı koşan).

basis_claims.quote: Şamanların Barak'a binerek göğe çıktıklarına inanılır ve boyunlarına onun simgelerini taktıkları söylenir.

statement.id: Dipercaya bahwa para dukun (şaman) naik ke langit dengan menunggangi Barak, dan konon mereka mengalungkan lambang-lambangnya di leher.
statement.en: It is believed that shamans (şamanlar) ascend to the sky (göğe çıktıkları) riding Barak, and they are said to wear its symbols (simgelerini) on their necks.

statement.en: Unexplained livestock deaths were blamed on creatures like the Beast of Bodmin Moor; British big cats.

statement.en: Per the ru article the Бодминский зверь is a big-cat-like animal seen over 60 times since 1983 on Bodmin Moor (Бодмин-Мур), Cornwall, England (Англия).

basis_claims.quote: La Bestia di Bodmin, nota anche come Bestia della Brughiera di Bodmin, è un presunto grosso felino; si dice che sia stato avvistato, appunto, nella Brughiera di Bodmin in Cornovaglia, ma anche in Devon e Somerset. Simile a un puma, dovrebbe essere di colore grigio scuro-nero

statement.id: Bestia di Bodmin, felin besar, terlihat di Cornwall (Cornovaglia), Devon, Somerset; mirip puma, abu-abu gelap hingga hitam.
statement.en: The Bestia di Bodmin, a supposed big cat seen in Cornwall (Cornovaglia), Devon and Somerset; puma-like, dark grey to black.

statement.id: Tidak ada kucing besar yang pernah dipastikan menjadi penyebab pembantaian ternak 1983; kejadian itu kini dikaitkan dengan penyebab lain seperti anjing besar.
statement.en: No big cat has ever been confirmed behind the 1983 livestock killings, which are now attributed to causes such as large dogs.

basis_claims.quote: La bestia di Exmoor è un felino della criptozoologia (vedi gatto fantasma) che è stato segnalato vagare nelle aree rurali di Exmoor, in particolare Devon e Somerset, nel Regno Unito.

statement.id: Beast of Exmoor adalah kucing kriptozoologi yang dilaporkan berkeliaran di pedesaan Exmoor, terutama Devon dan Somerset, Britania Raya.
statement.en: The Beast of Exmoor is a cryptozoological cat reported to roam rural Exmoor, especially Devon and Somerset, United Kingdom.

basis_claims.quote: fu pienamente al centro dei riflettori solo nel 1983, quando oltre cento pecore furono uccise, con la gola squarciata, a South Molton nell'arco di tre mesi, e la cui uccisione fu attribuita all'essere.

statement.id: Ia benar-benar menjadi sorotan pada 1983, ketika lebih dari seratus domba mati dengan leher terkoyak di South Molton dalam tiga bulan dan kematiannya dikaitkan dengan makhluk ini.
statement.en: It came fully into the spotlight in 1983, when more than a hundred sheep were killed with torn throats at South Molton over three months and blamed on the creature.

basis_claims.quote: Descritta col pelo grigio scuro o nero, si è pensato che si potesse trattare di qualche leopardo nero o coguaro liberato illegalmente

statement.id: Bulunya digambarkan abu-abu gelap atau hitam, dan diduga ia macan tutul hitam atau puma yang dilepas secara ilegal.
statement.en: Described with dark grey or black fur, it was thought to be a black leopard or puma released illegally.

basis_claims.quote: sebutan begu ganjang eksis karena kemungkinan bentuk dari begu ganjang adalah bertubuh panjang atau tinggi sehingga langkahnya pun panjang. Sosok begu ganjang dipercaya dapat dipelihara guna mencelakakan orang lain
basis_claims.locator: Esensi Begu Ganjang sebagai Tradisi Lisan

statement.id: Menurut kajian ini, sebutan begu ganjang ada karena kemungkinan wujudnya bertubuh panjang atau tinggi sehingga langkahnya panjang, dan sosok itu dipercaya dapat dipelihara untuk mencelakakan orang lain.
statement.en: According to this study, the name begu ganjang exists possibly because its form has a long or tall body and so long strides, and the being is believed to be keepable in order to harm others.

basis_claims.quote: begu ganjang tampak seperti bayangan yang semakin tinggi jika semakin dilihat ke atas dan percaya bahwa kematian orang secara mendadak disebabkan oleh begu ganjang.

statement.id: Menurut informan yang mengaku pernah mengalaminya dalam kajian ini, begu ganjang tampak seperti bayangan yang semakin tinggi bila semakin dilihat ke atas, dan mereka percaya kematian mendadak disebabkan oleh begu ganjang.
statement.en: According to informants in this study who said they had experienced it, begu ganjang looks like a shadow that grows taller the more one looks up at it, and they believe sudden death is caused by begu ganjang.

basis_claims.quote: begu ganjang dipersepsi akan semakin tinggi jika semakin dilihat dan akhirnya membunuh orang yang melihatnya. Kedua, bentuknya besar dan hitam.

statement.id: Menurut kajian ini, salah satu deskripsi populer adalah bahwa begu ganjang dipersepsi makin tinggi bila makin dilihat dan akhirnya membunuh orang yang melihatnya; deskripsi lain menyebut bentuknya besar dan hitam.
statement.en: According to this study, one popular description is that begu ganjang is perceived as growing taller the more it is looked at and finally killing the one who looks at it; another says its form is large and black.

basis_claims.quote: Ketiga, begu ganjang dipelihara untuk tujuan tertentu, misalnya menjaga ladang

statement.id: Menurut kajian ini, deskripsi populer lain adalah bahwa begu ganjang dipelihara untuk tujuan tertentu, misalnya menjaga ladang.
statement.en: According to this study, another popular description is that begu ganjang is kept for certain purposes, for example guarding fields.

basis_claims.quote: Dalam berbagai cerita rakyat Batak, Begu Ganjang dipaparkan sebagai sosok bertubuh besar, kurus, dan memanjang, dengan warna gelap yang menyerupai bayangan. Ciri khas yang menonjol dalam pengisahannya adalah kemampuannya tampak semakin tinggi dan besar ketika dipandang lebih lama.

statement.id: Dalam berbagai cerita rakyat Batak, Begu Ganjang dipaparkan sebagai sosok besar, kurus, dan memanjang dengan warna gelap menyerupai bayangan, dan ciri khasnya adalah tampak makin tinggi dan besar bila dipandang lebih lama.
statement.en: In various Batak folk tales, Begu Ganjang is depicted as a large, thin, elongated figure with a dark, shadow-like color, and its notable trait is that it appears to grow taller and bigger the longer it is looked at.

basis_claims.quote: Begu ganjang dikaitkan dengan sistem kepercayaan agraris, yakni sebagai kekuatan gaib yang diyakini mampu melindungi ladang dari pencurian atau gangguan yang merugikan hasil panen.

statement.id: Begu ganjang dikaitkan dengan sistem kepercayaan agraris, yaitu sebagai kekuatan gaib yang diyakini mampu melindungi ladang dari pencurian atau gangguan yang merugikan hasil panen.
statement.en: Begu ganjang is linked with the agrarian belief system, as a supernatural force believed able to protect fields from theft or disturbances that harm the harvest.

Loyaljusticeguardian

bi-an.aura: Awe comes frompowerfulagedtiger guardingprisonthreshold andjudgingright/wrong (bi-an-c02, bi-an-c09, bi-an-c10).

basis_claims.quote: 姿は老いた虎に似ていて威力があり、訴訟を好む。故に監獄の扉や、官庁の正面の広間の両側の格子窓の意匠となり、監獄の異称となった。

statement.id: Ia menyerupai harimau tua.
statement.en: It resembles an aged tiger.

basis_claims.quote: 故に監獄の扉や、官庁の正面の広間の両側の格子窓の意匠となり、監獄の異称となった。

statement.id: Gambarnya menghiasi pintu penjara dan balai pemerintahan.
statement.en: Its image decorates prison doors and government halls.

basis_claims.quote: 龍生九子,不成龍,各有所好。囚牛,好音樂,以飾胡琴。 ... 狴犴,好訟,為獄門。

statement.id: Dalam teks ini, "sembilan putra naga" disebut tidak menjadi naga dan masing-masing punya kegemaran; Bi'an (狴犴) digambarkan gemar perkara hukum dan dipakai untuk pintu penjara.
statement.en: In this text the "nine sons of the dragon" are said not to become dragons and each has its own liking; Bi'an (狴犴) is described as fond of litigation and used for the prison gate.

basis_claims.quote: 傳說其重義氣、好訴訟，能明辨是非、仗義執言《潛確居類書》有：「狴犴，其形似虎，有威力，故立於獄門上。」的敘述。故獄門或官衙正堂兩側立其形象，後為牢獄的代稱。

statement.id: Konon Bi'an menjunjung kesetiakawanan, gemar perkara hukum, mampu membedakan benar dari salah, dan berani bersuara demi keadilan.
statement.en: Bi'an is said to value loyalty, to be fond of litigation, to be able to tell right from wrong, and to speak out for justice.

basis_claims.quote: 傳說其重義氣、好訴訟，能明辨是非、仗義執言《潛確居類書》有：「狴犴，其形似虎，有威力，故立於獄門上。」的敘述。故獄門或官衙正堂兩側立其形象，後為牢獄的代稱。

statement.id: "Qianqueju Leishu" menyebut Bi'an berbentuk mirip harimau dan berkekuatan, sehingga dipasang di atas pintu penjara; karena itu rupanya dipasang di pintu penjara atau kedua sisi aula utama kantor pemerintah, dan kemudian menjadi sebutan lain bagi penjara.
statement.en: The "Qianqueju Leishu" says Bi'an resembles a tiger and has power, hence it is set above prison gates; so its image is placed at prison gates or on both sides of the main hall of government offices, and later became another name for a prison.

basis_claims.quote: Cadborosaurus, nicknamed Caddy by journalist Archie Wills, is a sea serpent in regional folklore of the Pacific Coast of North America.

statement.id: Cadborosaurus, dijuluki Caddy oleh jurnalis Archie Wills, adalah ular laut dalam cerita rakyat daerah pesisir Pasifik Amerika Utara.
statement.en: Cadborosaurus, nicknamed Caddy by journalist Archie Wills, is a sea serpent in the regional folklore of the Pacific Coast of North America.

basis_claims.quote: Its name is derived from Cadboro Bay in Victoria, British Columbia, and the Greek word saûros (σαῦρος) meaning lizard or reptile.

statement.id: Namanya berasal dari Cadboro Bay di Victoria, British Columbia, dan kata Yunani saûros yang berarti kadal atau reptil.
statement.en: Its name is derived from Cadboro Bay in Victoria, British Columbia, and the Greek word saûros, meaning lizard or reptile.

basis_claims.quote: Cadborosaurus willsi is said by witnesses to resemble a serpent with vertical coils or humps in tandem behind a horse-like head and long neck, with a pair of small elevating front flippers

statement.id: Para saksi dikatakan menggambarkan Cadborosaurus willsi sebagai ular dengan lekukan atau punuk vertikal di belakang kepala mirip kuda dan leher panjang, dengan sepasang sirip depan kecil yang dapat terangkat.
statement.en: Witnesses are said to describe Cadborosaurus willsi as a serpent with vertical coils or humps behind a horse-like head and long neck, with a pair of small elevating front flippers.

statement.en: It has the form of a yellow hedgehog about 50 cm long and 20 wide, and rides horses to exhaustion at night.

statement.en: The next day the horses look sick and exhausted, with tangled manes and drenched in sweat.

basis_claims.quote: It has the form of a hedgehog, is yellow- in colour, and is a foot and a half in length and a span in breadth.

basis_claims.quote: Horses are the special prey of the Chagrin, who rides them into a state of exhaustion, as does the Guecubu (q.v.) of Chili. The next day they appear sick and weary, with tangled manes and bathed in sweat.

basis_claims.quote: Camazotz is described as an anthropomorphized leaf-nosed bat. ... The god is also commonly depicted holding a sacrificial knife in one hand and a human heart or sacrificial victim in the other.

statement.id: Camazotz digambarkan sebagai kelelawar berhidung daun yang berwujud manusia; sang dewa juga lazim digambarkan memegang pisau korban di satu tangan dan jantung manusia atau korban di tangan lain.
statement.en: Camazotz is described as an anthropomorphized leaf-nosed bat, and the god is also commonly depicted holding a sacrificial knife in one hand and a human heart or sacrificial victim in the other.

basis_claims.quote: Later in the Popol Vuh, a messenger from the underworld in the form of a humanoid bat (believed to be Camazotz) appears to broker a deal between humanity and Lord Tohil, the patron god of the K’iche’.

statement.id: Kemudian dalam Popol Vuh, seorang utusan dari dunia bawah berwujud kelelawar mirip manusia (diyakini Camazotz) muncul untuk menengahi kesepakatan antara umat manusia dan Tuan Tohil, dewa pelindung bangsa K’iche’.
statement.en: Later in the Popol Vuh, a messenger from the underworld in the form of a humanoid bat (believed to be Camazotz) appears to broker a deal between humanity and Lord Tohil, the patron god of the K’iche’.

statement.en: Her portrayal is a young long-haired woman who counts her hair.

basis_claims.quote: 누군가가 세 번 기침을 하지 않고 측간에 들어오면 측신은 긴 머리를 이용해 침입자를 공격한다고 믿었다. 측신의 머리카락이 침입자의 살갗에 닿자 침입자는 병들어 죽고 만다. 무당이라도 머리카락으로 사람을 공격하면 여신을 달래지 못한다.

statement.id: Sebuah kepercayaan menyebut batuk tiga kali sebelum masuk untuk menghindari serangan rambutnya.
statement.en: One belief describes coughing three times before entry to avoid an attack with her hair.

basis_claims.quote: 측신각시는 늘 긴 머리카락을 발 밑에 감고 세고 있다가 사람이 갑자기 변소에 들어오면 깜짝 놀라서 세던 머리카락을 뒤집어 씌운다고 한다. 머리카락에 씌어진 사람은 병을 앓게 되는데, 이 측신각시는 놀라서 화가 났다 하면 무당이 굿을 하여도 잘 풀어지지 않아 대개는 죽는다고 한다.

statement.id: Cheuksin gaksi dikatakan selalu menghitung rambut panjangnya yang digulung di bawah kaki; bila seseorang mendadak masuk jamban, ia terkejut dan menyelubungkan rambutnya ke orang itu, yang lalu jatuh sakit, dan jika ia sudah marah, ritual dukun pun sulit meredakannya sehingga orang itu umumnya meninggal.
statement.en: Cheuksin gaksi is said to be always counting her long hair coiled beneath her feet; if someone enters the latrine suddenly she is startled and throws the hair over them, and the person falls ill; once she is angry even a shaman's ritual rarely appeases her and the person usually dies.

statement.en: Degei, enshrined as a serpent, is the supreme deity of Fiji.

basis_claims.quote: He is said to have at first moved about freely, but then in the form of a snake to have grown into the earth with his ringed tail. Since then he has become the god of earthquakes, storms and seasons.

statement.id: Ia dikatakan mula-mula bergerak bebas, tetapi lalu dalam wujud ular tumbuh menyatu dengan bumi bersama ekornya yang berlingkar; sejak itu ia menjadi dewa gempa bumi, badai, dan musim.
statement.en: He is said to have first moved about freely, but then, in snake form, to have grown into the earth with his ringed tail; since then he has become the god of earthquakes, storms and seasons.

basis_claims.quote: Whenever Degei shakes himself fertilising rain will fall, delicious fruits hang on the trees, and the yam fields yield an excellent crop.

statement.id: Setiap kali Degei mengguncang dirinya, hujan penyubur turun, buah-buahan lezat bergantung di pohon, dan ladang ubi memberi hasil yang sangat baik.
statement.en: Whenever Degei shakes himself, fertilising rain falls, delicious fruits hang on the trees and the yam fields yield an excellent crop.

basis_claims.quote: In these traditions Degei figures not only as the origin of the people, but also as a huge snake, living in a cave near the summit of the mountain Uluda - the northernmost peak of the Nakauvandra Range.
basis_claims.locator: In popular culture (quoting R. A. Derrick)

statement.id: Dalam tradisi-tradisi ini Degei tampil bukan hanya sebagai asal usul manusia, tetapi juga sebagai ular raksasa yang tinggal di gua dekat puncak gunung Uluda, puncak paling utara Pegunungan Nakauvandra.
statement.en: In these traditions Degei figures not only as the origin of the people but also as a huge snake living in a cave near the summit of the mountain Uluda, the northernmost peak of the Nakauvandra Range.

dilong.depicted_variant: two earth-dragons leapingfromriver in the classicalhistoryaccount

No horns, antlers, whiskers, mane, wings or visiblelimbs; anylimbs fullyoccludedbelowwater. Minimal reptilianhead is editorialinterpretation ofdragontaxon, not specificspeciesclaim. Twoheads completelyseparated andreadable.

Riverwestoftheunnamedcity inWangSengbians biography; darksky, no inventedimperialpalace.

basis_claims.quote: Dilong (traditional Chinese: 地龍; simplified Chinese: 地龙; pinyin: dìlóng; Wade–Giles: ti-lung; lit. "earth dragon") is a Chinese dragon name that is also used to mean "earthworm" in traditional Chinese medicine and Geosaurus in zoological nomenclature.

statement.id: Dilong adalah nama naga Tiongkok yang secara harfiah berarti naga bumi.
statement.en: Dilong is a Chinese dragon name literally denoting an earth dragon.

basis_claims.quote: Dilong first occurs in the mid-7th century CE History of the Southern Dynasties biography of Liang dynasty Admiral Wang Sengbian 王僧辯 (d. 555 CE). It says witnesses saw lianglong (兩龍; "two/paired dragons") that ascended into the sky, and this dilong "earth dragon" leaving Liang territory was interpreted as a portent of their defeat in 550 CE.

statement.id: Sejarah Dinasti Selatan mencatat Dilong dalam biografi Wang Sengbian.
statement.en: The History of the Southern Dynasties records Dilong in Wang Sengbian's biography.

basis_claims.quote: 三月庚寅，有兩龍自城西江中騰躍升天，五色分明，遙映江水。百姓咸仰面目之，父老或聚而悲，竊相謂曰：「地龍已去，國其亡乎。」

statement.id: Dalam catatan sejarah klasik ini, pada hari gengyin bulan ketiga dua naga melompat naik ke langit dari sungai di barat kota dengan lima warna yang jelas memantul di air; rakyat menengadah, dan para tetua berkumpul dengan sedih sambil berkata, "Naga bumi (地龍) telah pergi, apakah negara akan binasa?"
statement.en: In this classical history record, on the gengyin day of the third month two dragons leapt into the sky from the river west of the city with five distinct colors reflected on the water; people looked up, and elders gathered in grief saying, "The earth dragon (地龍) has gone; will the state perish?"

statement.en: Instead, its face is on its torso.

statement.en: Dōnotsura's body looks much like a human's except that everything from the neck up is missing; its extremely large facial features are prominently displayed on its torso, as its name implies.

vast subterranean sea inside dark rock cavern

statement.id: Saat menggerakkan kepala dan badannya terjadi gempa bumi dan badai melanda
statement.en: When it moves its head and body earthquakes and storms erupt

basis_claims.quote: Baş və bədənini oynatınca zəlzələlər olur, tufanlar qopar.
Belkemiği ters çevrilmiştir. Zincirlerle bağlı tutulur.

statement.id: Menurut Kamus Mitologi Turki karya Karakurt, tulang punggung Doydu terbalik dan ia dikatakan diikat dengan rantai.
statement.en: According to Karakurt's Dictionary of Turkic Mythology, Doydu's spine is turned upside down and it is kept bound with chains.

dyrnwch-gawr.depicted_variant: Dyrnwch Gawr the Welsh giant and owner of the bravery-testing cauldron

Welsh rocky ground in Gwent, neutral unnamed landscape

dyrnwch-gawr.aura: His cauldron swiftly boils meat intended for a brave person; actual rolling bubbles and thick steam inside cauldron, no generic aura or flames from body [dyrnwch-gawr-c03, dyrnwch-gawr-c11]

basis_claims.quote: Cawr Cymreig a gysylltir â'r Hen Ogledd ac â Gwent yw Dyrnwch Gawr (amrywiad, Dyrnhwch Gawr).

statement.id: Dyrnwch Gawr (varian: Dyrnhwch Gawr) adalah raksasa Welsh (cawr Cymreig) yang dikaitkan dengan Hen Ogledd dan Gwent.
statement.en: Dyrnwch Gawr (variant: Dyrnhwch Gawr) is a Welsh giant (cawr Cymreig) associated with the Hen Ogledd and with Gwent.

basis_claims.quote: Enwir Dyrnwch Gawr yn y rhestr Tri Thlws ar Ddeg Ynys Prydain fel perchennog pair arbennig

statement.id: Dyrnwch Gawr disebut dalam daftar Tri Thlws ar Ddeg Ynys Prydain sebagai pemilik (perchennog) kuali (pair) istimewa.
statement.en: Dyrnwch Gawr is named in the list Tri Thlws ar Ddeg Ynys Prydain as the owner (perchennog) of a special cauldron (pair).

basis_claims.quote: pe rhoid ynddo gig i ŵr llwfr i ferwi, ni ferwai fyth; o rhoid iddo gig i ŵr dewr, berwi a wnâi yn ebrwydd

statement.id: Jika daging (cig) untuk orang pengecut (llwfr) dimasukkan untuk direbus, daging itu tidak akan pernah mendidih (ni ferwai fyth); jika daging untuk orang pemberani (dewr), ia cepat mendidih (berwi).
statement.en: If meat (cig) for a coward (llwfr) were put in to boil, it would never boil (ni ferwai fyth); if meat for a brave man (dewr), it would boil (berwi) quickly.

basis_claims.quote: The cauldron (pair) of Dyrnwch the Giant is said to discriminate between cowards and brave men: whereas it would not boil meat for a coward, it would boil quickly if that meat belonged to a brave man.

statement.id: Kuali (pair) Dyrnwch sang Raksasa dikatakan membedakan pengecut dari pemberani: ia tidak merebus daging untuk pengecut, tetapi cepat merebus daging milik orang pemberani.
statement.en: The cauldron (pair) of Dyrnwch the Giant is said to discriminate between cowards and brave men: it would not boil meat for a coward but would boil quickly meat belonging to a brave man.

el-silbon.depicted_variant: El Silbón as the six-meter giant moving about treetops, carrying his father’s bones

Carry ONE rough sack containing clean dry pale bones, only small bone ends visible, no flesh/gore. Six-meter giant, legs longer than small trees beneath
Cursed eternal wandering and whistling; no visual sound rings, no magical beam or victim injuries
Los Llanos of Venezuela, small trees and plain below his legs

el-silbon.aura: Cursed eternal wandering and whistling; no visual sound rings, no magical beam or victim injuries [el-silbon-c07, el-silbon-c08]

basis_claims.quote: El Silbón (The Whistler) is a legendary figure in Venezuela, associated especially with the Venezuelan Los Llanos region

statement.id: El Silbón ("si Peluit") adalah tokoh legenda Venezuela yang terutama dikaitkan dengan wilayah Los Llanos.
statement.en: El Silbón ("The Whistler") is a legendary figure of Venezuela, associated especially with Los Llanos.

basis_claims.quote: After being released, he was set upon by two rabid, starving dogs—identified in some versions as the Perros Tureco or the Dogs of the Devil—which, according to the legend, will pursue him until the end of time. Before releasing him, his grandfather cursed him, condemning him to carry his father's bones for all eternity and to wander forever.

statement.id: Setelah dilepaskan, ia diserang dua anjing gila yang kelaparan, dalam sebagian versi disebut Perros Tureco atau Anjing Iblis, yang menurut legenda akan memburunya sampai akhir zaman; sebelumnya sang kakek mengutuknya agar memikul tulang ayahnya selamanya dan mengembara selama-lamanya.
statement.en: After being released, he was set upon by two rabid, starving dogs, in some versions the Perros Tureco or Dogs of the Devil, which according to the legend will pursue him until the end of time; before that, his grandfather cursed him to carry his father's bones for all eternity and to wander forever.

basis_claims.quote: It has a characteristic whistle. It is said that when the whistling sounds close, there's no danger, and the whistler is far away, but when the whistling sounds distant, it means it is nearby.

statement.id: Ia punya siulan khas; konon bila siulan terdengar dekat, tidak ada bahaya dan sang peniup jauh, tetapi bila terdengar jauh, berarti ia dekat.
statement.en: It has a characteristic whistle; it is said that when the whistling sounds close there is no danger and the whistler is far away, but when it sounds distant it is nearby.

basis_claims.quote: Some versions say it appears as a giant of about six meters that moves about the treetops, creaking, and emitting its chilling whistle.

statement.id: Sebagian versi menyebutnya tampil sebagai raksasa setinggi sekitar enam meter yang bergerak di pucuk-pucuk pohon sambil berderit dan mengeluarkan siulan yang menyeramkan.
statement.en: Some versions say it appears as a giant of about six meters that moves about the treetops, creaking and emitting its chilling whistle.

basis_claims.quote: Other versions say he appears as the shadow of a tall thin man, with a hat, and goes after drunkards most of all.

statement.id: Versi lain menyebutnya tampil sebagai bayangan pria tinggi kurus bertopi yang paling sering memburu pemabuk.
statement.en: Other versions say he appears as the shadow of a tall, thin man with a hat, and goes after drunkards most of all.

emela-ntouka.depicted_variant: Emela-ntouka the gray hairless elephant-sized horned beast with crocodile tail

visual_requirements.description: ONE large four-legged hairless gray-brown animal slightly larger than an elephant; FOUR stout legs, ONE long muscular CROCODILE-LIKE TAIL, ONE large HORN rising from nose/forehead, ONE head/TWO eyes. Broad herbivore muzzle with closed lips, NO sharp carnivore teeth, NO second horn, NO dinosaur frill/armor/spines. One smaller elephant stands off to side as scale comparison
Extremely aggressive herbivore attacks large animals with horn; physical charge and mud spray only, no visible injury or devouring
Likouala region of Congo, riverbank and surrounding dark forest

emela-ntouka.aura: Extremely aggressive herbivore attacks large animals with horn; physical charge and mud spray only, no visible injury or devouring [emela-ntouka-c03, emela-ntouka-c13]

basis_claims.quote: è una creatura leggendaria dalla regione Likouala dell'Africa centrale.

statement.id: Emela-ntouka adalah makhluk legendaris (creatura leggendaria) dari wilayah Likouala di Afrika Tengah.
statement.en: The emela-ntouka is a legendary creature (creatura leggendaria) from the Likouala region of Central Africa.

basis_claims.quote: La leggenda dell'emela-ntouka deriva dalla mitologia delle tribù pigmee che vivono in Congo.

statement.id: Legenda emela-ntouka berasal dari mitologi suku-suku Pigmi (tribù pigmee) yang tinggal di Kongo.
statement.en: The legend of the emela-ntouka comes from the mythology of the Pygmy tribes (tribù pigmee) living in Congo.

basis_claims.quote: pur essendo erbivoro, attaccherebbe spesso animali di grossa taglia, come elefanti, rinoceronti o ippopotami, ma senza divorarli.

statement.id: Walaupun pemakan tumbuhan (erbivoro), ia konon sering menyerang hewan besar seperti gajah, badak, atau kuda nil (elefanti, rinoceronti, ippopotami) tanpa memakannya.
statement.en: Although herbivorous (erbivoro), it reportedly often attacks large animals such as elephants, rhinoceroses or hippopotamuses (elefanti, rinoceronti, ippopotami) without devouring them.

basis_claims.quote: Si dice che abbia la pelle grigiastra senza peli, quattro zampe robuste e una coda simile a un coccodrillo.

statement.id: Konon kulitnya keabu-abuan tanpa bulu, kakinya empat dan kokoh, dan ekornya mirip ekor buaya (coccodrillo).
statement.en: It is said to have greyish hairless skin, four sturdy legs and a tail like a crocodile's (coccodrillo).

basis_claims.quote: Secondo i Pigmei e i testimoni che lo avrebbero visto, la creatura sarebbe un po' più grande di un elefante.

statement.id: Menurut orang Pigmi (Pigmei) dan para saksi, makhluk ini sedikit lebih besar daripada gajah (elefante).
statement.en: According to the Pygmies (Pigmei) and the witnesses, the creature is a little larger than an elephant (elefante).

basis_claims.quote: 当地人告诉他一种非洲象大小、有着粗壮四肢、棕灰色皮肤，额头或鼻子部位有着一个巨大的角的神秘动物。

statement.id: Penduduk setempat menceritakan hewan misterius sebesar gajah Afrika (非洲象), berkaki kekar, berkulit cokelat keabu-abuan, dengan satu tanduk besar (角) di dahi atau hidung.
statement.en: Local people described a mysterious animal the size of an African elephant (非洲象), with sturdy limbs, brownish-grey skin and one large horn (角) on its forehead or nose.

basis_claims.quote: 并且这种动物虽然是植食性，但却极具攻击性，会攻击其它大型动物，利用牠的角将对方杀死。

statement.id: Walaupun herbivora (植食性), hewan ini sangat agresif (极具攻击性) dan menyerang hewan besar lain lalu membunuhnya dengan tanduknya (角).
statement.en: Although herbivorous (植食性), the animal is extremely aggressive (极具攻击性) and attacks other large animals, killing them with its horn (角).

river in Japan where Enkō attacks horses

enko.aura: Elastic limbs extend while pulling at horse leg in river, physical stretch and splashing only; no victim wounds [enko-c04, enko-c10]

basis_claims.quote: 一般的にいう河童と異なるのは、姿が毛むくじゃらで猿に似ている点である。金属を嫌う性質があり、海又は川に住み、泳いでいる人間を襲い、肛門から手を入れて生き胆を抜き取るとされている。

statement.id: Wujudnya berbulu dan menyerupai monyet.
statement.en: Its hairy form resembles a monkey.

basis_claims.quote: 金属を嫌う性質があり、海又は川に住み、泳いでいる人間を襲い、肛門から手を入れて生き胆を抜き取るとされている。

statement.id: Ia dikatakan membenci logam (金属を嫌う), tinggal di laut atau sungai, menyerang orang yang berenang, dan mencabut hati hidup mereka lewat dubur.
statement.en: It is said to hate metal (金属を嫌う), live in the sea or rivers, attack swimmers, and pull out their living liver through the anus.

basis_claims.quote: Their long limbs are flexible and elastic, and if you pull on one arm it will stretch while the other arm shrinks.

statement.id: Satu gambaran memberinya anggota tubuh yang lentur.
statement.en: A description gives it elastic limbs.

basis_claims.quote: Their fingers are tipped with sharp claws.

statement.id: Ia memiliki cakar tajam di jarinya.
statement.en: It has sharp claws on its fingers.

basis_claims.quote: ある男が川辺に馬を繋いでいたところ、猿猴が馬の脚を引いて悪戯をするので、懲らしめようと猿猴の腕を捻り上げたが、捻っても捻ってもきりがなく、一晩中捻り続ける羽目になったという。

statement.id: Seorang lelaki yang menambatkan kuda di tepi sungai memelintir lengan enkō yang menarik kaki kudanya, tetapi lengan itu tak habis-habis dipelintir sehingga ia memelintirnya semalaman.
statement.en: A man who had tied his horse by a river twisted the arm of an enkō pulling at the horse’s leg, but the arm never ran out, so he ended up twisting it all night.

falhofnir.depicted_variant: Falhófnir the divine judgement-stallion ridden daily beneath Yggdrasil

Documented gods ride this steed daily to judgement at Yggdrasil; physical hoof impact and root dust, no intrinsic magic power
great ash tree Yggdrasil roots beneath immense trunk, no invented rainbow bridge

falhofnir.aura: Documented gods ride this steed daily to judgement at Yggdrasil; physical hoof impact and root dust, no intrinsic magic power [falhofnir-c01, falhofnir-c04]

basis_claims.quote: In Norse mythology, Falhófnir (Old Norse: [ˈfɑlˌhoːvnez̠] ) is a horse listed in both Grímnismál and Gylfaginning among the steeds ridden by the gods each day when they go to make judgements at Yggdrasil. However, in both stanzas Falhófnir is not assigned to any specific deity.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik, Falhófnir adalah kuda yang tercantum dalam Grímnismál dan Gylfaginning di antara tunggangan para dewa yang setiap hari pergi memberi keputusan di Yggdrasil, tanpa dikaitkan dengan dewa tertentu.
statement.en: In Norse mythology Falhófnir is a horse listed in Grímnismál and Gylfaginning among the mounts the gods ride daily to give judgements at Yggdrasil, not tied to any specific god.

basis_claims.quote: Glaðr ok Gyllir, Glær ok Skeiðbrimir, Silfrintoppr ok Sinir, Gísl ok Falhófnir, Gulltoppr ok Léttfeti, þeim ríða æsir jóm dag hvern, er þeir dæma fara at aski Yggdrasils.

statement.id: Dalam Grímnismál, Falhófnir disebut bersama Glaðr, Gyllir, Glær, Skeiðbrimir, Silfrintoppr, Sinir, Gísl, Gulltoppr, dan Léttfeti sebagai kuda yang ditunggangi para Æsir (æsir) setiap hari ketika mereka pergi mengadili di pohon abu Yggdrasil (aski Yggdrasils).
statement.en: In Grímnismál Falhófnir is named, together with Glaðr, Gyllir, Glær, Skeiðbrimir, Silfrintoppr, Sinir, Gísl, Gulltoppr and Léttfeti, as one of the steeds the Æsir (æsir) ride each day when they go to judge at the ash of Yggdrasil (aski Yggdrasils).

basis_claims.quote: Falhófnir: "Hairy-hoof" or "Hidden-hoof", i.e. whose hoofs are covered with hair, or "Pale-hoof";

statement.id: Wikipedia bahasa Inggris (artikel Horses of the Æsir) mengartikan nama Falhófnir sebagai "kuku berbulu" atau "kuku tersembunyi", yaitu yang kukunya tertutup bulu, atau "kuku pucat".
statement.en: English Wikipedia's article on the Horses of the Æsir glosses the name Falhófnir as "Hairy-hoof" or "Hidden-hoof", i.e. whose hoofs are covered with hair, or "Pale-hoof".

firedrakes-in-english-folklore.depicted_variant: English Firedrake as the recorded active fiery-meteor manifestation
