statement.id: Crinisus atau Crimisus adalah dewa sungai Crinisus di Sisilia dalam mitologi Yunani dan Romawi.
statement.en: Crinisus or Crimisus was god of the Sicilian river Crinisus in Greek and Roman mythology.

basis_claims.quote: According to most versions of the myth, Crinisus fathered Acestes with a Trojan woman while in the form of a dog.

statement.id: Menurut kebanyakan versi, Crinisus menjadi ayah Acestes dari seorang perempuan Troya saat berwujud anjing.
statement.en: In most versions, Crinisus fathered Acestes with a Trojan woman in the form of a dog.

basis_claims.quote: KRIMISOS (Crimisus) was a river-god of western Sikelia (Sicily). He seduced the daughter of a Trojan settler in the guise of a dog.

statement.id: Krimisos (Crimisus) adalah dewa sungai di Sikelia (Sisilia) barat; ia merayu putri seorang pemukim Troya dalam wujud anjing.
statement.en: Krimisos (Crimisus) was a river god of western Sikelia (Sicily); he seduced the daughter of a Trojan settler in the guise of a dog.

basis_claims.quote: The river Krimisos was located in the north-western Sikelia, entering the Mediterranean Sea near the Greek colony of Egesta.

statement.id: Sungai Krimisos terletak di Sikelia barat laut dan bermuara ke Laut Tengah dekat koloni Yunani Egesta.
statement.en: The river Krimisos was located in north-western Sikelia, entering the Mediterranean Sea near the Greek colony of Egesta.

cuca.depicted_variant: Brazilian alligator-headed witch c08 with Lobato's textual finger claws/cave c11/c12; original costume, no television design.

visual_requirements.description: One old witch with one alligator head and long toothed reptile jaws, humanoid body with two arms and two legs, fully covered in coarse opaque aged robe and shawl; five claw-tipped fingers per hand like hawk claws
Documented witch who kidnaps children; menace through reaching claws, toothed jaws and emerging action, no magical spell or invented power
Deep Brazilian forest, mouth of the cave where the horrible witch lives

cuca.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Lunge out of a forest cave toward the low camera with one clawed hand reaching and alligator mouth open, the other hand clutching robe; no child shown (cuca-c02, cuca-c08, cuca-c12).

basis_claims.quote: assume a forma de bruxa velha com aspecto de jacaré, que não se sabe ao certo sua idade mas que pode ter mais de 3 mil anos

statement.id: Ia berwujud penyihir tua berwajah jacaré yang dapat berusia lebih dari tiga ribu tahun.
statement.en: She takes the form of an old witch with alligator appearance who may be over 3,000 years old.

basis_claims.quote: Elle est décrite comme une sorcière qui kidnappe les enfants et qui peut prendre la forme d'une vieille femme ou d'une sorcière à tête d'alligator.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai penyihir yang menculik anak-anak dan dapat berwujud perempuan tua atau penyihir berkepala aligator.
statement.en: She is described as a witch who kidnaps children and can take the form of an old woman or of a witch with an alligator head.

basis_claims.quote: Au Brésil, la Cuca a été popularisée par le livre "O Saci" (1921), de Monteiro Lobato. C'est par ailleurs la seule œuvre de l'écrivain dans laquelle elle apparaît. Elle y est décrite comme une "horrible sorcière", dotée d'une ouïe très fine, "vieille comme le temps", vivant dans une grotte dans la forêt et ne dormant qu'une nuit tous les sept ans.

statement.id: Dalam buku "O Saci" (1921) karya Monteiro Lobato, Cuca digambarkan sebagai "penyihir mengerikan" berpendengaran sangat tajam, "setua waktu", tinggal di gua di hutan dan hanya tidur satu malam setiap tujuh tahun; itu satu-satunya karya Lobato tempat ia muncul.
statement.en: In Monteiro Lobato's book "O Saci" (1921), the Cuca is described as a "horrible witch" with very fine hearing, "as old as time", living in a cave in the forest and sleeping only one night every seven years; it is the only work by the writer in which she appears.

basis_claims.quote: Selon le livre, la Cuca a « un visage comme un alligator et des griffes sur ses doigts comme les faucons ».

statement.id: Menurut buku itu, Cuca memiliki "wajah seperti aligator dan cakar di jari-jarinya seperti elang".
statement.en: According to the book, the Cuca has "a face like an alligator and claws on her fingers like hawks".

daidarabotchi.depicted_variant: Great-person giant and mountain-bearing action; clothing/face editorial, no unsourced monster skin/third eye.

visual_requirements.description: One colossal human-shaped giant, one head, two eyes, two arms, two legs; opaque coarse ancient robe and knee-length trousers, bare feet; no horns or other monster anatomy
Huge footprint forms a pond, water collecting in the deep heel depression; spilled earth from carried mountain forms small hills
Kanto and Chubu Japanese landscape beneath Mount Fuji with tiny trees and ponds around fresh footprint

daidarabotchi.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Stride over a miniature landscape with one immense bare foot pressing into ground, bend under Mount Fuji carried on his back, mountain tied with wisteria vines stretched taut (daidarabotchi-c01, daidarabotchi-c10, daidarabotchi-c02, daidarabotchi-c06, daidarabotchi-c11).

basis_claims.quote: Daidarabotchi (ダイダラボッチ, 大座法師) was a gigantic type of yōkai in Japanese mythology, sometimes said to pose as a mountain range when sleeping.

statement.id: Daidarabotchi adalah yōkai raksasa dalam dongeng Jepang.
statement.en: Daidarabotchi is a giant yōkai in Japanese tales.

basis_claims.quote: The size of a Daidarabotchi was so great that his footprints were said to have created innumerable lakes and ponds.

statement.id: Jejaknya dikatakan membentuk danau dan kolam.
statement.en: Its footprints were said to form lakes and ponds.

basis_claims.quote: ダダ坊，デイラボー，大太法師などとも呼ばれる伝説の巨人。関東，中部地方を中心に広く分布している。
basis_claims.locator: 改訂新版 世界大百科事典「だいだらぼっち」

statement.id: Daidarabotchi adalah raksasa legendaris yang juga disebut ダダ坊, デイラボー, atau 大太法師, dan ceritanya tersebar luas terutama di wilayah Kantō dan Chūbu.
statement.en: Daidarabotchi is a legendary giant also called ダダ坊, デイラボー, or 大太法師, whose tales are widely distributed mainly in the Kantō and Chūbu regions.

basis_claims.quote: この巨人の大足跡とか，その足跡に水がたまってできた沼があると伝えている。また富士山を背負おうとしたとか，山作りの際にこぼした泥が小山になったとも語られている。
basis_claims.locator: 改訂新版 世界大百科事典「だいだらぼっち」

statement.id: Tradisi menyebut adanya jejak kaki besar raksasa ini dan rawa yang terbentuk dari air yang menggenangi jejaknya; ia juga diceritakan hendak memanggul Gunung Fuji, dan lumpur yang tumpah saat ia membuat gunung menjadi bukit kecil.
statement.en: Tradition says there are great footprints of this giant and a marsh formed by water collecting in his footprints; he is also said to have tried to carry Mount Fuji on his back, and mud spilled while making mountains became small hills.

basis_claims.quote: 大太法師の足跡と伝えられるくぼみが関東，中部その他の地方にあり，東京都世田谷区代田にはその足跡という場所が2ヵ所あって，これは大太法師がひとまたぎした足跡といわれる。
basis_claims.locator: ブリタニカ国際大百科事典 小項目事典「大太法師」

statement.id: Cekungan yang dikatakan jejak kaki Daidarabotchi terdapat di Kantō, Chūbu, dan daerah lain; di Daita, Setagaya, Tokyo, ada dua tempat yang disebut jejaknya, yang konon sekali langkah raksasa itu.
statement.en: Hollows said to be Daidarabotchi's footprints exist in Kantō, Chūbu and other regions; at Daita in Setagaya, Tokyo, there are two places said to be his footprints, made in a single stride.

basis_claims.quote: 九州では大人 (おおひと) 弥五郎という。巨人の伝説は古く『常陸国風土記』『播磨国風土記』に大人として記されており
basis_claims.locator: ブリタニカ国際大百科事典 小項目事典「大太法師」

statement.id: Di Kyūshū ia disebut Ōhito Yagorō; legenda raksasa sudah tua dan dicatat sebagai "ōhito" (orang besar) dalam Hitachi no kuni fudoki dan Harima no kuni fudoki.
statement.en: In Kyūshū he is called Ōhito Yagorō; giant legends are old and are recorded as "ōhito" (great people) in the Hitachi no kuni fudoki and Harima no kuni fudoki.

basis_claims.quote: これは大太法師がひとまたぎした足跡といわれる。また大太法師が山をかついで移そうとしたという話が各地に伝えられており，藤づるで縛って運んだ際に途中でつるが切れて土が落ちたのが現在のどこどこの小山となっているという伝説が諸地方にある。
basis_claims.locator: ブリタニカ国際大百科事典 小項目事典「大太法師」

statement.id: Di berbagai daerah diceritakan bahwa Daidarabotchi mencoba memindahkan gunung dengan memanggulnya; ada legenda bahwa ketika diikat dengan sulur wisteria, sulur itu putus di tengah jalan dan tanah yang jatuh menjadi bukit kecil.
statement.en: Tales in many places say Daidarabotchi tried to carry a mountain to move it; legends in various regions say that when it was bound with wisteria vines, the vines snapped on the way and the earth that fell became a small hill.

dingonek.depicted_variant: Complete Jordan c10 variant, not Hobley otter/no-fangs c05. Submerged limbs unspecified.

visual_requirements.description: One head broad as a lioness head and leopard-marked, two long white fangs descending from upper jaw; hippo-broad torso clad overlapping armadillo-like scales, body14–15ft long, exactly one broad fin tail; lower limbs submerged and undefined, no horns or added wings
No documented supernatural power; water displacement and spray from physical lunge, leopard markings and armadillo scales clear
Lake Victoria Nyanza tributary, reed lined river water at night

dingonek.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Drive forward out of Lake Victoria tributary toward low watersurface camera, great fangs close in foreground and broad fin tail sweeping an arc visible behind body (dingonek-c10, dingonek-c11).

basis_claims.quote: It lives in Lake Victoria Nyanza and its numerous tributaries, and there is no record of the monster having been seen in any other part of the world.

statement.id: Menurut Jordan, makhluk itu hidup di Danau Victoria Nyanza dan banyak anak sungainya (tributaries), dan tidak pernah tercatat terlihat di tempat lain.
statement.en: According to Jordan it lives in Lake Victoria Nyanza and its numerous tributaries, with no record of it seen anywhere else in the world.

basis_claims.quote: fourteen or fifteen feet long, head big as that of a lioness but shaped and marked like a leopard, two long white fangs sticking down straight out of his upper jaw, back broad as a hippo, scaled like an armadillo, but colored and marked like a leopard, and a broad fin tail

statement.id: Jordan menggambarkannya sepanjang empat belas atau lima belas kaki (fourteen or fifteen feet), berkepala sebesar singa betina bercorak macan tutul, bertaring putih panjang dari rahang atas, berpunggung selebar kuda nil (hippo), bersisik seperti armadillo, dan berekor sirip lebar.
statement.en: Jordan describes it as fourteen or fifteen feet long, with a head as big as a lioness's but marked like a leopard, two long white fangs from the upper jaw, a back as broad as a hippo, scaled like an armadillo, and a broad fin tail.

basis_claims.quote: Blast that blighter's fangs, but they looked long enough to go clean through a man.

statement.id: Jordan berkata taringnya tampak cukup panjang untuk menembus tubuh manusia (go clean through a man).
statement.en: Jordan says its fangs looked long enough to go clean through a man.

dover-demon.depicted_variant: Witness-described form c13/c15; roadside wall c01. Headlight light replaces editorial moon as dominant.

visual_requirements.description: One huge watermelon/double-lobed peanut-shaped head, two large orange reflecting eyes and NO visible nose or mouth; pale peach-white skin, very thin neck, tiny torso, skinny arms and legs, long fingers; roughly4feet tall
Orange eyes reflect vehicle headlights as described; no other supernatural power, no beam, forehead gem or aura
Broken stone wall beside Farm Street in Dover Massachusetts at night

dover-demon.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Clamber across a broken roadside stone wall, long fingers gripping near camera and torso twisted towards viewer, enormous blank face suddenly caught by headlights (dover-demon-c06, dover-demon-c13, dover-demon-c14, dover-demon-c15).

basis_claims.quote: According to Bartlett, the figure was perched atop a broken stone wall.

statement.id: Menurut Bartlett sosok itu bertengger di atas dinding batu yang rusak.
statement.en: According to Bartlett, the figure was perched atop a broken stone wall.

basis_claims.quote: The Dover Demon is a cryptid reportedly sighted on April 21–22, 1977, in Dover, Massachusetts, a town approximately 15 miles (24 km) southwest of Boston.

statement.id: Dover Demon adalah kriptid yang dilaporkan terlihat pada 21–22 April 1977 di Dover, Massachusetts, kota sekitar 15 mil (24 km) di barat daya Boston.
statement.en: The Dover Demon is a cryptid reportedly sighted on April 21–22, 1977, in Dover, Massachusetts, a town approximately 15 miles (24 km) southwest of Boston.

basis_claims.quote: While driving along Farm Street in Dover, Massachusetts on April 21, 1977, seventeen-year-old William "Bill" Bartlett reported seeing an unknown being approximately 4 feet (1.2 m) tall, which he claimed possessed glowing orange eyes, lacked a visible nose or mouth, and had a watermelon-shaped head.

statement.id: Saat berkendara di Farm Street, Dover, pada 21 April 1977, William 'Bill' Bartlett (17) melaporkan melihat makhluk tak dikenal setinggi sekitar 4 kaki (1,2 m) yang menurutnya bermata oranye menyala, tanpa hidung atau mulut yang terlihat, dan berkepala berbentuk semangka.
statement.en: While driving along Farm Street in Dover on April 21, 1977, seventeen-year-old William 'Bill' Bartlett reported seeing an unknown being about 4 feet (1.2 m) tall, which he claimed had glowing orange eyes, no visible nose or mouth, and a watermelon-shaped head.

basis_claims.quote: The first came when Bill Bartlett, 17, was rolling in his sweet Volkswagen with some friends. Suddenly he saw — though nobody else in the car did — a bizarre creature on the side of the road: short but with a huge head, white or peach in color, big eyes and no other facial features, and very thin neck and limbs.

statement.id: Menurut tulisan ini, Bill Bartlett (17) berkendara bersama beberapa teman dan tiba-tiba melihat, tanpa terlihat oleh orang lain di mobil, makhluk aneh di tepi jalan: pendek tetapi berkepala besar, berwarna putih atau persik, bermata besar tanpa ciri wajah lain, dengan leher dan anggota badan sangat kurus.
statement.en: According to this account, Bill Bartlett, 17, was driving with some friends and suddenly saw, though nobody else in the car did, a bizarre creature at the roadside: short but with a huge head, white or peach in color, big eyes and no other facial features, and a very thin neck and limbs.

basis_claims.quote: Two hours later, John Baxter (15) was walking home when he encountered a silhouette walking toward him. He called out, and the creature ran away across a ditch, and John then caught his first good look at it. It had a huge double-lobed head like a peanut, and skinny arms and legs with long fingers

statement.id: Dua jam kemudian, John Baxter (15) yang berjalan pulang bertemu siluet yang berjalan ke arahnya; ia berseru, makhluk itu lari melintasi parit, dan John melihatnya dengan jelas: kepala besar berlobus dua seperti kacang, serta lengan dan kaki kurus berjari panjang.
statement.en: Two hours later, John Baxter (15) was walking home when he met a silhouette walking toward him; he called out, the creature ran away across a ditch, and John then got a good look: a huge double-lobed head like a peanut, and skinny arms and legs with long fingers.

basis_claims.quote: Bartlett (today a professional artist) and Baxter both drew sketches of what they saw, and they were strikingly similar. A small thin creature with a huge double-lobed head, tiny body, and shockingly skinny neck and limbs — and no features on its face except glowing eyes, reflecting the headlights.

statement.id: Bartlett (kini seniman profesional) dan Baxter sama-sama menggambar sketsa apa yang mereka lihat, dan sketsa itu sangat mirip: makhluk kecil kurus berkepala besar berlobus dua, bertubuh mungil, berleher dan anggota badan sangat kurus, tanpa ciri wajah selain mata menyala yang memantulkan lampu.
statement.en: Bartlett (today a professional artist) and Baxter both drew sketches of what they saw, and the sketches were strikingly similar: a small thin creature with a huge double-lobed head, tiny body, and shockingly skinny neck and limbs, with no facial features except glowing eyes reflecting the headlights.

engkanto.depicted_variant: Fair golden-haired blue-eyed absent-philtrum manifestation c09/c26; punitive stone throwing c18. Opaque clothing and close framing editorial, respectful terrifying sacred encounter rather than generic portrait.

visual_requirements.description: One fair-complexioned human-shaped adult male, blue eyes, golden hair, high bridged nose and conspicuously absent philtrum: perfectly smooth skin between nose and upper lip with no vertical groove; one head, two arms/two legs; fully opaque coarse long-sleeved tunic and trousers, no pointed elf ears
Documented punishment by stone throwing; projectile and struck bark fragments physically visible, no levitation, psychic ribbons, flame or aura
Lonely forest at night beside massive old tree roots and a large rock, dwelling places of these spirits

engkanto.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Throw a stone directly past the viewer, hand releasing in foreground, expression severe and focused; smooth upper lip close and prominent, a second stone clutched in other hand (engkanto-c01, engkanto-c09, engkanto-c26, engkanto-c18).

basis_claims.quote: are mythical environmental spirits that are said to have the ability to appear in human form. They are often associated with the spirits of ancestors and spirits of the dead called anito in the Philippines.

statement.id: Engkanto adalah roh lingkungan mitos yang konon dapat tampil dalam wujud manusia; mereka sering dikaitkan dengan arwah leluhur dan arwah orang mati yang disebut anito di Filipina.
statement.en: Engkanto are mythical environmental spirits said to be able to appear in human form; they are often associated with the spirits of ancestors and of the dead called anito in the Philippines.

basis_claims.quote: Some appear to be beautiful having blue eyes, fair complexion and golden hair, but may also have unusual features such as high-bridged noses and absent philtrums.

statement.id: Sebagian engkanto tampak cantik dengan mata biru, kulit cerah, dan rambut keemasan, tetapi dapat pula memiliki ciri tak biasa seperti hidung mancung dan tanpa lekuk di atas bibir.
statement.en: Some engkanto appear beautiful with blue eyes, fair complexion and golden hair, but may also have unusual features such as high-bridged noses and absent philtrums.

basis_claims.quote: They inject fear by the spectacular feats they do in order to punish whoever disregards their affections: stonethrowing, wrapping clothes around a post closed on both ends

statement.id: Menurut esai itu, engkanto menebar rasa takut lewat aksi mengejutkan untuk menghukum orang yang mengabaikan kasih sayang mereka, seperti melempar batu dan melilitkan pakaian pada tiang yang tertutup di kedua ujungnya.
statement.en: According to the essay, engkanto instil fear through spectacular feats to punish whoever disregards their affections, such as stone-throwing and wrapping clothes around a post closed at both ends.

basis_claims.quote: They are of fair complexion, golden haired, blue eyed; they have clean-cut features and perfectly chiselled faces. They exemplify the best of the Spaniards (in the past) and of the Americans (in the present).

statement.id: Menurut esai itu, engkanto digambarkan berkulit cerah, berambut keemasan, bermata biru, dengan wajah bersih dan sempurna, mewakili yang terbaik dari orang Spanyol (dahulu) dan orang Amerika (kini).
statement.en: According to the essay, engkanto are described as fair-complexioned, golden-haired and blue-eyed with clean-cut, perfectly chiselled faces, exemplifying the best of the Spaniards (in the past) and the Americans (in the present).

basis_claims.quote: They are whimsical and unpredictable; they play jokes on people; making them go astray in the forest at night, or transform themselves into the likenesses of mortal friends and relatives in order to dupe the objects of their desire.

statement.id: Menurut esai itu, engkanto berubah-ubah dan tak terduga: mereka mengerjai orang dengan menyesatkannya di hutan pada malam hari, atau menjelma menyerupai teman dan kerabat manusia untuk memperdaya orang yang mereka inginkan.
statement.en: According to the essay, engkanto are whimsical and unpredictable: they play jokes on people by making them go astray in the forest at night, or take the likeness of mortal friends and relatives to dupe the objects of their desire.

basis_claims.quote: People observe silence when they approach their reputed habitats: large rocks, large trees, secret caves or springs and fountains.

statement.id: Menurut esai itu, orang berdiam diri ketika mendekati tempat yang dipercaya sebagai kediaman engkanto: batu besar, pohon besar, gua rahasia, atau mata air dan pancuran.
statement.en: According to the essay, people keep silent when approaching the places reputed to be their habitats: large rocks, large trees, secret caves, or springs and fountains.

feilong.depicted_variant: Cloud-riding flying Chinese dragon c01/c06; dragon head/horns/scales conventional editorial realization of category, not additional factual morphology; limbs outframe/behindclouds avoid invented count.

visual_requirements.description: One dragon head and its long curling neck dominating the frame; conventional Chinese dragon muzzle, scaled neck, two eyes and two short antler-like horns rendered as editorial category interpretation; rest of body and all limbs are hidden behind thick clouds or outside frame, NO visible wings or invented limb count
Ride clouds as documented, clouds follow the dragon; ordinary cloud vapor displaced around airborne neck, no storm/rain/lightning control or fire breath
High cloudy sky, flying dragon in heavens

feilong.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Fly out of cloudbank directly above viewer, head turned down toward camera and jaws open, neck coil curving back into cloud, active airborne movement (feilong-c01, feilong-c05, feilong-c06).

basis_claims.quote: Feilong (simplified Chinese: 飞龙; traditional Chinese: 飛龍; pinyin: fēilóng; Wade–Giles: fei lung; lit. 'flying dragon') is a legendary creature that flies among clouds in Chinese mythology. Feilong is a proper name, and is often used as a title for other ideas and objects.

statement.id: Feilong adalah naga legenda Tiongkok yang terbang di antara awan.
statement.en: Feilong is a Chinese legendary dragon flying among clouds.

basis_claims.quote: The (5th–3rd centuries BCE) Yijing "Book of Changes" first uses feilong to symbolize a daren (大人) "great person; accomplished person". Qian (乾) "The Creative", the first hexagram, says, "Nine in the fifth place means: Flying dragons in the heavens.

statement.id: Yijing menggunakan naga terbang sebagai gambaran orang besar atau terampil.
statement.en: The Yijing uses a flying dragon as an image of a great or accomplished person.

basis_claims.quote: 九五曰：「飛龍在天，利見大人。」何謂也？子曰：「同聲相應，同氣相求；水流濕，火就燥，雲從龍，風從虎；

statement.id: Teks Yijing (bagian Wenyan hexagram Qian) mengutip baris 'naga terbang di langit' lalu menjelaskannya dengan ucapan bahwa awan mengikuti naga dan angin mengikuti harimau.
statement.en: The Yijing text (Wenyan commentary on the hexagram Qian) quotes the line 'a flying dragon in the heavens' and explains it with the saying that clouds follow the dragon and wind follows the tiger.

basis_claims.quote: 慎子曰：飛龍乘雲，騰蛇遊霧，雲罷霧霽，而龍蛇與螾螘同矣，則失其所乘也。

statement.id: Hanfeizi mengutip Shenzi: naga terbang menunggangi awan dan ular terbang mengarungi kabut, tetapi ketika awan dan kabut menghilang, naga dan ular menjadi sama dengan cacing dan semut karena kehilangan apa yang ditunggangi.
statement.en: The Hanfeizi quotes Shenzi: the flying dragon rides the clouds and the soaring snake roams the mist, but when clouds and mist clear, dragon and snake are the same as earthworms and ants, having lost what they ride.

fisher-s-ghost.depicted_variant: Bridge-sitting pointing apparition c06/c07/c20, not generic horror corpse. Historical clothing/partial transparency/editorial moon support documented ghost/disappearance; no invented wound/gore.

visual_requirements.description: One human male ghost with recognisable farmer face, one head/two eyes/two arms/two legs, fully opaque-cut early19th-century coarse shirt waistcoat and trousers; subtly partially translucent figure, solid identifiable face and pointing hand, no skull face or corpse injuries
Spectre points then disappears as documented; rail and moonlit creek visible through dissolving lower silhouette, no floating glyphs, skull, aura or colored mist
Old bridge rail over Campbelltown Queen Street creek, New South Wales, paddock on Worrall's land beyond creek under night sky

fisher-s-ghost.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Sit precariously on the bridge rail just above low viewer, lean toward camera while silently beckoning with near hand and pointing with other arm firmly across creek to the paddock; ghost beginning to disappear at lower legs and hem, spectator looks up from foreground (fisher-s-ghost-c04, fisher-s-ghost-c06, fisher-s-ghost-c20, fisher-s-ghost-c07).

basis_claims.quote: It arose from a series of historical events which occurred in Campbelltown, New South Wales, now a large urban population centre on the southwestern outskirts of Sydney, but at the time a remote rural outpost.

statement.id: Kisah ini lahir dari peristiwa nyata di Campbelltown, New South Wales.
statement.en: The story arose from historical occurrences in Campbelltown, New South Wales.

basis_claims.quote: On 17 June 1826 an English-born Australian farmer from Campbelltown named Frederick Fisher (born 28 August 1792 in London) suddenly disappeared.

statement.id: Pada 17 Juni 1826, petani kelahiran Inggris dari Campbelltown bernama Frederick Fisher tiba-tiba menghilang.
statement.en: On 17 June 1826 Frederick Fisher, an English-born farmer from Campbelltown, suddenly disappeared.

basis_claims.quote: Four months after Fisher's disappearance a respectable local man named John Farley, ran into the local hotel in a very agitated state. He told the astonished patrons that he had seen the ghost of Fred Fisher sitting on the rail of a nearby bridge.

statement.id: Empat bulan setelah Fisher menghilang, seorang warga terpandang bernama John Farley berlari ke hotel setempat dengan gelisah dan mengatakan telah melihat hantu Fred Fisher duduk di pagar jembatan terdekat.
statement.en: Four months after Fisher's disappearance a respectable local man, John Farley, ran into the local hotel agitated and told the patrons he had seen the ghost of Fred Fisher sitting on the rail of a nearby bridge.

basis_claims.quote: Farley related that the ghost had not spoken, but had merely pointed to a paddock beyond the creek, before disappearing.

statement.id: Farley bercerita bahwa hantu itu tidak berbicara, hanya menunjuk ke sebuah padang di seberang kali, lalu menghilang.
statement.en: Farley related that the ghost had not spoken but had merely pointed to a paddock beyond the creek before disappearing.

basis_claims.quote: The best-known version states that the body remained undiscovered until a local farmer named Farley was returning home from Patrick's Inn and encountered Fisher's ghost sitting on the rail at the bridge over Queen Street. The spectre beckoned to him and pointed back towards Worrall's land.

statement.id: Versi terkenal menyebut jasad itu tak ditemukan sampai seorang petani bernama Farley, yang pulang dari Patrick's Inn, bertemu hantu Fisher duduk di pagar jembatan di atas Queen Street; sosok itu melambai dan menunjuk kembali ke tanah Worrall.
statement.en: The best-known version says the body stayed undiscovered until a farmer named Farley, returning home from Patrick's Inn, met Fisher's ghost sitting on the rail at the bridge over Queen Street; the spectre beckoned and pointed back towards Worrall's land.

visual_requirements.description: One short human-shaped adult dwarf, broad compact body, one head/two eyes/two arms/two legs, fully opaque rough wool tunic/trousers and leather apron; grounded human hands, no horns or pointed ears; editorial aged stern face and beard
Documented blend of honey and Kvasir's blood makes mead of poetry: dark opaque red liquid mixes with amber honey in kettle; no body, wound, gore, floating writing or magical glow
Inside the dwarves' abode, one kettle Odrerir and two separate wooden vats Son and Bodn behind; no readable labels, low doorway and rough stone interior editorial

fjalar-q11969058.aura: Kesan aktif berasal dari Lean forward over the great kettle toward low camera while pouring honey into dark red mead, grip heavy stirring spoon with other hand, glaring protectively at viewer, copper kettle close and dominating foreground (fjalar-q11969058-c01, fjalar-q11969058-c02, fjalar-q11969058-c04, fjalar-q11969058-c05).

basis_claims.quote: Fjalar – imię kilku postaci w mitologii nordyckiej, oznaczające „oszusta” lub „ukrywającego”. ... Kolejną, najważniejszą z postaci o tym imieniu, był karzeł, brat Galara. Razem z bratem zabili Kvasera, a z jego krwi stworzyli miód poezji.

statement.id: Fjalar adalah nama beberapa tokoh mitologi Nordik yang berarti "penipu" atau "penyembunyi"; yang terpenting adalah kurcaci saudara Galar, yang bersama saudaranya membunuh Kvasir dan membuat madu puisi dari darahnya.
statement.en: Fjalar is the name of several Norse mythological figures, meaning 'deceiver' or 'hider' (oszusta, ukrywającego); the most important is the dwarf (karzeł), brother of Galar, who with him killed Kvasir (Kvasera) and made the mead of poetry (miód poezji) from his blood.

basis_claims.quote: Fjalar (gammelnorsk; Fjalarr av fela, «gjemme»; «Gjemmeren») på islansk; Fjalar «vitur» eller «fjölfròdur» som betyr klok. Fjalar er navn i norrøn mytologi på en dverg som ifølge Snorres Edda sammen med sin bror Galar drepte den vise Kvase. Av hans blod laget de skaldskapsmjøden. Skaldedrikken blir senere stjålet av jotnen Suttung.

statement.id: Fjalar (Nordik Kuno Fjalarr, dari fela, "menyembunyikan"; "si Penyembunyi") adalah nama kurcaci dalam mitologi Nordik yang menurut Edda Snorri bersama saudaranya Galar membunuh Kvasir yang bijak; dari darahnya mereka membuat madu puisi, yang kemudian dicuri raksasa Suttung.
statement.en: Fjalar (Old Norse Fjalarr, from fela, 'to hide'; 'the Hider') is a dwarf in Norse mythology who, per Snorri's Edda, with his brother Galar killed the wise Kvasir; from his blood they made the mead of poetry, later stolen by the giant Suttung.

basis_claims.quote: This man is called Kvasir, and he was so wise that none could question him concerning anything but that he knew the solution. He went up and down the earth to give instruction to men; and when he came upon invitation to the abode of certain dwarves, Fjalar and Galarr, they called him into privy converse with them, and killed him, letting his blood run into two vats and a kettle.

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Prose Edda ini, Kvasir sangat bijak sehingga tak ada yang bisa menanyainya hal yang jawabannya tak ia ketahui; ketika ia datang atas undangan ke tempat kurcaci Fjalar dan Galarr, mereka memanggilnya untuk berbicara empat mata, membunuhnya, dan membiarkan darahnya mengalir ke dua bejana besar dan sebuah kuali.
statement.en: In this translation of the Prose Edda, Kvasir was so wise that none could question him on anything he could not answer; when he came by invitation to the abode of the dwarves Fjalar and Galarr, they called him into private talk, killed him, and let his blood run into two vats and a kettle.

basis_claims.quote: The kettle is named Ódrerir, and the vats Són and Bodn; they blended honey with the blood, and the outcome was that mead by the virtue of which he who drinks becomes a skald or scholar.

statement.id: Kuali itu bernama Ódrerir dan bejananya Són dan Bodn; mereka mencampur madu dengan darah itu sehingga jadilah madu yang membuat peminumnya menjadi skald atau cendekiawan.
statement.en: The kettle is named Ódrerir and the vats Són and Bodn; they blended honey with the blood, producing a mead that makes whoever drinks it a skald or scholar.

statement.en: Galloway Puma, a phantom cat of Scottish folklore, Dumfries and Galloway.

The tourists apparently saw the animal while returning from a nature walk in the Galloway Forest.

statement.en: Late 1990s, Canadian tourists saw a cougar-like animal near Kirroughtree, Newton Stewart, Galloway Forest; locals 1999.

basis_claims.quote: After this, many people, specifically farmers and Forestry Commission workers, claimed to have seen a big black cat throughout the region, but mainly in the Machars area.

statement.id: Petani dan pekerja Forestry Commission melihat kucing hitam besar, terutama di Machars.
statement.en: Farmers and Forestry Commission workers saw a big black cat, mainly in the Machars.

basis_claims.quote: In June 2001, a young lady walking her dog near Newton Stewart golf course, which lies on the edge of Galloway Forest, was left startled and shaken when what she described as a "large black cat, bigger than an alsatian", sprung out at her

statement.id: Juni (June) 2001, perempuan dekat lapangan golf Newton Stewart; kucing hitam lebih besar dari alsatian; lari saat anjing menggonggong.
statement.en: June 2001, a woman near Newton Stewart golf course; a black cat bigger than an alsatian; fled when the dog barked.

statement.id: Pada periode Ptolemeus, griffin muncul sebagai makhluk campuran bersayap yang berpadu dengan Mata Matahari; fabel demotik "Die Seherin und die Hörerin" menggambarkannya dengan paruh elang, mata manusia, anggota badan singa, telinga ikan, dan ekor ular.
statement.en: In the Ptolemaic period the griffin appears as a winged hybrid combined with the sun eye; the demotic fable "Die Seherin und die Hörerin" describes it with a falcon's beak, human eyes, lion limbs, fish ears and a snake's tail.

statement.id: Sejak Periode Akhir, griffin dengan sebutan Mesir kuno Sfrr terutama mengemban fungsi pelindung.
statement.en: Since the Late Period the griffin, under the ancient Egyptian designation Sfrr, took on especially a protective function.

basis_claims.quote: The Grootslang is said to be a huge serpent that dwells in a cave known as the

statement.en: The Grootslang is said to be a huge serpent dwelling in a cave.

basis_claims.quote: According to local legend, the cave is filled with diamonds.

statement.id: Menurut legenda setempat, gua itu penuh berlian (diamonds).
statement.en: According to local legend, the cave is full of diamonds.

basis_claims.quote: According to a version of the story reported by Jon Manchip White as being told by the Bushmen, the Grootslang is older than the world and will protect its treasure for eternity.

statement.id: Menurut satu versi yang dilaporkan Jon Manchip White dari cerita orang Bushmen, Grootslang lebih tua daripada dunia dan akan menjaga hartanya (treasure) selamanya.
statement.en: In a version reported by Jon Manchip White as told by the Bushmen, the Grootslang is older than the world and will guard its treasure for eternity.

basis_claims.quote: natives are reluctant to guide expeditions to the spot. They believe the deep, black cavern is the home of the

statement.en: Local people are reluctant to guide expeditions to the spot because they believe the deep, black cavern is the Grootslang's home.

basis_claims.quote: White eye-witnesses state that the snake is forty feet long, leaving a track on the muddy river banks about three feet wide.

statement.en: Eyewitnesses stated the snake was forty feet long, leaving a track about three feet wide on the muddy riverbanks.

basis_claims.quote: But in the native mind there remains only one Great Snake, greatly feared.

basis_claims.quote: The Great Snake's hoard is well guarded.

basis_claims.quote: гульбиябан (гульбияван, гуль) —■чело­ векоподобное сущ ество крупных размеров, покрытое желтовато-серог шерстью, напоминающей верблюж

statement.id: Menurut para penutur kisah di Pamir Timur yang dicatat Rozenfeld, gulbiyabon (gulbiyaban, gul) adalah makhluk berwujud manusia berukuran besar, berbulu kuning keabu-abuan seperti bulu unta.
statement.en: According to storytellers of the Eastern Pamir recorded by Rozenfeld, the gulbiyaban (gulbiyavan, gul) is a large humanlike being covered in yellowish-grey hair resembling camel hair.

basis_claims.quote: От гульбиябана исходит резкий, нестерпи­ мый запах, который ощущ ается на значительном расстоянии. Иногда в рассказах о гульбиябане присутствует мотив о том, что у него выворочень ступни: пятка находится спереди, а пальцы — сзади.

statement.id: Dari gulbiyaban menyebar bau menyengat yang tak tertahankan hingga jauh; dalam beberapa kisah telapak kakinya terbalik, dengan tumit di depan dan jari di belakang.
statement.en: A sharp, unbearable smell comes from the gulbiyaban and is perceptible at a considerable distance; in some tales its feet are turned backwards, heel in front and toes behind.

basis_claims.quote: Обитает он якобы в пустынных местах, избегает людей и издает особый характерный крик.

statement.id: Gulbiyaban konon tinggal di tempat-tempat sunyi dan gersang, menghindari manusia, dan mengeluarkan teriakan khas.
statement.en: The gulbiyaban is said to dwell in deserted, barren places, avoids people and utters a characteristic cry.

basis_claims.quote: Гульбиябан, встретившись с палваном, предлагает ему бороться. При этом гульбиябан сначала просит у палвана жевательного табака — нас, который носят в табакерке за поясом; это он якобы делает для того, чтобы проверить, нет ли у палвана ножа. Если побеж дает палзаи, то гульбиябан убегает и больше никогда уж е не попадается ему на глаза.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Pamir Timur, gulbiyaban menantang pahlawan (palvan) bergulat dan lebih dulu meminta tembakau kunyah untuk memeriksa apakah ia membawa pisau; bila palvan menang, gulbiyaban melarikan diri dan tak pernah muncul lagi.
statement.en: In the Eastern Pamir tales, the gulbiyaban challenges a hero (palvan) to wrestle and first asks for chewing tobacco to check whether he carries a knife; if the palvan wins, the gulbiyaban runs away and never appears to him again.

basis_claims.quote: Hırtık; üst kısmının insan, alt kısmının hayvan şeklinde olduğuna inanılan, bedeni tüylerle kaplı, ayakları ters kötücül cin, yaratık.

statement.id: Hırtık adalah jin atau makhluk jahat (kötücül cin) yang dipercaya bertubuh atas manusia dan bertubuh bawah hewan, badannya berbulu, dan kakinya terbalik (ayakları ters).
statement.en: Hırtık is a malevolent jinn or creature (kötücül cin) believed to be human above and animal below, with a hair-covered body and backward feet (ayakları ters).

basis_claims.quote: Akarsularda (Elazığ yöresinde özellikle Fırat Nehri'nde) yaşadığı kabul edilir. Bu yörelerde adına Çay hırtığı da denilmektedir.

statement.id: Ia dianggap tinggal di sungai (akarsularda), terutama di Sungai Fırat (Efrat) di daerah Elazığ, dan di sana disebut juga Çay hırtığı.
statement.en: It is held to live in running waters (akarsularda), especially the Fırat (Euphrates) River in the Elazığ area, where it is also called Çay hırtığı.

basis_claims.quote: Hırtık insan kılığına girip, kılığına girdiği kişinin yakın arkadaşlarına veya akrabalarına gidip, onlarla konuşarak orman ya da akarsu kıyısına götürüp boğmakta, öldürmektedir.

statement.id: Hırtık menyamar sebagai manusia (insan kılığına), mendatangi sahabat atau kerabat orang yang ditirunya, mengajak mereka bicara, membawa mereka ke hutan atau tepi sungai, lalu menenggelamkan dan membunuh mereka.
statement.en: Hırtık takes on a human guise (insan kılığına), goes to the close friends or relatives of the person it imitates, talks with them, leads them to a forest or riverbank, and drowns and kills them.

basis_claims.quote: Özellikle karanlıkta ortaya çıkan hırtıktan korunmanın tek yolu ateş yakmaktır. Konuştukları kişinin hırtık olduğundan şüphelenen kişiler, vücutlarının çevresinden veya ayaklarının altından ateş geçirirler.

statement.id: Hırtık terutama muncul dalam gelap (karanlıkta), dan satu-satunya cara melindungi diri adalah menyalakan api (ateş); orang yang curiga lawan bicaranya hırtık melewatkan api di sekitar tubuh atau di bawah kaki mereka.
statement.en: Hırtık appears especially in the dark (karanlıkta), and the only protection is to light a fire (ateş); people who suspect the person they are talking to is a hırtık pass fire around their bodies or under their feet.

basis_claims.quote: Üst kısmının insan görünümlü, ayaklarıyla bacaklarının ise hayvan biçimli olduğuna inanılır. Bedeni tüylerle kaplı, ayakları terstir.

statement.id: Bagian atasnya dipercaya tampak seperti manusia, sedangkan kaki dan tungkainya berbentuk hewan; badannya berbulu (tüylerle kaplı) dan kakinya terbalik.
statement.en: Its upper part is believed to look human while its feet and legs are animal-shaped; its body is covered with hair (tüylerle kaplı) and its feet point backwards.

hahau-whenua.aura: The documented great fish is physically pulled up from the ocean; immense seawater cascades off scales and body as it rises, no generic energy or magical aura [hahau-whenua-c01, hahau-whenua-c02, hahau-whenua-c04]

basis_claims.quote: In a Māori tradition ascribed by John White to the Ngāti Hau tribe, Hāhau-whenua is the name of the great fish caught by Māui which became the North Island of New Zealand

statement.id: Hāhau-whenua adalah nama ikan besar tangkapan Māui yang menjadi North Island di New Zealand.
statement.en: Hāhau-whenua is the great fish caught by Māui that became New Zealand's North Island.

basis_claims.quote: When he pulled the fish up, he saw it was Hāhau-whenua

statement.en: When Māui pulled up the fish, he saw that it was Hāhau-whenua.

basis_claims.quote: IKA-A-MAUI (myth.), Te Ika-a-Maui, the fish of Maui, the North Island of New Zealand, so called because pulled up by Maui from the depths of the ocean.

statement.id: Menurut Tregear, Te Ika-a-Maui, ikan Maui, adalah North Island of New Zealand, dinamai demikian karena ditarik Maui dari kedalaman samudra.
statement.en: According to Tregear, Te Ika-a-Maui, the fish of Maui, is the North Island of New Zealand, so called because it was pulled up by Maui from the depths of the ocean.

basis_claims.quote: He pulled up a giant fish which would become the North Island of New Zealand, known as Te Ika-a-Māui; the valleys and mountains of the island were made by his brothers chopping up the fish for themselves.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Māui menarik ikan raksasa yang menjadi North Island, dikenal sebagai Te Ika-a-Māui; lembah dan gunung pulau itu dibuat oleh saudara-saudaranya yang mencincang ikan itu.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Māui pulled up a giant fish that became the North Island, known as Te Ika-a-Māui; the island's valleys and mountains were made by his brothers chopping up the fish.

hakawai-mythology.depicted_variant: Hōkioi burung pemangsa raksasa sebesar moa, berbulu warna-warni dan jambul merah menurut Tregear (c12); bukan hipotesis snipe/frigatebird.

visual_requirements.description: One huge flying bird of prey with one head, hooked avian beak, two eyes, exactly two feathered wings and exactly two taloned avian legs. MANY-COLOURED feathers, and a clearly separate vivid RED bunch of feathers on the crown of its head. Size compared to moa means huge size only, NOT moa shape or flightlessness. Use a coherent flying raptor body, not an ostrich, snipe or frigatebird reconstruction.

Its descending night flight and roaring call are the omen-bearing action; express the non-vocal high-speed roar through physically swept feather tips and passing cloud mist, not visible sound lettering, shock rings, fire or supernatural lights. Keep the bird fully visible so its documented plumage is readable.
High moonlit night sky above distant dark New Zealand land silhouettes; only faint mist at altitude, no daylight storm, no invented temple or tribal artifacts.

hakawai-mythology.aura: Its descending night flight and roaring call are the omen-bearing action; express the non-vocal high-speed roar through physically swept feather tips and passing cloud mist, not visible sound lettering, shock rings, fire or supernatural lights. Keep the bird fully visible so its documented plumage is readable. [hakawai-mythology-c03, hakawai-mythology-c05, hakawai-mythology-c07]

basis_claims.quote: In Māori mythology the Hakawai was one of eleven tapu (sacred) birds of Raka-maomao, a god of wind.  The Hakawai lived in the heavens and only descended to the earth at night.

statement.id: Hakawai adalah salah satu dari sebelas burung tapu dewa angin Raka-maomao yang tinggal di langit dan turun ke bumi saat malam.
statement.en: Hakawai was one of eleven tapu birds of wind god Raka-maomao living in the heavens and descending at night.

basis_claims.quote: Hearing the Hakawai was considered to be a bad omen, traditionally presaging war.

statement.id: Mendengar suara Hakawai dianggap sebagai pertanda buruk yang menandakan datangnya perang.
statement.en: Hearing the Hakawai was considered a bad omen traditionally presaging war.

basis_claims.quote: It was considered to be a gigantic bird of prey and was described (as the Hōkioi) by a Ngāti Apa chief, to the Governor of New Zealand Sir George Grey

statement.id: Burung ini dipandang sebagai pemangsa raksasa yang digambarkan oleh kepala suku Ngāti Apa.
statement.en: It was considered a gigantic bird of prey described by a Ngāti Apa chief.

basis_claims.quote: There the sound ascribed to the Hakawai was described as having two main components, the first part being vocal, a call rendered as hakwai, hakwai, hakwai, followed by a non-vocal roar as of an object travelling through the air at high speed.

statement.id: Suara Hakawai digambarkan memiliki dua unsur yaitu panggilan vokal hakwai diikuti deru gemuruh cepat.
statement.en: The sound of Hakawai had two components: a vocal call hakwai followed by a high-speed non-vocal roar.

basis_claims.quote: In Maori legends and proverbs, the hakawai was a mythical bird dwelling afar in celestial space and only descending to earth at night.
basis_claims.locator: Myths and legends of the hakawai

statement.id: Dalam legenda dan peribahasa Māori, hakawai adalah burung mitos yang berdiam jauh di angkasa dan hanya turun ke bumi pada malam hari.
statement.en: In Maori legends and proverbs, the hakawai was a mythical bird dwelling afar in celestial space and only descending to earth at night.

basis_claims.quote: The call was heard on calm moonlit nights and came from a great height.

statement.id: Panggilan hakawai terdengar pada malam berbulan yang tenang dan datang dari ketinggian.
statement.en: The call of the hakawai was heard on calm moonlit nights and came from a great height.

basis_claims.quote: HOKIOI {hokioi), the name of an extinct or mythical bird ... The Natives say that it was (like the Arabian Roc) a huge bird of prey, large as the moa (Dinornis) ; also that it had many-coloured feathers, and a bunch of red feathers on its head.

statement.id: Kamus Tregear mencatat hokioi sebagai nama burung punah atau mitos; menurut penutur Māori ia burung pemangsa raksasa sebesar moa, berbulu warna-warni dengan seikat bulu merah di kepalanya.
statement.en: Tregear's dictionary lists hokioi as the name of an extinct or mythical bird; the Natives say it was a huge bird of prey, large as the moa, with many-coloured feathers and a bunch of red feathers on its head.

hasshaku-sama.depicted_variant: Hasshaku-sama legenda urban modern: perempuan pucat sekitar240cm, gaun terusan dan topi; adegan mengetuk serta meniru suara c06.

visual_requirements.description: One pale woman approximately 240 centimetres tall, indeterminate adult age rendered as an older woman with an ordinary human face. One head, two arms, two legs, ordinary human hands with exactly five fingers each. Wearing one plain broad-brim hat and a fully opaque, loose, ankle-length one-piece dress with high closed neckline and long sleeves. No cleavage, no tight fitting costume, no monstrous mouth or claws.

She lures with an imitated familiar voice and knocks at doors or windows; show the actual knocking gesture and disturbing speaking expression only. No written po-po-po, visible sound glyphs, eye glow, magical smoke or violent victim scene.

Outside a plain domestic wooden house in Japan at night, a normal approximately two-metre door and low window provide honest scale for a 2.4-metre figure. No signs, talismans, Jizo, inscriptions or franchise mansion. Empty scene with no child or victim.

hasshaku-sama.aura: She lures with an imitated familiar voice and knocks at doors or windows; show the actual knocking gesture and disturbing speaking expression only. No written po-po-po, visible sound glyphs, eye glow, magical smoke or violent victim scene. [hasshaku-sama-c05, hasshaku-sama-c06]

basis_claims.quote: Eight Foot Tall') is a Japanese urban legend that is depicted as a giant ghost-lady figure that arose recently in the internet, a fictional character that has been relatively invented and popularly adopted in modern Japanese urban legend.

statement.id: Hasshaku-sama adalah hantu perempuan raksasa dalam legenda urban Jepang modern.
statement.en: Hasshaku-sama is a giant woman-like ghost in a modern Japanese urban legend.

basis_claims.quote: Hasshaku-sama is depicted particularly as an 8 foot tall modern yōkai, a gigantic woman with pale skin and a one-piece dress.

statement.id: Sosok itu digambarkan tinggi dan pucat serta memakai gaun terusan.
statement.en: The figure is portrayed as tall and pale, wearing a one-piece dress.

basis_claims.quote: She is said to always appears as a woman with a hat, and she makes an odd "po po po" sound when she appears.

statement.id: Kisah-kisah memberinya topi dan bunyi po po po yang berulang.
statement.en: Stories give her a hat and a repeated po po po sound.

basis_claims.quote: 「ぽぽぽ」という、人間のような機械のような奇妙な女の声で笑い、人間を襲う。狙った人間を数日以内に取り殺すが、成人前の若者、特に子供を狙う傾向がある。

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Jepang, ia tertawa dengan suara perempuan aneh "po po po" yang seperti manusia sekaligus mesin dan menyerang manusia; ia membunuh sasarannya dalam beberapa hari dan cenderung mengincar anak muda, terutama anak-anak.
statement.en: According to Japanese Wikipedia, she laughs with an odd, human-yet-mechanical woman’s voice saying "po po po" and attacks people; she kills her target within days and tends to target the young, especially children.

basis_claims.quote: 声色を自由に変える能力を持ち、狙った人間の知人の声を出しておびき寄せたり、ドアや窓を叩いて音を鳴らすことがある。

statement.id: Wikipedia bahasa Jepang menyebut ia mampu mengubah suara sesuka hati, memancing sasaran dengan meniru suara kenalannya, dan kadang membuat bunyi dengan mengetuk pintu atau jendela.
statement.en: Japanese Wikipedia says she can freely change her voice, lures a target by imitating the voice of an acquaintance, and sometimes makes noises by knocking on doors and windows.

basis_claims.quote: 名前の通り、8尺(約240cm)ある高身長の女性の姿をしており、若い女性、中年女性、老婆など、年齢不特定である。

statement.id: Wikipedia bahasa Jepang menyebut sesuai namanya ia berwujud perempuan jangkung delapan shaku (sekitar 240 cm) dengan usia yang tidak tentu: perempuan muda, setengah baya, atau nenek.
statement.en: Japanese Wikipedia says that, as her name suggests, she appears as a tall woman of eight shaku (about 240 cm) of indeterminate age: young, middle-aged, or old.

hoop-snake.depicted_variant: Legenda lokal Hoop Snake Hill c07/c08: ular raksasa berguling menuruni bukit dengan ekor di rahang, duri ekor; bukan versi Australia berduri di sisi dalam.

visual_requirements.description: ONE continuous limbless scaly snake with ONE head and ONE tapering tail. Its body makes ONE complete upright circular HOOP, leaving a large empty hole in the middle. At the upper-right of the hoop its mouth clearly GRIPS ITS OWN narrow tail near the tail tip; tail is visibly between the closed jaws, with a small terminal hard SPIKE protruding just past the bite. One snake, two ordinary snake eyes; no limbs, wings, horns or second head. NO long spines on the inner hoop: do not mix the Australian variant.

Tail-gripping wheel-like pursuit down a hill is the visible action; the spiked tail remains held in the mouth in this moment before it straightens to strike. No victim, no venom beam, no tree magically dying in a scene where it is not jabbed.
Steep rough North American wooded hill slope, uninscribed trees and rocks; descending rolling motion toward viewer, no historical marker sign or text.

hoop-snake.aura: Tail-gripping wheel-like pursuit down a hill is the visible action; the spiked tail remains held in the mouth in this moment before it straightens to strike. No victim, no venom beam, no tree magically dying in a scene where it is not jabbed. [hoop-snake-c02, hoop-snake-c07, hoop-snake-c08]

basis_claims.quote: The hoop snake is a legendary creature of the United States, Canada, and Australia.

statement.id: Hoop snake adalah makhluk legendaris di United States, Canada, dan Australia.
statement.en: The hoop snake is a legendary creature of the United States, Canada, and Australia.

basis_claims.quote: According to folklore, the distinguishing feature of a hoop snake is that it can grasp its tail in its jaws, like the ouroboros of Greek mythology, and roll after its prey like a wheel.

statement.id: Ciri khas hoop snake adalah menggigit ekornya sendiri dan menggelinding mengejar mangsa seperti roda.
statement.en: A hoop snake grasps its tail in its jaws and rolls after prey like a wheel.

basis_claims.quote: FOR GENERATIONS, LOCAL LEGEND TELLS OF AN ENORMOUS SNAKE THAT GRASPED ITS TAIL IN ITS MOUTH AND ROLLED DOWN THIS HILL TOWARD ITS VICTIMS.

statement.id: Prasasti penanda sejarah menyatakan bahwa selama beberapa generasi legenda setempat bercerita tentang ular raksasa yang menggigit ekornya dan berguling menuruni bukit ini ke arah korbannya.
statement.en: A historical marker inscription states that for generations local legend tells of an enormous snake that grasped its tail in its mouth and rolled down this hill toward its victims.

basis_claims.quote: The hoop snake rolls toward its victims, and at the final moment straightens out its body and lashes out with its spiked tail.

statement.id: Menurut uraian penanda itu, hoop snake berguling ke arah korbannya dan pada saat terakhir meluruskan tubuhnya lalu menyerang dengan ekornya yang berduri.
statement.en: According to the marker description, the hoop snake rolls toward its victims and at the final moment straightens out its body and lashes out with its spiked tail.

dragon-turtle.depicted_variant: the original Chinese turtle-shell dragon-body mythic hybrid

visual_requirements.description: One living turtle-shell and dragon-body hybrid, one reptilian dragon head, two eyes, large domed turtle shell, scaled dragon neck and body; only two front feet visible, rear body naturally hidden by shell and crop; no horns, wings, extra heads or imported game monster ornaments

dragon-turtle.aura: No documented visible elemental power; imposing living hybrid through anatomy, determined action and light only [dragon-turtle-c01]

basis_claims.quote: A dragon turtle (Chinese : 龍龜, pinyin : Lóngguī) is a legendary Chinese creature that combines two of the four celestial animals of Chinese mythology: the shell of a turtle with a dragon's body is promoted as a positive ornament in Feng Shui, symbolizing courage, determination, fertility, longevity, power, success, and support.

statement.id: Dragon turtle adalah makhluk legenda Tiongkok yang memadukan cangkang kura-kura dengan tubuh naga.
statement.en: The dragon turtle is a Chinese legendary creature combining a turtle shell with a dragon body.

druk.depicted_variant: the revered thunder-dragon with jewels of Tibetan and Bhutanese mythology

visual_requirements.description: One living dragon head and upper curling neck, two natural eyes, smooth scaled skull, no horns, antlers, crown spines, wings, whiskers or manelike additions. Two visible foreclaws hold unmarked polished jewels; remaining body and limbs concealed naturally by storm clouds
Violent storm clouds and rain accompany its roar, the documented thunder as Cloud-Voice of dragon; no lightning breath and no jewel beams
Storm above the Ralung Monastery foundation setting, only dark sky shown

druk.aura: Violent storm clouds and rain accompany its roar, the documented thunder as Cloud-Voice of dragon; no lightning breath and no jewel beams [druk-c05]

basis_claims.quote: The Druk (Standard Tibetan: འབྲུག, Dzongkha: འབྲུག་) is the "thunder dragon" of Tibetan and Bhutanese mythology and a Bhutanese national symbol. A druk appears on the flag of Bhutan, holding jewels to represent wealth. In Dzongkha, Bhutan is called Druk Yul "Land of Druk", and Bhutanese leaders are called Druk Gyalpo, "Thunder Dragon Kings".

statement.id: Druk adalah naga guntur dalam mitologi Tibet dan Bhutan.
statement.en: Druk is the thunder dragon of Tibetan and Bhutanese mythology.

basis_claims.quote: The Druk (Standard Tibetan: འབྲུག, Dzongkha: འབྲུག་) is the "thunder dragon" of Tibetan and Bhutanese mythology and a Bhutanese national symbol. A druk appears on the flag of Bhutan, holding jewels to represent wealth. In Dzongkha, Bhutan is called Druk Yul "Land of Druk", and Bhutanese leaders are called Druk Gyalpo, "Thunder Dragon Kings".

statement.id: Pada bendera Bhutan, Druk memegang permata yang melambangkan kekayaan.
statement.en: On Bhutan's flag, Druk holds jewels symbolizing wealth.

basis_claims.quote: The druk (also known as a "duk" or "dug") was adopted as an emblem by the Drukpa Lineage, which originated in Tibet and spread to Bhutan.  According to traditional accounts, when the sect's founder, Tsangpa Gyare, 1st Gyalwang Drukpa, began to build Ralung Monastery, there was a violent storm.  Thunder, or the "Cloud-Voice", is seen as the roar of the dragon.

statement.id: Kisah pendirian Ralung mengaitkan badai dan guntur dengan raungan naga.
statement.en: The Ralung foundation story connects a storm and thunder with a dragon's roar.

dyrnwch.depicted_variant: the Welsh giant owner of the miraculous cauldron

dyrnwch.aura: Food physically boils inside the cauldron, with ordinary rising steam; its documented discrimination of brave and cowardly is not invented as colored magic [dyrnwch-c10]

basis_claims.quote: Dyrnwch, Beiname „der Riese“, auch Diwrnach, Beiname „der Ire“, Dyrnog, Tyrnog, irisch Diugurach, ist eine Sagengestalt aus der walisischen Mythologie.

statement.id: Dyrnwch, berjuluk 'sang Raksasa' (der Riese), juga Diwrnach berjuluk 'orang Irlandia' (der Ire), Dyrnog, Tyrnog, dalam bahasa Irlandia Diugurach, adalah tokoh legenda (Sagengestalt) dari mitologi Welsh (walisischen Mythologie).
statement.en: Dyrnwch, nicknamed 'the Giant' (der Riese), also Diwrnach, nicknamed 'the Irishman' (der Ire), Dyrnog, Tyrnog, Irish Diugurach, is a figure of legend (Sagengestalt) from Welsh mythology (walisischen Mythologie).

basis_claims.quote: Eine der Aufgabe ist, den Kessel des irischen Riesen Dyrnwch, im Text Diwrnach genannt, für das Hochzeitsmahl zu erringen.

statement.id: Salah satu tugasnya adalah merebut kuali (Kessel) milik raksasa Irlandia (irischen Riesen) Dyrnwch, yang dalam teks disebut Diwrnach, untuk jamuan pernikahan (Hochzeitsmahl).
statement.en: One of the tasks is to win the cauldron (Kessel) of the Irish giant (irischen Riesen) Dyrnwch, called Diwrnach in the text, for the wedding feast (Hochzeitsmahl).

basis_claims.quote: The Cauldron of Dyrnwch the Giant (Pair Dyrnwch Gawr ... "if meat for a coward were put in it to boil, it would never boil; but if meat for a brave man were put in it, it would boil quickly (and thus the brave could be distinguished from the cowardly)".

statement.id: Kuali Dyrnwch sang Raksasa (Pair Dyrnwch Gawr): daging untuk seorang pengecut tidak akan pernah mendidih di dalamnya, sedangkan daging untuk orang pemberani cepat mendidih, sehingga yang berani dapat dibedakan dari yang pengecut.
statement.en: The Cauldron of Dyrnwch the Giant (Pair Dyrnwch Gawr): meat for a coward would never boil in it, but meat for a brave man would boil quickly, so that the brave could be distinguished from the cowardly.

Tavatimsa heaven, dark vast sky and small distant clouds at its feet

basis_claims.quote: Er ist ein riesenhafter Elefant, groß wie ein Berg. Er hat meistens drei, manchmal sogar 33 Köpfe, jeder Kopf ist mit sieben Stoßzähnen ausgestattet.

statement.id: Erawan adalah gajah raksasa sebesar gunung, biasanya berkepala tiga, kadang sampai 33, tiap kepala bergading tujuh.
statement.en: Erawan is a giant elephant as big as a mountain, usually with three heads, sometimes 33, each with seven tusks.

basis_claims.quote: Er ist das Reittier des hinduistischen Gottes des Regens und des Donners Indra, dem Herrscher über den Tavatimsa-Himmel, der Wohnstatt von 33 Göttern vedischen Ursprungs.

statement.id: Erawan adalah tunggangan Indra, dewa Hindu (hinduistischen) hujan dan guntur, penguasa surga Tavatimsa, kediaman 33 dewa berasal-usul Weda.
statement.en: Erawan is the mount of Indra, the Hindu god of rain and thunder, ruler of the Tavatimsa heaven, home of 33 gods of Vedic origin.

basis_claims.quote: Deze reusachtige witte olifant is het rijdier van Indra en bevindt zich in de hemel Tavatimsa. Het dier wordt afgebeeld met drie of meer driekoppige olifantskoppen. Ook de naam "I-rapote" wordt in Thailand gebruikt.

statement.id: Gajah putih raksasa ini tunggangan Indra dan berada di surga Tavatimsa; ia digambarkan dengan tiga kepala gajah atau lebih, dan nama I-rapote juga dipakai di Thailand.
statement.en: This giant white elephant is Indra's mount and dwells in the Tavatimsa heaven; it is shown with three or more elephant heads, and the name I-rapote is also used in Thailand.

ethiopian-pegasus.depicted_variant: the two-horned winged horse of Pliny and medieval bestiaries

visual_requirements.description: One muscular horse head with exactly TWO plain straight horns growing from opposite sides of the forehead, two eyes, four horse legs ending in solid hooves, exactly TWO large feathered wings on its back, one natural horse tail. Red Sea island off Eritrean coast

ethiopian-pegasus.aura: No elemental power documented; natural wingbeats and physical spray from surf below, no magical glow [ethiopian-pegasus-c01, ethiopian-pegasus-c04]

basis_claims.quote: An Ethiopian pegasus is an animal from medieval bestiaries. According to Pliny the Elder, they were a breed of two-horned, winged horses from Ethiopia. They reportedly lived on an island in the Red Sea off the coast of Eritrea.

statement.id: Pegasus Etiopia adalah hewan dari bestiari abad pertengahan; menurut Plinius Tua, mereka ras kuda bersayap bertanduk dua dari Etiopia yang konon hidup di sebuah pulau di Laut Merah lepas pantai Eritrea.
statement.en: The Ethiopian pegasus is an animal of medieval bestiaries; according to Pliny the Elder they were a breed of two-horned winged horses from Ethiopia, said to live on an island in the Red Sea off Eritrea.

basis_claims.quote: «В Ефіопії народжуються... багато чудовиськ — [зокрема] крилаті коні, озброєні рогами, звані пегасами».

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Ukraina mengutip Naturalis Historia karya Plinius: "Di Etiopia lahir banyak monster, di antaranya kuda bersayap bersenjata tanduk yang disebut pegasus."
statement.en: The Ukrainian article quotes Pliny's Natural History: 'In Ethiopia are born many monsters, among them winged horses armed with horns, called pegasi.'

Documented river fish hunter caught mid-capture; only physical splash from movement, no magical water control
Dark wet riverbank beside flowing river

gangi-kozo.aura: Documented river fish hunter caught mid-capture; only physical splash from movement, no magical water control [gangi-kozo-c02, gangi-kozo-c11]

basis_claims.quote: 画図には全身が毛に覆われた河童のような妖怪が描かれており、石燕による同書の解説文によれば、やすりのような歯を持ち、川辺で魚を獲るものとされている。

statement.id: Gambarnya menyerupai kappa berbulu.
statement.en: The image resembles a hairy kappa.

basis_claims.quote: Their most notable features are their webbed hands and toes, and their long teeth which are sharp and jagged like files.

statement.id: Gambaran belakangan memberinya selaput pada tangan dan jari kaki.
statement.en: A later description gives it webbed hands and toes.

basis_claims.quote: Gangi kozō are hairy, monkey-like water spirits which inhabit rivers. They live along the riverbanks, where they hunt fish.

statement.en: Gangi kozō are described as hairy, monkey-like water spirits that live along riverbanks and hunt fish.

Crow Brook wooden footbridge at French Fort Cove at night

headless-nun.aura: The documented headless ghost roams searching for her missing head; no emitted glow or floating skull invented [headless-nun-c05, headless-nun-c10]

statement.en: The Headless Nun is a ghost legend tied to French Fort Cove in Miramichi, New Brunswick.

basis_claims.quote: the Headless Nun was an 18th-century resident of the area named Sister Marie Inconnue
