basis_claims.quote: is a mermaid, water spirit, and/or goddess in the folklore of parts of Western Africa, Central Africa, Eastern Africa, and Southern Africa.

statement.id: Mami Wata adalah putri duyung, roh air, dan/atau dewi dalam cerita rakyat sebagian Afrika Barat, Afrika Tengah, Afrika Timur, dan Afrika Selatan (Western, Central, Eastern, Southern Africa).
statement.en: Mami Wata is a mermaid, water spirit and/or goddess in the folklore of parts of Western, Central, Eastern and Southern Africa.

basis_claims.quote: often depicted as a fair-skinned woman with long, flowing hair and a particular interest in objects foreign to West Africans that her adherents place at her shrines.

statement.id: Ia sering digambarkan sebagai perempuan berkulit terang dengan rambut panjang tergerai, yang menyukai benda-benda asing yang diletakkan pemujanya di tempat suci (shrines).
statement.en: She is often depicted as a fair-skinned woman with long flowing hair, interested in foreign objects that her adherents place at her shrines.

basis_claims.quote: Mami is a goddess of wealth, fertility, healing, wisdom, and profound beauty. She holds the power to manipulate the oceans and rivers, and possesses the ability to transform in order to seduce and mesmerize humans with her alluring beauty.

statement.id: Mami adalah dewi kekayaan, kesuburan, penyembuhan, kebijaksanaan, dan kecantikan; ia berkuasa mengendalikan samudra dan sungai serta mampu berubah wujud untuk merayu dan memukau manusia.
statement.en: Mami is a goddess of wealth, fertility, healing, wisdom and beauty; she can manipulate oceans and rivers and can transform to seduce and mesmerize humans.

basis_claims.quote: People believe that she lives in a mansion under the water, from which she some times ventures on to the shore to comb out her long hair with a golden comb.

statement.id: Di Liberia orang percaya ia tinggal di istana di bawah air dan kadang naik ke pantai untuk menyisir rambut panjangnya dengan sisir emas (golden comb).
statement.en: People in Liberia believe she lives in a mansion under the water and sometimes comes ashore to comb her long hair with a golden comb.

mamlambo.depicted_variant: the horse-headed fish-bodied short-legged serpent-necked river monster reported in1997

basis_claims.quote: tenía cabeza de caballo, la parte inferior de un pez, piernas cortas, y el cuello de serpiente,

statement.en: According to villagers the monster had a horse's head (caballo), the lower body of a fish (pez), short legs and a snake's neck (serpiente).

maui.depicted_variant: the Polynesian hero hauling up a vast fish that becomes the NorthIsland

visual_requirements.description: ONE adult Polynesian humanhero, onehead/twoeyes, TWO arms with5fingers perhand, TWO legs. Fullyopaque plainwoven tunic andwrap cover chest/hips; no tattoos, jewelry or headdress. ONE large clearly recognizable JAWBONE FISHHOOK attached to tightlywoven FLAX LINE; no industrialmetalhook.

Documented giantfish becomesNorthIsland: ONE immense wetfish back rises throughwater beneath the tautline, darkrocky island-like ridge suggested alongits back; physicalseawater thundersdown. No glow, runes or firepower.
Ocean duringthe fishingexpedition. A plainwoodencanoe is practicaleditorial staging, no decoratedmodernboat.

maui.aura: Brace towardcamera and haul taut flaxline with bothhands, jawbonehook lifting the enormous fish fromthe ocean as his clothes andcanoe strainwiththe pull. Grounded in maui-c01, maui-c10, maui-c10, maui-c11

basis_claims.quote: Māui or Maui is the great culture hero and trickster in Polynesian mythology.

statement.id: Māui adalah pahlawan budaya dan penipu ulung dalam mitologi Polinesia.
statement.en: Māui is the great culture hero and trickster in Polynesian mythology.

basis_claims.quote: Māui also is credited with the creation of the Hawaiian islands, when he went on a fishing expedition with his friends, and, using a magic fish hook, pulled up various island groups from the oceanic depths.

statement.id: Māui juga dipercaya menciptakan kepulauan Hawaii: dalam ekspedisi memancing bersama teman-temannya ia memakai kail ajaib untuk menarik berbagai gugusan pulau dari dasar samudra.
statement.en: Māui is also credited with creating the Hawaiian islands: on a fishing expedition with his friends he used a magic fish hook to pull up various island groups from the ocean depths.

basis_claims.quote: One night, he wove for himself a flax fishing line and enchanted it with a karakia to give it strength; to this he attached the magic fish-hook made from the jawbone that his grandmother Murirangawhenua had given him.
basis_claims.locator: Māori mythology — Islands of New Zealand

statement.id: Pada suatu malam ia menganyam tali pancing dari rami dan memberinya kekuatan dengan karakia (mantra); padanya ia mengikatkan kail ajaib dari tulang rahang yang diberikan neneknya, Murirangawhenua.
statement.en: One night he wove a flax fishing line and enchanted it with a karakia (incantation) to give it strength; to it he attached the magic fish-hook made from the jawbone his grandmother Murirangawhenua had given him.

basis_claims.quote: He pulled up a giant fish which would become the North Island of New Zealand, known as Te Ika-a-Māui; the valleys and mountains of the island were made by his brothers chopping up the fish for themselves.
basis_claims.locator: Māori mythology — Islands of New Zealand

statement.id: Ia menarik seekor ikan raksasa yang kelak menjadi Pulau Utara Selandia Baru, yang dikenal sebagai Te Ika-a-Māui; lembah dan gunung di pulau itu terbentuk ketika saudara-saudaranya mencincang ikan itu untuk diri mereka sendiri.
statement.en: He pulled up a giant fish that would become the North Island of New Zealand, known as Te Ika-a-Māui; the island's valleys and mountains were made by his brothers chopping up the fish for themselves.

mbielu-mbielu-mbielu.depicted_variant: the submerged Likouala creature whose algal-covered back bears planks

ALL head,eyes,mouth,legs,belly andtail remain completely BELOWWATER and invisible. No dinosaurhead, monitorhead, crocodileface or tailspikes invented.

Riverwater in Likouala-Mossaka Congo; forest riverbanks remain smallbackground only. Afternoon.

mbielu-mbielu-mbielu.aura: Thrust the great plankback throughwater towardcamera so wetplates tower overthe foreground and green algae stream fromtheir edges. Grounded in mbielu-mbielu-mbielu-c02, mbielu-mbielu-mbielu-c05, mbielu-mbielu-mbielu-c05

basis_claims.quote: is a cryptid reportedly seen at the Likouala River in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

statement.id: Mbielu-mbielu-mbielu adalah kriptid (cryptid) yang konon terlihat di Sungai Likouala, Republik Demokratik Kongo.
statement.en: Mbielu-mbielu-mbielu is a cryptid reportedly seen at the Likouala River in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

basis_claims.quote: the animal with planks growing out of its back

statement.id: Namanya berarti 'hewan dengan papan yang tumbuh dari punggungnya' (planks growing out of its back).
statement.en: Its name means 'the animal with planks growing out of its back'.

basis_claims.quote: Mbielu-mbielu-mbielu is said to typically submerge itself in water with only its back showing, which is often covered in (usually green) algal growths. It has also been claimed that mbielu-mbielu-mbielu is mostly active in the afternoon.

statement.id: Makhluk ini konon biasanya terbenam di air (submerge itself in water) dengan hanya punggung yang tampak, sering tertutup ganggang hijau, dan paling aktif pada sore hari.
statement.en: It is said usually to lie submerged in water with only its back showing, often covered in green algae, and to be most active in the afternoon.

basis_claims.quote: it has been said that mbielu-mbielu-mbielu can be sighted in the rivers and lakes of Likouala-Mossaka in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

statement.id: Ia konon dapat dilihat di sungai dan danau Likouala-Mossaka (rivers and lakes).
statement.en: It is said to be seen in the rivers and lakes of Likouala-Mossaka.

memphre.depicted_variant: the sea-serpent account of the LakeMemphremagog monster

Only head,neck andtwo contiguous bodycoils show abovewater; tailhidden beneath lake. MOUTH CLOSED, no venomspecification.

LakeMemphremagog near OwlHeadMountain, a darkreal mountain silhouette beyond lakewater.

memphre.aura: Emerge fast towardcamera fromthe lake with serpenthead raised andwetcoil following, water collapsing around its neck. Grounded in memphre-c07, memphre-c08, memphre-c09, memphre-c07, memphre-c08

basis_claims.quote: In Canadian folklore, Memphré is a lake monster said to live in Lake Memphremagog, a fresh water glacial lake located between Newport, Vermont, United States and Magog, Quebec, Canada.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Kanada, Memphré adalah monster danau yang konon hidup di Danau Memphremagog, antara Newport, Vermont, dan Magog, Quebec.
statement.en: In Canadian folklore, Memphré is a lake monster said to live in Lake Memphremagog between Newport, Vermont, and Magog, Quebec.

basis_claims.quote: One such legend pertains to a creature that is said to inhabit the depths beneath Owl's Head Mountain.

statement.id: Salah satu legenda danau itu menyangkut makhluk yang konon mendiami kedalaman di bawah Gunung Owl's Head.
statement.en: One legend of the lake concerns a creature said to inhabit the depths beneath Owl's Head Mountain.

basis_claims.quote: According to a document from 1816, when the first settlers arrived from New England, the Indigenous people told them that they were afraid to bathe or swim in the lake because it was inhabited by a sea serpent.

statement.id: Menurut dokumen tahun 1816, ketika para pemukim pertama tiba dari New England, penduduk pribumi mengatakan takut mandi atau berenang di danau itu karena dihuni ular laut.
statement.en: According to a document from 1816, when the first settlers arrived from New England, the Indigenous people told them they were afraid to bathe or swim in the lake because it was inhabited by a sea serpent.

basis_claims.quote: Over the past two centuries, more than 225 sightings of the monster have been recorded. One of the earliest reports dates to 1847 when The Stanstead Journal proclaimed that "a strange animal, something of a sea serpent... exists in Lake Memphremagog."

statement.id: Dalam dua abad terakhir tercatat lebih dari 225 penampakan monster itu; salah satu laporan paling awal berasal dari 1847, ketika The Stanstead Journal menyatakan bahwa "hewan aneh, semacam ular laut... ada di Danau Memphremagog".
statement.en: Over the past two centuries more than 225 sightings have been recorded; one of the earliest reports dates to 1847, when The Stanstead Journal proclaimed that "a strange animal, something of a sea serpent... exists in Lake Memphremagog".

basis_claims.quote: Known in the past by such names as the "Sea Serpent," "the Anaconda," or "the Lake Memphremagog Monster," in recent years, the creature has been affectionately dubbed "Memphré."

statement.id: Pada masa lalu makhluk ini dikenal dengan nama seperti "Sea Serpent", "the Anaconda", atau "Lake Memphremagog Monster"; belakangan ia dijuluki dengan akrab "Memphré".
statement.en: In the past the creature was known by names such as "Sea Serpent", "the Anaconda" or "the Lake Memphremagog Monster"; in recent years it has been affectionately dubbed "Memphré".

miage-nyudo.depicted_variant: the Sado priest-shaped yokai growing as nighttravelers look up

visual_requirements.description: ONE bald humanoid Buddhist-priest-like head/twoeyes, TWO arms andTWO legs under fullyopaque roughdarkmonkrobe. No horns, skullface, claws, weapons or necklaces. Elongated torso/neck grows immenselytall, stillONE continuousfigure.
Documented growth inresponse tolookingup c03/c11: extremeheight above tinybackgroundslope traveler, no genericenergy; traveler recoilsbackwardwithoutinjury.
Small slope atnight onSadoIsland withdim denseforest.

miage-nyudo.aura: Grow upward andlean headbackdown directlyatviewer while one large robedhand reaches nearcamera, immensebody disappearingtoward darktreetops. Grounded in miage-nyudo-c03, miage-nyudo-c11, miage-nyudo-c03, miage-nyudo-c11

basis_claims.quote: Miage-nyūdō is a type of yōkai told about on Sado Island (Sado, Niigata Prefecture).

statement.id: Miage-nyūdō adalah yōkai dari Pulau Sado.
statement.en: Miage-nyūdō is a yōkai of Sado Island.

basis_claims.quote: When climbing a small slope at night, something taking on the appearance of a little bōzu would appear in front, and by looking up, it would become taller, and the person looking at it would fall down backwards.

statement.id: Sosok itu bertambah tinggi ketika pelancong mendongak melihatnya.
statement.en: The figure grows taller when a traveler looks up at it.

basis_claims.quote: In Utami, Ryōtsu (now a part of Sado), it is said that they are in places where trees grow thickly and is dim even at noon, and that a large stone called the "miage-ishi (見上石, look up stone)" has shapeshifted into a nyūdō.

statement.id: Kisah Utami mengaitkannya dengan batu yang berubah wujud.
statement.en: An Utami account associates it with a stone that changes form.

basis_claims.quote: As soon as a person raises his eyes to look upon a mikoshi nyūdō, the giant grows to an immense height—as tall the observer is able to raise his eyes, and just as fast.

statement.id: Menurut Yokai.com, begitu orang menengadah pada mikoshi nyūdō, raksasa itu tumbuh setinggi pandangan si pengamat dan secepat itu pula.
statement.en: According to Yokai.com, as soon as a person looks up at a mikoshi nyūdō, the giant grows as tall as the observer can raise his eyes, and just as fast.

mizuchi.depicted_variant: Mizuchi, the venom-spewing great water serpent of Kawashima River

visual_requirements.description: ONE natural snake head/two eyes, one long scaled serpentine body and one submerged tail. No horns, antlers, mane, whiskers, wings, arms or legs. Open natural snake mouth, no oversized fantasy tusks.
Documented venom c05 rendered as tangible clear amber liquid droplets coming from mouth and hitting rocks. No glow, smoke, green energy or visible victims. Physical swimming spray only.
Fork of Kawashima River, central Kibi Province, Japan.

mizuchi.aura: Rear from the river fork toward the viewer, expelling a heavy wet stream of venom onto immediate foreground rocks while a contiguous coil sweeps the water. Based on mizuchi-c01, mizuchi-c05

basis_claims.quote: The Mizuchi (大虬, 蛟龍, 蛟, 美都知) is a type of Japanese dragon or legendary serpent-like creature, either found in an aquatic habitat or otherwise connected to water.

statement.id: Mizuchi adalah naga atau makhluk mirip ular Jepang yang berkaitan dengan air.
statement.en: Mizuchi is a Japanese dragon or serpent-like being linked with water.

basis_claims.quote: The ancient chronicle Nihongi contains references to mizuchi. ... in central Kibi Province, at a fork on Kawashima River (川嶋河, old name of Takahashi River in Okayama Prefecture), a great water serpent or dragon (大虬) dwelt and would breathe or spew out its venom, poisoning and killing many passersby.

statement.id: Kronik kuno Nihongi memuat rujukan tentang mizuchi: di Provinsi Kibi bagian tengah, di percabangan Sungai Kawashima (川嶋河, nama lama Sungai Takahashi di Prefektur Okayama), seekor ular atau naga air besar (大虬) bermukim dan menyemburkan racun yang membunuh banyak orang yang lewat.
statement.en: The ancient chronicle Nihongi contains references to mizuchi: in central Kibi Province, at a fork of the Kawashima River (川嶋河, old name of the Takahashi River in Okayama Prefecture), a great water serpent or dragon (大虬) dwelt and spewed venom that poisoned and killed many passersby.

muki-mythology.depicted_variant: Muki, the small muscular two-horned miner of the Central Andes

visual_requirements.description: ONE dwarf no taller than two feet, disproportionately muscular, ghostly pale skin, long blond hair and reflective eyes. EXACTLY TWO horns, one head/two eyes, TWO arms with five fingers per hand and TWO legs. Fully opaque rough miner jacket and trousers. No weapons or invented attributes.
Two documented horns c04 physically break rock, expose an ordinary metallic mineral vein and scatter chips. Eyes c14 reflect lamplight without emitting it.
Inside a dark Central Andean mine.

muki-mythology.aura: Ram both horns into a mine wall while turning his watchful face partly toward the camera, small muscular body braced, hands holding rock. Based on muki-mythology-c03, muki-mythology-c04, muki-mythology-c14, muki-mythology-c01, muki-mythology-c02

basis_claims.quote: is a goblin-like creature in the mythology of the Central Andes in Bolivia, Peru, Ecuador and Colombia.

statement.id: Muki adalah makhluk mirip goblin dalam mitologi Andes Tengah di Bolivia, Peru, Ekuador, dan Kolombia.
statement.en: The muki is a goblin-like creature of Central Andean mythology in Bolivia, Peru, Ecuador and Colombia.

basis_claims.quote: He is known to be a miner and his existence is constrained to underground spaces: The muki lives inside the mines.

statement.id: Ia dikenal sebagai penambang yang hanya hidup di ruang bawah tanah, yaitu di dalam tambang.
statement.en: He is a miner whose existence is confined underground: the muki lives inside the mines.

basis_claims.quote: The muki is considered to be a dwarf due to its height, since it is no taller than 2 feet (0.61 meters).

statement.id: Muki dianggap kurcaci karena tingginya tidak lebih dari 2 kaki.
statement.en: The muki is considered a dwarf, no taller than 2 feet.

basis_claims.quote: In some mining traditions, he has two horns that are used to break the rocks and point at the mineral veins.

statement.id: Dalam beberapa tradisi tambang, ia bertanduk dua untuk memecah batu dan menunjuk urat mineral.
statement.en: In some mining traditions he has two horns to break rocks and point to mineral veins.

basis_claims.quote: According to oral tradition, the Muki is no more than two feet in height, yet is disproportionately muscular, with a deep voice. His skin is described as ghostly pale, with long blond hair framing dazzling eyes that reflect the light, like the metals in the mines he inhabits.

statement.id: Menurut tradisi lisan, Muki tidak lebih tinggi dari dua kaki namun berotot tidak proporsional dan bersuara dalam; kulitnya digambarkan pucat seperti hantu, dengan rambut pirang panjang dan mata berkilau yang memantulkan cahaya seperti logam di tambang.
statement.en: According to oral tradition, the Muki is no more than two feet tall yet disproportionately muscular, with a deep voice; his skin is described as ghostly pale, with long blond hair and dazzling eyes that reflect the light like the metals in the mines.

murkatta.depicted_variant: Murkatta, the headless Nepali ghost with a face in its chest carrying its own head

visual_requirements.description: ONE headless humanoid torso, EXACTLY TWO eyes and ONE mouth located on chest. No head above shoulders, no gore at neck. TWO arms/TWO legs, ONE separate human head tucked under left arm, with its own two eyes and one mouth. Opaque trousers and open-front opaque jacket frame the chest face; no sexual anatomy. No horns or claws.
No documented magic. Threat from displaced facial anatomy, dead spirit and active approach only. No emitted light or levitation.
Night path in lowlands Nepal, where head-carrying ghosts roamed.

murkatta.aura: Approach the viewer with chest face leaning forward and staring directly into camera; free hand reaches forward while detached head remains firmly held under the other arm. Based on murkatta-c01, murkatta-c02, murkatta-c07, murkatta-c03

basis_claims.quote: Murkatta (Nepali: मुर्कट्टा) is a headless ghost with eyes and mouth in chest and carrying its head tucked under its arm. Murkatta is mentioned in various Nepali culture and traditions. They are  considered as the spirits from the dead.

statement.id: Murkatta adalah hantu tanpa kepala dalam tradisi Nepal, bermata dan bermulut di dada.
statement.en: Murkatta is a headless ghost in Nepalese tradition with eyes and a mouth in the chest.

basis_claims.quote: Murkatta (Nepali: मुर्कट्टा) is a headless ghost with eyes and mouth in chest and carrying its head tucked under its arm.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan membawa kepalanya di bawah lengan.
statement.en: It is portrayed carrying its head under its arm.

basis_claims.quote: They are  considered as the spirits from the dead.

statement.id: Sumber menganggap mereka sebagai roh orang mati.
statement.en: The source regards them as spirits of the dead.

basis_claims.quote: murkatta, in the Nepali language for a headless ghost: that was the name of a hamlet close to where we lived in the lowlands of Nepal. People say ghosts that carried their heads under their arms roamed there.

statement.id: Penulis menuliskan bahwa orang berkata hantu yang membawa kepala di bawah lengan berkeliaran di sebuah dusun bernama murkatta di dataran rendah Nepal.
statement.en: The author writes that people say ghosts carrying their heads under their arms roamed a hamlet named murkatta in the lowlands of Nepal.

ningyo.depicted_variant: Ningyo, the hideous fish-heavy human-torso being with long clawed fingers

visual_requirements.description: ONE ugly deformed fish-like head/two eyes, one human torso, TWO arms with long bony FIVE-finger hands ending in sharp claws. One fish lower body and ONE fish tail, no human legs. Fully opaque coarse cloth wrap covers chest and hips. Natural rough fish scales; no horns or vampire fangs.
No curse disaster because no capture trigger occurs; only physical spray from approach and tail.
Dark Japanese sea and shore.

ningyo.aura: Lunge toward the camera from Japanese surf, reaching both clawed hands over wet shore stone as the fish tail thrashes water behind. Based on ningyo-c01, ningyo-c07, ningyo-c08, ningyo-c04

basis_claims.quote: Ningyo (人魚; "human fish"), is a creature with both human and fish-like features, described in various pieces of Japanese literature.

statement.id: Ningyo adalah makhluk dalam sastra Jepang dengan ciri manusia dan ikan.
statement.en: Ningyo is a being in Japanese literature with human and fish traits.

basis_claims.quote: But subsequent examples are usually seawater beings.

statement.id: Contoh berikutnya umumnya menempatkan ningyo di air laut.
statement.en: Later examples generally place ningyo in the sea.

basis_claims.quote: Unlike the mermaids of the Atlantic Ocean and Mediterranean Sea, ningyo from the Pacific Ocean and the Sea of Japan are hideous to behold.

statement.id: Berbeda dari putri duyung Samudra Atlantik dan Laut Tengah, ningyo dari Samudra Pasifik dan Laut Jepang digambarkan mengerikan untuk dilihat.
statement.en: Unlike the mermaids of the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea, ningyo from the Pacific Ocean and the Sea of Japan are described as hideous to behold.

basis_claims.quote: Ningyo are more fish than human. They can have anything from ugly, deformed fish-like faces, to entire human torsos with long, bony fingers and sharp claws. Ningyo range in size from a human child to a large seal.

statement.id: Ningyo lebih menyerupai ikan daripada manusia: dari wajah mirip ikan yang buruk dan cacat hingga seluruh torso manusia dengan jari panjang kurus dan cakar tajam; ukurannya dari seukuran anak manusia hingga anjing laut besar.
statement.en: Ningyo are more fish than human, ranging from ugly, deformed fish-like faces to entire human torsos with long bony fingers and sharp claws, and in size from a human child to a large seal.

nittaewo.depicted_variant: Nittaewo, the small upright reddish-haired hominid with short powerful arms and long claws

visual_requirements.description: ONE short hominid with one ape-like head/two eyes, reddish body hair, TWO VERY SHORT muscular arms with short hands and long hooked nails, TWO upright legs and NO TAIL. No horns, tusks or tools. Hair and opaque plain hip wrap cover body.
Documented predatory claw approach c07/c08/c11; no injured victim or gore, no magic, only physical dust from steps.
Sri Lankan cave and surrounding forest.

nittaewo.aura: Rush upright from a cave toward the viewer, short powerful arms thrust forward and hooked nails spread toward camera, feet gripping dusty rock. Based on nittaewo-c01, nittaewo-c03, nittaewo-c04, nittaewo-c07, nittaewo-c08, nittaewo-c11, nittaewo-c05

basis_claims.quote: Nittaewo (or Nittevo) were said to be a small tribe of short-statured bigfoot or Yeti-like hominid cryptids native to Sri Lanka. No archeological evidence has been found to prove the existence of these humanoids, but they are ubiquitous in Veddha mythology and Sri Lankan folklore.

statement.id: Nittaewo adalah humanoid bertubuh kecil dalam mitologi Veddha dan cerita rakyat Sri Lanka.
statement.en: Nittaewo are small humanoids of Veddha mythology and Sri Lankan folklore.

basis_claims.quote: They were covered in hair, which was often said to be reddish in colour, and were said to have very short, powerful arms with short, long-clawed hands.

statement.id: Mereka digambarkan berbulu dan memiliki tangan bercakar panjang.
statement.en: They are described as hairy with long-clawed hands.

basis_claims.quote: Unlike monkeys, they walked upright always and had no tails.

statement.id: Mereka dikatakan selalu berjalan tegak dan tidak berekor.
statement.en: They are said to walk upright and lack tails.

basis_claims.quote: The nittaewo lived in small parties, and slept in caves or among the branches of trees, in leaf-nests of their own design.

statement.id: Cerita menempatkan mereka dalam kelompok kecil yang tidur di gua atau sarang daun di pohon.
statement.en: Tales place them in small groups sleeping in caves or leaf nests in trees.

basis_claims.quote: They did not use tools, instead disembowelling their prey with their long claws or hooked nails, allowing them to feed on the entrails.

statement.id: Mereka tidak memakai perkakas, melainkan membelah perut mangsanya dengan cakar panjang atau kuku melengkungnya sehingga dapat memakan isi perutnya.
statement.en: They used no tools, instead disembowelling their prey with their long claws or hooked nails so they could feed on the entrails.

basis_claims.quote: It was said that whenever a nittaewa came across a sleeping Veddah, it would disembowel them with its claws.

statement.id: Dikatakan bahwa setiap kali seekor nittaewa menjumpai seorang Veddah yang sedang tidur, ia akan membelah perutnya dengan cakar.
statement.en: It was said that whenever a nittaewa came across a sleeping Veddah, it would disembowel him with its claws.

basis_claims.quote: These hairy cannibals attacked in companies, driving their long nails into the flesh which they tore out and ate. They were afraid only of the buffalo and the dog
basis_claims.locator: Chapter on the Westminster Abbey district

statement.id: Menurut buku ini, para kanibal berbulu itu menyerang berkelompok, menancapkan kuku panjang mereka ke daging lalu merobek dan memakannya; mereka hanya takut pada kerbau dan anjing.
statement.en: According to this book, these hairy cannibals attacked in companies, driving their long nails into the flesh, which they tore out and ate; they were afraid only of the buffalo and the dog.

nocnitsa.depicted_variant: Nocnitsa, the Croatian long-haired claw-fingered female nightmare spirit

visual_requirements.description: ONE adult woman spirit, one head/two eyes, VERY LONG dark hair, TWO arms with five fingers per hand ending in sharp claws; TWO legs under a fully opaque long black dress. No wings, bird head, worm form, horns or skeletal face.
Nightmare torment c01/c02 suggested by this threatening intrusion only; no dream rays, soul energy or children depicted.
Plain dark night bedroom beside an adult observer bed.

nocnitsa.aura: Lean suddenly into the sleeping observer viewpoint, face lowered close and one long-clawed hand reaching immediately toward camera, hair falling forward around the hand. Based on nocnitsa-c01, nocnitsa-c02, nocnitsa-c03

basis_claims.quote: often referred in plural, is a nightmare spirit or demon that torments people and especially children at night. Other names for notsnitsa in East Slavic languages include kriksy, plaksy, plachky

statement.id: Nocnitsa (ночница, Polandia nocnica), sering disebut dalam bentuk jamak, adalah roh atau iblis mimpi buruk yang menyiksa orang, terutama anak-anak, pada malam hari; dalam bahasa Slavia Timur juga disebut kriksy, plaksy, plachky.
statement.en: The nocnitsa (Polish nocnica), often plural, is a nightmare spirit or demon tormenting people, especially children, at night; East Slavic names include kriksy, plaksy, plachky.

basis_claims.quote: в славянской мифологии ночные духи женского пола, враждебно настроенные по отношению к людям. Ночницы нападают на детей, готовящихся отойти ко сну, причиняя им беспокойство и вызывая бессонницу. Славяне верили, что причина детского плача, ночного крика и плохого сна является результатом деятельности ночниц.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Slavia, nochnitsy adalah roh malam perempuan yang memusuhi manusia; mereka menyerang anak yang hendak tidur sehingga gelisah dan tak bisa tidur; bangsa Slavia percaya tangis dan tidur buruk anak di malam hari adalah ulah mereka.
statement.en: In Slavic mythology nochnitsy are female night spirits hostile to people; they attack children going to sleep, causing restlessness and insomnia; Slavs believed children's crying and poor sleep at night were their doing.

basis_claims.quote: В восточной Сербии ночницы (сербохорв. ноћнице) представлялись в виде уродливых баб в чёрном. По хорватским поверьям ночницы (хорв. noćničine) — длинноволосые женщины с когтями на пальцах рук. По единичным польским данным, они могли быть похожими на птиц или летучих мышей.

statement.id: Di Serbia timur nochnitsy digambarkan sebagai nenek buruk rupa berbaju hitam; menurut kepercayaan Kroasia perempuan berambut panjang bercakar; menurut sedikit data Polandia mirip burung atau kelelawar.
statement.en: In eastern Serbia nochnitsy were ugly old women in black; in Croatian belief long-haired women with clawed fingers; by scant Polish data like birds or bats.

north-shore-monster.depicted_variant: North Shore Monster, Old Briney, the charging horse-headed crocodile-bodied Great Salt Lake beast

visual_requirements.description: ONE natural horse head with two eyes/two horse ears and CLOSED normal horse mouth. ONE crocodile-like armored body with EXACTLY FOUR short natural crocodile legs and ONE long crocodile tail. No horns, mane ornaments, wings or fantasy teeth. Documented length about75feet.
Documented charge c07 and overturned boulders c09; physical tumbling rocks, brine and dust only, no storms or energy.
Great Salt Lake north shore near Monument Point saltworks.

north-shore-monster.aura: Charge directly toward the viewer across the northern salt shore, lowered horse head and crocodile forefeet slamming down as boulders roll aside. Based on north-shore-monster-c02, north-shore-monster-c04, north-shore-monster-c07, north-shore-monster-c09, north-shore-monster-c01, north-shore-monster-c03, north-shore-monster-c06

basis_claims.quote: The North Shore Monster, sometimes referred to as "Old Briney," reportedly inhabits the Great Salt Lake in Utah.

statement.id: North Shore Monster, kadang disebut "Old Briney", konon menghuni Great Salt Lake di Utah.
statement.en: The North Shore Monster, sometimes called "Old Briney," reportedly inhabits the Great Salt Lake in Utah.

basis_claims.quote: Descriptions of the monster vary, but it is most commonly described as having a crocodile-like body and the head of a horse.

statement.id: Gambarannya beragam, tetapi paling sering bertubuh mirip buaya dan berkepala kuda.
statement.en: Descriptions vary, but it is most often described with a crocodile-like body and a horse's head.

basis_claims.quote: The most well-known sighting occurred on July 8, 1877, when J.H. McNeil and other workers at the Barnes and Co. saltworks near Monument Point on the lake's northern shore claimed to have encountered a large creature

statement.id: Penampakan paling terkenal terjadi pada 8 Juli 1877, ketika J.H. McNeil dan pekerja tambang garam dekat Monument Point mengaku bertemu makhluk besar.
statement.en: The best-known sighting was on July 8, 1877, when J.H. McNeil and saltworks workers near Monument Point claimed to meet a large creature.

basis_claims.quote: McNeil estimated the creature to be about 75 feet long.

statement.id: McNeil memperkirakan panjang makhluk itu sekitar 75 kaki.
statement.en: McNeil estimated it at about 75 feet long.

basis_claims.quote: J.H. McNeil of Kelton, Box Elder County, and several other men were working for the Barnes and Company saltworks on the northern shore near Monument Point and the Central Pacific railroad line in early July of 1877 when they heard a frightful bellow.

statement.id: J.H. McNeil dari Kelton, Box Elder County, dan beberapa pria lain bekerja untuk tambang garam Barnes and Company di tepi utara dekat Monument Point dan jalur kereta Central Pacific pada awal Juli 1877 ketika mereka mendengar raungan yang menakutkan.
statement.en: J.H. McNeil of Kelton, Box Elder County, and several other men were working for the Barnes and Company saltworks on the northern shore near Monument Point and the Central Pacific railroad line in early July 1877 when they heard a frightful bellow.

basis_claims.quote: As McNeil tells it, they looked up and saw an awful creature with a crocodile-like body and the head of a horse. As it saw the men, it charged toward them and they fled to the mountains.

statement.id: Menurut penuturan McNeil, mereka melihat makhluk mengerikan bertubuh mirip buaya dan berkepala kuda; ketika makhluk itu melihat para pria, ia menyerbu ke arah mereka dan mereka lari ke pegunungan.
statement.en: As McNeil tells it, they saw an awful creature with a crocodile-like body and a horse's head; when it saw the men it charged toward them and they fled to the mountains.

basis_claims.quote: According to another account, huge overturned boulders marked the trail of the marauding beast.

statement.id: Menurut catatan lain, batu-batu besar yang terbalik menandai jejak makhluk yang mengamuk itu.
statement.en: According to another account, huge overturned boulders marked the trail of the marauding beast.

visual_requirements.description: ONE eagle head with two natural raptor eyes and hooked beak, short feathers, on ONE fully covered humanoid body. TWO arms with five fingers per hand; legs under long opaque plain robe. No wings, horns, crown, weapon, pail, pinecone or uncertain relief attributes. Eagle head in original quote c01.
No documented power. No magical effects or destruction; reverent awe from eagle-headed identity, imposing close approach and light.
House/temple of Nisroch where Sennacherib worshipped, plain unmarked dark stone.

nisroch.aura: Step from a dark temple threshold toward the viewer, lowering his great eagle head while an open hand extends in authoritative command. Based on nisroch-c01, nisroch-c02, nisroch-c04

basis_claims.quote: ニスロク(Nisroch)は、センナケリブに崇拝されたアッシリアの神である。旧約聖書列王記下第19章37節、イザヤ書第37章38節に名前が登場する。名前の意味は「偉大な鷲」であるといわれ、鷲頭を持つとされている。

statement.id: Nisroch adalah dewa Asyur yang dalam artikel disebut disembah Sennacherib.
statement.en: Nisroch is an Assyrian deity worshipped by Sennacherib according to the article.

basis_claims.quote: ニスロク(Nisroch)は、センナケリブに崇拝されたアッシリアの神である。旧約聖書列王記下第19章37節、イザヤ書第37章38節に名前が登場する。名前の意味は「偉大な鷲」であるといわれ、鷲頭を持つとされている。

statement.id: Artikel mencatat nama Nisroch dalam 2 Raja-raja 19:37 dan Yesaya 37:38.
statement.en: The article records Nisroch in 2 Kings 19:37 and Isaiah 37:38.

basis_claims.quote: as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god

statement.id: 2 Raja-raja menempatkan ibadah raja di rumah dewa Nisroch.
statement.en: Second Kings places the king’s worship in the house of the god Nisroch.

areop-enap.depicted_variant: Ancient Spider Nauru berkaki8 menggubah pulau dan vegetasi dari benang web, dalam kosmogoni clam-shell.

visual_requirements.description: Laba-laba tua, dua segmen badan dan8kaki artikulasi, tanpa tangan/wajahmanusia.
Webthread menjadi vegetasi di pulau,clam-shell bawahsebagaiEarth/atas sky.
Laut kosmogoni dan ruang tanpa batas,diantara shellEarth/sky.

areop-enap.aura: AncientSpider areop-enap-c01 mengolah pulau/vegetasi web areop-enap-c07 pada shellcosmogoni areop-enap-c06 memberi keagungan pencipta.

basis_claims.quote: Areop-Enap (Nauruan: old spider) played a major part in the creation of the world in the indigenous myths of the people of Nauru.

statement.id: Areop-Enap adalah laba-laba purba yang berperan utama dalam penciptaan dunia menurut mitos Nauru.
statement.en: Areop-Enap is an ancient spider playing a central role in Nauruan creation myths.

basis_claims.quote: The saltiness of the water killed the clam and opened the shell. Areop-Enap made the lower shell into Earth and the upper shell into the sky and set the smaller snail west of the sky-shell where it became the Moon. The second snail was set to the east and became the Sun.

statement.id: Asinnya air membunuh kerang dan membuka cangkangnya. Areop-Enap menjadikan cangkang bawah sebagai Bumi dan cangkang atas sebagai langit, menempatkan siput yang lebih kecil di barat cangkang langit sehingga menjadi Bulan, dan siput kedua di timur sehingga menjadi Matahari.
statement.en: The saltiness of the water killed the clam and opened the shell. Areop-Enap made the lower shell into Earth and the upper shell into the sky, set the smaller snail west of the sky-shell where it became the Moon, and set the second snail to the east where it became the Sun.

basis_claims.quote: Areop-Enap made islands from clam-flesh and clothed them in vegetation made from his own web-thread.

statement.id: Areop-Enap membuat pulau-pulau dari daging kerang dan menyelimutinya dengan tumbuhan yang dibuat dari benang jaringnya sendiri.
statement.en: Areop-Enap made islands from clam-flesh and clothed them in vegetation made from his own web-thread.

basis_claims.quote: in the beginning there were only the sea and Areop-Enap, ‘Ancient Spider,” who floated above in endless space.

statement.id: Dalam kisah yang dicatat Dixon, pada mulanya hanya ada laut dan Areop-Enap, "Laba-laba Purba", yang melayang di atas dalam ruang tanpa batas.
statement.en: In the tale recorded by Dixon, in the beginning there were only the sea and Areop-Enap, "Ancient Spider", who floated above in endless space.

anki-kiele.depicted_variant: Documented fish-bodied sea-spirit variant with huge shaggy head.

visual_requirements.description: One huge shaggy head with exactly two eyes and one large toothy mouth attached to a fish body with fins and one fish tail, no humanoid legs.
No magical glow or invented storm power; physical silt displaced by the fish body emphasizes its sea habitat.
The seabed in dark sea water.

anki-kiele.aura: Surge upward from the seabed toward the viewer, massive shaggy head filling most of the foreground. Supported by anki-kiele-c03, anki-kiele-c06, anki-kiele-c03.

basis_claims.quote: Согласно рисунку чукчи Онно (1912—1953), Анки-Киеле живёт на дне моря, имеет огромную мохнатую голову с двумя глазами и большой зубастой пастью.

statement.id: Menurut gambar seniman Chukchi Onno (1912–1953), Anki-Kiele tinggal di dasar laut dan berkepala besar berbulu dengan dua mata dan mulut lebar bergigi.
statement.en: According to a drawing by the Chukchi artist Onno (1912–1953), Anki-Kiele lives on the sea bed and has a huge shaggy head with two eyes and a large toothy maw.

basis_claims.quote: a “spirit” living in the sea (a'nqa-kal), has the body of a fish, with a very large shaggy head.

statement.id: Bogoras mencatat sebuah "roh" yang hidup di laut (a'nqa-kal) yang digambarkan bertubuh ikan dengan kepala berbulu yang sangat besar.
statement.en: Bogoras records a "spirit" living in the sea (a'nqa-kal), pictured with the body of a fish and a very large shaggy head.

kanas-lake-monster.depicted_variant: 1985 reported giant Red Fish, intentionally unconfirmed and not identifying it as taimen.

visual_requirements.description: Reported giant red fish10–15m with head over1m wide; unconfirmed
Kanas Lake Xinjiang
Reported water emergence and breaking metre wave, physical displacement only

kanas-lake-monster.aura: Awe comes from reported10–15m Red Fish with metre-wide head emerging close (kanas-lake-monster-c07).

basis_claims.quote: 喀纳斯湖水怪（英语：Kanas Lake Monster），是据传生活在中国新疆维吾尔自治区喀纳斯湖中的不明生物。与世界各地的其它湖怪不同，喀纳斯湖水怪并非传说的爬虫类或哺乳类，而类似于鱼类的生物。

statement.id: Monster Danau Kanas adalah makhluk yang dilaporkan hidup di Danau Kanas, Xinjiang; keberadaannya belum dipastikan.
statement.en: The Kanas Lake Monster is a creature reportedly living in Kanas Lake, Xinjiang; its existence remains unconfirmed.

basis_claims.quote: In 1985, Xinjiang Daily carried a headline announcing discovery of giant Red Fish in the lake, saying they were 10 to 15 meters long, weighing more than 4 tons and each having a head over one meter wide.

statement.id: Pada 1985 harian Xinjiang Daily memuat berita penemuan "Ikan Merah" raksasa di danau itu, yang disebut panjangnya 10 sampai 15 meter, berbobot lebih dari 4 ton, dengan kepala selebar lebih dari satu meter.
statement.en: In 1985 the Xinjiang Daily carried a headline announcing the discovery of giant "Red Fish" in the lake, said to be 10 to 15 metres long, weighing over 4 tons, with heads over a metre wide.

basis_claims.quote: they suddenly spotted two dark objects, very large in size, springing out of the water, breaking a wave one meter high. They leapt forward one following the other, headed swiftly towards the middle of the lake and disappeared from sight in about two minutes.

statement.id: Menurut laporan CERNET tahun 2005, tujuh wisatawan dari Beijing yang berperahu di danau tiba-tiba melihat dua objek gelap yang sangat besar melompat dari air dan memecah ombak setinggi satu meter, melaju ke tengah danau, dan menghilang dalam sekitar dua menit.
statement.en: According to the 2005 CERNET report, seven Beijing tourists sailing on the lake suddenly saw two very large dark objects spring out of the water, breaking a one-metre wave, rush toward the middle of the lake and vanish within about two minutes.

cenocroca.depicted_variant: Lion-jawed and lion-chested ass-bodied ibex-horned Cenocroca, lunging at night and calling with a seamless bone biting blade instead of teeth.

visual_requirements.description: One lion-jawed head, lion chest and ass body, four natural quadruped legs, two ibex horns, mouth split to ears with seamless bone instead of individual teeth.
Two pupils fixed straight ahead; visible focused predatory stare.
Calling mouth implies human voice imitation used to lure prey; no visible magic or sound waves.

cenocroca.aura: Predatory lunge, fixed straight-ahead pupils and calling ear-split jaw with bone instead of teeth (cenocroca-c02/c03); no visual magic.

basis_claims.quote: Viene descritta come avente la voce umana ma al posto dei denti un solido osso; un taglio della bocca che arriva fino alle orecchie, le fauci e il petto del leone, il corpo d'asino, le corna di stambecco

statement.id: Ia digambarkan bersuara manusia, tetapi giginya berupa satu tulang utuh, mulutnya terbelah sampai telinga, berahang dan berdada singa, bertubuh keledai, dan bertanduk ibex.
statement.en: It is described as having a human voice but a solid bone instead of teeth, a mouth slit to the ears, a lion's jaws and chest, an ass's body and ibex horns.

basis_claims.quote: Possedeva la bizzarra caratteristica di non muovere mai le pupille e di guardare sempre dinanzi a sé; con la propria voce umana imitava i richiami degli uomini o i versi degli animali per attrarre le prede e divorarle.

statement.id: Ia tidak pernah menggerakkan pupilnya dan selalu menatap lurus ke depan, dan dengan suara manusianya ia meniru panggilan orang atau suara hewan untuk memikat mangsa lalu melahapnya.
statement.en: It never moved its pupils and always stared straight ahead, and with its human voice it imitated people's calls or animal cries to lure prey and devour it.

gatipedro.depicted_variant: Gatipedro the horned white cat walking on four legs and its tongue

visual_requirements.description: ONE WHITE CAT with ONE head/TWO eyes/FOUR legs/ONE tail and exactly ONE DARK BROWN HORN on forehead. Long natural tongue touches floor as fifth support while four legs remain distinct. White fur rough and wet, face fierce, natural cat teeth only
At night horn pours water into children’s room; one continuous physical water stream leaves horn tip and splashes floor, no magical glow
Galician home at night, plain covered child bed only distant background, no exposed child

gatipedro.aura: At night horn pours water into children’s room; one continuous physical water stream leaves horn tip and splashes floor, no magical glow [gatipedro-c03]

basis_claims.quote: The gatipedro is a legendary creature in Galician folklore, who makes children wet their beds. It is portrayed as a white cat with a single brown horn on its head.

statement.id: Gatipedro adalah makhluk legendaris cerita rakyat Galisia yang membuat anak mengompol, digambarkan sebagai kucing putih dengan satu tanduk cokelat di kepalanya.
statement.en: The gatipedro is a legendary creature of Galician folklore that makes children wet their beds, portrayed as a white cat with a single brown horn on its head.

basis_claims.quote: O gatipedro é unha figura mitolóxica de Galicia que fai mexar ós nenos na cama. Ten forma de gato branco cun corno mouro na cabeza.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Galisia, gatipedro adalah tokoh mitologi Galisia yang membuat anak mengompol, berwujud kucing putih dengan tanduk gelap di kepalanya.
statement.en: According to the Galician article, the gatipedro is a mythological figure of Galicia that makes children wet the bed, shaped like a white cat with a dark horn on its head.

basis_claims.quote: At night, it enters houses, goes to children's bedrooms and pours water through its horn. The sleeping child dreams he or she is peeing, and so actually wets the bed.

statement.id: Pada malam hari ia masuk ke rumah, mendatangi kamar anak, dan menuangkan air dari tanduknya; anak yang tidur bermimpi buang air kecil dan sungguh-sungguh mengompol.
statement.en: At night it enters houses, goes to children's rooms and pours water from its horn; the sleeping child dreams of peeing and really wets the bed.

basis_claims.quote: According to popular tradition, it can be scared away by salt grains at a room's door and beside the window. It walks on all fours as well as its tongue, so when it tastes the salt, it turns around and leaves the kids alone.

statement.id: Menurut tradisi rakyat, ia dapat diusir dengan butiran garam di depan pintu kamar dan di samping jendela; karena berjalan dengan empat kaki dan lidahnya, begitu mengecap garam ia berbalik dan meninggalkan anak-anak.
statement.en: By folk tradition it can be scared off with grains of salt at the bedroom door and by the window; since it walks on four legs and its tongue, once it tastes the salt it turns back and leaves the children alone.

kallana.depicted_variant: Natural mature dwarf elephant of the Kaani report in a close warning charge, ears flared and trunk raised on rocky high forest ground.

visual_requirements.description: Single natural dwarf elephant of the Kaani reports, mature editorial depiction with one head, two eyes, two Asian ears, one trunk, four legs and one tail; small stature beside ordinary forest boulder and undergrowth.
No documented supernatural powers. Physical charging footfall throws ordinary rocky trail grit; trumpeting pose and charge are editorial action only.
Higher rocky rainforest ground in Kerala Western Ghats/Peppara forest range.

kallana.aura: Natural mature dwarf elephant charges with flared ears, raised trunk and weight driving grit from rocky high ground (kallana-c01/c07); no supernatural power.

basis_claims.quote: Kallana is a suspected species of dwarf elephant allegedly found in South India. Kaani tribals dwelling in the rainforests of the Western Ghats (Kerala, India) claim that there are two distinct varieties of elephants in the Peppara forest range, one the common Indian elephants (Elephas maximus indicus), and the other a dwarf variety which they call kallana.

statement.id: Kallana adalah sebutan bagi gajah kerdil yang diklaim masyarakat Kaani berada di hutan India selatan.
statement.en: Kallana names dwarf elephants reported by Kaani communities in South Indian forests.

basis_claims.quote: The tribals gave the creatures this name because they see the smaller elephant more often in the higher altitudes where the terrain is rocky.

statement.id: Suku itu memberi nama tersebut karena mereka lebih sering melihat gajah yang lebih kecil itu di dataran yang lebih tinggi tempat medannya berbatu.
statement.en: The tribals gave the creatures this name because they see the smaller elephant more often at higher altitudes where the terrain is rocky.

kay-s.depicted_variant: hand-bearing old-man ghoul gripping a traveller with clearly anatomical strap legs, not the handless waiting guise or snake-arm belly variant

visual_requirements.description: Old-man ghoul with two hands in the gripping variant; exactly two broad leather-strap legs visibly continuing from its hips into waist coils, no feet/buckles/conventional lower legs. One opaque-clothed adult traveller.
Ghoul physically rides traveller neck, clutches shoulders and binds waist using its own strap legs, traveller strains. No unrelated power.
Road next to river after dark.

kay-s.aura: Menace comes from the old ghoul clamping shoulders and tightening two continuous anatomical leather legs around a struggling adult, c02/c03/c05; no glow.

basis_claims.quote: Kayış, Çocukları korkutmak için uydurulmuş kötücül varlıktır. Kayış Baldır veya Kayış Bacak da denilen, ayakları kayıştan gulyabanidir.

statement.id: Kayış adalah makhluk jahat (kötücül varlık) yang direka untuk menakut-nakuti anak-anak (çocukları korkutmak); disebut juga Kayış Baldır atau Kayış Bacak, ia gulyabani yang kakinya dari tali kulit (kayış).
statement.en: Kayış is a malevolent being (kötücül varlık) invented to frighten children (çocukları korkutmak); also called Kayış Baldır or Kayış Bacak, it is a gulyabani (ghoul) whose legs are made of leather strap (kayış).

basis_claims.quote: O, kendi ayakları üzerinde durup yürüyemez. Bunun için de yoldan giden insanları aldatıp, onun boynuna biner.

statement.id: Ia tidak dapat berdiri dan berjalan di atas kakinya sendiri (yürüyemez); karena itu ia menipu orang yang lewat di jalan lalu menunggangi lehernya (boynuna biner).
statement.en: It cannot stand and walk on its own feet (yürüyemez); so it deceives people going along the road and rides on their neck (boynuna biner).

basis_claims.quote: Sonra kayış ayaklarını onun beline dolayıp, yolu bitinceye kadar onu bırakmaz.

statement.id: Lalu ia melilitkan kaki talinya ke pinggang orang itu (beline dolayıp) dan tidak melepaskannya sampai perjalanannya selesai (yolu bitinceye kadar).
statement.en: Then it wraps its strap legs around the person's waist (beline dolayıp) and does not let go until the journey ends (yolu bitinceye kadar).

basis_claims.quote: Elsiz ve ayaksız bir ihtiyar görünümünde olan bu varlık, ırmak kenarında oturup, gariban bir görünüş sergileyerek

statement.id: Makhluk yang tampak seperti orang tua tanpa tangan dan kaki (elsiz ve ayaksız bir ihtiyar) ini duduk di tepi sungai (ırmak kenarında) dengan penampilan memelas (gariban).
statement.en: This being, looking like an old man without hands or feet (elsiz ve ayaksız bir ihtiyar), sits by the river bank (ırmak kenarında) putting on a pitiful appearance (gariban).

basis_claims.quote: Elleriyle de sıkı sıkıya sarılıp, "Ne dersem, onu yapacaksın" diyerek, o insanı kölesi yapar.

statement.id: Dengan tangannya ia memeluk erat (sıkı sıkıya sarılıp) dan, sambil berkata bahwa orang itu harus melakukan apa pun yang ia katakan, menjadikan orang itu budaknya (kölesi yapar).
statement.en: Clinging tightly with its hands (sıkı sıkıya sarılıp) and saying the person will do whatever it says, it makes that person its slave (kölesi yapar).

basis_claims.quote: KAYIŞ: Çarpık Cin. ... Hava karardıktan sonra genellikle akşam ezanının ardından ortaya çıkarak tan vaktine kadar dolaşır. Eğri bacaklı, korkunç görünüşlü bir yaratıktır.

statement.id: Kamus kedua menyebut Kayış jin bengkok (Çarpık Cin) yang muncul setelah hari gelap, biasanya sesudah azan magrib (akşam ezanının ardından), dan berkeliaran sampai fajar (tan vaktine kadar); ia makhluk berkaki bengkok (eğri bacaklı) dan berpenampilan mengerikan.
statement.en: The second source calls Kayış the crooked jinn (Çarpık Cin), which appears after dark, usually after the evening call to prayer (akşam ezanının ardından), and roams until dawn (tan vaktine kadar); it is a crooked-legged (eğri bacaklı), terrifying-looking creature.

menehune.depicted_variant: three diminutive Menehune carrying and fitting final Kikiaola auwai stones at dead of night

visual_requirements.description: Exactly three small-stature adult Hawaiian humanoid craftspeople with normal two arms/two legs, opaque clothing; immediately adjacent full fern fronds and normal large masonry course make small stature readable.
Urgently fit and carry stones; vast newly fitted watercourse recedes around bend as one-night supernatural craftsmanship, no floating stones or light magic.
Kikiaola dam and auwai in deep forest at dead of night.

menehune.aura: Awe from tiny craftspersons urgently fitting the last stones of a vast nighttime watercourse; the physically completed work demonstrates c04/c11/c13/c15 without aura.

basis_claims.quote: Menehune are a mythological race of dwarf-like people in Hawaiian tradition who are said to live in the deep forests and hidden valleys of the Hawaiian Islands, hidden and far away from human settlements.

statement.id: Menehune adalah ras manusia kerdil mitologis di Hawaii yang hidup di hutan lebat.
statement.en: Menehune are a mythological dwarf-like race in Hawaiian lore living in deep forests.

basis_claims.quote: Legend has it that the Menehune appear only during the night hours to build masterpieces, and if they fail to complete their work in the length of the night, they will leave it unoccupied.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, Menehune hanya muncul pada malam hari untuk membangun mahakarya, dan bila gagal menyelesaikan pekerjaan dalam semalam, mereka akan meninggalkannya tanpa dihuni.
statement.en: According to legend, the Menehune appear only at night to build masterpieces, and if they cannot finish a work within the night they leave it unoccupied.

basis_claims.quote: No one but their children and humans connected to them can see the Menehune.

statement.id: Tidak ada yang dapat melihat Menehune kecuali anak-anak mereka dan manusia yang berhubungan dengan mereka.
statement.en: No one but their children and humans connected to them can see the Menehune.

basis_claims.quote: The Menehunes were supposed to have been a wonderful people, small of stature and of great activity. They were always united in doing any service required of them.

statement.id: Menurut catatan Thrum, Menehune dianggap bangsa yang menakjubkan, bertubuh kecil dan sangat aktif, dan mereka selalu bersatu dalam melakukan setiap pekerjaan yang diminta.
statement.en: According to Thrum's account, the Menehunes were supposed to be a wonderful people, small of stature and very active, always united in doing any service required of them.

basis_claims.quote: It was their rule that any work undertaken must be completed in one night, otherwise it would be left unfinished, as they did not labor twice on the same work; hence the origin of the saying: “He po hookahi, a ao ua pau,”—in one night, and by dawn it is finished.

statement.id: Menurut catatan Thrum, aturan mereka adalah bahwa setiap pekerjaan yang dimulai harus selesai dalam satu malam; kalau tidak, pekerjaan itu dibiarkan belum selesai karena mereka tidak mengerjakan hal yang sama dua kali.
statement.en: According to Thrum's account, their rule was that any work undertaken must be finished in one night, otherwise it was left unfinished, as they did not labor twice on the same work.

basis_claims.quote: and were invisible to every one but their own descendants, or those connected with them in some way. Many persons could hear the noise and hum of their voices, but the gift of seeing them with the naked eye was denied to those not akin to them.

statement.id: Menurut catatan Thrum, mereka tidak terlihat oleh siapa pun kecuali keturunan mereka atau orang yang berhubungan dengan mereka; banyak orang dapat mendengar deru dan dengung suara mereka, tetapi kemampuan melihat mereka dengan mata telanjang tidak diberikan kepada yang bukan kerabat.
statement.en: According to Thrum's account, they were invisible to everyone but their own descendants or those connected with them; many could hear the noise and hum of their voices, but the gift of seeing them with the naked eye was denied to those not akin to them.

basis_claims.quote: They were always willing to do the bidding of their descendants, and their supernatural powers enabled them to perform some wonderful works.

statement.id: Menurut catatan Thrum, mereka selalu bersedia memenuhi perintah keturunan mereka, dan kekuatan supernatural mereka memungkinkan mereka melakukan beberapa pekerjaan menakjubkan.
statement.en: According to Thrum's account, they were always willing to do their descendants' bidding, and their supernatural powers enabled them to perform some wonderful works.

basis_claims.quote: At the dead of night he heard the noise and hum of the voices of the Menehunes on their way to Kikiaola, each of whom was carrying a stone. The dam was duly constructed, every stone fitting in its proper place, and the stone auwai, or watercourse, also laid around the bend of Kikiaola. Before the break of day the work was completed

statement.id: Dalam kisah yang dicatat Thrum, pada tengah malam terdengar deru dan dengung suara para Menehune dalam perjalanan ke Kikiaola, masing-masing membawa sebuah batu. Bendungan dibangun dengan setiap batu pas pada tempatnya, dan auwai (saluran air) batu dipasang mengitari tikungan Kikiaola; sebelum fajar pekerjaan itu selesai.
statement.en: In a story recorded by Thrum, at dead of night the hum of the Menehunes' voices was heard on their way to Kikiaola, each carrying a stone. The dam was built with every stone fitting in place, and the stone auwai (watercourse) was laid around the bend of Kikiaola; before daybreak the work was complete.

mixtecatl.depicted_variant: giant human founder of Mixtlan striding across barren Mixteca hills with immediate ankle-high adult scale witnesses

visual_requirements.description: One giant human male son, normal one head/two arms/two legs, plain opaque tunic; tiny nearby ordinary adult figures no higher than his ankle make c01 giant scale unambiguous, no parent snake/frog anatomy.
Giant stride physically displaces loose soil and pebbles at foot; no documented magic, only giant stature.
Barren hills of Mixtecapan/Mixteca, sparse trees and adult witnesses serving solely as editorial giant-scale comparison.

mixtecatl.aura: Respectful founder awe through c01 gigantic stature over adjacent human-scale witnesses and physical c05 hill stride; no supernatural glow.

basis_claims.quote: Mixtecatl (From Nahuatl, 'Inhabitant of the land of clouds') is one of the six giants sons of Iztac-Mixcoatl and Tlaltecuhtli or Ilancueitl that populated the Earth after the Great Flood during the Fifth Sun in Aztec mythology.

statement.id: Mixtecatl adalah salah satu dari enam raksasa putra Iztac-Mixcoatl dan Tlaltecuhtli (atau Ilancueitl) yang menghuni Bumi setelah Air Bah pada masa Matahari Kelima dalam mitologi Aztek.
statement.en: Mixtecatl is one of the six giant sons of Iztac-Mixcoatl and Tlaltecuhtli (or Ilancueitl) who populated the Earth after the Great Flood in the Fifth Sun of Aztec mythology.

basis_claims.quote: The fifth son who founded Mixtlan from where the natives of the region known today as Mixteca come from.

statement.id: Ia putra kelima yang mendirikan Mixtlan, asal penduduk wilayah yang kini disebut Mixteca.
statement.en: He was the fifth son, founder of Mixtlan, origin of the people of the region now called Mixteca.

basis_claims.quote: the «ferocious serpent Of white cloud» which lives in Citlálco, (24) With her is joined in sweet union, Of love, which six tlacámes engender; (25) These brothers dwell on the earth And become the source of many races:

statement.id: Dalam puisi itu, "ular ganas dari awan putih" yang tinggal di Citlálco bersatu dengannya, dan persatuan itu melahirkan enam tlacámes (laki-laki); saudara-saudara ini hidup di bumi dan menjadi sumber banyak bangsa.
statement.en: In the poem, the "ferocious serpent of white cloud" who lives in Citlálco is joined with her, six tlacámes (men) are engendered, and these brothers dwell on the earth and become the source of many races.

basis_claims.quote: The valiant Mixtécatl guards himself From Mixtecápan in the barren hills; (32) ... (32) Today is called simply Mixteca.

statement.id: Dalam puisi itu, Mixtécatl yang gagah berani berlindung dari Mixtecápan di perbukitan tandus; catatan kaki 32 menyatakan bahwa kini ia disebut sederhana Mixteca.
statement.en: In the poem, the valiant Mixtécatl guards himself from Mixtecápan in the barren hills; footnote 32 states that it is today called simply Mixteca.

basis_claims.quote: The Indians believed that the earth was first inhabited by giants, and the large pachyderm bones that were found in a fossilized state in excavations, were their remains. They called them quinametzin,

statement.id: Catatan kaki dalam buku yang sama menyatakan bahwa orang Indian percaya bumi pertama kali dihuni raksasa, dan tulang besar fosil yang ditemukan dalam penggalian dianggap sisa mereka; mereka menyebutnya quinametzin.
statement.en: A footnote in the same book says the Indians believed the earth was first inhabited by giants, and that the large fossilized bones found in excavations were their remains; they called them quinametzin.

wd-q11410474.depicted_variant: Fierce living double-pupilled chicken-like Shuangjing lunging from a threshold with mantled wings as a tiger flees.

visual_requirements.description: One adult lean chicken-like bird: 1head/2natural-size eyes, each single iris containing2 separate pupils; 1beak/2wings/2legs/1tail. Hard lowered stare, wide mantled wings and raised hackles, no comic bulging eyes or gaping beak.
Bird physically confronts the intruder as one distant natural tiger visibly flees; no magical emission or phoenix fire. Tiger explicitly present in full c03 quote.
Chinese house doorway and swept threshold, recalling welcomed visits c03 and door guardians c05; living bird rather than carving.

wd-q11410474.aura: Hard lowered four-pupil stare, physical lunging advance, raised hackles and mantled wings drive off a visibly fleeing tiger, following wd-q11410474-c02/c03 without supernatural emission.

basis_claims.quote: 双睛（そうせい）は、中国に伝わる伝説の鳥。堯の在位70年を記念して献上されたといわれる。別名重明の鳥（ちょうめいのとり）。

statement.id: Shuangjing adalah burung Tiongkok legendaris yang juga disebut burung terang ganda.
statement.en: Shuangjing is a legendary Chinese bird also called the double-brightness bird.

basis_claims.quote: 姿は鶏に似ているが、目の中に瞳が二つあり、鳳凰のような声で鳴く。そして、羽毛が抜け落ちても、羽根のない翼で空を飛んだという。

statement.id: Ia menyerupai ayam dengan dua pupil dan suara mirip fenghuang, terbang bahkan setelah kehilangan bulu.
statement.en: It resembles a chicken with two pupils and a phoenixlike cry, flying even after losing feathers.

basis_claims.quote: 滅多に現れない鳥で、多くても一年に数回、少ない時は数年間も現れなかったという。虎や狼などの猛獣を追い払ったり災害を防いだりしてくれるので、人々は双睛が巣を作ってくれることを願い、家の前を綺麗にしていたという。

statement.id: Kunjungannya yang jarang disambut karena mengusir hewan buas dan mencegah malapetaka.
statement.en: Its rare visits are welcomed for driving off beasts and preventing calamities.

basis_claims.quote: 其未至之时，国人或刻木，或铸金，为此鸟之状。置于门户之间，则魑魅丑类，自然退伏。

statement.id: Menurut Shiyi ji, ketika burung itu belum datang, orang membuat patung kayu atau logam berbentuk burung ini dan menaruhnya di pintu, sehingga siluman dan makhluk jahat (魑魅) mundur dengan sendirinya.
statement.en: According to the Shiyi ji, when the bird had not come, people carved wood or cast metal in its shape and set it at their doors, so that goblins and evil beings (魑魅) withdrew of themselves.

nephthys.depicted_variant: Nephthys commands protection over a wrapped mummy with a barring palm from the solarbarque at creation.

visual_requirements.description: One goddess in plain humanlike female editorial form, fully opaque ceremonial cloth; no wings or unsourced emblem. One fully wrapped mummy.
Protective intervening palm toward viewer and hand over mummy; no invented magic effect.
Solar boat at creation, twilight to early night; starfield/celestial boat staging editorial, not a researched flight mechanism.

nephthys.aura: The documented divine solarboat context (c15) and decisive protection of mummy (c03/c08), without an invented power effect.

basis_claims.quote: was a goddess in ancient Egyptian religion. A member of the Great Ennead of Heliopolis in Egyptian mythology

statement.id: Nephthys adalah dewi Mesir anggota Ennead Heliopolis.
statement.en: Nephthys is an Egyptian goddess belonging to the Heliopolitan Ennead.

basis_claims.quote: Nephthys was typically paired with her sister Isis in funerary rites because of their role as protectresses of the mummy

statement.id: Isis adalah saudarinya dan pasangan dalam ritual pemakaman.
statement.en: Isis is her sister and partner in funerary rites.

basis_claims.quote: Nephthys is a protective goddess who symbolizes the death experience

statement.id: Ia dipandang sebagai dewi pelindung yang melambangkan pengalaman kematian.
statement.en: She is viewed as a protective goddess symbolizing the death experience.

basis_claims.quote: like her she had a place in the boat of the Sun at creation, when she probably typified the twilight or very early night.

statement.id: Budge menyebut tempat Nephthys dalam bahtera matahari saat penciptaan dan kaitannya dengan senja.
statement.en: Budge describes Nephthys’s place in the solar boat at creation and her connection with twilight.
